tei:div.tei:p: ci::bka'agu/ //cho chi/hā sbya 77/snarā 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
si dasna :du ri pa'i 'ab deb bcu ba/gtso sgrig pa/yangs gling rdo rje/ shātā/ /spya sbya/ zlo/ // ༵ r+sha spyu / 〉// /dri /bsgrigs/
3//( cha)chas rtsa rtsa ṭā/ //༵༵༵༵༵༵ khra///ma gyi po)//za masgoṣ+ṭha

si khron bod rig pa'i zhib gdeb bcu ba/gtso sgrig pa/yangasagling rdo rje/si khron bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug bshad sbyong gling dang /si khron zhing chen bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug tshogs pas bsgrigs/si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagamathun sgril dang dmangs gtso ni mi rigs sa khul gyi mi dmangs srid gros dang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las ku'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis yin/ yangs gling rdo rjes brtsams/ mdzod dge bud rnyas bsgyur/(1)gangs can snyan ngag gi lha dam pa a khu yi dam tshe ring lags la rjes dran gyi tshul du spel ba'i snyan rtsom gangs mtsho'i rang mdangs/ khyung dkar gtsug tor rnam rgyal/(63)bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs can bar gyi 'gal 'du thog mar brjod pa gsar rnying rig pa'i rtsod gleng / mdzod dge bud dha/(66)bod kyi rgyal bu 'jang tsha lha dbon la dpyad pa/ 'bum skyabs/(83)bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa dang thun mong ba'i rig gnas kyi ngos 'dzin dpyad gsum rigs pa'i 'dzum rlabs/ mdzod dge bud rnya/(100)bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi ngo bo dang da snga'i gnas stangs la dpyad nas spyi tshogs bde 'jags la phan nges pa'i thabs 'ga' rags tsam gleng ba/bsod nams tshe ring /(128)mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉 la rags tsam dpyad pa/ a sngags tshe ring bkra shis/(156)ser smad dbus bla se ra dge bshes tshang sku phreng rim byon gyi 'khrungs rabs rnam thar/ mdzod dge bud dha/(202)1

rgyal bstan sku phreng rim byon gyi mdzad rnam bsil zer dkar po'i thigs phreng / tshe ring dbang rgyal/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/(220)'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad skor gleng ba/lab phan 'dum blo bzang blo gros/(244)dpal spungs dgon pa'i par gzhi'i gsung rab pe cin dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa glog 'phrul rtsis 'khor gyis 'dra bshus byas pa'i skor gleng ba/kurma rgyal mtshan/(277)bod kyi slob gso'i yon tan pa gso skyong byed lugs kyi ma dpe 'ga' zhig la mtha' dpyad pa/ rin chen mtsho/ mdzod dge bud dha/(298)skad gnyis slob gso'i thabs lam skor cung bshad pa/ ye shes rdo rje/(319)dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rgya bod skad brda'i slob gsor bltas pa'i 'phros don 'ga'/ ye shes don grub/(328)dus rabs gsar ba'i mi rigs slob gso rags tsam bshad pa/dgar dge 'od zer/(346)si khron bod khul la 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i bsam gzhigs rags tsam brjod pa/ bkra shes don grub/(356)bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi gnad don 'ga' zhig mgon po bkra shis/(374)ka rtsom snyan ngag gi skor che long tsam brjod pa mdzub mo ri ston/ 'jam kho/(390)bod yul la bsngags pa zhes bya ba las 'phros pa'i gtam/ sha bo klu rgyal/(403)ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag che long du brjod pa nag po 'gro shes / dngos grub sgrol ma/(417)rtsom rig gsar rtsom khrod du tshig phrad rang dbang can bed spyod byed dus gzab 2

nan byed dgos pa 'ga' gleng ba/ co ne yum tshe ring /(434)slob 'bring slob mar tshig rgyan rig pa khrid skabs dpe rgyan gyi sbyor tshul skor lhan thabs su brjod pa shes rab sgo 'byed/ dngos grub sgrol ma/(447)bod skad kyi byung 'phel thad kyi lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/ 'jam po/(454)bod kyi spyi skad khyab spel gtong ba'i skor gyi bsam gzhigs/ mi nyag kun dga' rgyal mtshan/(476)bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i khrod skye bya ba gcig la byed sgra nyis brtsegs thob min skor cung zad gleng ba/ supo/(486)bod kyi skad yig gi tshig phrad skor cung tsam gleng ba/ chu mdo pad ma bkra shis/(502)the bo'i ming gi 'byung khungs la dpyad pa/ tshe gzungs skyabs/(512)rgyal rong dmangs khrod las byung ba'i khro ri a mye sgo ldong gi sgrung las 'phros pa'i gtam / rdorje/(518)bal po'i mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzhengs pa'i gter ma'i gtam gyi dgos pa'i skor gleng ba/ chu bzang klu rgyal tshe ring /(527)bod kyi rlung rta dang khor yug srung skyob bar gyi 'brel ba la mdo tsam dpyad pa/rig bstan/(534)gzhi rim dge rgan tshos slob ma skyong tshul skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/gnyan mo 'grub/(542)bod kyi bla sprul dag gis deng gi dus skabs su spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang mi rigs mthun sgril sogs la thon pa'i nus pa/ dpala'atsho/(546)mjug byang / (555)3

mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso ni mi rigs sa khul gyi mi dmangs srid gros dang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las ga'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis yin/yangs gling rdo rjeshā brtsams/mdzod dge bud dhas bsgyur/gleng gzhi/de yang krung go rnying ba'i dus su/ lo rgyus thog gi btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul dbang shugs las thon pa'i dbyen sbyor phra ma dang / dbang sgyur rgyal rabs rim byung / lhag par go min tang log spyod dbang sgyur gral rim gyi gnya' gnon mthong chung gi srid jus kyis grangs nyung mi rigs dang rgya rigs bar la 'gal zla 'khon sems gting zab mo bzos nas mi rigs 'brel bar nyen kha chen po byung yod/ grangs nyung mi rigs nang khul du'ang mi dmangs kyis bshu gzhog gral rim gyi ya nga ba'i chab srid gnya' gnon dang dpal 'byor bshu gzhog dngos su myangs shing / mi rigs nang khul du/ da dung dbang bsgyur gral rim phan tshun bar dgra ya 'khon 'dzing gi 'thab rtsod bar ma chad par byung /der brten krung go rnying ba'i mi rigs 'brel ba dang mi rigs nang khul gyi gral rim 'brel ba la'ang mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso zer ba gtan nas med/1

de'i phyir krung go rnying ba ni rigs so so'i mi rigs kyi btson ra yin/krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa 'dis mi rigs gnya' gnon lam lugs rtsa ba nas mjug rdzogs pa yin/ 'dis rang rgyal mi rigs mang po'i gcig gyur gyi khyim tshang chen po'i nang du 'dra mnyam dang /mthun sgril/ phan tshun rogs skyor bcas kyi mi rigs 'brel ba gsar ba zhig dbu tshugs yod par mtshon yod/1950lo nas bzung / grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du (thun mong rtsa 'dzin〉las gtan 'khel byas pa'i mi rigs srid jus kyi 'od stong lham mer 'phros pa'i 'og tu/ rim pa khag gi tang u dang srid gzhung gis nan tan sgos tang gi mi rigs sa khul gyi las don byed phyogs dang srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol nan mo byas shing / las ku'i khrod du ma'o kru'u zhis gsung ba'i bod ljongs su gnad don ci zhig bsgrub dgos na'ang thog mar mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi gnad don gnyis po 'di la bsam blo gtong dgos shing / las ka tshang mar nges par du gzab nan brtan 'gro yong ba byed dgos/ ① zhes pa'i byed phyogs lag bstar don 'khyol byas nas las don la grub 'bras phun sum tshogs pa thob/ der brten mi rigs las don la grub 'bras rgya chen po thob nas grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul gyi rnam par 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po byung yod / 'gyur ldog chen po 'di 'dra byung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig ni/bcings 'grol byas nas bzung rang re'i zhing chen gyi grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul de zhing chen tang u'i 'go khrid 'og mi dmangs srid gros dang tang gi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las ka de lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim so so'i nang du 2

mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis rgyun 'khyongs lag bstar byas pa 'di yin/ las ka de dag bsgrubs pa'i brgyud rim dang khyad chos sogs 'dir rim bzhin so sor bshad nas legs bshad g.yang ṭi 'dren pa'i so phag gi gtam 'di rang gis sngon la brjod par 'dod do/ /lo rgyus kyi dus rim dang po/ 195༷lo nas 1955lo'i lo mjug bar mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis rgyun 'khrongs byas nas mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lam lugs mngon 'gyur byed par skul 'ded btang yod/rang rgyal lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang du rigs so so'i mi rigs phan tshun bar gyi mi rigs 'brel ba la bltas na/ mthun sgril dang mnyam 'brel ni gtso rgyun yin la/ spyi'i 'phel phyogs kyang yin/ 'on kyang snyog 'dzing kyag kyog ldan pa'i lo rgyus kyi brgyud rim zhig kyang brgyud myong ba red/ sngon byung lo rgyus su bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sdud lam lugs can gyi rgyal khab nang du mi rigs gnya' gnon lam lugs gnas yod pa 'dis grangs nyung mi rigs rnams gnya' gnon myong mkhan du gyur yod/ der brten mi rigs 'gal ba dang mi rigs phan tshun 'gal zlar langs pa'ang yod/ dper na/ nye rabs dang deng rabs kyi man ju'i rgyal rabs mjug ma dang go min tang srid gzhung gi log spyod dbang sgyur skabs su/ dbang sgyur gral rim gyis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi mi dmangs la zhi drag mnyam spel zer ba'i 'dul thabs lag bstar 3

byas te mi rigs mthong chung dang / drag chas btsan gnon/ btsan dbang gis rang 'drar sgyur ba'i :srid jus lag bstar byas nas grangs nyung mi rigs dang rgya rigs bar gyi 'khon sems tshabs chen dang 'gal zla rno ngar can du gyur pas mes rgyas gcig gyur dang rigs so so'i mi rigs mthun sgril la gnod pa tshabs chen bzos yod/nga tshos da lta 'di nas thog mar rang re'i zhing chen gyi bod rigs sa khul du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi zhing bran lam lugs 'og tu/ de snga bar skabs shig la nyams su myong ba'i 'dra mnyam dang / mthun sgril/ dmangs gtso'i chab srid kyi shugs rkyen thebs yod pa la phyir 'dang zhig brgyab na/ 1936lor dmar dmag dkar mdzes dang rnga ba'i bod khul du rgyang skyod byed dus go min tang gi mi rigs gnya' gnon la 'gog rgol dang / mi rigs rang nyid kyis rang don rang thag gcod pa'i srid jus dang / chos lugs dad pa rang mos bcas kyi srid jus rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ /'dra mnyam dang / mthun sgril/dmangs gtso bcas kyi mi rigs 'brel ba 'don spel byas/ dmar dmag gis mi rigs sa khul du shes rtogs dang lag len gyi sgo nas thog mar mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gsar 'dzugs byas te mi rigs dang chos lugs phyogs kyi mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril byas/ skabs der le nyin dang si ta lin gyi mi rigs gnad don gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang lag len/ de min rang rgyal dmigs bsal gyi lo rgyus cha rkyen (rgyal spyi gsum pa'i khrid ston dang bod khul gyi don dngos gnas tshul)la gzhigs nas mi rigs rang gis rang thag rang bcad kyi dbang cha (mi rigs mnyam 'brel dang kha bral sogs kyang

yin)/ de min da dung rdzong dang chus dang zhang sogs mi nyung ba zhig tu su'u we e'i srid dbang btsugs shing / de dag gnas pa'i dus yun thung na yang / de ni lo rgyus su sngar byung med pa'i dmangs gtso'i chab srid kyi 'dzugs skrun zhig kyang yin/ dmar dmag gis da dung srid gzhung gis dbu khrid pa'i gsar brje'i dmag dang / nges med rgol rdung ru khag dmar srung ru khag sogs kyi drag dpung rtsa 'dzugs gsar 'dzugs byas shing / dmar dmag thad gtogs dmag dpung hri (7)zhig kyang btsugs/ skabs der dmar dmag nang du zhugs mkhan gyi rigs so so'i na gzhon 2400lhag yod/ khyon bsdoms na mi khri gcig tsam dmar dmag dang sa gnas gsar brje'i drag shugs rtsa 'dzugs su zhugs yod/ dper na/ bkra shis dbang phyug dang / sangs rgyas ye shes(ben pa'o) su'u zhin (mong rdzong gi cha'ang rigs)lta bu'i bod rigs dang cha'ang rigs na gzhon mang po skor zhig dang / wang he min dang / wang tso'o ye sogs dbyis rigs na gzhon mang po zhig kyang dmar dmag nang du zhugs/ kho tsho ni de'i nang gi sku tshab yin la/ der brten dmar dmag gis bod dang dbyis rigs sa khul du gsar brje'i sa bon btab pa yang yin/ dmar dmag gis mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i gnad don sogs la rogs skyor byas shing —/ de bzhin bod rigs mi dmangs kyis dmar dmag la dngos po dang bsam blo'i snying stobs thad nas rogs ram chen po byas yod pa 'brel yod lo rgyus yig char bkod pa ltar na/ bod mis dmar dmag la 'bru rigs rgya ma khri 2000lhag dang / zog lug khri 30lhag bcas sbyin yod/ de ma zad/ bod mis dmar dmag rmas ma 'bor chen srung skyob gso snyor byas yod/ tshul 'di 6

la / teng zha'o phin gyis/ 6khams bod mi dmangs kyis krung go bzo zhing dmar dmag la ches dka' ngal yod pa'i dus su/ dmar dmag srung skyob dang brtan gnas yong ba'i las 'gan la nus pa yod dgu bton yod/ ((teng zha'o min gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs/(1938go 1975)〉kyi shog ngos 162las gsal)/ ces gsungs/ 'dis krung go mi rigs 'brel ba dang bod dang dbyis rigs kyi gnad don thad/ sa gnas de ga'i mang tshogs dang lhag par bod dang dbyis rigs kyi na gzhon tshor chab srid bsam blo'i thog shugs rkyen zab cing ring ba zhig thebs yod par ma zad/ bod dang dbyis rigs sa khul du ches rin thang ldan pa'i mi rigs gsar brje'i sa bon btab yod/ dmar dmag song shul du go min tang dmag shed can dang sa gnas de ga'i 'go ba dpon po log spyod pa dang dgon pa bcas kyis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis gdug rtsub kyis dmar dmag la rogs skyor byas myong ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi gsar brje ba khri stong mang po dmar gsod btang yod pa 'di ni ya nga ba'i gnas shig yin/ lhag par bod rigs mi dmangs kyis tshul 'di la gzhal du med pa'i rin 'bab skyin tshab cig sprad yod pa 'di ni ches shin tu ma legs pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang de yang gzi brjid ldan la 'os shing rung ba zhig kyang yin/ 'di 'dra'i dka' gnas 'gro lam med pa'i 'og tu bod rigs mi dmangs kyis dmar dmag la lhag par blo gtad nas ri 'gog rgyal skyob kyi las su zhugs/ dmar dmag gi dmangs gtso'i gsar brje'i shugs rkyen 'di 'dra ni sngar bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba zhig kyang yin/ dmar dmag song shul du gsar brje'i sa bon de nyid bod khul du rtsa ba brtan zhing rtse

mo rgyas nas me tog kha gad de 'bras bu g.yur du za ba smin yod/ 1939lo la/phun tshogs dbang rgyal ('ba' thang gi 'ba' pa yin)dang shes rab/(mtsho sngon gyi mi yin) dkon mchog bkra shis/(kan lho khul gyi bla brang pa yin) ngag dbang skal bzang ('ba' thang gi 'ba' pa yin)sogs 'jon thang shes rab can gyi bod mi na gzhon khag cig la dmar dmag gi gsar brje'i shugs rkyen thebs te/mar le ring lugs kyi bsam blo dang gung khran tang gi 'go khrid la bsten nas khrong chin grong khyer gyi bod sog slob gru ru bod kyi gung khran ring lugs las 'gul tsho chung dang / slob grogs 20lhag 'dus pa'i tang gi mtha' skor rtsa 'dzugs sa gnas so so'i bod rigs na gzhon khrong chin la 'grim pa'i slob grogs tshogs pa ②gnyis thog mar gsar du btsugs/ de'i rjes su/ da dung stobs ldan ('ba' thang gi 'ba' pa yin)dang / dgra 'dul (sde dge ba)sogs bod kyi na gzhon 'dun ldan shes rab can khag cig gung khran tang dang tang gi mtha' skor rtsa 'dzugs nang du zhugs nas bod khul du mi rigs dmangs gtso'i gsar brje'i las 'gul du ma spel/ 1942lo'i zla 12par phun dbang (phun tshogs dbang rgyal)dang / ngag dbang skal bzang / stobs ldan/ dgra 'dul sogs dar rtse mdo'i lho sgo'i phyi yi brag khung nang du 6me stag sde tshogs btsugs/1943lor kho tshos lha sa nas me stag sde tshogs de tsamatho sgang gi gung khran ring lugs na gzhin mna' 'brel tshogs pa ( mtho sgang gi gung khran ring lugs las 'gul tsho chung yang zer)la bsgyur 'dzugs byas/ 1946lor/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / ha'e krin tha'o (bod ming du mgon po tshe ring zer)ngag dbang skal bzang / ye shes chos 'phel (phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi spun zla 8

chung ba)sogs kyis yun nan bde chen rdzong du 2shar bod mi dmangs rang skyong mna' 'brel tshogs pa mi( 6shar bod dmangs gtso'i na gzhon mna' 'brel tshogs pa'i 'byung khungs snga ma'ang yin)btsugs/ der brten spyi'i rtsa 'dzin dang mna' 'brel sgrig yig gtan la phab yod par ma zad/ gsar brje'i rtsa 'dzin kyang gsal bor bstan nas/ gsar brje'i nus stobs ci ltar spel tshul dang —/ drag po'i 'thab rtsod byed pa'i dgos pa/ bod khul du gsar brje'i brten gzhi'i sa khul 'dzugs pa'i dgos pa sogs kyang bstan yod/ lhag par du 1949lo'i zla 8par/ yun nan nub phyogs sa khul gyi tang us phun tshogs dbang rgyal la gros bsdur byas nas tsamatho sgang gi gung khran ring lugs las 'gul tsho chung gi ming bsgyur te krung gung khams bod mtha' khul gyi sa gnas las don u yon lhan khang (bsdus brjod byas na 4'ba' thang gi gsang ba'i tang mizir)zhes btags/ rtsa 'dzugs 'di'i 'gan khur mkhan gtso bo ni phun tshogs dbang rgyal yin la/ 'di'i mtha' skor rtsa 'dzugs shar bod dmangs gtso'i na gzhon mna' 'brel tshogs pa'i 'gan khur mkhan yang khong nyid yin/dus 'di nas bzung / 'ba' thang lte ba byas nas sde dge dang / bde chen/ lha sa| li thang gi sa cha sogs su gsar brje'i las 'gul rgya cher spel yod/1950lo'i zla 5par/ /shar bod dmangs gzhon spyi khyab las khungs kyis rtsa 'dzugs byas nas/ bod kyi na gzhon shes yon can gyi tang yon dang mna' pa brgya phrag 'ga' zhig gis dar rtse mdo'i dmag don do dam khang gi las gnas brje ba'i bka' bkod dang du blangs nas khag bgos dus bgos kyis dmag phyogs ang bco brgyad pa dang sa gnas srid gzhung du gsar zhugs las don 9

sgrub / kho tsho ni bod ljongs bcings 'grol dang / bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun/nub phyogs khams khul 'dzugs skrun gyi las ku'i rkang 'dzin par gyur yod pa ma zad / bod khul gyi las ka sna tshogs sgrub pa'i nang du nus pa gal chen po yang thon yod/1950lor grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul gyis bcings 'grol la sngon bsu byas pa nas bzung 1955lo'i lo mjug bar gyi dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur ma byas tshun chad du/ nga tsho'i tang gis grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du mi rigs srid jus dang mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi srid jus dril bsgrags dang lag bstar byas shing / btsan rgyal ring lugs 'gog rgol gyi rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las don de tang u dang srid gzhung gi lte ba'i las 'gan gtso bor bzung / tang gi rtsa 'dzugs kyis las ku'i 'go rtsom dus nas bzung tang gi 'go khrid gzhir bzhag pa'i 'og tu zumatho rim mi snar mthun sgril gtso bo dang / gzab nan sgos brtan zhing mdun du skyod pa'i byed phyogs rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ mthun sgril srid 'dzugs dang / snyemathun sgril bde bcos/ 2mthun sgril thon skyed bcas kyi byed sgo spel zhing / las byed pa gso skyong dang / gral rim dgra bo'i 'chal gtam dang gtor bshig phyi ru ther 'don byas nas go min tang gi jag nyul dmag mi lhag ma gtsang sel byas/ 'di ltar byas te rim bzhin bod mi dmangs dang lhag par mi rigs dang chos lugs mtho rim mi sna'i som nyi'i blo dang 'khon sems zhi bar gyur/ de bzhin gung khran tang dang rgya rigs mi dmangs la ngos 'dzin dang shes rtogs thog mar byung / der brten gung khran tang gi dgongs pa la brtsi srung byas te rgya rigs mi dmangs la rgya 10

gsar pa mi(rgya mi gsar pa)zer zhing / spun zla chen po'i go sa la 'jog nga tshos mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril gtso bor byed pa'i byed phyogs de blo sems 'gyur med sgo nas lag bstar byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ mi dmangs mang tshogs la 'brel ba yod par ma zad/ kho tshos mgo nag mi spyi'i gtso 'dzin mi chen zer zhing —/ brtsi 'jog byed pa'i mi rigs dang chos lugs mtho rim mi sna la'ang mthun sgril dam po byas yod pa dang chabs cig tu kho tsho dang mnyam du las don la gros mol yag po dang / mnyam 'brel mnyam sgrub byas nas las don bya ba thams cad bde blag ngang 'grub thub pa byung yod/ gzhan yang / mtho rim mi sna la mthun sgril byas nas rim bzhin mang tshogs dang thag je nye dang kho tshor skul slong byas te thon skyed slar gso dang / spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags srung skyong yang byed thub yod/ de ltar bya ba las don mang bo bsgrubs pa brgyud de/ mi rigs sa khul du mi rigs mthun sgril chen po mngon 'gyur byas shing / mthun sgril gyi rmang gzhi de'i thog nas mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong yang mngon 'gyur byed thub yod pa ma zad/ bya ba las don tshang ma bde blag ngang sgrub thub pa byung yod/1950lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 24nyin krung gung dar mdo sa khul tang u'i 'go khrid 'og dar mdo dmag don do dam u yon lhan khang gis 〈thun mong rtsa 'dzin〉nang gi grangs nyung mi rigs 'dus sdod sa cha la mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lam lugs lag bstar byed dgos zhes pa'i chod don gzhir bzung ste/nub khams ljongs tang us bton pa'i mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril gtso bo byed dgos pa'i byed phyogs don 'khyol byas nas mi rigs chos lugs mtho rim 11

mi snar gros mol gang legs brgyud de rang skyong sa gnas srid dbang 'dzugs skrun gyi las ku'ang spel/ snye nub khams zhing chen bod rigs rang skyong ljongs su mi rigs so so dang las rigs so so'i mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs 'du'i gros mol u yon lhan khang btsugs/ der khongs mi 91yod/ rang skyong ljongs gros mol u yon lhan khang gis rang skyong ljongs mi rigs so so dang las rigs so so'i mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs 'du'i las 'gan dbang cha tshab 'dzin byas shing —/ gos mol u yon lhan khang gis gra sgrig u yon lhan khang yang 'grub par byas / de'i las don gtso bo ni/ dar mdo sa u'i 'go khrid 'og tu mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril gtso bor byed pa'i byed phyogs rgyun 'khyongs dang / tang u la ram 'degs byas nas tang gi byed phyogs dang srid jus dril bsgrags byed rgyu dang —/ rigs so so'i mi dmangs la mthun sgril dang skul 'ded byas te rang skyong ljongs (khul)skabs dang bo'i mi rigs so so dang las rigs so so'i mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen 'tshogs rgyu dang / rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung 'dzugs pa'i 'brel yod las tshan rnams gra sgrig byas/ rigs so so'i mi rigs bar la mthun sgril shugs snon dang / 'dra mnyam/ mthun sgril/mdza' mthun/ mnyam 'brel gyi mi rigs 'brel ba gsar ba zhig kyang btsugs/nang khul gyi dgra ya gyod 'thab la 'dum 'grig byas shing / rim pa khag gi srid dbang btsugs nas dmag phyogs ang 18pa bod ljongs su bgrod pa la rogs skyor gang legs byas/ gzhan yang / jag nyul dmag ru rtsad gcod dang srid dbang rnying ba tshur len dang bdag po rgyab nas thon skyed slar gso dang gong 'phel btang zhing / mi rigs kyi las byed pa shugs cher gso skyong byas nas rig

slob 'phrod bsten dang dpal 'byor tshong gnyer sogs kyi las ka spel/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don shugs snon rgyab nas rim bzhin mi rigs so so dang las rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang mi dmangs tshogs pa rnams rtsa 'dzugs byas te rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung gi rmang gzhi sra brtan dang rgya je cher btang / 'di ni bod khul gyi lo rgyus thog sngar byung ma myong zhing thengs dang por btsugs nas nus pa 'don pa'i 'go bzung ba'i mi dmangs srid gros kyi rtsa 'dzugs nyid yin lags/mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar byed rgyu ni/ nga tsho'i tang gis mi rigs gnad don thag gcod byed pa'i rtsa ba'i srid jus shig yin/ 1950lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 7nas 24bar/ dar mdo nas nub khams zhing chen bod rigs rang skyong ljongs (da lta dkar mdzes khul zer)thengs dang po'i mi rigs so so dang las rigs khag gi mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs 'du 'tshogs shing /'dis ni rang rgyal gyi rtsa ba'i chab srid lam lugs yin pa'i mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen gyi lam srol yang mngon gsal bstan yod/ tshogs 'du der zhugs pa'i 'thus mi khyon sdom 273yod/ tshogs 'du'i steng du (nub khams zhing chen bod rigs rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung gi las 'gan〉dang (srid gzhung rtsa 'dzugs kyi srol yig〉dang (mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag dgos pa'i thad kyi gros chod〉sogs gros 'cham byung / zla 11pa'i tshes 24nyin / nub khams zhing chen bod rigs rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung 'dems bsko byas nas gsar du thon/ srid gzhung gi grub cha'i mi sna'i nang du sangs rgyas ye shes (then pa'o)kru'u zhi la bdams/ da dung kru'u zhi 13

gzhon pa bzhi dang / khrims dpon chen mo/ srid gzhung gi u yon kha shas kyang bdams thon byung yod/ ngas khams phyogs gsar brje'i rtsa 'dzugs shar bod dmangs gtso'i na gzhon mna' 'brel tshogs pa'i sku tshab byas nas thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du'i steng la zhugs pa ma zad/ tshogs chen steng nas skad cha yang bshad / thengs 'di'i tshogs 'du ni ha cang yag po zhig 'tshogs thub yod/krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bsko bzhag brgyud de bod rigs spun zla gtso bo byas pa'i mi rigs dmangs gtso'i khyad chos ldan pa'i nub khams zhing chen bod rigs rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung gsar thon byung / de dang chabs cig tu 'di 'dra'i snga na med pa'i mthun sgril chen po dang snying don gsar ba/ gnam gshis gsar ba bcas nges par du rdzong so sor bkram thub cing khyab nges par ma zad/ de las kyang gsar pa gsar rkyang gi rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung yang thon yong / mi 'di 'dra'i 'thus mi tshogs 'du'i lam lugs ni/ srid jus lag bstar dang / mang tshogs skul slong rgya cher byed pa/mthun sgril la shugs snon pa/ mi dmangs kyi srid dbang sra brtan du gtong ba'i ches legs pa'i thabs bkod dang srid dbang 'dzugs skrun gyi gal che'i las don yang yin/ gyi mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs 'du brgyud de btsugs nas byung ba'i rang skyong srid gzhung 'di ni/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis 'go khrid byas shing / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs su grangs nyung mi rigs rang nyid kyis rang gi mi rigs nang khul gyi las don la bdag po gnyer skyong byed pa'i srid gzhung zhig yin/ 1953lo'i lo stod tshun la rang re'i zhing chen gyi dkar mdzes dang / rnga ba/ le'ang hran rang skyong ljongs 14

(khul)gsum la snga phyir kron chus (khul)rim pa'i rang skyong srid gzhung gsar du btsugs / dkar mdzes khul du btsugs pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung 'di ni rgyal yongs bcings 'grol btang ba'i rjes su thengs dang por tshugs pa'i kron chus (khul)rim pa'i rang skyong srid dbang zhig yin/ 'di la rgyal yongs mi rigs sa khul du dpe mtshon rang bzhin can gyi nus pa'ang yod/ rang skyong srid gzhung ni mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i gros mol gang legs gnang ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog nas skrun pa'i dmangs gtso'i srid dbang gsar ba zhig yin/des grangs nyung mi rigs kyis rang khyim rang bdag byed pa'i dbang cha mngon 'gyur byung yod/ gsar du btsugs pa'i rang skyong srid dbang 'dis gom gang mdun spos kyis rigs so so'i mi rigs bar dang mi rigs nang khul du'ang mthun sgril chen po yong bar skul 'ded btang yod/ srid dbang gsar ba 'di la rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyis brtsi srung byas yod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / thog mar 'di la krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid yod pa dang / mar le ring lugs/ ma'o tse tung gi dgongs pa'i nang gi mi rigs gnad don thad kyi tshan rig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs sogs kyis mdzub ston byas yod pa'i stabs kyis yin la/ tshul 'di ni sa cha de ga'i mi rigs sa khul gyi gnas tshul dngos dang mthun par ma zad/ mi rigs so so dang las rigs khag gi rtsa ba'i khe phan dang yang mthun la/ rgyal khab kyi spyi'i khe phan dang yang mthun pa'i rkyen gyis yin/ da lta phyir 'dang zhig brgyab na/ nga tsho'i sngon gyi rgan rabs rgyal gces mi sna dang mi rigs shes yon can rnam pas/ sngon gyi dus su /khams pas khams khul skyong dgos zhes pa'i bsam blo bton yod pa de yang / skabs der 15

mtshon na/ phyogs gcig nas dmangs gtso'i gsar brje'i bsam pa'i rba rlabs kyis shugs rkyen thebs yod par ma zad/ lhag par go min tang log spyod dbang bsgyur gral rim gyis rgya rigs chen po'i ring lugs kyi srid jus lag bstar byed bzhin pa'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs 'og tu bton pa zhig kyang yin pas sngon thon gyi don snying ldan/ le nyin gyis gal te mang tshogs kyi gsar brje'i rnam 'gyur drag po'i mtho rlabs yar la ma phyur na/ krung go'i dmangs gtso'i phyogs khag gis krung go'i lam lugs rnying ba rtsa gtor gtong mi thub la/ spyi mthun gyi lam lugs kyang rtsod len byas nas lag tu rnyed gtan nas mi thub pa yin/ 'di 'dra'i rnam 'gyur drag pos ngal rtsol pa'i 'tsho ba'i gnas babs la lhag bsam bcos ma min pa'i snying rje dang kho tsho'i gnya' gnon mkhan la khong khro drag po langs nges pa'i sngon rkyen gzhir bzhag yin pa'i thog nas/ de dang dus mtshungs su yang de las ldog ste de la phyir 'di lta bu'i snying rje dang khong khro langs pa yin gsung ba ltar/ krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byas pa'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lam lugs kho tsho'i re 'dun dang blang bya'i dgos pa las yongs su brgal bar byas na da gzod ches sngon thon gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid lam lugs su 'gyur srid la/ des kyang kho tsho'i sngon gyi gdod ma'i mi rigs kyi 'du shes kho na 'gog par byed thub la/ de las kyang lhag par yid sems dang bas mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lam lugs kyi 'gro lam rjes su yi rang byas nas bgrod lam nang du skyod srid do/ /1950lo'i zla 11pa'i 'thus mi'i tshogs 'du'i thog tu/ krung dbyang gis mngags pa'i krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi pu'u krang gzhon 16

pa'am krung dbyang mi rigs don gcod u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa le'o ke yin gyis krung dbyang 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso byas te/ tang dang ma'o tse tung gis bod khul mi dmangs la gnang ba'i thugs khur dang / ma'o kru'u zhi sku dngos kyis phyag bris gnang ba'i phyag bstar yi ge dang / da dung gos dar chen po zhig gi ngos la rgya bod yig rigs gnyis kyi krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rigs so so'i mi rigs rnams mthun sgril byos shig ces pa dang —/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i sku par dang sku par rtags ma sogs 'khyer yong nas tshogs 'dur phebs pa'i 'thus mi rnams la phul/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i 6rigs so so'i mi rigs kyi mthun sgril chen po zhes pa'i 'bod skul ni/ krung go'i rigs so so'i mi rigs mthun sgril gyi rtag brtan dar cha zhig yin la/ nga tsho'i tang dang rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyis yun ring du mthon por bsgrengs pa'i dar cha zhig kyang yin/ mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril byed dgos pa'i byed phyogs kyis mi rigs mthun sgril mngon 'gyur byas shing / mthun sgril gyis mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong yang mngon 'gyur byas yod par ma zad/ dmangs gtso yang skul 'ded byas yod la/ mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi dmangs gtso'i rnam pa 'dis kyang mthun sgril la gom gang mdun spos sgos shugs snon brgyab yod/mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso gnyis gas las don so so bde blag ngang 'grub thub par skul 'ded btang yod/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i /rigs so so'i mi rigs rnams mthun sgril chen mo yong bar shugs snon rgyag dgos/ zhes pa'i 'bod skul de dngos su lag len don 'khyol du gyur nas yun ring zhing gting zab pa'i lo rgyus kyi shugs rkyen thebs yod/17

mthun sgril gyi dmigs yul 'grub dgos na/ de la rtsa don zhig gsal bor nges dgos te/ de ni las don thams cad grangs nyung mi rigs la gros bsdur byed dgos la/ lhag par grangs nyung mi rigs kyi mtho rim mi sna'i blo la 'bab dgos/ de yang grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du/ sngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lo rgyus dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor sogs kyi dbang gis mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi mtho rim mi sna'i nus pa ha cang che zhing / khong tsho ni dbang 'dzin phyogs khag ngo ma yin/ de dus blo mthun la lar the tshom gyi sems khur yod de/dper na/ 'di 'dra byas na gral rim gyi langs phyogs bor nas mang tshogs kyi lta ba med par gyur ba yin nam snyam/ tshul 'di la/ blo mthun teng zha'o yin gyis ci zhig la yang dag pa'i gral rim langs phyogs zer/ de ni dus da lta gral rim 'thab rtsod skul slong mi byed pa la zer/ gyizhes gsung yod pa 'di yang ngo bo'i cha nas mang tshogs kyi lta ba mngon par mtshon yod/ nga tshos phyogs ris pa'i mang tshogs kyi lta ba la tshod 'dzin byas te/ mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril byas na mang tshogs dang kha bral bar 'gyur ba'i lta tshul med par bzo dgos/de las ldog ste/ mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril byas pa brgyud nas 'bring rim mi snar yang mthun sgril byed dgos la/ der brten mang tshogs la'ang shugs rkyen thebs dgos/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi mtho rim mi sna'i sku tshab kyi rang bzhin dang nus pa'i dbang gis khong tsho grangs nyung mi rigs kyi mi dmangs la 'brel ba dam zab yod par ma zad/ mang tshogs kyang khong tsho'i lag nang du yod la/mang tshogs kyis khong tshor yid ches brtan po yod pa'i dbang gis skabs der krung dbyang srid gzhung gis khong tsho la grangs nyung mi rigs dang 'brel ba yod 18

pa'imago nag mi spyi'i gtso 'dzin mi chen zhes brjod la/ rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes pa tshun chad nas bzung ste las ku'i lag len khrod du/ khong tshos nus pa chen po thon yod par ma zad/ mi rigs rang skyong sa gnas kyi spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang / spyi tshogs bde bcos/ thon skyed gong spel/ dmag phyogs ang 18pabod ljongs su bgrod pa'i bya ba las don thad la/ khong tshos ches gal che ba'i byas rjes bzhag yod/ mthun sgril gyi dmigs yul 'grub dgos na/ nges par du dmangs gtso lag bstar byed dgos/ mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lam lugs lag bstar byed rgyu de ni/ ches mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa zhig yin la/ mtho rim mi sna dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis yid ches brtsi 'jog byed pa'i dmangs gtso zhig kyang yin/ mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar byed pa'i rang skyong las khungs kyi dmangs gtso'i rnam pa ni/ mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen dang mi dmangs srid gzhung gnyis yin/ mi rigs las byed pa dang rim pa khag gi srid gzhung las khungs su las don sgrub pa'i mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna dang mi dmangs 'thus mi thams cad ni mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong las khungs kyi rkang 'dzin mkhan gtso bo yin/ kho tsho la brten nas rang skyong gi dbang cha lag len don 'khyol byed dgos/ rang gi mi rigs kyi mi dmangs kyis cherang khyim rang bdag dngos su byed rgyu de ni mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi dngos yod ngo bo'ang yin/ 'o na/ rang khyim rang bdag ngo ma zhig byed dgos na/ rim bzhin chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ lo rgyus thog da dung lus yod pa'ilha don dngos thog gi 'dra mnyam min pa 'dis mi rigs 'brel ba'i thog gi 19

dmangs gtso'i dngos yod ngo bo mngon par mtshon 'dug 'di 'dra'i don dngos thog gi 'dra mnyam min pa 'di rgyal khab dang spun zla mi rigs rnams kyi rogs skyor med par mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong rang nyid gcig bu'i nus shugs kho nar brten nas rtsa med du gtong dka' zhing / mngon 'gyur kyang byed mi thub/ rang skyong las khungs kyis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi yul srol goms gshis dang chos lugs dad pa rang dbang la brtsi bkur dam po dang / grangs zhung mi rigs mang tshogs kyi re 'dod la brtsi bkur bcas byas yod pa 'dis kyi dmangs gtso mngon 'gyur gyi gsal bshad byas yod/ blo mthun teng zha'o phin gyis / zung tshos ngo ma 〈thun mong rtsa 'dzin〉ltar las don sgrub pa dang / nga tshos chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas kyi thad nas bsam pa rnam dag gis kho tshor rogs skyor byas na las don legs 'grub yong nges/ ②zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang skyong srid gzhung btsugs rjes su chab srid gros mol rnam pa gang legs bed spyad de/ mi rigs nang khul gyi las don la gros mol gang legs byas/ 6mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril gtso bo byed rgyu'i byed phyogs de lag bstar byed dgos na/ gtso bo snye gros mol brgyud de mngon 'grub byed dgos/gros mol gyi nang du mthun sgril byas nas kho tsho la rogs skyor byed rgyu dang / slob sbyong brgyud nas gros mol byed rgyu dang / rang gis rang la slob gso dang / rang gis rang la bsgyur bkod kyang byed dgos/ mtho rim mi snar gros mol byed pa'i khrod du rigs so so'i srid gzhung las byed pas bod khul spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul gting zab sgos rgyus lon byed thub la/ mtho rim mi sna'i go gnas dang /nus pa rtogs thub par ma zad/ rang nyid kyi mi 'dang sa'ang 'gog gsab byed 20

thub / mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i thabs lam gtso bo ni gros mol yin zhing —/ gros mol brgyud nas mi rigs nang khul gyi srid dbang 'dzugs skrun dang ske/ spyitshogs bde 'jags/ thon skyed 'tsho ba/ las byed pa gso skyong / nor srid khral len/ 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren sogs kyi las don dang / de min lo bcu phrag 'ga' dang / yang na mi rabs kha shas ring phan tshun dgra yar langs pa'i gyod gzhi tshabs chen rnams kyang thag gcod byed thub/ 1950lo'i zla 7par srid gros dbu brnyes pa nas bzung zla ba kha shas kyi dus yun thung ngu'i nang du/ lo rgyus thog byung zhing lus pa'i gnad don mang po dang / lhag par 'khon sems che zhing mthun sgril med pa'i rnam pa can dang / phan tshun dgra yar langs pa'i gyod gzhi mi nyung ba zhig kyang thag bcad nas med par bzos shing /de tsho las mang bo zhig rjes su mthun sgril dpe bzang can du gyur nas tang dang srid gzhung gis kho tsho la gzengs bstod dang bya dga' yang gnang yod/nga tshos lo rgyus kyi dus rim 'di'i nang du bsgrubs pa'i mi dmangs srid gros dang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don la/ ngal rtsol ba nang khul gyi bzo zhing mna' 'brel dang btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i rgyal gces pa'i bar gyi mna' 'brel rang bzhin ldan pa'i khyad chos mtshon yod/mna' 'brel 'di gnyis mngon 'gyur byed pa'i gnad 'gag gtso bo ni mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril gtso bor byed pa'i mibyed phyogs lag bstar bya rgyu de yin/6 mi rigs ring lugs gnyis la ngo rgol byed pa'i gnad don 'di ni/ mi rigs 'brel ba yang dag pa'i sgo nas thag gcod byed pa dang mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag pa'i thad kyi gal che'i phyogs gnyis yin/ (rtsa khrims〉21

las gtan 'khel byas pa ltar/ mi rigs mthun sgril la srung skyong byed pa'i khrod du / mi rigs chen po'i ring lugs la ngo rgol gtong dgos te/ gtso bo ni rgya rigs chen po'i ring lugs yin/ sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs la'ang ngo rgol gtong dgos/ ma'o tse tung dang / kro'u en la'e/ li'u hra'o chi/ kru'u te/ teng zha'o yin sogs 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i rgan rabs pa 'di dag tshang mas gtan 'khel 'di lag bstar rgyun 'khyongs byas yod/ 'di ni mi rigs 'brel ba thag gcod dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag pa'i srid jus gal chen zhig kyang yin/ 1952lo/ dar mdo sa us ljongs yongs kyi rgya rigs las byed pa rnams la mi rigs chen po'i ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i lhag ro med par gtong ba'i slob gso spel/ 'go khrid las byed pas thog ma nas don dngos dang 'brel te skyon brjod dang rang skyon rang brjod byas nas las byed pa dkyus ma rnams la de bzhin slob sbyong byed du bcug slob sbyong byed zhir dang / zhib bsher byed zhor/ legs bcos byed zhor bcas kyi thabs shes spyad de mi rigs srid jus lag bstar byed pa'i khrod du byung ba'i gnad don la zhib bsher dang nyes skyon legs bcos byas/ slob gso'i bya 'gul 'di la nus pa bzang bo thon yod/ byed thabs 'dis mi rigs las byed pa rnams kyis rang mos sgos sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs kyi 'du shes yod med la zhib bsher byed pa'i kun slong skyes shing blo sna'ang drangs/ 1953lor krung dbyang gis rgyal yongs su mi rigs srid jus lag bstar byas pa'i gnas tshul thad la zhib bsher chen po zhig byas/ de'i rjes su'ang zhib bsher mi nyung ba 'ga' byas yod pa 'dis/ smyo mi rigs ring lugs gnyis ka 'gog bcos dang mi rigs 22

mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag par byed pa'i thad la nus pa chen po thon yod/mdor na/ lo mang bo'i lag len gyis (rtsa khrims〉nang du gtan 'khel byas yod pa'i mi rigs ring lugs gnyis ka 'gog bcos byed dgos pa'i srid jus de ni/ mes rgyal khyim tshang chen mo'i nang gi mi rigs 'brel ba je bzang dang mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag thub pa'i yang dag pa'i srid jus kho na zhig yin pa bden dpang byas yod pas/ phyin chad kyi lag len khrod du mu mthud nas dus rtag tu rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos/ (rtsa khrims〉dang kha bral nas de las gtan 'khel byas pa'i nang don dang 'gal ba'i brjod tshul dang sgrub tshul gang yod pa thams cad ni/ mes rgyal khyim tshang chen mo'i nang gi mi rigs mthun sgril sra brtan du gtong ba la gnod pa nges par 'byung ba'i gzhi yin srid/ 1958lo'i lo smad du/ g.yon gyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen 'og rgyal yongs su sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs kyi las 'gul spel yod pa 'di ni/rigs gzhung dang lag len gang gi thad nas kyang las 'gul 'di'i yang dag pa'i rang bzhin brjod shin tu dka'/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ brgya cha kha shas las mi lon pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi mi grangs khrod du sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs pa khri phrag 'ga' zhig byung yod par byas shing / kho tsho ni gtso bo mi rigs kyi las byed pa dang mi rigs kyi shes yon can rnams yin/ de las ldog te ngo mtshar ba zhig ni/ srid skyong tang gi 'go khrid byas pa'i rgyal yongs mi grangs spyi'i brgya cha 90yan chad lon pa'i sngon thon gyi rgya rigs mi grangs las/rgya rigs chen po'i ring lugs pa gcig kyang byung du bcug med pa 'di yin/byed stangs de 'dras ni mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon gtan nas rgyag mi 23

thub / gnad don 'di'i thad la/ blo mthun lis we han gyis mjug bsdu dang rang skyon rang brjod yag po zhig byas yod/(lis we han gyis brtsams pa'i ('thab phyogs gcig gyur dang mi rigs gnad don〉gyi 'go brjod du gsal)ngas bltas na/ nga tsho'i tang gi srid jus ni lo rgyus dus rim 'di'i nang du legs 'grub chen po byung yod/ rgyu mtshan ni/ des dngos thog bden 'tshol dang —/ bya ba las don yod tshad grangs zhung mi rigs sa khul gyi gnas tshul dngos dang bstun nas bsgrub dgos pa'i bsam blo'i lam phyogs dang / mi rigs dang mi rigs sa khul gyi phyi rol chos nyid la gzhigs nas las don bsgrub dgos pa sogs rgyun 'khyongs byas yod pas yin/ der brten/ sngar dus yun ring bor yod pa'i mi rigs 'gal ba rno ngar ldan pa rnams bde blag ngang thag gcod byed thub yod par ma zad/ las don tshang ma bde blag ngang gong 'phel byung zhing / rigs so so'i mi dmangs rnams kyang yid tshims par byas yod/nga rang la nyams len las byung ba'i myong tshor zhig yod pa ni/ tang gi mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi srid jus dang / 2mtho rim mi sna la mthun sgril gtso bor byed pa'i byed phyogs ni/ nga tsho'i tang gis mar le ring lugs kyi mi rigs gnad don gyi rigs gzhung dang krung go'i mi rigs gnad don gyi dngos don zung 'brel byas pa'i mig dpe bzang bo zhig yin/ byed phyogs 'di lag bstar don 'khyol byas pa brgyud nas tang gi mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi lam lugs mngon 'gyur byed par skul 'ded thon yod la/ mi rigs dang chos lugs mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril dang slob gso'ang byed thub yod/ des kyang 24

rjes su gral rim zhig (zhing bran bdag po'i gral rim)rtsa gtor gtong bar byed pa la gra sgrig gi gzhi ma nus ldan zhig btings yod/ mtho rim mi sna la mthun sgril gtso bor byed pa'i mibyed phyogs lag bstar don 'khyol byed pa'i brgyud rim ni / 6phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten bsgyur bkod byas te/ rang snang gi 'jig rten yang bsgyur bkod byed dgos/ rang nyid kyi ngos 'dzin nus pa bsgyur bkod byas te/ rang snang gi 'jig rten dang phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten gyi 'brel ba'ang bsgyur bkod byed dgos/ (ma'o tse tung gi (lag len gyi rnam bshad〉las drangs)zhes pa ltar yin/ ngas sngon du bshad yod pa ltar/ nga tsho'i bod khul rgan rabs pas /khams pas khams khul skyong dgos zhes pa'i kha 'bod kyi sgrag tshig de ni/ skabs der mtshon na sngon thon gyi don snying ldan mod/ 'on kyang de ltar 'grub pa'i go skabs ni gtan nas med/ bcings 'grol gtong ba'i dus 'gor/ nga tsho'i bod rigs slob grogs skor zhig nub khams mi dmangs gsar brje'i las byed slob grwar zhugs rjes/ tsunang logs rgya'i sa char sa zhing bcos bsgyur byed bzhin yod pas/ slob grogs mi nyung ba zhig kyang kho tsho'i sa zhing bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul nang du zhugs/ de mtshungs su nga tsho'i bod khul la'ang sa zhing bcos bsgyur lag bstar byas nas/ bod khul gyi yul phran rgyal po dang 'go ba dpon po sogs bshu gzhog gral rim med par gtong dgos zhes pa'i yar zhu'i re ba slob grwa la phul/ tshul der zhing chen u yon lhan khang dang slob gas mthong chen byas te/ de ma thag tu slob grwas dus tshod bkod sgrig byas nas nga tshor mi rigs srid jus kyi slob gso gnang ba la brten nas nga tshos kyang de sngar sa zhing bcos sgyur bya dgos pa'i bsam tshul ni/ mig snga'i mi rigs sa 25

khul gyi gnas tshul dngos dang mi mthun par shes byung / da lta sa bdag rtsa med du gtong dgos pa ma yin par ma zad/ da dung kho tsho mi dmangs dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa'i mi rigs kyi gtso 'dzin mi sna'i go gnas su bzhag nas mthun sgril byas te/ kho tsho'i nus pa yod tshad 'don spel byed du bcug dgos/'dis ni nga tsho'i bsam pa la'ang bsgyur bcos byas yod la/ kha lo yang phyir bsgyur yod/ der brten nga tsho'i bsam blo yang tang gi srid jus kyi thog tu gcig gyur yong ba byas yod/ de'i rjes su/ mi rigs gnad don dang / mi rigs srid jus la slob sbyong byas pa brgyud nas lo mang bor mtho rim mi sna la mthun sgril byas pa'i lag len gyi khrod du/ lhag par du tang gi srid jus kyi yang dag pa dang mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i rang bzhin yin pa rang sems la mngon sum tshad mar shar/lo rgyus kyi dus rim gnyis pa/ 1956lo nas 1959lo'i bar dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur ni rgyal kha'i ngang legs grub byung zhing / gom gang mdun spos sgos mthun sgril la shugs snon brgyab nas dmangs gtso rgya cher btang /rang re'i zhing chen gyi mi rigs sa khul du/ 1954lor blo mthun li'u hra'o chis rgyal yongs dmangs chen skabs dang po'i thengs gcig pa'i tshogs 'du'i thog tu gnang ba'i (rtsa khrims kyi 'char zin snyan zhu〉yi nang du rigs so 26

so'i mi rigs tshang mas dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi dgongs don lag bstar bya dgos te/ 1956lo nas 'go bzung ste 1959lo'i bar du/ zhing chen yongs kyi bod dang dbyis rigs sa khul du rlabs che ba'i dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul spel/ de ltar byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lo kha shas kyi ring las don la nus pa ldan pa'i grub 'bras zhig byung yod pa 'dis/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi las sgo phye ba la cha rkyen nges can zhig kyang bskrun yod/bod dang rgya'i bar gyi mi rigs 'gal ba rnams kyang phal cher thag bcad rjes/rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyis dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byed dgos pa'i re ba nan po bton te/ 6 rgya'i sa char sngon nas sa zhing bcos bsgyur byas mod/ nga tsho'i 'di nas sems khur mi byed pa dang shi nyen byung yang mi skyob pa'i rgyu mtshan ci red/ ci'i phyir sa zhing bcos bsgyur mi byed pa yin zhes zer nas mtho rim mi sna'i nang du'ang gong rim la dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur lag bstar byed dgos pa'i re ba bton mkhan yang byung / de bzhin dmangs khrod du'ang khral 'gog dang gla 'gog gi don rkyen yang je mang du song / der brten mi rigs nang khul gyi bshu gzhog gral rim dang rgya che'i ngal rtsos mi dmangs bar gyi gral rim 'gal ba de phyi la mngon gsal dod po byung ba la brten te/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur lag bstar bya rgyu de ni da lta'i 'gro phyogs gtso bo zhig tu gyur yod la / de ni/ dus kyi 'pho 'gyur chen pos 'gro lam bstan/ /'pho 'gyur nyid las gzhan gyis 'grub ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar yin/ 1955lo tshun chad nas/ rgyal yongs su zhing las mnyam las can du 'gyur ba'i las 'gul mngon 'gyur byung zhing —/ tang krung dbyang gis bar rgal dus skabs kyi spyi'i 'gan khur (spyi tshogs 27

ring lugs kyi bzo las can lag bstar dang / zhing las dang lag shes bzo las / ma rtsa ring lugs kyi bzo tshong las rigs la spyi tshogs ring lugs kyis bsgyur bkod byed dgos pa ste/ bsdus na/ 8 can gcig dang bsgyur bkod gsum )dang mi rigs sa khul spyi'i 'gan khur bton yod pa red/ tang u dang srid gzhung gis las byed pa dang mtho rim mi sna rtsa 'dzugs byas nas bar rgal dus skabs kyi spyi'i 'gan khur dang mi rigs sa khul spyi'i 'gan khur slob sbyong byas yod/ der brten/ mtho rim mi sna la dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi gnad don skor gros mol byed pa'i las don la shugs snon brgyab yod/ lhag par du 1955lo'i zla 12par/ khrin tu'u grong khyer nas skabs dang po'i thengs gsum pa'i zhing chen mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen 'tshogs te/ mi rigs kyi mtho rim mi snar gros mol byas shing / khong tshos mgrin gcig tu dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur la brtsi srung byed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/1955lo'i dgun kha nas 'go bzung ste/ rang skyong khul gsum pos rang rang gi mnga' khongs kyi rdzong dang chus kha shas la dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi tshod lta byas nas rgyal kha'i grub 'bras thob/ de ltar rang skyong khul gsum pos 1956lo'i lo 'go nas zhi bde'i bcos bsgyur gyi byed phyogs spyad nas dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur lag bstar byas/ 'on kyang / khyon yongs nas dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byed skabs su/ log spyod kyi lta ba mkhregs 'dzin byed pa'i zhing bran bdag po dang bran g.yog bdag po/ dgon pa'i mtho rim mi sna sogs kyis gral rim gyi khe phan rgyud 'dzin srung skyob byed pa'i ched du lo rgyus kyi gar stegs las phyir 'bud pa'i kun slong gtan nas skyes med la/ kho tshos 28

a ri dang cang ce hri dgra bo'i myul ma'i rgyab skyor la brten nas/ 2mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi dar cha bsgrengs te/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur ni rgya rigs kyis bod rigs bcos bsgyur byas pa yin la/ 6 chos lugs rtsa med du btang ba yang yin par bshad/ kho tshos rang nyid ni mi rigs kyi khe phan srung mkhan dang —/ smyo chos lugs kyi khe phan srung skyob byed pa'i sku tshab kyang yin zhes zer nas/ gung khran tang dang ngal rtsol mi dmangs la 'gran ya byas/ bstan srung dmag dpung dang yul dmag lam lnga'i dpung sde sogs rtsa 'dzugs byas nas drag shugs kyis ngo log zing 'khrugs byas/ kho tshos da dung mang tshogs (lo 18 60bar can)'bor chen la btsan shugs dang g.yo rdzun gyis mgo skor btang nas ri mgor bud de ngo log zing 'khrugs byed du bcug ngo log zing 'khrugs pas dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byed pa'i sngon thon pa bsad par ma zad / las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyi srog dang 'tsho ba la'ang gnod 'tshe btang zhing —/ bcings 'grol dmag gi dngos rdzas 'phrog bcom dang / rdzong dang srid gzhung las khungs kyi mtha' bskor nas rdzong thog sreg bcom dang / bcings 'grol dmag la rgol rdung / 'grim 'grul gzhung lam dang brda 'phrin yo byad sogs bcad gtor btang nas ngan dgu don du gnyer yod pa 'dis ni kho chos tang dang mi dmangs la nyes pa tshabs chen bsags yod/ mi rigs sa khul gyi rim pa so so'i tang u dang srid gzhung gis krung gung si khron zhing chen u yon lhan khang gis brgyud bsgrags byas pa'i 1956lo krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'u yis 'dzub ston byas pa'i bcos bsgyur ni dgos nges yin pa dang / 6 sems thag bcad yod pa ni yang dag pa yin pa dang / snyedamag 'khrug ni bcings 'grol gyi 29

dmag 'khrug yin pa dang / bsgyur na ni dngos gnas kyis bsgyur dgos pa dang —/ rten sa ni gzhi rtsa'i mang tshogs yin dgos pa dang / 6 da dung yang zhi bde'i bcos bsgyur lag bstar byed dgos pa midang / rtsa mang tshogs skul slong /mtho rim gros mol gyi yi ge brgyad po tshang ma bsgrub dgos la/ de snga mi 'dang sa zhig yod pa ni gros mol byed nyung ba de yin pa dang / /'go mjug thams cad du chab srid kyis tshur bsdu 'dren byed pa dang dmag don gyis rdung rdeg gtong ba'i byed thabs la dam lhod shor mi rung ba dang / 6 ngo log zing 'khrug zhi 'jags su gtong zhor dang bcos bsgyur byed zhor byed dgos pa ((da rabs si khron don chen gnad bsdus〉 kyi shog grangs 111las gsal/ si khron mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis 1991lor par du skrun)bcas kyi dgongs don ltar / (dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur lag bstar byed thabs〉 gzhir bzung nas/rgya che'i mang tshosas kyi dbu khrid nas legs smin gyi dus las ma yol bar blo brtan 'gyur med sgos ngo log zing 'khrug zhi 'jags su gtong ba dang dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur phyogs yongs nas lag bstar byed pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi las su zhugs pa yin/ grong sde'i dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur dang dgon pa'i bcos bsgyur gnyis ka gom pa gnyis su bgos te bsgrub dgos pa'i byed phyogs gzhir bzung nas/ grong sde bcos bsgyur gyi rmang gzhi'i thog nas/ 1958lo'izla 10par bod khul du dgon pa la dmigs pa'i 'gog rgol bzhi'i (ngo log zing 'khrug la 'gog rgol dang / dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha la 'gog rgol/ khrims 'gal la 'gog rgol/ bshu gzhog la 'gog rgol/)las 'gul spel nas/ chos lugs kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bshu gzhog la ma lugs bcos bsgyur byas 30

shing —/ chos lugs dad pa rang mos kyi srid jus rgyun 'khyongs don 'khyol byas/1959lo'i zla 3par/ nga tshos tshogs chen 'tshogs nas rgyal dbang tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal du bros pa'i nyes pa la 'dul gtam yang sgrog par byas/ ngo log zing 'khrug zhi 'jags dang dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi las ka kun gyi khrod du/mang tshogs la skul slong dang / chab srid kyis tshur 'dren/ dmas don gyis rdung rdeg byed pa'i /rnam gsum gcig 'dus gyi rtsa ba'i thabs shes spyad yod la/lhag par du mang tshogs la skul slong byed pa ni bya ba'i thog mtha' bar gsum du nges par rgyun 'khyongs byas yod pa'i lte ba'i gnad 'gag zhig kyang yin/ de ltar lo bzhi'i ring gi dka' spyad tshad med kyi 'thab rtsod brgyud nas 1959lor slebs dus/ mi rigs sa khul khyon yongs kyi drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrus zhi 'jags su phab nas/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur la rlabs che ba'i rgyal kha thob pa dang chabs cig tu/ bshu gzhog gral rim dang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs/ bran g.yog lam lugs bcas rtsa gtor lhag med du btang / grong sde'i gral rim 'brel ba la rtsa ba'i cha nas 'gyur ldog byung zhing /zhing bran bdag po dang bran g.yog bdag po'i gral rim yang ngal rtsos gyi khrod du sems sgyur 'u sa sgyur gyi bsgyur bkod kyang thob yod/ de bzhin rjes su rang kha rang gso'i ngal rtsol ba ngo ma zhig tu gyur yod/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs chab srid kyi thog nas yar langs shing / rang khyim rang bdag byas nas spyi tshogs kyi bdag por gyur/ sa med zhing med kyi zhing ba rnams kyis rmi lam du'ang rnyed par dka' ba'i sa zhing dang rmon mdzo/ zhing las lag cha sogs thob nas 'tsho ba je bzang du gyur/ der brten ngal rtsol mi dmangs la chab srid kyi dung 31

sems dang thon skyed kyi brtson sems mthon po snga na med pa zhig kyang skyes/dgon pa'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bshu gzhog lam lugs rtsa rlag tu btang nas / btsun pa dang grwa pa 'bor chen rang yul la phyir log nas ngal rtsol byas pa la brten te/ grong sde'i thon skyed dang rig gnas las don la yar skul chen po byung / dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur legs grub byung ba 'dis/ tang gis grangs nyung mi rigs mi dmangs la 'go khrid byed pa'i dbang cha mngon 'grub byung zhing / grangs nyung mi rigs mi dmangs kyis kyang spyi chogs ring lugs kyi mdun lam mthong thub pa byas yod/ 'di ni lo rgyus kyi don snying chen po ldan pa'i don chen zhig kyang yin/ de dang chabs cig tu/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyis gral rim 'byung khungs kyi rtsa ba'i cha nas mi rigs nang khul dang mi rigs bar gyi 'gal ba dang 'khon sems thag gcod byas yod/ der brten grangs nyung mi rigs dang rgya rigs bar la mthun sgril yang byung yod/ tshul 'di la brten nas nga rang la shes rtogs gting zab mo zhig shar yod pa ni/ mar khe si dang en ke sis (gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam〉 du gsungs pa'i /mi yis mi la bshu gzhog byed pa de rtsa med du btang na/ mi rigs kyis mi rigs la bshu gzhog byed pa'i tshul de yang de dang 'grogs nas rtsa med du 'gro la/ mi rigs nang khul gyi gral rim 'gal zla rtsa med du btang na/ mi rigs bar gyi dgra ya'i 'brel ba'ang de dang 'grogs nas rtsa med du 'gro'o/ ①zhes pa'i tshan rig gi tshig thag bcad yod pa 'di shin tu ngo mtshar che zhing gnad la 'khel yod / mi rigs nang khul gyi bshu gzhog gral rim rtsa med du btang ba 'dis mi rigs bar dang mi rigs nang khul gyi dgra ya'i 'brel ba'i gral rim gyi 'byung

rtsa'ang gting 'gog byas yod/ de'i rjes su byung ba'i mi rigs kyi 'brel ba ni/'dra mnyam dang / mthun sgril/ phan tshun rogs skyor byed pa'i 'brel ba gsar ba'i rigs shig yin/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur dang ngo log zing 'khrug zhi 'jags btang ba'i rgyal kha blangs yod pa 'di ni/ mi rigs sa khul gyi rlabs che ba'i lo rgyus kyi 'pho 'gyur zhig yin la/ spyi tshogs rnying ba nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi phyogs su kha bsgyur ba zhig kyang yin par ma zad/ 'di ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi rlabs che ba'i rgyal kha zhig kyang yin/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi rgyal kha blangs yod pa 'dis/ da dung 6kha 'bral thabs med pa gsum yang mngon gsal du bstan yod la/ rigs so so'i mi rigs dang / lhag par du rgya rigs mi dmangs kyis mi shugs dang / rgyu stobs/ rig stobs sogs phyogs mang bo nas grangs nyung mi rigs kyi yar langs bcings 'grol gyi las don la rgyab skyor chen po byas shing / bod rigs mi dmangs dang lhan gcig tu mthun sgril mnyam byed dang / 'thab rtsod mnyam byed byas par ma zad/ mi mi nyung ba zhig gis rtsa che zhing rnyed par dka' ba'i tshe srog kyang phul yod/ kho tsho ni dus rtag tu nga tsho'i sems gting la gnas shing brjed kyang mi srid/dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul legs grub byung ba la brten nas/tang dang mi dmangs mang che ba'i bar la mthun sgril dam po byung zhing mi dmangs mang che ba'i dmangs gtso yang rgya je cher btang / dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur ma byas gong gi snyematho rim mi snar mthun sgril byed pa ni/ gtso bo spyi'i mi grangs las ches shin tu nyung ba'i mtho rim mi snar mthun sgril bya rgyu de yin la/kho tshor brten nas rgya che ba'i mang tshogs la 'brel ba dang bag chags bzhag 33

yod pa 'di dag ni/ dgos mkho shin tu che zhing yang dag pa zhig kyang yin/dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur ma byas gong gi /dmangs gtso gros mol byed thabs ni / dmag don do dam khang (rdzong gi nang du dmag don sku tshab pa yod)gis bsam 'char bton te/ mtho rim rgyal gces mi snar gros mol byas te khong tsho'i bsam 'char la nyan nas legs bcos byas pa brgyud de/ slar yang khong tshor bsam 'char zhus te 'thad pa byung rjes thag gcod byed pa'i rnam pa can zhig yin / 'on kyang / 'di 'dra'i mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso ni/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen 'og tu lag len byas pa zhig yin pas/ de la bkag rgya shin tu che / dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur lag bstar byas rjes/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs ni tang gi 'go khrid 'og tu zhing bran bdag pos bshu gzhog gnya' gnon myong mi dgos par spyi tshogs su rkang 'dzin mkhan gyi nus shugs gtso bor gyur zhing /rang gi gral rim gyi dge mtshan grub nas zhing ba'i gros tshogs dang mi dmangs kyi drag dpung (rang srung dmag ru)yang btsugs/ de'i rjes su/ zhang gi mi dmangs srid dbang btsugs/ der brten ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyis kyang rang gi re ba dang dgos mkho sogs 'gog med du brjod thub pa byung bas ngal rtsol mi dmangs thams cad kyi zumathun sgril chen po yang mngon 'grub byung / smyo dmangs gtso yang mang che ba'i mi dmangs nang khul gyi dmangs gtso yin/ de ma zad rang gi sku tshab 'dem bsko byas nas rdzong dang khul/ de'i yan chad kyi rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen dang / rgyal yongs srid gros tshogs 'du sogs su zhugs nas spyi tshogs gnas tshul dang mi dmangs kyi re 'dod yar zhu byed chog la/ rgyal khab bdag gnyer gyi don chen gros 'go sogs su'ang zhugs 34

chog dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi dus rim skabs su/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur la brtsi srung byas yod pa de'ang mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i chab srid kyi rmang gzhir gyur yod par ma zad/ mi rigs phan tshun bar gyi mthun sgril gyi ming gzhi zhig tu'ang gyur yod/dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byed pa'i skabs su/ rang re'i zhing chen gyi mi rigs sa khul du mi dmangs srid gros dang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi rtsa 'dzugs des tang gi lte ba'i las 'gan la dmigs te bya ba las don rab dang rim pa mang po spel/ dper na/ dkar mdzes khul srid gros kyis 1956lo nas tang krung dbyang dang zhing chen/ khul u bcas kyi 'brel yod dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi slob ston dgongs don slob sbyong dang brgyud bsgrags byas te/dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi 'brel yod thag bcad dang lag bstar byed thabs skor la gros mol dpyad bsdur byas yod/ 1957lo'i zla 1bor/ dkar mdzes khul srid gros skabs dang po'i thengs gnyis pa'i u yon lhan tshogs kyis gros mol byed pa'i lte ba'i nang don yang / ngo log zing 'khrug zhi 'jags byed pa dang mu mthud nas dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur legs 'grub byed pa'i gnad don de dag yin/ lo de'i zla 5bar/ yang dkar mdzes khul gyi zhing chen dang khul srid gros kyi u yon rtsa 'dzugs byas nas/ khag du mar bgos nas rdzong khag brgyad kyi grong sde'i mnyam las rogs skyor kyi bya ba dang thon skyed 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul sogs la gzigs zhib gnang / zla 6par/ yang khul mi dmangs 'thus mi dang khul srid gros kyi u yon rtsa 'dzugs byas nas rdzong lnga'i dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur dang / ngo log zing 'khrug zhi 'jags/ mang tshogs kyi thon 35

skyed 'tsho ba sogs kyi gnas tshul la gzigs zhib gnang / mi dmangs srid gros kyis mi dmangs mang tshogs la'ang 'brel ba 'dzugs par byas shing / srid gros u yon gyis tang gi slob gso dang du blangs nas dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul khrod du nus pa yod tshad legs 'don byas yod/dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi grub 'bras ni shin tu che zhing / dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur legs grub byung yod pa 'di la rlabs che ba'i lo rgyus kyi don snying yang ldan la/ de ni grangs nyung mi rigs rjes lus nas mthun sgril sngorne thon gyi lam la nges par du bgrod dgos pa'i 'gro lam zhig kyang yin/ 'on kyang / da dung bshad dgos pa zhig ni/ nga tshos 'di 'dra'i grub 'bras thob pa'i ched du/rin tshab chen po sprad yod par ma zad/ mi rigs lus srog blos btang gi gyong gud kyang byung yod/ thengs 'di'i bcos bsgyur ni/ srid 'dzin tang gis mi rigs sa khul du spel ba'i gzhi rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi gral rim 'thab rtsod cig yin la/ dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur ma byas pa'i gong du/ mi rigs las byed pa grangs nyung zhing rkang rtsa zhan pas mtho rim mi sna'i nus pa la dge mtshan lhag par ldan/ nga tsho'i mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi shin tu zhan pa'i dbang gis dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur la bar chad 'gog rkyen chen po byung yod/ thengs 'di'i dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi /brgyud rim khrod du bkol ba'i byed thabs 'ga' la/ 'dang ma phog sa dang / sgug nyung ba/ bzod sgom mi 'dang ba/ las don rags pa sogs nang gi sems 'tshab tshub kyi skyon cha byung yod/ ② ma'o kru'u zhis 1956lo'i zla 7par dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur la gnas pa'i gnad don skor ston skabs/ ru nyes skyon yod pa khas len dgos te/ gros mol mi 'dang ba 36

dang —/sngon dpag mi 'dang ba/ gra sgrig mi 'dang ba/ sgug pa mi 'dang ba/ brtsi bkur mi 'dang ba/ bzod sgom mi 'dang ba/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi rang bzhin mi 'dang ba sogs kyi gnad don yod par slob ston gnang yod/(〈dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi lo rgyus〉 kyi shog grangs 61par gsal/ krung gung dkar mdzes khul u'i tang gi lo rgyus zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2000lo'i zla 12par dpar skrun byas/) slob ston 'di dag las ston pa'i mi 'dang sa rnams rjes su byung ba'i las 'gul nang du mu mthud nas sel thabs dang legs bcos kyang byas yod/ de ring / nga tshos 'das song gi lo rgyus kyi gnad don la phyir 'dang zhig brgyab na/ gnad don 'di dag la yang nan tan sgos mjug sdom byed yul gyi rin thang dang ldan pa zhig yin/lo rgyus kyi dus rim gsum pa/ 1959lo nas 1966lo'i bar mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi sgyur bkod dang spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs srun byed pa'i chab srid kyi dmigs yul 'di'i thog tu mngon 'gyur byas yod/1959lo nas 1961lo'i bar/ rgyal yongs ni /mi dmangs kung hre cher sgrub dang 6 mchong skyod chen po/ dbyin rgal me snyeg byas te/ gom rgyug myur mos gung khran ring lugs su skyod pa'i 2gung khran gyi rlung dang / 2 g.yas lhung la ngo 37

rgol sogs byed pa'i nor 'khrul ldan pa'i lo rabs shig gi nang du slebs yod pa'i steng du/ da dung skabs der rang byung gi gnod 'tshe yang byung bas lo 'di gsum po'i ring gi rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor la dka' ngal ha cang chen po thebs shing / rgyal khab dang mi dmangs la'ang gyong gud ha cang chen po byung nas mi dmangs kyis dka' sdug tshad med myangs yod/ dus skabs 'di ni/ mi rigs sa khul du dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi 'bras bu sra brtan du gtong bzhin pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi sgyur bkod dang spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i dus skabs yin la/ rang re'i zhing chen mi rigs sa khul gyi rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyis kyang de las logs su med par nam ngan gyi gnod 'tshe dang mis bzos gnod skyon/ (las don steng gi zugayon thal drags pa dang mgyogs drags pa/ 2gung khran gyi rlung g.yug pa/ ‘ che gcig spyi gnyis kyi nor 'khrul bya ba sgrub pa/ gzhan yang dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur gyi skyar gsher kha gsab las 'gul sogs kyi gral rim 'thab rtsod) dpal 'byor 'tsho ba'i thad bcas nas dka' sdug tshad med myangs te nyams sad yod par ma zad/ rin tshab chen po'ang sprad yod/ bod dang dbyis rigs sa khul gyi mi dmangs ni rang zhing gi mi dmangs dang mnyam du mthun sgril byas nas dka' ngal gyi 'gag sgo las thar bar byas te/ rgyal khab kyi ched du dka' ngal mnyam khur yang byas yod / rang zhing gi mi rigs sa khul du snga rjes su dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byas rjes/ dus der dam mthud byas nas snga rjes su mnyam las can lag bstar dang rjes kyi mi dmangs kung hre can gyi las 'gul yang spel yod/1959lo'i lo dkyil tsam la/ rnga ba dang / le'ang hran khul gnyis dang zhis 38

khrang sa khul bcas la phal cher mtho rim mnyam las khang mngon 'grub byung yod/dkar mdzes khul gyis dma' rim mnyam las khang mu mthud nas sra brtan dang gong 'phel du btang zhing / 'brog khul du dma' rim mnyam las khang dar spel btang ske/ 'brog khul tu lo 'di rnams la phyugs rigs mang bo shi ba'i gnad don tshabs chen byung / 1959lo yan chad kyi lo kha shas ring la/ thon skyed rgyu cha sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs la spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi sgyur bkod byas nas legs grub byung zhing sra brtan du btang ste/ mi rigs sa khul gyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs dus 'di nas bzung ste gsar 'dzugs gtan 'khel byas yod pa yin/dus rim 'di'i nang du/ mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i rmang gzhi ni zhing 'brog las mnyam las can du 'gyur ba'i las 'gul spel rgyu dang / thon skyed rgyu cha sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs la spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi sgyur bkod mngon 'gyur bya rgyu de yin/ 1962lo'i zla 10par/ rang zhing gis tang gi skabs brgyad pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs bcu ba'i dgongs don brgyud bsgrags don 'khyol byas te/ slob sbyong gi gtso bo ni gral rim gros bsdur dang /dus bab gnad don/ phyogs yongs nas gral rim gnyis ('byor med gral rim dang 'byor ldan gral rim)dang / 'gro lam gnyis (spyi tshogs ring lugs dang ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'gro lam)kyi 'thab rtsod kyi slob gso de yin/ mi rigs sa khul du da dung dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur mtha' 'khyol ba byung med zer nas/de la skyar gsher kha gsab kyi 'thab rtsod mdzad sgo'ang spel yod la/ 'os 'tsham min pa'i sgo nas gral rim 'thab rtsod spyad de spyi tshogs ring lugs sgyur bkod 39

thad kyi gnad don thag gcod byas/ der brten mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong dang —/ 'dra mnyam/ mthun sgril/ thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel sogs kyi gnad don thad la mnyam 'jog sems khur nyung zhing 'dang med/ rgya che'i las byed pa dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis shi lceb gson mchong byas nas spyi tshogs bsgyur bcos kyi rjes su 'brang zhing / dza drag che ba'i chab srid bsam blo'i slob gso brgyud nas zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi go rtogs mthor 'dregs byung ba la brten te/ mjug mthar spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs dang mthun zhing stun pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog nas mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso gsar ba mngon 'gyur byung yod/ 'di ltar bshad chog ste/ mi rigs sa khul du dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byas pa nas bzung spyi tshogs ring lugs sgyur bkod byed pa'i bar 'di ni/ dpal 'byor steng dang / chab srid steng / bsam blo'i steng kun nas mu mthud du mgyogs myur gyis dpal 'byor spyi tshogs lam lugs kyi chags srol kha lo sgyur ba'i brgyud rim zhig kyang yin/dus skabs 'di'i nang du/ mi rigs kyi 'bring rim dang mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna mang bo zhig khul dang rdzong srid gros su bsko bzhag byas yod/ tang gis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi sgyur bkod byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod du mi rigs mtho rim mi sna la mthun sgril dang / slob gso/ sgyur bkod bcas kyi byed phyogs lag len bed spyod byas/ 'brog khul gyi mnyam las can gyi las 'gul skabs su/'brog sde'i spyi tshogs la 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po byung yod/ mi rigs kyi mtho rim mi snas slob sbyong dang / rang gis rang la slob gso/ mes rgyal nang logs rgya'i sa char lta skor/ khul nang du brtag dpyad zhib 'jug sogs spyi tshogs 40

dngos su lag len brgyud nas/ rgyal gces ring lugs dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi go rtogs je mthor gyur zhing / 'di 'dra'i spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur chen po'inang du/ mtho rim mi sna mi nyung ba'i bsam blo'i lta ba la mgyogs myur gyi sgo nas 'gyur ldog byung zhing / mi kha shas kyi bsam blor shugs rkyen thebs te rang gi tshe gang bo'i las skal mdun lam gyi las dbang sgyur ba'i dbye mtshams su gyur yod / kho tsho'i nang gi sku tshab mi sna kha shas zhing chen dang / khul/ rdzong mi dmangs srid gros kyi khongs mir gyur zhing / chab srid kyi steng nas bsko bzhag 'os 'tshams dang / 'tsho ba'i steng nas dgos mkho skong bar byas yod/ mi la la zheng chen dang / khul/ rdzong gi 'go khrid las byed par gyur yod/ kho tsho'i nang gi mi mang che bas chab srid bsam blo'i cha nas gung khran tang gi 'go khrid brtsi srung byed la/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs kyang brtsi srung byed par ma zad / mes rgyal gcig gyur dang mi rigs mthun sgril yang srung skyob byed/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs 'og tu/ rgya che'i zhing ba 'brog pa rnams thun mong gi zhing bar gyur nas/ spyi 'ogs ring lugs brtsi srung byed pa'i ngal rtsol par gyur yod/ 1962lo nas 1966lo'i (rig gnas gsar brje'i sngon)bar grong gseb nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi slob gso dang zugatsang bsher bzhi'i las 'gul spel/ lo 'di dag la/ mi rigs sa khul gyi spyi tshogs cung zad brtan po yin la/ grong gseb kyi dpal 'byor la 'phel rgyas nges can byung yod/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yang cung zad je bzang du gyur yod/ tang gi chos lugs srid jus lag len don 'khyol byas yod par brten nas chos lugs khag gi mi sna la brtsi bkur cung zad thob yod/ chos lugs bya 'gul gyi mdzad 41

sgo yang phal cher sgrub thub pa byung yod/ de'i rkyen gyis dus rim 'di la/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs kyi rmang gzhi'i steng nas mthun sgril gsar ba mngon gyur byed thub pa byung yod/ mi dmangs mang tshogs dang rim gras khag so so'i mi sna'i blo kha cung brtan por gyur yod/'on kyang / mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso rgyun 'khyongs byed pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim khrod du/ nor 'khrul mi nyung ba byung yod la/ lam kyag kyog mi zhung ba'ang bgrod yod/ gtso bo ni g.yon lhung dang 'tshab 'tshub kyis 'grub par byed pa'i bsam blo'i shugs rkyen yin/ /mi rigs gnad don gyi ngo bo ni gral rim gyi gnad don yin zhes pa'i nor 'khrul can gyi rigs gzhung gi slob ston 'og tu/ gral rim 'thab rtsod 'di nyid ni dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur dang /ngo log zing 'khrug zhi 'jags/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi sgyur bkod bcas kyi thad nas rgya skyed gtong ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur zhing / las don khrod du grangs nyung mi rigs dang mi rigs sa khul gyi gnas tshul dngos la mi stun par byed pa dang / mi rigs dang sa khul gyi khyad chos dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhin la mnyam 'jog mi byed pa'i gnad don 'di dag gis mthun sgril gyi rgya skyed pa dang dmangs gtso gom gang mdun spos kyis rgya je cher spel bar 'gal ba'i shugs rkyen yang bzos yod/ gnad don 'di dag la nges par bsam gzhig nan mo dang legs nyes phyogs sdom byed pa'i rin thang chen po ldan yod par ma zad/ phyin chad blang dor gyi bslab bya'i me long du yang 'dzin par byed dgos /42

lo rgyus kyi dus rim bzhi ba/ 1966lo nas 1976lo'i bar gyi rig gnas gsar brje chen pos mi rigs mthun sgril dang sbyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid gtor brlags byas nas rtsa med du btang yod/rig gnas gsar brje chen po ni/ ma'o kru'u zhi sku dngos kyis 'go khrid byas nas skul slong byas pa yin la/ lin pi'o dang cang ching gsar brje ngo log pa'i tshogs khag gnyis gas bed spyod byas pa zhig kyang yin/ 'dis tang dang rgyal khab/ rigs so so'i mi dmangs rnams la gyong gud tshabs chen brgyab nas nang 'khrug zhig tu gyur/ nang 'khrug 'di'i nang du/ 6 mi bzhi shog khag gis tang gi dbang cha g.yo 'phrog byed pa'i ched du/ gsar brje'i 'go khrid las byed pa 'bor chen zhig la ma rtsar 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa dang / myul ma/ tshogs khag nag po sogs kyi nyes ming bkal zhing / ya nga ba'i 'thab rtsod byas nas snying rje med par rdung rdeg btang ste/ mi mi nyung ba zhig la gnod 'tshe byas nas tshe srog blangs/ da dung gsar brje shes yon can rnams la log spyod rig gzhung mkhas dbang gi ming ngan btags shing / grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pa 'bor chen la mnar gcod kyang btang yod/ 8mi bzhi shog khag gis tang gi rigs gzhung gi bden rdzun dang / lam phyogs kyi bden rdzun/bsam blo'i bden rdzun kun dkrug par byas nas dgra gnyen gyi rnam bzhag go 43

ldog nas rnyog sre byas/ /mi bzhi shog khag gis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khrims kyis skyong ba la gtor rlag byas nas mi dmangs srid gros dang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don la yang phyogs kun nas gtor rlag bzos/ srid gros u yon dang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur byed yul gyi mi sna sogs lha 'dre gdon bgegs su rtsis te srid dbang sger 'dzin bya yul du gyur nas sdug bsngal tshad med brjod yul las 'das pa myangs/ srid gros kyi las khungs ni sa bdag gi las khungs yin zer nas mdze bo'i ra ba lta bur gyur te/ 'brel gtug byed phod mi med par gnas/ mi rigs gnad don gyi thad nas/ 6 mi bzhi shog khag gis spyi tshogs ring lugs su gyur zin pas mi rigs zhes pa zhig yod don med ces mi rigs dngos su yod pa dang / mi rigs las don gnyis khas mi len pas mi rigs mthun sgril la gtor rlag byas yod/ kho tshos da dung ma'o kru'u zhis 1963lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 8nyin gsungs pa'i (a me ri ku'i mi nag gis a ri'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis mi'i rigs brgyud tha dad la mthong chung gnang bar drang bden gyi 'thab rtsod byas pa la rogs skyor byed pa'i gsal bsgrags〉kyi nang du/ /mi rigs 'thab rtsod de/ mthar gtugs nas bshad na/ gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi gnad don zhig red ces pa'i dpyad gtam yang dag 'di nyid kho tshos bed spyod byas shing / 'brel log brgyab yod la/ tshig don dum bcad byas nas go ba log par blangs yod par ma zad/ tshig dum 'di (ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung btus〉 nang du bzhag nas nor 'khrul gyis lung gi rten gzhir bzung ste/ rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su mu mthud nas gral rim 'thab rtsod 'di mi rigs sa khul gyi 'gal ba gtso bor bzung / der 44

brten mi rigs sa khul du gral rim 'thab rtsod rgya chen po byas yod/ mi rigs sa khul du dus snga mo nas mi dmangs srid gzhung btsugs zin pas/ bshu gzhog bral rim yang snga mo nas med par btang yod la/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs mngon 'gyur byas yod pa'i cha rkyen 'og tu/ da dung /mi rigs gnad don de don dngos su gral rim gyi gnad don zhig red ces pa'i nor 'khrul gyi rigs gzhung rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ nor 'khrul gyi rigs gzhung 'dis kyang rgyal yongs kyi mi rigs las don la 'dzub ston byas pa la brten nas mi rigs las don 'di log lam du song ba red/ kho tshos sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs zer ba'i zhwa mo bed spyad nas grangs nyung mi rigs las byed pa mang por rdung rdeg byas shing / 'ba' thang gi gsang ba'i tang la'ang rdung deg byas par ma zad/'ba' thang gi gsang ba'i tang dang des 'go khrid byas pa'i shar bod dmangs gtso'i na gzhon mna' 'brel tshogs pa (bsdus ming la/ /shar bod dmangs gzhon )zhes pa'i gsar brje rtsa 'dzugs 'di yang 6myul ma'i rtsa 'dzugs dang /smyo gsar brje ngo log pa'i rtsa 'dzugs kyi gras su bzhag ste/ gsar brje la byas rjes yod pa'i gsang ba'i tang de'i tang yon dang mna' 'brel pa 'bor chen la ya nga ba'i mnar gcod tshad med byas yod par ma zad/ bod ljongs dang si khron bod khul du rgya khyon che ba'i 'thab rtsod dgag pa brgyab/ de las mi kha shas kyis kyang khyim gtor mi bsad kyi sdug bsngal mig gis lta mi bzod pa myangs yod / /shar bod dmangs gzhon gyi gnad don ni tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzom gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes kyi 1982lo la da gzod krung gung si khrin zhing chen u yon lhan khang gi rtsa 'dzugs pu'u yis 45

dkar 'don dag sel byas/ de bzhin de'i gnas tshul kyang tshod 'dzin bkag sdom yod pa'i sgo nas rdzong yan chad kyi las byed pa'i nang du khyab bsgrags byed du bcug yod/ 1968lor/ rig gnas gsar brje'i ches g.yon thal drags pa'i lam phyogs kyi dug rgyun dang shugs rkyen thebs nas/ rnga ba khul du/ rnga ba rdzong dang / mdzod dge rdzong / rme ba (hong yon)rdzong / 'dzam thang rdzong / zung chu rdzong (gtso bo ni dmu dge'i sa cha yin)sogs 'brog rdzong lnga la/ ngo log gsar ba zer ba'i don rkyen bzos yod/ rig gnas gsar brje'i nang gi drag po'i 'thab rtsod la/ /ngo log gsar ba red zer nas thag bcad yod/ mang tshogs khri phrag gsum lhag ngo log ring 'khrug pa red zer nas thag bcad yod pa 'dis / ngo bo mi 'dra ba'i 'gal ba gnyis mnyam bsres tshabs chen byas te go log tu sdeb yod/ nor 'khrul gyi gyod gzhi 'dis/ mi rigs mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso la gtor brlag tshabs chen byas yod par ma zad/ mi rigs 'brel ba dang tang dang mang tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba la'ang gtor rlag byas yod/lo rgyus kyi dus rim lnga ba/ 1976lo'i zla 1༷bar /mi bzhi shog khag rtsal du brlags rjes su/ zing bcos yo bsrang brgyud nas bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed dang krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i sbyi tshogs ring lugs lag len byed pa'i khrod du mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis yang bskur slar gso dang rgyun 'khrongs byas yod/1976lo'i zla 10bar/ krung dbyang chab srid cus kyis rgyal yongs mi 46

dmangs kyi 'dod blo'i tshab byas nas dus gcig nyid la cang ching gsar brjer ngo log tshogs khag rdul du brlags nas tang 'jig nyen las skyob pa dang /gsar brje yang 'jig nyen las skyob par byas pa 'dis/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar ba zhig gi nang du khrid yod/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis dga' ba'i glu blangs/ skyid pa'i bro 'khyab/ tang krung dbyang gis 'phral du dus thog la rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi 'go khrid byas nas cang ching gsar brjer ngo logs tshogs khag gi nag nyes la dgag pa chen po rgyag pa'i byed sgo spel te/kho tsho'i gsar brjer ngo log gi tshogs khag ma lag la ther 'don dang gtsang bsher brgyab nas/ /mi bzhi shog khag gi dug rgyun dang shugs rkyen kun dag 'don byas yod/ 1978lo'i zla 12par/ tang krung dbyang gis tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs / 'di ni rgyal khab btsugs rjes su nga tsho'i tang gis lo rgyus thog don snying zab cing ring ba ldan pa'i rlabs chen gyi kha phyogs bsgyur mtshams shig yin la / thengs 'di'i tshogs chen thog tu/ blo mthun teng zha'o phin gyis bsam blo bcings 'grol dang / dngos thog bden 'tshol/ rdog rtsa gcig bsgril gyis mdun la blta ba bcas byed dgos/ mizhes pa'i byed phyogs slob ston gnang / tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs kyis phyogs yongs nas rig gnas gsar brje'i khrod du g.yon thal drag pa'i lam phyogs dang / rig gnas gsar brje'i snga gzhug tu g.yon la phyogs pa'i nor 'khrul la nan tan gyis yo bsrang byas/ rgyagral rim 'thab rtsod rkang du 'dzin pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs la mi 'tsham pa'i kha 'bod 'di 'phral du 'bod mtshams bzhag nas las ku'i gtso 47

phyogs spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i thog la 'khor dgos pa'i 'thab jus bton yod pa 'dis/ tang gis mar khe si ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i lam phyogs dang / chab srid lam phyogs/ rtsa 'dzugs lam phyogs rnams yang bskyar gsar du gtan la phab pa mtshon yod par ma zad/tang yang mar khe si ring lugs kyi 'khor lam nang du bud nas skyod pa'ang mtshon yod/ tang krung dbyang gis zing bcos yo bsrang 'don par byas te/srid jus rab dang rim pa mang bo don 'khyol byas yod/ bzos rdzun 'phyug gsum gyi gyod gzhi 'bor chen la dag sel nus ldan byas te/ byed thabs gom rim ldan pa'i sgo nas rgyal khab btsugs tshun gyi lo rgyus thog lus pa'i gnad don dang / da lta dngos su yod pa'i chab srid kyi 'tsho ba'i nang du byung ba'i gnad don thag gcod byas/ de las lo rabs lnga bcu ba'i dus mjug gi dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur skabs su byung ba'i ngo log zing 'khrug rgya skyed can du btang ba'i gnad don gal chen 'di yang 'dus yod/ de ltar rgyal khab 'di la chab srid thad dang dpal 'byor thad tshang ma nas gnas tshul shin tu bzang ba'i dus bab cig byung zhing / mi rigs sa khul gyis tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don nan tan sgos slob sbyong dang lag bstar byas nas bsam blo la bcings 'grol thob cing mi rigs dang chos lugs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid jus/ las byed pa'i srid jus/ shes yon can gyi srid jus sogs lag len don 'khyol byung yod/1979lo'i zla 10par/ krung gung si khron zhing chen u yon lhan khang nas 'tshogs pa'i rdzong u hru'u ci'i tshogs 'du'i thog tu/ rnga ba khul gyi tshogs 48

bzhugs mi snas skabs der rgyal yongs su rlung ltar grags pa'i mi rigs gnad don gyi ngo bo ni don dngos su gral rim gyi gnad don yin/ zer ba'i nor 'khrul gyi rigs gzhung 'di la dgag pa nus ldan brgyab yod par/ zhing mus rgyab skyor dang bsngags brjod gdengs 'jog dngos su gnang yod/1980lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes 7nyin gyi tang krung dbyang gis 〈bod kyi las don skor kyi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i zin bris gnad bsdus〉 brgyud spel byed rgyu'i skor gyi brda tho las nor 'khrul ldan pa'i rigs gzhung 'di la dgag pa brgyab yod / 1980lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 15la/ mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par gyi dpyad brjod pas par ngos yug gcig can gyi rtsom yig cig bris nas rigs gzhung nor 'khrul can 'di la sun 'byin pa'i dgag pa brgyab yod/ de ltar rgyal yongs mi rigs las don gyi slob ston bsam blo yo bsrang byed pa'i phyogs la byas rjes bzhag yod/ da dung 'di nas bshad dgos pa zhig ni/ 1978lo/rnga ba khul gyi las byed pa dang mang tshogs kyis ngo log zing 'khrug gsar ba'i gnad don la dkar 'don dag sel byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/ kho tshos ci'i phyir rig gnas gsar brje'i nang du/ nang logs rgya'i sa cha nas drag chas 'thab rtsod byed pa la gyen log zer zhing / bod khul du drag chas 'thab rtsod byed pa la ngo log zing 'khrug zer/ des na nga tshor dkar 'don byed dgos zhes bshad / de'i rjes su/ khul us zhing u dang tang krung dbyang la yar zhu byas shing —/ de ltar chog mchan yang gnang ste/ dngos gzhi nas kun la phyogs yongs nas 1968lo rnga ba dang / mdzod dge me ba/(hong yon) 'dzam thang / zung chu rdzong (gtso bo dmu dge'i sa cha yin)bcas rdzong lnga'i zhing 'brog pa'i mang tshogs 49

kyis 2rig gsar nang dul gyen log gi bya 'gul byas pa la/ 2'khrug gsar (ngo log zing 'khrug gsar ba)zhes pa'i gyod gzhi nor 'khrul can 'di la dkar 'don dag sel byas yod/ 'khrug gsar dkar 'don byed pa'i bya ba ni gal chen gnad chen gyi byed thabs shig yin te/ des tang gi dngos don bden 'tshol gyi rtsa don rgyun 'khyongs byas nas mang tshogs 'bor chen la mthun sgril byed thub yod la/ mi rigs kyi 'brel ba dang tang dang mang tshogs kyi 'brel ba'ang je legs su btang yod/ mang tshogs kyi chab srid mos sems dang 'tsho ba gsar ba 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i hur brtson rang bzhin je mthor btang zhing /skabs bcu gsum pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i dgongs don gyi 'od stong gis gangs ri'i spang ljongs yongs su khyab par byas yod / 1978lo tshun chad nas/ bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed dang spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i lo rgyus kyi dus rabs gsar ba zhig la slebs shing / rang zhing gi mi rigs sa khul gyi tang u dang srid gzhung la sogs pa'i 'brel yod phyogs so so nas/ mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i thad la 'bad brtson chen po byas te/ grub 'bras chen po'ang thob yod/ der brten mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas je mgyogs su song yod/1980lo tshun chad nas/ krung dbyang dang zhing us grong gseb kyi nang du rong 'brog dud tshang la thon sbrel 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag len byas te/ rong 'brog pa rnams la thon skyed kyi dbang cha rang la dbang ba'i go skabs byin yod/der brten kho tsho'i thon skyed kyi hur brtson rang bzhin sngar las lhag par je 50
