mthor gyur/ rgyal khab kyis ma dngul mang po ma btang yang / rang stobs rang spel rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ zhing phyugs las thon skyed gong 'phel mgyogs tsam byung yod/ lhag par krung dbyang gis nub rgyud gsar spel chen po byas tshun chad nas / ma dngul je mang du btang ste/ mi rigs sa khul ni rgal ba'i rnam pa can gyi 'phel rim du slebs shing / mang tshogs kyi thon skyed 'tsho ba lo re nas lo rer gong 'phel du song yod la/ mi rigs rig gnas slob gso'i phyogs la'ang gong 'phel che tsam byung yod/ nyin 'ga'i sngon du/ nga dkar mdzes khul du rtog zhib la song nas shes byung ba zhig ni/ dkar mdzes khul us khul yongs kyi bod dang rgya rigs las byed pa tshang mas bod yig slob sbyong byed dgos par ma zad/rgyugs sprod zhib bsher brgyud nas go gnas yar 'phar ba'i cha rkyen gyi gras su 'jog dgos pa gtan 'khel byas yod/ khul us da dung / zhing chen bod yig slob grwa'i nang du/ slob ma 80dang / slob yun lo gnyis can gyi 'dzin grwa zhig ched du btsugs nas las thog tu yod pa'i las byed pa rnams 'khor res byas nas bod yig sbyong brdar byed pa'i rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ dus yun ring bor rgyun 'khyongs byed bzhin yod/ ngas bltas na/ byed stangs 'di dag la don snying chen po ldan 'dug rig gnas slob gso'i gnad don ni chab srid dang / dpal 'byor la 'brel ba dam po yod par ma zad/ mi rigs shig gnas pa dang 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i rtsa ba'i gnad don zhig tu gyur yod/ bcings 'grol byas ma thag pa'i dus su/ blo mthun teng zha'o phen gyis lho nub cus su phyag las gnang skabs su/ chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas gsum gyi thad nas grub 'bras shig thob nus na/ da gzod mi rigs rang gi las don legs 51

por bsgrub thub par gsungs shing / gzhan yang khong gis /'dir bshad pa'i rig gnas ni/ gtso bo kho tsho'i mi rigs rang gi rig gnas la zer ba yin/ (teng zha'o phen gyi 〈lho nub grangs nyung mi rigs kyi gnad don skor〉las drangs) zhes gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ dkar mdzes khul u dang / khul srid gzhung gis mi rigs rig gnas slob gso la ha cang mthong chen byas te/kho tshos slob grwa'i skad gnyis (bod yig dang rgya yig)slob gso'i slob khrid dam 'dzin hur brtson byed pa dang dus mtshungs su/ nan tan gyis las byed pa'i bod yig slob sbyong dam 'dzin yag po byed bzhin yod/ de bzhin bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong byed pa'i srol rgyun bzang bo bskyar gso dang dar spel btang zhing —/ kho tshos rgyal khab kyis gnyer ba'i slob gso dam 'dzin legs po byed pa dang dus mtshungs su/ spyi tshogs kyis gnyer ba'i slob gso'i skor la rgyal khab kyis 'bod skul gnang ba yang dang du blangs nas/ dgon pa'i gzhung ngam bla grwa rang sger dang mi sger gyis gnyer ba'i slob sgrub rnam pa gang yod la rgyab skyor byas te/ bod yig slob gso dar spel btang nas deng rabs rig gnas shes yon slob sbyong byed pa'i thad la grub 'bras legs po thob bzhin yod/ mi rigs yi ge slob sbyong byed pa'i gnad don 'di/ mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas bzang bo brgyud 'dzin dang dar spel gtong ba la dmigs te/ lhag par bod yig slob sbyong dang phyogs yongs nas bod yig bed spyod gtong ba zung 'brel byas te/ mi rigs kyi yi ge dang skad gnyis (bod yig dang rgya yig)yon tan pa'i thon khungs kyi sgo yangs por phye nas bed spyod kyang byed dgos/ 'di ltar byas na/ mi rigs sa khul gyi rmang gzhi'i slob gso gong 'phel du 'gro la/52

rig gnas dar rgyas/ spyi tshogs nying 'jags/ mi rigs mthun sgril/ ngal rtsol pa'i khyon yongs kyi rkang rtsa sogs kyang je bzang du 'gro thub par ma zad/phyogs kun la nus pa chen po thon nges/ 'dis mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi tshad je mgyogs dang rkang rtsa je bzang du 'gro ba'i gnad don yang thag gcod byed thub pa yin/ des na 'di ni/ mi rigs srid jus dang mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi srid jus don dngos su lag bstar byed pa'i 'gan khur gal chen zhig yin la/ rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs la mi rigs rig gnas gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i re ba skong bar byed pa'i dgos mkho yang yin/ bod mi rigs kyis thog mar mi rigs rang gi ma skad de bod yig gi lus phung gis theg pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas de khong du chud par byas te/ de dang chabs cig tu rgyal khab phyi nang gi sngon thon rig gnas gang yod pa rnams dang lhag par rgya'i rig gnas rang gi phyogs su len phod pa byed dgos la/ de'ang legs par sbyangs nas grub 'bras yod par byed dgos/ nga tsho la nges shes zab mo zhig thob yod pa ni/ phyi nas 'ongs pa'i rig gnas gang yin yang / thams cad mi rigs rang gi rig gnas dang 'brel ba byas nas brje res byed dgos la/ mi rigs rang gis de la las snon dang bzo bcos brgyab te / mi rigs rang gi rnam pa (bod kyi skad yig)can du gyur na/ da gzod de'i bcud tshur blangs nas zhu bar byed thub pa yin/ de dang dus mtshungs su/ mu mthud nas gsar btod byas te/ mi rigs rang gi rig gnas lus su gyur pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rig gnas gsar ba 'grub par byed dgos/ 'di ni /rgyu mang lus gcig gi krung hwa rig gnas chen po'i chags dbyibs mngon par 53

byed pa dang 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i phyogs gcig kyang yin/ lo ngo lnga bcu lhag gi ring la/ nga tshos mi rigs slob gso'i thad la dka' khag myong ba'i sgo nas 'tshol zhib byas pa dang / mi rigs slob gso'i kyag kyog gi 'phel rim 'dis bden dpang byung yod pa zhig ni/ 'di ltar ma byas na lam kyog tu 'gro la/gyong gud kyang thebs nges yin phyir/ tshul 'di las pham kha'i bslab cibya zab mo len rgyu yod pa shes gal che/ de ma zad/ sems thag bcad nas legs bcos byed rgyu'ang gal shin tu che/ deng skabs/ ches gal che ba'i gnad don thog ma zhig ni/ mi rigs sa khul gyi 'go khrid gtso bo kha shas la/ mi rigs srid jus dang rtsa khrims kyi 'du shes zhan pa dang / slob gso'i chos nyid mi shes pa/ shes rtogs kyi chos nyid mi shes pa/ bod yig khong du chud pa'i don snying chen po mi shes pa sogs kyi gnad don yod pa 'di dag bsgyur bcos byed dgos pa yin la / 'di'i dbang gis bod kyi skad yig shes yon can gso skyong byed pa'i srid jus lag len don 'khrol mi byed pa dang / de la mthong chen mi byed pa'i gnad don 'di dag byung ba'ang yin/ gnad don gnyis pa ni/ bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bod kyi skad yig phyogs yongs nas bed spyod gtong ba dang skad gnyis shes yon can gso skyong byed pa'i gnad don thag gcod byed dgos pa de yin/ de ni bod yig dang skad gnyis shes yon can gyi thon khungs sgo 'byed dang bed spyod gtong dgos pa'i gnad don de yin/ 'di'i nang du bod kyi skad yig slob khrid kyi nus shugs la gom gang mdun spos sgos shugs je cher brgyab nas spyi tshogs kyis gnyer ba'i slob grwa'i nus pa 'don par byed pa la mthong chen nges par byed dgos pa'i skor rnams 'dus yod/ spyi tshogs kyis 54

gnyeraba'islob grwa'i nang du dgon pas gnyer ba'i slob grwa (dgon pa'i spyi gzhung ngamabla grwa mi sgor gang rung)yang 'dus yo da/ don dngos su/ chos lugs phyogs kyi mi snas slob grwa sgrub gnyer byed pa dang slob khrid byed pa'i tshul 'di bcings 'grol byas tshun chad nas rang zhing gi bod khul du lo mang bor gnas shing yod pa zhig yin la/ der yang skye stobs kyi bla srog ldan 'dug ngas rang zhing dang zhing chen gzhan dag kha shas la rtog zhib byas pa ltar na/ dgon pas gnyer ba'i slob grwa la grub 'bras ldan zhing nus pa bzang ba'i bden dpang byed chog la/ mang tshogs kyi dga' bsu yang thob yod par ma zad/ zhing chen slob u dang dkar mdzes khul u/ khul srid gzhung dang slob gso'i sde khag gis rgyab skyor yang byas yod/ 'on kyang / nga tsho'i blo mthun kha shas kyis/ bod yig gis 6go mi chod par smra ba dang / bod yig rjes lus yin par smra ba'i brjod gtam sgrog bzhin yod/ dus rgyun du 'di nyid gral rim 'thab rtsod dang 'brel bar byas nas/ bod yig slob sbyong byed pa ni 6'byor med gral rim gyi rgyud 'dzin pa 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod yin zhes zer la/ yang bshad tshul zhig ni/ bod yig slob sbyong byas pa des chos 'don par cha rkyen skrun yod ces pa'i log bshad 'di yin/ da dung rnyog bshad rdzogs rgyu med pa bzos nas mi mngag par bzung / des mi tshad da dung mi la las/ byis pa na gzhon gyis thog mar rig gnas slob stong byas nas rmongs pa sel ci thub gang nus byed dgos pa'i kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi gnad don 'di yang mthong chung byas te/chos lugs kyis shugs rkyen thebs 'dug ces rnyog dra slong bzhin yod par ma zad / dgon pas lo mang bor gnyer zhing / phan nus bzang ba/ phyogs so so 55

nas rgyab skyor thob pa'i deng rabs slob grwa'ang gtor/ ngas bltas na/ gong gi lta tshul dang byed stangs 'di dag ni/ g.yon gyi bsam blos bar chad byas pa yin la/ 'dis chos lugs kyi gnad don dang mi rigs rig gnas kyi gnad don la ngos 'dzin yang dag pa dang thag gcod bzang bo byed mi thub par ma zad / lta tshul 'di dag ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus/'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid jus sogs dang yang mi mthun pas/ nga tshor chos lugs phyogs kyi mi sna mang che bas tang la brtsi srung dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs la brtsi srung / rgyal khab la dga' zhen yod pa'i yid ches yod dgos/ kho tshos slob grwa gnyer ba ni tang gi slob gso'i srid jus dang chod don la 'gal ba min par ma zad/ hur brtson gyis /chos lugs dang spyi tshogs ring lugs phan tshun mthun 'jug byed pa'i las la dngos su brtson pa'i rtags mtshan zhig yin pas / 'di ni rgyab skyor dang bstod bsngags byed dgos pa'i yul zhig kyang yin/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes su/ bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed dang spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar ba'i nang du/krung go mi dmangs chab srid gros mol tshogs 'du'i rim pa so so'i u yon lhan khang bskyar gso dang gong 'phel byung yod/ mi dmangs srid gros ni/ /krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byed pa'i dmangs gtso'i tang shog khag so so dang /tang shog med pa'i dmangs gtso'i mi sna/ mi dmangs tshogs pa/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi mi sna dang las rigs khag so so'i rgyal gces mi sna zhugs pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi ngal rtsol ba dang spyi tshogs ring lugs las don kyi 'dzugs 56

skrun pa/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la brtsi srung byed pa'i rgyal gces pa dang mes rgyal gcig gyur brtsi srung byed pa'i rgyal gces pa bcas las grub pa'i zhang gang dmigs bsal srid 'dzin sa khul gyi spun zla zhang kung ba/ a'o min dmigs bsal srida'adzin sa khul gyi spun zla a'o min pa/ spun zla tha'e wan pa dang rgyal phyir yod pa'i spun zla krung go ba sogs 'dus pa'i ches rgya che ba'i rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur ①zhig yin/ nga tsho'i tang gis krung go khyad chos ldan pa'ispyitshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam bgrod pa dang / dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun lte bar 'dzin pa rgyun 'khyongs byed pa/ bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed rgyun 'khyongs byed pa/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi tshong ra'i dpal 'byor lam lugs thog mar gsar 'dzugs byed pa/ khyon yongs nas 'byor ba 'bring ba'i spyi tshogs su 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar ba zhig bskrun yod/skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs rjes su/ mi dmangs srid gros kyi ngo ba/ go gnas dang nus pa la 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po byung yod cing / mi dmangs srid gros kyi go gnas kyang je mthor song yod/ las don la'ang 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod/ srid gros kyi 〈sgrig yig〉las gtan 'bebs byas pa ltar/ krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byed pa'i tang mang mnyam sgrub dang chab srid gros mol lam lugs ni rang rgyal gyi rtsa ba'i chab srid lam lugs shig yin/ mi dmangs srid gros ni ches rgya che ba'i rgyal gces 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi rtsa 'dzugs yin la/ krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byed pa'i tang mang mnyam sgrub dang chab srid gros mol mngon 'gyur byed pa'i gal che'i las khungs shig kyang yin/ spyi tshogs ring 57

lugs kyi dmangs gtso dar spel gtong ba'i sal che'i bgrod lam zhig yin la/spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid mngon 'gyur byed pa'i gal che'i rnam pa zhig kyang yin/ rang rgyal gyi chab srid/ dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang du tshab byed mi rung ba'i nus pa ldan/ mi dmangs srid gros kyi rtsa ba'i 'gan nus ni chab srid gros mol dang / dmangs gtsos lta skul/ srid zhugs srid gleng byed pa de yin/ srid gros kyi las ka la nus mthu je che dang /srid gros kyi go gnas je mthor 'gro bzhin yod pa 'di ni/ dus skabs gsar ba'i mi dmangs srid gros kyi gal che'i kha lo 'gyur mtshams shig kyang yin/lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar ba'i nang du/ rang zhing gi grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul gyi srid gros las don yang lo rgyus kyi dus rim gsar ba zhig tu slebs nas/ rgyal yongs sa gnas so so'i srid gros las don gyi gom rjes chod yod / mi rigs sa khul du nan tan gyis srid gros kyi (sgrig yig〉 dang (mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi bca' khrims〉kyis gtan 'khel byas yod pa ltar las don bsgrubs shing / snyemathun sgril chen yo dang 6gcig gyur chen mo'i dgongs don lag bstar mthar phyin byas nas mi dmangs srid gros kyi mthun sgril gyi cha dang 'brel ba'i cha sngar las lhag par je cher btang yod/ mi rigs sa khul gyi mi dmangs srid gos la grub cha'i phyogs nas bltas na/ bzo zhing ngal rtsol ba'i sku tshab dang / mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi mtho rim rgyal gces mi sna/ phyi nas nang du log pa'i bod rigs spun zla'i khrod kyi shes ldan mi sna/shes yon las rigs khrod kyi sku tshab/ spyi la dbang ba min pa'i dpal 'byor lam lugs kyi sku tshab sogs yod la/ gzhan yang/ krung gung tang gi las byed 58

pa'ang yod/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun chad nas/ rang zhing gi mi rigs sa khul srid gros kyis rim pa mang bo can dang nus pa mang bo can brgyud de/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i lte ba'i las 'gan gyi mtha' skor nas/ mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis rgyun 'khyongs byas te/srid gros kyi rtsa ba'i 'gan nus khas len lag bstar byas shing las don 'bor chen bsgrubs nas/ dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i ched dang / mes rgyal gcig gyur/ mi rigs mthun sgril/ spyi tshogs snying 'jags bcas kyi ched du nus pa gal chen 'don pa ra byas yod/da lo'i zla 3par/ krung gung krung dbyang gis bton pa'i (krung gung krung dbyang gi mi dmangs srid gros kyi las kur shugs snon rgyag pa'i thad kyi bsam 'char〉(〈bsam 'char〉)zhes pa 'di ni/ dus skabs gsar ba 'di'i dus rim gsar ba'i nang gi mi dmangs srid gros kyis gzhi 'dzin sa'i bya spyod kyi rtsa 'dzin yin pas/ rim pa so so'i srid gros kyis (bsam 'char〉slob sbyong dang don 'khyol byed pa'i tsha rlabs drag tu 'phyur bar byas shing / (bsam 'char〉slob sbyong byas pa brgyud nas/ mi dmangs srid gros kyi ngos 'dzin je mtho dang /srid gros la bton pa'i blang bya gsar ba rnams gsal bor rtogs thub pa byung yod la/ srid gros kyi las don la 'phel rgyas gsar ba yong ba'i skul 'ded dang —/ srid gros kyi ma 'ongs pa'i gzi brjid 'od stong ldan pa'i mdun lam kyang phyogs ston sngon dpag byas yod/mdor na/ gong gi lo rgyus kyi dus rim so sor bltas na/ mthun sgril dang59

phudamangs gtso'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis rgyun 'khyongs byas yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi dus rim gang dang gang yin na'ang / de dang de'i skabs su/ nga tsho'i tang gi las don tshang ma bde blag gi ngang nas gong 'phel du song yod la/ de las ldog dus/ bar bcad dang gyong gud chen po thebs yod/ mi rigs sa khul gyi mi dmangs srid gros kyis lo rgyus kyi dus rim so so'i nang du/ mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis la dmigs te/ las kyi dang bor gyur ba'i dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi rjes su bstun par byas nas/de la zhabs 'degs kyang zhus yod la/ mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol byas te/ srid gros kyi rtsa ba'i 'gan nus khas len lag bstar dang / mi rigs sa khul du mthun sgril dang srid 'byor rig gsum gong 'phel yar rgyas su 'gro ba la byas rjes gal chen bzhag yod/ de ltar yin na'ang —/ mi rigs sa khul gyi srid gros kyis kyang dka' spyad sdug rus sgos 'tshol zhib byas nas kyag kyog ldan pa'i lo rgyus kyi lam bu'ang bgrod myong yod pa red/ma 'ongs sngon dpag byas te/ 'od stong 'bar ba'i mdun lam sngon du bsus nas/ mi rigs sa khul gyi srid gros kyis mar le ring lugs dang / ma'o tse tung gi dgongs pa/ teng zha'o yin gyi rigs gzhung dang mtshon byed gsum gyi gal che ba'i dgongs pa rlabs chen gyi dar cha mthon por sgreng nas/ blo mthun hu'u cin tha'o yis spyi khyab hru'u ci mdzad pa'i tang krung dbyang gi 'go khrid 'og tu/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi lta ba rgyun 'khyongs byas nas / mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi rtsa ba'i chab srid kyi lam lugs kyang rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos la/ las kyi dang bor gyur ba'i 'phel rgyas 'di la dmigs 60

te / /mnyam du mthun sgril 'bad brtson dang snyemanyam du dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro ba rgyun 'khyongs byas nas/ srid gros kyi rtsa ba'i 'gan nus khas len lag bstaradang / mu mthud du mthun sgril dang dmangs gtso'i brjod bya'i don snying chen po gnyis srid gros kyi las don yongs kyi khrod du lag len don 'khyol byas te/ rang zhing gi dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs rgal ba'i rnam pa can gyi 'phelargyas su skul 'ded btang nas/ phyogs yongs nas 'cham mthun rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'byor 'bring spyi tshogs su 'dzugs skrun byed pa la 'bad brtson lhod med byed dgos/ /mchan/༷krang ko hwa yi 〈bod ljongs mes rgyal gyi pang du phyir slebs〉 1962lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 25nyin gyi (mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par〉 las drangs/()wang yon rlung gi 〈dga' ldan gser khri gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi rnam thar sprul sku'i 'jig rten〉 gyi shog grangs 72las drangs/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1997lo'i zla 4par par skrun byas/du me'o phong thos kru'u ren gyis nub khams zhing chen bod rigs rang skyong ljongs kyi skabs dang po'i mi rigs dang las rigs so so'i mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs 'du thengs dang po'i steng du dar mdo'i dmag don do dam u yon lhan khang gi zla ba bdun gyi ring gi las don mjug bsdu'i snyan zhu'i skor〉 las drangs/ (1950lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 8nyin)()le nyin gyi 〈 krung go'i dmangs gtso ring lugs dang dmangs legs ring lugs〉〈le nyin gyi gsung 'bum〉 deb 2pa'i shog grangs 426las drangs/duX teng zha'o dzin gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉 (deb dang bo)kyi 〈lho nub grangs nyung mi rigs kyi gnad don skor〉 gyi shog grangs 169dang 163las drangs/ mi 61

dmangs dpe skrun khang gis 1989lo'i zla 5par par skrun byas/0〈mar khe si'i gsung 'bum〉deb dang bo/ (gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam〉shog grangs 270las drangs/du da rabs si khron don chen zin tig〉shog grangs 104las drangs/ las cin chon gyis krung gung thengs 8pa'i rgyal yongs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thog tu bshad pa'i (mu mthud nas rgyal khab dang zhing ba'i 'brel ba legs bcos byed dgos〉zhes pa las gsal/()(krung go mi dmangs chab srid gros mol tshogs 'du'i sgrig yig〉gi spyi'i rtsa 'dzin las drangs/ 2004lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 12nyin gyi krung go mi dmangs chab srid gros mol tshogs 'du skabs bcu pa'i thengs gnyis pa'i tshogs 'du'i steng du bzo bcos brgyab/(ched rtsom 'di ni yangs gling rdo rje mchog sku dngos kyis rgya yig tu brtsams shing /'brel yod 'go khrid che khag dang mkhas dbang 'ga' la bsam 'char bsdu len mang du byas pa'i ma rtsom nang khul ma la dag bcos thengs rmong byas mthar/ sku dngos kyis bod 'gyur ma'i ched du gtan la phab yod pa nyid gzhir bzung nas/ si khron zhing chen mi dmangs srid gros kyi rigs gzhung dang lag len zhib 'jug tshogs pa'i rgyun las drung chen gzhon pa dang —/ si khron zhing chen bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug tshogs pa'i drung chen gzhon pa mdzod dge bud dha mtsho ldan dges pa'i rdo rjes bsgyur ba yin/)62

gangs can snyan ngag gi lha dam pa a khu yi dam tshe ring lags la rjes dran gyi tshul du spel ba'i snyan rtsom gangs mtsho'i rang mdangs/khyung dkar gtsug tor rnam rgyal/shar phyogs 'od kyi rig pa'i 'khor los nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i zhal thang phyes/ / —lhophyogs g.yu 'brug dpal gyi dbyangs kyis mdongs mtha' dgyes pa'i gdugs chen phabs/ /byang phyogs bsil rlung 'gyur bag stong gis snying gi me tog gar du spel//nub phyogs te so'i gangs kyi snyan grags gaṅga'i pu wang rgyal mo yis/ /phyogs bzhi'i legs tshogs gcig tu bsdus te dam tshig can la spel zhes thos/ /shar phyogs dngul gyi kha 'bab rgyud las sgeg pa'i snyan rtsom khyod kyis drangs/ /lhag bsam dngul dkar bye ma 'bum bcas sgeg pa'i rtsom phran lnga brgya yis/ /te se gangs dang ma pham mtsho la dang bas g.yas bskor lan bdun gyis//yid 'ong snyan tshig rlabs phreng stong gis zhi bde rgya mtsho dga' bas bsnyegs/ /lho phyogs khyung chen kha 'bab rgyud las dpa' ba'i snyan rtsom khyod kyis drangs/ /'jigs rung gser gyi tsha zer 'bum bcas dpa' ba'i rtsom phran lnga brgya yis/ /te se gangs dang ma pham mtsho la dad pas g.yas bskor lan bdun gyis//63

'jigs med snying stobs go cha btsan pos rgya mtsho'i khri la zhabs kyis phyogs/ /byang phyogs seng chen kha 'bab rgyud las bzhad gad lhan rtsom khyod kyis drangs/ /'phya ba'i bye ma 'bum dang bcas te bzhad gad rtsom phran lnga brgya yis/ /te se gangs dang ma pham mtsho la dud pa'i g.yas bskor lnga brgya yis/ /wa skyes stong phrag zhi bar byed pa'i rgya mtsho'i gangs la rtsal gyis chas/ /nub phyogs rta mchog kha 'bab rgyud las snying rje'i snyan rtsom khyod kyis drangs/ /byams ldan bye ma 'bum dang bcas te snying rje'i rtsom phran lnga brgya yis/ /te se gangs dang ma pham mtsho la mos pa'i g.yas bskor lan bdun gyis/ /thugs rje rlabs phreng stong phrag dang bcas brtse chen mtsho la snying gis phyogs/ /e ma phyogs bzhi'i snyan ngag rgya mtshor lha dang bcas pa cis mi dgyes/ /shar phyogs klong rgyas zhi ba'i lha tshogs dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa la/ /sgeg pa'i snyan rtsom bshos dkar stong la dga' ba'i mar rgyan 'bum dang ni/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnam lnga rnam bdun dngos sprul longs spyod stong mchod kyis//thugs rje nyi ma 'bum gyi lha zhal dge legs dbyar du cis mi 'phel/ /lho phyogs klong rgyas gsang sngags tshogs dkyil yongs su rdzogs pa la/ /dpa' ba'i snyan rtsom bshos dmar stong la brjid pa'i mar rgyan 'bum dang ni/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnam lnga rnam bdun dngos sprul longs spyod stong mchod kyis//'jigs rung lha zhal sreg za stong gis dus mtha'i me la cis mi 'phya/ /byang phyogs klong rgyas lha tshogs dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa la/ /phul byung snyan rtsom bshos ser stong la dga' ba'i mar rgyan 'bum dang ni/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnam lnga rnam bdun dngos sprul longs spyod stong mchod kyis//64

rnamadagalha zhal chu skyes 'bum gyis bsil zer pham par cis mi byed/ /nub phyogasaklong rgyas kun rig lha tshogs dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa la/ /ngo mtshar snyan rtsom bshos ljang stong la dga' ba'i mar rgyan 'bum dang ni/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnam lnga rnam bdun dngos sprul longs spyod stong mchod kyis//kun rig zhal tshogs dbyar dpal rgyas pas rma bya'i sgro yang skyengs par byed/ /e ma phyogs bzhi'i lha tshogs dkyil 'khor gcig tu dgyes na gzhan ci zhig /shar phyogs rig pa'i rgyal khams kun gyi rig byed yang bcud stag tu 'phyo/ /lhophyogs rig pa'i rgyal khams kun gyi ngargo rig nor bu'i khyung chen lding / /nub phyogs rig pa'i rgyal khams kun gyi snyan tshig gdong lnga'i g.yu ral gsig /phyogs bzhi mnyes pa'i snyan tshig rlung rta sde bzhi'i dpal 'dir sus mi bsngags//

bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs can bar gyi 'gal 'du thog mar brjod pa gsar rnying rig pa'i rtsod gleng /mdzod dge bud bha/ gsar rnying rig pa'i 'gal 'du'i phung po kun/ /lo rgyus dus kyi 'khor lor 'khor ba na/ /khyod las nga dang nga las khyod yod pa'i/ /ngo mtshar rig bcud 'dus pa'i dpal yang shar/de yang / spyir gsar byung de ring gi bod 'di ni khar sang gi bod kyi rdzas rgyun phyi ma yin la/ 'byung 'gyung ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi rdzas rgyun snga ma'ang yin dgos / de bzhin bod kyi rig gnas kyang ngang tshul de lta bu zhig yin phyir/ de las rig gnas 'phel rgyun gyi rgyud 'dzin pa'i gnad don gal chen po 'di byung ba red/ der brten nga tsho'i mes pos gna' srid pa thog mar chags dus nas bskal pa da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas mtha' yas pa 'di dag las phan pa'i bcud du smin pa'i ngo mtshar rig gnas bzang bo thams cad ni 'phel rgyun gyi rdzas su 'os shing rgyud 'dzin pa'i gzhi yang yin pas / de nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong dgos par ma zad/ de nyid kyis 66

deng rabasacanagyilas don la zhabs 'degs dang 'grub byed kyi grogs bzang bo nges parabyedadagos/ 'on kyang / deng sang mgo yang shes chung gi mi 'ga' res / bsam bzhin du bod kyi lo rgyus dang srol rgyun rig gnas 'phel rgyas kyi rdzas rgyunabatsan bcad dang / rnying ba thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du bsgoms nas srol rgyun rig gnas tshang ma 'phongs phyis kyi rdo bzhin du mi gtsang go lud kyi khrod du 'phen ci thub byed bzhin yod kyang / des ni gna' rabs bod kyi shes rig dang deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi shes rig gnyis rtsa ba nas 'gal zlar bzung bas / bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la mtha' dpyad pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'dzin pa'i tshan rig gi byed phyogs dang dpag tshad brgya phrag stong phrag khri phrag las kyang rgyab kyis phyogs pas/ dbu ma dang bral ba'i lta ba'i rtag mtha' la ring du lhung phyir de la rmongs pa las thar ba'i go skabs ni shin tu nas kyang phra/ lhag par de las byung ba'i mjug 'bras ya nga ba ni rig gnas gsar brje yis dkar nag dang bzang ngan gyi rkya mi phye bar sngar yod srol rgyun rig gnas thams cad rdul du brlags par byas pa'i mjug 'bras ngan pa 'di rang yin/ 'di 'dra'i gyong rgyad chen po ni lo rgyus kyi steng du lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis mig stong du sprul nas btsal kyang rnyed dka' 'o/ /'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas nga cho'i rnying ba thams cad lha yi lugs su brtsi zhing / gsar byung thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du sems pa'i lta ba'i chad mtha' la lhung ba'i nyen kha chen po 'di la'ang dogs zon dus rtag tu byed dgos pa ni da lta'i dus kyi 'os 'gan du mthong / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ spyir bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas 'di nyid da lta la mtshon na 'das zin sngon gyi rig gnas rnying ba zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ de dang deng 67

rabs can gnyis ku'i bar la mthun 'jug mi byed pa dang 'gal 'du'i rtsod gleng yang mi nyung ba zhig 'byung bzhin yod par mthong / lhag par des deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs la ngang ngam shugs kyis mi mthun pa'i 'gal rkyen mi nyung ba zhig bzo bzhin yod phyir/ tshul de la/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ /legs par brtag la nga yi bka'/ /blangs par bya yi gus phyir min/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dpe ltar/ rang gi mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas rnying ba la bzang ngan gyi shan mi 'byed par phyogs lhung dang rmongs zhen/ ma gus pa dang gus pa thal drag pa/ rang re'i mkhas pa la dgra lha dpung bstod dang gzhan sde'i mkhas pa la smod pa byed ci thub byed pa sogs kyi ra ri'i dri mas ma lhad par/ lhag bsam dkar gsal gyi zla ba'i 'od la brten nas bden pa'i bzhin ras cung zhig gsal bar byed pa'i las 'di ni rtsam gzan slog gyon gyi bod phrug bdag gis bya'o / /dang po/ rnying zhen dang gsar btod bar gyi rtsod gleng /tshul 'di la mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ /thams cad khong du sbed pa zab mor rloms/ /kun la dogs pa za ba grung por byed/ /rnying ba thams cad lha yi srol du bsgrags/ /gsar ba thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du sems / /ngo mtshar phal cher than ltas nyid du bsgoms/ /chos kyi rgyal khams tri bho ṭa yi srol/ /'di ni da lta'i bar du rang re'i srol/ / zhes gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad 'di la bsam blo zhib mo zhig btang tshe 'dis rang re la dngos su yod pa'i rnying zhen dang gsar btod kyi bsam pa'i bar gyi 'gal 'du'i rtsod 68

gling dmar rjen du bton yod par ma zad/ des ni sngon song lo rgyus dang srol rgyun rigaganas kyi snyigs ma da lta'i bar du 'dor ma thub par rgyun chags su gnas yod pa'ang gsal bor bstan yod ces bshad na mi chog pa ci yang med/lhag par lo rgyus kyi me long du cung zhig bltas tshe/ tshul 'di ni thon mi sam bho ṭas bod yig gsar du bzos pa la blon po rnams kyis sdang ba mdzad pa nas bai ro tsā na rgyal mo tsha ba rong du rgyang phud btang ba dang / dge 'dun chos 'phel a mdo bla brang dang dbus gtsang lha sa nas rgya gar du 'khyams pa dang / don grub rgyal rang gi pha yul nas bsam bzhin du nam mkha'i dbyings su gshegs pa'i lo rgyus las kyang ra sprod yag po byed thub/ der ma zad da lta'i rong 'brog sgar grong kun tu'ang de dang de 'dra ba'i rnying zhen gyi bag chags zab mo ni gcig gis gcig la rang shugs su brgyud nas nyams su myangs shing lag tu len bzhin 'dug /de 'dra'i ngan shan rgod ma thag drud kyi rnam thar las nga tsho la smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ rnying ba mkhregs por 'dzin pa dang / sngon thon ya rabs kyi bsam pa 'gag nas 'tsho ba ngan ngon tsam dang 'khor ba 'khor tsam don du gnyer bzhin yod pa 'di red/ 'di dang 'di 'dra bas ni deng rabs can la med du mi rung ba'i dka' spyad gsar btod kyi snying stobs mchog gi mig rjes lta ci thal rjes tsam yang chod pa'i skabs ni ma mchis pas/ rtsod gleng 'di las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal kha 'thob mkhan dang rgyal mtshan dkar po sgreng mkhan ni da nas bzung ste nges par du gsar btod ces pa'i rtsod zla mchog 'di nyid gcig pu yin du bcug dgos pa ni lo rgyus kyis nga tshor byin pa'i 'os 'gan gzur du med pa zhig yin lags/69

gnyis pa/ mtho dman gyi 'du shes dang dmangs gtso'i lta ba'i bar gyi rtsod gleng /mi lo stong phrag du ma'i lo rgyus kyi chu bo ring mo'i nang du bod mi rigs 'di nyid spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs gsar rnying sna tshogs brgyud nas da lta'i bar du lham me lhang nge lhan chags su grub pa'i mtho dman bzang ngan gyi go rim 'di 'dra zhig chags yod de/ de ni 'di ltar/1 'go ba dpon po rnams (sngon gyi 'go dpon dang da lta'i 'go khrid sogs)mtho zhing lha sde mi ser kun (sngon dang da lta'i mi dmangs)dma' bar 'dzin pa/2 bla ma sprul sku rnams mtho zhing dge bshes grwa btsun kun dma' bar 'dzin pa/3 chos pa ser po rnams mtho zhing grong pa skya bo kun dma' bar 'dzin pa/4 skyes pho rab rnams mtho zhing sman bud med kun dma' bar 'dzin pa/5 lus dar ma rnams mtho zhing rgan byis pa kun dma' bar 'dzin pa/6 log gzan las byed rnams mtho zhing rong 'brog ngal rtsol ba kun dma' bar 'dzin pa bcas yin/gong gi 'dzin pa drug ldan gyi spyi tshogs kyi gnad don 'di dag deng rabs dmangs gtso'i 'dra mnyam gyi lta ba dang mthun thabs kyi go skabs ni mo gsham gyi bu bzhin phra bar ma zad/ de las lta ba dang bo ni/ deng rabs chab srid kyi dmangs gtso'i lta ba dang 'gal zhing / gnyis ba ni/ tshang ma spyi dmangs yin 70

pa gang zhig /chos byed pa'i mi yin pa 'dra 'dra yin zhing rnam par shes pa'i bdag nyidacan yang yin phyir mtho dman dbye ba byed don med par ma zad/sngon gyi rnam shes bzang ngan gyis da lta'i mi'i bzang ngan gyi tshab byed pa'ang de bas 'khrul/ gsum pa ni/ srid kyi dbang du btang na ser skya 'dra mnyam dang /chos kyi dbang du btang na sems can thams cad mar ma gyur ba med pa'i cha nas thams cad phan tshun gyi ma yin tshul 'dra zhing / sems can thams cad sangs brgya nges pa'i cha nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'ang bslu med yin par 'dod phyir mtho dman 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rnyed dka'/lnga ba dang drug pa'ang gong du bshad pa'i 'dra mnyam dang dmangs gtso'i rtsa don dang 'gal 'dug / mdor na/ gong du bshad pa'i gnad don 'di dag tshang ma mtho dman go rim gyi lta ba dang dmangs gtso'i lta ba'i bar gyi rtsod gleng gi gnad don sha stag yin phyir/ de las ldog ste mi tshang ma 'dra mnyam dang mi dmangs la chab srid kyi steng nas rang khyim rang bdag byed pa dang / rang dbang gi bsam 'char 'don pa / lhag par rgyal khab bdag gnyer gyi srid don la dmangs gtso'i dbang cha ming don mtshungs pa zhig yod dgos na srid kyi cha nas mtho dman dang chos kyi cha nas bzang ngan go rim gyi lta ba rnying ba rmeg med du gtong ba'i bya ba gces su 'dzin gal che'o/71

gsum pa/ dge sdig gi lta ba dang tshan rig gi bsam blo'i bar gyi rtsod gleng /bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyis dge sdig la tshan rig gi bsam blo'i sgo nas gsal bshad mtha' chod pa zhig byas med pas/ skabs 'gar mi mang mang la phan pa'i bya ba yang sdig pa'i las su rtsis nas de la bar gcod byed pa'ang rgyun du mthong / dper na/ rong ba rnams kyis sdig par 'dzems nas zhing 'bu mi gsod pa dang / 'brog pa rnams kyis sdig par 'dzems nas a bra dang byi long mi bda' ba'i las 'di dang 'di 'dra ba shin tu mang bo ga sa gang du mthong mthong rig rig yin/ spyir nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di gna' nas rang byung khor yug srung skyong la shin tu mkhas mod/ 'on kyang nga tshos rang byung khams la brtag dpyod mi bgyi zhing / rang byung kha lo bsgyur ba'i las ni de bas kyang mi byed la byed kyang thub ki med/ der ma zad/ rig gnas slob gso dang / tshan rig lag rtsal kyang che che mtho mtho/ bzang bzang rgyan rgyan kun gyis rtsa chen du 'dzin dgos par rgan pos ma ṇi 'don pa nang bzhin gsungs pa tshang ma chu la sor rgyag gi dpe ru song dang 'gro ru bcug bzhin yod/ der brten/ dge ba'i phyi pags gyon pa'i gong gi sdig pa tshab chen de dang de 'dra ba dag gis nga tsho'i rig gnas rjes lus dang rgyu med lag stong du 'gro ba'i grogs bzang bo byas pa yin la/ des kyang deng rabs can du mchong rgyug byed bzhin pa'i rkang ba la rdo btags pa yin phyir/ de len pa'i thabs kho na ni mang mang kun la phan pa'i tshan rig gi bsam blo las byung ba'i thabs dam pa 'di rang yin pa shes gal 72

che'o //bzhi pa/ kun spyod gtso zhing rang khe phal ba'i rin thang gi lta ba dang thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel du gtong ba'i bar gyi rtsod gleng /spyir bod mi kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin zhing nyin bzhin kha don byed pa'i smon lam las kyang / ‘ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad kyi don du nga sangs shig rgyas pa'i smon lam/ zhes pa sogs kyi smon lam mang po dus rgyun du 'debs bzhin 'dug kyang / thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel du gtong ba'i skabs 'dir de las ldog phyogs su smon lam 'theb 'dug pa 'dra/ rgyu mtshan gang yod zer na/da lta'i bod kyi srol rgyun la mi bzang snying rje'i ring lugs kyi kun spyod slob gso thal che bas/ rgyu rdzas dngos po'i dpal yon nam bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang bskrun pa nyung zhing / lto rgyags lus drod kyi 'byor ba tsam gyis yid tshims nas chog shes bsten pa thabs bzang bor brtsi bzhin yod/ de las thon pa'i mjug 'bras ni le lo dang gti mug 'phel zhing / dngos pos spyi tshogs la thon dgos pa'i nus pa je zhan du song ba de rang red/ des na 'gal rkyen 'di dag gis da lta'i dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel du gtong ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor nus mthu je mthor gtong ba'i phyogs la bar gcod byed bzhin yod pas skyon cha 'di dag bcos gal che/ 'on kyang de rgyu mtshan du byas nas slar yang gzhan gnod kyi rang khe kho na don du 73

gnyer ba'i rang don ring lugs kyi ngan mtha' la lhung ba'i skyon cha yang 'byung sla bas mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbu mar gnas gal che'o/ /lnga ba/ chos dang 'jig rten nam tshe 'di phyi'i bar gyi rtsod gleng /spyir 'dzam bu gling 'dir chos lugs kyi grub mtha' chen po gsum dang /chung ngu mtha' yas pa zhig yod cing / de dag la dad pa byed mkhan gyi mi rigs kyang shin tu mang / de las kyang rang re'i bod 'di chos lugs la dad pa shin tu che ba'i mi rigs shig yin par ma zad/ chos dang 'jig rten rtsa ba nas 'gal zlar 'dzin pa lag len du btab dang 'debs bzhin pa'ang mthong thos kyi yul du gyur pa mang ste/ dper na/ sde ba la la'i nang du chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ku'i rtsa ba'i rting rdo'am khyim gzhi ni 'khor ba 'khor byed kyi rgyu dang / tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig tu mthong nas 'khor ba'i rgyun thag bsam bzhin rtsa med du bcad pa'ang dngos su yod pa 'di rang red/ 'di la sa cha la las 'khor ba gting rdzogs dang la las khyim rjes bcad pa yang zer nas rtsa che che dang / ya rabs kyi spyod par brtsi/ 'di 'dra'i gnad don byung dgos pa'i rtsa ba ni chos dang 'jig rten nam tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka lag len gyi cha nas 'gal zlar bzung ba'i rkyen gyis yin la/ de'ang gtso bo 'khor ba sdug bsngal ba dang /srid pa'i phun tshogs mi rtag pa/ nam 'chi cha med pa/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gzod rlag med pa/ rgyu gsog pa sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra bar 'dod pa'i yongs grags kyi lta ba 'di dag gis bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis yin/'di 'dra'i brjod bya gtso bor bshad pa ni bka' bstan bcos tsam du ma zad 74

tha na rim byon mkhas pa'i bslab bya dang mgur glu yod tshad mthong tshad las kyang kha phye ba tsam gyis mthong thub pa 'di ni chos 'jig rten gnyis las chos gtso bo byas drag pa dang / tshe 'di phyi gnyis las phyi ma gtso bo byas drag pa/ phyi'i lus dang nang gi sems gnyis las nang gi sems gtso bo byas drag pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dpe gzhi ngo ma zhig kyang yin/spyir mi rigs shig la mtshon na/ 'dzam gling gi dngos lugs rig pa'i mkhas dbang / ltos sa ltos 'jog gi dngos lugs rig pa'i byed po e yin si than gyis chos gcig pu las tshan rig ma dar ba'i mi rigs ni ches blun po'i mi rigs yin la/ tshan rig gcig pu las chos marar ba'i mi rigs ni ches sdig rtsub che ba'i mi rigs nyid yin/ des na/ chos dang tshan rig gnyis ka dar ba'i mi rigs ni ches ya rabs dang shes rig ldan pa'i mi rigs yin par bshad pa 'di la skabs 'dir bsam blo zhib mo zhig btang na phan pa shin tu che/rang re'i mi rigs 'di la chos dang rig gnas gnyis ka yod kyang / gtso phal gyi khyad par nor na blun po'i gras su 'gro ba'i nyen kha shin tu che'o/ /mdor na/ gong du bshad pa'i lta ba 'di 'dra bas srid pa'i phun tshogs 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i snying stobs kyi spa bkong bar ma zad dam chos mi yul can dang spyi tshogs gong 'phel du 'gro ba la'ang phan pa 'byung dka' phyir deng rabs can gyi las don la mthun 'jug byed ci thub kyi phyogs su kha dkri dgos/drug pa/ zhing phyugs las dang tshong las bar gyi rtsod gleng /spyir bod 'di gna' dus nas rong bas zhing las dang 'brog pas phyugs 75

las byas nas rang kha rang gso byed pa'i rang byung dpal 'byor gyi las ka la goms pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis zhing las dang phyugs las la mthong chen rang bzhin gyis byed kyang / tshong las la mthong chung tshod med byed par ma zad/ tshong ba rnams kyang rdzun gyi rgyal ba dang / rku 'phrog gi sna 'dren lta bur rtsis nas dma' 'bebs byed srol dar 'dug /der brten tshong las 'di'ang spangs blangs gnyis las spangs bya lta bur 'dzin mkhan mang / lta ba 'di las deng rabs bod kyi spyi tshogs la thon pa'i mjug 'bras ngan pa ni tshong las sgrub pa la ngo tsha byed pa dang / tshong las lkog tu sbed nas byed pa'am tha na mi byed pa la sogs pa'i tshong zog gi 'du shes med pa dang shin tu zhan pa'i gnad don 'di byung ba red / deng sang dgon mtha'i tshong ra dang rdzong dang grong sde'i tshong ra 'ga' tsam dngos su yod pa 'di dag kyang mang che ba zhig ni sa cha gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i mis byas pa sha stag yin pas phan pa de tsam 'byung dka' la/ rang gi nang du byung ba'i 'gyur ldog gal chen zhig la ngos 'dzin kyang byed dka' 'o/ /mdor na/ gong gsal gyi gnad don 'di dag gis deng rabs bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi tshong ra'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba la phan pa 'byung dka' zhing bar chad kyang byed bzhin yod pas 'di dag bcos pa'i thabs dang tshong ra'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i las la 'bad par rigs so/ /bdun pa/ lha mis skyong ba dang khrims kyis skyong ba'i bar gyi rtsod gleng /bod btsan po'i skabs nas chos srid zung 'brel gyi bar dang / de nas da 76

lta'ibod sa gnas srid gzhung la thug gi bar du chab srid skyong ba la lha dang mi yisaskyong ba gtso bor byed cing / khrims kyis skyong ba la mthong chen de tsam mi byed par ma zad/ mi yis khrims kyi tshab byed pa dang / dbang chas khrims kyi tshab byed pa'i srol 'di dar so che/ de phyir chab srid khrims kyis skyong ba'i 'du shes shin tu zhan par gyur 'dug /gnad don 'di bod tsam du ma zad nang logs rgya'i sa khul la'ang zhan cha 'di yod la/ de ni khrims kyis skyong ba'i deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho'i tshad dang thag shin tu ring bar ma zad/ deng rabs rtsa khrims kyi lta ba'i phyogs nas bltas kyang lha mis skyong ba'i rnam bzhag 'di la skyon cha shin tu mang / des 'phel rgyas kyi bang kha rlung las kyang mgyogs pa'i deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho ni de bas kyang skong mi thub/ de phyir yang gsar spyi tshogs kyi khrims lugs dmangs gtso'i rang bzhin can dang / rtsa khrims kyi rang bzhin can du 'dzugs skrun byed dgos na nges par du chab srid lha mis skyong ba'i rnying dri tha ra ra'i bdag nyid can de ni bsgyur bcos byed dgos so/ /brgyad pa/ kun la bstun pa dang rang gshis rang dbang bar gyi rtsod gleng /spyir mi su zhig yin rung rang rang la spyi las bye brag gi rang gshis mi 'dra ba re yod mod/ 'on kyang de 'dra'i rang gshis snying rje po de nyid chung dus nas ngang ngam shugs kyis rang dbang dang bral ba'i gzhan dbang btsan pos sna khrid dang 'gog snon byed ci thub gang thub cig byas dang byed bzhin yod par 77

mthong —/ de'ang gna' nas da lta'i bar du srol rgyun la goms pa'i kun dang bstun na mkhas pa yin/ kun dang mthun na bzang bo yin/ zhes pa'i bod mi'i srol rgyun gyi lta ba gtan chags 'dis rkyen byas pa yin/ don dngos su spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nang du kun dang bstun thabs bral ba zhig yin par ma zad / kun dang mthun thabs kyang gtan nas med/ gal te de ltar yod na/mang mang mgo rdo yin na khyod kyang mgo rdo byed dgos la/ mang mang zha 'theng yin na khyod kyang zha 'theng du bsgyur dgos par 'gyur bas/ ha cang thal drags pa ma yin nam/ lta ba 'di dag gis mi so so'i rang gshis rang dbang gi rkang lag dam por bcings shing / lhag par gsar btod kyi snying stobs la brten nas thon skyed nus pa gong 'phel du gtong ba dang / spyi tshogs phyogs thams cad nas gong 'phel du gtong bar rang gshis kyi rang dbang ldan par bya dgos pa'i 'phel phyogs dang yang gtan 'gal du 'gro ru bcug par ma zad/ rang gshis la brtsi bkur dang rang gshis kyi rang dbang yang med par 'gyur 'gro bas gnad don 'di la gzab gal che'o/ /dgu ba/ phrag dog 'dra 'dod kyi lta ba dang brtson 'grus rtsod len gyi 'du shes bar gyi sdod gleng /bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yul khams shog kha'i chags tshul dang / spyi tshogs rig gnas kyi sems khams grub lugs sogs kyi dbang gis mi rigs gzhan las kyang phrag dog 'dra 'dod che zhing / lhag par rang gi rigs kyi nang dang —/ sde ba shog kha'i nang / nye sa bzang sa'i nang la tshul min gyi phrag dog 'dra 78

'dod de bas kyang che/ der brten dus rgyun du sa rtsod chu rtsod dang / wa kha zhing rtsod / mi kha pra mchu'i sdig sna mang bo rgyun mi chad/ gzhan yang gnad don 'di 'dra ba ni gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/ 6skam tsho dus bsha' ran/ rta mgyogs dus btsong ran/ zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ rang rigs kyi nang du mkhas pa grags chen re byung na rgyang phud gtong ba dang / bla ma thabs mkhas re byung na de la bar chad byed pa/ bu rab dpa' bo re skyes na de la 'thab mo byed pa/khyim tshang ya rabs phyug po re byung na de la rku 'phrog sma 'bebs byed pa sogs mdor na phrag dog 'dra 'dod kyi lta bas gzhi byas nas 'phel ba'i tshul min gyi zhe snang ngan pa 'di'i dbang gis rang gi dga' ba gzhan gyi rgyad par sgom pa'i 'du shes ngan pa chags dang chags bzhin yod/ der brten kun gyis phyogs thams cad nas zhe snang dang / phrag cadog dang / gnod sems kyi dri mas ma lhad par rang gi nus pa yod tshad lhag med du bton nas thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel du gtong ba la rang nus rang spel dang rgyu 'bras 'dra mnyam gyis gzhi byas pa'i su bzang gang bzang dang / khyod las nga bzang gi brtson 'grus ldan pa'i 'gran bsdur gyi rtsod len ngo ma zhig yong ba la bar chad shin tu che/ gnad don 'dis deng rabs can du 'gyur ba la med du mi rung ba'i rang nus rang spel gyi brtson 'grus dang 'gran bsdur rtsod len gyi 'du shes gnyis kun nas bskyed pa la bar chad dang ldog phyogs kyi dgra ru song yod pas 'di nyid 'dul byed kyi gnyen po zhig bsten gal che'o//79

bcu pa/ thon skyed chung ngu'i 'du shes dang bzo las chen po'i lta ba'i bar gyi rtsod gleng /bod kyi srol rgyun zhing las dang phyugs las spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa la brten nas grub pa'i rmang gzhi ni/ kha 'thor ba'i khyim tshang so sos logs su bdag gnyer byed pa'i thon skyed chung ngu yin zhing / de la brten nas byung ba'i goms gshis ni/ ngang dal bag phebs dang / rgyud ring le lo/ dka' tshegs nyen kha med par thob pa'i thon skyed byed stangs bcas yin la/ 'di 'dra'i thon skyed chung ngu'i 'du shes ni/ deng rabs grong khyer gyi bzo las chen po'i 'du shes ldan pa'i grong khyer bas dus tshod la 'dzin pa'i lta ba dang / las ku'i zang rtsa la 'dzin pa'i lta ba/ nyen kha chen po la mi 'dzem pa'i lta ba bcas dang dngos su thad kur 'gal zlar langs 'dug /dper na/ ngang dal bag phebs la dus tshod kyi rnam bzhag med la/ rgyud ring le lo la las ma'i rkang rtsa bzang bo 'byung dka' ba/ dka' tshegs nyen kha mi byed pas don chen nyen kha can gyi las ka 'grub mi thub la byed pa'i snying stobs kyang skyed mi thub pa yin pas/ skyon cha 'di dag ni shes rig ldan pa'i deng rabs bzo las dang grong khyer gsar ba dar ba'i kug yin/ 'on kyang bod yul du mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bod rang gi grong khyer gsar ba mang bo dar bar byed pa'i gnad don 'di la srid jus kyi rgyab skyor dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ mi grangs bcas kyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig kyang chags dgos pa ni bshad ma dgos pa zhig yin no/ /mdor na/ gong du bshad pa'i bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng 80

rabs can du 'gyur ba'i bar gyi 'gal 'du'i rtsod gleng chen po bcu bo 'di ni bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la nying bcud dang snyigs ma gnyis su phye ba'i nang gi snyigs ma'i phyogs su gtogs pa yin la/ de bzhin spang blangs gnyis las spang bya'i phyogs su gtogs pa'ang yin/ skabs 'dir nga tshos bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyis deng rabs can la mthun 'jug mi byed pa'i phyogs gsal bo zhig mthong dgos par ma zad/ deng rabs can dang phan tshun sgrig min rang 'grig tu gyur pa'i bcud ldan legs cha'i phyogs rnams ni de bas kyang mthong gal che zhing / de bas kyang lhag par srol rgyun rig gnas tshang ma snyigs ma sha stag yin par 'dod pa'i 'khrul shes ngan pa rtsad 'gog byed dgos/ yang 'dir shes dgos pa zhig ni skabs 'dir bshad pa'i rig gnas ni deng sang yongs grags la sgra dog 'jug dang yangs 'jug gnyis yod pa'i nang nas yangs 'jug gi rig gnas la go ba len dgos phyir/ de dang khyab che chung sogs mi 'dra ba'i bcu phrag rig gnas lta bu tsam la go ba len mi nyan/ gzhan yang —/ bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang du phan pa sman gyi cha dang gnod byed dug gi cha ni dus rtag tu gzhi gcig la phyogs gnyis ka phan tshun gcig la gcig 'dres nas yod par mthong phyir/ de ni ji skad du/ /kun la phan pa'i sman yin kyang / /sbyor ba ma shes dug tu 'gyur/ /kun la gnod pa'i dug yin kyang —/ /sbyor ba shes na sman du 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ thog mar sman dug so sor ngo shes pa dang / de nas sbyor ba la mkhas pa zhig yong phyir/ bya dngos tshang ma la dngos don bden 'tshol gyi tshan rig gi bsam pas sreg bcad rdar gsum byas nas bden mtha' dpyad gal che zhing / lhag par dug kyang sman du 81

bsgyur ba'i thabs dam pa rnyed par byed pa la 'bad dgos/mjug mthar/ gna' nas da lta'i bar du byung ba'i bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas tshang ma ni zhi dor dang mtha' dpyad pa'i sgo nas rgyud 'dzin yang dag cig byed pa la rang skyon rang gis dmar rjen du bton phod pa'i snying stobs dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i 'dun ldan tshang mas da nas bzung ste sgo kun nas dus rtag tu 'bad par rigs so/ /'dir smras pa/ dngos po gcig la phan gnod gnyis/ /dpyad gsum rigs pas brtag tshe gsal/ /de bzhin srol rgyun rig gnas kyang / /phan gnod mtha' bzhi'i mtha' las gsal/ /spyi tshogs rig pa'i thabs lam nas/ /kho bos rnyed pa'i dpyad mtha' 'di/ /gzur gnas lhag bsam dang ldan pa'i/ /rang rigs rnams la gos su 'bul/ /

bod kyi rgyal bu 'jang tsha lha dbon la dpyad pa/'bum skyabs/deb ther 'ga' zhig las/①'jang tsha lha dbon ni khri lde gtsug btsan dang 'jang mo bza' khri btsun gyi sras su 'khrungs shing / de la cin khrin kong co gnyen bslangs pa la blon po gnyags khri bzang yang 'don gyis rang gi bu mo ma blangs pa'i ko long byas nas 'jang tsha lha dbon bkrongs pas/ cin khrin kong co yab khri lde gtsug btsan gyis bcun mor bzhes zer ba dang / deb ther 'ga' zhig tu/② kong co bod du phebs dus rgyal bus mtshan mor rta rgyugs pas rtas bskyur nas sku 'das zhes pa dang / yang deb ther 'ga' rer/② rgyal bus mtshan la rta bcags pas/ 'phang thang dge rar sngags pas zor mda' 'phangs pa phog ste grongs zhes 'khod 'dug de dag gang ltar yang 'jang tsha lha dbon ni khri lde gtsug btsan dang 'jang mo bza' khri btsun gyi sras su 'khrungs pa dang / cin khrin kong co yang 'jang tsha'i khab tu blangs pa la rgyal bu ni kong co bod du ma gshegs gong nas sku tshe las 'das pas/ yab khri lde gtsug btsan gyis khab tu bzhes pa mgrin dbyangs gcig tu snang / deng sang la las 'jang tsha lha dbon bod kyi lo rgyus steng ye nas byung ma myong ste med ces zer la las 'jang tsha bya ba lo rgyus steng dngos su gnas par 'dod pa ma zad u tshugs dang 'ol tshod 83

zung du byas nas kong co 'jang tshar blangs kyang khong bkrongs ba'i mod la btsan po yab kyi khab tu bzhes pa 'di yang gna' dus grangs nyung mi rigs 'ga' la yab sras dag gis chung ma gcig thun mong du byed pa'i lugs srol yod pa ltar red ces 'ur gyis sgrogs nas/ btsan thabs kyis en khe si'i dud tshang dang sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs dang rgyal khab bcas kyi 'byung khungs〉 nang gi tshig don 'ga' la sbyar te khog gtugs shing lta ba gsar pa zhig yin par 'dod na yang / de dag lo rgyus dngos dang ma mtshungs par rgyab 'gal du song 'dug lta ba de rnams la mi 'thad pa dang dogs yul du gyur pa 'ga' byung bas / kho bos 'jang tsha lha dbon zhes pa de bod kyi lo rgyus gar stegs steng du byung min dang / don dam cin khrin kong co btsan po gang la btsun mor blangs pa dang gang gi khab tu gyur pa'i skor la rang gi lta tshul tsam gleng bar bya'o/ /'jang tsha lha dbon zhes pa'i mtshan gsol don/de yang 'jang tsha 'di pa'i yab khri lde gtsug btsan nam khri lde gtsug brtan dang yum 'jang bza' mo khri btsun yin pa rtsod gzhir mi 'gyur la yab sras gnyis kyi bar du mtshan thog nas 'brel ba med par gsal 'dug 'on kyang yum sras gnyis kyi bar mtshan gsol ba'i thad la 'brel ba dam po zhig mchis pa ma zad yum gyi mtshan la yang lkog gyur gyi gnas 'ga' mchis pas/ thog mar yum gyi mtshan la dpyad dgos byung ba de'ang 'jang bza' zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di la thug yod/ de yang bod kyi lo rgyus thog bod chen po'i rgyal khab dang thang rgyal rabs la sogs pa'i rgyal khab che chung du ma'i bar du gnyen slong ba'i lam srol yangs 84

shing rgyachebazhigabatsugs yod pa ni/ en khe sis zuganyen sgrig de ni chab srid kyi bya spyodacig lags shing gnyen sgrig gi 'brel ba gsar pa der brten te dbang shugs je cher gtong ba'i go skabs zhig kyang yin pas/ don gtan du 'bebasanus pa ni rus rgyud tsho khag gi khe phan yin pa las rang nyid kyi smon 'dun ma yin ② zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skabs 'di'i chab srid kyi dgos dbang 'ba'azhig la rag las pa bod la yang de ltar red/ stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi dus su khong gi sring mo zhig zing po rje la bag mar byin pa dang / srong btsan gyi skabs khong gi sring mo sad mar dkar zhang zhung rgyal po lig mig skya'i khab tu gshegs pa/ khri 'dus srong gi sku ring du btsan mo khri bangs 'a zha rje la bag mar gshegs pa/gyi srong btsan sgam po'i khab tu bzhes pa'i btsan mo zhang zhung rgyal po'i sras mo ru yong bza' rgyal mo btsun dang / stod lung mong nas zhang blon gyi sras mo mong bza' khri lcam/⑥ de bzhin bal bza' khri btsun dang rgya bza' kong co la sogs tshang ma rgyal khab dang rgyal phran du ma nas gnyen du bslangs pa sha stag yin pas/ gong gi stag ri gnyan gzigs nas bzung bod dang gnyen 'brel byung ba'i rgyal khab che chung du ma yod pa 'dir gzhigs na/ 'jang bza' mo khri btsun ni 'jang yul nas blangs pa'i btsun mo zhig yin par 'dod de/ ru 'jang yul ni da lta yun nan zhing chen nub rgyud kyi ta li dang li cang la sogs pa'i yul gru spyi dang / sa dam ni de'i bye brag li cang kho na'i ming yin/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus tsam la grangs nyung mi rigs 'gas mnyam 'brel gyis sa phyogs de dbang du bsgyur/ spyi lo 649nas 902bar lo grangs 253gyi ring la khu la kug dang / kug lo bong sogs rgyal po bcu gsum rim par byung ba de dag la 85

bod btsan po dag gis btsan po'i gcung zhes zer/ ① btsan po khri 'dus srong gi skabs su sgod kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i lho bal sogs ngo log pa la/ btsan pos ru sna drangs te dmag byas/ btsan po rang yang dmag thog tu bgrongs/ ②zhes pa dang deb gzhan las/ tsuyos bu'i lo ste spyi lo 703lor btsan po dgun 'jang yul du gshegs te 'jang phab par lo gcig de'i phyi lo'i dgun khar btsan po chab srid la māl gshegs pa las dgung du gshegs/ gyi zhes pa des bod dang 'jang gi 'brel ba gsal bor mtshon/ der bltas na 'jang yul ni btsan po khri 'dus srong gi gong rol nas bod kyi chab 'og tu chud yod pa rtsod med du snang / des na khri 'dus srong gi sras khri lde gtsug btsan gyi khab tu 'jang yul nas 'jang bza' mo khri btsun blangs pa yin zer na 'gal ba ci yod/ sku zhabs zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gyis khri lde gtsug btsan la btsun mo kha shas bzhes yod cing / btsun mo gcig tha'i nas bzhes yod pa de la bod pa tshos 'jang bza' mo khri btsun zhu/ ༷ zhes gsungs pa dang deb ther de las/tha'i bya ba ni 'jang yin par gsal bshad gnang 'dug cin khrin kong co la bod pa rnams kyis rgya mo bza' 'am yang na rgya bza' zhes mtshan nas 'bod pa bzhin / 'jang yul nas blangs pa'i btsun mo la 'jang mo khri btsun nam yang na 'jang bza' mo khri btsun zhes mtshan gsol ba la ya mtshan ci dgos/ yang deb ther 'ga' shas su 'jang zhes pa'i yig 'bru de /ljang dang jang zhes ci rigs 'bri srol snang yang don dam gcig kho nar nges so/ /des na 'jang tsha zhes pa ni/ yum 'jang bza' dang 'jang gi tsha bor gyur pas 'jang tsha zhes mtshan thogs/ 'o na lha dbon zhes pa gang lags she na/ (sba 86

bzhed〉(shog grangs gsum pa'i ngos)las/ ‘ ljang mo khri btsun la sras lha'i bu 'dra ba/ sna'i gzengs mtho ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ shin tu rmadzes pa zhig btsas pas zhang blon rnams na re/ bod kyi btsan po 'di rgyal po yang dag pa'o zer / sras la 'di mi min lha'i dbon po yin zer nas/ ming yang ljang tsha lha dpon du gsol lo/ / zhes dang / yang deb gzhan du/ /'jang bza' mo khri btsun la sras mi las khyad du 'phags pa zhig 'khrungs pa de'i mtshan du 'jang tsha lha dbon zhes btags/ yi zhes 'khod yod pa de las/ lha'i bu 'dra ba'i cha nas lha dbon zhes btags pa shes thub/ mdor na sras 'di ba'i mtshan gyi 'byung khungs ni/ 'jang bza'i sras su 'khrungs shing 'jang gi tsha bor gyur pas 'jang tsha zhes dang / skye gzugs mi las khyad du 'phags shing lha yi bu dang 'dra ba'i cha nas lha dbon zhes btags te/ 'jang tsha lha dbon du grags pa yin no/ /(tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig tshang〉(shog grangs so bzhi)las / 6yos bu'i lo(739)la/ btsan po dbyar chab srid la beg tu gshegs te/sras lhas bon dron na bzhugs/ bzhugs pa las nongs zhes pa dang / 8sprul gyi lo(741)la / btsan po sras lhas bon dang / btsan mo khong co gnyis kyi mdang btang par lo gcig ces pa 'di gnyis su gsal ba'i /sras bya ba des btsan po khri lde gtsug btsan ni de'i yab yin par mngon sum du mtshon zhing / lhas dang lha'i zhes pa gnyis sgra gdangs ches nye bas 'brel sgra dang byed sgra gnyis phan tshun ldog nas bris pa gsal/ spyir tun hong yig tshang la byed 'brel go ldog dang /ming rjes go ldog tu bris pa'i yi ge gang mang 'dug pa dper na/ lhas sgang tsal zhes pa'i sa ming de skabs 'gar lha gang tsal dang yang na 87

lha'i gang tsal du bris pa yang mang / sras lhas bon zhes pa'i bon yig 'di yang de dang 'dra ste/ skabs 'di ba'i bon ni dbon zhes pa'i don du go dgos pa dper na/ tun hong gter yig la blon po dbon da rgyal la bon da rgyal dang yang na 'bon da rgyal zhes pa dang / btsan po dbon mang srong mang btsan la btsan po sbon khri mang slon mang rtsan du bris 'dug pa sogs la gzhigs na/ (sba bzhed〉las 2sras 'di mi min lha'i dbon po yin zer nas/ming yang ljang tsha lha dbon du gsol zhes pa'i nang gi sras lha'i dbon po bya ba dang tun hong las byung ba'i sras lhas bon zhes pa gnyis yongs su mtshungs pas / 'jang tsha lha dbon ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog dngos su byung ba'i rgyal sras shig yin pa'i bden don ra sprod byas yod/de yang 'jang tsha 'di ba'i 'khrungs lo 'di yin zhes kha tshon gcod mi btub kyang / phal cher spyi lo723lo'i yas mas su 'khrungs pa min nam snyam pas brtag 'das lo ni 6yos bu'i lo ste spyi lo739lo la/ btsan po dbyar chab srid la beg tu gshegs te/ sras lhas bon dron na bzhugs/ bzhugs pa las nongs / btsan po yab dgun bod yul du slar gshegs/ btsan mo kim sheng khong co nongs par lo gcig 0 ces pa las 'das lo spyi lo 739(yos lo)la yin par bstan/ (snga rabs bod kyi byung ba brjod pa'i 'bel gtam lung gi snying po〉bya bar btsan po rim byon rnams kyi bang so'i dpe ris shig bkod 'dug pa der khong gi bang so ni khri lde gtsug btsan gyi bang so'i mdun du yod pa des 2 'jang tsha lha dbon bang so mes kyi mdun/ zlum por brtsigs nas gter yang sbas so jisazhes pa de bden don du mchis pa'i ra sprod byas/88

tson khrin kong co 'jang tsha lha dbon gyi khab tu blangs pa yin nam/yongs grags su/ cin khrin kong co 'jang tsha lha dbon gyi khab tu blangs kyang kong co bod du phebs tsa na/ 'jang tsha sku grongs pas kong co yab khri lde gtsug btsan gyi khab tu gyur pa red ces mgrin gcig tu gleng zhing gda' mod/'on kyang kho bo cag gis tun hong gi gter yig dang rgya nag gi thang yig sogs la zhib phra dpyad rjes gong gi bzhed pa de dogs yul du gyur pa ma zad dor bya kho nar snyam pas/ bzhed pa de bden par 'dzin mkhan dag gis bzod par 'tshal zhes zhu ba la/de yang rang lugs su 'dod pa ltar na/ thog mar bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i yab dang mes po rnams kyis btsan thabs dmag shugs dang zhi thabs gnyen slong bya dga' sogs la legs par brten nas sum pa dang / dwags po/skong po sogs chab 'og la bcug ste mnga' khongs yangs shing rgya cher btang nas mtho sgang gi yul gru chen po 'dir dbang shugs che ba'i bod chen po'i rgyal khab btsugs te phyogs bzhi'i rgyal phran kun las mngon par 'phags pa'i khar/ srong btsan mchog gis mu mthud yab mes rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi ba dan mthon por bsgrengs shing / de bas lhag pa'i mdzad rjes kyi thog nas shar phyogs dung ri dkar po yan chad bod khams yongs su gcig gyur mdzad/ srong btsan sku 'das rjes blon chen mgar stong btsan yul zung dang sras bzhi ste mgar btsan snya ldom bu dang / mgar khri 'bring btsan brod/ mgar blon zi mdo ye/ mgar btsan gnyan srung ston(mgar blon 'bal slon)bcas pas btsan po mang srong mang btsan dang khri 'dus srong yab sras gnyis la srid dbang skyong rogs mdzad 89

de bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag nas bod la sku drin shin tu che na yang /btsan po khri 'dus srong gis drin lan ldog tu 'jal ba ni/ smyo btsan po khri 'dus srong sku gzhon nu las cher skyes te/ blon chen lon yan dang lkog tu blo bsdur/de dus khri 'bring phyi rol du mchis pas/ btsan pos ri dwags rngon par ljags g.yar te dmag bsdus shing / khri 'bring la glo ba nye ba nyis stong lhag bzung nas bsad / pho nya ba mngags te khri 'bring dang btsan brodage gnyis la skad btang yang —/ khri 'bring gis dmag shugs la brten nas bka' ma brtsis/ der btsan pos ru sna drangs te rgol du phyin pa la/ g.yul ma sprad par khri 'bring gi dpung 'thor bas/ khri 'bring gis rang srog bcad/ kho'i blo thub snying nye ba brgya lhag kyang nyin der rang srog bcad de shi/ btsan brod kyis rang gi 'khor stong phrag gcig lhag dang / gcen po'i sras mang po rje sogs khrid de thang la mgo 'dzul/ tshu zhes pa dang / yig tshang gzhan las/ khyi yi lo ste spyi lo698lor mgar la bkyon pa / zhes pa sogs las mtshon nus/ tun hong gter yig la 'khod pa'i le'u dgu par khri 'dus srong gis mgar spun mched la mgur blangs pa'i don la gzhigs na/ btsan po khri 'dus srong gis mgar la khrims bcad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni / mgar khri 'bring spun mched rnams la srid dbang dang dmag shugs chen po mnga' bas gcig nas btsan pos srid dbang shor bar dogs pa dang sgos su blon po lon yan sogs kyis mgar spun mched la phrag dog byas pa'i dbang gis mgar la khrims bcad par mngon/ 'on kyang mgar spun mched rnams kyis btsan po la glo ba ring ba'i bya spyod gang yang byas med pa ste/ khri 'bring spun mched kyis phyogs gcig nas btsan por rogs ram gyis rgyal srid kyi bya gzhag 90

bskyangs padang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas btsan po'i dmag don gyi bya ba mchog tu bsgrubasapas/ phyi nang gi dgra bo thams cad las rnam par rgyal te bod khams bde 'jags su bkod/ lhag par du 'a zha thams cad chab 'bangs su bkugs nas /lo ngo sum cu lhag gi ring la thang rgyal khab sa mtshams kyi gegs su gyur 'ab bcas de ltar lags kyang / sa pho khyi ste spyi lo 698lo'i dgun khar nyes med kyi khri 'bring spun mched la nyes skyon phog rjes/ bod chen po'i dmag don la gyong kun chen po rdzog nas dmag shugs nyams rgyad du song / de nas dmag dpon mang po rje lha zung gis byas te rgya dmag dang thengs gcig 'thab pa yang pham nyes byung rjes/ btsan po khri 'dus srong sku ngo mas dmag chig khri lhag khrid de zhi krig tu g.yul 'gyed pa la rgyal kha de tsam ma lon te/ (thang yig gsar rnying〉ltar na da dung pham nyes byung ba sogs/ skabs der bod la blon khri 'bring spun mched lta bu'i dpa' mdzangs dkyil che zhing dmag don la mkhas pa'i blon po dkon pas bod dmag la de snga lta bu'i stobs shugs dang thabs bkod med pa'i khar/ chab 'og na mnga' ba'i rgyal phran 'ga' ngo log pa dang /nang khul yang 'gal cha mang ba'i dbang gis/ yun thung zhig ring bod chen po'i rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags la 'jigs snang byung ba de lta bu'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs 'og btsan po khri 'dus srong sogs kyis bod spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul dang bstun te thang rgyal rabs dang 'dum par byed pa'i re 'dun bton cing /rang rgyal rabs kyang skabs der stobs shugs nyams rgyad che tsam byung bas bod dang 'thab pa'i nus pa chung bar gyur nas 'dum par 'dod pa la/ 6lhad kyis pho nya ba blon mi bzang bya ba 'dum byed du mngags/ lu'u tse then nas smin te pho 91

brang du skems gsol bar gdan drangs shing / rol mo sogs rtsed mo mang po 'khyab ston byas/ 0 de ni rgyal mo wu'u tse then gyis rgyal srid bzung ba'i dus yin zhing kho mos spyi lo 690nas 704bar lo bco lnga'i ring srid dbang bskyangs shing spyi lo 705lor dgung du gshegs/ khrang an khri lo gnyis pa ste spyi lo 702lo ni chu pho stag gi lo la bab ste/ bod nas pho nya ba blon mi bzang bya ba 'dum par byed du mngags shing rgya bod 'dum pa'i lam du bkod de/ khrang an gyi khri lo gsum pa ste spyi lo 703lo ni chu mo yos la babs te/ btsan po(khri 'dus srong)dbyar la gling gi 'ol phyag na bzhugs shing / rgya yi pho nya ba kum keng (56)phyag btsul/dgung btsan po 'jang yul du gshegs te/ 'jang phab par lo gcig ⑫ 6lo de'i zla ba bzhi pa la/ sgod nas pho nya ba mngags te rta mchog nyis stong dang /gser srang nyis stong phul te gnyen bslangs pa la/ wu'u tse then nas kyang gnang ngo / / 0 zhes pa der gzhir bzung nas zhib tu dpyad na/ skabs de'i kong co bya ba ni khri 'dus srong ngam rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i khab tu gnyen bslangs pa yin par nges zhes pa'i sdom tshig kho bo'i mgrin pa'i dbus las thal te / 'jang tsha lha dbon gyi khab tu blangs pa la 'jang tsha grongs pas/ yab khri lde gtsug btsan gyis cin khrin kong co btsun mor bzhes zhes pa'i nor 'khrul de dag par byed chogade la sgrub byed gang lags she na bdun yod de/ rgyal mo wu'u tse then bya bas srid dbang bzung ba'i dus skabs ni spyi lo 690nas 704bar du lags shing /bod la khri 'dus srong gis rgyal srid skyong ba'i dus skabs ni spyi lo 676nas 704bar du yin pas/ sgod nas gnyen bslangs pa la tse then gyis 'thad de gnang 92

ngo zhes pa'i don ni rgyal mo wu'u tse then dang btsan po khri 'dus srong gi skabs su byung ba yin par bstan pa dang gcigabod lugs chu pho stag gi lo la bab ste/(thang rgyal rabs kyi khrang an khri lo gnyis pa ste spyi lo 702lor yin/)lo der bod kyis pho nya ba blon mi bzang bya ba 'dum byed du mngags pa la/ thang rgyal rabs nas kyang dmag 'khrug byed mi 'dod pas 'dum par 'thad de rgyal mo lu'u tse then gyis pho nya ba blon mi bzang sogs smin te pho brang du skyems gsol bar gdan drangs/ de'i phyi lo chu mo yos te khrang an gyi khri lo gsum pa'i(703)zla bzhi par bod kyi pho nya ba rgyal sa khrang an du phyin nas gnyen bslangs pa la/wu'u tse then gyis kong co gnang ba ni thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs〉(shog grangs148—149)dang / (rus sbal lcibs la bkod pa'i rgyal srid lo rgyus〉(shog grangs 80)(rgyal skyong gsal ba'i me long byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs〉bcas par dgongs bzhed gcig tu snang /da dung /yos bu'i lo(703)la/ btsan po dbyar gling gi 'os phyag na bzhugs shing —/ rgya'i pho nya kum keng phyag btsal/ dgun btsan po 'jang yul du gshegs te 'jang phab par lo gcig ci ces pa des lo der btsan po khri 'dus srong bzhugs yod par bstan pa ma zad 'jang yul du ru sna drangs par mtshon pa dang gnyis/ tshostag gi lo la babs te(khrang an gyi khri lo gnyis pa spyi lo 702) sum ru'i mgos chen po bgyis ༅ zhes pa dang khrang an khri lo gsum pa'i(703)zla bzhi pa la/ sgod nas pho nya ba mngags shing rta mchog nyis stong dang gser srang gnyen slong ba'i skyes su phul zhes pa gnyis thad kur 'brel ba yod pa dang gsum/ bod kyi pho nya bas gnyen bslangs pa la/ tse then gyis 93

'thad de kong co zhig gnang ba'i dus skabs te/ yos bu'i lo ni khrang an khri lo gsum pa(703)yin zhing / skabs der 'jang tsha lha dbon lta ci/ khri lde gtsug btsan yab kyang sku 'khrungs med pas kong co btsan po khri 'dus srong gi khab tu gnyen bslangs pa yin dgos pa dang bzhi/ gal te cin khrin kong co 'jang tsha lha dpon gyi btsun mor gnyen bslangs pa yin na/ yab khri lde gtsug btsan ma 'khrungs gong nas sras la kong co zhig gnyen bslangs pa yin zer na 'chal gtam du 'gro ba dang lnga/ skabs der khri 'dus srong dgung lo nyer bdun las ma son pas/ btsun mo 'ga' shas bzhes yod na yang da dung btsun mo gzhan khab tu bzhes par 'os pa dang / rgya bod gnyis mang du 'thab kyang spyir rgyal pham do mnyam zhing phyogs gnyis la gyong gun chen po byung ba'i dbang gis 'dum par 'dod pa ni kong co gnyen du slong ba'i cha rkyen legs po zhig yin zhing dmigs yul yang de lags pa dang drug stod nas pho nya ba mngags te gnyen slong ba la rgyal mo wu'u tse then nas gnang ba'i dus skabs te chu mo yos la khrang an gyi khri lo gsum par(703)babs pa dang / rjes su 'bro bza' khri ma lod kyis blon chen stong bzher mngags te gnyen slong ba'i dus skabs ni/ thang krung tsung li zhan gyi cin lung khri lo dang po ste me mo lug gi lo(707)la babs pas bar du lo du mas chod 'dug gcig ni bod la khri 'dus srong dang thang la rgyal mo wu'u tse then gyis srid dbang skyong ba'i dus su babs shing / gcig shos ni bod la 'bro bza' khri ma lod kyis rgyal tshab byed pa dang thang la gong ma li zhan gyis srid skyong ba'i dus skabs su babs pas/ snga ma khri 'dus srong gi khab tu gnyen bslangs pa dang phyi ma khri lde gtsug btsan gyi khab tu gnyen bslangs pa mngon sum tshad 94

mas grubabo/ /yin na yang / 8yos bu'i lo(703)la/ dgun btsan po 'jang yul du gshegs te 'jang phab par lo gcig yiyin zhing / de'i phyi lo 'brug gi lo(704)la dgun btsan po chab srid la mū la gshegs pa las dgung du gshegs ⑫zhes padang deb gzhan las/ 6 de dus lhad kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i lho bal sogs ngo log pa la/ btsan pos ru sna drangs te dmag byas/ btsan po rang yang dmag thog tu bkrongs zhes pa dag mtshungs 'dug shing mo sbrul gyi lo(hrin lung khri lo dang po ste spyi lo 705)la/ stod nas pho nya ba mngags te btsan po bkrongs ba'i gtam zhus/ gong ma krung tsung(li zhan)gis kyang der mya ngan zhus te / nyin gcig la srid khrir yang ma bzhugs/ ༅ zhes btsan po khri 'dus srong dgung du gshegs pas/ rgyal mo wu'u tse then gyis gnang ba'i kong co de bod du gshegs ma dgos par lus/ 'on kyang / skabs der rgyal mo lu'u tse then gyis gnang ba'i kong co de cin khrin kong co ma yin par 'dod de/ tse then gyis bod la gnang ba'i kong co 'di yin zhes ston rgyu mi 'dug pas skabs der kong co gang yin pa thag ma bcad pa 'dra/ cin khrin kong co ni thang krung tsung li zhan gyis / 8 dbyang wang hrig li bya ba'i sras mo'i ming du cin khrin kong jor mtshan gsol nas lhad du brdzangs ༷zhes pa des gsal bar bstan zhing / phyis su bod la gnang ba yin pa yang ra sprod byung 'dugade yang khri 'dus srong sku 'das rjes rgya bod gnyis bar gnyen 'brel byung tshul dang skabs de'i bod spyi tshogs kyi don dngos la bltas na/ 'brug gi lo ste spyi lo 7(4lo'i dpyid kur pho brang tshal(pho brang ldan dkar)du/ rgyal gtsug ru 95

(khri lde gtsug btsan)sku 'khrungs shing / dgun khar yab btsan po(khri 'dus srong)chab srid la mū la gshegs pa las dgung du gshegs/ de skabs btsan po dgung na ma son pa dang / bod la mgar spun mched lta bu'i dpa' zhing mdzangs la / dmag srid gnyis la mkhas pa'i blon po dkon pas/ bod chen po'i srid dbang de 'bro bzang khri ma lod bya bas rgyal tshab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes nas skyong bzhin yod mod/ 'on kyang sbrul gyi lo(705)la/ 6 khu mang rje lha zung la bkyon phab/ dbas khri gzigs zhang nyen blon chen por bka' bstsal/ se rib log par lo gcig chaces par gzhigs na/ dus thung lo gcig tsam nang tshabs che'i don de 'dra byung 'dug par ma zad/ blon po khu mang po rje lha zung la nyes skyon phab pa'i phyi lo la/ /lho 'dus sreg la bkyon phab/ 7 de'i phyi lor 2brung ba gnubs kho ma re gum ste/ skyin bar rdo phan kong bcug ci ces pa dag gis/skabs der bod srid dbang nang khul du rnyog 'dzing gi 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod ji 'dra yod pa mngon thub pa dang rtsod gzhi yang srid dbang kho na'i ched du yin pa bstan 'dug la/ de'i skabs lo 'ga'i ring bod dmag rgya ru ma drangs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang der thug gang ltar skabs der blon po dang btsan po'i bar du 'gal ba rnyog 'dzing che ba dang / chab 'og gi tsho khag gam rgyal phran 'ga' ngo log nas spur rgyal bod kyi srid dbang la mi dge ba'i gnad don tshabs chen 'ga' byung yod pa gsal bar mngon/gong gsal gnas tshul 'og 'byo bza' khri ma lod kyis chab srid la mngon par 'jug pa'i spyan zung ring pos bod kyi gnas tshul dang bstun nas rgya bod 'dum par byed pa'i bya thabs te/ gna' dus srid 'dzin mkhan rnams 96

kyis rgyun par spyod pa'i gnyen slong gi bya ba'i 'go brtsams nas/ spyi lo 707(me mo lug)lo'i zla ba gnyis pa la/ ‘ btsan po'i gyos mos blon chen stong bzher bya ba mngags te skyes phul zhing / mo'i tsha bo la gnyen bslangs/ gong ma krung tsung nas rang gis gnyor ba'i dbyang wang hrig li bya ba'i sras mo'i ming du cin khrin kong jor mtshan gsol nas stod du brdzangs ༅ shing / spyi lo 709lo(sa mo bya ste cin lung khri lo gsum pa)la/ /sgod nas blon chen zhang btsan to sogs kong jo bsu bar mngags/ mi (spyi lo 710lo lcags pho khyi ste cin zhan khri lo dang po)la/ 6zhang btsan to re lhas byin las stsogs pas/ gnye bo(gnyen dpang )bgyis te/btsan mo kim shang khong co ra sa'i sha tsal du gshegs/ nya thang rgyal rabs phyogs nas co wi dmag dpon chen mo dbyang cu bya bas gong ma'i bka' rtags bsnams nas kong co bod du bskyal ba dang / gong mas kyang kong co la rtsed mo mkhan dang dar gos sna tshogs pa'i rdzong gya nom pa bstar cing / chig tshi zhes bya ba'i rol mo dkrol mkhan mngags/ rjes su lhad nas zhus pa ltar hi zhi gyig chu'i sa cha kong co'i bgo skal du gnang / kong co bod du gshegs pa'i lo der yab khri lde gtsug btsan dgung lo bdun las son med pas/ sras 'jang tsha lha dbon ga la 'khrungs srid/de dag bsdoms nas bshad na/ deb ther mi nyung ba zhig tu cin khrin kong co ni 'jang tsha lha dbon gyi khab tu blangs pa la 'jang tsha sku 'das pas/ kong co yab khri lde gtsug btsan gyis khab tu bzhes so zhes pa ni nor 'khrul kho nar 'dod de/ yab khri 'dus srong dang sras khri lde gtsug btsan gnyis kyi bar du byung ba'i don de/ yab khri lde gtsug btsan dang sras 'jang tsha lha dbon gnyis 97

kyi bar du sbyar ba zhig yin pa mngon sum tshad mas grub bo/ /mchan 'grel/()(rgya bod yig tshang chen mo〉 shog grangs brgya dang don brgyad/ (snga rabs bod kyi byung ba brjod pa'i 'bel gtam lung gi snying po〉 shog grangs brgya dang nyer gcig(deb ther dmar po〉 shog grangs so drug (dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉 shog grangs lnga bcu tham pa/ ()(rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉 shog grangs brgya dang go brgyad/〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉(snum par)shog grangs nyis brgya so gnyis/()〈sba bzhed〉 shog grangs gsum pa/()en khe sis mdzad pa'i dud tshang dang sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs dang rgyal khab bcas kyi 'byung khungs〉()〈tun hong las thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha〉 shog grangs nyer gcigadu bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs〉 shog grangs brgya dang lnga bcu/(kye(bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo〉 shog grangs brgyad brgya gya bzhi/()〈thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs〉 shog grangs brgya dang zhe dgu/zhi ()(nye()4)4)phoyiphon〈tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus〉 shog grangs nyer ba ༷()(bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs〉 shog grangs brgya dang re drug()(tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha〉 shog grangs so bzhi/()(rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉 shog grangs brgya dang go brgyad/() khri 'bring dang btsan brod gnyis mi gcig yin te/ 〈tun hong las thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha〉 shog grangs nyi shu'i ngos las/ bang mo bang gar du blon khri 'bring 98

btsan brodablon por bcug ces pa dang / (bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs〉 su yang mgar khri 'bring btsan zod ni spyi khyab blon chen yin zhes gsungs/()rdowa〈 thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs〉 shog grangs brgya da~X( // kā/ga gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs〉 shog grangs brgya dang zhepho //yi/kye/ 4)(thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs〉 shog grangs brgya dang lnga bcu/phonyerkyunyaphon〈tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha〉 shog grangs nyer lnga/4)(tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha〉 shog grangs nyer drug

bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa dang thun mong ba'i rig gnas kyi ngos 'dzin dpyad gsum rigs pa'i 'dzum rlabs/ mdzod dge bud dha/phul byung mkhyen rab nyi zer bye ba'i 'dzum rlabs can/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i 'dab stong lhug par bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi bcud du 'khyil ba'i zil mngar 'bum/ /ci dgar ster mdzad dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog la 'dud/ /mdzes sdug gangs ri tshar du dngar ba'i bsil ljongs brda skad gnyen du 'gug mdzad ngo mtshar yig gzugs zla ba gsar ba'i gzi byin gyis//mtha' yas shes bya'i chu gter rlabs phreng gyen du 'phyur zhing sman ljongs rig pa'i ku mud sbubs rgya lhug par grol bas 'dzum zhal ston/ /snyan pa'i dbyar rnga srid gsum kun tu ldir ba'i mod la 'phags bod 'dzam gling dran dbang bye bas gtsug gi rgyan mchog nor bur 'dzin/ /e ma ngo mtshar smra ba'i khyu mchog bzang bo'i bod ces yongs su grags pa'i slob dpon thon mi sgo gsum pad+mo'i rgyan du rol/ /gang gi legs gsung bdud rtsi'i thigs pas kun nas gsos pa'i grags pa don 100

ldan bodayul paṇa grub skad gnyis smra ba 'jig rten mig /rtag gzhol brtson pa'i gru gzengs la brten mtha' klas rig gnas rgya mtsho chen por grangs med bgrod pas gtsug lag rin chen nor bu'i tshogs/ /thos bsam bsgyur dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bde lam la brten gzhan las 'dren zhing rang gis bskrun 'di nor 'dzin sgeg mos ma theg par//'khun sgra sgrog cing rngul chus dbang phyogs chu klung bdag po gter du bsgrubs pas kun gsal mdzes ma'i spyan zung nyi zlas gzigs mor byed/ /de lta'i ngo mtshar gzhan phan rig pa'i sbrang rtsi'i bcud 'dzin me tog dga' tshal ljongs 'dir skyed mdzad lo paṇa tshogs kyi byin mthu yis/ /deng gi char yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir bod kyi rig gnas mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig nyid du grub ces shes ldan rna ba'i dpyid du 'jo/ /de phyir bdag la yon tan nor bu'i gos bzang klub 'dzad mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos 'di yi ngos 'dzin don gsal rig pa'i bcud 'dus shig /rtsom par mdzod ces gsung gi gnang ba'i dri zhim pad+mo 'od rigs 'bar bas kun tu bzhad la bung bas 'phur lding cis mi bya/ /dpag yas shes bya'i snying bcud kun 'dus bod kyi rig pa'i kun gsal mtha'//blo dman bdag ltas ma lus brjod pa'i rnam dpyod stobs su rdzogs min yang //rang gi blo gros yar ngo'i zla ba'i dpal la 'gran par bya phyir dang / /skal mnyam gzhon nu'i rig pa'i myu gu skyed pa'i grogs su lhur len gyi/ /don gnyer 'phur lding rtse dgar rol ba'i gzur gnas dran dbang tshogs rnams kyis/ / 101

rmad du byung ba'i yang dag gtam dang nyes par bshad pa'i 'o chu zung / /ma 'dres so sor 'byed par rigs so 'dir zhugs skal bzang grogs po dag /ces rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i thog mar bshes gnyen la gus par bya pa'i tshul sogs don gyi gnad rnams ma 'phyugs par rang nyid la rnam mang rig pa'i dga' ston ci dgar stsol ba'i bshes gnyen mchog dang / gangs can yi ge'i byed po slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭa sogs lo paṇa rim byon rnams kyi bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan ngag gi lam du nye bar drangs pa'i shis par brjod pa dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba/ snod ldan mnyan par bskul ba sogs kyi tshul 'di yang shar tsong kha ba chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa'i bla na med pa'i rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las /de ltar don gyi gnad rnams ma 'phyugs na/ /tshig sbyor dman na nyes pa chung mod kyang / / rgyal ba nyid kyis gsung rab bsngags pa na/ /don bzang ba dang tshig 'bru bzang bo zhes/ /gsungs shing shin tu dkar ba'i khang bzang la'ang /bsil zer bye ba'i 'od kyis byugs pa bzhin/ /don bzang ba la yid 'phrog tshig sbyor gyis/ /spras par gyur na ches cher mdzes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang sgo de dang bstun par byas pa lags so/ /de yang bod kyi mkhas pa chen po sa skya paṇa ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan 102

gyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las/bshad sla ba dang bzung bde zhing //bstan bcos la yang rtsod bral phyir/ /mkhas pa la la bstan bcos lus/ /bsdus te thog mar dgod par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar brjod par bya ba'i don 'di nyid kyang bsdu na rnam pa gnyis su 'du ste/ bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang thun mong ba'i rig gnas so/ /dang po/ bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas bshad pa/gcig rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga bshad pa/'dzam gling nor 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa'i gangs can bod kyi ljongs zhes mthong thos dran pa'i mod la sgo gsum kun nas smon pa'i zhing mchog dam par gyur ba 'di nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa'i tshul la 'di skad rjes su thos te/bod ces bya ba kha ba can gyi yul/ /yul las khyad par 'phags pa de yin te/ /gangs ri rang byung mchod rten brtsigs pa 'dra/ / lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa yin/ /mtsho bzhi g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal bkram pa 'dra/ /thang bzhi rang bzhin mchod pa bshams pa 'dra/ /103

ya mtshan gser gyi me tog rgyas pa'i gling / /bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / /chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ /'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / /rkang bzhis kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/ / de ltar ngo mtshar che ba'i gnas mchog de/ /zhes dang gzhan yang ji skad du/ ri mtho bsil la dwangs pas mi rgyud rig pa bzang / yul la dge bcu tshang bas yon tan phun sum tshogs/ chu bo dwangs la bsil bas 'du ba rang bzhin gyis snyoms/ bsil drod kyi sngo sna tshang bas bdud rtsi'i sbyor sde 'dzoms/ mi thams cad legs lam la dga'/ chu thams cad shar phyogs su 'bab/ ri thams cad gangs dkar gyis g.yog /dus bzhi'i rnam 'gyur gsal/ mnga' thang dang longs spyod che/ bzang shing dang 'bras bu mang / phyugs rigs la rtswa gzan mod/ stod lha chos kyi yul nas lha ldan sprul ba'i gtsug lag /pho brang po ta la/ zhes snyan pa'i 'brug stong phyogs mtshams bar med du ldir ba'i sman ljongs 'dir gna' snga mo'i dus nas mi rigs rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i khyad chos 'bum dang ldan pa'i sngon bzang gi rtsa ba rab tu brtan cing / mi rigs dang rgyal khab gzhan pa'i rig pa'i legs cha bcud du smin pa'i yal 'dab kyi kho lag kun nas rgyas pa'i yang rtser gna' dang deng gi char yang dge mtshan mngon sum du bdo ba'i sde bzhi'i 'bras bus yongs su spud cing / shes bya kun gyi nying bcud 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas zhes yongs su grags pa 'di rnams ni bod kyi thun mong ma 104

yin pa'i rig gnas yin la/ nye rabs dang deng rabs kyi dus su rig gnas dang tshan rig lag rtsal sngon thon gyi phyi'i rgyal khab dang mi rigs 'ga'i tshan rig gi rig gnas gsar ba'i shugs rkyen chen po la brten nas rtsom bsgyur gang mang gnang ba'i 'dzam gling mi yi rig pa'i nying bcud sna mang 'dus pa'i tshan tshan rig pa ste/ dngos lugs rig pa dang / rdzas 'gyur rig pa/ tshab rtsis dbyibs rtsis sogs rtsis kyi rig pa/ 'grim 'grul skyel 'dren rig pa/ bzo las tshan rig /zhing las tshan rig sogs ni bod kyi thun mong ba'i rig gnas yin no/ /ci'i phyir 'di dag la bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang bod kyi thun mong ba'i rig gnas zhes pa'i ming gis gsar du snyad zer na/ 'di ltar/spyir rig gnas zhes pa ni/ shes pa dang rig pa don gcig yin pas/ shes par bya ba'i yul lam gnas dang / rig par bya ba'i gnas gnyis tshig sna bsdus nas shes bya'i gnas sam rig pa'i gnas zhes brjod la/ de slar yang bsdus pas rig gnas zhes grub pa yin te/ legs par bshad pa'i bstan bcos be+eḍūr+ya dkar po'i do shal dpyod ldan snying nor las/shes pa rig pa don gcig pas/ /shes par bya ba'i yul byed dam/ /rig par bya ba'i gnas yin pas/ /rig pa'i gnas zhes bya der yang / /zhes gsungs pas gsal lo/ /deng sang skye bo phal mo ches rig gnas zhes pa sum rtags dag gsum dang /105
