snyan ngag mngon brjod tsam du sems par 'dug ste/ de ltar na mtha' klas pa'i rig pa'i gnas 'di nyid kyang mtha' klas ma yin par mtha' chung nyid du 'gyur zhing —/ mtha' chung nyid las kyang cha shas tsam zhig tu ngos 'dzin par 'gyur ba shin tu gsal lo/ /des na rig gnas zhes pa ni shes par bya ba'i gnas spyi la go phyir shin tu rgya che zhing gting zab pa zhig yin la/ de yang bod snga rabs pa rnams rtag pa dang dngos po gnyis shes bya'i gnas su 'dod do/ /gzhan du na/rig gnas zhes pa ni 'gro ba mis spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus gsar du bskrun pa'i chu tshad dang / slebs tshad/ spus tshad bcas kyi ngang tshul zhig yin la/ de'i grub cha gtso bo yang spyi tshogs kyi mi yin zhing / grub cha phal ba ni phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten yin/ rig gnas de yang mi'i rtsol ba la ma brten par rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rang byung dngos po sha stag cig ma yin par/ de ni mi yis spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba nyams su myangs pa las byung ba'i ngos 'dzin dang / rtogs pa/ phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten bsgyur ba las byung ba'i dngos po'i nor rdzas thams cad dang dzha/ bsam pa'i nor rdzas thams cad/ spyi tshogs lam lugs 'phel rgyas kyi chu tshad / slebs tshad/ spus tshad bcas kyi kun 'dus phung po zhig yin zhing /dkyus gcig tu 'brel ba'i ma lag cig kyang yin/ der brten rig gnas 'di nyid mdor bsdus na phan tshun nang khul gyi 'brel ba yod pa'i rnam pa gnyis su dbye chog ste/ de ni dngos po'i rig gnas dang / bsam pa'i rig gnas gnyis yin / de gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba ni phan tshun rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i bdag nyid can zhig yin phyir rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi dang steng gi bkod pa'i rtsod sgrub kyi 'brel ba yin/ des na skabs 'dir brjod par bya ba'i bod kyi 106

thun mong ma yin pa dang thun mong ba'i rig gnas 'di dag ni bsam pa'i rig gnas kyi khongs su gtogs shing de'i grub cha gtso bo zhig kyang yin no/ /'o na bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas bcu po gang zhe na/ che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga'o/ /che ba lnga po gang zhe na/ sgra rig pa dang / tshad ma rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ nang don rig pa ste lnga'o/ /de yang gna' rabs su rgya gar gyi yul du yul de ga'i khyad chos dang mthun pa'i rig pa'i dngos po lnga zhes snyad tshul yod pa ni/ thabs la mkhas pa drin lan bsabs pa'i mdo'i nye bar bsnyen pa'i le'u dgu pa las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i dngos po lnga sngar ma bslabs na nam du yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par mi nus so/ /de bas na bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir/ rig pa'i dngos po lnga bslab bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / byams chos sde lnga las rgyan rnam gnyis kyi ya gyal theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan gyi yongs su tshol ba'i le'u bcu gnyis pa las/rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes bzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyi bstan bcos sa sde lnga'i nang tshan rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' shes bya'i gnas gnyis pa las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nang gi rig pa dang / gso ba'i rig pa/ 107

gtan tshigs kyi rig pa/ sgra'i rig pa dang / bzo'i las kyi gnas kyi rig pa'o/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i gzhi'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas stobs kyi rigs kyi le'u brgyad pa las/ de byang chub sems dpa' ci'i phyir thos pa tshol bar byed ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos kyi nan tan gyis yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par bstan par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi bka' yongs su tshol bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni gtan tshigs/ kyi rig pa tshol bar byed de/ bstan bcos nyid las legs par bshad pa dang nyes par brjod pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcad par bya ba'i phyir dang / bstan pa 'di la ma dad pa rnams dad par bya ba'i phyir dang / dad pa rnams kyang phyir zhing 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni sgra'i rig pa tshol bar byed de/ tshig dang yi ge nges pa'i tshig bzang po spyod pas legs par sbyar te/ brjod pa la mos pa rnams bdag la yid ches pa bskyed pa'i phyir dang / don gcig la yang nges pa'i tshig rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rjes su tha snyad btags pa la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir ro / /byang chub sems dpa' ni gso ba'i bstan bcos tshol bar byed de/ sems can rnams kyi nad rnam pa sna tshogs rnams zhi bar bya ba'i phyir dang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po la phan gdags pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni 'jig rten pa'i bzo dang las kyi gnas shes pa rnams tshol bar byed de/ sems can gyi don du tshegs chung ngus longs spyod sgrub ba'i phyir/ sems can rnams kyi gces par bya ba bskyed pa'i phyir dang / bzo dang las kyi gnas shes par sbyin 108

pa'i phan 'dogs bsdu ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes sogs mang du 'byung ste/ de ni skabs der nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab 'ga' dang / rgya gar gyi rgyal phran dang yul mngache bas tshad mar 'dzin pa'i kho tsho'i rig pa'i dngos po lnga zhes pa'i 'dod tshulayin la/ thang sin bla ma rgya gar du phebs skabs su'ang de ltar yin par 'dug ste/ khong gis brtsams pa'i chen po thang gi nub khul gyi zin bris las/dang po/ sgra'i rig pa/ gnyis pa/ bzo'i las kyi gnas kyi rig pa/ gsum pa/gso ba'i rig pa/ bzhi pa/ gtan tshigs kyi rig pa/ lnga pa/ nang gi rig pa/zhes go rim cung mi 'dra bar bkod 'dug /de las gzhan pa'i nub phyogs kyi rgyal phran dang yul 'ga' res mchod sbyin dang / srid srung / nges brjod/ snyan tshig ste bzhi la rig byed bzhi'am rig pa'i dngos po bzhi zhes brjod pa gtso bor byed pa'ang yod/rang re'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gna' snga mo'i dus nas gzhan gyi lad zlos tsam min par rang gi skad dang yi ge sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mang du ldan pa'i sgo nas bod kyi rig pa'i gnas chen lnga dang gnas chung lnga bsdoms pas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas zhes nyi ma gsal ba ltar yongs su grags pa zhig yod de/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung las/ thub bstan zhing sa gshin par sgrub pa tshul khrims so sor thar ba'i bstan/ /lung rtogs sdong bu lo 'dab rgyas byed sgra tshad bzo gso sde snod gsum/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu yongs su dud pa nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i lam/ /tshul bzhin gnas lnga rig pa nyan 'di sngon bsags bsod nams shing rtas 109

drangs / /zhes dang /mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la rnam dpyod rtsal du rdzogs pa'i mkhas mchog mthong ba don ldan kirti blo bzang 'phrin las mchog gi gsung las/kun gzigs phyag na pad+mo lha yi dbang / /lnga rig mkhyen dpyod 'dren byed stong mnga' zhing / /zhes dang / bdag gi sgo gsum kun nas skyong mdzad dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa/ grags pa don ldan gyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ bod kyi mtho rim phyugs bcos gso ba rig pa'i ched mkhas/ bod kyi slob gso ba chen mo/ mdzod dge nyi ma mi 'jigs dbyangs can dges pa'i 'od snang mchog gi zhal nas/legs bshad gsung gi 'brug sgra zab mo sgrog pa'i mod/ /skal bzang rma bya'i blo la dga' ba mchog tu sbyin/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i sprang char sil ma'i bcud bzang bos/ /skye dgu'i 'dzin ma rtag tu gso mdzad gang der 'dud/ /ces dang / bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan chen po rin spungs sa spyod dbang bos/sgra dang tshad ma'i rig pa gtum pos lta ngan ma lus shes bya'i dbyings su bsad / /bzo dang gso ba rjes su 'dzin pa'i phan pa mngon sum nyid du yang dag rgyu / /chos kyi dra ba sdom pa'i nang gi de nyid smra ba kun gyi rgyal po che/ /lnga rig mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor lo dus gsum bsgyur ba rnams la dang 110

bas bstod/ /ces dang / bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po tshe tan zhabs drung ngag dbang dbyangs ldan rig pa'i 'dod 'jo'i zhal nas/sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa sogs/ /mkhas dgu bag yangs spyod pa'i yon tan mdzod/ /ces dang / bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las mchog gis/yid 'phrog lang tsho'i gzigs 'dzin gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i skye stobs dpal 'bar ba zhes dang / snyan pa'i grags pas nor 'dzin khyon kun 'gengs pa'i nges pa don gyi mkhas dbang yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan mchog gi gsung las/dreg ldan zhal gyis 'degs par mi nus pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i phyag mtshan gnas lnga rig pa'i gdugs//zhes dang / mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba can/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis /sgra dang tshad mas log par smra ba sel/ /bzo dang gso bas 'dun ldan re ba 'jo/ /nang don dam pas nges legs lam 'bras spel//zhes dang / chos srid rig gnas kun la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa bla na mtho ba'i mkhas dbang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mchog gis/ 111

mkhas mang dgongs pa'i chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /ma rtogs mun pa bkru ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /lo rgyus tsha zer 'bum sde'i snang ba'i dpyid/ /lnga rig pad+mo'i mdza' bshes 'di rmad byung / /zhes sogs bod kyi mkhas dbang gser ri'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba lta bu mang bos rang gi phul du byung ba'i rig pa'i gnas chen lnga po 'di dag gtsug gi nor bur bzung ste/ bstan bcos kyi 'go brjod mjug byang tsam las kyang bsngags brjod mang du mdzad yod pa 'di'o/ /des na tshig dang don gyi 'khrul ba ma lus sel zhing rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la 'jug par byed pa'i rtsa ba'i yo byad dam pa sgra rig pa yin zhing / mngon lkog sogs shes bya mtha' dag par rigs pas dpyad pa lhur len cing / rang gi lta ba dang grub mtha' gang yin de nyid yang dag gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas tshad mar sgrub pa dang / log par rtog pa dgag cing sel byed tshad ma rig pa yin/'gro ba rnams la nyer mkho'i dgos 'dod longs spyod thams cad tshegs chung ngus bde blag tu bsgrub pa dang / 'dod pa ma lus yid bzhin du 'jo byed bzo rig pa yin la/ rten lus dang brten pa srog bcas mi na bar gnas shing na ba gso bar byed pa dang / tshe ring ba/ rgas sra ba/ nad med pa sogs kyi bde ba mngon sum du ster byed gso ba rig pa yin/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bla na med pa 'thob pa'i phyir du bstan pa'i bslab pa gsum dang /bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len sogs gsal bar rtogs byed nang don rig pa (skabs 'dir bod kyi bon chos smra ba rnams kyi nang don rig pa la sangs rgyas 112

g.yung drungapon nyid 'jog ste/ de'ang bod kyi nang don rig pa'i grub cha thun mong ma yinapa'i rig gnas shig yin par ma zad bod kyi nang don rig pa khyad parabazhigakyang yin no/ /)ste/ 'di lnga bo la mkhas pa bod kyi yul 'dir gnas lngarig pa chen po ba ste paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhes mkhas pa bla na med par mgrin gcig tu brjod la/ deng sang yang mtho rim shes yon can gyi rig pa'i go gnas sam yon gnas co'u hru'o(77)sogs kyi mtshan rtags bka' yig la phyag rgya ma nyams pa ster bzhin yod par snang / 'di'i thad la mnyam med tsong kha ba chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa'i byang chub lam rim chen mor sems bskyed nas spyod pa phyin drug la slob skabs/ shes rab la gsum du phye ba'i nang nas dang po rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i shes rab ni kun rdzob rtogs pa'i shes rab yin par 'dod do/ /gnyis / rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga bshad pa/'o na rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga po gang zhe na/ snyan ngag gi rig pa dang /mngon brjod kyi rig pa/ sdeb sbyor gyi rig pa/ zlos gar gyi rig pa/ rtsis kyi rig pa ste lnga'o/ /'di la bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma dag bzhed pa mi 'dra ba cung zad snang ba 'di ltar/ dpang lo tsā ba dang / 'jam dbyangs kha che/ snar thang lo tsā ba saḥshrī ste dge 'dun dpal ba/ rin spungs ngag dbang 'jig grags bcas kyis/sgra rig pa rjod byed kun gyi gzhi yin pa'i steng du/ snyan ngag dang / mngon brjod/sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar rnams bsnan te sngar rig gnas che ba lnga bshad skabs 113

bgrangs zin pa'i sgra rig pa de slar yang rig gnas chung ba lnga bshad skabs sgra rig pa gzhir bzung ba'i lnga zhes bshad 'dug ste/ de ltar na sgra rig pa 'di nyid kyang gnyis su dbye dgos par 'gyur ba'am/ yang na bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas zhes bgrang skabs dgu las med par 'gyur ba'i gnod pa 'bab 'dug la / dpal khang chos mdzad lo tsā ba ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sdes/skar rtsis snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang / /mngon brjod zlos gar 'di lnga la/ / rig gnas lnga zhes 'phags yul na/ /grags pa'i ba dan rlung ltar sgrog /ces gsungs pa'i don dang mthun par bod 'dir phyis kyi mkhas dbang phal mo ches rig gnas chung ba lnga bgrang skabs snyan ngag dang / mngon brjod/sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar bzhi po'i steng du skar rtsis bsnan pas lngar gsungs 'dug ste / 'on kyang snga ma ltar na rig gnas gcig gis mi 'dang zhing / phyi ma ltar na'ang khyab cung zad chung bar mngon te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ spyir skar rtsis zhes pa'ang khyab chung chung zhig ma yin mod/ 'on kyang bod yul 'dir dar ba'i rtsis kyi rig pa ni 'phags yul du rlung ltar grags pa'i skar rtsis ste dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las phyi dus 'khor gyi skar rtsis dang dbyangs 'char ba'i rgyud le'u bcu pa sogs las 'phros pa dang bcas pa dag las kyang brjod bya dang / de ston pa'i gtsug lag sogs gang ci'i thad nas de las brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis phun sum je tshogs su grub yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir bsil ldan kha ba'i 114

ljongs 'dir smra shes shing don go la lag cha bzo thub pa'i mi'i 'gro ba chags nas deng gi bar du spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang mthun par gna' snga mo'i dus nas mi rnams kyis ngal rtsol brgyud de snod bcud kyi 'jig rten la mngon sum dang rjes dpag gi shes tshor byung nas nyams myong gang thob rnams kha rgyun dang lag rgyun dpe rgyun sogs thabs shes sna tshogs la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos 'bum dang ldan pa'i bod kyi rig gnas phul du byung ba rgyu skar gyi grangs las 'das pa lta bu zhig bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod pa 'di yin la / de las bod kyi skar rtsis kyi rig pa dang / dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rig pa'i gzhung lugs cha yongs su tshang ba'i del rtsis sogs brjod bya mtha' yas pa'i rtsis rig sna tshogs shig yod pa dang / de min bod rgyal srong btsan sgam pos rgya nag nas rgya bza' lin khrin kong jo'am hru'i lin kong jo ste sras mo chu yi pad+mo khab tu bzhes skabs nas bzung dus rabs mang bo'i bar du rgya nag po'i yul nas bod du shugs rkyen thebs pa las dar zhing / der yang zhib 'jug dang je legs su btang ba'i rtsis rig sna tshogs pa la nag rtsis zhes grags pa 'di nyid las kyang skar rtsis kyi khongs su bsdus na 'tshams dang mi 'tshams pa'i rtsis rigs sna tshogs shig yod pa na/ 'di dag kun gyi spyi la skar rtsis zhes ma brjod par rtsis rig ces brjod na ni shin tu legs/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bod kyi rtsis rig 'di rang gi mes po gong ma rnams kyis sreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du dpyad gsum dag pa'i sgo nas rtsis kyi rig pa'i rmang gzhi brtan po zhig sngon nas gsar du btod yod pa'i steng du rgya gar nag la sogs pa'i rtsis rig sna tshogs kyi legs cha'i rtsi bcud kun nas 'dus shing / dri zhim yongs su 'thul 115

ba'i 'dab stong me tog ngo mtshar ba zhig yin pas na skar rtsis kyi ming gi ra ba las ches cher 'gongs yod pa ni mngon sum tshad mar grub bo/ /des na rgya gar gyi yul du skar rtsis rig gnas chung ba zhig tu brtsi srol yod pas bod 'dir yang de dang mthun par bshad pa 'di mkhas pa chen po'i gsung yin phyir da lta'i bar du rjes 'jug gi dran dbang rnams kyis de ltar 'dren bzhin mchis mod / 'on kyang der yang nges pa cher med de/ thang sin bla ma'i chen po thang gi nub khul gyi zin bris las/ rgya gar du skar rtsis bzo rig pa'i nang tshan yin par gsungs phyir brtag par bya'o/ /lhag par kho bos de ltar mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngon byon mkhas dbang chu bo'i rgyun lta bu bar med du byon pa rnams kyi gsung la ma gus pa dang / de rnams kyis bod kyi rig gnas la mdzad rjes ma bzhag pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug ma byas so zhes brjod nas/pha bsad pa la rgyal rnga brdungs pa'i dpe dang du blangs pa ni ye nas ma yin no/ /bod kyi rig gnas bzang bo 'di nyid yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin sngar las lhag par gong 'phel da/ phun sum je tshogs su gtong dgos na/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rab brag ri brtsigs pa lta bu gzhir bzung zhing / rjes 'jug gi mkhas pa rnams kyis yang dag pa'i rigs pas dpyod pa lhur blangs nas/ de la zhib 'jug dang snyigs dor bcud len kyi sgo nas dngos su lag len byed dgos shing ske/ de'i steng du kha snon dang / gzhan gyi legs cha tshol sdud/ gsar bskrun bcas bya dgos pa red/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag rin thang ldan par ma mthong ngo zhes zhib 'jug dang snyigs dor bcud len ma byas par mi gtsang ba bzhin du dor nas rang tshab gzhan byed dam rang gi rig gnas 116

thams cad brje spor byed dgos zhes smra mkhan yod mod/ kho bos ni de ltar ma yin la/ de ltar yin na ni sngon nas rang skad dang mthun zhing ma tshang ba med par grub pa'i bod kyi yi ge dbyangs bzhi gsal byed sum cu can/ deng gi dus 'dir 'bri klog sbyor gsum sogs gang ci'i thad nas kyang tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan zhing yig rigs ches sngon thon zhig tu brtsi bzhin yod pa 'di nyid kyang mi rigs gzhan pa'i skad dang yi ge la brten nas rgyang phud gtong bar 'dod pa'am/ yang na dgos med kyi yig nyog zhig kyang a ma'i lus nas gsar du 'khrungs par smon lam btab pa yin las che ste/ des ni 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta'i bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas la bar chad byas pa las phan du re ba ni rtsa ba nas ma yin zhing / gal te yin pa'i dbang du btang na'ang bla na med pa'i log rtog cig yin la/ lhag par mi rigs shig yin phyin rang la thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang khyad chos shig yod kyang yod la dgos kyang dgos te/ gal te de las ldog na ni mi rigs de rang rkya 'pher bar gnas pa'i go skabs rin thang ldan pa dang bral nas zungs med du 'gyur srid cing / lhag par bsgyur bya'i mi rigs de nyid sgyur bar byed po'i mi rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang khyad chos kyis phyi nang kun tu khyab par 'gyur nges pa ni lo rgyus kyi chos nyid yin phyir/ mi rigs kyi brtse dung la gus bkur byed pa'i gzur gnas skye bo kun gyis tshul 'di la dpyad gsum dag pa'i dkyil 'khor zhig bkod na shin tu sman no/ /da ni gong du bshad pa ltar bod kyi rig gnas chung ba lnga bgrang skabs snyan ngag dang /mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar/ de'i steng rtsis rig ces bgrang 117

na don la gnas par sems shing / de ltar ma yin par sngar bzhin skar rtsis zhes bgrang na ni ge sar can la ge sar zhes brjod pa dang 'dra'o/ /gal te bod kyi dpal 'byor rtsis rgyag gi rig pa sogs dang / nag rtsis kyi rigs sna tshogs pa 'di dag thams cad kyang skar rtsis kyi nang du 'du'o zhes smras na ni snod chung nang du dngos po mang bo mi shong bzhin du btsan btsug byas pa dang 'dra'o/ /de phyir kho bos 'dir bod kyi rig gnas chung ba lnga bgrang skabs skar rtsis zhes ma bgrang bar rtsis rig ces bgrang ba yin/ der yang skyon yod ce na/ de'i lan du/shes bya yin na dngos po yin pas ma khyab kyang / dngos po yin na shes bya yin pas khyab pa de bzhin du/ rtsis rig yin na skar rtsis yin pas ma khyab kyang /skar rtsis yin na rtsis rig yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ de la ma khyab pa'i skyon 'jog rgyu med cing / skar rtsis ni rtsis rig gi nang tshan yin pa'i phyir na/ de ltar brjod kyang skyon med ces sngon byon mkhas pa'i legs gsung dang / da lta'i bka' drin mtshungs zla ma mchis pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi legs bshad sbrang rtsis kun nas bskyangs pa'i skal bzang gung ba gzhon nu bdag gis dpyad gsum dag pa'i tshul gyis smras pa lags/ gzhan yang tshul 'di la sngon byon bod kyi mkhas pa 'i gsung las/ snyan ngag shes na tshig rgyan la mi rmongs/sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs / zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs/ rtsis shes na grangs kyi gnas la mi rmongs/ zhes pa'i tshig mtha' ma 'dis kyang don 'di la me rlung 'phrad pa stobs ldan sbyor ba nyid du 'gyur ro/ /des na gong du bshad pa'i rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga bo 'di dag bsdoms pas bcu phrag rig pa'i 118

gnas zhes bod kyi mkhas pa'i gsungs kho na las mang du 'byung ba'i tshul ni/bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen nges pa don gyi gnas lnga rig pa'i slob dpon chen mo bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros mchog gi zhal nas/rnam dpyod bdud rtsi'i mtsho la nyer chags pa'i/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i 'dab ma 'bum grol te/ /dge mtshan bye ba'i dpal ldan dri bsung gis/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten di kun khyab gyur cig/ces dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs las/e ma ngo mtshar rgya mcho'i rang bzhin kun gsal sgeg mo'i ska rags kyis kyang gzhal du med pa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/ /ma rmad mkhyen dpyod brtson pa mchog gi ka shi mdzes dga'i 'gram pa'i chang gis ba ki la yi dog pa ji bzhin 'byed mdzad pas/ /sā la'i yul ljongs tha snyad man dā ra ba'i phreng mdzes mang du thos pa'i dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 'bras bur spyod pa'i dga' ston tshogs//sngon byon mkhas pa'i zla med drin gyis 'phags yul paṇa chen rnam par thar ba sa 'dir 'phos la snying nas dga' bas yid rab phrogs/ /zhes dang /phug lugs rtsis kyi bstan bcos be+eḍūr dkar po las/mang thos rnam dpyod yangs pa'i gser mngal du/ /smin pa'i lang tsho bcu phrag rig pa'i dpyid/ /119

ces dang / rmekhas pa'i dbang po akyu yongs 'dzin dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyi gsung las/phul byung mkhyen brtse'i chu mthongs khyon yangs su/ /thugs rje nyin mor byed pa'i 'od stong gis/ /bdag blo'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i ge sar dbus/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i sbrang rtsi 'khyil bar mdzod/ /ces sogs lan gcig min par bod kyi mkhas dbang so sos yang yang gsungs yod pa 'dis kyang sngon nas da lta'i bar du rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan la ngo gnong mi dgos pa'i rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa zhig mngon sum tshad mar grub yod pa ra sprod byed thub bo/ /des na bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas 'di dag la blun phrug kho bos bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas yin zhes brjod pa yin/ ci'i phyir 'di dag la de ltar brjod ce na/ bshad par bya ste/ mkhas dbang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bstan bcos be+eḍūr dkar po las dri lan 'khrul snang g.ya' sel don gyi bzhin ras ston byed ces bya ba'i bstan bcos su/ gtsor stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rig gnas kun shes las/ don gnyer rjes 'dzin bzo dang gso ba'i dpyad / /log smra tshar gcod sgra dang gtan tshigs ste/ /phyi rol rig gnas bzhi dang —/ zhes phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas bzhi dang / de steng nang rig pa ni/thun mong min pa'i mdo sngags 'dir rig bya/ /zhes sogs mkhas pa mang bos gsungs shing de ltar bzhed la/ de rnams kyis sgra tshad bzo gso bzhi la phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas dang / nang don rig pa la phyi nang thun mong ma yin pa'i 120

rig gnas zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngar nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' dang mi mthun zhing / dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas yang dag tu khas mi len pa'i phyi rol mu stegs kyi mkhas pa rjes 'jug dang bcas pa rnams dang / ston pa shākya thub pa'i rjes 'jug ste dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas yang dag tu khas len pa'inang ba sangs rgyas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis sgra dang tshad ma/ bzo dang gso ba rig pa bzhi po grub mtha' phyi nang med par thun mong gi bslab bya'i gnas su 'dzin pas na phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas zhes dang / phyi rol bas tshad mar mi 'dzin cing bslab par mi bya ba'i nang ba'i ston pa sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bka' dang rjes 'jug mkhas pas brtsams pa'i dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams/ nang ba sangs rgyas pa kho nas khas len cing bslab par bya ba'i gnas su 'dzin pa'i nang don rig pa 'di la skabs der rgya gar dang grub mtha' sogs kyi shan zhugs nas phyi nang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas zhes bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang / khebs che chung sogs la ma bltos par logs su dmigs bsal gyi sgo nas brjod pa yin/ kho bos 'dir ni de ltar brjod pa ma yin par bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun dmigs bsal med par bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas su ngos bzung ba yin/ ci'i phyir zhe na/gna' snga mo nas deng gi bar du bod mi rigs rang la gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas shig yod pa dang / rgya gar sogs rgyal khab gzhan dang mi rigs gzhan gyi rig pa'i cha 'ga' re 'dus yod kyang phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas su gyur med de/ spyir mi rigs su zhig gi rig gnas yin yang lo rgyus kyi chu bo dal 'bab ring mo las phan tshun brje res byas nas shan phar zhugs tshur 121

zhugs ma byung ba med do/ /des na char ba chu grogs yin yang rgya mtsho ye nas chags med sar char chu tsam zhig 'khyil nas rgya mtshor 'gyur dka' ba bzhin yin zhing / lhag par tshul 'di la a me ri kha'i mkhas dbang pe ne te khi thi (2pa khyichab0713 )mchog gis/ spyir 'jig rten spyi'i rig gnas ni rigs gcig mtshungs kho na zhig ma yin par/ de la'ang rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i rigs du mar dbye chog cing / mi rigs shig dang lhag par thun mong ma yin pa'i mi rigs gtso bo zhig la mtshon na de la nges par thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas shig yod par bzhed pa ni/ skabs 'dir bod kyi don dngos dang shin tu 'tsham par gyur 'dug /des na bod la gzhan dang mi 'dra bar rang kho na la yod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas shin tu mang zhing / de las sgra rig pa la dper mtshon nas cung zad brjod na/ bod yig gi rtsa ba'i yi ge'i grangs nyung zhing sbyar na mtha' yas par 'gyur ba ma zad/ rang skad las da dung skad rigs gzhan pa shin tu mang bo zhig gi sgra gdangs ji ma ji bzhin du yi ger phabs thub la/ yi ge'i sgra gzugs don gsum 'brel dam por chags yod pa dang / 'dzam gling gi sgra sbyor yi ge gzhan la med pa'i srog gi yi ge tsheg sogs khyad chos gsar btod ldan pa ma zad/ don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming la/ spyir btang ba dang / zhe sa dang —/ mngon par brjod pa sogs bgrang gis mi long ba yod la/ de las bya ba'i ming la/ dus kyi rnam gzhag yod par ma zad bya byed las gsum gyi 'jug pa dang bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba sogs ku sha'i rtse ltar phra zhing zhib cha ldan pa zhig yod pa dang / rnam dbye tshig phrad phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pas/ yid kyi 'gyur ba/ lus ngag gi nyams/ don gyi khyad par phra zhing zhib pa sogs gzugs 122

can snang ba bzhin tshig gi rtsal thon thub pas gzhung lugs gang yin yang ji 'dod du kha gsal zhing gting zab pa yid 'phrog par brda sprod thub pa sogs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos sha stag gis gang ba'i bod kyi sgra rig pa ste/sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa la sogs pa'i rig pa 'di bod mi rigs rang yul las thun mong ma yin par grub pa'i tshul 'dis gcig shes kun grol du 'gro phyir rig pa gzhan rnams kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas yin tshul gong dang rigs bsgres nas dpyad na rtogs par 'gyur bas 'dir zhib tu brjod pa'i ngal ba bya mi dgos so/ /gong gi rgyu mtshan 'di dag gis bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas min zhes brjod pa'i go skabs gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhyen ldan su la'ang ye nas med phyir/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi yid bzhin nor bu 'di rnams bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas yin zhes bod phrug kho bos dpyad gsum rigs pa'i yum las 'khrungs pa'i drang gtam tshangs thig gi spun zla 'di nyid spros pa lags so/ / gnyis pa/ bod kyi thun mong ba'i rig gnas bshad pa/dngos lugs rig pa dang rdzas 'gyur rig pa sogs ci'i phyir bod kyi thun mong ba'i rig gnas su brtsis pa yin zhe na/ brjod par bya ste/ nye rabs dang lhag par deng rabs kyi dus 'dir/ tshan rig la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gtso bo zhig yod pa ni/ phyogs gcig nas mi rigs dang rgyal khab sogs kyi khyad chos tsam zhig la ma ltos par tshan rig las slar yang tshan tshan rig pa 123

mang bo zhig logs su phye nas rgya je che dang gting je zab/ cha je zhib tu 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin yod cing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas rim bzhin yar rgyas su gyur nas sna 'dzoms kun 'dus kyi phung po dang gcig gyur gyi lam du 'gro bzhin yod/ der brten dngos lugs rig pa dang / tshab rtsis dbyibs rtsis sogs rtsis kyi rig pa/ rdzas 'gyur rig pa sogs ni/ mi rigs gcig gi rig gnas ma yin par mi rigs mang bo'am 'dzam gling spyi'i thun mong gi rig gnas su 'grub bzhin yod cing / lhag par mi gshis bzang zhing rig pa gsal ba/las la brtson zhing 'thab la dpa' ba'i bod mi rigs kyi mkhas pa rnams dang bod kyi rig gnas la mkhas pa 'gas gzhung lugs 'di rigs brtsams pa dang bsgyur ba gang mang gnang zhing / slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug lag len dngos su byed bzhin yod pa'i phyir na rig gnas 'di dag la bod kyi thun mong ba'i rig gnas zhes pa'i mtshan gsar ba 'di nyid kho bo'i smra byed kha yi lding khang nas myong byed khye'u dmar leb gar du rtsen pa'i tshul las byung rgyal du smras pa'o/ /des na 'dir brjod pa'i bod kyi thun mong ba'i rig gnas 'di dag kyang gong du brjod pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi nang du bsdu bar byas na mi 'grig gam zhes gsung mkhan yod de/ 'on kyang de nyid thabs dam pa zhig min pas de ltar ma byas la dgos pa'ang cher med snyam/ mdor na lo rgyus ring zhing gzi brjid ldan pa'i bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'di nyid sngar las lhag par gong 'phel du gyur nas deng rabs 'dzam gling sngon thon rig gnas kyi gral 'gor rkang ba 'jog dgos na/ bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas gcig pu skyar zlos dang dam 'dzin byas pa tsam gyis mi chog par/ bod kyi thun mong 124

ba'i rig gnas dang / lhag par dus yun ches mgyogs pa'i sgo nas ches mtho ba'i nus pa yod dgu la brten te dar kha mgyogs pa'i 'dzam gling sngon thon rig gnas kyi legs pa'i cha yongs su tshang zhing yang dag pa'i sgo nas slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug lag len dang kun khyab dar spel btang nas/ dus rabs gang du slebs kyang de'i skabs kyi mi'i rigs kyi ches mtho zhing phun sum tshogs pa/dpal yon ldan pa'i phul byung rig gnas kyi grub 'bras gsar bskrun dang / de thad kur bed spyod thub par byed pa la 'bad brtson lhod med byed dgos/ de ltar byas na da gzod bod rang gi rig gnas 'di nyid bod rang la phan pa ma zad / 'jig rten khams kyi mi'i rigs spyi la phan pa'i nyin byed gnyis pa lta bur 'gyur nges shing / gal te de ltar ma byas na/ rba rlabs thengs gsum pa zhes bya ba las/ ma 'ongs pa'i yig rmongs pa ni/ yi ge mi shes pa rnams min la/sngon thon mi rigs kyi rig gnas mi shes pa dag yin/ zhes gsung yod pa 'di ni 'byung 'gyur gsal bar ston pa'i me long yin zhing / nga tsho'i mi rigs la ched du dmigs nas sman gyi tshul du brjod pa dang 'dra bas/ nad can gso bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba'ang yin/ de phyir bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba 'di nyid nad can gyis rol na nad las sangs shing / nad med kyis rol na lus stobs gso ba'i dpe ltar/ rang rigs kyi rig gnas rgan la gzhon pa 'di nyid stobs ldan shed bur 'gyur dang mi 'gyur mthar gtugs na rang cag rnams la rag las shing / lhag par shes rig 'jon thang dang stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan pa'i mi rigs shig byed par 'dod na/ rang gi rig gnas thun mong ma yin pa 'ga' re la sdang rdzas su 'gyur bar dogs nas/ phyi dang gzhan las 125

'ongs pa'i rig gnas la 'jigs skrag skye ba phar zhog da dung rig gnas de nyid kyi bcud rnams zas su rol na lus stobs gso ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ba dper na/ mi zhig gis phag sha zos pa na/ pho ba 'ju byed kyis zhu nas mi de'i lus phung 'tsho ba'i bcud du 'gyur ba las/ phag sha zos pas gang nyid phag tu 'gyur ba mi srid pa bzhin no/ /mdor na bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid yongs grags kyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas tsam ma yin par/ de la thun mong ma yin pa dang thun mong ba'i rig gnas mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa ni kun gyis rtogs dgos pa zhig yin zhing / lhag par tshul 'di la 'khyal gtam rnying ba'i bag chags zab mo can dang / rgyus med kyi rgyus gtam sgrog mkhan 'ga' zhig gis khron pa'i nang gi sbal bas nam mkha'i rgya khyon 'jal ba'i rnam thar bskyangs dang skyong bzhin yod pa ni tshan rig gi gos dang bral phyir/ rnam mang gzigs mkhan gyi mdun sar gsham par mi 'tshal lo/ /der brten bod kyi rig gnas 'di nyid la/ dus rabs kyi rang bzhin shin tu drag po zhig yod cing / de'i nang du bod kyi gna' rabs kyi rig gnas dang —/ nye rabs kyi rig gnas/ deng rabs kyi rig gnas bcas 'dus yod/dus rabs so so'i rig gnas la'ang rgyud pa'i rang bzhin dang / gsar skrun gyi rang bzhin/ thun mong ba'i rang bzhin dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhin bcas yod phyir/ dus rabs gang rung zhig gi rig gnas kyis gna' nas deng gi bar gyi bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas yod do cog gi tshab byed pa ni shin tu 'khrul lo/ / de phyir kho bos bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa dang thun mong ba'i rig 126

gnas kyi ngos 'dzin ji ltar byed pa'i tshul gyi dpyad gtam 'di nyid rnam mang gzigs pa po'i spyan sngar gus pas phul ba lags so/ / //'dir smras pa/phyogs su lhung ba'i rgun chang mngar mos ma bzi zhing / /lhag bsam dkar po'i srog gi bcud kyis yongs 'tsho ba'i/ /deng rabs gzhon nu'i rigs pa'i 'char sgo gsar ba 'di/ /'dzam gling rig pa'i yang rtser steg pa'i thabs su bskrun/ /'on kyang ngag gi zla ba 'di yis ma bsdams pa'i/ /nyes bshad ra ra'i dri ma cung zad 'dzin srid kyang / /yang dag rig pa'i ngos 'dzin kun da dkar po'i kha/ /dpyad gsum 'od rigs 'bar bas bzhad phyir brdzi mi 'gyur/ /de ltar ngo mtshar kun tu dga' ba'i rol dbyangs 'bum/ /rang rigs rang gi rig pas skyong ba'i slob gling du/ /dgyes chags zung gi rten 'brel tshogs pa'i 'bras bu ru/ /sgrog pa'i byed po mtsho ldan dges pa'i rdo rje'o/ /127

bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi ngo bo dang da snga'i gnas stangs la dpyad nas spyi tshogs bde 'jags la phan nges pa'i thabs 'ga' rags tsam gleng ba/bsod nams tshe ring /bod kyi khrims rgyud gna' nas dar zhing bod kyi khrims rig kyang rgyun ring du gnas yod/ rang cag gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i yul 'dir gna' btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su dge ba bcu dang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug /khrims yig chen mo drug sogs gzhir gyur nas khod so drug gtan phab byung ba nas bzung / rgyal po dang rgyal rabs rim byung gis rabs dang rim pa'i sgo nas rang gi dus rabs dang don dngos la mthun pa'i khrims lugs legs par phab yod pa de nged cag gi spyan lam du da lta dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa ni kun gyis bston du med pa gzhir bzhag /'di dag ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyi dbang sgyur byed kyi yo byad du gyur rung / skabs so so'i srid khrims la cha rgyus yod na/ bod bde 'jags yong spyad la phan thogs pa ma zad/ mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon pa dang mes rgyal gcig gyur srung zhing skyob pa la'ang phan thogs pa gdon mi za'o/ /128

dang po/ bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi gnas stangs dang khyad chos bshad pa/snying stobs dang blo stobs ldan pa'i bod mi'i rigs 'di la lo rgyus kyi rgyun yun ring zhing thun min gyi rig gnas phun sum tshogs shing rmad du byung ba'i mi'i rigs shig yin la/ lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i khrod 'dir/ spyi tshogs so so'i rang nyid kyi chos nyid ltar/ mtha' skor gyi khyim mtshes mi rigs dang 'brel mang po tshugs te/ rgya gar nag dang sog yul gyi khrims srol dang chos lugs/rig gnas sna tshogs bcas phyogs yongs nas bsdu len byas/ bod brgyud nang bstan bod yongs la dar ba dang bstun nas yul so so'i khrims srol gyi nang du nang bstan gyi shugs rkyen thebs pas/ khrims srol gyi rigs pa'i gzhi 'dzin sar gyur ba dang / de min rang nyid so so'i khyad chos ldan pa'i ma lag kyang chags yod pas sa gnas rang bzhin gyi dmangs khrod khrims srol thun mong min pa re'ang grub yod/ bca' khrims rig gnas 'di bod kyi rig gnas kyi gshin sar 'thims nas bod mi rigs kyi lus ngag gi spyod pa'i tshad gzhir grub yod/bod btsan po'i skabs ni bod mi rigs kyi bca' khrims rig gnas byung 'phel lo rgyus khrod kyi gal chen gyi dus rim zhig yin zhing / dang thog bod kyi bca' khrims rig gnas ni bod kyi rang sa'i srol lugs dang bon gyi rig gnas las byung zin par gdon mi za'o/ /bod kyi bca' khrims rig gnas kyi 'byung khungs dang khyad chos la zhib 'jug byed rgyu ni bod kyi bca' khrims rig gnas la brtag pa'i rmang gzhi yin/ 129

dus rabs gang 'dra zhig yin yang rtsa khrims ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyis gzhan la dbang sgyur byed pa'i lag cha gal che shos shig yin la/ rtsa khrims kyi rnam pa la brten nas rgyal khab so so'am dbang sgyur gral rim de'i srid dbang gi ngo bo gang 'dra zhig yin pa dang / spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi rnam pa gang 'dra zhig yin pa mtshon thub/ sngon gyi lo rgyus dag las/ dang thog bod kyi yul 'dir ma sang spun dgus dbang bsgyur gdang / de nas rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sil ma bzhi bcu/ yang rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyis dbang bsgyur ba sogs bkod yod pa las / gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir gna' gnya' khri btsan po'i sngon nas dbang bsgyur mkhan ma sang spun dgu dang rgyal phran yang du ma byung yod pas sngar nas rgyal khab dang dbang sgyur mkhan la med du mi rung ba'i khrims lugs kyang deb bam yig thog tu gsal bor bkod med rung dngos su yod dgos pa rjes su dpag nus/ gal te dbang sgyur mkhan nam rgyal khab gang rung la srid skyong gi khrims lugs gang 'os shig med na de dag gi ming tsam yang yod ga la srid / mar khe si'i dgongs pa ltar na rgyal khab ni gral rim can gyi spyi tshogs kyi thon dngos shig yin par 'dod do/ /khrims dang las ga'i sgrig gzhi ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyis gzhan la dbang sgyur byed pa'i gal che shos kyi lag cha zhig red / rgyal khab che chung gang 'dra zhig yin rung rang rang gi dgos mkho dang bstun pa'i khrims dang las ta'i sgrig gzhi re yod pa gor ma chag /yin na'ang rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs kyi khrims dang las ga'i sgrig gzhi gsal por 'khod pa'i yig cha shin tu rnyed dka' bas/ skabs de'i gnas tshul gsal por bshad ma thub na'ang / lde'u jo sras kyis mdzad pa'i(lde'u chos 'byung〉las/130

de nas yum bu bla sgang du gshegs te/ ye nas mtho ba la/ phyag tshang lho dang snyags / de nas phying ba stag rtser byon te dar dkar gyi yol ba dgu rim bgyis nas / bla'i sku ya rabs rnams kyis bskor nas/ gcig lag gi thang khrims ni lha'i lugs/ sgrung dang lde'u tsam ni byung / dgongs pa 'phrul gyi ras chags pas/gsang gros rnam gsum gyis phyi nang gi dmigs phye/ mi la chad rnam gnyis dang bzhed rnam lngas bod kyi khrims bcas/ yig tshang sde dgu dang dpa' mtshan rnam brgyad bka' rim par gnang ste/ 'dzam bu gling na mtha' bzhi rgyal po bzhi yang dpya 'bul lo/ /zhes pa'i tshig don las rgyal srid skyong ba la med mi rung ba'i khrims dang las ku'i sgrig gzhi bcos yod pa gsal te/ dar dkar gyi yol ba dgu rim bgyis zhes pa'i tshig don la dpyad na/ rgyal po gtsos pa'i sku 'khor tho rigs rnams kyis phying ba stag rtser gnas bcos te khrims yig dang sgrig gzhi bzo ba la/ blon po rnams kyis phyi nas rim par bsrungs te gzhan gyi 'grul lam 'gog gin yod pa'i don du nges te/ dgu rim mam rim pa dgu zhes pa ni rang re bod kyi kha skad kyi goms srol du shin tu nan po'i sgo nas dam rgya byas pa'i don ste/ dper na rgya rim pa dgu btab/ yod dgu thams cad po lta bu'o/ /gtsug lag gi thang khrims ni lha'i lugs zhes pa sngar g.yung drung bon gyi skabs su gtan 'bebs byas pa'i lugs rnams de gar rang gtan 'jags byas / mi la chad rnam gnyis dang bzhed rnam lngas bod kyi khrims bcas zhes pa'i chad ni bcad pa'i don yin pas na bka' yis bcad pa gnang ba'i don du go dgos la/ de yang bzang la nor gyi dpa' dar dang bstod pa'i sngags brjod bgyid pa'i bka'i bcad pa dang / nyes can dang ngan par lus la gcod 131

brdung dang nor la 'phrog len sogs byed rgyu'i bka'i bcad pa ste/ rtsa ba'i khrims srol gnyis po'i steng du rgyal po'i srid la phan pa'i bzhed lnga'am lugs srol lnga'i khrims lugs byung yod kyang 'di dag gi ming tsam 'khod pa las yig cha gsal po lag tu ma son pas thabs gzhan zad do/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos khrims yig don tshan so drug gam khod so drug ces pa gtan la phab cing / gzhan yang(bca' ba bzhi'i khrims)①ni bod rje srong btsan sgom pos bcas pa'i khrims kyi yan lag ste/ bsad pa la stong 'ded pa/ brkus pa la brgyad 'jal ngo dgu 'ded pa/ 'dod log spyad pa la byi rin 'ded pa/ rdzun smras pa la mna' sgeg pa ste bzhi'o/ /gtan la phab pa'i dgos pa ni/ bod kyi rgyal phran dang tsho ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas bod yongs gcig gyur byung ba'i srid dbang de sra brtan yong rgyu dang / stobs dang ldan rgyu/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi sgo nas thon skyed dag gong du spel rgyu dang —/ mtha' mtshams brtan po yong rgyu bcas dbos pa du ma'i ched du yin pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig yin no/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos blon po mgar sogs la bka' phab nas ha lam spyi lo641la dge ba bcukhyasogs rmang gzhir bzung nas bzos pa'i khod so drug de ni chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉ltar na/1 khod so drug las bka' yi khrims yig chen po drug ni/① 〈bod rgya shan sbyar gyi shes bya'i rnam grangs kun btus tshig mdzod〉/ha'o kun zhin dang to'u tshun chi gnyis kyis bsgrigs/mtsho sngon mi rigasadape kun khang gis 1987lo'i 8par zi ming nas phud/shog ngos 174na gsal/②dge ba bcu desrog mi gcod pa dang / ma byin pa mi lenapa dang / log par mi g.yem padang kun dang phra ma dang ngag 'chal dang tshig rtsib sogs spong ba dang brnab sems dang gnod sems dang log lta sogs mi byed pa bcasayin132

1 khrims rtse 'bum gzher gyi khrims dang / (las sne dang sa khongs dang go gnas dang las 'gan dang dmag shog dang sa srung)2 'bum gser thog sha ba can gyi khrims/(bre srang phul khyor zho nam se sran dang stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi blon po khri ngor snal btsan zhes pas bod du bre srang gi tshad gzhi thog mar bzos)3 rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims(bya bar 'os dang mi 'os ston pa)'di'i nang du dbye na/ 〈ka〉rgyal khrims bco lnga dang / 〈khu〉khrims chen bdun/ 〈ga〉mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug bcas bsdoms pas khrims phran sum cu so brgyad bsdus yod de/〈ka〉rgyal khrims bco lnga'i skor ni/ 1 mdzad pa gsum dang / 2 mi mdzad pa gsum/ 3 bstod pa gsum/ 4dmad pa gsum/ 5 mi mnar ba gsum bcas yin la/〈khu〉khrims chen bdun ni/ 1srog mi gcod pa'i khrims gshin stong dang gson stong / nam byin pa mi len pa'i khrims/ 3log par mi g.yem pa'i khrims/4rdzun spong gi khrims/ 5 chang la tshod 'dzin dgos pa'i khrims/ 6 kheng mi ldog pa'i khrims/ 7 bang so mi 'dru ba'i khrims dag go/ /〈ga〉mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug ni/ 1 dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song zhing dad pa dang mos gus bya ba/ 2 pha ma la drin du bzo zhing bkur bsti bya/3 mi drin can dang pha khu rgan gsum gyi yid mi gcod / 4 bzang bo la bzang lan byed pa/ 5 mi ya rabs dang rigs btsun pa la mi rgol zhing dang du len pa/6las dang spyod pa thams cad ya rabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ 7 lha chos dang yi 133

ge la blo 'jug cing don shes par bya/ 8 las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing mi dge ba 'ba' zhig la 'dzem pa/ 9 mdza' bshes dang khyim mtshes la phan 'dogs shing gnod sems mi bya/ 10 gzhi drang bor bya zhing blo sems dpang du 'jog pa / 11 zas chang la tshod 'dzin cing khrel yod par bya ba/ 12 bu lon dus su 'jal ba/ 12 bre srang la g.yo zol mi bya ba/ 14ma bskos shing ma bcol ba'i bya ba la rtog 'jug mi bya ba/ 18 gros kyi nang du bud med (bud med kyi kha la nyan che ba'i rgyu mtshan yang yod)kyi kha la mi nyan zhing rang tshugs 'dzin pa/16 yin min gyis ma tshang ba byung na yul lha brtan srung dpang du btsugs nas mna' byed pa bcas so/ /4 mdo lan zhu bcad kyi khrims/(kha drag pa ma skyengs shing zhan pa yi mi 'chad par gcod pa)5 dbang chen bcad kyi spyi khrims/(gnyis ka lan pa la bram ze dbyug can gyi glang g.yar ba bzhin phyir sprod skabs su ma smras pa'i lce bcad pa dang ma btags pa'i lag bregs pa lta bu'o)6 khab so nang pa'i khrims bcas so/ /(gnyis ka bden na rigs gnyis pa ltar bcad ces pa bzhin)khyim bdag gi khye'u chur lhung nas nyas mid cing khyim gzhan zhig gis rnyed nas khyim gnyis kyis brtsad nas mthar zhal lce ltar khyim re res gsos shing bud med re rer blangs nas khye'u btsas nas khye'u rigs par ming chags so/ /2 khod so drug las bka' gros chen po drug ni/ rgyal por sri zhu ji ltar bya ba la sogs pa rgyal srid skyong lugs skor yin te/134

1 rje'i sku 'tsho zhing zho sha slar dbul/2 rgod kyi gnya' mnan zhing /yang kheng gi rgyab rten pa/ཿ kheng rgod du mi gtang zhing /mo btsun bka' la mi gdags/4 so mtshams srung zhing /'bangs kyi tshal zhing rta dkyus kyis mi gcad/bya dgra 'dul zhing /'bangs bskyangs/6 dge bcu sgrub cing / mi dge ba bcu spang rgyu bcas so//3 khod so drug las yig tshang drug ni/1 gser yig/2 g.yu yig/3 dngul yig/4 phra man gyi yi ge/bya zangs yig/0 lcags yig bcas so/ /4khod so drug las phyag rgya drug ni/1 sgrom bu/2 ru mtshon/ ཿ sku mkhar/4 lha khang /bya stag slog6 yig tshang ste drug yin la/5khod so drug las rkyen drug ni/135

1 gung dang stag6 wa zhu/3 lha chos/4 thags dang bon/5 yig tshangs/6 thun ma bcas drug yin la/ /6khod so drug las dpa' mtshan drug ni/1 stag stod/2 stag smad/3 zer chen/4 zer chung /5 gam ras/6 stag slog bcas drug yin no/gong rnams rgyas par gzigs 'dod na dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i (chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉du gsal/gzhan btsan po'i skabs su gtan phab byung ba'i khrims yig la tun hong nas thon pa'i skor la/1 ri dwags rgyag pa'i skor dang /1 khyi bod nas myi bsad pa'i skor/3 brkus 'jal gyi skor sogs mang po yod do//spyi lo1354la sa skya pas bod yongs la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i srid dbang 136

thor zhig tu song nas sde srid phag gru bas bod la dbang sgyur byed pa'i srid dbang dngos su 'go tshugs pa dang / tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i bod kyi bca' khrims(g.yu 'brug sgrog pa'i zhal lce bco lnga〉zhes pa ni/ (deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉las/ de yang dpal ldan sa skya bas bod tsam du ma zad bod chen po'i rgyal khams la mnga' dbang bsgyur na'ang / gdung rgyud zhal ngo rnams thugs 'dod kyi 'then phyogs so sor song zhing / dpon chen rnams kyang tig mi chags par spo len mang ba gong ma'i khrims kyang hor gyi shan shor pa'i hang zom sogs la brten/ thang lhod dang mtho dma' ci rigs pa dang / khyad par hor khrims la mi bsad na sros tshab tu srog gtong bas mtshon pa'i khrims rma rnams sdig pa'i las shas che bar brten/bod chos rgyal gong ma'i lugs srol bzang po dge ba bcus gzhi bzung ba 'di nyid / tā'i si tus gtso bor mdzad par bzhed de/ tshul de nyid sgrub par byed pa la khas zhan rnams yal bar dor cing / dregs po rengs su bcug pa ma yin pa'i bden rdzun thang mar brdal nas/ dkar nag shan 'byed pa'i khrims kyis rgyal khams rgan mo gser khur lta bur bde ba'i ched du/1 dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce/2 snar ma wa'i zhal lce/3 sna mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce/4 zhu bzhes bden 'dzin gyi zhal lce/5 bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce/6 nag can khrag bcor(sbyor)gyi zhal lce/137

2 dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal lce/8 hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce/9 bsad pa stong gi zhal lce/10 rmas pa khrag gi zhal lce/11 bsnyon ham mna' bsgag gi zhal lce/12 brkus pa 'jal gyi zhal lce/13 nye 'brel 'bral bzlums gyi zhal lce/14 byi byas byi rin gyi zhal lce/15 nam phar tshur gyi zhal lce zhes khrims kyi zhal lce bco lnga'i rnams grangs zhib tu gsungs yod/spyi lo 1618la gtsang pa rgyal pos srid dbang skyong ba dang dus mtshungs su khrims yig zhal lce bcu drug gtan 'bebs gnang yod pa ni/1 dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce/2 sdar ma wa'i zhal lce/3 rgyal po me long gdong gi zhal lce'am sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce/4 zhu bzhes bden 'dzin gyi zhal lce/bya bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce/ca nag can khrag sbyor gyi zhal lce/2 dran 'dzin chad las gyi zhal lce/8 hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce/9 bsad pa stong gi zhal lce/138

10 rmas pa khrag gi zhal lce/11 bsnyon ham mna' dag gi zhal lce/12 brkus pa 'jal gyi zhal lce/13 nye 'brel 'bral sdum gyi zhal lce/14 byi byas byi rin gyi zhal lce/15 nam phar tshur gyi zhal lce/16 gla klo mtha' 'khob kyi zhal lce bcas bcu drug go/ /spyi lo1642la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtshos bod yongs la chos srid kyi dbang mdzad nas dga' ldan pho brang gi 'go bzung ba'i skabs su khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum gtan 'bebs gnang yod pa ni/1 rgyal po me long gdong gi zhal lce'am sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal lce/2 zhu bzhes bden 'dzin gyi zhal lce/3 bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce/4 nag chen khrag sbyor gyi zhal lce/5 dran 'dzin chad las gyi zhal lce/0 hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce/7 bsad pa stong gi zhal lce/8 rmas pa khrag gi zhal lce/9 bston ham mna' dag gi zhal lce/10 brkus pa 'jal gyi zhal lce/11 nye 'brel 'bral sdum gyi zhal lce/139

12 byi byas byi rin gyi zhal lce/13 nam par tshur gyi zhal lce bcas so/spyi lo'i1681la gnas dus kyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos(blang dor gsal bar ston pa'i drang thig dwangs shel me long〉zhes pa'i khrims yig don tshan nyer gcig pa can zhig mdzad yod pa de ni/1 srid skyong ba'i sa skyong de'i bya gzhag gi gtso bo/2 las tshan bcu gsum gyi 'os 'gan/3 blon po'am phying sang du grags pa'i 'os 'gan/4 dmag dpon dang mda' dpon gnyis 'thus kyi 'os 'gan/6 khrims kyi zhal lce gcod pa'i sngon du zhib bsher byed rgyu'i 'os 'gan/6 mgron gnyer gyi 'os 'gan/7 drung yig gi 'os 'gan/skyi dngos rdzas bdag gnyer byed stangs kyi skor/9 rgyal po'i bya bzhag phra zhib thams cad rtsis kyis gtan la 'bebs dgos pa/10 rta mdzo'i dpon gyis bgyid pa'i rim pa/11 rtse zhol lha sas mtshon pa'i nye skor gyi gnyer ba dang / mi dpon bcas kyis bgyid 'os kyi rim pa/12 gsol gzims phyag tshang pas mtshon pa'i nang skor gyi bgyi ba/13 bzo rigs 'u lag dang bcas pa'i do dam pa'i bgyi ba/14 sdom gcod pa'am 'gag pa rnams kyi 'os 'gan/140

15 dkor gnyer du gtogs pa rnams kyis bgyi 'os/16 byang rigs kyi rda ro kha dang / rtswa shing / khang pa/ gdan sogs phran tshegs kyi gnyer pa'i 'os 'gan/17phyogs su mngags pa'i tshong dpon dang gser yig pa'i 'os 'gan/18 yong sdud pa'i rim pa/19 bkar rgya nyis gshor bgyi ba'i rim pa/20 rdzong sdod kyi bgyi ba'i rim pa/21 gzhis gnyer gyis bgyid pa'i rim pa bcas yin la/ khrims yig 'di'i nang don zhib tu mkhyen 'dod pa rnams kyis dwangs shel me long〉nyid la gzigs rogs gnang /gong gsal bzhin bod kyi khrims rgyud gna' nas dar zhing bod kyi khrims rig kyang rgyun ring du gnas yod/ rang cag gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i yul 'dir gna' btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su dge ba bcu dang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug /khrims yig chen mo drug sogs gzhir gyur nas khod so drug gtan phab byung ba nas bzung / rgyal bo dang rgyal rabs rim byung gis rabs dang rim pa'i sgo nas rang gi dus rabs dang don dngos la mthun pa'i khrims lugs legs par phab yod pa de nged cag gi spyan lam du da lta dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa ni kun gyis bston du med pa gzhir bzhag /'di dag ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyi dbang sgyur byed kyi yo byad du gyur rung / mar khe si'i lo rgyus dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba gzhir bzung na skabs de'i khrims srol gyi nang don gyis dbang sgyur gral rim gyi dbang sgyur bsam blo'i chu tshad dang spyi tshogs de'i 141

dpal yon gyi chu tshad mtshon no/ /bod kyi khrims srol du srog mi gcod pa'i khrims chags nas lo ngo stong phrag lhag 'gor te dus rabs nyer gcig tu slebs pa na da bzod dpal yon gyis khengs pa'i nub gling dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab khag tu srog tshab la srog mi gtong ba'i khrims gsar bcad pa ni dper na/deng sang gi 'dzam gling 'dir srog tshab srog gcod pa'i srog khrims dor ba'i rgyal khab ni dbyin ji dang 'jar man/ o si khru ri ya/ ten mag grin lan/dbyi tha li/ ho lan/ mo ro kho/ 'khyags gling / phor thi'u gal/ par cir/ ne'u tsi lan sogs rgyal khab sum cu lhag las med la/ sngar su'u len gyis srog khrims thengs gnyis la dor yang gzhug nas slar du gsos/ 'ja' pin gyi 'bangs mang che bas kyang srog khrims dor rgyu la ngo rgol byed shas yod/ rang cag kha ba'i ljongs 'dir sngar nas khrims srol legs po zhig dar yod pa 'dis deng sang gi mi sna kha shas kyi snang yul du yod pa'i bod ces pa'am bod pa la gna' nas khrims med lugs med du rol ba'i khrims srid kyi dpal yon rjes lus kyi spyi tshogs su rol ba'i lta ba don dngos dang mi mthun pa ji snyed sel nus shing —/ bod ni pha mes yang mes kyi ring nas khrims dga' lugs dga' zhig yin pa'am bod pa'i spyi tshogs gna' nas dpal ldan du spos pa'ang zhor nas mtshon thub / deng sang bod rkun khar kher gyis grong khyer du nyul rku byed pa dang / sa phyogs yul phyogs ru sde tsho ba mtha' na khyim rus kyi rna bzung nas rtswa sa rtsod pa dang rku ras gsod rmas byed pa/ bod mi rigs kyi rna 'dzin rgyu kha g.yar nas mi rigs gzhan la gnod 'tshe sna tshogs btang nas rang mi rigs kyi bla tshong mkhan rnams kyis rang ngo tsha rgyu phar bzhag nas rang dpa' bor 'dod pa ni ches glen 142

pa sdug pozhig yin pa brjod yul las 'das/ 'di dag gi spyod pa ni mes po'i gdamasakhrims dang rtsa ba nas 'gal yod pa rang gis shes par chug /'di dag gi spyod ngan dang ston pa'i zhal gdams dang 'gal yod pa mthong sla/ 'di dag gi bya ngan dang 'dzam gling gi mi rigs gang dang chos lugs gang gi bsam blo'i khyer phyogs dang ldog yod pa kun gyis mkhyen pas na/ de ni rang mi rigs kyi mes po rnams kyi dor byar gyur la/ deng gi dor byar yang 'gyur dgos rgyu kun gyi phrag la babs/ bod kyi lo rgyus su rang gi mes po rnams kyis bzhag yod pa'i khrims lugs 'di dag ste bod kyi khrims rig gi dga' 'tshal du skyengs med bzhagayod pa ma zad/ da lta'i bod kyi spyi tshogs su'ang shugs rkyen thebs yod pa dang / tha na deng gi krung go'i khrims rig gam 'dzam gling khrims rig tu'ang gzhan gyis tshab mi nus pa'i go gnas nges can zhig zin yod pas/ nged cag bod kyi khrims rgyun la zhib 'jug dang slob sbyong bya rgyu/ dmigs su bod rig pa'i tshan khag gi khrims rig 'dzin grwa lta bur mtshon na shes bya ches gal che ba zhig yin pa ma zad/ rgyal khab gang dang mi rigs gang gi khrims srol gang yin yang nyes mgo gnon rgyu dang ya rabs skyong rgyu ni kun mthun yin pas na/ bod kyi gna'i khrims rgyun de deng sang gi bod pa'i spyi tshogs kyi phyogs so sor rkyen shugs sna tshogs mu mthud du thon pas/ bod spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags dang dpal yon la srung skyong byed dgos na'ang 'di'i skor la 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas na da lta'i don dngos su nus yon 'bur du thon yong rgyu gdon mi za/gnyis pa/ bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol 'di spyi tshogs dngos su spyad pa'i tshul la brtag dpyad kyi dri ba'i thabs la bsten nas/ spyi tshogs su bde 'jags 143

mi rigs kyi yul srol goms 'dris la gnod pa skyel zhing / 'di'i nyes tshabs che na lo gnyis man gyi dus btson dang yang na btsan nyar las skul byed dgos/ 'di dag ni tang dang rgyal khab kyis nam yang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi yul srol goms 'dris la brtsi bkur byed pa'i srid jus de bca' khrims su gtan 'khel byas yod pa de yin/mi rigs so sos rang nyid kyi goms srol la 'dzin skyong dang yang na sgyur bcos kyi rang dbang yod/ 'di nas bshad pa'i 'dzin skyong dang sgyur bcos ni mi rigs kyi yul srol goms 'dris la brtsi bkur byed dgos pa'i rtsa don gyi phyogs gnyis nas rnam bshad byas pa yin/ brtsi bkur nang du 'dzin skyong dang sgyur bcos gnyis ga'i don 'du/ gcig na mi rigs so so'i yul srol goms 'dris 'dzin skyong dang sgyur bcos byed pa ni rang mi rigs kho na la thag gcod pa'i 'gan dbang yod pa ma gtogs/ gzhan sus kyang 'gal rkyen dang gtor brlag byed pa'i dbang med pa mtshon/ yang gcig na mi rigs so so'i yul srol goms 'dris las bzang ngan gnyis ka gsal bor mngon pas/ mang tshogs kyi snyigs dor bcud len la dril bsgrags dang rogs ram byed dgos/2005lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 6nyin/ rgyal yongs kyi skabs dang po'i dmangs khrod bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug gros tshogs mtsho sngon mi rigs slob chen nas tshogs 'go btsugs/ hran dung slob chen/ nan khad slob chen/ zha min slob chen/ lho nub srid khrims slob chen dang ne'u po'u slob chen(yolkolkolha smo༅lkolha tsho/ ka/ )lkoho khro tshocholkolha lta'ilkostsa)sogs rgyal yongs kyi slob chen bcu lhag gi ched mkhas dang mkhas pa sum cu 147

lhag gi tshogs 'du'i steng rang rgyal gyi dmangs khrod bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi gnas bab dang de'i skor yod pa'i gnad don sogs bgro gleng byas pa red / dmangs khrod bca' khrims dang khrims srol gyi thon khungs sdog 'don/legs sgrig dang zhib 'jug las don la shugs snon rgyu ni mtsho sngon zhing chen dang rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khrims lugs 'dzugs skrun gyi don dngos la bstun ci thub byas te/ khrims lugs lag bstar gyi khor yug legs pa zhig bskrun par don snying gal chen ldan no/ /mi rigs khrims srol gyi zhib 'jug ni gsar dar gyi rig tsham/ zhig yin/mi rigs sa khungs rang skyong gi bca' khrims khyab bsgrags lag bstar byas pa dang bstun nas/ mi rigs sa khungs rang skyong gi bca' khrims kyi 'dzugs skrun rgyun chad med par phun sum tshogs pa dang cha tshang ba'i rgyu rkyen 'og /mi rigs khrims srol ni 'phel bzhin pa'i mi rigs bca' khrims rig pa'i las khungs kyi gzhi rtsa'i rig tshan zhig tu 'gyur 'os par ma zad/ bca' khrims rig pa'i rang rkya thub pa'i rig tshan gyi yan lag gsar ba zhig kyang yin 'os/ de ni mi rigs sa khungs rang skyong gi bca' khrims dang 'brel yod kyi khrims lugs snang tshul skor la zhib 'jug dang / mi rigs sa khungs rang skyong gi bca' khrims kyi nang yod chos nyid dang khrims lugs kyi khyad chos brtag dpyad byed pa'i tshan rig cig yin/ mi rigs khrims srol la slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byas na/ da lta'i nub rgyud kyi gsar spel chen mo dang mthun bde'i spyi tshogs bskrun rgyu/ nga tshos mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi rtsa don rgyun 'khyongs rgyu dang / mi rigs so so'i khrims mthun gyi khe dbang la 'gan len rgyu/ mi rigs so so'i bar gyi mthun sgril sra 148

brtan du gtong rgyu/ mes rgyal yongs su gcig gyur yong rgyu dang krung hwa mi rigs kyi rlabs che ba'i yar dar gyi las don chen mo bcas la don snying gal chen po dang nus pa rgya chen po zhig ldan no/ /bod kyi khrims lugs rig gnas kyis da bar du bod yul gyi spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags dang 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen gal chen po zhig thon yod pa dang /'di ni bod kyi mi tshos bsam blo lag len khrod kyi ches ngo mtshar ba'i tshon mdangs bkra ba'i me tog bzhad pa zhig yin/ sa gnas so sor dus yun ring bor phan tshun gcig khongs su mi gtogs pas khrims srol so sor snang bar ma zad / bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther nang yang 'di'i skor gyi don tshan bkod pa ha cang nyung ba'i rkyen gyis/ mang che ba ngag rgyun du chags yod pas nges par du mgyogs myur ngang 'tshol sdud dang legs sgrig byed dgos/ krung go gsar ba tshugs rjes su/ rgyal khab kyis bod sa gnas so so'i dmangs khrod kyi khrims srol khag gcig la 'tshol sdud dang legs sgrig /dpe skrun dang zhib 'jug byas pas/nyams myong dang dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rtsa chen 'ga' 'tshol sdud thub yod pa dang —/ 'dis bod kyi dmangs khrod khrims srol la sngar las lhag pa'i zhib 'jug byed par rmang gzhi nges can zhig bton yod/dpyad gzhi 'di'i kha byang nas khyab khongs kyi phyogs gang la bltas na/ spyi tshogs zhig la rags bsdus kyis brtag dpyad tsam byas pa dang bsdur na lhag tu zab cing phra ba'i khyad chos ldan/ bod kyi dmangs khrod khrims srol 'di sngon gyi spyi tshogs brtag dpyad re gnyis dang sa gnas lo rgyus kha shas su cung tsam bshad yod pa de/ ngo sprod tsam dang phyi tshul tsam/ khe phan tsam zhig mtshon pa 149

yin par ma zad/ thar thor dang cha mi tshang ba/ zhib phra dang dngos yod min pa/rigs pa'i gzhung lugs nas dpyad bsdur nyung ba sogs kyi skyon mang bas na/dpyad gzhi 'dis bod sa gnas so so'i dmangs khrod khrims srol dang srid 'dzin / sa bab dang mi grangs khyab tshul sogs re re bzhin rnam grangs gsal bar 'god rgyu ma zad/ ches gtso bo ni dmangs khrod khrims srol gyi byung 'phel dang 'gyur ldog /mtha' skor gyi khyim mtshes mi rigs so so'i bar gyi 'brel ba sogs yang dag par gsal bshad byed ci thub la 'bad rgyu ma zad/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi shugs rkyen thebs pa'i gnad rnams gzhir bzung nas/ mar khe si'i dngos gtso ring lugs dang dngos yod rtsod sgrub rigs pa'i dpyad thabs bkol te deng skabs bod kyi dngos yod 'tsho ba dngos la dmigs nas/ bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khrims lugs 'dzugs skrun bar gyi mthun sa btsal nas/ bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol lta bu'i srol rgyun rig gnas dag bde legs ngang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khrims lugs 'dzugs skrun gyi bcud du 'gyur bar byas na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mi rigs sa khul gyi 'phel rgyas dang 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs thub cing / nub rgyud gsar spel chen mo'i skabs 'dir bod yongs su bde 'jags yong bar mi chos kyi khor yug legs po zhig kyang bskrun thub pa ma zad/ lag len du 'khyol thub pa'i khrims gzhi'i srid jus kyi gzhi 'dzin sa zhig tu'ang 'gyur nges yin/gsham du bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol 'di spyi tshogs dngos su spyad pa'i tshul la brtag dpyad kyi thabs dang / tshod lta'i lag len du bstar spyad la bsam 'char gyi dogs gzhi 'ga' tshul bzhin bkod na/ 'di'i thad la bsam 150

gzhig btang nas de'i phan yon la cha rgyus blangs na 'os snyam/da lta'i skor dang bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi shes bya'i skor gyi dogs zhu/1 dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rim mgyogs por bstun nas/khyed kyis bltas na bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyis ji ltar deng gi spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho dang bstun dgos/2 khyed kyis bltas na da lta'i bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol 'di lugs mthun zhig e yin/ don tshan gang dag ched du dmigs nas kha bsnon dgos pa dang —/don tshan gang dag nyung 'phri dang gcig sdud byed dgos/3 don dngos kyi lag len khrod/ khyed kyis bltas na bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi don tshan gang dag bkol spyod byed mi thub bam mi bzang bar snang —/ ji ltar dag bcos byed dgos/4 khyed kyis bltas na rang sa dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi lag len gyis ra sprod byed thub pa'i nyams myong dang byed thabs gang dag bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol du kha snon dang gsal bshad byed dgos pa ma zad/ gtan 'khel dang nges gsal byed dgos/5 khyed kyis bltas na bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyis bod rigs kyi khe dbang srung 'dzin dang mi rigs mthun sgril phyogs nas mi 'dang sa gang dag yod pa dang ji ltar thag gcod byas na bod rigs kyi khe dbang srung skyob dang dus mtshungs su mi rigs mthun sgril srung 'dzin byed thub/6 khyed kyis bltas na bod yul gyi slob gso/ las 'khod/ dbul skyor/spyi tshogs la 'gan len/ rig gnas/ lus rtsal sogs phyogs yongs nas gnad 151

don gang dag yod pa dang / ji ltar bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol la dag bcos dang kha snon byas te/ rtsa ba nas gnas tshul 'di dag legs bcos byed thub/7 khyed kyis bltas na bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol dang bca' khrims gzhan dag bar 'gal ba e yod/ gal te yod na/ khyed kyis bltas na gnad don 'di ji ltar thag gcod dgos/8 rgyal khab kyis mi dmangs kyi ched du mi gtso bor bzung nas srid skyong ba dang / dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs gnyis ga zung du mthun 'grig ngang gong 'phel yong rgyur do snang chen po byed pa'i go rim khrod/ ji ltar khrims 'dzugs la brgyud nas bod yul dang shar lho'i mtsho rgyud kyi sngon thon grong khyer dag do mnyam du khyon yongs nas 'byor 'bring gi spyi tshogs su bsgyur dgos/9 nub rgyud gsar spel chen mo dang / spyi tshogs la 'gan len dang yang bskyar las zhugs kyi srid jus je bzang du gtong rgyu/ dbul phongs can la sman bcos kyi jogs skyor/ rong 'brog pa'i ches dma' ba'i 'tsho bar 'gan len gyi lag bstar byed pa sogs kyi go rim du bod yul yongs la mthun pa'i bsam 'char gang yod 'god par zhu/10 khyed kyis bltas na bod yul du bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khrims lugs bar ji ltar zung 'brel dam tshags yong thub/11 khyed kyis bltas na bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyis rang sa'i mi rnams kyi bya spyod la mdzub ston byed par nus pa gang dag thon yod/12 khyed kyis deng skabs bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi mi 'dang sa dang skyon char lta tshul ji 'dra 'dzin/152

13 gal te bod yul la bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi kun spyod spel rgyu lag bstar byas na/ khyed kyis bltas na bya ba gang dag je legs su sgrub dgos/14 khyed kyis da lta'i gnas bab la lta tshul ci yod/ khyed kyis bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi 'gyur phyogs la bsam 'char ga 'dra yod/15 khyed kyis bltas na nye char ches do snang byed dgos sa'i bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi gnad don gang dag yin/ji ltar thag gcod dgos/16 khyed kyis bltas na nye char bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi nang gi bsam blo'i 'dzin stangs gang phyogs la nyams 'jog byed dgos/17 khyed kyis bltas na bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol kyis nub rgyud gsar spel chen mo dang /mthun 'grig gi spyi tshogs bcas la nus pa gtso bo gang dag 'don nus/de bas na/ gong gi dri ba dag la bsam gzhig btang nas/ bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol kyi gnas stangs la brtag dpyad byed sa'i gnas gzhi gtso bo de/gna' rabs bod kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs dang / nye rabs bod kyi tsho ba'i gnas stangs/ deng dus bod kyi tsho ba'i gnas stangs/ bod kyi srol rgyun khrims srol gyi gnas gzhi dang khyad chos gtso bo/ bod khams so so'i srol rgyun khrims srol bod kyi tsho ba'i khrims srol gyi 'grig lam/ bod kyi tsho ba'i khrims srol gyi ma 'ongs pa'i lam bcas yin pas na/ gong gi zhib 'jug gi gnas dag la dpyad na/ srol rgyun gyi khrims srol 'dir don dngos kyi dpyad 'bras shig thon nges / bod sa khul gyi spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags dang / mi rigs mthun sgril/153

2002 (12)( chos thamacho can stsaṭha4 spo cha shāṭha ma ṣ+ṭha ////shāḥswādzādzādzādzādzāhāXṣ+ṭhasbyināḥrāḥsturā zloskyuḥtrīḥlo ༈ ཿswāzlomacho cha (rdoX// bod rgya shan sbyar gyi shes bya'i rnam grangs kun btus tshig mdzod〉ha'o kun zhon dang to'u tshun chi gnyis kyis bsgrigs/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1987lo'i zla8par zi ling nas phud/

mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi(klu sgrub dgongs rgyan〉 la rags tsam dpyad pa/a sngags tshe ring bkra shis/gcig zhi brjod/de yang zab mo dbu ma'i srol 'byed 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rtsa sher sogs bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs su lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum gyis thog mar bod du drangs nas 'chad nyan spel gsum gyi dbu brtsams te deng gi bar lo paṇa gser ri'i phreng ba byon pa rnams nas phyogs 'di la byas rjes rang so so'i nus pa ltar che chung sna tshogs bzhag yod pa ni zab mo dbu ma'i lugs bzang gangs can ljongs su byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus la phyi mig cig 'phangs pa las gsal ler shes thub/ de dag las lo tsā ba chen po pā tshab nyi ma grags pa nas dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i dbu ma la 'jug pa sogs thal 'gyur ba'i gzhung lugs bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab rjes 'khor slob kyi rgya mtsho bskyangs shing —/ tshig la mkhas pa dar yon tan grags/ don la mkhas pa gtsang pa sa sbos / gnyis ka la mkhas pa rma bya byang ye/ gnyis ka la mi mkhas pa zhang thang zag pa zhes bu chen bzhi byon te snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs bcur 'bar ba byung /de nas slob brgyud de dag las mched pa'i thal 'gyur ba'i 'chad nyan gyi lugs 156

'dra min sna tshogs rgya mtsho chen po'i klong brdol ba lta bu ste/ rma bya byang brtson nas mched pa'i slob brgyud las bu ston rin chen grub dang red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ yar 'brog pa rin chen tog rje tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa sogs byon zhing / zhang thang zag pa las rong ston shes bya kun khyab dang stag lo shes rab rin chen/ gser mdog paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ gi rams bsod nams seng ge sogs zab mo dbu ma las thal 'gyur lugs bzang 'chad nyan spel gsum la byas rjes bla lhag bzhag pa'i mkhas pa tshab mtshon rang bzhin can de rnams byon pas/ gangs can gyi sa dge bka' rnying sogs grub mtha' ris med kyis lta spyod gnyis las lta ba ni rmad du byung ba dpal 'phags pa klu yi dbang po khongs su bcol ba 'di ko byung / zab mo dbu ma 'chad spel gyi khrod mkhas pa so so nas gdul bya'i blo yi khyad par la bstun/ don gyi gnad khrol ba la rtsal 'don lugs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis tha snyad kyi zhal bzhes cung zad mi 'dra ba byung mod/ mthar thug gi dgongs pa dbu ma chen po spros bral mnyam pa nyid du dbye bsri med par gcig tu gzhol zhing 'bab pa'o/ /de yang tha snyad kyi zhal bzhes mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis sngon byon mkhas pa'i khrod du rong ston stag lo go shāka sogs snga rabs lugs 'dzin gyis rje tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i phyogs 'di'i lta grub la skyon brjod mang du mdzad cing /rje'i slob brgyud las mkhas grub rje dang se ra rje btsun/ paṇa chen bde legs nyi ma/ 'jam dbyangs dga' blo/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs nas brgal lan rgya chen mdzad de rje'i lta grub srung 'dzin byas/ snga phyi phyogs gnyis nas kyang rang rang la rgyab rten gyi lung 167

dang dgongs pa'i bab/ rigs pa'i 'gros khyad par ba re yod pas na/ rang lugs kyi dar cha bsgrengs te/ brgal lan dag tu tshig gi shags 'dra min gyis bsdos te gzhan lugs tshar gcod pa'i bzo stabs bstan cing don du rang sde'i la rgya srung ba tsam las cig shos tshar bcad de lta ba rmeg med du btang ba ni gcig kyang med/ de ltar yang yin nges snyam ste/ zab mo dbu ma lta bu 'gro ba mi rigs kyi shes rig gling du tshad ches mtho shos su bslebs pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa lta ci/ brda sprod rig pa lta bu rmang gzhir gyur ba'i shes bya'i thad kyi ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba'i cha nas byung ba'i mkhas pa'i bar gyi rtsod pa tsam yang rang rang gi lugs 'dzin pa tsam las/ gcig gis gcig tshar gcod thub pa'i lo rgyus shig da bar bod na 'chad du med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshul 'di la dge chos kyis / rang so so'i rjes 'brang dag gis rgyu mtshan med par dad pas yid ches na ni der zad kyi phan tshun bsdur te 'di gnyis rtsod tshe/ gcig gis gcig nam yang sun phyung mi nus pas phan tshun khro zhing tshig rtsub smra ba tsam gyi mtha' can du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /spyir stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog tsong kha ba zhes gangs ljongs grub mtha' ris med kyi shes nas smra ba kun gyis mgrin gcig tu brjod la/ don du'ang de ltar yin nges te/ rje bdag nyid chen po 'di pa'i lta grub ni chos rje don grub rin chen/ rje btsun red mda' ba/ bla ma dbu ma pa/ lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan / skyabs chen lo chen dpal bzang sogs skabs de'i yul gangs can gyi grub mtha' ris med kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba snga gzhug bzhi bcu nye ba gus pas rtse gcig tu bsten te byung ba lags pas/ de sngon grub mtha' ris 158

med kyi legs pa'i snying bcud 'dus yod pa smros med yin stabs gangs can na mngon par mtho ba yin mod/ 'on te gdul bya blo yi mos pa sna tshogs la gang la gang 'tshams de la de bstun gyi tshul du song bas grub mtha' gzhan dag kyang rang so so'i thun min gyi khyad chos re yod pas mtha' gcig tu 'di ni mchog 'di ni dman no zhes pa'i shan 'byed du med la gcig tshab gcig gis kyang byed ga la thub snyam mo/ /gal srid phan tshun rigs pa'i bgro gleng byed dus grub mtha'i la rgya'i shan ngan mi zhugs la/ mtha' gcig tu rang lta mchog 'dzin gyis gzhan phyogs la lta ngan lta log chos log sogs kyi tshig gis dmod par mi byed par ngo mtshar ba'i lung rigs kyi 'phrul 'khor skor ba zhig yin na/ chos lugs pa zhig gi ngor de ni rang bzhin gyi kha bton dge sbyor gang gis kyang 'gran mi nus pa'i rlabs chen gyi tshogs bsags yin la/ rig gnas 'dzugs skrun gyi las la gzhol ba'i 'jig rten pa'i ngor de ni me tog mnyam bzhad/ mkhas brgya 'gran gleng gi rnam pa ste rig gnas gong 'phel du 'gro bzhin pa'i dan rtags rnal ma yin no/ /de bzhin skabs su bab pa gleng bar bya ba'i gzhi dge chos kyi klu sgrub dgongs rgyan du zab mo dbu ma'i dka' gnad skor zhig ste/ tha snyad tshad grub 'dod min/ dbu ma ba la khas len yod min/ bden gnyis gang gzhi gtso bo 'dzin pa sogs kyi thad la grags pa'i rjes su ma 'brang par rang gi dpyad stobs rigs pas phra zhing zhib par 'jug pa byas te bod snga rabs dang phyi rabs gang gi lugs la'ang snga rgol du dmigs su ma bzung par dogs pa bslang ba'i tshul gyis rang lugs shugs nas bzhag ste brjod cing / tha snyad tshad mas 159

grub min dang dbu ma ba la khas len yod med skor la dngos stobs rigs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te snga rabs lugs 'dzin gi rams pa'i lta ba 'thad phyogs su dmigs shing rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i lugs 'dzin gyi mkhas pa dag gi dgongs pa la cung zur za'i tshul du song bas rje shes rab rgya mtsho nas klu sgrub dgongs rgyan la che long du brtags pa mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro zhes pa'i dgag yig brtsams te sun 'byin mdzad/ lar mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro lta bu brgal brtag gi gzhung 'di rgyab rdzong gi lung dang / go ba chu thub kyi rigs pa sogs phyogs gang nas gzhigs kyang rje rin po che'i lta grub gsal kha bton pa'i gzhung bzang rin chen dang po'i gshis su song bas dge ldan lugs bzang 'dzin pa'i skyes bu lta ci/ gangs ljongs rgyal bstan ris med kyi gzur gnas mkhas dbang rnams kyis kyang e ma ho zhes bstod sprin phul ba'i gnas su song mod / 'on te gzhung de nyid du snga rgol la lta log pa/ chad lta ba/ smyon pa/'chal bo sogs tshig gi dug mda' mang po 'phangs shing / nyag rong rong dgu'i phul du brjid mod kyi/ /la las las 'bras med par smra 'di nongs/ /zla grags ba 'jo kun bzang lhun po yang / /dge ming bdud 'dun chos min 'phel bas smad / /ces pa lta bu rtsom gyi nyams ha cang che ba'i sho lo ka mang po bar skabs su bcug te ngan dmod mang po byas pa ni spyir col chung byis pa de'i rjes su 'brang par dogs nas dgongs gzhi dgos pa can gyi gtam du song ba yin kyang srid rung —/ nyi ma shar ri'i phrag nas 'phags tshe lag pas mi khebs pa'i dpe bzhin gzur gnas rtog ge rigs pa'i brgal brtag gi gling du tshul de ha cang ngan thal du song bas phyis byon pa'i mdun du ngang ngam shugs kyis ngan dpe zhig 160

kyang bzos song snyam ste/ chos la mi rton gang zag la rton pa'i tshul gyis dge chos kyi thun mong snang ngo'i bya spyod la dmod pa'i cha nas khong gi brtsams chos nang gi gzi 'od rab tu 'phros pa'i rtog ge rigs pa'i 'od rlabs dang rig gnas la dpyad pa lhur len pa'i thabs lam ma rmad de nyid mog por byas pa ni phyogs gang nas dmigs kyang mi 'os pa zhig yin la/ kha phyi ltos su dpyad na tshul des mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro zhes pa rang gzhung yang g.ya' yis sgrib pa'i gser rdog tu song ste gangs ljongs ris med shes nas smra ba'i snang ngor de yi gzi byin ji bzhin 'phro mi thub pas yid 'phangs dgos pa'i gnas so/ /de bzhin klu sgrub dgongs rgyan la dgag pa gtong ba'i deng gi gsar byung brtsams chos dag kyang spyir rtsod sgrub rigs pa'i brgal brtag tu song bas tshad mtho dman gang yin yang rung de bstun gyi rin rang zhig yod nges mod kyang / phal mo che rtsom gyi 'jug pa thog ma nyid nas pha rol po la lta ngan rgol ngan zhes pa ngan rtog gis drangs pa'i tshig 'chal dang gzhan la spa bkong ba'i dzigs nyams kyis brjod par byas pas snga rgol lta ci/ gzur gnas kun gyi yi gar mi 'ong bar byas 'dug pas don gyi rin thang de nyid kyang sgrib song ba ni blo pham dgos pa'i gnas gzhi los yin snyam/ 'di la dmigs na gi rams pas lta ba'i shan 'byed theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer nang du/ rje tsong kha ba'i lta dgongs la mi 'thad tshul brjod skabs thog ma nyid du legs par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs pa rang stobs kyis 'grel zhing snying rje dang sems bskyed la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi rgyan gyis mdzes pa shar tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi zhal snga nas zhes che brjod kyi mtshan nas drangs te lung rigs kyi 161

dpyad par 'jug cing mjug bsdus skabs kyang / rtsod 'dod rgol ba yod na zla ba yi/ /'grel chen gsum po dpang bor byas nas ni/ /rtsod par bgyi yi mdun du lhags par gyis/ /de ltar min pa deng sang byis pa yi/ /mgo bo skor ba'i tshig gi zer zlos la/ /kho bo rtsod pa dag ni mi bgyi ste/ /'jig rten bya ba snying po med phyir ro/ /ngan rtog rlung gis blo gros ma dkrugs par/ /gnas lugs 'khrul med ji bzhin rtogs 'dod na/ /zhes pa sogs rigs pa'i bgro gleng rnal ma las chags sdang gis rang rgyud ma bslad pa ni ji 'dra'i legs pa la ang /des na/ gzhon skyes rnams nas spyir rigs pa'i brgal brtag ni rig gnas dar ba'i gsos su dmigs nas rjes su yi rangs byed cing rang yang de lta bur zhugs dgos mod/ 'on tang rang gi grags 'dod sogs ngan rtog gis drangs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bgro gleng ni nam zhig mthun sgril gyi gshed du 'gyur bas dogs zon byed dgos pa'i gnas su shes par bya'o/ /gnyis / tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed pa'i skor/tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed pa ni klu sgrub dgongs rgyan gyi brjod snying gtso bo yin te/ bsdus te brjod na/ tha snyad tshad grub ces pa ni so so gang snang ba de nyid rang ngor bslu med bsnyon med du grub par brjod la/ de nyid mi 'dod pa ni tha snyad du gang snang bslu med du myong rung / myong ba de nyid brtag cing dpyad na tshad grub tu gcig kyang med par thams cad rdzun gyi steng nas rnam bzhag sna tshogs byed pa'o/ /spyir tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed pa ni mkhas dbang dge chos kyi gsar btod cig min par bod snga rabs lugs 'dzin stag lo sogs nas de 162

lta bu'i lta ba bton yod de/ grub mtha' kun shes las/ gang dag dpal ldan zla ba'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba tshad grub tu/ /rigs pa du mas dpyad nas khas len pa/ /'di la 'gal ba'i khur chen 'di ltar yod/ /yul kun rdzun dang yul can bslu med 'gal/ /yul der 'khrul dang de la tshad ma 'gal/ /rjes dpag yod dang bsgrub ngag med pa 'gal/ /mthun snang med dang chos can tshad grub 'gal/ /phyi don tshad grub rdul phran cha bcas 'gal/ /rigs drug tshad ma rdos bcas tshad grub 'gal sogs brjod de tha snyad tshad grub bzhed pa'i lta dgongs la 'gal ba'i khur chen bstud mar brtsegs pa dang /paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan nas dbu ma la 'jug pa'i dka' ba'i gnas 'ga' zhig rnam par bshad pa ku mud phreng mdzes zhes par/ kun rdzob bden pa 'jog byed kyi tshad mar bshad pa ji snyed pa de dag dbu ma pa rang gi lugs 'jog pa na tshad mar khas blang du mi rung ste/ gal te rung na rang lugs kyi tshad mas grub pa'i don la tshad ma go chod po gzhan gyis gnod par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ rnam kun 'jig rten tshad min de yi phyir/ /de nyid skabs su 'jig rten gnod pa med/ /ces gsungs so zhes dbu ma pa rang gi lugs la ni 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi bden pa lta zhog rnal 'byor pa'i kun rdzob tsam yang khas len pa ma yin te/ spros pa'i mtshan ma mtha' dag 'gog pa'i phyir zhes thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed pa dang / zhes dang / de bzhin gi rams pa nas kyang dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel ba lta ba ngan sel dang lta ba shan 'byed ces pa'i gzhung rnams su thal 'gyur bas tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed tshul brjod yod/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i lugs 'dzin 'ju mi pham dang de'i 163

slob brgyud rnams nas kyang tha snyad tshad grub bzhed pa la skyon brjod byas yod de / nges shes sgron mer/ ka ba ka bas mi stong dang / /chos nyid ka bas stong ngo zhes / /stong gzhi bzhag nas gzhan stong pa/ /tshig dang don gyi gzhan stong gnyis / /zhes chos can ka ba mi stong pa chos nyid ka ba'i bden grub stong pa zhes pa ni tshig dang don gyi gzhan stong du 'gyur 'dug ces zur za ba'i cha nas tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed pa'i lugs la 'thad pa'i 'dem shog 'phangs pa lta bu'o / /lung rigs dpe gsum gyi sgo nas tha snyad tshad grub rgya cher 'gog mkhan ni dge 'dun chos 'phel tshang lags te/ klu sgrub dgongs rgyan du/ rang cag gis yin min thag bcad pa thams cad kyang rang gi sems la ji ltar shar ba bzhin thag bcad pa tsam las/ rtsa ba gzhan ci yang med ces pa nas tha snyad tshad grub 'jog la blo ma bde zhes pa'i bar du tha snyad tshad grub 'dod mi nus tshul dang 'dod na skyon 'bab tshul lung gi rgyab rten yod thog dngos stobs rig pa gtso bor byas te rgyu ma phu ded kyi tshul du rgya cher spros yod/ rang cag gis gang tshad grub tu thag bcad tshad thams cad kyi rtsa ba mthar thug zhib tu dpyad tshe rang rang gi blo la tshad mar bcol ba ma gtogs gzhan ci yang mi snang tshul de rdzigs rdzigs ji ltar bshad kyang seng ge'i dpang bo stag stag gi dpang po g.yag de'i dpang po la khyi/ khyi yi dpang po la byi ba/ byi ba'i dpang po la 'bu btsugs 'dug pa'i dpe ngo mtshar ba dag bkod nas zab rgyas go dka' ba'i dbu ma'i dka' gnad de nyid rang bzhin gyi gleng mol ltar brjod pas kun gyis 'jug bde ba ltar byas so/ /des na klu sgrub dgongs rgyan gyi gzhung 'di'i rtsa ba'i 'dzin sa/ rtsa ba de nyid gsal mor bstan pa'i gzhung gi sgrig gzhi/164

gzhi rtsa ba de las gyes pa'i 'brel yod kyi cha lag sogs dbu nas zhabs su bsdu ba'i don thams cad la dmigs te brjod na/ spyir tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed mkhan snga rabs lugs 'dzin go shāka stag gsum sogs yod mod kyang / dge 'dun chos 'phel nas tshul lugs de nyid stabs bde'i rjes zlos byas pa tsam min par rang gi khyad chos mngon par phyug pas na/ tha snyad tshad grub mi 'dod pa'i thad la tshab mtshon rang bzhin can gyi mi sna ni mkhas dbang 'di pa brtsis rung la/ phyogs 'di yis dge chos gangs can bsam blo ba chen po bcu yi ya gyal du rigs smra 'brong bu sogs kyis bgrangs 'dug pa de'ang rgyu mtshan can du snang ngo / /de yang bod snga rabs kyi lugs su song ba'i tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed pa'i lta dgongs 'di ko phyis byon stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog rje tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis dgag bya khyab che'i skyon du mthong ste legs bshad lnga dang khyad par du byang chub lam rim nang du bkag yod pa la/ snga rabs lugs 'dzin stag lo nas rje lta ba la 'gal khur bco brgyad brtsegs pa'i brgal brtag phul/ de la'ang rje'i slob brgyud se ra rje btsun dang 'jam dbyangs dga' blo/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs nas rje'i lta ba 'thad ldan du sgrub pa'i cha nas gzhan lugs ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs kyi skyon gyi phung por btang yod/dge chos nas snga rabs lugs 'dzin rnams kyi lta ba dang lta ba de nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs pa la yid rab phyogs cing rje'i slob rgyud du gtogs pa'i mkhas pa re zung gis rje'i lta ba'i 'dzin mtshams gol bar mthong ste zur za dang dogs slong tshul gyis tha snyad tshad grub 'dod mi rigs tshul rtsal du bton 165

te brjod yod/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi tha snyad tshad grub mi bzhed pa'i 'dod tshul de stag lo'i tshad ma mi 'dod pa dang tshad grub mi bzhed pa las gsal kha che zhing 'ju mi pham sogs snga 'gyur lugs 'dzin pa'i tshad ma'i lta dgongs las kyang thal che ba'i tshul du snang ste/ stag tshang lo tsā bas/ 'on kyang tha snyad tshad grub 'dod na ni/ /rang rgyud 'thad phyir rgya bod mkhas mang bzhed/ /'di yang kun rdzob ma btags nyams dga'i ngor/ /'jog ces gsungs kyang rtog ger goms ches pas/ /mthun snang rten 'brel btags bral ma tshang na/ /blos btags tsam la bya byed ma mkhyen pas/ /stong dang brten 'byung don gcig mtshan nyid la/ /cung zad 'khrul phyir dbu ma chen po min/ /'on kyang don dam rigs pas dpyad bzod 'gog /spros pa nyer zhi mthar thug don dam dang / /skye med rnam grangs par bzhed mtha' bral phyir/ /dngos smra las lhag dbu ma kho na'o / /zhes gsungs pa ltar tha snyad tshad grub 'dod pa ni dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lta ba las thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba min pa brjod pa dang / de bzhin bod pa sprul skus lta grub shan 'byed du/ rigs de tha snyad tsam du yang / /skye sogs dpyad bzod med par sgrub/ /ces don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs shes des ni/ tha snyad tsam du yang skye sogs spros pa'i snang ba dpyad bzod med par bsgrub par byed ces brjod pa lta bu dang / 'ju mi pham nas/ don rnam nges shes rab ral grir/don dam la yang rnam grangs dang / /rnam grangs min pa'i tshul gnyis kyis/ /de 'jal don dam dpyod byed kyi/ /tshad ma de yang gnyis su 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ don dam la yang rnam grangs dang rnam grangs min pa gnyis su phyes te/rang rgyud pas don dam gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs su/ bden gnyis so sor 166
