lta legs grub byung zhing / de yang / rten 'brel slu ba med pa mtshon pa'i phyir du/ji skad du/ ston mo thams cad dga' ba yin/ /dga' ba thams cad dge ba yin / /zhes pa ltar gyi legs grub mdzad sgo dus dang mtshams pa zhig kyang spel bzhin bde bar bzhugs pa'i skabs lags so/ /ser smad dbus bla se ra dge bshes tshang sku phreng rim byon gyi 'khrungs rabs mdor bsdus gdan sa gsum gyi chags tshul dang 'brel ba'i rnam thar dpar gyi ri mo'i phra rgyan can 'di ni/ 'grel yod rnam thar dang se ra dge bshes tshang sku phreng lnga pas nyar tshags byas yod pa'i da yod bka' shog tham yig rtsa chen rnams dang / lo rgyus kyi dpang por gyur ba'i rgan po shes pa can 'ga' zhig gi khungs ldan ngag bgros sogs dpyad gzhir bzung nas/ 'jigs byed lha khang 'dzam gling g.yul rgyal legs grub byung ba'i skyes su/ si khron zhing chen srid gros kyi rig gzhung dang lag len zhib 'jug tshogs pa'i rgyun las drung chen gzhon pa/ si khron bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug tshogs pa'i drung chen gzhon pa mdzod dge bud dha mtsho ldan dges pa'i rdo rjes rab byung bcu bdun pa'i thams cad 'dul zhes pa me mo phag (2007)gi lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 28la grong khyer spos ngad ldan du sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/ //219

rgyal bstan sku phreng rim byon gyi mdzad rnam bsil zer dkar po'i thigs phreng /tshe ring dbang rgyal/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/sku phreng dang bo bla ma blo bzang bstan pa/de yang byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs chen po rnams ni ji srid 'khor ba na gnas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag grol min de srid du rang nyid zhi bde'i go 'phang don du mi gnyer bar/ bsam bzhin du mchog gi sprul sku'i sgron me rnam par 'god par mdzad pa ltar byung ba'i bla ma blo bzang bstan pa rin po che khong ni / rgyab ri mtho na byin chags nyams rtogs 'phel zhes pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa bum gter sgang gi nye 'dabs su/ ha ldi grong pa'i khyim rgyud zhig tu mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mngon par bzhad/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i bag chags rang chas su mnga' ba dang rim bzhin yi ge 'bri klog sogs bslabs pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ bka' gdams gong ma'i skyes mchog rnams kyi rnam thar la lhur bzhes mdzad pa'i bla ma dge 'dun phun tshogs sogs mkhas grub kyi go 'phang brnyes pa'i dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs shing / mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas legs par bsten te gtsug phud phul/sdom pa gsum gyis bcas mtshams phra mo tshun chad kyang spyan 'bras ltar srung zhing 220

tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs/ dpal gsang bde 'jigs gsum gtsos rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi khrid sogs rgyas pa dang / mdo sngags gzhung bshad man ngag dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan bsam mthar phyin/ de ltar bslab pa'i rim pa rnams thos pa tsam gyis tshim pa ma mdzad par don rgyud la sbyar te ha ldi ri khrod du sgom pas bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems thugs rgyud du 'khrungs/ thun mong lam gtso rnam gsum dang thun min rim gnyis zab mo sogs mngon rtogs kyi yon tan khyad par can la mnga' dbang 'byor te/ zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsis bgrang las 'das pa'i sems can rnams kyi khams dbang bsam pa sogs yongs su tshims par mdzad cing gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so/ /sku phreng gnyis pa rgyal bstan blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/skyes pa'i sku rabs gnyis pa rgyal bstan blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho rin po che ni/ gong du bkod pa'i grong tsho de nyid kyi khyim rgyud zhig tu ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas byis pa phal pa lta bu min pa'i mngon rtogs lhan skyes su byung zhing / dus gsum sgrib med du gsal ba'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa la chags thogs rdul tsam yang mi mnga' ba lha mgon rdo rje 'chang rje btsun blo bzang rab rgyas nas/ sku'i skye srid snga ma blo bzang bstan pa nyid 'chi srid chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon du mdzad pa'i rjes thob de ma thag par snying rjes gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pa'i yang sprul 'khrul bral du ngos 'dzin gnang / sku rabs dang po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi

bzhes pa'i dge slong gnang shar sogs kyis sku bdag mdzad cing / chos sde chen po bkra shis dar rgyas dgon pa'i 'jigs med rdo rje'i khri la zhabs sor bkod/ris su ma chad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas rjes su bzung nas gtsug phud bzhes/ yi ge 'bri klog sogs nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la gsan bsam mdzad de mkhyen rab kyi pad mo rab tu bzhad/ mkhas pa'i yon tan/ btsun pa'i tshugs sogs dgra bcom nye bar 'khor slar yang mi yul du byon pa dang phyogs kun nas mtshungs zhes/ blo ldan yongs su rdzogs pas mgrin pa gzengs su bstod de bsngags brjod kyi gnas su gyur/ dgung grangs bcu bzhir son pa na lha ldan du phebs te jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs mjal zhing mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par spros/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che 'grub pa'i thugs bskyed rgya cher mdzad/ se byes mkhas snyan grwa tshang du zhugs shing dge 'dun 'dus sde rnams la sri zhu bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa phul nas/ rigs kyi bdag po'am yongs 'dzin du mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i sa la bzhugs pa byams pa mkhyen brtse rin po che bla mar bsten nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung lo gsum la sbyangs pa mthar phyin/ de nas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i don la gzhol bar dgongs nas/ chos rje sgrub khang pa chen po blo bzang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho rin po ches/ dpal gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang / rta mchog rol pa/ rdo rje phreng ba/ mi tra brgya rtsa sogs kyis dbang khrid rgyas par bstsal/ gzigs rgyab rin po che blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi dbang phyug dpal bzang po nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid zab rgyas su bstsal/ nges don 'khor lo'i mgon po skyabs rje pha bong kha pa khyab

bdag bde chen snying po las/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dbang dang / rim gnyis kyi zab khrid/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang gi rim pa sogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan bsam mthar phyin par mdzad/ grub dbang lam brag rin po che las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te/ ltung ba'i nyes spyad phra mos kyang ma gos pa tshul khrims gsum gyi gter chen por gyur/ nag tshang rin po che las rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo'i lung dang / nya rgyas rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan 'jigs med grags pa las rgyal ba yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum sogs kyi lung chad lus med par gsan nas/ nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba sogs chos kyi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su bkang / rgyud sde gong 'og gi las rung bsnyen tshad dang —/ gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po dpal 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dang / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi gzhi bsnyen chen po rnams tshad du phyin pa mdzad par ma zad/ de dag gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams thugs rgyud la skye nges pa'i sgo nas bskyed rim la gsal snang thob/ rdzogs rim bde stong zung 'jug gi lta ba'i yang rtser phebs te lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyi zhal gzigs shing lung bstan du ma yang thob/ ha ldi mchog sprul gtsos snga gzhug ser skya bgrang las 'das pa la bka' chos dang dge tshul slong sogs kyi sdom pa dang /dpal gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs/ 'khor lo sdom pa/'jam dpal gshin rje/ dpa' bo gcig pa/ kun rig rnam snang sogs kyi dbang legs par bstsal te sems can mtha' yas pa smin grol la bkod/ sku tshe'i smad tsam la ri mda' grong dang nye ba'i la'i sgang zhig tu rgyal bstan 'phel 223

rgyas gling zhes pa'i ri khrod btab ste rten bzhengs pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'gran bral du mdzad de mthar dgung grangs nga bzhir phebs pa'i tshe shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas bde bar gshegs so/ /'dir chos sde chen po bkra shis dar rgyas dgon pa'i gdan rabs gsal bar byed pa'i nyin byed ces bris ma zhig tu gong gi sku phreng gnyis ka 'khrungs yul gcig tu nges pas de ltar bris pa'o/ /sku phreng gsum pa rgyal bstan blo bzang byams pa/'khrul bral gyi dam pa'i rnam thar skyong ba de dag gi 'phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i zlos gar las byung ba'i skye phreng gsum pa 'di nyid zur dben grong du yab dkon mchog tshe ring dang / yum tshe skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i me pho khyi ste spyi lo1946lo'i zla ba lnga bar rgyu skar 'phrod sbyor legs pa'i nyin mo mtshan ltas dag pa'i snang ba dang 'brel te sku bltams/ chung ngu nyid nas zhi zhing dul ba'i ngang tshul can/ dbang po gsal ba/ skye mched gtsang ba/ nar ma son pa na yang byis pa'i rnam 'gyur spyod lam las 'das pa'i rtags du ma rang chas su byung bar dgung grangs gsum gyi thog sa pho byi ba ste spyi lo1948lor sgrib med ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa mnga' ba phur bu lcog byams pa rin po ches/ rgyal bstan blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zhes mtshan snyan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa gang gi sprul pa'i sku rabs gsum par ngos bzung gnang / rgyal bstan blo bzang byams pa bskal bzang bstan 'dzin mkhas grub mtshan du gsol/ lo de'i zla tshes dge ba'i nyin mor tre hor bkra 224

shis chos tshul mtha' dag dar zhing rgyas pa'i dgon pa'i mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol/ mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhas shing grub pa'i rnam par thar pa la sus kyang 'gran du med pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje btsun bla ma byams pa mkhas grub rin po cher gtsug phud phul nas theg pa mchog gi gling du chos sgor zhugs/ dam pa de nyid yongs 'dzin gyi gtso bo dang /gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa'i ngang tshul lhan skyes su gsal ba blo bzang tshe ring mchog rgyun gyi slob dpon bsten nas 'bri klog sgrig khrims sogs grwa pa dkyus ma'i nang bzhin dpyis phyin par bslab gnang mdzad/ mgon po rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun bla ma byams pa mkhas grub rin po che'i mdun nas mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes par mdzad pa'i tshul ni / dpal ldan a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i byang chub lam rim zhes skyes bu gsum gyis lam gyi bgrod tshul man ngag gser gyi yang zhun gyi khrid rgyas pa dang / lam rim bdud rtsi snying po'i khrid lung / bla ma mchod pa'i khrid lung / dga' ldan lha brgya ma sogs zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor skor gyi khrid dang lung rnams go thos tsam gyis ma bzhag pa thos don rgyud la sbyar te gsan pa rgya che/ smin byed dbang la ji ltar 'jug pa ni dpal gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs yi dam gyi lha mchog mang po'i dbang khrid rgyas par gsan pas bskyed rdzogs la yang nang byan chud pa mdzad/ spyi lo1955lor rgyal dbang pad ma ka ra'i 'phrin las kyi zlos gar bstan 'gro'i dpal du shar ba kurma pa rang byung ye shes rig pa'i rdo rje sogs pe cin nas yar phebs pa'i lam bar lo de'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes drug gi snga char/ bkra shis dar rgyas dgon sogs sde 'bangs kun gyis mi bsus rta 225

bsus mchod bsus kyi rim pa zad du med pa rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod pa ltar spros te gus pa bla na med pas bsnyen bkur dang bcas gtsug lag khang gi yang rtser gzim chung bde chen 'bar ba la zhabs mthil bkra shis kyi ri mo mngon par bkod cing / mnyes pa'i thabs gsum gyi sgo nas dgyes pa bskyed de chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bar gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa bzhin/ chos kyi khri 'phang rab tu mtho ba la 'jigs pa med par khyu mchog rlabs po che'i stabs kyis gshegs/ chos kyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs/ gsung gi dbang phyug la mnga' dbang brnyes pa'i ljags rnam par bskyod de/ smin byed thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang / grol byed khrid kyi rim pa ngo sprod/ rgyab brten lung gi chos char dgung nas phab cing / gang la gang 'tshams kyi mdzad pa dus las mi yol bas gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol la bkod nas tshes brgyad kyi bar bzhugs/ de nas bzung gcig chog thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rim dang gsung gi mchog gyur snying po yi ge drug ma'i rdzogs rim sgom bzlas sogs la brtson pa chags med mdzad nas dus kyi 'pho 'gyur ma byung bar 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa rin po che rgyun bskyangs gnang / spyi lo1960lo nas1963lo'i bar rong pa tsha slob chung du phebs nas rgya bod kyi yig rigs la sbyangs ba badzad/ sbyi lo1964lo nas1981lo'i bar dus kyi dbang gis 'khrungs yul du phebs nas zhing las thon skyed ngal rtsol du zhugs/ rim bzhin tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i gzi 'od rab tu 'phros te mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus sogs phyogs mtha' kun nas je 226

bzang yar zla ltar 'phel ba'i tshe na/ gsung gsang bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang phyur bur bltams pa don gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phun tshogs dar rgyas rin po che'i mdun nas 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa/ bde mchog lus dkyil / sgrol dkar/ rnal 'byor ma'i dbang khrid sogs rgyas par zhus te 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa kun la blo gros kyi 'jug pa lhag par rgyas par gyur to / /lo der bde ldan zhing gi mgon po mi'i zol du byon pa bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam pa kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog dang mjal 'phrad kyi go skabs pe cin nas byung zhing / rin po che nyid nas mnyes par byed pa'i zhabs tog phun sum tshogs par phul te bkra shis dar rgyas dgon pa'i sngon byung da gnas kyi skor cha tshang tshig nyung don gsal gnad 'dus kyi sgo nas snyan seng legs par zhus pas/ kun gzigs rin po che'i dgyes 'dzum lhug par grol ba'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung zhing bsngags brjod pun ḍa ri ku'i phreng ba yang yang bstsal gnang mdzad de mthar/ gnas tshul je bzang du 'gro bar nges/ zhes dang /yang ngas dkon mchog la gsol 'debs byed yong / khyed tshos kyang smon lam yag po rgyob shog ces sogs gsungs/ spyi lo1985lor kun gzigs rin po che mchog bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes nas lo 'khor nyi shu rdzogs pa'i dga' ston du pe cin nas lha ldan du ched phebs mdzad pa na/ rin po che nyid kyis zhabs tog rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsnyen bkur bla na med pa phul te phyag phyir du byon zhing / sku rten rin po che jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs rten byin chen rnams la mchod sprin dpag tu med par spros te bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che 'grub pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa dang 'brel gnas mjal 227

legs po byung tshul yang gsungs/ spyi lo1986lor kun gzigs rin po che pe cin nas khams phyogs sogs rgyud de phebs pa'i lam bar gdul bya smin pa'i dus la bab pa mkhyen te dpal 'jigs byed bcu gsum pa'i dbang bgo skal du bstsal zhing thugs kyi sras su gyur/ sras kyi thu bo'i bzhed pa don yod par bya bar dgongs te kun gzigs mchog ri mda' grong du rgyal bstan rin po che'i bzhugs gnas su yang zhabs sen gyi pad mo mngon sum du bkod/ bkra shis dar rgyas dgon sogs kyi sku rten/ gsung rten/ thugs rten rnams ji srid bskal pa ma stongs bar du gnas par byin gyis brlabs/ ser skya yongs kyis nyid zhal mthong grol chen mo mig gis mngon sum mjal ba'i skal bzang byung /de nas da bar rin po che nyid kyis lhag pa'i lha de dag gi snying po dang yang snying sogs la yang brtson pa nyams len gyi rgyun bskyangs pa dang / rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon tshad ldan du grags shing grub pa'i dam pa du ma las zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa mnos tshul mchis kyang re zhig mdo tsam gyis mtshon par byas so/ /tang dang rgyal khab kyi las bgo ji ltar bzhes par mdzad pa'i rim pa ni/spyi lo1982lor dkar mdzes rdzong gi srid gros u yon dang / rdzong nang bstan tshogs pa'i drung yig chen mo gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes gnang /1984lor rdzong srid gros rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u yon gyi 'gan bzhes/1986lor rdzong nang bstan tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso gzhon par gdam bskos 228

dang —/ de'i phyi lor rdzong srid gros khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes/1990lor rdzong srid gzhung gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes/1993lor si khron zhing chen srid gros u yon dang / gzhan yang skabs dgu pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi 'thus mi dang / si khron zhing chen nang bstan tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso gzhon pa dang / dkar mdzes khul mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa sogs kyi go gnas kyang bzhes gnang mdzad do/ /gzhan phan ji ltar bsgrub par mdzad pa'i tshul/bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i yul dang yul 'khor kun bde 'jags dang bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che sgrub par mdzad pa ni 'di lta ste/ de yang blo gros kyi 'jug ldog yangs pa/ snying stobs kyi go cha btsan pa'i dam pa 'di'i gzhan phan byang sems dang 'brel ba'i lta ba'i bzhes tshul ya mtshan pa zhig zhal nas thol byung du byung bar/ nga rang ni tang dang mi dmangs kyi slob gso'i bdud rtsi mngar mor longs su spyad nas bya ba dang bya ba ma yin par shan 'byed nus pa'i blo gros kyi gdeng tshod phran bu zhig rnyed/ spyir na mi'i sems kyi 'dzin stangs dang lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur bya spyod gang yin rung rang don dang ma 'brel ba med / 'on kyang mi tshe thung ngu 'dir don ldan gyi las bgo rang rang so sor 'jug tshul thun mong ma yin pa mang yang / khyad par dus rabs kyi 'gros dang sgo bstun nas so so'i nus pa dang 'tsham pa mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs las phongs ngan nyams thag can rnams gtso che bar bzung ste 'bad pa chen pos sgo kun 229

nas de dag la zhabs 'degs zhu thub pa zhig byung na/ de la rin thang gzhal med kyi don snying ldan pa'i mi tshe'i bgrod lam zhig tu ngos bzung byed kyin yod la / lha chos kyi snying po/ srid jus kyi dgongs don gang la sbyar na yang 'byar ba zhig yin zhes gsungs/ des na rdzogs chen dpal sprul rin po ches/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa shes na/ /chos dang srid kyi bya ba mi 'gal/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sems can mgu bya ma gtogs pa/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs gzhan med/ /ces gsungs pa sogs dang mi mthun pa phra mo tsam yang med/ yang dpal sprul rin po ches/ sems dpa' mchog rnams gzhan don rtag tu dgongs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rin po che nyid kyi dgongs pa zab mo'i dbyings su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa las 'phros pa'i 'od dkar gyi zer thag phyogs kun tu brkyangs pa ltar/ rlabs che ba'i thugs kyi gtad so rnam par dag pa zhig ni spyir 'dzam gling zhi bde dang / bye brag mi rigs lnga bcu lhag las grub pa'i mes rgyal mthun sgril yong ba'i bya ba chen por rgyun du 'bad pa dang / rgyal khab kyi gtan 'bebs ltar nang pa'i chos lugs kyi srid jus lag bstar dngos su byung ba'i ba dan dkar po mkha' la bsgrengs te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs mtha' kun nas skyong / rnam par g.yeng bas mi brdzi ba'i brtson pa chen po lhur bzhes shing khul rdzong chus shang ru khag dgon sde kun la spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi rtsa khrims slob gso khyab spel yang yang mdzad cing grub 'bras bzang po mngon gyur thon/ dper na/ blo dang ldan na ma smras kyang / /rnam 'gyur nyid las bsam pa go/ /gsungs pa ltar spyi lo1990lor si khron zhing chen mi rigs mthun sgril sngon thon gyi bya dga' zhes 230

sku nyid la gzengs su bstod de gnang / 1995lor zhing chen chos lugs tshogs pas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gnyis spel 'dzugs skrun mkhan gyi zhabs phyi mi sna zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba'i gnas su gyur te gzi brjid ldan pa'i bya dga' yang gnang / yang bar skabs shig la khul gtso bzhugs gnang ba'i rin po che nyid dang / rang rdzong gi dbu khrid rnam pas mi dmangs kyi gnas tshul dngos dang mthun par gzigs zhib yang dag byung ba'i legs cha gcig tu bsdus na/ srid dpal rig gsum 'phel phyogs zhan pa'i sa khul 'ga' la bcos sgyur ji ltar dgos pa'i skor la so so'i bka' gros lhug stsol gnang ba'i don bzang mang po byung mthar/ thog mar sa khul dbul po dag la 'dzugs skrun gyi grub cha gtso bo glog las thon dgos zhes pa'i gros legs gcig mthun gyur pa ma zad/ rin po che nyid zhing chen chab srid gros mol tshogs par phebs pa na/ khong gis ches dbul ba'i rdzong dang sa khul sogs la dpal 'byor dang mi'i bsam blo'i tshad gzhi mtho 'degs gtong bar/ dang po glog gi byed sgo spel dgos zhes rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas snyan zhu yang yang phul bas —/ gong zhus kun gyis thog mtha' bar gsum du thugs khur dang rgyab skyor tshad med gnang ba las byung ba'i/ da lta rong pa tsha'i rta khog lung nang du glog khang phun sum tshogs pa grub ste nyin mtshan gang la spyod kyang rdzogs mtha' med pa / zer stong phyogs brgyar 'bar bzhin rdzong gcig gi glog gi lte bar yang gyur te thun mong gi bzhed pa ji bzhin grub/ mig sngar dkar mdzes khul gyi srid dpal rig gsum gyi gnas stangs dang / mi dmangs kyi dka' ngal bcas la gzigs zhib yang dag mdzad nas lan grangs du mar rgyal yongs chab srid gros 231

mol u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa sku zhabs nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs ri med mchog dang mjal 'phrad mdzad cing spyi la phan bde 'byung ba'i gal che'i don rnams snyan seng legs par phul bas ches bzang ba'i gnas tshul mang po yang bka' thag bcad thub pa byung / mkha' khyab skye rgya'i mchod sdong chen mo bkra shis dar rgyas dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa nyams pa gsar du bzhengs pa'i tshe na/ rin po ches zhum pa med pa'i blo gros kyi 'jug sgo rab tu yangs pa mdzad de sor bcu'i thal sbyar spyi bor bkod cing sngon gyi gnas stangs/da lta'i grub tshul sogs dngos thog bden 'tshol gyis gtan la phabs te dpal 'byor dang ngal rtsol zung 'brel dgos pa'i re 'bod tshig gi me tog mu tig star la rgyus pa star phul ba'i yul/ gong du mthon por bzhugs pa krung dbyang gi dbu khrid rim pa dang / si khron zhing chen rim pa'i dbu khrid/ dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul rim pa'i dbu khrid/ dkar mdzes rdzong rim pa'i dbu khrid / chus shang ru khag yan chad kyi dbu khrid rnams dang rgya che ba'i mi dmangs yongs la rogs skyor gnang dgos so zhes pa'i 'brel bzang zam ma chad par btsugs gnang mdzad/ dper na/ mi gang gros la mi dga' bar/ /'gyod pa rim gyis nyos pa yin gsungs pa ltar ma yin par/ bkra shis kyi dge mtshan 'dzin ma'i khyon kun tu snyan pas khyab pa rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs mtha' dag dar zhing rgyas pa'i dgon pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gtsos bslab pa gsum gyi rgyan gyis mdzes par spras pa'i grwa tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa dang / rje btsun bstan pa'i 'khor lo mi'i zol du shar ba rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i mtshan tsam rna bas thos na yang bde legs kyi snang ba rgyas pa 232

dang —/ bstan pa rin po che la 'jug pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams ni/phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ thal mo sbyar ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ bsod nams dang dpal gyi zhing / yon tan yongs su sbyong ba yin no gsungs pa ltar/ dad pa gtsang ma rang chas su byung ba'i rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs sogs kyi 'dod blo dang bstun nas/ thog mtha' bar gsum du kun gyis ngar shugs gcig sgril mdzad pa las byung ba'i mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing mchog legs grub kyi gtso bo yang mdzad do/ /dam pa'i rang bzhin ston pa/zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang ba'i rin po che nyid kyi snying stobs kyi ngo mtshar gsal bar bya ba'i slad du rang gshis rnam par dag pa la mtshon na bzang ba dang / g.yo dang sgyu med pa/ skye bo kun la rang bzhin gyis snying nye ba/ phan pa'i bsam pa dang / lugs bzang po 'gran par spyod pas mchog dman bar pa'i skye bo mang du 'du ba sogs dam pa'i ngang tshul mngon du gsal ba dang / grub pa'i mtha' gzhan dag 'dzin pa dag la yang lam gyi bgrod tshul tha dad pa tsam las 'gal ba can du 'dzin pa ni gnas ma yin no dgongs nas/ phyogs 'dzin gyi bkag pa med pa rgyal gsung tshad ma gcig tu nges par mdzad de gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba/ bstan pa 'gal med rtogs pa sogs gzhan phan 'ba' zhig lhur bzhes pa las/ tshul min du spyod pas 'gying nyams dang / gzhan gyi ngo bstod/ a gsar gyi skad cha/233

shes med kyi kha ta/ mi ser tshar bcad kyis dbang bsgyur ba sogs gzhan gnod gzhir bcas la gtan nas mi dgyes pa/ sdug bsngal gsum gyi khur po nyin mtshan 'bral med du khur ba'i skye rgu mtha' dag dang / bye brag rong pa tsha'i rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs rnams kyi ngal gso'i 'bab stegs la dgongs te/rin po che nyid nas dgon pa'i bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin gyi 'gan bzhes mdzad cing / grwa ser yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen mthun sbyor gyi 'char bkod dang mdzub ston yang dag gnang ba ni/ dgon pa'i 'brog ra dang zhing las ngal rtsol khang / dngos rdzas nyo tshong khang dang bod sman khang bcas btsugs te dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / rang stobs rang spel gyi lam la 'jug dgos zhes bka' slob gnad du khel ba gnang ste grub 'bras 'bur du thon no/ /'gro la gcig tu sman pa gangs can bod kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin la thugs gzhol ba/'di ltar skyes bu dam pa rnams ni gzhan la phan pa'i dam bca'i rtsa ba brtan cing / sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu khyed kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig la chags par ma byed cig chos kyi sgo gcig dang / spyod pa gcig yongs su rdzogs pas chog par ma 'dzin cig de ci'i phyir na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad med pa yongs su bsdu bar bya dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rin po che nyid kyis gangs ljongs phan bde'i rtsa lag nye bar gsal ba'i slad du bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing pho khyi ste spyi 234

lo1994lor rmad byung gi dgongs pa 'di ltar 'khrungs te/ spyir na mi'i rigs la dbul phyug gnyis su byung ba ni rang rang gi bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa las byung ba yin rung / dus dang bstun te dpyad na dbul phongs dang rjes lus kyis nyam nyes thebs pa las skyobs mkhas pa ni rig pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i sgo las thabs gzhan sed/ 'jig rten na dge bcu tshang ba/'byor zhing rgyas pa/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa rnams ni thun mong rig pa'i gnas dang / thun min nang rig pa dang / 'dzam gling na dar rgyas che ba'i tshan rig sogs la brten nas byung ba las/ dus kyi rnam 'gyur dang sgo bstun pa'i blo med par sngon las 'ba' zhig yid la bcang zhing mgo bo skur nas sdod pa las byung ba ni nam yang ma yin/ des na bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa rnams blang dor la 'jug pa'i grub cha gtso bo bod gangs can pa'i skad yig gnyis po gtso bor bzung nas rgya dang dbyin yig tshan rig gi shes bya sogs dang zung 'brel nus pa'i sger gyis gnyer ba'i slob grwa slob yon gtan nas mi dgos pa zhig btsugs thub na/ mi ser rnams la 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba ni de las bzang ba med/ 'on kyang tang dang rgyal khab kyi srid jus dang 'grig mthun byung na de ltar bya'o gsungs te/ rong pa tsha chus gcig dang nye rgyud gangs lam mam go lam shang gi mi ser rnams kyi gnas tshul la gzigs zhib gnang ba'i tshe/ dper na ches dbul ba'i khyim tshang dag ni tang dang rgyal khab kyis dbul skyor rogs bskyabs ni lo ltar dus las mi yol rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin rdol na yang so nam la tshogs zhan pa dang / sgo phyugs la gegs che ba/tshong las la brtson pa'i dngos po med pa/ gla pa pher ba'i nus pa med pa/235

dbyar 'o zho med pa/ dgun gyon chas srab pa/ ston 'bru phung dma' ba/ dpyid sa bon nyung ba/ lus kyi mdangs zhan pa/ skad kyi nga ro 'chor ba sems kyi stobs shugs chung ba/ legs nyes kyi lam bstan med pa/ gnyen dang nye dus dor ba/ mgon med kyi dwa phrug dang dbang po skyon can/ nyam thag gi khyim pa dka' ngal can sogs las thon pa'i bu dang bu mo rnams ni rig pa'i gnas la sbyang ba'i go skabs ches phra ba la gzigs te/ sku sger gyis gnyer ba'i slob grwar slob yon gtan nas mi dgos pa zhig 'dzugs na 'grig mthun yong ba'i re zhus spyi lo1994lor rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung la snyan zhu nan du phul ba ltar/rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung nas mig sngar mi ser gyi gnas tshul dang rin po che nyid kyi bzhed pa ji bzhin du/ lo der mthun 'gyur gyi brda tho bdun pa'i rtags can du bkod nas legs par gnang ba dang chabs cig me pho khyi ste spyi lo1994lo'i zla ba bcu ba'i tshes gcig nyin rta lam snang du slob 'go btsugs/rin po che nyid kyi lhag bsam dri ma med pa'i 'byor babs dang bstun na/ dang po 'dzin grwa gnyis su bgos nas slob ma'i grangs ka brgyad cu tsam las 'char bkod gnang med kyang / zhing 'brog mi ser tshos skom pa chu 'dod ltar rang rang gi re ba ltar nyid la zhu ba gsol ba ches mang stabs/ sku ngal khyad du bsad nas khyon lo der slob ma brgya dang so brgyad bsdus te mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo yongs su bskangs/ rab byung de'i shing mo phag ste spyi lo1995lor rin po che nyid kyi slob grwa 'di mu ra rdo gseb tu spos te slob khang khang mig brgyad can dang / dge rgan bzhugs gnas khang mig bcu/ slob ma'i sdod khang khang mig brgyad dang / mtha' skor gyi lcags ri sgo chen sogs kyang legs 236

grub mdzad de/ slob grwa'i slob gsor nyams myong mngon rtogs gsal por byung ba'i dge rgan ye shes dar rgyas gdan zhus mdzad nas slob dpon gzhon pa'i mtshan thob phul/ lo der bsam sbyor bzang po'i lugs la 'jug pa'i dge rgan drug dang 'tsho ba'i ma byan gcig nyid bzhag gnang mdzad/1 slob khrid nang don/nang du gsal bor bkod pa'i slob sbyong gi don la mtshon na/ rgyal khab kyis gcig gyur tu gtan la phab pa'i deng rabs can gyi slob tshan so sor tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgo nas slob chung gi slob deb tu bkod pa'i rgya yig dang bod yig rtsis rig mdzes rtsal lus rtsal sogs gtso gnad du bzung ba zhig yin/2 slob gso'i dmigs yul/phugs kyi dgongs bzhed rgya che ba'i dmigs rten rnam par dag pa ni/spyod yon zung ldan gyi spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs shing skrun pa'i mi bzang bskyed sring dgos pa'i don la gzhi rtsa bzung /3 khrid nyan pa po slob ma'i 'tsho ba/dpe don khrid par bya ba'i yul gyi rnam pa ni pho mo'i dbye ba med par gcig gyur gyi sgo nas slob khrid dang len chog pa dang / lugs bzang gi dpe srol mngon par btod cing zhal gsung don la 'jug pa mdzad de/ slob ma yongs kyi slob yon gtan nas mi dgos pa ma zad/ slob deb dang 'bri deb/237

sgyu gu/ glog dud shing / ja tshwa sogs dang / slob ma'i 'tsho rten du lo ltar zhing la nas dang rgya gro ma btab/ mdzo mo gsum gyi 'o dkar gcig tu 'dres par byas pa'i zhim mngar gyi rgyun ja yang yod pa dang / dge rgan gyi gla phog dang 'bras ldan gyi shing dang nags tshal btsugs pa sogs 'gro gron mtha' dag rin po che nyid kyis mthun sbyor mdzad/ 'jig rten pa rnams ni stobs 'byor khengs pas dregs na cung tsam 'grig min gyi bya ba la yang gshe ba dang rdeg pa snang ba sogs brtse sems med pa'i rang bzhin 'phral du ston pa ltar ma yin par/ rin po che nyid kyis ni zhar dang zhor la slob ma rnams la dgyes pa'i zhal ston 'dzum pa'i mdangs phyung ste/ slob sbyong dang sgrig khrims/ mi chos gtsung ma bcu drug sogs kyi legs bshad chos kyi bdud rtsis slob ma'i blo gros kyi bum bzang yongs su bkang bar mdzad do/ /4 slob khrid sgrig bkod/slob khrid kyi bkod sgrig ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul la mtshon na/ lo rim dang po nas lnga ba'i bar bod rgya dbyin gsum gyi slob deb dang / bod kyi yig gzugs / rig gnas kun shes kyi gzhung la sgra/ skal ldan rjes 'dzin gyi gzhung la bzo dang gso ba rig pa sbyong dgos pa bstan pa dang / rig gzhung so so'i sdom tshig blor bzung ba dang las bya tshad du phyin dgos pa sogs 'char bkod tshul ldan gnang ba ltar grub nas ches bzang ba'i 'bras bu smin zhing spyi lo 1998lo'i mjug bzo gso 'dzin grwa gnyis las mthar phyin slob ma lnga bcu tsam byung bar/ dper na ded dpon mkhas pas rgya mtsho las nor bu blangs nas rang khyim du bde bar 'byor ba ltar/ blo ldan kun gyis phyi nang gi rig pa'i 238

gnas la 'jug par spro ba dang / gzhan gyi don chen po sgrub par spro na phyogs der 'dengs shig dang / re ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes skad mthon por sgrog pa'i gnas su gyur to/ /spyi lo1998lo'i sngon rjes su bod ljongs nas dbyin yig slob dpon du ma dang / shes bya rig pa'i gnas la spyan dkyus rab tu yangs pa slob dpon bkra shis don grub ched du gdan zhus mdzad de/ sgra rig pa dang / lañja/ wartu/ sum snyan dag gsum/ nag rtsis rig pa sogs 'chad spel gyi 'phrin las skyong bzhin pa dang / lo de nas da bar gcig tu bsdoms na rgya bod dbyin gsum la mkhas pa'i dge rgan nyi shu dang las bzo ba lnga'o / /spyi lo1998lor slob ma nyis brgya nyer bdun bsdus shing zla ba yar ngo'i dkar cha 'phel ba ltar phyogs kun nas dar zhing rgyas pa'i rang bzhin zhig tu gyur / phyis su slob ma'i grangs ka ji ltar bsdus pa gsal por ma shes pas 'dir bkod med/ sbyangs par 'bur du thon pa'i phul byung gi slob ma rnams la gso ba rig pa dang dbyin yig zab mo sbyong rgyu'i go skabs gnang zhing snga rjes su lha sa la slob ma bcu bzhi dang / dus kyi sbyor ba'i blang dor gyi gnas ston pa skar rtsis kyi rig pa ched du sbyong bar lho nub mi rigs slob gling du mi gnyis dang —/ dus rabs dang 'grogs nas byung ba'i ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi rig gsar klog klad ched du sbyong bar bka' bstan dpe bsdur khang du mi gcig bcas mngags gnang mdzad cing / de dag kun la zas gos kyi mthun sbyor dang slob yon bcas rin po che nyid kyis 'gan bzhes mdzad do/ /gzhan yang rin po che mchog ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mdzad pa lhur len pa las chos brgyad don du gnyer ba'i mi chen gyi lad mo mi mdzad par/ nang du 239

byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyud yongs su grol te snying rje chen po'i khur bzhes shing —/ nad pa'i zug gzer gcog pa thugs rje sman gyi 'phrin las spel bar dgongs te/ spyi lo2001lor phan bde'i sman khang zhes pa yang gsar 'dzugs gnang ba sogs bstan 'gro la phan pa'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'gran bral du mdzad pa'o/ /5 slob ma'i lus rtsal/slob ma rnams kyi lus khams snyom zhing bde ba dang sbyong bar spro bas 'jug pa bya ba'i slad du rgyal khab spyi'i lugs ltar spo lo gtsos pa'i lus kyi rtsal bstan dgos pa du ma'i bya 'gul bzang po yang spel ba dang / drug gcig byis pa'i dus chen zhes mi ser tsho'i rma bya rab tu dga' ba'i dbyar rnga'i sgra la ji ltar mos pa bzhin/ ltad mo'i 'dod blo rgyas te gzigs mor phebs pa rnams la legs dar gyi tshul du phul ba 'di lta ste/ gna' bo'i mi rabs brgyud nas byung ba'i glu gar gyi sgyu rtsal bro dang gzhas lha mo'i 'khrab ston dang / gcan gzan gyi rgyal po seng ge/ sgo phyugs kyi nor bu lha g.yag gnyis po yang 'khrab gzhung du drangs te gson po'i nyams dang rnam 'gyur ltar dang / lang tsho'i mtshar sdug smin pa'i gzhon nu ji snyed pa de snyed kyis snyan po glu'i 'gyur khug rdung bar rol mo'i sgyu rtsal / bde bar gar gyi rnam 'gyur sogs ma 'dres pa/ cha lag tshang zhing go rim 'grig pa/ mkhas blun sus mthong na yang mi mthun pa med pa rna bar snyan pa / mig sngar mdzes pa/ yid la spro ba'i nus pa mngon par ster ba'i dga' ston gyi dus lo ltar yod pa zhig kyang mdzad do/ /240

6 spyi la gnang ba'i zhal gdams/yang rin po che nyid kyis slob mar shes rab kyi myu gu rgyas shing bsrung bar bya ba'i slad du skabs skabs su khyim pa dang dge rgan rnams gcig tu 'tshogs nas bka' mol lhug por gnang ba'i yang zhun gser gyi thigs pa 'di ltar/dus rabs 'di la gyong kha che shos ni sde tsho re la grong 'khyar gyi byis pa du ma bag med lhod g.yeng gi bya spyod la 'jug pa mthong ba na blo pham zhing sems pa skyo bo byung —/ des na khyim tshang phyug dbul dang rigs rus mtho dman la ma ltos par khyim pa kun gyis byis par tshul mthun gyis bslab bya gnang zhing rig pa'i gnas la sbyong du 'jug pa ni spyi la phan bde 'byung ba'i srol bzang med du mi rung ba zhig yin/ spyod ngan lang shor du gtong na dar bab kyi dus su lugs gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab dang mi ldan par/ mgo bo rmongs shing rang zon 'dzems pa med par log par spyod pa'i tshul la zhugs nas khrims lugs dang 'gal / pha ma dang nye du kun gyis 'phral yun gyi bde ba rmeg med du gtong ba de spang dgos/ rang gzhan gnyis ku'i phan bde la gnod pa'i rtsub spyod ma rung ba rnams 'gog par bya ba'i las la 'bad de/ gna' srol bzang po dang phyi rabs byas rjes gnyis la bsam zhing mi tshe'i bgrod 'gros yang dag zhig la bstun dgos/ khyad par du lo ngo 'ga' zhig nas gangs can bod kyi gna' rdzas sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin chen rin gzhal med pa'i gras rnams/ klad med 'ga' zhig gis phyi phyogs su btsong ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs pa/dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrugs pa/ phyi 'byung gi mi rabs la gnod pa'i tha chad kyi las ka mi nyung ba yang byung yod pas blo ldan 241

kun gyis 'gog par bya ba'i las la brtson par rigs so/ /de dang dus mtshungs sho rgyan 'dzugs pa'i srol ngan phyogs mtha' kun nas chu mig rdol ba bzhin byung zhing / rtog dpyod dang bral ba'i rigs rnams ldog med kyis zhen sred me ltar 'bar te/ nor dngos chud zos su btang zhing ci yang med par gyur ba na rang lus kyi cha shas kyang rgyan du btsugs te sdug bsngal ba'i las la 'jug pa yang byung tshul yod/ bya ba 'di la mchog dman bar pa'i skye bo gang 'jug kyang lugs gnyis kyi ljon shing bzang por gcod byed kyi sta re rnon po g.yug bzhin pa ltar spyi la gnod pa dang / sger la bsam na'ang mi phal cher nyin mtshan du mar sbrel nas zas dang skom ma 'byor ba'i rkyen gyis bad kun gyi nad dang grang nad snying nad mig nad sogs 'byung ste tshe thung zhing myur du 'chi ba'i las la sbyor ba dang / dkon pa'i nor brlag pa/ bsags pa'i rgyu gtor ba / tshe gang 'grogs pa'i gza' zla dang 'thab pa/ ring nas skyong ba'i phru gu dang 'gras shing phan tshun brtse dung gi 'brel ba med par gyur te rigs rgyud kyi mdun lam sogs la gnod pa 'phral du 'byung ba'i las la gzab cing mgon po klu'i dbang pos gsungs pa ltar grags pa nyams par 'gyur ba'i rgyu drug sogs la brten bya ma yin pa shes par bya'o/ /7 dge rgan la gdams pa/ skye 'gro phan bde'i dpal la rnam kun sbyor ba'i thabs su brtson pa'i dam pa nyid kyis legs bshad mtha' khyab tu 'phros pa'i cha shas skabs bab dang sbyar te byung bar/ slob grwa'i slob gso zhes pa ni 'chad pa dang rtsod pa rtsom pa gsum la zla med pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyi zhal sgo nas byung ba'i legs par bshad pa 242

yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang chos mtshungs pa gangs can bod kyi gnas lnga rig pa dang —/ gna' bo'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus/ skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar/ spyi tshogs kyi rnam 'gyur/ ma 'ongs kyi 'char 'god/ tshan rig gi shes bya bzang po dang 'brel ba'i dus rabs kyi lta ba rnams 'di'o zhes dgyes 'dzum lhug par grol ba'i tshig gis dbugs dbyung zhing don gsal lhang nge slob mar bstan nus pa la dge rgan zhes pa'i sgra don 'jug pa ma zad/ snga shul 'dzin la mkhas pa/ phyis 'byung mthud la bzang ba/ lugs bzang mtha' nas skyong ba/ mi'i dpe ru 'os pa / shes bya'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings lta bu dang mtshungs pas na/ rang gzhan gnyis kur gnod pa'i rgyan 'dzugs sogs kyi bya ba la nam yang brten du rung ba ma yin zhing / rnam kun lhag bsam dkar ba/ ngang rgyud ring ba/ kun spyod gtsang ba/ slob ma skyong la mkhas pa/ rgya bod kyi gzhung lugs sogs la blo gros kyi 'jug sgo rab tu yangs par mdzad de 'phral phugs su phan bde'i snying po lon thabs la 'bad pa las mi tshe stong zad kyi dbang du gtong ba ni gnas min pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ gzhan yang grwa mang la zhar byung gdams pa'i legs bshad nor bu'i phung po rdzogs mtha' med pa'i gter chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur kyang re zhig de gas 'thus pa byas so/ /slar smras pa/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul las/ /shar ba'i bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon blo bzang grags/ /dgongs klong dbyer med rang gsal byams brtse'i gter/ /sku tshe mi shigs bskal brgyar bzhugs par smon/ /243

'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad skor gleng ba/lab phan 'dum blo bzang blo gros/gcig dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri dgos pa'i bsam pa'i kun slong /kho bos lo shas sngon du 〈lab chos 'byung〉zhes pa'i lo rgyus kyi deb ther zhig 'bri ba'i skabs su/ de'i nang du rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob/ bstan pa phyogs mtha' spel ba'i dar chen drug gi ya gyal 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal gyis rje tsong kha pa'i bka' lung ji bzhin/ se ra byams chen chos rje dang bka' gros mdzad de/ lab dgon pa dang se ra dgon gnyis bod rab byung bdun pa'i sa mo phag spyi lo 1419lor zla ba dang tshes pa sogs dus mtha' gcig tu btab mdzad/ de nas yon tan dpal khong nas slar zhwa ser gyi bstan pa lhag tu rgyas ched/ snga gzhug tu /'dan yan lag bco brgyad :ces dgon khag bco brgyad btab yod pa lo rgyus pa rnams la gsung rgyu 'dugade'ang par skrun byas pa'i dgon sde khag gi lo rgyus dag tu la las lab dgon pa la bu dgon skabs su grangs nyi shu tsam bkod yod pa dang / la la'i nang du bu dgon bco brgyad yod pa de dag dgon ming dang yul bcas pa gsal bor ston 'dug yin na'ang kho bos zhib 'jug skabs su/ dgon pa nye skor dag la bca' dri zhus kyang / phal cher khas len mkhan mi 'dug dper na/ 'brom bu 244

dgon pa lta bu dngos su lo rgyus kyi yig cha dang bca' yig sogs su bu dgon yin pa gsal bor bkod 'dug kyang kho tshos kyang khas len gyin mi 'dugade'ang bu dgon red zer ba'i dgon khag la la'i dus tshod thod thug mi 'dugade'i phyir kho bor dogs sems chen po skyes rkyen/ rang gis rang la go skabs btsal nas 'grim 'grul gyi cha rkyen dang 'gro song / phrang lam gyi nyen kha/ rgyang thag rkang thang gi ngal ba bcas la ma 'dzem pa srog 'ben la bzhag nas yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul dang si khron dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul ser shul rdzong mnga' 'og gi dge lugs pa'i dgon pa re re bzhin sgo 'gros gdong gtug sgos bca' 'dri zhus/ bsdoms rtsis dgon khag sum cu so drug tsam 'dug pa cig car mtshams 'drir song nas rtag dpyad byed thub par byung —/ de ma tshad de'i skor la cha rgyus ldan pa'i bla ma dang dge bshes/ mkhas pa kha shas shig la zhal gtug byas kyang / de dag gsung tshul mi 'dra ba dang la las go thos tsam las dngos su gang dag yin pa mi gsal zhes gsungs/ gang ltar kyang kho bos lo rgyas kyi dpyad gzhi yig cha dang / dgon khag so so'i bshad tshul / mkhas dbang rnams kyi bshad tshul bcas la brten nas zhib 'jug nan mor byas mthar/ rang gi lta ba bkod pa gsham gsal ltar ro/ /gnyis / dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri dgos pa'i dmigs yul/de'ang mnyam med rje tsong kha pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa gser sbyang btso ma lta bu de thog ma bod gangs can ljongs su dar ba'i skabs su/ khong gi dngos slob dag te/ lhag par du bstan pa phyogs mtha' spel ba'i dar chen rnam pas 245

khong gi bka' lung ljid po thugs su btags nas bod khongs stod mnga' ris skor gsum dang bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug bcas la phebs nas sngar gnas dgon pa mang tsam zhig bka' lung dbang gsum gyis zhwa ser bstan pa'i ring lugs su bsgyur/ la la gsar du btab mdzad/ dus de tsa na/ 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal mdo stod rang yul phyogs su phebs nas zhwa ser gyi bstan pa thog mar spel/ zhwa ser gyi dgon sde thog mar btab / bshad ma dgos par lab dgon pa ni thog ma'o/ /de nas rim gyis 'dan yan lag bco brgyad btab mdzad ces bden nam mi bden rung / yang na skabs der 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad byung ba red ces gang ltar rung /dgon pa 'di dag ni mdo stod smad sa khul du byung ba'i zhwa ser bstan pa'i chos sde khag dang po yin pas/ rje tsong kha pa'i ring lugs spel rgyur gal 'gangs che bskyed kyi nus pa byung yod pa dang gcig gnyis ni 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad kyi skor la bshad srol gang mang dang / de la rnyog dra dang rtsod gleng gang mang mchis pas/ de'i skor la gsal bshad cig thub na bsam nas dpyad rtsom 'di bris pa lags so/ /gsum / 'dan ma zhes pa'i yul ston pa/de'ang sngar lo rgyus kyi yig cha dag tu ldan ma'am 'dan ma zhes yul dngos bstan nas 'bod tshul ha cang mang bas/ klog pa po rnams kyis de la ngos 'dzin ji ltar byed dgos zer na/thog mar bod gangs can zhes yongs su grags pa'i gangs ri'i ra bas 246

bskor ba'i zhing khams/ bsil ldan sā la'i sman ljongs 'di la glog bkra 'phrul gyi me long thogs pa na/ chos rgyal mes dbon gyi dus su brdar btags pa'i gangs g.ya' mtsho gsum gyis bskor ba'i yul lung khag gsum ste/ stod mnga' ris bskor gsum zhes pa spu hreng gangs kyis bskor/ gu ge g.ya' yis bskor/zangs dkar mtsho yis bskor/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi zhes pa gtsang g.yas ru dang ru lag gnyis/ dbus na dbus ru dang g.yon ru ste bzhi/ smad la khams dang a mdo gnyis gcig tu brtsis pa'i mdo khams sgang drug zhes mdo khams zal mo spang gi sgang / tsha ba rong gi sgang / smar khams chu bo'i sgang / sngo 'bor ri yi sgang / rma rdza zal mo'i sgang / mi nyag rab kyi sgang zhes grags pa spyir skabs der bod la stod smad bar gsum du phyes pa chol kha gsum zhes dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ khams pa mi yi chol kha/ a mdo rta yi chol kha zhes 'bod mur/ de la bod kyi mtshams su gnas pa'i mi'i chol kha khams phyogs su rim gyis 'phrul gyi me long skyod pa la/ khams stod smad las stod kyi cha ste khams stod / khams stod las 'dan ma/ 'dan ma las 'dan stod/ 'dan stod las sga ba/ sga ba ru chen tsho drug las sga stod/ bod gangs can ljongs la gnas ri chen po bzhi yod pa'i nang gi ya gyal/ yul de la bzhugs pa'i jo bo skyogs chen sdong ra'i nye logs/ 'bri klung gser ldan chu bo dal gyis 'bab pa'i g.yon zur/srid gsum mtshan snyan grags pa'i sga yi mchod rten dkar po'i lung phugs/ lha chab bsil ma dal gyis 'bab pa'i lha lung gi mda'/ yul lha chen po rma sras sku la gtsug rgyan nor bu'i ri rgyud/ ma cig lab kyi sgron mas byin gyis rlabs pa'i rdzu 'phrul phug gi 'og zhol/ bod mdo stod phyogs kyi ri bo dga' ldan pa'i 247

dgon khag thams cad kyi ma dgon/ lab chos sde dgon nam lab dga' ldan mdo sngags bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling 'phags dang mchod sde chen po'i gdan sa / sa yi dpyad pa dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas bzang po 'di la sga dang 'dan ma zer zhing / gnas de la gnas pa'i mi la sga ba'am 'dan ma zhes 'bod/sga zhes pa'i byung ba ni bod yul 'dir mi byung ba snga'i rus ming mi'u rus bzhi bya ba dang mi'u rgyud drug tu grol te/ de'ang sngon dang po/ yul dma' kha shu g.yag zhur gyi gong kha bya bar/ srid pa'i rgyal bu thing gi zhes pa la bu gsum byung ba la/ rgya bod sog tshor gsum du gyes pa'i bod mi khri do chen po zhes bya ba de la bu drug byung ba ni/ dbral 'gru ldong gsum lga dang bzhi/ /nu bo dbas brda' gnyis dang drug du bod kyi mi rgyud drug des sa mtshams bzung nas lga yis lhar ma mer po thob/ 'di bod yul du rus tshad snga ba yin/ dusga zer ba'i rgyud de dus byung / ‘ de'ang bod yul 'dir/ mi byung ba la snga ba'i rus ming /mi'u rus bzhi bya ba dang / mi'u rgyud drug bya ba byung ba'i nang nas/ rmu tsha lha'i rgyud par 'dug pas na/ ldan stod lha'i yul du/ lha ang snyen dam pa zer ba'i 'byor ldan/ dkar phyogs la mos pa gcig byung ba de nyid kyi/ lga ldang tre bo'i sa khongs su/ lha khang rgya phibs khyung mgo can brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha khang re'i nang du / rten ngo mtshar can dang / bka' 'gyur ro cog cha tshang ma re bzhengs pa'i drung du/ dkar mo khor yug mchod pa rnam lnga'i rgyun ma chad pa'i dge rgyun btsugs pa la sogs cho 'phreng phun sum tshogs pa'i 'phrin las rgya chen por mdzad 'dug 0 de'ang sga zhes pa'i ming la da ga (dga')dang sa ga (sga/)la ga (lha)/ ra ga(rgan/ wa zur can ra ga (zhwa)/ da dung ga ha (lha)sogs 'bri 248

srol mchis/ yig rnying dag la sga zhes 'bri ba las dga' yig dang gha yig ni dper na/ rgya bod yig tshang chen mo na/ 6byang phyogs/ hor bod kyi so mtshams la nye ba'i sa na/ pha wang chen po 'bri 'dra ba/ kha shar la bltas pa gcig yod pa / de'i rgyab ngos nas 'bab pa'i chu bo la/ tsha skye gtsang po zer/ nub la 'gro/mdun nas 'bab pa la/ 'bri chu zer/ shar phyogs ldan ma'i yul la 'gro ba'i de'i byang rgyud la/ ldan nyin rgyud pa dang / lho rgyud la ldan srib rgyud pa zer/lung chen de'i phyed smad tsam/ skyed stubs la/ rgya hor gyi 'ja' lam chen mos bcad yod pa'i/ stod phyogs de la/ ldan stod/ sga pa'i yul zer bar 'dug cing —/ ldan chu rgyud kyi mdo na/ tre bo'i yul yod pas/ dga' ldan tre bo gsum zer ༷zhes pa'i dga' yig dang / ('bo gangs dkar sprul sku'i rnam thar〉las 6rma se rtogs ldan blo gros rin chen ni mi nyag gha yi yul deng sang mtsho sngon skye rgu mdo'i mi yin zhing / skye rgu mdo ni mi nyag gi skad de chu bo 'dus mdo'i ming yin/ mi nyag skad ngo mar cu sngon 'dus zer 0zhes pa'i gha yig ma gtogs gzhan 'bri srol ha cang dkon/ (skye rgu mdo la cu sngon 'dus zer min skabs 'dir 'brel ba cher med phyir/ dpyad mkhan rnams kyis zhib 'jug mdzad par 'tshal)/ phyis su sga zhes 'bri srol ldan pas da lta thun mong du yi ge 'di bkol bzhin yod/ de'ang sga ni mi'u gdong drug gi nang gses dang /gna' po'i dus su 'a zha yul zhes grags/ 'dan ma zhes pa ni sngar chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su ldan ma rtse mang zer ba sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po dang gzhan yang ldan ma chos kyi byang chub/ ldan byang khri zer ba sogs phebs myong te sngar lo rgyus thog tu 'dan ma zhes yod pa gsal thub/ deng si khron zhing chen 249

dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul ser shul rdzong khongs gtogs kyi 'bri chu'i rgyud la 'dan khog zer/ mdor na/ phal cher khams kyi stod dbus kyi mi la 'dan ma thogs/ se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'dan ma'i khang tshan du zhugs pa'i grwa rgyun tshang ma yul phyogs de dag gi yin pas de skad dang / lhag par du se ra'i 'dan ma'i khang tshan grwa ba mang shos ni lab nas yin pas so so'i mtshan gyi sngon du 'dan ma zhes bsus nas 'bod srol mchis/sga ba la 'dan ma zhes 'bod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ hor bod kyi so mtshams la nye ba'i sa na/ pha bong chen po 'bri 'dra ba yod pa/ kha shar la gtad nas mdun du 'bab pa la 'bri chu zer/ stod phyogs de la ldan stod sga ba'i yul zer ba 'dug ①ces gong du bstan pa bzhin sga ba ni 'dan ma'i stod du chags pas de skad do/ /kho bo'i 'dod tshul la/ 'dan khog gi mi dngos las gzhan sga ba'i mi la 6 sga zhes pa dang / la lar 'dan ma zhes 'bod tshul 'di ni chos kyi grub mtha' la rag las 'dug snyam/ ri bo dga' ldan pa yin na 'dan ma zhes brjod / 'di gtso bo chos grwa zhugs sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'dan ma'i khang tshan du yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang 'dan chos 'khor gling gtsos pa'i rag shul klung shod dgon dang / ser shul dgon/ zil dkar dgon/ mkhar nang so dgon sogs kyi grwa rgyun tshang ma la 'dan ma zhes brjod/ gzhan gyi grub mtha' yin na sga ba zhes brjod pa mang / gtso bo sa skya pa'i skyes chen dam pa tshang ma la sga zhes zhu/ dper na khri 'du skal bzang dgon 'debs pa po la sga a mye dam pa zhes pa dang / phyis su rdzong sa bshad grwa dang rdzogs chen bshad grwa/250

gzhan gdan sar zhugs pa'i skye rgu don 'grub lung pa dang khri 'du rgya gar lung pa / ne'u lung pa/ 'bri chu 'gram gnyis sogs phreng ba bstar la rgyus pa'i dgon khag mang po'i skyes bu dam pa tshang ma la che sga zhes mtshan gyi sngon du 'phul yod pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po sogs khams phyogs mkhas dbang du ma'i gsung 'bum du gsal/de'ang 'dan ma zhes pa la ldan dang 'dan gnyis 'bri srol yod de/ yig rnying dag tu ldan zhes pa phyis su gcig gyur sgos 'dan zhes 'bri srol mchis pa kun gyis nges dgos so/ /bzhi / 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad bshad tshul skor/de'ang 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad ces yod pa lo rgyus kyi yig tshang dag tu nges thub pa dper na/ yul shul rdzong rag shul klung shod dgon gyi mkhan po mkhyen brtse dang dge slong bkra shes tshe ring rnam gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i (rab shis klung shod dgon gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru/zhes bya ba'i nang du/ bod chen po zhes pa'i nang tshan mdo smad sa yi thig le 'dir/ldan ma dgon khag bco brgyad du gyes pa'i ya gyal/ rab shib klung shod dgonaXzhes pa dang /pad ma kun dga' nas mdzad pa'i (khri 'du rdzong dgon khag skor gyi lo rgyus〉las zil dkar dgon pa'i lo rgyus skabs su bkod pa ltar na/ de'ang zil dkar dgon bla sprul mtsher dmar sku phreng bzhi ba rnam rgyal bzang po'i skabs su (spyi lo 1541lo nas spyi lo 1636bar)/ zil dkar dgon ha 251

cang dar rgyas byung bas/ ldan dgon sde bco brgyad/ dgon lag brgya dang drug cu'i rwa yod kyi rtse/ yu lu'i gtsug yin ①zhes grags pa byung lta bu dang /'brang sgo mang dge btsun ngag dbang nyi mas mdzad pa'i 〈chos 'byung lung rigs sgron me〉zhes pa'i nang du/ 6ldan ma rlung shis dgon gtso ba'i dgon khag bco brgyad yod pa de dag lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po glang dar ma bkrongs te khams la phebs skabs phyag btab mdzad pa yin/ rlung shis dgon pa ni dang por phyag btab pa red/ dge 'dun zhal grangs chig stong brgal ba/mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan dang po yod/ ༷zhes gsungs 'dug pa dang / gzhan shog ngos de'i klad na zur mchan zhig yod pa 'di ltar te/ ldan ma dgon khag bco brgyad ni/ dge rgyas bkra shis lha phug rlung shis (klung shod)dgon/ 'bum dgon /('bum sgang dgon) rdzog dum (skyogs dung )dgon/ dgon sar dgon/sha(sha)ri dgon/ 'bar dgon/ ze khar dgon(zil dkar)/ dga' ('gag)la dgon/ kha nar (mkhar nang)dgon/ lab dgon/ 'brom bu dgon/ 'ga' (mgar)ra dgon/ rwa nyag dgon/ 'brom chung ('bur dil)dgon/ zur mang dga' ldan dgon/ nang chen dkar 'da' dgon/ sde rgya (dud brgya)dgon bcas nyer lnga'i dgon pa bcu dgu yod ces gsung yod/ nyer lnga ni da lta'i yul shul yin/ sngar nang chen rgyal po'i mnga' 'og na tsho ba nyer lnga yod pas de skad do/ /de'ang klung shod dgon gyi mkhan po la 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad gang dag yin zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ gong gsal gyi dgon khag de dag dang ha lam 'dra/ mdor na yul shul mnga' 'og gi dge lugs dgon pa dag yin pa 252

gsung 'dugade'ang 'dan ma dge bshes/ bka' 'gyur ba chos rje la zhus rung / khong gis kyang gang dag yin pa grangs mi nges kyang / sngar gyi lo rgyus bshad gsal ltar na/ dngos su 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad zer ba yod pa ma zad/ de la 'khor yan lag so lnga yod pa cig car gnas chen sga stod jo ba skyogs chen ldong ra nyi ma lta bu de'i mtha' bskor na chags yod par gsungs/lnga / 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad byung tshul/1 grangs bco brgyad byung tshul skor/grangs bco brgyad kyi sgra bshad/ de'ang 'dir grangs lugs su brjod pa'i skabs su bcu lnga dang bcu brgyad gnyis kho na la de ltar mi brjod pa bco lnga bco brgyad ces na ro'i sgra sgrog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ grangs de gnyis bor ba'i gcig gam gnyis/ gsum/ bzhi/ drug bdun/ dgu sogs la dbyangs yig yi'am yang na u sogs zhugs pas de dag gi snga mar bcu'i u dang 'phrad tshe sgra mdo'i rtsa ba las dbyangs mtshams sbyor ba ma yin no zhes de dag 'gyur ba'i lugs med pa dang / lnga dang brgyad gnyis kyi ming gzhi la dbyangs yig a zhugs yod pas de phral ba tsam gyis dbyangs can sgra mdo las u wa'o zhes tshu rol gyi u yig pha rol na a ldan na/ tshu rol gyi dbyangs u ni wa yig tu 'gyur te bcwa lnga dang bcwa brgyad ces pa lta bur grub/ dper na legs sbyar gyi skabs su snyems tra (sbrang rtsi 'di zhes pa'i don)zhes pa ni thog mar sbrang rtsi'i skad dod ma dhu zhes bzhag pa la/ 'di zhes pa'i skad dod a tra zhes grogs su gnas pa na/ rnya srog 253

gi u phral/ dha srog med du song / dbyangs kyi mtha' las ra ha gnyis ma yin pa'i ha sa'i yi ge (legs sbyar gyi yi ge ltar gsal byed rnams kyi bsdus brjod)rnams gnyis su brjod pa rnya gnyis brjod/ dzha bha la dza ba rnams so zhes dha yig gong ma da ru bsgyur/ pha rol du dbyangs yig ldan phyir/ u yig lnga yig tu bsgyur / dbyangs kyis dman pas rim bzhin drangs phyir/ mar+sātra zhes de ltar grub 0pa lags so/ /de lta bu'i klog tshul skor la snar thang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i sngags kyi bklag thabs las/ wa btags phal cher na ro ste/ /wa sgra cung zad ldan par bklag /ces ston te/ don ni gsal byed kyi yi ge la wa btags sam wa zur yod pa phal cher na ro yod pa'i tshul gyis bklag par bya ste/ shugs la wa sgra cung zhig ldan par byas nas bklag ces pa'o/ /dper na gang gi maṇ+ḍatra lta bu la mang dhe tar zhes pa'i gdangs su bklag dgos/ de bzhin nga tshos rtag par mig sngon du mthong bzhin pa'i oṃ swa ste (bkra shis bde legs su gyur cig)dang lo ke shwa ra ('jig rten dbang phyug ste spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan )lta bu la/oṃ so sti dang lo ke sho ra zhes klog gin yod/ deng sang rgya yig gi (2khriXbacu'i5mtsho4)zhes pa la krung hwa zhes sgra sgyur byas yod pa 'di'ang sgra gdangs o la shugs su wa sgra thon tsam zhig yong ba byas te mig 'dzum gcig gi yun klog pa tsam tshad ldan du bsgyur ba kun gyis shes gsal ltar ro/ /de nas gong gi bcu lnga dang bcwa brgyad ces grub pa 'di'ang sgra gdangs brjod tshul de bzhin gyur pa ma yin lags/ phyis su bod kyi yi ge ba rnams kyis sgra gdangs klog tshul de la brten nas ma bsam lhun gyis na ro sgra'i gzugs dngos su bkod nas bca lnga dang ba'o brgyad (yig gzugs 'di rigs da 254

lta'ang dngos su mthong rgyu yod)lta bu'i lugs su mchis/ de'ang skad gsar bcad gang rung gi skabs su/ spyir bod yig la legs sbyar yi ge'i zol du wa zur sbyar ba ni bod rang nyid kyi yi ge la mi 'thad cing / yang na sgra gdangs kyi thad la dgos pa med par dgongs phyir/ de dor nas da lta'i bco lnga dang bco brgyad ces brjod tshul dang 'bri tshul bcas gzhi nas grub te rang skad kyi lugs su dar bar mdzad pa yin snyam mo/ /gzhan yang bod yig tu zhwa tshwa khu gwa dang dwags dwangs sogs bod lugs ltar sbyar ba'i ched du dang / dwags dang dwangs sogs ni rgas dang rngas kyi gdangs su nor dogs bcas kyi ched du sbyar ba tsam las/ sgra gdangs dngos brjod pa la shan shugs ci yang med pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar ro/ /2 grangs bco brgyad yin dgos pa'i go don/de'ang bod lo rgyus gzhung mo che la bshad ma dgos te/ kho bo kho nas rtsom 'bri skabs su thug myongs ba la/ rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad/dumu li dgon khag bco brgyad/ tshurag shul shog chen bco brgyad/ du'adan ma dgon khag bco brgyad/ ⑩'dan yan lag bco brgyad/ du'adam yan lag bco brgyad ('dam dkar dgon) dud lta'i dkar mdzes rdzong khag bco brgyad/ yidus rgyun mi rnams kyis kha nas brjod bzhin pa dmyal khams bco brgyad dang / da dung chos gzhung nang du grangs bco brgyad ldan pa'i ming tshig du ma ldan pa lta bu'o / /de dag grangs bco brgyad tshang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ kho bo'i lta tshul du/ dper na dal 'byor mi lus rin chen lta bu zhig la cha mtshon 255

na / lhu lag gis grub nas mi lus tshad ldan zhig la gyur/ de'ang mi lus la sha lhu bco brgyad kyis grub yod pa kun gyis gsal bzhin no/ /gal te sha lhu gcig ma tshang na/ mi lus cha tshang zhig mi ldan pa dbang skyon gyi mi zhig la gyur/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bco brgyad 'dus pa'i go don de yin par 'dod/ de'i phyir/grangs bco brgyad ni ltas bzang gi grangs te/ cha tshang dang hril bo'i snying po ldan pas/ dgon pa dag la yan lag bco brgyad yod dgos pa de'i rgyu mtshan no / /de yang snyigs ma lnga ches cher bdo ba'i stabs kyis 'gro ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam la blta ba'i 'dren byed mdongs par gyur ba na/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu mthon thing gi zur phud dor te/ ngur smig bla gos gsum gyis mdzes par klubs nas/ thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i srid chen po la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis bod kha ba can gyi bstan 'gro kun la ri bo dge lugs pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag dus gcig tu dbye bar mdzad pa dang chabs cig tu/mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i gnad thams cad la 'khrul ba'i dri ma lhag med du bsal te/ mtha' dbus kyi yid can grangs las 'das pa zhig dus kyi mthar yang blang dor la ma rmongs pas thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can chen po yongs su khyab par brdal ba las/ mgon po gang gi gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs nyin byed kyi snang ba yangs pos mkhas pa dang grub pa'i brtul zhugs kyi 'dab brgya ches cher bzhan pa las/ zab don gyi sbrang rtsi mngar po'i bcud len gyis skal 256

ldan gyi skye bo bung ba'i tshogs du ma zhig smin grol gyi dga' bde la 'god par mdzad pa'i slob ma/ bstan pa phyogs mthar skyong ba'i dar chen drug gi nang tshan 'dan ma yon tan dpal ba zhes lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa de nyid rgya nag tu phebs nas/ gong ma tā ming rgyal po yung lo (147)mchog gi dbu bla mdzad / gong ma chen pos kyang dad gus gzigs skyong tshad med bstsal nas slar bod du phebs/ rje rin po che rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos/ yon tan dpal la mdo khams stod kyi char/ sga ba rin chen tsho drug gi phyogs su sa dpyad phun sum tshogs pa rgyab ri ni song ge gnam du mchong ba 'dra la/ mdun ri ni glang chen rgyan gyis 'gying dang 'dra ba/ shar gyi lab chu sngon mo dal gyis 'bab pa/ shar phyogs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba'i tshe/ gser bya g.yu 'brug la zhon nas yong ba lta bu/ lho chu zhe chung gi chu bo rgyun bzang dang mnyam du lung mdo nas 'dres pa g.yu 'brug ma bu lhan 'dzoms lta bu sogs kyi dbus su/ lha sa'i me tog thang zhes pa la dgon pa 'debs dgos tshul gyi lung bstan dang bcas gzungs gzhug na khong gi dbu skra lan bu gcig yod pa'i rje nga 'dra ma dang sgrol ma byi'u drod ma/ mkhas grub rje'i phyag bzo chos rgyal zhal 'bag dang dbyug to/rje bla ma nyid kyi snam sbyar gnangs pa da lta'ang yod bzhin pa dang / rje bla mas lung bstan pa skabs su babs pa'i dus/ se ra'i byams chen chos rje dang bka' gros mdzad de/ bod rab byung bdun pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1419lor/ zla ba dang tshes grangs bcas pa dus mtha' gcig tu se ra theg chen gling dang lab dgon 'debs rgyu'i thugs thag bcad de mdo khams su phebs/ de'ang mkhan chen yon tan dpal mdo khams stod kyi ljongs 'dir rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan

pa spel ba'i phyir du/ mdo khams su zhabs sor bskyod pa'i tshe/ lab dgon gsar mar bsgyur ba'i dus la babs yod pas gzhan yang rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal nas/ ru khams su bu khyod la nga yi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rgyal mtshan zhes 'bod pa zhig 'ong bas/ de la rje nyid dang byin rlabs khyad par med pa'i sku brnyan nga 'dra ma 'di 'phrod par gyis/ de la nga yi ring lugs dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ dgon pa zhig kyang thob gsungs pa rnams lung bstan pa'i skyes bu dam pa rje mkhar pa rin po che yin par mkhyen nas/ thog mar mga' ra dgon la phebs/ mi⑤ de'i skabs su ljongs 'dir/ ci nge brgya dpon dang / mkhar pa rin po che mchod yon/ dam tshig lu gu rgyud dang 'brel ba'i bstan srid dar dkar yug gcig gis khyab pas/ skabs shig 'gu 'dzang mda' la byang chub mchod rten chen mo bzhengs skabs/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes lab mkhan chen yon tan dpal ba khong lha sgra'i yul du bsod snyoms la phebs dus/ mchod rten bzhengs pa'i las gral du phebs dgos byung bas/chos gos sogs yo byad 'phrog par brten/ mkhar pa rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi zhal gras nang ma zhig chos gos brgya dpon 'phrog pa'i lo rgyus dang bslab gzhi 'dzin pa'i dge slong gi yo byad yin tshul dang / zhag gis bcad na ltung bas gos pa'i rgyu mtshan bcas zhib tu zhus pa bzhin/ sku mdun rin po che'i snyan du sgron pas/ mdangs nga yi rmi lam gyi mtshan ltas shin tu bzang bas/ bla ma de khyad par 'phags pa'i skyes bu dam pa yin par gor ma chag cing / sku chos phyag tu 'phrod thabs dgos tshul dang / mjal 'phrad mdzad par bzhed nas/ sku chos sogs phyir 'bul thabs mdzad/ de rjes mjal 258

'phrad mdzad nas/ 'bral spong gi ltung ba 'byung tshul las 'phros pa'i bslab pa rin po che tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i gzhi rtsar gyur pa so sor thar pa'i don phyin ci ma log par bsnyad pa'i chos 'dul ba'i gzhung rnams la gsung 'phros zhib par mdzad de/ thugs dgyes pa'i gsung pa'i dad pa phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gyur/ de'ang 'dan ma yon tan dpal bas rje'i lung bstan dang bka' ltar sku nga 'dra ma phul ba sogs kyis sngon gnas rjes dran/ phyis 'byung khyad par can la dgongs nas rje bla mas lung bstan tshul thams cad mkhar pa rin po che yang thugs shin tu mnyes te/ de phyin nas dge lugs pa'i lugs srol bzang po 'di nyid bdag gir bzhes nas grwa bu slob dgon pa'i 'dus grwa rnams kyang dge ldan par gyur te da lta'i bar du dpal mnyam med pa'i bshad sgrub ma nyams pa bzhugs bzhin pa'o/ /gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs/ rdzong 'go dang / nas 'ju dang / khyad par mgar rar chos sde 'di nyid bcas 'dus sde gsum phyag gis btab/ 'gu 'dzung / zhe 'dzung / dzu 'dzung gsum gyi mchod rten nub gcig la ming bting / lab zhe 'dzung gi mchod rten bzhengs dus thig btab bzo tshad mi 'dra ba bcu gsum gsungs nas da dung nga la shes rab skye rgyu 'dug gsung / a gro ge 'phan dang / lab nyi ma 'bum/ ci nge brgya dpon bcas dpon po rnams kyis bzo'i khur len gyi dod ma mthun rkyen dang /spal gu'i gyad sogs gyad bzhi/ gzhan yang nyin mo mi dang mtshan mo mi ma yin gyis bzhengs te/ dus gcig la mchod rten gsum grub par mdzad pas rdzu 'phrul gyi mchod rten du grags/ glu gsum khag gsum/ bya klu rten gsum gyis 259

gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba las gla brngan gyis thams cad tshim par mdzad/ ji skad du/blo bzang rgyal ba'i gsung skyes dran dbang che/ / yon tan dpal sogs blo ldan rna lung du/ /bdud rtsi'i bgo bsha' stsal des de dag blo/ /gting nas dad dang gus pa'i rjed 'jos brel/ /zhes ()mkhar pa bsod nams rgya mtsho rin po che nas yon tan dpal la bsngags pa'i me tog gi lam la drangs pa gda'o/ /zhes 'dan ma yon tan dpal gyis mgar ra dgon par gsar ma'i lugs kyi chos spel tshul dang /de nas rwa nyag khams mgyogs bla chen gyi dbu bla mdzad/ lab lha sa'i thang na sa dpyad sogs gong gi rje rin po che'i lung bstan dang mthun par 'dug ste/der dgon pa 'debs dgos pa'i thugs dgongs 'khrungs tsa na/ lab dgon pa gsar mar bsgyur nas dgon bdag mdzad/de'ang (sum pa chos 'byung dpag bsam ljon bzang〉 du/ bstan pa phyogs mthar skyong ba'i dar chen bdun ni/ mnga' ris zhang zhung du 'khrungs te dbus su byon nas mkhas par gyur nas nag shod spu mda' dang khams chab mdo'i gdan sa gnyis pa mdzad cing dus 'khor ṭika chen gyi smad kha skong ba po chos dbang grags pa dang / mnga' ris gu ger 'khrungs nas bod du byon te rje'i bstan pa phyogs der nyi ma ltar rgyas par mdzad pa po ngag dbang grags pa /tho ling gsar ma bzhengs)dang / khams lho'i phyogs nas dbus su byon te rje bla ma las gdams pa mang po gsan nas slar rang yul du song ste dge ldan pa'i 260

lugs bzang spel ba'i lho ba rgyal mtshan seng ge /gnas thang btab)dang /thugs rgyal can gyi khams 'dan ma ba yon tan dpal /lab dgon btab/dang /mdo smad pa bsod nams shes rab dang tsha kho'i phyogs dang nye bar 'khrungs pa'i rong bo lce nag pa dang / mdo smad pa 'od zer rnams so/ /dude mur 'dan pa yon tan dpal khong 'bri klung gser ldan chu bo'i ngogs gnyis 'bom ('brom)bu ltag dgon dang 'gag la na 'gag la co ge dga' ldan phun tshogs gling ste dgon ma bu gsum chags btab par ma zad/ rab tu byung ba rnams ston pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po'i rjes su rab tu byung nas drang srong gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i khar/ rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud mtha' dag gdams ngag gi mchog tu gzung nas/ nyams su len pa'i lugs srol gtsang ma dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa yi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs su mdzad bcugade'ang slar 'dan chos 'khor dgon du gsar chos spel/ khams mgyogs bla chen sogs dngos slob grangs las 'das pa bskyangs/de'ang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i (dga' ldan chos 'byung be+eḍūr+ya ser po'i〉 nang du lab chos sde ni sngar sus btab ma byung / phyis ldan chos 'khor nas skyong zhing / chos spyod dang grwa rgyun dgon dang 'dra/ dge 'dun brgya dang nyi shu/ dgon lag yul shul phun tshogs gling la dge 'dun brgyad cu/ sha ru dgon la dge 'dun brgya/ jo gdan dgon la dge 'dun bdun cu ⑩zhes pa dang /de'ang sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i (sum pa chos 'byung dpag bsam ljon bzang〉 du'ang lab chos sde dang dgon lag yung shu phun 261

tshogs gling (100)jo gdan dgon (70)bya mo sna (70)rnams kyi'ang 'debs mi ma rnyed do/ / yizhes gsungs yod pa dang bcas 'dan chos 'khor dang —/ phun tshogs gling (dgon sar dgon pa yin par 'dod/) sha ru dgon/jo gdan te skyogs dung dgon pa bcas sngar lab dgon gyi bu dgon yin pa gsal thub pa dang /yang snyan grags dang pad ma dge 'dun gyis gtso sgrig mdzad pa'i (mtsho sngon bod rgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i dkar chag gsal ba'i me long〉zhes pa'i nang du/ yul shul sa khul gyi dge lugs pa'i dgon pa mang shos dgon pa de'i (lab dgon pa)bu dgon yin pa 'dra/ da dung si khron gyi 'dan chos 'khor dgon pa dang / rma mgril dgon/ gru ba dgon/ 'bar rnya dgon/ ser shul dgon / ba rod dgon/ ka bzhi dgon/ 'bum rnying dgon/ 'bum gsar dgon / dbang po dgon/ mtsho nub sog rigs bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi ru ngar dgon pa dang / bkra shis chos sgang sogs yin/ ma dgon ni bod ljongs se ra dgon yin zhes phonabastan 'dugade bzhin du phu'u lun khrin gyis mdzad pa'i 〈kan su'u mtsho sngon bod rgyud nang bstan dgon pa〉zhes pa'i nang du'ang / lab dgon pa ha cang dar rgyas byung ba'i skabs su/ mnga' 'og na gtogs pa'i bu dgon bco brgyad yod de/mgar ra dgon pa dang rwa nyag dgon pa gnyis phar phud/ rang rdzong gi mnga' 'og na 'brom bu dgon pa dang / zil dkar dgon pa/ mkhar nang so dgon pa/shul ma dgon bcas dang / de'ang yul shul rdzong mnga' 'og gi 'gag la dgon dang klung shod dgon/ mtsho nub tu'u lan rdzong gi ru ngar dgon/ si khron ser 262

shul rdzong mnga' 'og gi ser shul dgon pa dang ka bzhi dgon pa/ ba rod dgon / 'bum rnying dgon/ 'bum gsar dgon/ mang dge dgon/ 'bar rnya dgon / chos 'khor dgon sogs yin zhes yin pa yibakod 'dugade'ang yin chas hrin gyis mdzad pa'i (mtsho sngon gyi dgon pa dang mchod rten / ri khrod/〉 ces pa'i deb nang du'ang lab dgon la dgon lag bco brgyad yod pa yigong gsal ltar bkod 'dugagong gsal lo rgyus kyi deb ther dag las lab dgon pa la dngos gnas dgon lag du ma yod pa bden dpang byed thub/ yang na gang dag ni 'dan yan lag bco brgyad yin zer na/mi rigs shig gi rig gnas la cha mtshon na/ mi rigs rgyud spel gyi gnas tshul las chu bo'i rig gnas zer ba kun gyis khas len gyin yod/ dper na/krung hwa'i rma chu'i rig gnas dang / dbus gtsang gi yar klung rig gnas/nub phyogs pa'i chu bo nying lo (777)rig gnas bcas so so rgyud ngogs kyi rig gnas mched spel gyis rgyal khab bam mi rigs de'i rig gnas dang rig gnas kyi gnas babs mtshon thub la/ chu bo bzhin rig gnas kyi 'byung khungs dang rig gnas kyi gzhung yang gsal bor mtshon thub par byed/ de'i phyir 'bri chu gser ldan chu pos kyang de rgyud kyi rig gnas skyong zhing khyab spel byas yod/da lta yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul la khyad mtshar ldan pa'i bod kyi zhabs bro'i rig gnas dang / dmangs khrod kyi rtsed 'jo'am rta rgyugs rtsed 'jo/ sgra gur gyi rig gnas sogs mdo bsdus nas bshad na 'bri chu'i rig gnas yin/de'ang chos lugs kyi rig gnas dang de'i shul bzhag gna' shul bcas 263

pa 'ang de'i ngogs 'gram na chags srid/ mdo khams kyi mchod rten dang po mdzo nyag mchod rten/ tsha tsha dang po smriti tsha tsha/ rgya bza' kong jo'i lha khang / sga a gnyen dam pa'i dgon pa/ 'bri gung bka' rgyud kyi 'byung rtsa/ mdo khams zhwa ser bstan pa'i chos sde dang po tshang ma 'bri chu gnam 'bab chu bo'i (7chag po)ngogs 'gram na dar/ de lta bu yu la shul rig gnas mtshon byed kyi 'bri chu'i gnam 'bab chu bo'i rig gnas de la chos sde thog ma mang po byung yod pa bshad ma dgos pa yin/ yul shul gyi rig gnas ni 'bri chu gnam 'bab chu bo'i rig gnas dang / de'ang 'bri chu'i rig gnas ni yul shul gyi rig gnas yin pa phan tshun bden dpang thubo/ de'i phyir/ kho bo'i lta tshul la 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad ni 'bri chu'i rig gnas shul bzhag zhig yin pa rtsa ba'i lung dang gzhung gi rig pas ra sprod byed thub/'o na 'dan ma dgon khag la 'dan ma zhes yig 'bru gnyis mdun du bsu dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug 'dug zer na/ kun gyis ltas na 'dan khog tu chags yod pa de skad sems/ de la bden don cung 'dug rung / lo rgyus kyi yig cha dang gsar chos dar tshul bcas la gzhigs na 'di thog mar byung don ni 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal gyis ma dgon lab dgon btab rjes/de nas gong gsal gyi lo rgyus ltar bka' dang lung dang dbang bcas kyis sngar 'bri gung bka' rgyud kyi dgon pa dag gsar mar bsgyur mdzad pa'i phyir du'o/ /de dag la bu dgon zhes thogs te 'dan yan lag bco brgyad ces de ltar byung /de nas dgon pa de dag spyi khyab tsam du zhwa ser bstan pa'i lugs su dbang bsgyur rjes/ dus ring yun ma 'gyangs par dgon pa so sor rang khyim rang gis 264

bdag pa'i bla ma byung bar brten/ sngar gyi 'dan yan lag bco brgyad de rim bzhin dgon khag bco brgyad du gyur nas 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad ces ming de skad byung bar 'dod/spyir sngar nas da bar du ma bu dgon gyi lta ba la rnyog dra gang mang ldan/'di bu dgon rnams kyis mi 'dod de/ gtso bo so so dgon pa'i mtshan snyan la bsam te de bzhin no/ /bu dgon yin na dbang bsgyur ba'am chung ba'i don dang ske/ ma dgon yin na bdag po'am che ba'i don gyi shan shugs bcangs nas khas mi len par 'dod/ dper na dga' ldan chos 'byung du yul shul shwa skyogs dgon gsum ni lab dgon pa'i yan lag yin pa gsungs 'dug kyang kho tshos de la ma dga' bas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la tshig dmod btab 'dugangs ltas na bod kyi mkhas pa de lta bu la dgon chung 'ga' zhig gi don du de 'dra dma' 'bebs byed dgos don mi 'dug snyam/ de ni gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la ba rkun ma sug ge tsha skum lta bu red/ gzhan yang reb der nga 'tshams 'drir skyod dus ma dgon nam bu dgon gang yin zhes 'dri ba'i skabs su / mang shos kyis ma dgon dkon pa bu dgon mang po gsung rgyu 'dug de'i thog nas bltas na mang shos kyis lo rgyus la yid mi ches pa dang phyogs ris kyi lta stangs mang po 'dug pa sems/sngar lo rgyus thog tu lab dgon pa ches dar ba'i dus rabs gnyis byung ste/gcig ni lab skyabs mgon sku phreng dang po 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal gyi skabs su dang / gnyis ni khong gi sku phreng bcu gnyis pa lab dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje'i skabs su yin/ gong gsal lo rgyus deb ther dag tu lab 265

dgon pa la dgon lag mang po yod pa bris 'dug pa de dag phal cher yin rung /'on kyang dus rabs kyi khyad pa'i dbye ba la ra lug bsres nas 'tshos pa lta bu ste de la nor 'khrul dang lta ba mi mthun pa mang po byung / 'dan yan lag bco brgyad zer ba de sngar 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal gyi skabs su yin pas / skabs der kha shas bdag gir tsam dang / la la ni grub mtha' bsgyur ba tsam las bdag po dngos rgyag med/ phyis su'ang lab dgon gyi dgon lag tu rtsis med/ dgon pa de dag ni 'bri chu'i 'gram gnyis su chags pa'i dgon khag dag yin no/ /de'ang gong du 'brog thang byang rdza chu kha'i dge lugs dgon pa phal cher lab dgon pa'i bu dgon yin zer 'dug pa de ni sngar skyabs mgon sku phreng dang po 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal gyi skabs su ma yin pa khong gi sku skye bcu gnyis pa lab skyabs dgon dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje'i dus su yin/skabs der lab dgon pa sngar dar ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas chen po byung bas/khong kyang rgya nag gong ma'i dbu bla 'khod pa ma zad/ rgya sog gnyis la bstan pa bka' drin shin tu yangs pa lo rgyus deb ther rnams su gsal bo mthong rgyu yod/de'ang lab be khu'i 'gan khri bzhes nas chos srid gnyis ka skyong ba'i mdzad rjes bla na ma mchis pa ldan pa gangs ljongs kun tu mtshan snyan rlung ltar grags/ de dus khong gi rdza chu kha'i dgon pa mang tsam zhig bka' lung gis bsdus pa ma zad/la la ni dngos su btab mdzad/ dper na/ snyan grags dang phu'u lun khrin/phing chas hrin sogs kyis gsung ba'i shul ma dgon dang mkhar nang so dgon/ka bzhi/ ba rod/ ser shul/ 'bum rnying / 'bum gsar/ bo rod/ thar 266

shul / jo bo/ dbang po dag dang / gzhan yang mtsho nub khul tu'u lan rdzong mnga' 'og gi ru ngar dgon dang bkra shis chos sgang sogs so/ /de'ang gsal dgos pa ni de dag ni lab dgon pa'i bu dgon las 'dan ma yan lag bco brgyad kyi gras su tshud med/de'ang skabs der 'bri chu rgyud kyi dgon khag la la sngar ltar lab dgon gyi bu dgon yin par 'dod de/ dper na/ gong gsal lo rgyus kyi deb ther nang du gsung pa ji bzhin zil dkar dang / mgar ra dang rwa nyag 'gag la/ 'brom bu / klung shod/ 'bar rnya/ gru ba/ rma mgrin sogs so/ /mtha' gtugs nas bshad na/ 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad gang dag yin zer na/ kho bo'i lta ba la/ de'ang yul shul chu rma leb rdzong 'og gi shwa ri dgon dang skyogs dung dgon/ 'ba' dgon bcas dang / 'bri stod rdzong mnga' 'og gi dgon gsar dgon/ yul shul rdzong mnga' 'og gi mgar ra dgon/ rwa nyag dgon/ 'bum dil dgon 'gag la dgon/ klung shod dgon/ 'bum sgang dgon sogs dang / khri 'du rdzong mnga' 'og gi lab dgon/ 'brom bu dgon/zil dkar dgon sogs dang / si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes khul ser shul rdzong mnga' 'og gi 'bar rnya dgon/ gru ba dgon/ rma mgrin dgon/ 'dan sgrol ma lha khang sogs dang / bod ljongs 'jo mda' rdzong mnga' 'og gi 'dan chos 'khor dgon bcas so/ /de'ang gsal bshad byed dgos pa ni/ 'dan yan lag bco brgyad skabs su lab dgon ni ma dgon yin te/ de las bu dgon gcig snon dgos pa ni ka chos gnyis zhes de'i skabs su gsar ma la bsgyur ba'i ka bzhi dang 'dan chos 267

'khor dgon gnyis la zer/ de'i phyir yan lag skabs su ka bzhi dgon pa brtsi dgos par 'dod do/ /3 grub mtha' gsar ma yin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/gong dag la 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad yin zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/de'ang la las bshad tshul ltar na/ 'di grub mtha'i khyad med par 'dan ma'i sa khongs na sngar chags srid pa'i dgon pa dag yin zer/ gzhan yang gong gsal bkod pa ltar lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po glang dar ma bkrongs rjes/khams su phebs nas btab pa yin gsungs 'dug kho bos bltas na de cung mi mthun snyam/ da lta 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad kyi ya gyal yin zer ba'i dgon pa khag tshang ma dge lugs pa yin zer ba so sos bden dpang thub/de'ang mang tsam zhig gis yul shul nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mnga' 'og na chags pa'i dge lugs pa'i chos sde dag yin zer/ de yul gyi khyad par las grub mtha'i thad nas bshad na mthun pa zhig red/ 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad ni 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal rang yul phyogs su phebs nas thog mar grub mtha' gsar mar la bsgyur ba'i 'dan ma yan lag bco brgyad zer ba de las gyes nas dgon khag bco brgyad la grub pa yin te/ 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad ces de ltar dga' ldan ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dgon khag yin pa kun gyis bden dpang byed thub/4'bri chu'i ngogs rgyud na yin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/chu bos rig gnas skyong zer ba de lo rgyus kyi bden tshig cig yin pas/de'i phyir/ yul shul la chos lugs thog mar dar sa'i gnas kyang 'bri klung 268

gser ldan chu bo'i 'gram gnyis su yin/ 'bri chu la rab bzhi rtsis yod de/rab dang po ni 'bri klung sngon mo'i chu 'go nas 'bab bzhin pa'i dmar chu yin/'di ni a chen gangs rgyab kyi nye 'dabs su ri dwags tsam las mi med thang stong yin pa de yin/ de'i mtshams su gnam 'bab chu bo (7ma/7)zer te da lta yulashul sde ba chags pa'i 'go nas bzung / si khron ser shul khongs kyi 'dan sgrol ma lha khang ngam chu pha rol bod ljongs 'jo mda' rdzong mnga' 'og gi 'dan chos 'khor yan chad yin/ la las de'i bar gyi 'bri chu la gser ldan chu bo ( tshi/ 2)zer rung / rgya skad ltar na de'i man chad nas yun nan bar mtshams su 'bab bzhin pa de yin dgos/ yun nan nas rgya mtsho'i bar 'bri chu (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)zhes 'bod/ de'i phyir ngas bshad dgos ni 'bri chu gnam 'bab chu bo'i ngogs gnyis su mu tig bstar la rgyus pa bzhin chags pa'i grub mtha'i rigs du ma yod pa'i dgon sde dag las zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin pa'i chos sde rnams yin/de'ang dgon pa de dag gsar du gzhi chags nas btab pa ma yin pa phal mo che 'bri gung bka' rgyud kyi grub mtha' gsar mar bsgyur bar mdzad/ de yin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/ dgon pa 'di dag gzhi btab nas lo grangs mang po brgyud cing / tha na la la gna' snga mo bon po'i dgon pa yin pas phyis su nang chos chags/ chos sde 'di dag sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhi rtsa brtan chags shing chos spyod dang bca' khrims bcas gsar ma'i lugs la nye rkyen/rtsod med 'khrug med kyi sgo nas bde blag ngang zhwa ser ring lugs kyi bstan pa 'dzin par mdzad do/ /de'i phyir 'bri chu'i ngogs gnyis su 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad shugs 'byung gis lhun chags byung ngo / /269

ga sa gnas kyi cha rkyen la'ang rag las so/ /de'ang yul shul sa khul ni mang shos 'brog sa rtswa thang yin pas/ shing ngam rdo'i cha rkyen gtan nas med/ de dag la chos sde btab dgos na dka' ngal ha cang che/ skabs der 'phrul 'khor rigs kyi cha rkyen phar zhog yo byad lcags kham mam 'drud byed rgyun thag sogs ha cang dkon po red/ 'bri chu ngogs gnyis ni brag rong yin pas shing dang shug pa/ brag dang rdo'i cha rkyen gang legs ldan phyir/ gna' nas yul de dag la grong pa dang dgon sde chags/ de'i phyir sngar gyi rmang gzhi ldan pa'i chos sde rnams zhwa ser la bsgyur thub na rab yin te / ma thub na'ang dgon pa gsar du btab dgos kyang dka' khag chen po med pas 'bri klung 'gram na chags dgos pa gtso bo de la rags las so/ /6 'dan ma zhes 'bod dgos pa'i 'byung rkyen/de'ang yang bshad du/ 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad zhes 'bod dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen ni 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal gyis 'dan ma yan lag bco brgyad btab pas de'i phyir khong gi mtshan la brten nas byung ba yin dgos/la las bshad tshul ltar na/ 'di ni yul gyi khyad par gyi sgo nas byung ba yin skad gsungs/ kho bos bltas na/ de la 'gal zla cher mi 'dug snyam/gang yin zer na/ 'bri chu gnam 'bab chu bo 'dan stod smad bar gsum gyi sa cha yin/ de'i phyir dgon pa de dag 'dan yul du chags yod pas de skad byung bar 'dod/ mdor na 'dan ma mkhan chen yon tan dpal khong rang yul 'dan phyogs la phebs nas rang yul la nang bstan chos lugs spel ba la rigs ma 'gal bar sems so/ /270

7 grangs kyi bgrang tshul las kun slong byung ba/kho bo dgon pa de dag la song nas rtag dpyad zhib 'jug byed pa'i skabs su / glo bur du stod pa dgon khag drug zer ba'i ming brda rnyed/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad skabs su/ 'dan stod dam 'bri chu'i stod phyogs na dgon khag drug yod pa de la stod pa dgon khag drug zer/ de ni dgon khag bco brgyad ngos 'dzin byed yas kyi gzhi'am gtan tshig gal chen zhig rnyed/ de nas khong gi sems su/ gal te stod yod na bar dang smad yod nges dang / de'ang stod smad bar gsum ni 'bri chu gnam 'bab chu bo'i stod smad bar gsum dang yang na 'dan ma stod smad bar gsum du yin pa ngos zin pa dang gcig gnyis ni dgon pa de dag dge lugs dgon pa sha stag yin pa sems su thag chod rjes/ dpyad 'bras 'di lta bu zhig byung ba bsham gsal ltar ro/ /de'ang stod pa dgon khag drug zer ba chags pa'i yul ni da lta'i 'bri stod rdzong dang chu rma leb rdzong / de'i mtshams su khri 'du rdzong dang yul shul rdzong sde'i 'bri chu'i chu 'gram gnyis su chags yod pa dang / de'i mtshams su sga ba zer bas da lta'i 'bri chu zam chen yan chad dang / de'i mtshams su 'dan ma yin pas dkar mdzes ser shul dang bod ljongs 'jo 'da'i mdan khog zhang yan chad yin/ de ltar du kho bo'i dpyad gzhi la stod la stod pa dgon khag drugabar gyi sga ba la sga khog dgon khag drug smad 'dan ma la 'dan khog dgon khag drug bcas drug gsum bco brgyad du dbye/ de la'ang nang gses su/(1)stod pa dgon khag drug de la nang gses gnyis yod de/ srol 271
