rgyun gyi 'bod tshul ltar shwa skyogs dgon gsum dang 'bar zil 'bum gsum bcas so/ /shwa skyogs dgon gsum ni/ thog mar skyogs dung dgon zhes chu rma leb rdzong gi mnga' 'og na chags/ 'di ni gnam 'og 'bri chu'i dgon pa dang po yin / 'bri klung shar 'bab chu po'i g.yon 'gram na chags/ de nas rim bzhin 'bri stod rdzong mnga' 'og gi dgon gsar dgon/ 'bri chu'i g.yas 'gram na chags / da lta gdan sa spos nas rdzong gi nye phyogs su chags/ de nas shwa ri dgon / chu rma leb rdzong gi mnga' 'og 'bri chu'i g.yon na chags/de nas 'ba' zil 'bul gsum/ 'ba' dgon/ chags gnas gong ltar/de nas zil dkar dgon/ khri 'du rdzong gi mnga' 'og 'bri chu'i g.yon 'gram chags / 'bum sgang dgon/ yul shul rdzong gi mnga' 'og 'bri chu'i g.yas 'gram du chags/(2)sga khog dgon pa drug de la'ang nang gses gnyis dbye yod de/mgar rwa 'bum gsum zhes/ mgar ra dgon pa/ rwa nyag dgon pa/ 'bum dil dgon pa bcas tshang ma yul shul rdzong gi mnga' 'og te 'bri chu'i g.yas 'gram na chags/ de nas lab 'brom 'gag gsum zhes lab dgon pa dang 'brom bu dgon pa gnyis ni khri 'du rdzong gi mnga' 'og 'bri chu'i g.yon 'gram na chags/'gag la dgon pa ni yul shul rdzong gi mnga' 'og 'bri chu'i g.yas 'gram na chags/(3)'dan khog dgon khag drug de ru nang gses gnyis dbye yod de/272

'bar gru rma gsum zhes/ 'bar rnya dgon pa dang / gru ba dgon/ rma 'gril dgon bcas gsum po si khron dkar mdzes ser shul rdzong gi mnga' 'og te/cig car 'bri chu'i g.yon 'gram na chags/'dan gnyis klung gsum zhes 'dan gnyis ni 'dan sgrol ma lha khang dang /'dan chos 'khor dgon/ 'dan sgrol ma lha khang ni 'bri chu'i g.yon 'gram te ser shul rdzong gi mnga' 'og dang / 'dan chos 'khor dgon pa ni de'i thad kur 'bri chu'i pha rol na chags zhing bod ljongs 'jo dar rdzong gi mnga' 'og yin / rag shul klung shod dgon zhes 'di 'dan yul na ma chags kyang kun gyis 'dan ma la rtsis nas de ltar grags/ yul shul rdzong gi mnga' 'og na chags / 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad gang yin pa gtan 'khel byas rjes/kun gyis ngos 'dzin je gsal du yong ched/ gsham gyi re'u mig 'di bkod par bya'o/ /

ga sha ri dgon (mtsho sngon chu rma leb rdzong /)shā sbyags smyogs dung dgon (mtsho sngon chu rma leb rdzong /)stod pa dgon dgon gsum/ dgon gsar dbon (mtsho sngon 'bri stod rdzong /)khag drug zi 'ba' dgon pa/(mtsho sngon chu rma leb rdzong /)'ba' la zil dkar dgon/(mtsho sngon khri 'du rdzong /)'bum gsum/ 'bum snang dgon/(mtsho sngon yul shul rdzong /)'dan mgar ra dgon/(mtsho sngon yul shul rdzong /)ma mgar rwa rwa nyag dgon/(mtsho sngon yul shul rdzong /)dgon sga khog dgon 'bum gsum/ 'bum dil dgon/(mtsho sngon yul shul rdzong /)khag khag drug te lab dgon pa/(mtsho sngon khri 'du rdzong /)bco lab 'bram 'brom bu dgon/(mtsho sngon khri 'du rdzong /)brgyad/ 'gag gsum/ 'gag la dbon/(mtsho sngon yul shul rdzong /)'bar bha dgon/(si khrod ser shul rdzong /)'bar gru spu ba dgon/(si khrod ser shul rdzong /)'dan khog migasum/ rma mgrin dgon/(si khron ser shul rdzong /)dgon khag drug 'dan sgrol ma lha khang /(si khron ser spel rdzong /)'dan gnyas 'dan chos 'khor dgon/(bod ljongs 'jo mda' rdzong /)klung gsum/ rag shul klung shod dgon/(mtsho sngon yul shul rdzong /)gong gsal ni kho bos zhib 'jug byas rjes thag bcad pa'i 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad yin pas/ mi mthun pa dang nor 'khrul/ dogs snang bcas yod srid pas rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis thugs 'char bton rgyu gal/de'ang zhu rgyu zhig ni kho bos dka' spyod sdug rus chen pos dgon pa de dag la dngos sum̐ song nas zhib 'jug byas yod pas phyis su ( 'dan ma dgon khag bco brgyad〉 ces lo rgyus kyi deb rtsom hu/ga 'bri rgyu yin pas gong gsal gyi lta ba la lhag bsam ngang bsam 'char dang rogs ram mdzad rgyu snying thag pa nas bka' drin zhu'o/ /274

mchan 'grel/ du du dudapal 'byor bzang pos mdzad pa'i 〈rgya bod yig tshang chen mo〉 yi shog ngos 12 13 372 373 372thog tu gsal/ spyi lo 1985lor si khrin mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du bskrun/()mi nyag mgon pos mdzad pa'i ( 'bo gangs sprul gyi rnam thar〉 zhes pa shog ngos 18thog tu gsal/ spyi lo 1998lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du bskrun/()()()mkhan mkhyen brtse dang dge slong bkra shis tshe ring rnam gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i (rab shes klung shod dgon gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru/ zhes pa'i shog ngos 1 79 1thog tu gsal/ nang khul dpar bskrun yig cha/()pad ma kun dgas mdzad pa'i (khri 'du) zhes pa'i shog ngos 141thog tu gsal/spyi lo 2002lor mtsho sngon khri 'du rdzong srid gros u yon lhan khang gi nang khul par bskrun yig cha/ du'abrang sgo mang dge btsun ngag dbang nyi mas mdzad pa'i 〈chos 'byung lung rigs sgron me〉 zhes pa'i shog ngos 251thog tu gsal/ nang khul yig cha/⑩'dar lo tsā ba ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i (dbyangs can sgra mdo'i 'grel pa gsal ldan〉zhes pa'i shog ngos 20thog tu gsal/ shing par/()bla brang lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'i (chos kyi rnam grangs mthong ba kun 'dus〉zhes pa'i shog ngos 40thog du gsal/ spyi lo 1998lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du bskrunatshu/ 'di nga tsho mu li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong la dgon sde lo rgyus 'bri bar song ba'i skabs su shes/()lab phan 'dum blo bzang blo gros kyis bris pa'i (lab chos 'byung 〉 zhes pa'i shog ngos 36thog tu gsal/ krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun grub 'dug()yul shul rdzong gis bsdu sgrig byas pa'i (yul shul rdzong dgon sde'i lo rgyus mdor 275

bsdus〉 zhes pa'i shog ngos 118thog tu gsal/ spyi lo 1997lor yul shul rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi nang khul dpar bskrun yig cha yin/(yi(dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul lo rgyus yig tshags〉 zhes par gsal/()()〈mgar ra dgon pa'i dkar chag〉 zhes pa'i nang du gsal/ shing par/phonye(yisum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i 〈sum pa chos 'byung dpag bsam ljon bzang 〉 zhes pa'i shog ngos 491 658thog tu gsal/ spyi lo 1992lor kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du bskrun/6)/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈dga' ldan chos 'byung be+eḍūr+ya ser po〉zhes pa'i shog ngos 33thog tu gsal/ spyi lo 1989lor krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis dpar du bskrun/phonasnyan grags dang pad ma dge 'dun rnam gnyis kyis gtso sgrig mdzad pa'i (mtsho sngon bod rgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i dkar chag gsal ba'i me long 〉 (rgya yig)zhes pa'i shog ngos 141thog tu gsal/ spyi lo 1993lor kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du bskrushā/phu'u lun khrin gyis mdzad pa'i (kan su'u mtsho sngon bod rgyud nang bstan dgon pa 〉 (rgya yig)zhes pa'i shog ngos 334thog tu gsal/ spyi lo 1990lor mtsho sngon mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du bskrun/phonaphing chas hrin gyis mdzad pa'i (mtsho sngon gyi dgon pa dang mchod rten/ ri khrod〉ces pa'i shog ngos 265thog tu gsal/ spyi lo 1998lor mtsho sngon mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du bskrun/gsal bshad/ rtsom yig nang du lung drangs pa'i ma yig khrod du ( )rtags can gyi nang du yi ge bris yod pa de ni kho bos gzhung 'dren ma yig dag bcos kyi yi ge'o/ /276

dpal srungs dgon pa'i par gzhi'i gsung rab pe cin dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa glog 'phrul rtsis 'khor gyis 'a dra bshus byas pa'i skor gleng ba/garma rgyal mtshan/dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling ni bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug tu grags pa'i 'bri klung dang / zla klung gnyis kyi bar du tshud pa'i 'bri zla zal mo snga dang / sngon gling gi dus gling dpon du si dang / bar sde dge rgyal rabs/ phyis sde dge rdzong sman shod chus dpal spungs zhang bcas kyi mnga' khongs su gtogs/ gnas de'i khyad par ni thun mong so skye rnams kyi mthun snang du ji ltar grub pa ni/ 'phags yul dang rgya nag gi gzhung las ji ltar gsungs pa'i sa dpyad legs rnyed dka' ba thams cad ma tshang ba med pa dang —/ sa gzhi thams cad 'jam zhing ngam grog dang g.yang sa med cing rdo dang tsher ma nyung ba/ mi ma yin gdug pa can dang gcan gzan gtum po'i 'tshe ba med cing khyad par du sbrul la sogs mi bsrun pa'i srog chags nye ba'i phyogs su'ang mi gnas pa/ sa gzhi mtho dma' khod snyom pa/ gnam gshis kyang ha cang 277

tsha ba dang grang ba'i gnod pa med pa/ dbyar dgun kun tu skye bo rnams khams dwangs shing rig pa bkra ba/ shin tu mdzes pa'i brag ri dkar dmar sngon po'i phreng ba dang / bzang shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang ne'u gseng yid du 'ong ba bcas kyis brgyan pa/ ro nus khyad par 'phags pa'i sman gyi rigs du ma skyes pa/ lung pa phu ma shor mda' ma ral ba/ dwangs shing bsil ba'i 'bab chu'i sgra snyan dag g.yas g.yon nas rgyu zhing mdun du 'dus pa/ ri rgyud gangs dang 'brel zhing chu rgyud gtsang por zug pa/ rgyun du skad rigs mi gcig pa'i skye bo du ma 'dus shing sde bzhi dge bcu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa phyi ltar bsngags par 'os pa'i yon tan du ma'i dpal gyis spungs pa/ nang ltar mkhas grub skyes chen du ma'i gdan sa/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan bkra ba / lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis spungs pa/ gsang ltar o rgyan pad+mas mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga'i nang yon tan thugs kyi gnas de bī ko ṭī tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi mdun zhol sngon dus rje mar pas bstan pa rgyas pa lung bstan pa'i khyad par 'phags pa'i dpal gyis mngon par srungs pa'i ci gnas khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /de'ang 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi thugs sras dpal ldan byang chub gling pa dpal spungs su 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis btang ba ltar phyag phebs te dgon sa thog mar btab ste/ res mtshor gnas pa'i nag phyogs klu ma rung pa phyag mkhar gyis bsnun nas bsgral te mtsho phal cher bskams par mdzad/ de nas bon gyi tha tshig la gnas pa'i btsan dmar cod gwa pa zhes pa da lta dgon pa'i nub phyogs kyi brag ri la gnas pa de dang / bon po rnga khur/ nga 'dra che 278

brgyad / spu khyim stag slags/ spa ra/ gdong ra sogs kyis phyogs thams cad kyi gzugs med rnams dam la btags shing deng sang dgon gzhung rdo gcal yod pa de la mtsho zhig yod par klu nag phyogs gnas pa de'ang btul te mtsho chos gos kyis 'gebs par mdzad/ phyag phreng gtor bar mdzad pas shug spos dri zhim can byung ba yin pas deng sang gi bar du'ang phyag phreng sgang zhes grags/sa phyogs thams cad byin gyis brlabs te rdzu 'phrul gyis zhabs rjes stod smad bar gsum bzhag pa da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ de nas gdan sa'i mthil dpal spungs su mdzad cing de las gyes pa'i brag nag dgon klog pa gtso che'i grwa sde dang —/ dbu che ri mgul sgom grwa chen mo bcas dgon khag gsum gyi gtsos dge 'dun khri tsho du ma 'dus par grags/ gdan sa de dag dang nye ba'i thang zhig la chos khri brtsigs nas rgyu 'bras kyi chos du ma gsungs/ da lta'ang thang de la chos khri thang zhes zer zhing / skabs der chos gsung sa'i chos khri rdo pha wang zhig yod pa de/ deng dpal spungs zhang srid gzhung gi sgo ra nang du mjal rgyu yod/dpal ldan byang chub gling pas thog ma'i dgon pa btab pas dgon ming la byang chub gling zhes brjod par/ khams pa'i ngag rgyun du spe'u byang chub gling dgon yang zer/ dbu che mgul sogs la spong ba po'i khang mal mang po deng sang yang mthong rgyu yod/ de ltar bshad sgrub gnyis kyis 'bri gung bstan pa yun ring bskyangs / deng sang gi dpe war dgon pa dang / lcags ra dgon sogs kyang de dus 'bri gung bka' brgyud yin par gdon mi zo'o/ /rab byung lnga pa'i lcags stag spyi lo1290lor 'bri gung gdan sar sa skya'i dpon chen ang len gyis sne khrid pa'i sa skya'i dmas gis 'bri gung bcom ste/ skya ser khri phrag lhag bsad 279

pas lo rgyus thog 'bri gung gling log ces pa de byung / de skabs khams dbus kyi 'bri gung dgon sde mang po sa skya la bsgyur/ dgon 'di'i ma lag dang bcas pa'ang grub mtha' sa skya la bsgyur/de nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po mnga' ris rab 'byams tshul khrims 'od zer gyis dpal spungs gdan sa bzung nas gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo zab rgyas bskor/'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha' rgya cher rgyas par mdzad de/ mkhan slob gzi brjid can du ma bzhugs stabs mdo khams phyogs kyi sa skya dang / ngor pa rnams dgon 'di la chos zhus pa las sa ngor du chos zhu grwa rgyun 'gro mkhan rgyun chad song bas/ shar dpal spungs la ngor pas mthu mdzad de ngor gyi gtor zor zer ba'i dgon de'i g.yon ri'i brag gru gsum dmar gtor 'dra ba zhig dang / mdun gyi nags tshal dbus mi lpags thang zhes spang ri g.yang bzhi'i dbyibs 'dra ba zhig yod/ de ltar dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa sa skya'i mkhan po dpal ldan lhun grub kyi bar du dar rgyas su bzhugs/ de skor spe'u byang chub gling pa'i bstan pa a ras bshigs zhes lung bstan yod skad kyis grwa pa tshos srog chags a ra la sdang ba byas kyang / rjes su shing mkhan a ra zer ba zhig gis dgon pa me la shor bas dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs brlag song ba red ces bshad srol yod pa tsam ma zad phyis su zhing rmo dang —/ sa rko/ rdo slog byas skabs khang pa'i ka ba dang / rgya bzos kyi gan dzir pa ṭa dang / si tu chos 'byung skabs me dgra'i sri gnon la phur khang bdud dpung zil gnon rten chos sgrub brgyud ma chad pa 'jog par gnang ba sogs kyi lo 280

rgyus gtan tshig gis dgon pa mer shor yod par grub/ de ltar dgon snga ma de'i shul tsā khang dmar gdung ma zer ba zhig dang / dpa' 'og smyung gnas lha khang zhes pa las med par gyur/ smyung gnas lha khang de ni phyis su mkhan chen zla ba bzang pos stsatsha 'bum phrag gzungs ldan gyis bskangs kyang deng sang dbyings su bshigs par gyur to/ /de ltar sa 'bri gnyis rkyen 'gas stong du gyur nas/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug lo ste spyi lo1727lor dbu brtsams te dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling bya ba deng yongs su grags pa 'di phyag btab/ de'ang si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas dang a lo bla ma kun mkhyen gnyis dpal 'byor dgon nas dpal spungs su btegs te dgon pa 'debs sa'i sa dpyad gzigs skabs/ da lta'i 'du khang bzhugs pa'i sa der rdo zhig gi thog tu nas bzang po khyor gang tsam yod pa de bye'u zhig gis bsrungs nas 'dug pa mthong bas der dgon pa 'debs rgyu'i rten 'brel 'grigs stabs si tu chos 'byung dpon slob gnyis kyis dgon sa thugs thag bcad/ chos 'byung skabs nas de dpal srungs dgon pa'i rten sgam du yod pa chos 'byung rnam thar du gsal/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes kur sa slong mdzad de sde dge'i gnyer chen chos skyong bkra shis las dpon mdzad nas rmang bting / sde dge rgyal pos 'u lag gnang ste lo gnyis tsam gyis gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang nyer lnga tsam bzhengs grub/ de skabs rje nyid tsā 'dra rin chen brag tu sku mtshams bcad rgya mdzad / de nas sa bya'i lo spyi lo1729lor sde dge rgyal po chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring 'khor dang bcas pa dpal spungs su byon nas dgon pa btab pa'i legs 281

skyes dngos po gya nom pa gnang ba dang chabs cig sde dge'i mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i phyi 'brog pad+ma dpon khag rnams dang / a lo/ dpe war/ lha ru bcas nas btsun khral lnga brgya lhag bkas bcad/ don de ni sngon si tu chos 'byung dgung grangs gnyis la bzhes pa sngon srol ltar kurma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas rab byung gsum pa'i shing sprul ste spyi lo1185lor phyag btab pa'i kurma lha steng dgon pas sprul skur gdan 'dren zhus kyang / sde dge'i bla mas nga'i sa char 'khrungs pa'i sprul sku nga rang la dbang gsungs nas garma dgon la ma gnang ba'i stabs kyis sde dge tshang gis ha cang mthong chen byas/ de nas si tu sku phreng na rim sde dge tshang gi dbu blar gyur la/ sde dge tshang gi chos srid la dpal spungs si tu sku rabs kyi phan bde'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel ba dang / lhag don rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag dwags brgyud kyi bstan pa sa phyogs de nas rab tu dar ba'i bskal bzang byung / de nas si tu pad+ma nyin byed dang / 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyis sgrub sde gong 'og gnyis gsar du btsugs pa dang / si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos spyi lo1927lor dpal spungs 'du khang chen mo rgya bskyed gnang ba dang / sgrub sde 'og ma / bshad grwa khang / par khang bcas gsar bzhengs dang zhig gso mdzad/'jam mgon kong sprul gnyis pa dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis sgrub sde gong ma rgya bskyed gnang zhing / kur rabs lha khang rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs mdzad/krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes rjes dpal spungs dgon pa ni si khron zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis chog mchan gnang ba'i srung skyob bya sa'i bka' 282

brgyud pa'i dgon pa zhig gi gras su bzhag /bzhi rgol 'gul skyod ces pa'i skabs su 'du khang tshogs chen gyi rten dang brten pa bcas srid gzhung gis srung skyob gnang ba dang chabs cig dge 'dun pa bcu gnyis sgrig 'dzugs byas nas de dag gis rgyun ldan gyi chos lugs byed sgo spel gyi yod mod/ rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i las 'gul skabs gtor bshig tshabs chen rdzogs nas rtsa med lta bur gyur rung / rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa rta ste spyi lo 1978lo'izla 12pa'i tshes 23nyin skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun/ zang zing yo srong byas pa brgyud rim pa khag gi srid gzhung gis mi rigs dang / chos lugs bcas kyi srid jus don 'khyol byas te/rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya ste spyi lo 1981lor si khron zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis dpal spungs dgon pas chos sgo phye chog pa'i chog mchan gnang bar brten lo de'i zla ba 9pa'i tshes 22nyin slar yang dgon sgo dngos su phyes/de nas dpal spungs dgon pa si khron zhing chen gyis zhing chen yongs kyi gtso gnad rig dngos srung skyob sde tshan gas su khyab bsgrags gnang nas gal che'i srung skyob bya sa'i gnas su brtsis/ rgyal khab kyis gron dngul 'os 'tshams zhig gnang ste sngon ma'i bkod dbyibs gzhir bzung slar gso byas dang byed bzhin pa rtsa ba'i cha nas legs grub zin/ dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs rnams kyi bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa dang / rgyal khab phyi nang gi yul skor spro 'cham pa rnams kyi 'dren byed kyi dbang du gyur to/ /de'ang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa/ /sgrub par 283

byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs mtha' dag 'jo ba'i gzhi/ spang bya'i dri ma dang bral zhing rtogs bya'i ye shes rgyas pa'i gnyen po gcig pu ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la brten nas 'byung dgos la / bstan pa de nyid lung rtogs gnyis la 'dra/ de nyid bshad sgrub gnyis kyi 'khor los 'dzin dgos/ de'ang thog mar lung gi bstan pa la ltos nas 'byung /de'i rtsa rkyen ni gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa dri ma med pa'i ring lugs yi ge'i glegs bur snang ba 'di tsam la nges par thug ste/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid yi ge'i gzugs su snang / /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rten gsum gyi bye brag gsung rten yi ge yin pa dang / thub bstan 'dzin par byed pa la gtso bo lung gi chos la brten nas bshad sgrub kyi 'phrin las skyong dgos shing / khyad par thub pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya'i tha ma lung gi gsham tsam du zin pa deng gi dus su ston pa nyid dngos su bzhugs pa lta bu'i blang dor gyi gnas mthong ba'i mig lta bu ni gsung rab rin po che dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las gzhan chen po su'i lta ba dang grub pa'i mtha'i rnam gzhag la brten kyang phyin ci ma log pa'i lam la 'byor ba med cing / khyad par du ngo mtshar par gyi 'phrul chen gyi phyi mo 'di lta bu ni chos dang rig gzhung spel ba la rmad du byung ba'i phan bde'i sgo chen por gyur pa ste/ de lta bu'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa par gyi glegs bam la 'khod pa ni/ mdo smad kyi khul sde dge'i mnga' ris sde dge par khang chos mdzod chen mo chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring yab sras mes dbon gyi bdag rkyen las byung ba dag ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo mtshar thal mo sbyor ba'i gnas 284

'dzam bu gling gi rgyan gcig tu gyur pa dbang po'i mngon sum gyi rgyal bstan gnas pa'i rtsa lag chen por bzhugs pa dang / de'ang gdan sa chen po dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi par khang 'di ni si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i sku ring du gsar bzhengs mdzad/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos rgya bskyed btang ba dang / dpe rnying 'tshol bsdud byas te skabs de'i dpal spungs dgon pa'i mkhan chen drung gnyis tshe dbang dang / gnas gsal bkra 'phel sogs kyis zhu dag byas pa dang / spar byang bris nas par du brkos/ der bzhugs gsung rab par shing ni ston pa thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa 'ga' zhig gi dbang du byas te 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir byon pa'i mkhas shing grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis legs par bkral ba'i 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dang / gzhan yang rab 'byams gsung rab kun la blta ba'i mig gcig pu thun mong rig pa'i gnas dang /skabs 'ga' zhig tu nyer mkho'i tshogs ji snyed pa las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug kurma kai tshang chen po dang / byams mgon tā yi si tu yab sras/ 'jam mgon kong sprul sogs kyi ljags rtsom bcas khyon bsdoms pod chen sum brgya lhag la par shing brgyad khri lhag bzhugs pa gsham bkod kyi re'u mig dang / slad phyin kho bos sgrig grabs yod pa'i dpal spungs par khang gi dkar chag zhib rgyas su bkod pa las shes par 'tshal/ par khang 'di nyid ni sde dge'i par khang phud khar bod kyi par khang ches che gras zhig yin la/ par khang 'dir bzhugs pa'i gsung rab par shing phal cher dpe rgyun ches dkon la/ bod kyi par khang gzhan gyi par shing dang bskyar zlos byung med/ par khang de nyid la lo rer par 285

'debs kyi tshar grangs dang / dpe cha blu yon/ blang dor gyi bcad khrims/ 'go 'dzin las byed gong 'og rim pa ltar bkod 'doms/ snag shog sdud khral/par bkru rgyu sogs shin tu nges dkrigs mgo lung yod pa mdzad pa'i phyag srol lam lugs par khang gzhan las thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag gnyer kyi sgrig lam dam po yod pa ste/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'di la sus log sgrub zhus na rnam par smin pa bzod dka' bas yun ring du mnar ba gdon mi za ba ma zad/ 'dir snang chos 'jig rten gyi khrims lugs dang 'gal ba'i rtsad gcod kyis 'gal ba po drag zhan su zhig yin yang rgyu lus gnyis char bshags med kyi nyes chad/ mig ltos la phan pa'i bda' 'ded 'byung nges yin la/ de ltar kun gyis blang dor gyi gnad la/ phyin ci ma log pa'i 'jug ldog gzob pa'i bag yod tshul bzhin du brten pa'i sgo nas/ lung rtogs rgyal bstan rin po che yun du gnas pa'i gzhi gcig pu/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu bye ba brgya stong gi rin thang dang mi bsgrun pa'i gnas 'di la/ rgyu mtshan shes pa'i sgo nas phan pa sgrub pas/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis yar tshes kyis bskyed pa'i zla ba'i dang/la ltar gong 'phel du gtong ba cis kyang bgyi dgos rgyu dang / dpe cha che chung blu yon bla brang gzhung du song ba che phra ji snyed de dag tshang ma/ ci byas med pa'i za spyad dang / bar lam 'thor zog song na gsung rab kyi glud rnam smin shin tu lci ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba shes bzhin/de dag par dpon dang par gnyer sogs kyis 'gan len ci thub byas te rten bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i thebs rtsa ru 'gro nges bya dgos pa las par yon gang mos spyad mi chog pa bcas kyi bca' yig zhal gsal bkod yod pa'o / /286

khag las go rim lnga pa'i gas su tshud yod par ma zad/ deng skabs lo re la'ang deb bam dum pa khri 60—70bar 'phar bsnon 'gro gi yod pa red/ dpe mdzod khang de nyid du rang rgyal mi rigs khag gi yig rigs 'dra min bcu drug gi gna' dpe bsdu nyar byas yod la/ de'i nang rang re bod yig gi gna' dpe'ang snga mo nas gna' dpe rtsa chen(lhos)khang du nyar tshags byas te/ deng bar khyon dum pa bzhi stong tsam yod pa las dus rabs dgu pa'i g.yas g.yon la bris pa'i tun hong gi dpe rnying dum pa nyis brgya dang /(mkhas pa la las tun hong gi dpe rnying gras phon chen zhig pe cin du'ang khyer zhes pa de 'di yin pa 'dra/) mthing shog thog bris pa'i bka' 'gyur gser bris ma dum pa chig brgya/ bstan 'gyur gser bris bskums par ma(0776tan+t+ra lha)deb tshig brgya/ pe cin par ma 'jar pan par len(bras76bze'isgros)par gzhi deb bzhi brgya brgyad cu/ sde dge dang —/ dpal spungs/ snar thang / be cin/ sku 'bum gyi par gzhi'i gsung rab phal cher dang / de min rdo par dang / dbus par/ ngor par/ bkra shis sgo mang gi par/ rdzogs chen gyi par/ zhe chen gyi par/ rdzong gsar sogs dgon sde khag gi par gzhi'i gsung rab kyang nyung ngu 'dug /pe cin dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i gna' dpe de dag ni bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog skor dang / gsung 'bum skor/ phyogs bsgrigs skor / thor bu'i skor bcas sde tshan chen po bzhir dbye zhing / pod so so'i ring thung dang / che chung la bstun nas shog leb sra mo la rgya ras sngo nag gis g.yog ste sgam chung gru bzhi nar mo bzhi lteb bam drug lteb can gyi nang du pod ches che ba rnams dum pa gnyis su bgos te dpe cha'i mdzod khang gi dpe khri'i steng du 289

bzhugs su gsol/ spyir dpe mdzod khang gi dpe cha sde tshan chen po bzhi las gang yin thams cad la dkar chag rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi re ste/ dpe khri'i dkar chag dang / dpe cha'i mtshan byang dkar chag /mdzad pa po'i mtshan gyi dkar chag /sde tshan gyi dkar chag bcas las dang po ni mdzod khang du las sgrub pas lag len byed yas yin la/ dum pa re la ang ki re dang ang ki re la dum pa re'o/ /phyi ma gsum ni klog pa po dang las sgrub pa gzhan gyis dpe cha 'tshol byed sogs yin/ bye brag tu dpe cha'i sde tshan chen mo snga ma gsum re re la'ang dkar chag mi 'dra ba gsum re ste/dang po bka' bstan 'gyur skor/ 1 par gzhi spyi'i dkar chag /dper na/par gzhi spyi'i dkar chag shog byang las/ par gzhi che ge mo la khyon pod du yod dang ske/ldeb ring thung gi tshad/ dkar chag ang ki gang la yod bcas shes/2 dum pa so so'i dkar chag /dper na/ dum pa'i dkar chag shog byang las/sher phyin sogs ka dum pa la chos tshan du yod dang / dum pa de la ldeb grangs du yod bcas shes/ 3 chos tshan dkar chag dper na/ chos tshan dkar chag shog byang las/ chos tshan de'i mtshan cha tshang dang / ldeb grangs du nas du bar khyon ldeb grangs du yod shes/gnyis pa gsung 'bum skor/ 1 gsung 'bum spyi'i dkar chag dper na/gsung 'bum spyi'i dkar chag shog byang las/ rtsom pa po che ge mo'i gsung 'bum la pod rtags gang nas gang bar khyon pod du yod/ par gzhi gang gi yin / ldeb ring thung gi tshad bcas shes/ 2 dum pa so so'i dkar chag dper na / dum pa'i dkar chag shog byang las/ ka dum pa la chos tshan du yod dang /290

dum pa de la ldeb grangs du yod bcas shes/ 3 chos tshan dkar chag dper na/chos tshan dkar chag shog byang las/ chos tshan de'i mtshan cha tshang dang / ldeb grangs du nas du bar khyon chos tshan de la ldeb du yod shes/gsum pa phyogs bsgrigs skor/ 1 phyogs bsgrigs spyi'i dkar chag dper na / phyogs bsgrigs spyi'i dkar chag shog byang las/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos phyogs bsgrigs gnang ba'i sgrub thabs kun btus la pod rtags ka nas a bar khyon pod bcu bzhi yod pa/ sde dge'i par gzhi yin pa/ldeb ring thung gi tshad 4756 507bcas dang / 2 dum pa so so'i dkar chagadaper na/ dum pa'i dkar chag shog byang las/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med dkar po sgru ba thabs rjes gnang sogs ka dum pa la chos tshan 26yod pa/ dum pa de la ldeb grangs 321yod pa/ 3 chos tshan dkar chag /dper na/ chos tshan dkar chag shog byang las/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med dkar po sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa zhes bya ba la/ ldeb grangs 1nas 12bar khyon chos tshan de la ldeb 12yod pa bcas shes thub pa lta bu'o/ /thor bu'i dkar chag shog byang ni gong zhus sde tshan khag gi dkar chag gsum pa chos tshan dkar chag dang phal cher 'dra/klog pa po rnam pas bod kyi gna' dpe g.yar skabs rang la dgos pa'i dpe cha sde tshan chen po bzhi las gang dang gang gi khongs gtogs kyi dum pa'i dkar chag gi shog byang ngam chos tshan dkar chag gi shog byang thog gi dpe mdzod khang gi dum rtags ang ki dang 'brel yod rgyu cha dpe cha g.yar tho 'bri sa'i shog bu'i thog bris nas las sgrub pa la sprod de g.yar dgos/ de nas gna' dpe rtsa chen khang gi dpe blta khang du gzigs pa las phyir khur srol mi 291

'dug /gal srid khyed kyi gong zhus rgyu cha rnams ma shes na dpe blta khang gi dkar chag sgam chung nang gi dkar chag shog byang las shes par bya dgos pa las / glog rdul rtsis 'khor gyis dkar chag 'tshol ba sogs kyi sngon thon gyi chu tshad thog da dung slebs mi 'dug /de bas dpe cha'ang ma dpe ngo ma lta ba las glog rdul rtsis 'khor gyi dpe blta khang mi 'dug /sde dge'i phyogs kyi par gzhi'i gsung rab ni/ spyi lo 1958lor sku zhabs yu'u ta'o chon(cha'i )dpe mdzod khang de nyid kyi blo 'dri yul gyi 'gan bzhes mdzad skabs/ khong dang sku zhabs li te chi(stoṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha)gnyis kyi gros skul ltar pe cin dpe mdzod khang gi ched gtong mi sna thong cing hwa(ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhañca)sogs kyis hran tung nas thon pa'i rgya shog spus legs snag shas can 'bor chen khur te dbyar lo gcig gi ring la sde dge'i phyogs kyi dgon khag tu phebs te par 'debs kyi bya ba bsgrubs nas dpe mdzod khang du bsdu nyar byas pa gsal/ de'ang zhu dgos pa zhig ni rgyal khab dpe mdzod khang du grangs nyung mi rigs kyi gna' dpe rnying pa de 'dra mang po zhig bsdu nyar byas thub pa de ni gong zhus kyi rgya mi gnyis dang /sog rigs bla ma phan se tan(769)zhes pa gsum gyi mdzad rjes bla na med pa dang kha bral thabs med la/ khong gsum ni gna' dpe bsdu nyar byed pa'i srol gtod mes po lta bu yin la/ rang re tshos khong gsum gyi dpe rnying bsdu nyar byas pa'i dpe bzang la dus gtan du slob sbyong bya dgos pa ma zad/ dus gtan du khong gsum la rjes dran yang bya dgos snyam/de ltar sde dge phyogs kyi par gzhi'i gsung rab pe cin dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs su gsol ba ni sde dge par khang dang / dpal spungs par khang gnyis 292
'jarme (6zlo rmedhe rlomacherno (drung gnyis sgra 'grel/)
mi pham rnam )la rgya mtsho/(sman gzhung sogs/)
sngargorme kyi spyi don/('od zer skor gsum/)

pa'i mjug bar khyon zla ba dgu ring dgon pa'i phyogs mkhan po bu ston lags dang kho bo kurma rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis 'gan khur ba dang / dpe mdzod khang gi phyogs grangs nyung mi rigs skad yig tsho chung gi 'go 'dzin pa chon ku'e hwa(4ṣ+ṭhalko)yis 'gan khur nas glog 'phrul rtsis 'khor du 'dra bshus byas te/ da lam dgon pa dang / dpe mdzod khang gnyis so sor 'dra bshus byas tshad kyi glog rdul 'khor lo tshar re nyar tshags bya rgyu byas/ de'i 'gro gron rgya'i dge bsnyen ma yon kri chi (224)sogs kyis mthun rkyen mdzad/ de min sde dge rdzong u dang —/ rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung / sngon rdzong mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi kru'u rin gzhon pa tshe ring rdo rje sogs kyis kyang mthong chen byas pas bya ba bde blag ngang grub pa la phan thogs chen po byung / de'ang nga tshos las ka 'di lta bu thog mar 'go brtsams pa yin pas/ nyams myong sogs ci yang med pa dang / las ka 'di 'dra'ang 'grig min mi shes kyang / dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni cha 'phrin gzhi 'dzin grangs can du gyur pa'i dus skabs yin/ glog rdul brda rtags kyi lag rtsal gom gang 'gro ba dang / sa steng 'dir brda gtong glog lam dra rgyas 'brel ba'i rmang gzhi'i sgrig chas kyis khyab pa/ glog rdul gzhi 'dzin grangs can du gyur ba'i las ka sgrub dang bsgrub dgos pa'i skabs 'dir/ srol rgyun gyi dpe mdzod khang gi byed nus dang brda 'phrin lag rtsal 'phel rgyas kyi rnam pa'i bar 'gran bsdur chen po slong gi yod pa red/ der brten/ 'dzam gling thog gna' dpe ches mang ba'i gras su tshud pa'i kha ba ri pa'i bla sprul dang / dgon sde khagamakhas dbang rnam pas rang rang gi za gsog gi cha rkyen gsung rab kyi glud la mi re ste/ bstan pa dang mi rigs la bsam nas dbang yod nor yod des bod kyi 296

gna' dpe myur skyob dang bsdu nyar byas tshad/ glog rdul rtsis 'khor du blugs nas go la hril po'i don gnyer can rnams la gna' dpe'i thon khungs mnyam spyod bya rgyu'i mkho sprod gnang ba ni/ gting zab cing yun ring ba'i lo rgyus kyi don snying dang rgyal spyi'i don snying yod pas/ ji srid bskal pa gnas kyi bar 'gal med rgyun du spyod pa'i blang dor tshul mthun yin snyam/ zhes sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya lo sa ga zla ba'i gral tshes bzang por kurma rgyal mtshan gyis spel ba shrī dza yan+tu/ /

bod kyi slob gso'i yon tan pa gso skyong byed lugs kyi ma dpe 'ga' zhig la mtha' dpyad pa/rin chen mtsho/ mdzod dge bud dha/sa bcad dang po/ btsan po'i dus skabs kyi slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe la dpyadapa/de yang bod kyi slob gso'i thog ma'i gnas babs ci 'dra zhig yin pa'i thad dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ha cang nyung bas de'i skor ngo ma zhib par gleng dka' yang —/ spyi lugs ltar na/ bod kyi slob gso 'di nyid mtsho bod mtho sgang gi gna' po'i mi'i rigs kyi ngal rtsol las byung ba'i rjes su bod rigs spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur dang 'phel rgyas la bstun nas rgyun ma chad par yar thon byung yod / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus dus mtshams mi 'dra ba'i nang du bod kyi thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i chu tshad kyang mi 'dra ba dang / thon skyed 'brel ba dang chab srid lam lugs mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis bod kyi slob gso'i ngo bo dang khyad chos kyang mi 'dra ba byung ba yin/bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas brgyud spur rgyal gyi gdung rabs dbu brnyes shing / bod kyi mkhar dang po sku mkhar yum bu bla sgang yang brtsigs/khong gi sku dus su bon gyi lugs dar rgyas su btang nas bod kyi slob gso'i thog ma'i ma dpe yang byung / skabs de'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe ni man ngag 298

gyer 'don dang man ngag snyan rgyud gtso bo yin par bshad/ bon gyi gsung rabs mdo 'bum rgyud mdzod sogs po ti mang po bsgyur zhing / 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun sogs byung nas bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig la yar skul chen po byung / btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i dus la slebs dus mtha'i rgyal phran sil ma mang po dbang du bsdus nas bod khams gcig gyur bzos pa dang mnyam du da lta bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i bod yig 'di nyid gsar gtod mdzad/ spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi dang khrims srol gtan la phab nas zhing phyugs las rig gnas sogs gang ci'i thad nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod/ de ni bod btsan po'i skabs su phyi phyogs la sgo mro phye ba las byung ba'i grub 'bras rlabs chen po zhig red/btsan po'i skabs kyi gna' rabs bon gyi yig rnying dang btsan po srong btsan gyi sku ring la byung ba'i tshad ldan sgra sbyor yi ge 'dis bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ dmag don/ khrims lugs/ slob gso bcas phyogs yongs nas sku la 'ded bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas yod la/ bod kyi slob gso yang man ngag snyan brgyud nas yig thog slob gsor 'pho 'gyur byung bas bod rigs kyi rig gnas slob gsor 'phel rgyas yong rgyur dus mtshams phye ba'i cha rkyen gsar pa bskrun yod/ de ni bod kyi spyi tshogs shes rig gi phyogs su bskyod pa'i gom chen ang dang po yang yin la btsan po'i dus kyi slob gso'i 'phel rim chen po gsum gyi ang dang po'ang yin/299

dang po/ btsan po'i skabs kyi dgon sde'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus la bod du nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs dar zhing / ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang sogs gsar du bzhengs / 'on kyang skabs der bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang ni gtso bo dad rten mtshan byed kyi mchod khang tsam yin pa las rab byung gi sde med la dgon sde'i slob gso yang med/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas sba gsal snang sogs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba de ni bod kyi rab byung ba rnams kyi mes po yin par ma zad bod kyi dgon sde'i slob gso'i myu gu thog mar 'bus pa'ang yin/ skabs der dgon sde gsar bzhengs dang rgya gar nag li bal sogs phyi nang gi lo tsā ba mang du byon nas dgon sde'i slob gso'i gzhi rgya dang spus tshad thad 'phel rgyas chen po byung / lo tsā ba mang po byon nas bka' dang bstan bcos 'bor chen bod yig tu phab bsgyur mdzad pa des dgon sde'i slob gsor slob gzhi mang dag cig mkho 'don byas pa dang / lo tsā ba mang po zhig dgon sde'i slob gso'i dge rgan la gyur yod/skabs der bsgrigs pa'i (dkar chag ldan dkar ma〉 la khyen bsdoms chos tshan bdun brgya nyer gsum gyi mtshan byang bkod 'dug 'di ni bod du chos 'gyur ro cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i thog ma yang yin/ 'dis dgon sde'i slob gsor skul 'ded chen po byung zhing / dgon sde'i slob khrid nang don yin par ma zad/ btsan po'i sku dus kyi slob gso'i rgyu rkyen gtso bor gyur yod/300

gnyis pa/ btsan po'i dus skabs kyi gzhung gnyer slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe/skabs der dgon sde'i slob gso yang gtso bo gzhung gnyer byas pa yin pas gzhung gnyer slob gso'i khongs su bsdus kyang mi chog pa med mod/ 'on kyang 'dir bshad pa'i gzhung gnyer slob gso ni dgon sde'i grwa ba ma yin pa'i slob ma la rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang tshan rig rig gnas gzhan dag slob khrid byed pa'i slob gso bcas yin/ da yod dpyad gzhir gzhigs na bod kyis phyi rgyal la slob ma mngags pa'i slob gso'i lam lugs ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs nas ches cher dar ba yin/ 'on kyang de'i sngon nas phyi rgyal phyogs nas mkhas pa du ma gdan drangs pa'i lo rgyus gsal bo mang po mthong rgyu yod/skabs der btsan po'i gzhung phyogs nas thog mar rgya gar la slob sbyong byed du btang ba'i slob ma de dag bod la phyir phebs nas skabs de'i bod kyi rig gnas slob gso 'phel rgyas thad la mdzad rjes rlabs chen bzhag yod/ de las phul du byung ba ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos slob dpon la bkur ba'i slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭa yin la/ khong gis da lta nga tshos bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i bod yig tshad ldan 'di nyid gsar du bzos/ lo tsā ba dharma ko ṣa dang lha lung rdo rje dpal dang bai ro tsa na sogs kyis mdo sngags bstan bcos dang sman rtsis skor shin tu mang po bod yig tu bsgyur nas skabs de'i slob gso dar rgyas byung yod pa de yin/ gzhan yang btsan pos gzhung phyogs nas mngags pa'i slob ma khag gnyis pa dang gsum pa sogs khag mang po'i slob ma rnams ni/ rgya 301

gar dang rgya nag li yul dang bal bo/ kha che dang u rgyan bcas la bskyod nas de dag gi chos dang rig gnas mang po bod la dar du bcug nas phyi phyogs la rig gnas brje res dar spel dang / rgya gar nag sogs dang bod mi rigs phan tshun bar gyi 'brel ba'ang sngar las je zab tu btang yod par ma zad/ skabs de'i tshan rig lag rtsal dang rig gnas slob gso'i bya gzhag thad la nang don gsar pa mang po kha snon byas yod/gsum pa/ btsan po'i dus skabs kyi sger gnyer slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe/btsan po dang blon chen/ btsun mo dang g.yog 'khor nang tshang / dpon rigs dang sku drag che chung khag bcas phal che bas chos dang rig gnas slob gnyer byas yod cing / de dag gso skyong byed sa ni skabs de'i sku drag sger gnyer slob grwa red/ 'di'i skor gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mthong rgyu shin tu dkon na'ang tun hong nas thon pa'i bod yig shog dril 'bor chen dang / shin cang nas thon pa'i btsan po'i dmag gi shing khram yi ge la bltas na/ skabs der bod yig dar khyab shin tu che zhing / rgya cher bed spyod thub yod pa mthong thub/ de dag tshang ma dgon sde dang gzhung gnyer slob gso rkyang rkyang la brten pa tsam gyis yong thabs gtan nas bral ba zhig yin/ skabs de'i gso rig slob gso yang gtso bo sger gnyer slob grwa'am pha bu dang gnyen tshan gyi gdams ngag rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob gso'i ma dpe la brten nas dar ba yin/302

sa bcad gnyis pa/ rnying ma pa'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe la dpyad pa/snye mdo phyogs la gsar rnying gi dbye ba ma byung bas/ rnying ma dang /gsar ma'i rnam bzhag ni gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin/ 0 rnying ma'i grub mtha' 'di'i gzhi bcol yul gtso bo gsang sngags rnying ma yin stabs 'di'i slob khrid byed thabs la'ang gsang sngags kyi khyad chos du ma dang ldan pas pha bu'am bla slob kyi brgyud par brten nas gdams pa 'chad nyan byed pa'i slob gso'i lam lugs shig yin/rnying ma pa'i slob gso'i lam lugs ni bod btsan po'i slob gso'i lam lugs kyi rmang gzhir brten nas byung ba zhig yin par ma zad/ gtso cher dmangs khrod kyi rang bzhin dang / rgya che ba'i rang bzhin/ gdams ngag rgyud pa'i rang bzhin/ slob yun ring thung ma nges pa'i rang bzhin bcas ldan yod la / rnying ma'i ring brgyud bka' ma sgyu 'phrul gsang ba'i snying po'i gdams rgyud las byung ba'i zur po che dang zur chung sgro phug pa bcas mes dbon rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bzhes stangs de las rnying ma pa'i pha bu'i gdams pa rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe gsal por mthong thub/ gzhan yang / rnying ma'i bla rgyud mang por bltas na rnying ma pa'i slob khrid byed stangs ni bla mas rang gi thugs sras slob ma re gnyis kho nar gdams pa ster ba las rgya cher mi bsten pa mtshon thub/ brgyud pa'i rim pa la/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud gsum dang / yang bka' babs lung bstan 303

gyi brgyud pa/ las 'phro gter gyi brgyud pa/ smon lam gtad rgya'i brgyud pa ste brgyud pa drug gi rnam bzhag kyang byed do/ / mi②de las gang zag snyan brgyud dang bka' babs lung bstan gyi brgyud gnyis ni rnying ma pa'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe gal che shos dang khyab brdal che ba'i rang bzhin ldan 'dug mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis 'dzam gling gi ngag gi rig gnas ches rtsa chen mthong chen du byed pa'i ge sar sgrung gi rgyud pa 'di da lta'i bar du rgyun ma chad par dar spel byung ba 'di yang rnying ma pa'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe bzang po 'di la brten nas byung ba yin/ der brten srol rgyun rig gnas rgyud 'dzin byed dgos na 'dzam gling go la grong sder 'gyur bzhin pa'i da lta'i spyi tshogs su'ang nges par slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe 'di la mthong chen dang len byed gal ches shin tu che lags/dus rabs bcu drug par slebs dus rnying ma pa'i slob gso'i ma lag shin tu cha tshang ba zhig tu gyur yod/ skabs der gsar du bzhengs pa'i rnying ma'i dgon chen rdo rje brag dang smin grol gling gnyis ni slob gzhi'i nang don dang 'chad nyan sgrig gzhi dpal 'byor dang rtsa 'dzugs sogs phyogs yongs nas phun sum je tshogs su gyur yod/ lhag par du nye rabs kyi smin grol gling gi rig gnas kyi slob gso de bod khul yongs la snyan pa'i grags pa khyab yod cing / de sngon gdan sa chen po se 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge bshes mtshan btags thon rjes rig gnas gzhan dag slob sbyong gnang sa smin grol gling byed kyi yod/ sngar gyi sku drag mi skya mang po zhig smin grol gling du rig gnas slob sbyong la song yod par ma zad/ phyis kyi rtse slob grwa'i rig gnas dge rgan phal che ba smin grol gling 304

nas phebs pa yin/sa bcad gsum pa/ gsar ma dge lugs pa'i dgon sde'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe la dpyadapa/dang po/ lha sa'i se 'bras dga' gsum gyi slob gso'i sgrig gzhi/gsar ma dge lugs pa ni rgyal ba tsong kha pas bstan pa dag ther byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng nas gsar du dar ba'i grub mtha' chen po zhig yin/lha sa'i gdan sa gsum mam se 'bras dga' gsum gyi slob gso'i sgrig gzhi la/ bla spyi dang grwa tshang / khang tshan bcas rim pa gsum du dbye yod la/ bla spyi ni dgon sde'i srid 'dzin do dam gyi sgrig gzhi mtho shos yin/ grwa tshang ni rim pa gnyis pa yin zhing / dge 'dun sde tshogs kyi tshan khag cung zad che ba zhig yin / khang tshan ni dgon sde'i rmang gzhi'i rtsa 'dzugs shig yin zhing / grwa pa'i yong khungs sa khul la gzhigs nas tshan khag so sor bgos pa zhig yin/ dper na / a mdo mdzod dge sa khul nas yong ba'i khang tshan la the bo khang tshan zer/gdan sa gsum la cha bzhag na se rar khang tshan 30dang / 'bras srungs la khang tshan 80/ dga' ldan la khang tshan 26bcas yod/ khang tshan du ma las grwa tshang gcig grub pa yin/ grwa tshang ni dge lugs pa'i slob gnyer byed skabs kyi slob gso'i sgrig gzhi yin/ der mdo dang sngags phyogs kyi dbye ba chen po gnyis yod/305

gnyis pa/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi slob gso'i lam lugs/mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi slob gzhi'i nang don ni/ gzhung bka' pod lnga dang rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung rtsom dag slob gzhi gtso bor 'dzin pa gcig mthun yin zhing / de'i steng du dgon sde'i grwa tshang so so'i rgyud pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rang gi yig cha'i rten gzhi yang mi 'dra ste/ dper na blo gsal gling bas paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i yig cha dang / sgo mang pas kun mkhyen yab sras kyi yig cha tshad gzhir 'dzin/ gzhung bka' pod lnga ni/ mdo phyogs kyi rgya gzhung gtso bo lnga ste/ phar phyin dang / dbu ma/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'dul ba/mdzod bcas yin/ mdor na/ mdo phyogs kyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang nang slob gnyer gyi gzhung tshang ma mdo'i skor yin/mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi 'dzin grwa'i rim pa dang dbye ba ni/ gsang phu dgon pa'i mkhan po phya pa chos kyi seng ge ni 'dzam gling thog 'dzin grwa'i srol thog mar btod mkhan yin pas bod kyi slob gso'i lam lugs la byas rjes chen po bzhag yod / khong gis tshad ma rnam 'grel la 'dzin grwa lnga ru phye yod de/ bsdus chung dang bsdus 'bring / bsdus chen/ rtags rigs/ rnam 'grel bcas yin/ de'i rjes su 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi tshad ma rnam 'grel la/ bsdus chung dang /bsdus 'bring /bsdus chen/ blo rigs/ rtags rigs bcas 'dzin grwa lnga dang /par phyin la phar phyin skabs dang po dang gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi ba bcas 'dzin grwa bzhi/ dbu ma la skabs dang po dang gnyis pa ste 'dzin grwa gnyis/'dul ba la 'dzin grwa gcig mdzod la 'dzin grwa gcig bcas khyon bsdoms 306

mtshan nyid grwa tshang la 'dzin grwa bcu gsum du dbye ba byas yod/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi slob sbyong lo tshad ni/ se 'bras dga' gsum du gzhung chen po lngar slob sbyong byed rgyu'i lo tshad thad grwa tshang khag so sor dbye ba cung mi 'dra ba yod/dper na/ 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi tshad ma dang phar phyin 'dzin grwa gnyis la lo lnga dang / dbu ma'i 'dzin gyur lo gnyis/ mdzod kyi 'dzin grwar lo gcig 'dul ba'i 'dzin grwar lo gnyis 'gor gyi yod/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang so sor nyung na lo bcu kha dang mang na lo nyi shu lhag 'gor gyi yod/ dge bshes lha rams pa ma thon bar phal cher lo nyi shu tsam 'gor gyi yod/mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi chos mtshams dbye stangs ni/ thog mar tsong kha pas gtan 'bebs gnang ba dang de nas rim bzhin brgyud pa yin zhing / phal cher deng sang gi spyi lugs dbye stangs dang 'dra che/ der yang chos mtshams dang chos mtshams chen mo gnyis su dbye srol yod/mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi mtshan rtags sprod srol ni/ bod la mkhas pa'i mtshan rtags sprod srol lo rgyus shin tu ring po yod par ma zad/ mtshan rtags kyi rigs kyang zhib phra tshad gzhi ldan pa zhig yod de dper na/ bod snga rabs pa'i lugs su dka' bcu pa dang / dka' bzhi pa/ rab 'byams pa bcas dka' pod lnga la sbyangs pa phar phyin thon yod med kyi cha nas mtshan rtags sprod srol rim pa gsum can 'di byung ba yin/ de rjes lha sa'i gdan sa gsum kyi dge bshes gyi mtshan rtags la rim pa ltar lha rams pa dang / tshogs rams pa rdo rams pa/ gling bsres dge bshes bcas rim pa bzhi can 'di dar khyab byung ba yin/307

gzhan yang bod kyi rig gnas gzhan dag gi sbyangs pa mthar phyin na de mthun gyi mtshan rtags sprod srol yod pa 'di ltar sgra rig pa'i sbyangs pa mthar phyin na slob dpon gyis brda sprod kun bshad kyi ming 'dogs srol yod pa dang /skar rtsis kyi sbyangs pa mthar phyin na rtsis rams pa dang / gso rig gi sbyangs pa mthar phyin na sman pa 'bum rams pa dang / sman pa rab 'byams pa/ sman pa dka' bcu pa/ sman pa bsdus grwa ba bcas rim pa bzhi ldan gyi mtshan rtags sprod srol yod/ srol 'di da lta'i 'dzam gling slob gso'i spyi 'gros kyi mtshan rtags rim pa dang sbyar na'ang ches shin tu 'os shing mtshams pa zhig yin te/dper na po hri ( cha)la 'bum rams pa dang / hra hri(o༅)la rab 'byams pa / zho hri(lho )la dka' bcu pa zhes sbyar na ming don gnyis mtshungs su gyur yod par ma zad/ lo tsā ba'i 'gyur dag mo zhig tu'ang rtsis chog snyam mo/ /gsum pa/ dga' ldan gser khri'i slob gso'i lam lugs/dga' ldan gser khri'i slob gso'i lam lugs ni/ 'dzam gling thog khyad chos 'bur du thon pa zhig yin par ma zad/ bod kyi rig gnas kyi thob thang rtsa chen zhig yin la mkhas pa'i yang rtser son na gcig las gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin yang mtshon 'dugadaga' ldan gser khri'am dga' ldan khri pa ni rje tsong kha pa'i rgyal tshab yin la / dge lugs pa'i ma dgon dga' ldan dgon gyi khri pa yang yin/ rje tsong kha pas spyi lo 1409lor dga' ldan dgon pa phyag btab pa dang khri pa ang dang po mdzad pa nas spyi lo 1958lo'i bar gyi lo lnga brgya dang nga bcu'i ring la 308

dga' ldan khri pa khyon bsdoms 96byon yod/ de ni chab srid dang dpal 'byor sogs cha rkyen khyad par ba ci yang mi dgos par grwa ba dkyus ma tshos rang gi 'bad pa du mar brten nas 'chad nyan sgrub sbyong bla lhag mdzad pa las thob pa'i mkhas pa'i go gnas ches mtho shos shig yin/ gdan sa chen po se 'bras dga' gsum gyi grwa pa'i nang nas lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs lha rams pa dge bshes kyi mtshan rtags kyi ang rim thob rjes rgyud grwa stod smad gang rung zhig la zhugs nas sngags rams dam bca' 'jog dgos la/ de'i dge bskos lo phyed dang dbu mdzad lo gsum/ mkhan po lo gsum/ mkhan zur bcas rim bzhin mdzad cing / de nas dga' ldan shar rtse'am byang rtse gang rung gi chos rje byas mtshams dga' ldan khri pa khri bzur ram 'pho 'das byung na de'i go sa thob kyi yod/ de yang shar rtse dang byang rtse'i mkhan zur gnyis re mos byas nas khri pa mdzad dgos/ dga' ldan khri pa'i chos khrir bzhugs yun lo bdun yin zhing /lo dus tshang mtshams nges par khri las mar 'bab dgos/ der brten thob thang 'di yang tshe hril por dbang ba zhig min pas shin tu ngo mtshar che/sa bcad bzhi ba/ nye rabs bod kyi gso rig slob grwa'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe la dpyad pa/rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sku dus su bod kyi gso rig slob gso 'phel rgyas chen po byung zhing snga phyir 'bras spungs su gso rig 'gro phan gling dang / gzhis rtse bsam 'grub rtser gso rig drang srong 'dus pa'i gling / rtse lha dbang lcog tu dar mo sman rams pa'i gso rig slob grwa/ lha sa'i nye 'khor gsang phu nyi ma thang 309

du bod sman slob khang bcas gsar 'dzugs gnang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos lha ldan du lcags ri 'gro phan rig byed gling gsar du btab/ de rjes rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku dus su lha sar sman rtsis khang gsar du btsugs / sman rtsis khang gi las 'gan gtso bo ni bod kyi gso rig dang gnam rig skar rtsis kyi shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed rgyu de yin/ sman rtsis khang gi slob khrid dang slob gso'i lam lugs mang che ba lcags ri rig byed gling ji lta ba'i steng slob grwa'i khyad chos dang mthun pa'i byed thabs 'ga' shas legs bcos kha snon byas yod/ gso rig sbyong mkhan tshos 〈rgyud bzhinagatso bo dang chabs cig 'grel pa 〈be+e sngon〉dang / de'i sman dpe gzhan dag sbyang dgos/ rtsis sbyong mkhan tshos ('byung rtsis man ngag zla ba'i 'od zer〉 dang (skar rtsis sngon 'gron rigs ldan snying thig〉 〈be+e dkar〉bcas sbyang dgos/ de min sman rtsis gang zhig sbyangs rung gzhung don go ba len rgyur phan ched rig gnas skor la dag yig dang / sum rtags/ snyan ngag mngon brjod / sdeb sbyor/ sgra bcas dang / da dung kha shas kyis lañja dang wartu/ thang ga sogs kyang sbyang srol 'dugasman rtsis khang gi sgrig 'dzugs sgrig lam ha cang dam po yod/ slob ma tshos slob grwa'i nang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs skor thos bsam byed dgos par ma zad/da dung sman ngos 'dzin dang sman sbyor lag len rgyus mnga' yong ched/ dbyar kha ri thang la sngo sman 'thu bar 'gro rgyu'i lam lugs chags yod pa des gso rig slob sbyong la skul ma shin tu chen po thebs yod/ srol rgyun 'di da lta'i bar du'ang ma nyams par rgyun 'khyongs byed bzhin yod pa mdzod dge'i nyi ma'i slob 310

gso byed lugs kyi ma dper bltas na gsal por mthong thub/ slob grwa 'di dag gis bkol ba'i bod kyi gso rig rgyud bzhi'i sman thang 'di da lta 'dzam gling gso rig slob gso'i slob khrid sman thang gi ang dang po dang ches snga shos kyang yin par khas len 'dug de las sman thang dag ma kha shas de sngon thog mar mdzod dge a skyid rong gro tshang dgon dang da lta mdzod dge rdzong bod sman khang du nyar tshags byas 'dugs bcad lnga pa/ mdzod dge nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe la dpyad pa/si khrin zhing chen rnga ba bod rigs cha'ang rigs rang skyong khul mdzod dge rdzong bzhag sdom sa char ngo mtshar ba'i slob grwa gnyis (mdzod dge rdzong zhing 'brog pa'i rig gnas lag rtsal slob grwa dang rnga ba khul mdzod dge bod yig slob 'bring /)dang / phyugs bcos sman khang gcig (mdzod dge rdzong skar dmar yul tsho'i phyugs bcos sman khang)bcas sde gsum ngo bo gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can zhig yod/ slob grwa gnyis dang sman khang gcig bcas sde gsum po 'di ni rgyal yongs tshan rig lag rtsal sngon thon pa/ rgyal yongs ngal rtsol dpe bzang ba/ bod kyi phyugs bcos gso ba rig pa'i mkhas chen/ bod kyi slob gso ba chen po dge bshes mdzod dge nyi ma mchog gis sku dngos su gsar 'dzugs gnang ba zhig yin zhing / 'di la bod khul spyi tshogs kyis dga' bsu dang gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po byed bzhin yod par ma zad/ bod kyi 'brog khul slob gso la byas rjes chen po'ang bzhag yod/311
phyugs bcos sman khang gi phyugs bcos las don/

skyed kyi ma lag gnyis nus pa mnyam sbyor yag po byung ba yin/nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe ni bod yig slob 'bring dang / rig gnas lag rtsal slob grwa/ phyugs bcos sman khang gsum las grub pa yin/ gnyis pa/ nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe'i nang don/nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe'i bsam blo dang kha phyogs ni/ thog mar bod khul gyi slob gsos nges par du bod khul gyi rong 'brog pa'i mi dmangs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dngos la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa'i bsam blo gal chen po de ldan yod/ gnyis su/ bod khul kyi slob gso'i skad dang yi ge nges par du bod khul spyi tshogs kyi gnas babs dngos dang gnyis su med par byed dgos kyi de yin/ gsum ni/ bod khul gyi slob gsos nges par du bod mi rigs kyi phul byung srol rgyun rig gnas rgyud 'dzin byed dgos par ma zad mi rigs dang rgyal khab gzhan las byung ba'i legs cha rnams kyang rang gis tshur len par byed pa de yin/ bzhi ru/ slob ma'i gan sa tshul dngos dang bstun nas slob khrid byed dgos pa'i kha phyogs gsal bor bstan 'duga'adzin grwa'i grub tshad dang slob khrid nang don ni/ lag rtsal slob grwa la rig gnas 'dzin grwa dang lag rtsal 'dzin grwa/ dus thung stong brdar 'dzin grwa/gsab sbyong 'dzin grwa/ rigs gzhung 'dzin grwa bcas lnga ru dbye chog de las rig gnas 'dzin grwa ni bod yig gi rmang gzhi med pa'i slob ma gsar pa rnams la btsugs pa yin/ de'i sbyang tshan gtso bo ni bod kyi skad yig yin/ de las 313

dag yig dang / sum rtags/ rtsom yig 'bri stangs/ gso rig ming tshig sogs yod / slob mthar phyin rjes lag rtsal 'dzin grwar 'phar chog bod yig gi rmang gzhi yod pa'i slob ma gsar pa rnams thad kur lag rtsal 'dzin grwar zhugs kyang chog lag rtsal 'dzin grwa ni/ gtso bo bod kyi phyugs nad gso bcos kyi lag rtsal lag len gtso bor sbyang dgos la/ sbyang tshan du sman rdzas rig pa dang sman sbyor gces btus/ nad rtags rig pa/ sman sbyor sdeb kha/ bcos thabs lag len sogs yod/ gzhan yang nub lugs phyugs bcos gso rig dang / krung sman phyugs bcos gso rig nyer mkho kha shas kyang sbyang dgos/ 'dzin grwa 'di mthar phyin rjes mang che ba phyugs las thon skyed dang phyugs bcos sman khang du 'gro gi yod / de las nyung shas shig kyang rigs gzhung 'dzin grwar 'phar chog rigs gzhung 'dzin grwa'i sbyang tshan de las kyang zhib rgyas yod pas/ phal cher ched las 'dzin grwa'i sbyang tshan las mi nyung ba zhig yod/ dus thung sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa ni 'dzin grwa snga ma gsum gyi kha gsab lta bu zhig yin/ dus thung sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa'i sbyang tshan nang don phun sum tshogs po yod par ma zad/ sla/myur / rkyang ba'i rang bzhin kyang ldan la/ phyugs bcos lag rtsal rkyang ba dang bod lug bsgyur kha/ grong sde bdag gnyer/ci partsis pa/ dmangs sgrub dge rgan/rkang rjen sman pa/ rdzi bo sogs yod/ gsab sbyong 'dzin grwa ni/ gtso bo dus nges med kyi rig gnas gsab sbyong byed rgyu de yin zhing / slob lo 'dzur ba'i slob ma la yig rmongs sel ba'i nus pa yod la/ slob lor slebs pa'i slob ma la gong rim slob grwa chung 'bring du 'phar ba'i gra sgrig byed sa'ang yin/ de dag ri mos lam du drangs na 'di ltar/314
dus thung sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa/

rnam pa ni gtso bor lam lugs dang byed thabs la go dgos/ thog mar/ slob ma bsdu tshul gyi phyogs nas bshad na/ slob grwa gang dang gang yin yang slob 'dod yod pa'i mi thams cad nang du bsdu ba'i dgos mkho skong mi thub mod/ 'on kyang nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe 'dis phal cher yong ba thams cad slob mar 'dzin thub kyin 'dug de nas slob yun lam lugs kyi phyogs nas bshad na/ nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe 'di'i slob yun ni ches gson nyams 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin ldan la/ lhag par rig gnas lag rtsal slob grwa'i 'dzin grwa las tshul 'di mngon gsal dod pa shes thub/ gzhan yang slob ma slob grwar 'dug stangs kyi phyogs nas bshad na/ nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe 'dis lo rabs drug cu pa'i nang nas bzung bca' sdod slob grwa btsugs nas slob ma rnams nyin rer lam thag ring bo brgyud nas slob grwar yong ba'i dka' ngal snga mo nas med par bzos/ 'di yang rang re'i rgyal khab dang slob grwa'i bca' sdod lam lugs kyi ma dpe thog ma'i gras su rtsis kyang mi chog pa med snyam/gzhan yang / nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe'i dge rgan ru khag gtso skyong 'dzugs bskrun thad ha cang mthong chen byed la/ dge rgan mang che ba ni ma dpe rang gis gso skyong byas pa yin zhing / de las slob grwa gzhan dang spyi tshogs thog nas gdan drangs pa'ang 'ga' re yod/mdor na/ nyi ma'i slob gso byed lugs kyi ma dpe 'di'i rnam pa khyad par ba la brten nas ma dpe 'di'i nang don grub pa yin la/ des kyang spyi tshogs phyi nang gi nus pa phan tshun bar 'os shing 'tsham par mnyam sbyor 'grig mthun yong 316

bar byas nas ma dpe gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i dge mtshan mang po byung dang 'byung bzhin yod pa 'di yin lags/ /mchan 'grel/()(thu'u bkwan grub mtha'〉shog ngos 55las drangs/ gan su 'u mi rigs dpe bskrun khang gis 1989lo'i zla 3pa'i dpar thengs gsum par gsal/du thu'u bkan grub mtha'〉shog ngos 62las drangs/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(1)(bod ljongs kyi slob gso〉rdo rje tshe brtan gyis brtsams/ krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis 1991lo'i zla 7par dpar thengs dang po btab/(2)(krung go'i bod kyi gso ba rig pa〉byams pa 'phrin las kyis brtsams/ krud go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe bskrun khang gis 1996lo'i zla 8par dpar thengs dang po btab/(3)(bla brang dgon pa'i spyi bshad〉blo h+pha zhis sogs kyis bsgrigs/ kun su'u mi rigs dpe bskrun khang gis 1987lo'i zla 8par dpar thengs dang po btab/(4)(krung go'i mi rigs slob gso'i 'phel phyogs 'gro lam brtag dpyad〉phrin hong tha'o yis brtsams/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob gling gi dpe skrun khang gis 1990lo'i zla 1por dpar thengs dang po btab/(5)〈bod kyi slob gso bcos bsgyur dang 'phel rgyas〉bshad sgrub sogs kyis gtso sgrig byas/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1993lo'i zla 12par dpar thengs dang po btab/(6)(bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug bdud rtsi'i thigs pa〉dor zhi rin po ches brtsams/kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2003lo'i zla 9par dpar thengs dang po btab/(7)(bod kyi nye rabs dang deng rabs kyi slob gso'i lo rgyus gnad bsdus〉kro ce lin gyis rtsom sgrig byas/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe bskrun khang gis 1993lo'i zla 12par 317

dpar thengs dang po btab/(8)(mi rigs slob gso'i zhib 'jug phyogs bsgrigs〉 si khron zhing chen rnga ba khul slob u dang rnga ba khul slob gso'i rigs gzhung tshogs pas bsgrigs/ si khron slob chen gyi dpe skrun khang gis 1992lo'i zla 6par dpar thengs dang po btab/

skad gnyis slob gso'i thabs lam skor cung bshad pa/ye shes rdo rje/rig gnas dar na dpal yon dar 'gyur zhing / / dpal yon dar na spyi tshogs ngang gis 'phel/ /kun gyi rtsa ba slob gso nyid yin phyin/ /nam yang slob gso dar la 'bad par bya/ /zhes pa'i sho lo gas gtam gyi sgo mo phyes te 'dir ngas bod sa khul gyi skad gnyis slob gso'i lo rgyus dang gnas babs sogs cung tsam zhus yod/ khyed rnam pas mkhyen pa bzhin/ rang rgyal gyis grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul la skad gnyis slob gso spel nas mi lo bcu phrag du ma phyin mthar bod dang bcas pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sa khul du thabs lam rigs mi 'dra ba du ma dod yod pa red / bod la bshad na khrid srol phal cher gnyis dod de/ thabs lam rigs dang po ni/ slob grwa chung ba nas mtho 'bring gi bar gyi khrid bya yod dgu bod rang gi phal skad nas khrid shul rgya nag gi skad yig gcig po bsnan te khrid pa'i thabs lam de la zer/ khrid thabs de la yongs grags su phal skad slob khrid ces brjod/ thabs lam rigs gnyis pa de las ldog te/ slob grwa chung ba nas mtho 'bring gi bar gyi khrid bya tshang ma bod rang gi phal skad min par rgya rigs kyi 319

spyi skad thog nas slob khrid byas shul bod kyi skad yig gcig po bsnan te khrid pa'i thabs lam de la zer/ slob gso bas thabs lam de rigs la skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid zer gyi yod/ thabs lam de gnyis bod sa khul du khyab spel byed stangs mi 'dra ste/ bod rang skyong ljongs dang / si khron dkar mdzes khul / yu na nan bod khul sogs kyi khongs su thabs lam rigs gnyis pa ste skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid dam rgya yig slob khrid gtso bo byed kyi 'dug /de nas mtsho sngon dang kun lho/ si khron rnga ba khul sogs kyi khongs su thabs lam rigs dang po ste phal skad slob khrid dam bod yig slob khrid gtso bo byed kyi 'dug /nye ba'i lo shas ring si khron bod khul du thabs lam rigs dang po la gtso bor brten nas bod phrug slob ma mang po mi rigs slob grwa chen po ma gtogs pa'i si khron gyi rgya yig slob grwa chen po dang / rgyal yongs kyi rim pa dang po'i dngos gzhi slob grwa sogs la btang thub song / der brten/ da lta si khron bod khul gyi rdzong khag mang pos thabs lam rigs dang po ste phal skad slob khrid la dga' po byed bzhin yod/ de bzhin thabs lam mi 'dra ba las grub 'bras kyang mi 'dra bas/tshan rig gis gong gsal thabs lam rigs gnyis po la shes rtogs bya phyir cung smra bar spro'o/ /de'ang slob gso'i rig gzhung ltar na/ gong gsal thabs lam rigs dang po'i slob khrid la pal skad slob khrid dang / thabs lam rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid la skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ces brjod/ thabs lam rigs dang po'i slob khrid dang thabs lam rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ces pa ni si khron bod khul gyi brjod tshul bye brag pa zhig yin/ thabs lam rigs dang po'i slob 320

khrid dang thabs lam rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi khyad par ni phal skad slob khrid dang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi khyad par la ma 'dus pa med pas yongs grags kyi phal skad slob khrid dang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi khyad par nas cung zhus na 'di ltar te/phal skad slob khrid ni slob gso'i chos nyid dang mthun cing byis pa'i shes rab 'phel ba'i lugs dang yang mthun pa'i slob khrid kyi thabs lam zhig yin phyin / mi rigs so so'i slob gso'i slob khrid la thabs lam de bkol spyod che/grub 'bras kyang legs/ de ni slob gso'i las don spyi'i 'gro lugs khungs lung btsan zhing rgyu mtshan ldan la phugs mtha' ring ba zhig yin la/ mi rigs dang rgyal khab so sos slob gso'i nang don phal cher phal skad slob khrid la brten nas spel bzhin yod/ 'byung 'gyur slob gso'i las don ji ltar dar rung thabs lam de ni 'gran zla bral zhing rtsod pa med pa'i slob khrid kyi thabs lam gtso bo zhig yin/ rang rgyal srid gzhung gis kyang shugs chen pos thabs lam de skul bzhin yod/ 'on kyang / dus rabs gsar ba'i skabs mi rigs phan tshun gyi 'brel ba je mang du phyin pas phan tshun bar slob sbyong dang nyams myong brje len byed stangs kyang sna mang du phyin/ da lta skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ces pa 'di'ang mi rigs so so'i slob gso la dar bzhin yod/ slob khrid de da lta mi rigs so so'i phal skad slob gso'i kha snon med du mi rung ba zhig tu gyur dang 'gyur bzhin yod/skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ces pa ni phal skad slob khrid min pa'i skad rigs gzhan gang gi slob khrid la zer te/ dper na/ bod sa khul gyi skad 321

rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ni rgya skad sogs bod skad min pa'i skad rigs gzhan dag gang gi slob khrid la go dgos/ de bzhin du sog rigs kyi skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ni rgya skad sogs sog skad min pa'i skad rigs gzhan dag gang yin pa ltar ro/ /rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs so so'i phal skad kyi khongs su rgya skad sogs skad rigs gzhan gang gi slob khrid byas pa yin na / slob khrid de la skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ces zer gyi 'dug /'o na/phal skad slob khrid dang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid la khyad par gtso bo du yod ce na/ de gnyis la khyad par bzhi yod de/ dmigs yul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang / ngo bo mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ khungs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ khor yug mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sogs bzhi yod/dang po/ dmigs yul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ phal skad slob khrid dang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi dmigs yul mi 'dra ste/ phal skad slob khrid kyi dmigs yul 'di skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi dmigs yul las che/phal skad slob khrid kyis slob ma'i skad cha'i nus pa skyed bsring byed par ma zad/des slob ma la rig gnas skor gyi slob gso dang / blo rig sbyong brdar/ goms gshis chags rgyu sogs la gtso bor dmigs nas spel dgos phyin/ phal skad slob khrid kyi 'os 'gan yang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi 'os 'gan las lci / de nas skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi dmigs yul phal skad slob khrid kyi dmigs yul las chung / 'os 'gan yang phal skad slob khrid las yang / skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni slob ma'i skad cha nus pa ci skyed bsring bya rgyu tsam yin/ de min kho tsho'i rig gnas slob gso dang bsam 322

gzhigs sbyong brdar sogs ni kho tsho'i phal skad slob khrid kyi 'os 'gan yin pa las skad rigs gnyis pa gang gi 'os 'gan min/ 'on kyang / rgya nag spyi skad dang dbyin ji'i skad ni dar khyab che bas/ bod phrug rnams kyis mi sbyong ka med red / yang sgos su rgya nag gi spyi skad cis kyang legs po sbyong dgos pa ma zad bed yod du sbyong dgos/gnyis pa/ ngo bo mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ phal skad slob khrid dang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid gnyis kyi ngo bo mi 'dra ste/ phal skad slob khrid kyis skad yig gi lag cha'i rang bzhin dang / skad yig gi mi chos rig gnas kyi rang gzhin gnyis ka la mthong chen byed dgos te/ lag cha'i rang bzhin dang mi chos rig gnas kyi rang bzhin gnyis gcig gyur gtong ba de ni phal skad slob khrid kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos shig yin/ skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyis skad yig gi lag cha'i rang bzhin la mthong chen byas pa las skad yig gi mi chos rig gnas kyi rang bzhin la mthong chen byed mi nus te/ slob mas thog mar skad rigs gnyis pa gang bed spyod gtong rgyu sbyong dgos phyin/ slob ma'i skad cha'i nus pa gso ba ni skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi 'gan gtso bo yin/ de 'dra yin phyin/ 2002lor rang rgyal slob gso pu'u yis nyin hril po'i lugs kyi mi rigs slob grwa chung 'bring gi rgya yig slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin zhes pa la dag bcos mdzad mthar/ rtsa 'dzin gyi ming yang nyin hril po'i lugs kyi mi rigs slob grwa chung 'bring gi rgya skad slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin zhes su bsgyur yod/2002lo'i mi rigs slob grwa chung 'bring gi rgya yig slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin rnying ba de'i bed spyod gtong mtha' rdzogs so/ /da lta bed spyod gtong bzhin yod pa 323

ni nyin hril po'i lugs kyi mi rigs slob grwa chung 'bring gi rgya skad slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin zhes pa de yin/ 'dir rgya yig slob khrid de rgya skad slob khrid du bsgyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang skad rigs gnyis pa kho rang gi ngo bo dang khyad chos kyis mtshon thub par ma zad/ rang rgyal gyi bca' khrims su rgya nag gi spyi skad ni rang rgyal gyi spyi skad yin pas shugs chen pos khyab spel byed dgos zhes pa'i snying don dang yang mthun no/ /rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs la cha bzhag nas bshad na/ skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ces pa de rgya nag gi spyi skad slob khrid de la go ba las/ rgya nag gi skad yig slob khrid la go mi rung / de gnyis la khyad par chen po yod rung skabs babs kyi brjod don min pas bshad pa spangs/grangs nyung mi rigs slob mas rgya skad dang rgya yig gnyis las rgya skad gtso bo sbyong dgos/ yang sgos su rgya skad spyod nus gdod ma nas gso skyong byed dgos/rgya yig sbyong rgyu'i 'gan ni shin tu yang ste/ phal skad slob khrid gtso bo byed bzhin yod pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi slob ma so sos slob chung skabs su rgya yig yig 'bru 500nas 1000tsam dang / dma' 'bring skabs su yig 'bru 1000nas 5000tsam/ mtho 'bring skabs su yig 'bru 5000nas 10000tsam shes dgos zhes nyin hril po'i lugs kyi mi rigs slob grwa chung 'bring gi rgya skad slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin gsar pa la bkod yod/gsum pa/ khungs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ phal skad slob khrid dang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid gnyis kyi khungs mi 'dra ste/ phal skad slob khrid kyi skabs su/ slob ma la yod pa'i skad kyi khungs dang rig gnas kyi khungs ni kho rang tshos slob sbyong byed bzhin pa'i skad kyi khongs dang rig gnas kyi khungs 324

sogs dang mthun po yod/ kho tsho'i slob sbyong byed tshul dang bsam gzhigs byed tshul / kho tshos shes pa'i yon tan dang yul srol goms gshis sogs kyang kho tshos slob sbyong byed bzhin pa'i phal skad des mtshon pa dang gcig mthun yin/ 'on kyang —/ skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid zer ba ni de ltar min te/ skad rigs kyi khungs mi 'dra bas slob mas shes pa dang da lta sbyong bzhin pa gnyis thod mi thub / mang che ba gtan nas mi 'dra/ phal cher mgo nas slob sbyong byed dgos/slob sbyong byed tshe'am mang che bas phal skad slob sbyong gi nyams myong ltar skad rigs gnyis pa la slob sbyong byed nges pas/ dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la skad rigs gnyis pa'i khungs dang lung sogs ngo sprod zhib mo byed pa gal che snyam /bzhi pa/ khor lug mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ phal skad slob khrid dang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid gnyis kyi khor lug mi 'dra ste/ phal skad slob khrid kyi slob ma dag kho rang skyes pa nas bzung slob sbyong byas dang byed bzhin pa'i skad rigs de yi khor yug tu gnas yod pas/ slob grwa la ma yong gong nas kho rang la skad rigs de'i rmang gzhi nges can re yod/ skad rigs de las bslabs pa'i nyams myong dang / skad rigs des skyed bsring byas pa'i brda sprod kyi nus pa sogs kyang kho rang la nges can re yod pa'i stabs kyis/ slob gso bas de la byis pa'i snga yod shes rig ces brjod do/ /'on kyang / skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi yul ni de lta min te/ slob ma de tsho mang che ba brda mi 'phrod pa'i skad rigs gzhan gyi khor yug tu tshud yod pas/ rmang gzhi gtan nas med/tshang ma mgo nas slob sbyong byed dgos/ slob sbyong byed pa'i dus tshod kyang slob 325

khrid skabs kyi dus tshod nges can de ma gtogs med/ de 'dra yin pas/ phal skad slob khrid kyi khor yug ni rnying chags yin/ skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob gso dang bsdur na de'i rmang gzhi brtan/ mthun rkyen yang mang / 'on kyang / skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid ces pa de'i khor yug ni gsar chags yin/ phal skad slob khrid dang bsdur na de'i rmang gzhi dben/ mthun rkyen yang nyung / der brten / phal skad slob khrid shul skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi khor yug gsar skrun ji lta bya rgyu ni slob gso ba kun gyi mdun du thon pa'i gnad don gsar ba zhig kyang yin no/ /gong gsal phal skad slob khrid dang skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid gnyis la so so'i dmigs yul mi 'dra ba dang / ngo bo mi 'dra ba/ so so'i khungs dang khor yug kyang mi 'dra ba sogs kyi khyad par rnams zhus tshar/ mdor na/ bod sa khul gyi phal skad slob khrid ni bod skad slob khrid la go dgos shing / de ni bod khul gyi skad gnyis slob gso'i thabs lam gtso bo de yin phyin/ skad gnyis slob gso'i nang don ji ltar 'gyur rung / thabs lam de ni nam yang gtso bo yin nges pa ni slob gso'i chos nyid red/ chos nyid la shes rtogs dang chos nyid bed spyod gtong ba las chos nyid la sgyur bcos gtong srol med/ nga tshos nam yang phal skad slob khrid kyi khrid srol de mi rabs nas mi rabs bar du mi 'gyur brtan po'i ngang rgyun 'khyongs byas thog skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kha snon tshul bzhin byas pa yin na/ bod sa khul gyi skad gnyis slob gso'i las don ni dbyar mtsho bzhin dar rgyas 'gro nges yin/ yang smra ba/skad gnyis slob gso 'dzam bu gling la dar/ /326
grid thabs kyi gtso bo yica/ gyis slob gso nyams mi na gnyis ku'i nus pa pe/ bsdus so/ /

dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rgya bod skad brda'i slob gsor bltas pa'i 'phros don 'ga'/ye shes don grub/spyir skad gnyis zhes dus gcig tu skad rigs gnyis bed spyod dang brgyud spel byed pa la go/ rang rgyal la mtshon na skad gnyis zhes rgya'i skad dang grangs nyung mi rigs gang rung zhig gi skad la ngos bzung / skad gnyis kyi snang tshul 'di mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel phyogs gcig tu sgril zhing / thun mong gi dmigs yul 'grub pa'i mtshon rtags su snang la/ mi rigs mang ba'i rgyal khab dang spyi tshogs kyis skad yig bed spyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'phel phyogs kyang yin/deng skabs ni brda 'phrin myur spel gyi dus rabs shig yin la mi rigs gang yin yang rang rigs kyi skad legs bkol byas pa'i dus mtshungs su/ blo rgya cher bskyed kyis mi rigs gzhan pa'i skad la'ang sbyong spyod byas nas 'jig rten gzhan pa'i brda 'phrin rgyus lon thabs byas na/ mi rigs de nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro bar phan 'bras brjod las 'das pa thon thub/ mi rigs phan tshun skad yig sbyong spel byed pa ni dus rabs 'phel phyogs kyi dgos mkho dang mi rigs so so dar rgyas su 'gro ba'i skabs su babs pa'i bsgrub bya'i don chen zhig kyang yin/ dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul du skad gnyis lam 328

'u gas spel ba 'dis rang khul gyi brda 'phrin bsdu len nus pa je che dang / sa gnas dang mi rigs gzhan pa'i rig gnas rang lugs su 'dren rgyu/ khyad par 'dzam gling yongs kyi sngon thon lag rtsal las smin pa'i rmad byung legs 'bras la ngoms med rol cing / sa gnas 'di'i mi'i 'jon thang dang nus pa bla lhag tu rgyas par gor ma chag /dang po/ dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi mi rigs ngos 'dzin dang rgya bod skad brda'i slob gso'i nus par ngos 'dzin byed tshul/gcig mi rigs ngos 'dzin dang phan tshun bar gyi 'brel ba/dkar mdzes khul ni bod rigs gtsor byas pa'i mi rigs rang skyong gi sa khul zhig yin/ 'dir da dung rgya rigs dang hu'e rigs/ cha'ang rigs/'jang rigs sogs mi rigs nyi shu lhag phan tshun gcig gis gcig la brten cing zhi bde'i mtsho mor dga' bde'i dpal la rol te gnas/ 1990lor thengs bzhi pa'i rgyal yongs mi grangs zhib bsher gyi sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/khul yongs la mi grangs brgyad 'bum nyis khri brgyad stong lnga brgya so gcig (828531)yod pa las/ bod rigs mi grangs drug 'bum nyis khri bdun stong brgya med nyer bzhi (627024)yod pas mi grangs spyi las brgya cha'i75 685zin / rgya rigs chig 'bum bdun khri bdun stong brgyad brgya nyer gsum(177823)yod pas mi grangs spyi las brgya cha'i21 465zin/ dbyis 329

rigs chig khri brgyad stong brgyad brgya nyer gsum (17723)yod pas mi grangs spyi las brgya cha'i2 275zin/ hu'e rigs chig stong bdun brgya nyer lnga (1725)yod pas mi grangs spyi las brgya cha'i 0 215zin/ cha'ang rigs tshig stong bdun brgya nyer gnyis (1722)yod pas mi grangs spyi las brgya cha'i0 215zin / 'jang rigs drug brgya bdun cu don drug (676)yod pas mi grangs spyi las brgya cha'i 0 085zin/ de min sog rigs dang mi'o rigs / ya'o rigs/ pa'i rigs/ yu gur rigs/ krong rigs/ pu'u dbyi rigs / khra'o zhan rigs/ man ju rigs/ tung rigs/ thu'u ca rigs/ ta'e rigs / li rigs/ tung zhang rigs/ hor rigs/ mu'u la'o rigs/ sa lar rigs / ke la'o rigs/ cing rigs bcas mi grangs bdun brgya bzhi bcu zhe gsum (743)yod pas mi grangs spyi las brgya cha'i 0 095zin pa bcas so/ /mi rigs 'di dag dkar mdzes khul rdzong khag bco brgyad du las byed mngags gtong dang tshong las gnyen sgrig sogs kyi rkyen gyis phal cher 'dres sdod byas shing / phan tshun 'brel 'dris zab cing / tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi rta bdun zer brgyar brten nas rgyal dar dmangs phyug gi las kur sems shugs gcig tu sgril ba'i rnam pa zhig tu snang la/ mi rigs so so 'tsho gnas byed yul thad khyad cung tsam yod de/ bod rigs ni dkar mdzes khul du phal cher 'dus sdod byas shing / bye brag nyung shas mi rigs gzhan pa dang 'dres sdod byas yod de/ dar mdo sgyu la'i nub rgyud kyi sa bde dang rdzong zhabs/ lha sgang / rta'u rdzong / brag 'go rdzong /dkar mdzes rdzong / gser rta rdzong / ser shul rdzong / sde dge rdzong / nyag rong 330

rdzong —/ dpal yul rdzong / 'ba' thang rdzong / cha 'phrin rdzong / 'dab pa rdzong / sde rong rdzong / nyag chu kha rdzong bcas rdzong khag bcu bzhi dang chus gsum gyi khongs su bod rigs 'dus sdod byas yod/ mi rigs gzhan pa dang 'dres sdod bya yul ni dar mdo sgyu la'i shar rgyud kyi dar mdo grong khul dang / dar mdo'i grong rdal/lugs thang dang khang yul chus/ mgo thang chus dang brgyad zil rdzong / rong brag rdzong bcas rdzong khag gnyis dang chus bzhi grong rdal gcig gi khongs su rgya rigs sogs dang 'dres sdod byas shing lcags zam rdzong du bod rigs nyung shas las med do/ /rgya rigs ni dkar mdzes khul du phal cher mi rigs gzhan pa dang 'dres sdod dang nyung shas 'dus sdod byas yod de/ dar mdo sgyu la'i shar rgyud kyi brgyad zil rdzong dang rong brag rdzong du rgya rigs mang zhing mi rigs gzhan pa dang 'dres sdod byas pa gtso bo yin/ de min rta'u rdzong dang brag 'go rdzong /dkar mdzes rdzong / gser rta rdzong / ser shul rdzong / dpal yul rdzong / sde dge rdzong —/ nyag rong rdzong / nyag chu kha rdzong / 'ba' thang rdzong / li thang rdzong / cha 'phrin rdzong / 'dab pa rdzong dang sde rong rdzong bcas la rgya rigs yod kyang grangs nyung zhing / grong khyer dang rgya lam rgyud du ma gtogs med/ bcing 'grol sngon du gser rtar rgya rigs med cing / bcing 'grol rjes su rim bzhin yul der rgya mis gzhis bcas nas sdod mkhan byung / lcags zam rdzong ni rgya rigs 'dus sdod bya yul gtso bo zhig yin/ 1990lor rdzong 'dir mi grangs spyi las brgya cha'i 9 295zin par gnas/dbyis rigs dkar mdzes khul du 'dus sdod bya yul gtso bo ni brgyad 331

zil rdzong dang lcags zam rdzong gnyis yin/ de min rdzong khag so sor thar thor du gnas/hu'e rigs ni gtso bo dar mdo rdzong dang rong brag rdzong du mang zhing / de min rdzong khag bcu drug tu mi grangs mang na bcu lhag dang nyung na bcu kha ma zin pa re yod pa bcas ni rgya rigs dang bod rigs mnyam du 'dres sdod byas yod/sog rigs dang khra'o zhan rigs bcas ni mi grangs nyung shas las med cing ske/ yod pa de dag kyang khul rim pa'i las khungs dang khe las sde khag sogs kyi las byed pa dang las bzo pa yin la/ rdzong khag so sor re gnyis tsam yod/gnyis / mi rigs 'brel ba las rgya bod skad gnyis kyi don byed nus min snang tshul sna tshogs/dkar mdzes khul ni bod rigs gtso byas nas mi rigs nyi shu lhag las grub pa'i bod rigs rang skyong khul zhig yin/ mi rigs 'di dag yun ring 'dres sdod dang phan tshun 'gro 'ong gi 'brel ba rgyun ma chad par gnas pas/mi rigs bar gyi srol rgyun goms gshis sogs rig gnas bar chu dang 'o ma lta bu'i 'brel ba zhig chags 'dug /lhag par du deng rabs gsar skyes gzhon nu'i khrod du ra ma lug gi rnam pa can 'bor chen thon dang 'thon mus su mchis stabs / rgya bod skad gnyis kyi snang tshul thad la'ang rigs du ma zhig mngon par phyi rol yul gyi cha nas brtag na mu bzhi yod de/1 bod skad gtsor byas shing rgya skad kyis don mi 'byor ba'i mu/mu 'di ni ser shul rdzong dang gser rta rdzong / li thang rdzong / nyag rong rdzong —/ brag 'go rdzong / dkar mdzes rdzong / sde rong rdzong / rta'u rdzong bcas kyi 332

'brog sde dang thag ring gi grong gseb yin/ yul bye brag pa 'di dag tu da dung srol rgyun spyi tshogs gyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i rnam pa las grol ma thub pas/gdod ma nyid nas 'tsho gnas byas pa 'i bod rigs kho na las dka' tshegs kyi sdug bsngal bzod thub mkhan dkon la/ las byed pa'ang bod rigs las med pas skad yig gzhan pas brda 'byor mi nus pa yin/2 bod skad gtso zhing rgya skad kyis rams 'degs byed pa'i mu/mu 'di ni ser shul rdzong dang sde dge rdzong / nyag rong rdzong / brag 'go rdzong /rta'u rdzong / li thang rdzong / 'ba' thang rdzong / cha 'phrin rdzong / 'dab pa rdzong /rong brag rdzong sogs kyi rdzong srid gzhung chags sa'i grong khyer dang / rong khul/rgya lam rgyud kyi grong sde yod rgu gtogs/3 rgya skad gtso zhing bod skad kyis ram 'degs byed pa'i mu/mu 'di ni dar rtse mdo dang brgyad zil rdzong / nyag chu kha rdzong bcas yin/rdzong 'di gsum las grong khyer du sdod pa'i mi phal cher rgya bod pho mo zung las brgyud pa mang bas/ dus rgyun skad brda sprod byed gtso bo rgya skad byed cing / bod skad shod mkhan nyung shos yin/ de las nyag chu kha dang rta'u rdzong du skad kyi snang tshul dmigs bsal ba zhig yod de/ mi mang shos kyis log skad ces tshig gi 'gros bod skad ltar yin mod/ tha snyad phal cher rgya skad yin te/ dper na/ skya mi zhig song zhes par (zalkoman+t+ra1)zhes dang / za ma bza' zhes par (yolhaṣ+ṭha)zhes brjod/ skad 'di smra mkhan tshos bod skad yin zhes spobs pa cher bskyed kyis brjod la/ rgya skad dag pa shod par rgya skad yin par 'dzin/ gang ltar 'di'ang rgya bod skad brdas phan tshun shan zhugs song ba'i rtags mtshan 333

zhig yin/ rta'u dang brag 'go rong brag rdzong bcas nas bod skad kyi bye brag rgyal rong skad kyang bed spyod byed bzhin yod cing / gser rta/ ser shul bcas su am skad 'chad mkhan yang mang bas/ dkar mdzes khul du bod skad nang gses kyi khams skad gtsos pa'i am skad dang rgyal rong skad kyang yod pa shes dgos so/ /4 rgya skad las bod skad kyis brda mi 'byor ba'i mu/mu 'di ni gtso bo lcags zam rdzong la go rdzong 'dir sog rigs sogs yod pa las bod skad smra mkhan ni med do/ /gong gsal gyi mu bzhi las nga tshos dkar mdzes khul du rgya bod skad brda'i don byed nus par yul dus kyi gnas bab gsal por rtogs thub bo/ /gnyis pa/ rgya bod skad brda'i slob gso'i gal che'i snying don dang dkar mdzes khul du rgya bod skad gnyis kyi slob gso spel tshul/gcig rgya bod skad brda'i slob gso'i gal che'i snying don/spyir mi rigs gang zhig thog mar grub pa nyid nas skad kyang lhan skyes su grub pa zhig yin/ skad ni mi rigs de'i khyad chos mtshon thub pa'i brda rtags gtso bo zhig yin pa ma zad mi rigs de'i lo rgyus kyi bang mdzod chen mo las rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gna' rdzas lta bu zhig kyang yin pas/ mi rigs de'i khyad 'phags rang bzhin dang lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim gsal por mtshon thub/ skad kyi byed las kyang mi'i brjod 'dod kyi blo gzhan la brda sprod cing mi rigs phan 334
