tshun bar 'phrin spel dang rig gnas brje res byas nas thun mong gi blo gros shig grub byed kyang yin/ gcig mthun gyi skad shig yod tshe rigs so so'i rig gnas dang lo rgyus/ tshan rtsal bcas mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud spel dang dar khyab tu gtong thub la/ mi rigs gang zhig yun ring du gnas shing dar rgyas su 'gro ba'i srog gi dbang po lta bu'ang yin/mi rigs su'i skad yin yang 'gyur med rtag brtan can ni ma yin la/ lo rgyus kyi bshul lam ring mo las mi rigs so so'i chags gnas 'jig tshul dang /phan tshun 'gro 'ong 'brel 'dris kyi dbang gis skad la'ang rim bzhin 'gyur ba yong srid de/ mi rigs 'ga' zhig gi skad rgyun spel thub cing brda dang tha snyad phun sum je tshogs dang / 'ga' zhig gi skad kyi nus pa shor nas med par gyur cing mi rigs gzhan pa'i skad g.yar spyod byed pa las thabs bral/ 'di lta'i mi rigs ni srog gi dbang po dang bral ba'i mi ro skam po ltar gyur cing mi ring bar rang mi rigs kyi ming yang brlags te med par 'gyur nges red/dkar mdzes khul ni bod rgya mi rigs gtsos pa'i mi rigs mang 'dus kyi sa khul zhig yin la/ bod rgya skad zung gis sa khul 'di'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor / rig gnas slob gso bcas kyi thad la 'dab chags shig gi gshog zung lta bu'i nus pa 'thon bzhin yod/ mi rigs mthun sgril dang bsam blo lhug por brje res byed par phan nus brjod las 'das pa thon thub/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na khul 'dir bod rgya skad brda'i slob gso spel ba'i dgos pa byung ba yin/gnyis / mi rigs skad yig gi nus pa 'don cing / bod rgya skad gnyis kyi slob gso'i sgrig gzhi 'thus tshang zhig 'jugs pa ni dkar 335

mdzes khul gyi slob gso'i nang don gco bo zhig ngu gyur 'dug/1984lor / khul slob gso cus kyis 'das pa'i slob gso'i nyams myong phyogs bsdoms kyis rgya bod skad yig slob khrid kyi gtso phal zlas phyes nas slob khrid thabs lam rigs bzhir bgos te lag len byas pa nas bzung skad gnyis kyi slob gso'i lam lugs rim bzhin grub/ 1989lor/ bod rgya skad gnyis slob gso'i skor dang rgyun sdod slob grwa'i slob gso'i skor gyi gros tshogs bsdus nas / nyams myong phyogs bsdoms dang las ku'i legs nyes la dmigs pa'i byed thabs gsar 'tshol byas shing khul yongs kyi skad gnyis slob gso 'phel thabs kyi 'char 'god bkod/ 1990lo mjug bar khul yongs su bod yig slob khrid byed bzhin pa'i slob chung bzhi brgya so bdun (437)dang / slob ma nyis khri brgyad stong dgu brgya re lnga (28965)yod la/ slob grwa chung 'bring du 'dzin grwa chig stong dgu brgya nga lnga (1955)la bod yig khrid tshan bsgrigs/ de dag las rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid 'char 'god du thebs pa'i 'dzin grwa tshig stong bzhi brgya don gnyis (1472)dang / rigs gsum pa'i 'dzin grwa gnyis brgya nyi shu (220)dang / rigs bzhi pa'i 'dzin grwa nyis brgya re gsum (263)bcas yod pas skad gnyisatsāb khrid kyi khyab tshad brgya cha'i 68 55zin/nye ba'i lo shas ring bod rgya skad yig gi slob gso'i las kur shugs snon byas la grub 'bras kyang mngon gsal thob yod de/ bod rgya zung khrid kyi slob grwa chung 'bring lnga brgya gya lnga (585)dang / slob ma sum khri drug stong brgyad brgya nyer bdun (36827)yod pas/ mi rigs rang gi slob ma spyi las brgya cha'i 71 045zin / bod kyi skad yig gtso khrid byed cing rgya yig khrid tshan yang 336

yod pa'i slob chung nyer drug (26)yod la/ slob ma nyis stong brgyad brgya zhe gsum (2843)yod pa bcas ni slob grwa chung ba dang dma' rim slob 'bring las mngon pa'i grub 'bras yin/slob grwa che 'bring du'ang bod rgya skad yig zung khrid kyi thabs sna tshogs bkol nas 'bras bu g.yur du za bar smin yod de/ khul 'dir dkar mdzes dge thon slob grwa dang 'ba' dge thon slob grwa/ dar mdo dge thon slob grwa/ zhing chen bod yig slob grwa/ dar mdo mtho rim dge thon ched stong slob grwa bcas su bod kyi skad yig gtso khrid dang rgya yig zur khrid/ rgya yig gtso khrid dang bod yig zur khrid byed pa ci rigs kyis rgya bod skad yig zung khrid thabs kyis slob grwa chung 'bring gi dge rgan dang bod rgya skad gnyis kyi lo tsā ba 'bor chen gso skyong byas/ 1995lo'i bar du dge rgan drug stong brgyad brgya so gcig (6831)tu zin pas/ 1990lo las brgya cha'i 20 75'phar snon song yod / de las bod rgya skad yig slob khrid dge rgan brgyad brgya re drug (866)yod pas dge rgan spyi las brgya cha'i 12 75zin/dar mdo mi rigs las byed slob gas kyang dkar mdzes khul du mi rigs las byed kyi bod rgya skad gnyis kyi lo tsā ba dang drung yig 'go khrid pa bcas mi nyung ba zhig gso skyong byed bzhin yod/skad gnyis bslab gzhi'ang gang mang rtsom sgrig byas yod de/ 1982lo nas ljongs zhing lnga'i slob gzhi mnyam sgrig lhan tshogs btsugs pa nas bzung rtsis rig dang chab srid/ sems khams rig pa/ slob gso rig pa/ slob khrid rtsa gnad / dpyad gzhi'i yig cha bcas rtsom sgrig dang gsar rtsom byas la/ slob 337

chung skad yig rigs lnga dang deb bco brgyad zhib dpyad byas nas bton pas/bod kyi slob grwa chung 'bring du skad yig slob gso'i rmang gzhi zab mo zhig bting /dkar mdzes khul du dge 'os slob grwa gsum gyis rim bzhin dpal 'byor rgyun shes / chab srid rgyun shes/ dge rgan gyi kun spyod rgyun shes/ mar khe si'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang rtsis rig sogs kyi bslab gzhi bsgyur cing tshod lta'i tshul du spyod bzhin yod/ zhing chen bod yig slob gas kyang yig sgyur gzhung lugs dang brda sprod skor sogs kyi bslab gzhi bsgrigs shing / dar mdo mi rigs dge 'os ched sbyong slob gas rtsom yig gces bsdus dang / rgya bod yig sgyur gzhung lugs bsgrigs pa sogs kyis bod rgya skad gnyis slob gso'i bya gzhag la brjod las 'das pa'i phan 'bras thon mus su mchis/bod rgya skad gnyis slob gsor brten nas yig rmongs sel ba'i bya ba la'ang phan 'bras bzang po thob yod de/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi yig rmongs sel ba'i las ku'i srung bya las/ yig rmongs sel ba'i slob khrid byed skabs rgyal yongs gcig gyur gyi spyi skad la brten dgos shing / grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du mi rigs rang gi skad yig kyang slob khrid byed chog /sa gnas de las mi rigs spyi spyod kyi skad yig gis slob khrid byas na'ang chog ces blang bya bton pa ltar / dkar mdzes khul du rgya bod skad yig zung gis yig rmongs sel thabs byas pas/ 1995lo'i bar du khul yongs su lcags zam rdzong dang rgyal rong rdzong gnyis dang de min rdzong bcu gnyis kyi zhang krin nyi shu/ brgya cha'i 15 75gyi zhang krin khongs mi phal cher yig rmongs las thar/ khul yongs kyi yig rmongs pa je nyung du song yod do/ /mi rigs rang gi skad yig sbyong spyod spel 338

gsum bya rgyur mthong chen byas tshe/ rgya bod skad gnyis slob gso dang spyi tshogs su yig rmongs gtsang sel dang rig gnas khyab bdal btong ba/ 'gan babs slob gso bde blag tu 'grub pa bcas la nus pa ches cher thon pa ni bston med yin/gsum pa/ bod rgya skad gnyis slob gso'i gegs su gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen dang rjes ma'i 'phel phyogs la sman pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub thabs/gcig srid jus las bton pa'i blang byar go ba zab mo ma blangs pas bod rgya skad gnyis kyi slob gso ni lam bor ba'i mgron po lta bur gyur/skad gnyis slob gso'i lam lugs ni mi rigs mang 'dus rgyal khab kyi skad yig thad kyi tshul ldan lam lugs shig dang / skad yig bed spyod kyi khrims lugs kyang yin/ rang rgyal gyi skad gnyis jus don gyis rgyal nang mi rigs khag gi khe phan mtshon cing / mi rigs bar 'dra mnyam dang mthun sgril/ gcig gyur yin pa'i dngos yod bden don kyang mtshon/ rgyal nang mi rigs slob gso las skad gnyis slob gso zhes grangs nyung mi rigs gang zhig gi skad yig gzhir bzhag ste 'dzugs spel byas pa'i slob gso'i sgrig gzhi dang / grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad yig dang rgya'i skad yig zung du sbrel ba'i slob gso'i brgyud rim 339

la bya/ slob gso'i lam lugs 'di ni srol rgyun bkag rgya las thar nas deng rabs can gyi lam chen du bgrod thabs shig dang krung go'i khyad chos dang 'tshams la tshan rig dang yang mthun pa'i slob gso'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig kyang yin mod/ 'on kyang dkar mdzes khul gyi rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs khrod du bod rgya skad gnyis slob gso'i skor gyi jus don dril bsgrags byed mkhan med cing / yod kyang dngos thog bden 'tshol byed pa ni dkon pas/ mi skor zhig gis a ma las mi ngo mi shes/ thab ka las sa rgyus med pa'i tshul du mi 'dug ka med gyur/ yang mi skor zhig gis bod kyi skad yig gis 'dom gyis sar sor gyis mi chod cing rjes ma'i 'gro lam yang rgya chen med par brlams ste mthong chung dang dgos med kyi gdon sems rgyud du zhugs te rgya'i skad yig las mi shes pas/ so so'i rigs rus cho 'brang gang yang mi shes pa'i g.yu 'brug zol ma'i dbyibs ltar lus/nga tshos mi rigs 'dra mnyam dang skad yig 'dra mnyam yin pa'i srid jus kyi blang byar go ba zab mo yod par bya dgos te/ rtsa khrims las /mi rigs khag la rang nyid kyi skad yig bed spyod byed pa'i rang dbang yod/ ces gsungs pa 'dis mi rigs tshang ma 'dra mnyam dang mi rigs so so'i skad yig ni krung hwa mi rigs rig gnas kyi grub cha yin pa bcas mtshon cing / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi 'gan babs slob gso'i khrims yig las/ /slob grwas rgyal yongs gcig gyur gyi spyi skad khyab gdal byed dgos/ zhes pa 'dis/ rang rgyal deng rabs can gyi 'dzugs skrun las skad yig 'dzugs spel gyi mi rigs slob gso'i nyer mkho'i rgyu rkyen gsal por mtshon pa sogs kyi snying don ltar/ skad 340

gnyis slob gso'i las kur g.yo zol dang ngo lkog med par bsgrub na/ mi rigs skad yig las ku'i gal che'i rang bzhin dang yun ring gi ngo bor nges shes zab tu 'gro ba dang / mi rigs skad yig las ka dang mi rigs slob gso'i bya ba ni nga tshos rtsa ba'i lam phyogs la zhabs 'degs dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi don dam pa'i las kur zhabs zhu yin pa'i bsam blo'i langs phyogs brtan po zhig ci nas chags par bya dgos so/ /gnyis / skad gnyis slob gso'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs 'thus tshang med pas long bas mda' 'phangs pa lta bu'i gnas su lhung /gzhung lugs ni nyams len dngos zhugs las smin pa'i rig pa tshad ma ba yin dgos/ tshad ldan gyi rigs pa des lag len bya rgyu'i rgyab rten tshad ma dang /lam ston sgron me lta bu'i nus pa thon dgos/ dkar mdzes khul du skad gnyis slob gso'i dge rgan dang las byed pa mang po yod kyang / kho tshos phan tshun sbal bas nga sbom dang / sbrul gyis nga ring bsam pa'i dpe ltar du rang mthong 'gying gi dra rgyar tshud de phan tshun nyams myong brje res dang dpung rogs bya ba'i skal ba nam yang med cing de rnams kyi blo gros rtsal las thon pa'i tshad mar 'dzin chog pa'i gsung chos kyang nyin mo'i skar ma'i zla ru zad pas/ bod rgya skad gnyis slob gso'i sgrub thabs su yul lung so so dang dbang 'dzin pa so sos ci dran gang mos kyis las khral sgrub ched tsam du lus pas long bas mda' 'phangs pa lta bu gtad so med pa'i rnam pa zhig tu lus 'dug /bsam blo gu yangs su btang nas khron sdod sbal ba'i rang gzugs spangs te / bod rgya skad gnyis slob gsor dmigs pa'i bsam blo'i kun spyod dang /341

g.yo zol dang bral ba'i spyod pa bzung nas brtsad cing dpyad pa'i blo gros las smin pa'i rig pa tshad ldan gyi gzhung lugs shig gtan la phab nas/ mi rigs slob gso dang mi rigs skad yig slob khrid kyi 'brel ba/ mi rigs skad yig dang krung hwa mi rigs kyi spyi skad kyi 'brel ba/ bod rgya skad gnyis slob gso dang lo dgu'i lugs kyi slob gso khyab gdal gtong ba'i bar/ bod rgya skad gnyis slob gso dang mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba/krung hwa mi rigs thun mong du gra rgyas 'gro ba'i bar gyi 'brel ba/ skad gnyis slob gso dang mi rigs mthun sgril dang mi rigs 'dra mnyam bar gyi 'gal 'brel sogs gsal por shes rtogs su yong thabs re nas dmigs yul yod la 'char gzhi dang ldan pa'i skad gnyis slob gso'i ma lag zhig grub par bya dgos so / /gsum / skad gnyis bslab gzhi tshad ldan med bas lag ldum brag la 'dzegs pa lta bur gyur/bslab gzhi ni slob gso'i srog rtsa lta bu yin la/ dge slob bar gyi 'chad nyan gyi dgos par dmigs nas bsgrigs shing / slob ma'i blo dang 'tshams pa'i shes bya dang / slob ma'i nus pa 'don spel thub pa'i yon tan gong bu gcig tu bsgril nas blo gros gsar bu bar spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nus mthu dang mi'i rigs la zhabs 'degs byed thub pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal skyed sring byed thub dgos/nang don la ched las kyi rig pa dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos bsnan nas bslab gzhi'i nus pa mtshon thabs su re dgos/da lta'i bdag cag gi bod rgya skad gnyis bslab gzhi la bltas tshe/ rgya yig 342

las thad bsgyur byas pa sha stag yin pas rdo chag btsan sgrig gi tshul du snang ba dang —/ ma yig gi don gcig la 'gyur ma'i don du ma zhig du snang la/ mi gcig gi ming la mi du ma zhig tu snang ba lta bu sogs tha snyad kyi don thad sgyur thal ches pa sogs kyis brjod bya'i don la go ba yang dag par lon rgyur ltar zhog tshig gi brjod pa yang ra ma lug gi tshul du don gyis dben pa'i sog rdul bldad pa lta bu'i snang ba las ma 'das/ 'di lta bu yong rkyen yang gcig na rgya bod skad gnyis shes pa tsam gyis yig sgyur gyi las la gzhol khul byas pa'i mi shes nga rgyal can gyi mi khag gcig dang / dpar skrun dang dpe sgrig 'gan khur pa la'ang bslab gzhi rtsom sgrig byed pa'i nus pa med pa/ gnyis su dus rabs kyi 'phel phyogs dang dgos dbang la ma ltos par long bas long ba khrid de song ba'i tshul du bslab gzhi gang mang rtsom sgyur thub pa tsam gyis dus las yol ba'i gzhan gyi zas 'phro za ba ltar snang bas gnod pa las phan yon cis 'byung / gsum du spyi'i 'go 'dzin gyi sde khag nus ldan can med pas yul lung so sor gnas pa'i rtsom sgyur mkhan gyis rang snang gang shar gyis sgyur rtsom byas stabs/ ma yig don gyi mtshan nyid bsgyur nor byas yod par ma zad mtshan mtshon bar 'gal ba'i tshul du bsgyur ba'ang mang dag cig snang ba sogs kyis slob gso'i nus par gnod rkyen brjod las 'das pa zhig thebs so/ /nga tshos rgyal khab phyi nang gi slob gso rig pa dang / mi rigs gzhan pa'i skad gnyis slob gso'i skor gyi nyams myong dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la dper bltas kyis bod sa gnas gzhan dang dpung pa zung du sbrel nas/ skad gnyis slob gso'i chos nyid dang 'phel 'gyur la mngon rjes tshad ma blos legs 343

par brtag ste byis pa'i blor bstun cing / spyi tshogs la'ang spyod sgo che ba'i bslab gzhi legs sgrig byas nas skad gnyis slob gso'i rkang brtan po tshugs thabs bya rgyu ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin par shes dgos so/ /mi dmangs kyis blo 'khel zhing tang dang rgyal khab kyis yid ches pa'i 'go khrid pas nges par du mthong rgya chen po'i sgos/ bod sa gnas rang skyong gi khrims lugs ltar skad gnyis slob gsor khrid ston yang dag par bya rgyu las/ rang gis ma shes pas med par bzung ste/bod kyi skad yig ni zhib 'jug gi rin thang las bed spyod kyi dgos pa med ces smras na/ deng gi krung hwa mi rigs nga drug tu ma tshud pa'i ra ma lug gi ngang tshul 'dzin mkhan la mtshon na/ skad cha de yid rton byed chog kyang / ser shul dang gser rta sogs kyi grong gseb tu gnas pa'i bod mir mtshon na bgod bro ba'i gnas shig tu gyur pa ma yin nam/mdor na/ dkar mdzes khul du skad gnyis slob gso byed par dpon dmangs sems shugs gcig tu sgril cing / slob grwa dang spyi tshogs kyi nus pa chabs cig tu bton nas skad gnyis slob gso'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs rgyab brten tshad mar bzhag ste/ sa gnas rang gi gnas tshul dngos dang skad gnyis slob gso'i chos nyid la mthun pa'i slob gso'i sgrig gzhi dang / spyi tshogs kyi khor yug chags par byas nas mi shugs dang dngos shugs rgyas 'dzoms byung na skad gnyis slob gso'i bya gzhag la skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba ni gdon mi za'o / /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(1) deng rabs dkar mdzes/344
da thasgo'i

dus rabs gsar ba'i mi rigs slob gso rags tsam bshad pa/dgar dge 'od zer/mi yul shes bya chu gter yangs pa las/ /mi rigs slob gso'i 'dab brgya yongs bzhad de/ /mi lus 'dod yon zil dngar gyis bltams pa'i/ /mi yi bung ba rgan po myos pa'i glu/ /de yang 'dir/ bod mi rigs kyi slob gso zhes pa ni bod rigs mi dmangs la rang las gzhan pa'i skad yig cig u tshugs kyis slob tu 'jug rgyu kho nar go mi nyan pa ma zad/ de yang mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos ldan zhing dus rabs gsar ba'i spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i ched rtsal gang mang zhig sbyong ched rang nyid kyi brda sprod rig pa'am skad yig gi rmang gzhi legs po 'ding dgos pa de'o/ /de ltar phul byung tshan rtsal ched las sna tshogs la brten nas dus rabs gsar ba'i spyi tshogs kyi dge mtshan mngon ci thub bya dgos pa'i phyir gnad don kha shas gleng bar bya ba las/346

dang po/ dus rabs gsar ba'i mi rigs slob gso'i 'du shes rags tsam bshad pa/1 gces mthun mnyam las/ rang re'i mes rgyal ni mi rigs khag mang bo las grub pa'i khyim tshang chen po zhig yin par gzhigs na/ bod rigs gtsos mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig tsam ma zad tshan rig lag rtsal rnam mang 'dus pa'i las rigs sna tshogs thad/ phan tshun gces bkur dang mnyam spel legs skyong sogs byed dgos pa'i skor gang mang zhig rgyal srid spyi khyab khang dang sa gnas srid gzhung gi mi rigs khe dbang las ma bstan nam/ de yang / ji srid bskal par de srid du/ /snod bcud rten 'brel gsar ba ngom/ /zhes pa ltar/da lta 'dzam gling yongs la mtshon na dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i spyi 'gros dang mthun pa'i shes rig gsar ba brtson len byas dang byed bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir / nga tsho mes rgyal nang khul la mtshon na bod kyi skad yig ni gzhan gang las kyang tshan rig rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyi skad yig sna tshogs pa'i khrod du gnas bab mi dman pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar lags pas/ nga tshos kyang bod yul gyi kha skad mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa der nye sngon yul skad che shos gsum du 'bod pa de yang dus rabs gsar pa'i shes bya dag la 'jug bde ba'i phyir/ sngon thon mi rigs gang yin pa'i gces bkur 'og skad yig gzhan gyi the gtogs med par yul dbus sam/bod yul stod smad bar gsum tsam ma zad rgyal khab phyi nang sogs nas go thub pa'i yig skad dag ma zhig spyod dgos pa ni/ slob grwa chung 'bring dang dge thon 347

ched slob bcas kyi 'os babs yin pa'i phyir/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs rang nyin nas spyi tshogs thog bod yig gi spyod sgo'am dge mtshan la gang byung gis the gtogs mi yong ba bya rgyu de ni rtsa ba'i gnad don zhig tu gyur pa de'o/ /na gsar skrun mdun skyod/ de ltar bod mi rigs la gcig gyur gyi skad yig dag ma zhig yod bzhin du de las 'gros nyog la don dor 'dzor che ba'i gzhan skad 'chal ma 'chol la rten dgos pa'i nges pa med/ yin na'ang rang skad thun mong pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog rgyal khab phyi nang tshud pa'i 'dzam gling gi rig lam yangs por dpung 'jug byed dgos pa thos ci dgos/ mig sngar bod yul spyi la mtshon na thog mar bod mi rang nyid nas chos sde khag brgyud de yong pa'i bod kyi srol rgyun slob gnyer dang / dang thog spyi tshogs sam dmangs khrod nas byung ba'i las rigs lag rtsal sna tshogs kyi slob gnyer dag 'gran rtsod kyi tshul du gnas yod/ de yang nang log tu kong tse mkhan po'i ring nas srol rgyun gyi gzhung dang lag len gyi rig pa sbrags te da gzod nges pa don gyi slob gso'i thabs lam byung ba ltar/ bod yul 'dir phyogs kun nas sngar yod bcu phrag rig pa'i srol rgyun gyi spangs ljongs yangs por sngon thon rgyal khab dang mi rigs gang yod kyi phul byung shes rig gi rtsi thog gsar pa'i bcud kyis yongs su spras te rnam pa gsar ba'i bod kyi slob gso zhig 'don spel byed dgos pa de'o/ /3 dngos phan legs skyong / spyir btang shes rig slob gso ni yig thog gi slob gnyer kho na tsam ma yin te/ ji skad du rig pa dpe thog lus pas dgos pa chung zhes bshad pa ma yin nam/ des na rang nyid la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skad yig gi yon tan nges can zhig yod phyin/ da gzod yul dus 348

dang mi rigs kyi las bab sogs la phyogs yongs nas mkho zhing khe phan che ba'i ched las lag rtsal byang tshad ldan pa zhig slob rgyu ni/ spyi tshogs mdun skyod dang mi dmangs 'byor phyug ldan par byed pa'i rtsa gnad cig yin/ yin na'ang tang gi mi rigs srid jus la go ba log nas mi rigs kyi shes rig dang ched las lag rtsaladagos med du 'dzin pa dang / mi rigs ga ge mo'i rang gshis ni rjes lus su 'dod pa/ mi rigs kyi las don mtha' dag 'khrab ston rdzig po'i rnam par zad pa sogs kyis gong gsal rtsa gnad don du smin long med par sgyur ba'i rul slad kyi ngo bo de rigs mtha' dag gtsang sel sgos/ don dngos thog mi rigs dang spyi tshogs kyi re 'dod skong ched yul babs dang bstun pa'i shes rig gi gzhi legs po zhig 'ding dgos pa de'o/ /gnyis pa/ dus rabs gsar ba'i mi rigs slob gso'i mthun rkyen rags tsam bshad pa/1 slob gso rnam dag da lta rgyal yongs kyi mi rigs gang yin yang thun mong spyi khyab kyi slob gso'i gzhi cung brtan zhing go rim ldan pa zhig chags yod na'ang —/ de tsam gyi gzhir ched las tshan rtsal rig pa'i slob gso dpyis phyin pa zhig ma byung bar spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i las go mi 'pher la/ de bas kyang dpal 'byor rtsa ba yin pa'i deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun gyi dgos pa ga la 'grub/spyir slob gso ni mi yi rang gshis legs bcos byed thabs nyag gcig yin pas rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi khe phan dang mthun pa'i bslab bya gzhir gzung nas/mi sems 'dre ru sprul ba'i log shes sna tshogs sel zhing nang sems rgyud dang phyi 349

kun spyod sogs sbyang 'bras kyi dgos pa nyid du smin cing grub pa dang / shes bya dri ma med pa'i gzhung lugs ma lus par nges shing lag len la byang ba sogs dang 'brel/ dus rabs gsar ba'i mi rigs chos nyid ldan pa zhig dgos/ de yang mdor na 'jig rten gyi spang blang gi rnam gzhag ma 'chug pa'i sgo nas mi lus la bogs bzang bo lon par bya ba bcas kyi dgos pa las ldog na/ ma nyes nyes pa ko ba rwa las gyong / /zer ba las mi 'ong ngo / /2 dge rgan rnam dag mig sngar rang rgyal gyi gnas tshul spyi dang khyad par mi rigs grangs nyung sa khul la mtshon na slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum dang / de min ched las lag rtsal sde khag sogs kyi ched las rig pa'i mkhan po ru 'bod pa skor zhig ni don las ming che ba dang ming las kyang nga rgyal che ba de rigs kyi dbang gis/ gdul bya de dang de yi gnyen por 'gro ba nyin skar gyi zla ru song zhing rjes 'jug las 'dzin pa dag khron pa'i sbal ba'i chos nyid las ma 'das so / /spyir btang dge rgan rnam dag zhig yin phyin gdul bya dang 'dul byed/dgos pa'am dmigs 'dun bcas mi 'dra ba ji ltar yang nad sman sprod mkhas pa'i lha rje lta bu yin dgos pa gzhir bcas/ de la yang / bshes gnyen dul zhi nye bar zhi/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson 'grus ldan/ /de nyid rab rtogs lung gis phyug /brtse ldan smra mkhas skyo ba spangs/ /zhes rab byung na mtshan nyid bcu dang ldan pa dang / tha na yang bslab bya'i gzhung nges shing spyod mkhas pa dang / mi rigs dang gshis ka mi 'dra ba su yin yang rjes su 'dzin nus pa zhig dgos la/mdor na rang nyid gzhan gyi dpe ru ston 'os pa'i dgos pa las ldog na/ mdzes pa'i chu zla don gyis stongs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /350

3 'go khrid rnam dag rang re'i mes rgyal 'di nyid thun mong ma yin pa'ichab srid kyi lta ba la brten nas mi rigs mang po 'dus pa'i khyim tshang chen pozhig yin/ de la grong khyer nas sa gnas bar bgo skal mi 'dra ba'i slob grwa dang sde khag gang yin yang de dag rgyal pham gyi reg las byed pa yin mod/ der brten don 'dir khrims lugs bden don gyi spyod pa btsun pa dang / srid 'byor rig gsum gyi lta ba yangs pa/ rgyal dmangs gnyis phan gyi khe dbang mtshon pa bcas dgos pa ma zad/ khyad par dus kyi 'gros la mkhas shing blo rig gi dpal dang ldan la yar rgyas kyi gdengs mtho ba zhig dgos pa las/nam rgyun rang nyid 'jig rten byed por 'gran pa'i rloms sems dang bcas g.yo sgyu'i gar stabs phyogs med ngom pa de rigs ni/ zab yangs chu gter ba tshwas snyogs pa dang gnyis su ma mchis so/ /gsum pa/ dus rabs gsar ba'i mi rigs slob gso'i dgos pa rags tsam bshad pa/1 las rigs lag rtsal dar spel byed dgos pa/ de yang dus rabs gsar pa'i skabs 'dir mi rigs kyi slob gso la mtshon na/ spyir btang gi slob gso ste yi ge shes su 'jug pa de'i dma' rim spyi tshogs sam dmangs khrod kyi 'du shes phal shos shig tu gyur pa yin gshis de tsam gyis mi yong / da lta'i spyi tshogs deng rabs can dang mi rabs shes yon can gyi dgos mkho ltar mi yi gshis ka dang 'tsho ba nus rtsal sogs gang thad nas sngar las lhag pa'i yar rgyas dang byang tshad ldan pa'i slob gso'i rnam pa gsar pa zhig la brten nas/351

dus dang yul babs kyi phul byung mi sna gsar pa zhig 'tshar longs yong du 'jug dgos pa de yin/ don 'dir bod yul spyi dang khyad par rong 'brog dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'am spyi tshogs kyi dgos pa ltar/ sa gnas mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas dang lag rtsal dar rgyas yong bar bya rgyu ni skabs 'di'i gnad don gtso bo zhig yin/ der brten/ mig snga'i zhing phyugs thon 'bras kyi rnam pa mi snyom pa'i gnad don la gzhigs te mi rigs rang nyid kyi srol rgyun shes rig gam ched las lag rtsal sna tshogs kyi slob gso la brten na da gzod deng gi zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi re 'dun skong thub par nges/ spyir bod mi rigs la mtshon na lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i sngon rol nas da lta'i bar ngal rtsol mi dmangs spyi dang rim byon mkhas mang rnams kyi blo gros dang lag len las byung ba'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i ched rtsal las rigs gzhan dring 'jog mi dgos pa zhig yod par ma zad / de yang da lta'i spyi tshogs su mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba yar rgyas la mi phan pa zhig ga la yin/ dper na mdzes shing brjid nyams ldan pa'i 'dzugs skrun dang / zhim mngar ro bcud 'dzom pa'i zas rigs / spus legs dro 'jam yangs pa'i gon pa sogs rang byung snod bcud sdebs lugs kyi bzo rtsal sna tshogs dang / dngos po'i byed nus 'don pa dang dus kyi 'byung 'gyur rtogs pa sogs rten 'brel chos nyid rig pa'i tshan rtsal sna tshogs / phyugs zhing thon rdzas spel ba sogs/ dpal 'byor tshong las ched gnyer gyi rig pa/ skyes dngos gter rdzas dang rig rtsal khyim chas sogs snod bcud kyi skor/ khyad par tshan rig gi gzhung lugs su nges pa'i snod bcud rten 'tsho'i rnam gzhag ma lus pa/ mdo sngags ming gis bsdus pa'i brjod bya la brten 352

nas mi tshe'i 'dun ma don du smin cing grol bar byed pa'i thabs dam pa bcas thun mong ma yin pa'i ched las tshan rtsal gyi rig pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod bzhin du sa yi rdo len pa la rum gyi gser stor na phan pa las ldog pa'i phyir/gong gsal ched gnyer las rigs kyi slob gso ming don mtshungs pa zhig dar spel dang legs sgrub byed dgos pa ni/ shin tu do gal che ba'o/ /2 bod kyi rig par gsar shugs snon dgos/ de yang / bod 'dir mtshon na gna' snga mo'i dus su 'dzam gling gi rig gnas kyi lte ba yin pa'i 'phags yul nas dbu drangs te nang bstan brgyud bsam blo chab srid dang /khrims lugs 'tsho ba/ dpal 'byor mnga' thang sogs rang yul gyi 'gro ba mi'i bslab gzhung legs po zhig byung yod par ma zad/ gzhi de la lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi rig pas brjod bya dang rjod byed gnyis kyi sgo nas rnam par spud pa dang bcas da lta'i bod rig pa zhes 'dzam gling mkhas mang gi dpyad gzhir 'dzin cing yod pa 'di byung / de bzhin rig pa chen po bcu phrag gcig las grub pa'i gzhung 'dir dus dbang gsar pa'i dgos mkho la phan khe ches pa'i dngos yod kyi las rigs dang lag rtsal gang mang zhig 'dus yod par rten/ da skabs rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan dang gzhan gyi shes rig pa mang po gcig rjes gnyis 'thud kyi sgo nas bod kyi yul gru gang sar lta skor gyi rnam pas mi rigs 'di yi shes rig gi dge mtshan bsdu gsog ci thub byas dang byed bzhin yod pa mngon gsal ltar/ nga tsho bod rigs phyi rabs pa dag rang nyid nas kyang spobs pa chen pos nus rtsal yod dgu bton te rgyal nang gi skad yig kho na'i phyogs su mi lhung bar rang gi srol 353

rgyun bcu phrag rig gnas kyi gser ldan yangs por rgyal spyi'i sngon thon shes rig gsar ba'i 'dab brgya kun nas bzhad du 'jug dgos pa gnad che bar 'dug /spyir gangs ri'i ljongs kyi mi rigs 'dir gong gsal ltar gna' snga mo nas bzung brda dang skad yig rnam par dag pa zhig ste/ bkol bde la don 'dus shing go sla ba bcas kyi dge mtshan dang ldan pa zhig yod gshis/ 'dzam gling thog skad dang yig rigs mi 'dra ba'i shes bya gang yang rung sgra don ji bzhin thon thub pa'i phyir/ khyad du 'phags pa'i skad yig 'di la brten nas skabs su babs pa'i sngon thon tshan rig gi snying bcud mtha' dag rang re'i gtsug lag gan mdzod chen mo'i rgyan du legs par spud de/ ma 'ongs par 'dzam gling tsam ma zad 'jig rten yongs na'ang 'gran du med pa'i gangs ljongs bod kyi rig pa zhes pa zhig 'dzugs skrun gyi slad du nam yang dpung 'jug byed dgos pa ni/rang re'i yab mes dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gzo phyir 'os su babs 'dug pa de ltar lags/mdor na/ dus rabs gsar ba'i bod kyi slob gso ni tang gi lo 'khor brgyad cu'i sdom tshig las bstan pa ltar rgya chen mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan mtshon par byed dgos pa de yin gshis/ mi rigs gang zhig rang gi shes rig dang 'brel te tshan rig dar spel sgos bde skyid ldan pa'i spyi tshogs gsar ba zhig don du gnyer dgos pa ma zad/ der brten ma 'ongs par 'dzam gling yongs kyi mi rnams rang mos kyi khe dbang la spyod pa'i rdzogs ldan gyi bskal ba zhig mngon du 'gyur bar 'bad brtson lhod med byed dgos pa lags so/ /smras pa/ rang nyid shes rig smra ba'i gral mtha' yang /354

rang rigs slob gso'i las la brnag ches pas/ /rang gzhan kun la bsams shing dpyad pa'i gtam/ /rang tshod ma zin rgan po'i ngag las thal /gang mang rig pa la 'jug nas/ /gang phan don du gnyer pa'i slad/ /gang dran brjod pa'i zhu tshig 'di/ /gang gi bka' drin gzo phyir ro/ /

si khron bod khul la 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs yin byed pa'i bsam gzhigs rags tsam brjod pa/bkra shes don grub/tang gi skabs bcu drug pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thog tu krung dbyang gi spyi khyab hru'u ci hu'u cin tha'o lags kyis rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gnang dgos pa'i re 'dod bton yod/ da lor tang gi skabs bcu drug pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs bzhi pa'i thog tu spyi tshogs ring lugs 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi nus stobs je cher gtong dgos pa'i bya gzhag ni/ tang gi srid 'dzin nus pa 'dzugs skrun gyi las 'gan gtso bo zhig yin par nan tan gyis gsungs yod pa red/spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed pa ni/tang gi krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs rlabs chen gyi bya gzhag dang rgyal khab yun ring bde 'god kyi tshad mtho'i thog nas gal 'gang chen po'i thabs jus gtan la phab pa red/ gnad don de ni rig pa'i gzhung lugs thog nas bshad na gsar pa gsar rkyang zhig yin la/ spyi tshogs lag len thog nas bshad na yang gal che ba'i gnad don zhig red/356

bod rigs sa khul ni rang byung khams dang thon skyed/ dpal 'byor rig gnas bcas rgya yul dang mi rigs gzhan dag gi sa khul dang mi 'dra bas/'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun ji ltar byed rgyu'i thad du bod rigs sa khul gyi tang u dang srid gzhung / rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi las byed pa/ spyi tshogs lag bstar ba/ rig gnas mkhas pa la sogs pas blo bsdus dge 'tshol gnang nas bod rigs sa khul gyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun zhing kha lo bsgyur thub pa dang / sa gnas khyad chos ldan pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'don dgos/phran rang la si khron zhing chen bod rigs sa khul gyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu'i thad du bsam gzhigs cung zad 'dug pas/ rtsom yig nyung nyung zhig bris nas klog pa po rnams la 'bul rgyu yin/ gzhan yang rtsom yig nyung nyung 'dis rang re'i zhing chen bod rigs sa khul 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun la phan thog yod pa'i re ba 'chang yod/dang po/ si khron bod rigs sa khul du 'cham mthun sbyi tshogs 'dzugs sgrun byed rgyu ni/ zhing chen yongs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'jugs skrun gyi cha shas shig red/tang krung dbyang gis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul gnang zhing / de ni rgyal khab yongs su 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa de yin zhing / sa khul kha shas dang mi rigs kha shas la 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu tsam zer ba ma yin/ der rigs 'ded byas na 'cham mthun spyi tshogs rgyal khab yongs su 'grub byung na ma gtogs/ sa khul so sor 'grub rgyu tsam la zer ba min /357

bod rigs sa khul ni bod rang skyong ljongs dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sa khul mang che ba/ si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul dang rnga ba bod rigs cha'ang rigs rang skyong khul/ mu li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong —/ kun su'u zhing chen kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul dang / dpa' rus bod rigs rang skyong rdzong / yun nan bde chen (sham bha la)bod rigs rang skyong khul bcas yin/ mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ bod rigs sa khul gyi sa khyon sdom grangs ni spyi le gru bzhi ma sa ya gnyis dang 'bum bzhi lhag yod pas/rang rgyal gyi bzhi cha'i gcig gi sa khyon zin yod pa dang / mi 'bor bye ba gcig tsam yod/ bod rigs sa khul 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun ni rgyal khab yongs su 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i nang gi gal che ba'i cha shas shig tu chags yod pa red/ nga tsho si khron bod rigs sa khul ni si khron zhing chen gyi gnyis cha gcig gi sa khyon zin yod pa dang / mi grangs sa ya gnyis yod pa'i sa khul zhig yin pas/ si khron zhing chen 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun ni bod rigs sa khul gyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang kha bral mi thub pa'i gnas tshul dngos gnas chags yod pa red/gnyis pa/ bod rigs sa khul gyi srid gzhung dang mang tshogs kyis 'cham mthun sbyi tshogs 'dzugs rgyan gyi gnad don gal chen yin pa'i shes rtogs mtho ru gtong dgos/thog mar spyi tshogs ring lugs 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu de ni tang dang srid gzhung gi thabs jus chen mo yin pa blo la 'dzin dgos/gnyis par tang gis srid 'jin nus stobs kyi chu tshad mthon por ngos 'dzin 358

byed dgos/ gsum par 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi ngo bo nges par du shes rtogs byed dgos/krung gung krung dbyang gis 'tshogs pa'i zhing chen dang pu'u rim pa'i 'go khrid las byed pa gtso bo zhugs pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi nus stobs mtho ru gtong ba'i dpyad gleng 'dzin grwa'i thog spyi khyab hru'u ci hu'u cin tha'o yis nga tshos 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs ni dmangs gtso dang khrims skyong dang gzhung drang drang ldan/ kha dan tshig gnas dang gces skyong/ gson nyams ldan pa / bde 'dzugs sgrig yod/ mi dang rang byung khams 'cham mthun mnyam gnas bcas dgos par 'don yod pa red/ de ni da lta'i rim pa'i nang spyi tshogs ring lugs dang 'cham mthun/ spyi tshogs kyi don spyi dang khyab che pa'i rang bzhin yin / 'cham mthun spyi tshogs ni spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba'i 'cham mthun dang gang zag dang rang byung khams kyi bar 'cham mthun yod pa de red/ yang na dmangs gtso dang khrims skyong gcig gyur/ tshan rig dang mi tshul gcig gyur/ gang zag dang rang byung khams gcig gyur bcas mtshon yod/ der brten chab srid thad gal che ba'i srid jus yin pa dang / rig pa'i gzhung lugs thad gal che ba'i zhib 'jug bya gzhi yin pa dang / lag bstar thad tang gi srid 'dzin nus stobs mtshon pa'i thabs jus cig kyang red/bod rigs sa khul gyi srid gzhung dang mang tshogs kyis tang dang srid gzhung gi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun la mthong chen dang shes rtogs yang dag pa byed dgos shing / bod rigs sa khul ni mi rigs gzhan dag gi sa 359

khul dang mi 'dra ba'i gnas tshul la zhib 'jug gting zab byed dgos pa dang /bod rigs sa khul gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi byed thabs 'tshol dgos/gsum pa/ 'cham mthun spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo dang si khron bod rigs sa khul kyi dngos yod gnas tshul/'cham mthun spyi tshogs dang / dmangs gtso dang khrims skyong ni nga tsho'i krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i chab srid kyi sgrig gzhi dang —/ de ni nga tshos 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i chab srid kyi 'os 'gan zhig kyang yin/ gzhung drang drang ldan ni nga tshos 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi kun spyod kyi khyad rtags red/ kun spyod bzang po'i spyi tshogs ni gzhung drang drang ldan yod pa'i spyi tshogs shig red/ kha dan tshig gnas dang gces skyong ni nga tsho'i rgyal khab spyi tshogs nang du mig snga'i dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun nas 'don pa red/ mig snga'i gnas tshul ni spyi tshogs nang kha dan tshig gnas kyi spyi mi nyung du 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / mi dang mi phan tshun thugs khur dang gces skyong mang po med pa dang / ga sa gang du'ang rgyu dngul skyabs bkur ring lugs dar khyab che ba dang dngos rdzas rdzun ma tshong rgyag dang dngul rtsa kha bslus rgyag pa la sogs pa'i kha dan tshig gnas med pa'i bya spyod yod pa de ltar yin/ mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba dza drag che la/ spyi tshogs kyi mi la kun spyod bzang po dar khyab gtong dgos la/ gson nyams ldan pa ni spyi tshogs gson shugs dang 'phel shugs yod pa/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor / rig gnas/ spyi tshogs kyi gang ci'i thad du bya las 'phel rgyas ldan pa'i 360

rnam pa mngon yod pa de 'dra'i spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa red/bde 'jags sgrig yod ni spyi tshogs zing 'tshub med pa'i bde 'jags dang lam lugs yod pa'i spyi tshogs la ston gnang ba red/ mi dang rang byung khams 'cham mthun mnyam gnas ni da lta'i 'jig rten thog dar srol gyi 'gro phyogs shig red/sngon chad mi'i rigs kyis mi dang rang byung khams 'cham mthun mnyam gnas byed dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin med pas rang byung khams 'dul bar byas nas nags tshal 'breg bcad bzo ba dang btsog chu dwangs chu'i nang du gtong ba/mkha' rlung sbag btsog bzo ba/ rang byung khams kyis mi la 'khon lan slog pa/sa zhing bye thang du 'gyur ba/ chu log gi god chag byung ba/ rang byung gnod 'tshe nyin re nas nyin rer je mang byung bzhin yod/ sngon chad kyi bya spyod de tsho bkag dgos par brten nags tshal srung skyob dang btsog chu dwangs gtsang /nam mkha' dwangs gsal byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul gnang yod pa red/si khron bod rigs sa khul ni mtsho bod mtho sgang gi shar lho'i sne mor khel zhing mtsho bod mtho sgang nas si khron gshongs sa'i bar mtshams kyi sa khul yin la / rgya mtsho'i ngos nas brtsis pa'i mtho tshad cha snyom byas na smi 3500yan chad zin yod/ sa dbyibs thad ri rgyud dang mtho sgang bde thang / ri mtho grog rong rigs gsum du dbye chog gnam gshis ni drod tshad dma' zhing dgun dus ring ba/ kha ba dang ba mo mang la char 'bab grangs nyung ba/ nyi 'od tsha ba phog pa/rlung khams chen mo 'khor 'thud byed pa'i nyin rdu'i rgya mtsho dang zhi bde rgya mtsho'i shar lho'i dus tshigs rlung khams thug par 'khel ba dang sbrags/ mtho sgang rang nyid kyi ma lag kyang chags pa red/361

mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ thang che sa ni sa mthon po dang gnam gshis grang ba/ gso rlung nyung ba/ zhing las sgrub rgyu dka' bas/ mi mang por 'tsho ba'i bka' ngal zhe drag 'dug /gnam gshis dro grang snyoms po dang gso rlung ji tsam mang pa'i sa khul la yang lung pa rkyang rkyang las thang chen po mi 'dug /mi mang po gso thub dka' bar ma zad/ gzhung lam 'dzugs kyang dka' bas/gzhung lam dang 'grim 'grul bde mo med pas/ bzo grwa chen mo dang khe las chen mo 'dzugs skrun gyi cha rkyen yang mi 'dug /bod rigs sa khul la mi grangs mang po med pas/ dngos rdzas tshong yul chung zhing mi rnams las kur zhugs sa dka' mo 'dug /de ltar yin pas mi dmangs myur mgyogs gis phyug por 'gyur ba'i cha rkyen yang mang po mi 'dug /de ni deng rabs si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi dngos yod gnas tshul dang cha rkyen zhan pa'i gnas bab red/bya ba thams cad la cha rkyen zhan pa'i gnas bab ngan pa yod par ma zad bzang po yang yod/ da sngon rgyun du bshad rgyu ni si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi cha rkyen gnas bab ngan pa red zer mod/ 'on kyang si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi rkyen bzang ga re 'dug zer na/ gcig ni chu bo gtsang po mang po 'dug pas/chu glog sa tshugs 'dzugs bskrun gyi cha rkyen bzang bo 'dug gnyis ni mdzes sdug ldan pa'i ljongs skor sa cha mang zhing / dper na yid dbang 'phrog pa'i ri lung mtshe'u 'bab chu rtswa thang nags tshal la sogs pa mang po 'dug /mkha' dbyings ha cang dwangs gsal dang mkha' rlung gtsang zhing bsil ba/ khyad chos ldan pa'i bod kyi rig gnas dang gshis srol ni phyi rgyal ba dang rgya rigs bcas la yid 'phrog pa'i nus pa chen po 'dug /cha rkyen bzang bo de dag gis si khron 362

bod rigs sa khul gyi srid gzhung dang mi dmangs kyi dpal 'byor la phan thog ha cang chen po 'dug /si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi cha rkyen bzang po dang cha rkyen ngan pa da dung mang po 'dug /'dir tshang ma bshad mi thub pas/ dper brjod gnyis gsum yod na don dag gsal bshad byed thub pa yin/ bod rigs sa khul gyi srid gzhung dang mi dmangs kyis rang re'i sa khul gyi cha rkyen bzang bo dang cha rkyen ngan pa ga re 'dug pa la zhib 'jug gting zab byas na 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun lag bstar nang cha rkyen bzang po 'don spel dang dpal 'byor dang rig gnas dar spel btang nas mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba je legs su gtong thub pa yin/bzhi ba/ 'cham mthun sbyi tshogs 'dzugs spun lag bstar nang du gnad don gsum mthong chen byed dgos/1 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang bde 'jags gnad don bar gyi 'brel ba/spyi tshogs bde 'jags ni 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun lag bstar byed pa'i gal che ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags la gnod rkyen mi 'dra ba mang po yod la/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor rig gnas bcas kyi cha nas spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi gnod rkyen ldan pa yin/ si khron bod rigs sa khul mig snga'i gnas tshul la bltas na/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags la gnod rkyen phog pa'i rkyen gtso che ba ni chab srid thadad gnas yod/ gnod rkyen de mi mngon par bsdad yod/ thad kur bshad na bod rigs sa khul 'di 363

rgyal khab dang kha bral byed mkhan bod rang btsan pa zer ba nyung shas 'dugade min rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs thog mi kha shas kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi krung go la mi dga' ba dang ngo rgol byed kyin yod/ kho tshos yang na krung go'i gung khran tang srid stegs nas lhung ba'i rmi lam dran bzhin 'dug yang na krung go stobs ldan rgyal khab tu 'gro ba'i gom pa la bkag 'gog byed snyam 'dug yang na krung go'i tha'e wan sa khul dang bod rigs sa khul/ zhin cang yu gur rigs rang skyong ljongs / nang sog rang skyong ljongs bcas krung go'i sa khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i bya ngan spel bzhin yod pa dang / rgyu rkyen de tshos bod rigs sa khul gyi spyi tshogs bde 'jags la gnod 'tshe mi mngon par gnas yod/ bod rigs sa khul gyi tang u dang srid gzhung / ser skya mi dmangs kyis spyi tshogs bde 'jags la mthong chen byed dgos pa dang / mi rigs mthun sgril yag po byed dgos / spyi tshogs bde 'jags yod na dpal 'byor dang slob gso/ rig gnas gang ci'i thad 'phel rgyas kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yag po yod la/ bod rigs sa khul gyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs dang rang rgyal gyi sa khul gzhan dag gi mi dmangs rnams phan tshun phyar ba grung 'degs byas na/ bod rigs sa khul gyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi rlabs chen gyi bya gzhag nges par du dngos su 'grub thub pa yin/2 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang nyams zhan spyi tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba/phyi rol yul dang bstun nas gnad don la bltas na/ bod rigs sa khul gyi rang byung khams dang gnam gshis yag po mi 'dug /zhing las thon skyed dang 364

phyugs las thon skyed kyi cha rkyen legs po med/ sa cha mang che bar grong khyer chen mo 'dzugs pa'i cha rkyen mi ldan/ nga tsho si khron bod rigs sa khul du grong khyer chen mo 'dzugs pa'i cha rkyen ldan pa'i sa cha gcig kyang mi 'dug bod rigs sa khul gyi ri bo mthon po'i sa rgyus su lcags lam 'dzugs dka' ba dang spus tshad yag shos kyi gzhung lam 'dzugs pa yang dka' ngal che/ de ltar yin na mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba phyug po dang phun sum tshogs pa myur du bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen nyung zhing / mi dmangs mang che ba'i 'tsho ba'i chu tshad dma'/ 2005lor si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi bod rigs zhing pa dang 'brog par lo de'i nang mi re'i lag dngul yong 'bab cha snyoms rtsis na chig stong nyis brgya yas mas yin/si khron zhing chen rgya yul sa khul gyi zhing pa tshor lo de'i nang mi rer lag dngul yong 'bab cha snyom rtsis na nyis stong drug brgya lhag tsam 'dug grong khyer pe cin dang hrang ha'e/ kong tung zhing chen/ kre cang zhing chen/ cang su'u zhing chen la sogs pa rgya mtsho'i 'gram rgyud sa khul gyi zhing pa tshor lo de'i nang mi rer lag dngul yong 'bab cha snyoms rtsis na bzhi stong drug brgya lhag tsam 'dug sa cha gzhan dag gi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas spyi tshogs gang ci'i thad bsdur na/bod rigs sa khul ha cang rjes lus shig red/ mi dmangs kyis 'tsho ba rol ba la yang mi 'dang ba chen po 'dug /zhing chen las khungs kha shas dang dkar mdzes khul dang rnga ba khul gyi srid gzhung bcas kyis mnyam du zhing pa dang 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba la brtag dpyad gting zab byas pa'i dngos yod gnas tshul ni/ si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi zhing 'brog mang tshogs brgya cha'i bzhi bcu'i mi rnams cha snyoms byas na lo gcig nang mi rer lag dngul yong 365

'bab drug brgya lhag tsam ma gtogs med/ phyug po dang dbul po la khyad par chen po yod na 'cham mthun spyi tshogs su rtsi rgyu med/ dbul po mang tshogs kyi spyi tshogs rgyu nor bgo gsha' rgyag pa'i nang gyong rag pa dang / rgyal khab gcig gi mi dmangs yin na spyi tshogs rgyu nor bgo gsha'i gnad la gzhung drang byed dgos/da lta'i gnas tshul ni rang rgyal da dung phyug po ma yin pas/ rgyu nor gyi bgo gsha' 'dra mnyam byed pa'i cha rkyen mi 'dug /rgyal khab dang zhing chen gyi nor srid bgo gsha' si khron bod rigs sa khul la gsog tshad byas nas je mang du btang yod/si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi dngos yod gnas tshul ni zhing pa dang 'brog pa mi nyung ba zhig da dung ha cang dbul po yin la/ 'di si khron bod rigs sa khul 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun la cha rkyen ngan pa zhig red/ dbul po'i mi mang bas nyams zhan spyi tshogs chags pa red/ nyams zhan spyi tshogs ni dpal 'byor thog dka' ngal yod pa dang shes rig yon tan med pa/ bya spyod nag nyes can mang du byung yul zhig yin/ der brten bod rigs sa khul gyi tang u dang srid gzhung gis mthong chen byed dgos/ dbul po chags pa'i rgyu rkyen la brtag dpyad byed pa dang dbul ba sel ba'i thabs shes yag po 'tshol dgos / spyir btang nas bshad na mi phal che bas mi phyug po tshor mthong chen byed pa'i lugs srol yod pa las/ mi dbul po rnams dang nyams zhan spyi tshogs snang med du 'jog bzhin yod/ don dag de si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi tang u dang srid gzhung gis mthong chen ma byas na si khron bod rigs sa khul la 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun mngon du 'grub thub pa ma red/366

3 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang bod kyi rig gnas bar gyi 'brel ba/krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu de krung go'i rgya mi rigs kyi deng rabs can gyi rig gnas rmang gzhir brten nas lag bstar byed rgyu red/ bod rigs sa khul du/rgya mi rigs kyi deng rabs can gyi rig gnas dang bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas gnyis mnyam du gnas yod/ rgya mi rigs kyi deng rabs can gyi rig gnas ni rgya mi rigs kyi srol rgyun gyi rig gnas dang mar khe si ring lugs kyi chab srid rig gnas/ nub phyogs deng rabs can gyi mang tshogs can du 'gyur ba'i rig gnas mnyam du bsres pa'i rig gnas shig red/ rgya mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas ni ru'u lugs rig pa dang nang pa chos lugs/ ta'o ca'o chos lugs gsum mnyam bsres kyi rig gnas shig red/ chab srid thog tu mar khe si ring lugs kyi 'gro phyogs gtso bo yin pa dang / ru'u lugs rig pas kyang nus pa 'don spel byed bzhin yod/ mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i thog tu nub phyogs kyi deng rabs can gyi rig gnas dang ru'u lugs rig pa/ nang pa chos lugs/ta'o ca'o chos lugs bcas kyi shugs rkyen thebs yod/ thon skyed dang tshan rig lag rtsal thad du nub phyogs kyi deng rabs can gyi rig gnas kyis gtso khrid byas yod/ de ni rgya mi rigs kyi rig gnas dngos yod gnas tshul red/nga tsho bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas ni nang pa chos lugs gtso bo yin / si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi gnas tshul la bltas na/ rgya mi rigs kyi deng rabs can gyi rig gnas ni grong khyer gyi bod rigs las byed pa dang /367

bod rigs bzo pa/ bod rigs sa khul du las ka byed mkhan dang 'tsho ba gnas yod pa'i rgya che rgya mi'i nang du 'don spel gtso bo byed bzhin yod/ grong khyer gyi rgya bod mi rigs kyi nang du deng rabs can gyi rig gnas dang srol rgyun gyi rig gnas mnyam bsres byas nas gnas yod/ rgya che ba'i bod rigs zhing 'brog sa khul du srol rgyun rig gnas 'don spel gtso bo byas yod/'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu'i gtso bo ni 'cham mthun rig gnas 'dzugs skrun byed dgos/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul skabs su/ bod kyi rig gnas gtso bo nang pa chos lugs rtsa med btang ba'i bya ba mang po byas myong / rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i rjes 'bras ni thon skyed kyi chos nyid dang 'gal bar mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba nyin re las nyin rer dbul por 'gro ba de red/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i thog tang krung dbyang gis rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i bya ba ngan par zing bcos yo bsrang byas yod pa red/ yin na'ang rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gul gyi shugs rkyen ngan pas mi rnams kyi bsam blo da dung gtsang ma bzos med/ mi kha shas kyis bod mi rigs kyi nang pa'i chos lugs ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rig gnas dang thon skyed nus pa 'don spel byed rgyur bkas bkod kyi rig gnas yin zer/ yang mi nyung shas zhig gis bod mi rigs kyi nang pa'i chos lugs ni bod sa khul rgyal khab las kha bral byed pa'i rig gnas tsam zhig yin par 'dod/ bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas gtso bor yongs su khas mi len par byed pa red/ de ltar byas na mar khe si ring lugs kyi lta tshul ltar na phyogs re ba'i rang bzhin ldan pa red/368

lo ngo stong phrag gcig lhag gi sngon du nang pa chos lugs bod sa khul du dar spel byas pa nas bzung / bod mi rigs kyis mtha' mtshams dang nye ba'i mi rigs gzhan dag la 'phrog bcom dang dmag 'khrug rim bzhin je nyung dang rtsa med du song ba red/ mi rigs bar gyi zhi bde dang mthun sgril la byas rjes chen po 'bul yod pa dang / mtsho bod mtho sgang ni e she ya gling chen gyi gnam gshis sprin pa'i 'byung khungs dang chu bo'i thon khungs gtso bo'i sa khul yin/ skye dngos gnas lugs gtor brlag byas na/ mtho sgang du sa rgod mtha' yas pa dang bye thang sha stag tu 'gyur 'gro/ 'di 'dra yin na chu bo dang gtsang bo'i chu yang nyung du 'gyur la/ chu dang gtsang po'i 'dabs phyogs kyi rgya yul sa khul dang rgya gar sa khul/ hi rdu ji la sa khul bcas kyi gtsang po che shos phal cher gyi 'byung khungs ni bod mi rigs kyi sa khul red/ chu bo gtsang po de dag gis mi 'bor dung phyur nyi shu lhag tsam gsos yod pa red/ chu bo gtsang po'i chu je nyung du gyur na mi rnams kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba la dka' ngal chen po 'byung yong ba yin / bod mi rigs kyis nang pa'i chos lugs la dad mos gnang ba las byung ba'i mi rigs bar gyi mdza' mthun 'brel ba dang mtsho bod mtho sgang gi skye dngos kyi khor yug srung skyong byas yod pa des ni 'dzam gling la byas rjes chen po bzhag yod pa red/ der brten bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la rtsod sgrub rig pa'i thog nas ya lan byed dgos/nga tshos si khron bod rigs sa khul la 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun lag bstar byed pa'i nang du/ bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la bden pa bden thog gis zhib 'jug byed dgos/ mar khe si ring lugs kyi lta tshul 369

nas bshad na don dag gang yin yang phyogs gnyis su 'dus/ phyogs gcig ni yag phyogs dang phyogs gzhan ni rdugs phyogs yin/ yag phyogs ni 'don spel dang rdugs phyogs ni sel bar byed dgos/ lo rgyus thog bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la phyogs re ba'i rang bzhin gyi lta tshul dang byed thabs la khyad bsad byed dgos/ de 'dra med na bod rigs sa khul gyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed thub kyi ma red/ mi rigs mi 'dra bas rang re'i rig gnas la drang bden langs phyogs thog nas brtag dpyad byed dgos/ yag po dang rdugs po dbye ba byed thub na mi rigs gong 'phel la phan thogs chen po 'dugargya mi rigs yin na 'dra/ yang na bod mi rigs yin na 'dra/ 'di 'dra ma byas na rang re'i mi rigs rgyang ring bo'i 'phel rgyas la rang shugs kyi bkag 'gog byed bzhin yod/ mi rigs gang yin na'ang rang re'i rig gnas la bstod bsngags byed pa dang chabs cig mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas la dma' 'beb byas na yag po ma red/ deng skabs 'dzam bu gling du bod kyi rig gnas la dga' mkhan mi rigs mi 'dra ba mang tsam 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na / bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas la tshe srog la dga' gces dang rang byung khams la srung skyong gi nus pa yod pa dang / 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun la phan thogs ldan pa de gtso bo yin/nub phyogs deng rabs can gyi rig gnas ni stobs shugs che ba'i rig gnas yin/ des rgyal khab khag dang mi rigs so so'i spyi tshogs nang du sim 'dzul byed kyin yod/ rgya mi rigs kyi deng rabs can gyi rig gnas la dper bzhag na/ mar khe si ring lugs ni nub phyogs kyi rig gnas kyi ya gyal zhig 370

yin pa dang / deng rabs kyi bzo las thon skyed/ slob gso'i sgrig gzhi/ grong khyer gyi do dam/ grong khyer chen po'i nang gi mi dmangs kyi bya spyod kyi tshad gzhi la sogs pa phal che ba ni nub phyogs kyi rig gnas dang bstun nas 'gro bzhin yod / nga tsho bod rigs sa khul gyi rgya che'i zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyi rig gnas ni bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas yin pas/ nub phyogs kyi stobs shugs che ba'i rig gnas sim 'dzul mang tsam byung med/ yin na yang bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas yar rgyas 'gro dgos na/ deng rabs can gyi rig gnas nang 'dren byed dgos par ma zad/ rang re'i mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la brtag dpyad zab mo'i sgo nas rig gnas legs rdugs dbye 'byed byed dgos/ legs po de dar spel dang / rdugs po rnams sel ba/ de min rang phan gyi deng rabs can gyi rig gnas bod sa khul dang mthun pa rnams nang 'dren hur len byed dgos / de ltar byas na tshe srog la dga' gces dang / spyi tshogs la dmangs gtso dang khrims lugs ldan pa dang / mi dmangs la tshan rig lag rtsal yod pa/ thon skyed dang yon tan gong 'phel 'gro ba/ mi dmangs myur du phyug por 'gro bar phan yod gnod med yin/ si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi chogs 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu de la bod kyi rig gnas kyang dus mthun gyis 'dzugs skrun mi byed thabs med red/lnga ba/ bod rigs sa khul gyi tang u dang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis 'cham mthun sbyi tshogs 'jugs spun lag bstar nang gartso khrid byed dgos/tang krung dbyang gis spyi tshogs ring lugs 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs 371

skrun byed dgos pa'i bka' 'don pa dang sbrags tang gis srid 'dzin nus par gal che ba'i nyams tshod nan tan blangs yod pa red/ phyogs yongs nas 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun don thog tu 'khyol ba'i las 'gan gtso bo ni rim pa khag gi tang u dang srid gzhung gis mthong chen byed dgos pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i las ka khag la shugs chen po rgyag dgos pa dang legs bcos byed dgos/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun lag bstar byed rgyu de khyon yongs gi las ku'i nang nas gal che ba'i gdan thog tu 'jog dgos/tang krung dbyang gis spyi tshogs ring lugs 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun thad 'bod skul chen po gnang yod pa red/ tshags par dang brnyan 'phrin rgyang sgrags thog khyab bsgrags yang mang po byas yod/ rgya yul sa khul dang bod rigs sa khul gyi grong khyer nang gi mi rnams kyis phal cher 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi nang don ha go rgyu red/ bod rigs sa khul gyi rgya che'i zhing 'brog gi ser skya mi dmangs rnams rig gnas kyi chu tshad dma' bas/'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi nang don dang ngo bo nges rtogs ha cang dka' po 'dug des ma tshad 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi cha 'phrin dang gsar 'gyur yang go khag po 'dug de 'dra yin na/ bod rigs sa khul gyi tang u dang srid gzhung gis 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun gyi nang don dang ngo bo rgya chen pos khyab bsgrags byed dgos pa dang / 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun skor gyi dpe deb kyang rgya che'i zhing 'brog sa khul gyi mi dmangs la 'grem gtong byed dgos/ si khron bod rigs sa khul gyi 'cham 372
re las don sa 'don da

bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi gnad don 'ga' zhigamagon po bkra shis/dang po/ rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams/da bar bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus bris pa mang po yod de/ phyi rgyal la mtshon na de snga'i su'u len rgyal khab kyi spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gis bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus zhig bris yod ces kun yus thang gis bshad la/ rgyal nang du rgya yig gis bris pa ni/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mos bsgrigs pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus dang / nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i wang yis lon dang thang cin h+phu gnyis kus brtsams pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus mdor bsdus dang /gzhan slob grwa de'i dge rgan sun chon hru'u yis bsgrigs pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus sogs yod/ bod yig gis bris pa ni lha rgyal tshe ring dang dpa' rtse gnyis nas brtsams pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus deb chung zhig dang / slob grwa re 'gas snum par du btab pa'i 'di'i skor gyi dpe deb re gnyis ma gtogs mang du mjal ma myong / go thos ltar na/ 'di'i phyogs su spyan dkyus g.yo ba'i rtsom rig lo rgyus smra ba 'ga' zhig gis kyang bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus sgrig bzhin yod ces zer/ de min 'di'i khungs su gtogs pa'i rtsom rig skor gcig gi byung 'phel dang lo rgyus brjod pa'i dpe deb dang dpyad rtsom yang kha shas yod 374

de / dper na don grub rgyal gyi mgur glu'i byung 'phel dang khyad chos〉dang /bsod nams g.yang 'dzoms kyi bod kyi snyan ngag gi byung rim brjod pa/〉 chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gi bod kyi gab tshig gi byung 'phel dang khyad chos〉sogs lta bu/ gong du brjod pa'i rtsom rig lo rgyus sam de dang 'brel ba'i dpyad rtsom 'di dag gis rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams dbye tshul ni sna tshogs su mchis te / krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob deb tu rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams ni 'di ltar dbye yod de/ bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs dang bcas pa'i de snga'i dus rabs thams cad ni tshan pa'am sa bcad gcig dang / bod sil bur thor ba'i dus skabs ni tshan pa gcig(dus rabs dgu ba'i lo rabs bzhi bcu dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i lo rabs lnga bcu) de nas bod gcig gyur byung ba nas dga' ldan pho brang bar ni dus skabs gcig(dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i lo rabs drug cung dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu) de nas bcing 'grol byas pa'i bar ni dus mtshams gcig(dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i lo rabs lnga bcu dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs bzhi bcu)bcas tshan pa'am sa bcad chen po bzhir byas nas brjod yod/wang yis lon sogs kyis ches snga mo nas sa skya srid dbang bar dus mtshams gcig dang /(skal ba ya thog nas 1253lor 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i skabs)/ de nas yon rgyal rabs bar dus mtshams gcig(1279—1644) de nas bcing 'grol byas pa'i bar dus mtshams gcig(1644—1951)bcas dus 375

mtshams gsum du dgar yod/don grub rgyal gyi mgur glu'i lo rgyus dang khyad chos〉las mgur snga dar ni bod btsan po'i skabs dang /(gna' snga mo nas 842lo ste glang dar ma'i bar /) bar dar ni bod sil bur thor ba nas rje tsong kha pa'i skabs / (843—1419lo bar/) phyi dar ni rje tsong kha ba'i skabs nas bcing 'grol byas pa'i bar yin/'ju skal bzang gi deng rabs bod kyi snyan ngag gi rgyud 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas skor〉las bod kyi gdod ma'i snyan ngag(bon po'i lde'u gzhir bzung)dus skabs gcig dang / gnya' khri btsan po nas srong btsan sgam po'i bar bod btsan po'i dus rabs snga ma'i snyan ngag(tun hong gter yig gtso bo byas pa/)de nas glang dar ma'i skabs dus mtshams gcig de nas bod sil bur thor ba'i bar dus mtshams gcig de nas snyan ngag me long dar ba'i bar dus mtshams gcig snyan ngag me long dar ba tshun dus mtshams gcig de nas deng rabs kyi snyan rtsom bcas zhib gsal du dus mtshams mang du dgar yod/bsod nams g.yang 'joms kyi dbye stangs ni snyan ngag snga dar bod btsan po'i skabs dang / bar dar ni bod sil bur thor ba nas snyan ngag me long bsgyur ba'i bar dang / phyi dar ni snyan ngag me long bsgyur ba nas bcing 'grol byas pa'i bar yin/(1277—1951lo bar)chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gi dbye stangs ltar na/ gab tshig snga dar ni gna' nas snyan ngag me long bsgyur ba'i bar dang /(1 —1277lo bar/) bar dar ni snyan ngag me long bsgyur ba nas mkhas chen dbyi sa blo gros rgyal mtshan 376

bar /(1277—1900lo bar/) phyi dar ni de nas bcing 'grol byas pa'i bar yin(1900—/951lo bar)dga' ba pa sangs kyi dbye stangs ni de'i(bod rigs kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams dbye stangs skor rags tsam gleng ba〉las gsal/ khong gi lta bar / gna' snga mo nas skad gsar bcad thengs gnyis pa khri ral ba can gyi bar dus mtshams gcig(1 —842) khri ral ba can nas bcing 'grol byas pa'i bar dus mtshams gcig bcas stabs bder dbye yod/gzhan yang khag gcig gis bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams ni snyan ngag me long ma ma bsgyur gong dang bsgyur rjes bcas dus mtshams gnyis su dbye ba'ang yod/gong gi dbye stangs 'di dag phyogs sdom byas na/ mang che ba ni rags bsdus che bas bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus zhib gsal du mthong dka' ba'i skyon du gyur 'dug /rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi las 'gan ni dus rabs so so'i rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul dang khyad chos klog pa por ngo sprod pa'i ched du yin/ gting zab mor zhib 'jug byas na 'di las skabs de'i bod kyi spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor gnas tshul dngos kyang gsal bor mtshon thub / dbye stangs 'di dag gi thun mong gi khyad chos ni/ thams cad kyis bskal ba ya thog tu bod kyi 'gro ba mi byung ba nas yi ge ma byung ba'i bar dmangs khrod kyi ngag sgron du gnas pa'i rtsom rig rnam pa dag dus mtshams gcig tu byas pa/lha sgrung dang gtam rgyud gtso bor byas pa'i rtsom rig rnam pa 'di dag ni yig thog tu phab med la mig tu mthong ba'ang dkon rung / 'gro ba mi byung ba dang 377

skad rigs byung ba nas bzung 'di dag ngag sgron tu brgyud nas gnas pa ni thams cad kyis khas mi len rang len yin/ de'i phyir dus skabs 'di ni rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi dus mtshams shig tu mi byed ka med yin/ mig mthong gi shes bya las gzhan rna thos kyi shes bya yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan bod btsan po'i skabs te/ lhag par du srong btsan sgam po'i skabs bod chen por gcig gyur byung rjes/ bod kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang rig gnas bcas kyi thad du 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba dang / yi ge'ang byung nas de skabs kyi spyi tshogs gnas tshul dngos yig thog tu phab pa'ang tun hong yig char yod pas/ dus skabs de rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams shig tu byed pa'ang bsnyon du med/btsan po'i rgyal rabs sil bur thor nas yun ring ba'i dus skabs su/ bod kyi spyi tshogs la 'pho 'gyur yang rab dang rim pa byung bas/ dus skabs de'ang thams cad kyis rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams shig tu khas len bzhin yod/de'i rjes su sog po rgyal po'i rgyab skyor 'og tu/ sa skya'i srid dbang byung zhing /'gro mgon 'phags pa'i skabs snyan ngag me long ma yang bod du yongs su bsgyur te / bod kyi rtsom rig la shugs rkyen gal chen thebs pas/ mang che bas 'di'ang rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi rdo ring lta bur brtsi bzhin 'dug de'i rjes su chin gong ma'i rgyab skyor 'og dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang btsugs shing / de'i snga rol du nang chos dang rtsom rig kun tu shing rta'i srol 'byed du khas len pa'i rje bdag nyid chen po byung bas/ de'ang rtsom rig gi dus mtshams shig tu 'jog /de nas bcing 'grol byas nas krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes te/ bod kyi spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas la 'gyur ldog chen po byung bas/378

'di'ang nga tshos tshor du yod pa'i rtsom rig gi dus rabs gsar pa zhig go /gong du dper drangs pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa 'di dag ni rtsom rig rnam pa'i ya gyal du gyur bas rtsom rig yongs kyi 'thus tshab byed mi thub rung / rtsom rig gi grub cha gal chen yin la rtsom rig spyi'i rgyab ljongs su byung zhing 'phel ba dang / spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi dngos yod gnas tshul gcig gi phyi rol yul gyi cha rkyen 'og tu byung ba yin pas/ rtsom rig spyi'i lo rgyus brjod par rin thang nges can zhig ldan/ mig sngar mig mthong du yod pa'i rtsom rig lo rgyus sam de dang 'brel ba'i dpyad rtsom 'di dag tu/ rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi dus mtshams ni da dung gcig gyur ma byung bas/ rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul brjod par dus kyi rim pa gsal thag chod pa zhig med pas/ 'di ni rtsom rig lo rgyus la gal 'gangs che zhing rtsom rig lo rgyus su nges par thag gcod dgos pa'i gnad don zhig tu gyur 'dug /gnyis pa/ bod kyi rtsom rig dang nang ba'i chos lugs/de yang sku zhabs rta mgrin dbang 'bum gyis brjod pa ji bzhin/ bod kyi rig gnas ni nang ba'i chos lugs kho na'i rig gnas ma yin la/ bod kyi rig gnas ni sngon byung mkhas pa'i brtsi stangs ltar rig gnas che chung lnga tsam yang ma yin/ de bzhin du bod kyi rtsom rig ni rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal snyan ngag kho na'ang ma yin/ 'di ni nga tshos bod kyi rtsom rig slob sbyong byed par nges par rtogs dgos pa zhig yin/ kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar/ chos lugs kyis bod kyi lo rgyus dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang du go gnas gal chen bzung yod pas / chos lugs kyis bod kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas dang 379

bsam blo sogs phyogs kun tu shugs rkyen gting zab zhugs bzhin yod/ de mtshungs su bod kyi rtsom rig gi brjod bya dang brjod gzhi/ bsam blo dang phugs 'dun/ mi sna gsar bzhengs dang sems khams zhib 'bri/ gtam rgyud kyi byung rim sogs kyi thad du'ang shugs rkyen gal chen thebs yod/ de'i phyir chos lugs dang 'brel ba chen po yod pa 'di ni bod kyi rig gnas ma tshad bod kyi rtsom rig gi khyad chos gtso bo zhig kyang yin te/ 'di ni bod kyi rtsom rig ngos 'dzin dang dpyad pa gtong bar mnyam par 'jog dgos pa'i gnad don gal chen zhig yin/bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus la bltas na/ bod 'di ni gna' snga mor bo chos la dad pa dang / rjes su nang chos bod du dar bas mang tshogs yongs kyis bod brgyud nang bstan dang bcas par dad pa byed/ chos lugs ni bod mi dmangs kyi bsam pa'i dad phyogs yin la/ chos lugs kyis mang tshogs kyi bsam blo dang kun spyod bcas la slob ston byas yod/ de'i stabs bod mang tshogs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon byed du gyur ba'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom la'ang chos lugs kyi rkyen ma zhugs rang zhugs red/ bod kyi spyi tshogs sam lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs ni de lta bu yin pas/ sngon byon bod kyi mkhas pa'am rtsom pa po mang che pa ni lus dgon sde chos grwar bzhugs pa'am 'grim pa dang / sems chos la mi phyed kyi dad pa rnyed pa/ rnar tshangs pa'i dbyangs thos pa dang mig tu bka' bstan mjal ba/ ngag tu chos sgra sgrog pa'i chos pa sha stag yin la/ chos kyi rtogs pa shin tu mtho ba'i bla sprul dge bshes kho nar nges/ khong rnam pa'i phyag gi 'du byed las thon pa'i phyag rtsom 'di dag la chos kyi dri bsung mi 'thul ga la 380

rung —/ khong rnams ni chos la mkhas shing rtsom la'ang mkhas pa/ chos pa yin la rtsom pa po'ang yin no/ /rtsom rig gi brjod bya'am brjod gzhi'ang chos dang 'brel ba chen po yod de / brjod bya mi nyung ba ni chos dpe las thad kur drangs pa yin te/ dper na ston pa'i skyes rabs las drangs pa skyes rabs so bzhi dang mdo mdzangs blun sogs dang / rgya dpe nas thad kur bsgyur ba dge chos kyi bya len ma'i rtogs brjod dang / rgya dpe'i nang gi gtam rgyud rgyas par drangs pa dri med kun ldan dang chos rgyal nor bzang / gzhon nu zla med sogs lta bu grangs kyis mi langs/mdor na brjod bya mang che ba ni rgya gar gyi nang ba'i bstan bcos su de'i khungs rnyed thub/ rig byed kyi gtam rgyud dang gtam rgyud gzhan dag kyang rgya gar gyi bram ze'i chos lugs dang nang ba'i chos lugs las drangs nas bod kyi rtsom pa po rnams kyis brgyan zhing spras pa yin/ gzhan bod kyi rtsom pa po dag gis gsar rtsom byas pa'i bstan bcos sam brtsams chos mang po'i brjod bya'ang chos dang bral thabs med pa 'di yin/brtsams chos kyi bsam blo'i thad du/ las rgyu 'bras dang tshe snga phyi/ bden pa bzhi dang dag pa'i zhing khams/ dge sgrub sdig spangs dang nges 'byung gi bsam pa/ thar ba'am tshangs rgya ba sogs chos kyi bsam blo gzhir bzung nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom byas yod/ khag cig gis bod kyi rtsom rig ni chos sam chos kyi rtsom rig tu brjod pa'ang 'di'i rkyen gyis yin/gong du brjod pa bzhin bod kyi mang tshogs rnams ni mi chos dang lha chos kyi khor lug tu gnas shing 'tsho bas/ chab srid thad du btsan blon rnams kyis kyang 381

chos la dga' mgur byas shing / chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam lugs kyang gna' nas lag bstar byas/ dpal 'byor gyi thad du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dang bran g.yog lam lugs/ dgon sde'i dpal 'byor bcas kyang gna' snga mo nas dar yod/ rig gnas dang bsam blo'i thad du chos 'di'ang med du mi rung /rtsom pa po'i thad du chos pa dang rtsom pa po gnyis ku'i thob thang zung du 'brel bas / spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi rgyab ljongs 'di 'dra'i 'og tu/bod kyi rtsom rig ni chos dang bral thabs med pas/ 'di ni bod kyi rtsom rig gi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa zhig yin/ bod kyi rtsom rig la spyan dkyus phyogs dus gnas tshul 'di'ang gsal bor shes dgos/gsum pa/ rtsom rig dang lo rgyus/ mtshan nyid rig pa bcas gcig tu 'dres pa/bod 'di'ang 'dzam gling gi mi rigs gzhan dag dang 'dra bar/ lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mor 'di'i lo rgyus rig pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsom rig bcas phung bo gcig tu 'dres nas yun ring bar 'gor/ de skabs bod kyi rtsom rig ni lo rgyus rig pa dang mtshan nyid rig par 'dres nas rig pa'i gnas kyi ya gyal bye brag pa zhig tu ma grub pas/ deng gi brjod stangs dang mthun pa'i rtsom rig gi go don yang ma byung / de'i skabs kyi brtsams chos dag ni lo rgyus kyi yig char brjod chog la/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i yig char yang brjod chog /de mtshungs su de'i skabs kyi lo rgyus yig cha dang mtshan nyid rig pa'i yig cha'ang rtsom rig brtsams chos su'ang brjod chog /spyir btang du rtsom rig gsar rtsom ni smra brjod kyi lag cha zhig yin pas/ chab srid dpal 'byor 382

lazhabs 'degs byed chog la/ rig gnas lo rgyus la'ang zhabs 'degs byed chogapas/ lo rgyus smra ba dang mtshan nyid rig pa smra ba dag gis nam rgyun lag cha 'dir yongs su brten/ dper na/ btsan po'i gdung rgyud dang lo rgyus kyi don chen brjod pa'i lo rgyus kyi yig cha dang / skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi tshe gang bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i rnam thar rtogs brjod/ chos kyi gnas lugs brjod pa'i chos gzhung sna tshogs/ 'jig rten gyi chos nyid brjod pa'i bslab bya legs bshad sogs lta bu/ deng gi skabs brtsams chos 'di dag ni rig pa'i gnas kyi ya rgyal bye brag pa zhig tu 'jog kyang srid rung / so so'i dmigs bya brjod pa dang dus mtshungs su rtsom rig gi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa 'di dag gi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal lam rjod byed kyi tshig dang brjod bya'i don/ rtsom gyi nyams dang rtsom stangs/ mi sna gsar bzhengs dang mi sna'i gzugs brnyan bcas ni yid dbang 'phrog pa sha stag yin pas/ de'i stabs brtsams chos 'di dag ni bod kyi rtsom rig tu bzhag na rigs shing ran te/ 'di ni bod kyi rtsom rig gi dngos yod gnas tshul dang yongs su mthun pa zhig yin/rtsom rig dang lo rgyus/ mtshan nyid rig pa bcas gcig tu 'dres pa dper na/ lo rgyus yig cha(sba bzhed〉dang / (ma ṇi bka' 'bum〉dang /(bka' thang sde lnga〉dang / (rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉dang / (dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉dang / (mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉sogs lta bu/ skyes chen dam pa'i lo rgyus dper na/ (mi la ras ṅge'i rnam thar〉dang / (mar ba lo tsā ba'i rnam thar〉dang / (mi dbang rtogs brjod〉sogs lta bu/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i yig chanas skya legs bshad〉dang / 〈dge ldan legs bshad〉383

dang —/ (chu shing bstan bcos〉 dang / (rten 'brel bstod pa〉sogs lta bu/dpe deb la la ni sna 'dzoms yig mdzod du'ang brjod chog /bzhi ba/ dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig dang rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig /dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig dang rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig gnyis ni rtsom rig bya rgod gnam 'phang gcod pa'i gshog zung lta bu yin te/ phan tshun brten cing gnas pas gnyis ka med du mi rung / bod kyi dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig tu (gling ge ser rgyal po'i sgrung〉 lta bu'i 'dzam gling yongs su grags che ba'i dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo yod par ma zad/ dmangs glu dang dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud/ gtam dpe dang lha sgrung / dmangs khrod kyi snyan rtsom ring mo dang ri dwags kyi gtam rgyud/ chang gzhas dang mchod bshad/gnyen bshad sogs kyang yod/ 'di dag gi gsar rtsom gyi lo rgyus ni rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig las ring la/ rtsom gyi rnam pa'ang de las phun sum tshogs pa dang /brjod bya rgya che zhing rjod byed kyi tshig gson nyams ldan pa/ stabs bde zhing go sla ba'i ngag sgron gyi brtsams chos 'di dag ni bod mang tshogs kyis yun ring po'i ngal rtsol 'tsho ba'i myong tshor las thon pa sha stag yin pas/ mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes dang mdzes rig dga' snang gi yul dang dge sdug gi sems sogs mtshon thub/ bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan por brjod pa 'ga' zhig gis grong ba'i tshig dang lug rdzi'i ngag tu brtsi ba ni rigs shing ran pa min no/ /rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig ni nga tshos mig mthong lag zin tu gyur pa'i rtsom rig gi nor bu'i do shal zhig yin te/ bod la yi ge byung ba nas bzung bod kyi com pa po rnams kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rgyun yang chad ma myong / mi rigs kyi khyad 384

chos ldan pa'i brtsams chos grangs las 'das pa 'di dag gis bod kyi rtsom rig bang mdzod rnam par gtams pas/ phyi rabs pa dag la shes rig gi nor bu gzhan la skyengs mi dgos pa bzhag yod/rtsom rig gi rnam pa 'di gnyis ka so sos rang nyid kyi lus phung rgyas pa'i ched du/ phan tshun rang nyid la phan zhing dge mtshan ldan pa'i nying bcud bsdu len byas dang byed bzhin yod de/ rtsom pa po dag gis nam rgyun du dmangs khrod rtsom rig nang gi gtam rgyud dang gtam dpe/ ngag sgron dag bsdu len byas pa ni nga tshos de dag gi brtsams chos las rgyun du mthong thub/ 'di'i mig dper gyur ba ni mgur glu yin te/ mgur zhes pa'i rtsom gyi rnam pa 'di ni thog mar glu'i rmang gzhi'i thog nas 'phel rgyas byung ba yin pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar / dmangs khrod rtsom rig gis kyang rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig rna thos mig mthong du gyur rjes de'i steng du gsar rtsom byed la/ yin na yang de gnyis ka ni phan tshun 'thus tshab byed mi rung ste/ so sor khyad chos dang dge mtshan ldan pa'i phyir / gzhan yang rtsom gyi rnam pa 'di gnyis ka ni phan tshun 'gal ba min la mthong chung yang byed mi rung ste/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig ni grong pa'i tshig dang lug rdzi'i ngag ma yin la/ rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig ni rtogs pa can kho na'i mjal yul dang mtha' gcig tu 'phags pa'ang min/ 'di gnyis ka ni rten cing 'brel nas gnas shing phan tshun skul 'ded byed la/ de'i stabs kyis sbyong ba dang dpyod pa'i skabs su phyogs lhung gi lta ba 'dzin mi rung /lnga pa/ rtsom pa po dang brtsams chos rtsom rig lo rgyus su 'jog pa'i tshad gzhi/385

rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus ring mor rtsom pa po dang brtsams chos grangs las 'das pa byung mod/ 'on kyang rtsom rig lo rgyus nang du 'di dag thams cad bgrang nas dpyad pa'am brjod pa ni ches dka' ba zhig yin la brjod kyang mi nus/ de'i phyir de dag rtsom rig lo rgyus nang 'jog pa'am 'dems par tshad gzhi zhig kyang dgos te/ bod kyi sngon byon mkhas pa dag ni rig gnas che chung lnga por mkhas pa sha stag yin la/ khong rnams kyi phyag gi 'du byed las thon pa'i brtsams chos dag kyang rig gnas so so'i khungs su gtogs/de yang nga tsho'i brjod bya ni rtsom rig yin pas rtsom rig gi khyad chos gtso bor 'dzin dgos pa ni brjod du med pa yin/ brtsams chos kyi thad nas bshad na/brtsams chos la la'i brjod bya ni rig pa'i gnas gzhan gyi khungs su gtogs rung —/ der rtsom rig gi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa yod na de'ang rtsom rig lo rgyus su 'jog dgos/ gzhan yang grags che ba dang rtsom rig 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa'i brtsams chos dag kyang 'di'i dpyad pa'i yul du gyur dgos/ de min 'thus tshab kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i rtsom dag kyang 'dir 'dren pa'i dgos pa yod la/ rtsom pa po'i thad nas bshad na/ rig gnas gzhan dag la mkhas min dang lo rgyus thog grags chen yin min ni phal ba dang /phul byung gi brtsams chos yod med dang rtsom rig 'phel rgyas la mdzad pa yod med ni gtso bor 'dzin dgos/ gzhan yang rtsom gyi rnam pa dkon zhing / brjod bya'i nang don dang rjod byed kyi tshig /rtsom lugs dang rtsom stangs/ rtsom gyi nyams bcas khyad chos thun min ldan pa/ dus rabs dang sa phyogs bcas kyang dmigs bsal du 'dzin dgos/386

drug pa/ bod kyi rtsom rig gi tshad gzhi/gnar dus su bod mis skad rigs sam yig rigs gzhan la brten nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom byas pa ni phal cher med de/ yod na'ang legs sbyar gyi skad kyis brtsams pa ni yod/ mkhas dbang dge chos kyis dbyin ji'i skad kyis snyan ngag brtsams yod ces thos myong rung mig mthong du ma gyur/ deng skabs la mtshon na bod kyi rtsom pa po'i dpung khag tu rgya yig gi sgo nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed pa'i rtsom pa po'ang mi nyung ba byung yod de/ lo rgyus kyi dbang gis rtsom pa po 'di dag gis bod rang gi yi ge la brten nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed pa'i go skabs ma rnyed rung / rgya yig gis sbyong ba thob ste rgya yig gi rtsom 'bri bzhin yod pa 'di rigs la'ang skyon yon gnyis ka yod de/ skyon ni des zhabs 'degs byed yul ni bod mang tshogs min la/ bod mang tshogs kyis bkol ba'i skad rigs ni da dung bod skad gtso bo yin pas/ rtsom pa po dang klog pa po'i bar skad yig gi thog nas bar chod 'dug /yon tan ni bod kyi rtsom rig rgyal spyi can du gyur ba dang lhag par bod kyi rtsom rig mi rigs gzhan dag la ngo sprod byed par phan pa'o/ /bod kyi rtsom rig gi tshad gzhir yang lta ba mi mthun pa kha shas yod de/ kha cig gi lta bar/ bod kyi rtsom rig ni brjod bya bod mi'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon pa dang rjod byed bod kyi skad yig yin dgos shing / rtsom pa po'ang bod mi'am bod mi'i bsam blo 'du shes yod pa zhig yin dgos zer/ yang kha shas kyis 'di gsum po gang rung zhig bod kyi yin pas chog par 'dzin/ rtsom pa po dang brtsams chos/ brtsams chos kyi skad yig rnam pa bcas gsum po bod kyi yin na 387

bod kyi rtsom rig tu 'jog pa ni bsnyon du med mod/ deng skabs rig gnas phan tshun brje res dang mi rigs phan tshun 'gro 'ong nyin bzhin je mang du byung bas / rtsom pa pos mi rigs gzhan pa'i skad yig la brten pa'ang gsar du byung ba'i gnas tshul gsar ba zhig yin la/ dus mtshungs su bod kyi rtsom rig smra bar thag chod dgos pa'i gnad don zhig kyang yin/mi rigs kyi rtsom rig cig yin phyin/ mi rigs de'i khyad chos yod dgos/mi rigs de'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon dgos pa ma zad mi rigs de'i bsam blo 'du shes kyang mtshon dgos/ nges par du mi rigs der zhabs 'degs zhu dgos / mi rigs zhig la mtshon na mi rigs de'i khyad chos ni phyi'i rnam pa tsam ma yin par nang bsam pa'i 'du shes kyang gtso bo yin te/ mi rigs gang rung zhig nyams rgyad du 'gro dus nang bsam blo'i 'du shes ni 'jig dka' la/ phyi'i rnam pa ste cha lugs dang goms gshis dag ni dus rabs kyi 'pho 'gyur nang du rtswa kha'i zil ba lta bu yin/ mi rigs kyi rtsom rig la mtshon na'ang nang don dang rnam pa zung du 'brel dgos/ nang don stong ba'i rnam pa ni gson nyams med pa'i shing skam lta bu yin la/ rnam pa med pa'i nang don ni mtshon thabs med pa dang —/ rnam pa mdzes pa kho na gcigs su bzung zhing don gyis dben na myur du yal ba'i me tog lta bu yin/spyir sgyu rtsal la sa phyogs kyi mtshams gsal bo med rung mi rigs kyi mtshams nges can yod pas/ mi rigs kyi rtsom rig la thun min gyi khyad chos mngon gsal yod la/ mi rigs phan tshun 'gro 'ong dang rig gnas bar phan tshun brje res byed pas/ brjod bya rjod byed thad kyang phan tshun rkyen byed la/388
nga phan tshuspa 'dzam

ka rtsom snyan ngag gi skor che long tsam brjod pa mdzub mo ri ston/'jam kho/gcig ka rtsom snyan ngag gi go don/bod yig gi phyi mo gsal byed kyi yi ge sum cu la ka mad zer zhing / de'i go rim gzhir bzung nas bshad pa'i rtsom yig la kha skad ltar na ka bshad ces grags pa dang / yig srol la ka li'i phreng ba bstar du bsgrigs pas ka phreng zhes zer gyi yod/ rtsom srol 'di ni rang cag bod mi rigs kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsom rig cig yin zhes dang / ka rtsom ni bod yig gi gsal byed sum cu'i go rim gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom srol zhig yin zhes/ de ni bod rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i rang rkya thub pa'i rtsom rig gi rtsom lus sam rnam grangs shig tu bgrang mod/ kho bos bltas na ka rtsom de kā li'i phreng ba spel ba'i rtsom lus kho na zhig tu go na cung gu dog par snyam/ ka rtsom dang mgur glu legs bshad bcas la rang rang gi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa re yod pa ni bsnyon du med mod/ khyad chos cung zad mi 'dra ba tsam re la brten nas rtsom lus re dgar dgos tshe rang re'i bod kyi rtsom lus la rnyog 'dzing gi dra ba zhig bzo bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir ka rtsom ni sgyu rtsal rtsom rig 390

latshig sbyor spel stangs kyi cha nas brtsams sgrung dang / lhug rtsom/ zlos gar/snyan ngag bcas bzhi ru dbye ba'i ya gyal snyan ngag gi nang du bsdus na don dang mthun zhing mtshan nyid kyang 'jog bde ba zhig tu 'gyur/ rgyu mtshan de la brten nas kho pos kyang ka rtsom snyan ngag ces brjod don de ltar yin/ des na ji lta bu zhig la ka rtsom snyan ngag ces brjod dgos zer na/ de ni sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi rtsom lus shig tu byas pa'i snyan ngag gi nang gses shig ste/ dbyangs kyi 'degs 'jog gsal ba'i lus la phun sum tshogs pa'i ka phreng gi rgyan gyis gtso bo spras shing —/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba snying bsdus su srog tu byas pa'i tshor 'du shugs drag pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa tshigs bcad kho nas bris pa zhig la ka rtsom snyan ngag ces zer dgos par snyam/ mkhas dbang don grub rgyal gyis kyang bod kyi mgur glu byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus dang khyad chos bsdus par ston pa rig pa'i khye'u rnam par rtsen pa'i skyed tshal〉zhes pa las/ ka phreng gi rgyan zhes pa ni bod kyi gsal byed sum cu'i go rim gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa'i rtsom khyad par can zhig yin zhes ka phreng gi rgyan zhes brjod pa las logs su rtsom lus rang tshugs can zhig tu dgar med pa de'ang rgyu mtshan med pa ma yin no/ /gnyis / ka rtsom snyan ngag gi rgyan gyi dbye ba/bod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i ka rtsom snyan ngag der tshig sbyor spel tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bya sla ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan dang / bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan gnyis su 'du ba yin/ de yang bya sla ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan sbyor tshul la'ang rigs mi 'dra ba 'ga' mchis pas dper mtshon 'ga' bgrang 391
