bar rigs so/ /1 gsal byed sum cu ka nas a'i bar go rim ltar tshigs rkang rnams kyi thog mar sbyor ba la lugs 'byung ka phreng gi rgyan zer/ dper na/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ ka ye kho bo gzhan du song rjes su/ /kha nas ci bshad med pa'i a khu 'gas/ /ga ler gnas chung 'phrin las rgyal po yis nga rgyal che zhes sdod du ma bcug zer/ /ca dag byed pa'i chos skyong zhig yod na/ /cha rgyus yod med sa cha kun 'grims nas/ /ja chang skam lug sogs kyis tshong byed pa'i / /nya nyog de tsho sdod du ga la bcug /ces pa lta bu shin tu mang ngo / /2 gsal byed sum cu'i go rim ldog nas a nas ku'i bar tshigs rkang so so'i thog mar sbyor ba la lugs ldog ka phreng gi rgyan zer/ dper na/ mkhas mchog don grub rgyal gyis/ a ma'i drung gi gces phrug kha mkhas tsho/ /ha cang gces lang shor na nam zhig tshe/ /sa mthar gcig pur 'gro ba'i dus shig na/ /sha shed nyams pa'i sos dus rta pho bzhin/ /la thang chod pa'i re ba ye med pas/ /rang mgo 'khyong ba'i thabs la 'bad par 'tshal/ /ya mtshan ma 'ongs lam chen mthong bzhin du/ /'a 'ur 'du 'dzi che ba'i khrom thog tu/ /za 'thung kho na gnyer ba'i mkhas rlom can/ /zha 'theng rgan po'i rnam thar skyong min nam/ /zhes pa lta bu/3 gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams rim pa bzhin tshigs rkang so so'i dbus sam mtha' ru gnas nges par sbyor ba la gnas nges pa'i ka phreng gi rgyan zer/dper na/ chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs lags kyis/ 'gyur med rab brtan ka ba lta bu'i blo/ /can bzhi'i ched du kha tsam ma yin par/ /dka' nyen che sa ga 392

dus yin na yang / /stag ltar mchong ba nga yi grogs po mchog /ces pa lta bu dbus na gnas pa dang / mkhas dbang don grub rgyal gyis/ ngo mtshar che'o lha mo me na ka /me tog ji bzhin nam yang 'dzum pa'i kha/ /ri dwags lta bu'i khra chung mig gnyis ga /gzhan la mi dbang de yi bdag po nga / /zhes mtha' na gnas pa lta bu/4zhan yang sde ba snga phyi gnyis sho lo ka gcig gi nang du bsdebs te/ sde ba dang bo gong nas 'og tu dang / sde ba gnyis pa 'og nas gong du klog pa'i sbyor tshul yang yod de/ dper na/ don grub rgyal gyis/ ka ye blo gsal blo mthun nya mo'i tshogs/ /kha sang bslab pa'i slob tshan ja yi ro/ /ga ler myangs pa'i myong tshor cha shas tsam/ /nga yi ngag bzhin ngag gi ca co glongs/ /lta bu/ gsal byed kyi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa'i ka phreng gi rgyan 'di lta bu ni sbyong bde zhing / don yang rtogs sla bas bya sla ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan du bzhag pa yin/ gong gsal de dag nyung shas shig dper mtshon tsam du bkod pa las/ bya sla ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan gyi sbyor tshul 'dra min da dung yod cing rang rang gi rtsal gyis kyang ci 'jon par sbyar chog pa zhig yin no/ /bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan la/ gsal byed kyi yi ge gcig mnga' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan/ dbyangs med pa'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan/ dbyangs ldan bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan/ thog mtha' sbyar ba'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan/bskor ba'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan/ bsdus pa'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan / rtags kyis dbye ba'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan sogs rnam pa mi 'dra ba mang po mchis pa las/ 393

1 tshigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang so so'i thog mar gsal byed kyi yi ge gang rung zhig sbyar nas spel ba la gsal byed kyi yi ge gcig mnga' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan zer/ dper na/ don grub rgyal gyis/ ka kha slob pa'i deng gi gzhon nu 'ga' / /ka li phreng bar bsgrigs pa'i rtsom la dga'/ /ka rtsom bris na shin tu legs mod kyang / /ka rdo med na ka ba'i phug mi brtan/ /kwa ye zer ba'i ka rtsom mang na yang / /ka bar rung ba'i rgyu cha ches nyung bas/ /ka nas dag pa'i bsam pa'i kun slong gis/ /ka rkyang kho nas sems gtam 'di dag smras/ /zhes pa lta bu/na gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams tshig rkang so so'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung la go rim bzhin sbyar zhing / tshigs bcad sho lo ka gcig gam du mar dbyangs bzhi po'i gcig kyang med par sbyor ba la dbyangs med pa'i ka phreng gi rgyan zer/ dper na/ a lags tshe tan zhabs drung gis/ ka nas yang dag bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /kha ba ltar dkar zla bral lhag bsam ngang / /ga shal rgyan cha dar sna mang bshams nas/ /nga rgyal rgyags bral dad pas phyag mang 'tshal ca lag khyad rdzas bsags la ma gzan par/ /cha byad rnam dag skra dang sma ra bzhar//ja mdangs dar las gzan dang sham thabs 'chang / /nya gang zla rgyas bsam pas gzhan phan brtsams/ /ta thā ga ta sogs gsal byed sum cu go rim ma 'chol bar tshigs rkang re'i mgor bkod pa dang / /dkyus kyi tshig rnams la gi gu zhabs kyu 'greng bu rna ru gcig kyang med par ma zad/ rtsom pa po'i tshe gang gi byung ba brjod pa'i don bsdus te bkod pa lta bu/3 gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams tshig rkang so so'i mgor rim par bsgrigs pa'am tshigs bcad gcig la sde ba de thon par byas nas/ sho lo ka gcig gi 394

nang du dbyangs bzhi po rim bzhin dang gang rung zhig sbyor ba la dbyangs ldan bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan zer/ dper na/ rje rin po ches/ ke ru zhes grags gnas 'dir 'khod pa rnams/ /khe dang rnyed bkur dor te chos la gzhol / /ge sar nyi shar 'od kyis mdzes pa bzhin/ /nge rang rnams kyang gsung rab snang bas rtsen/ /zhes dbyangs e nges pa can dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes/ ko tam bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren tha ma kha/ /kho thag chos la gcod byed tha ma kha/ /go rig dran pa slad byed tha ma kha/ /ngo tsha khrel 'dzem 'dor byed tha ma kha/ /zhes dbyangs o nges pa can dang / rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyis/ ki swa g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgya bod dpung / /khu tshur mtshon cha sna tshogs brten bzhin du/ /ge sar bdud 'dul lta bur chas pa'i tshe/ /ngo tsha kha skyengs gor kha rgyal blon rnams/ /zhes dbyangs bzhi rim par sbyar ba dang /gzhan yang zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas/ ca co glu yis co nas 'dren khyod ci yang mchod tshig ce spyang skad mtshungs lus gcu zhing / /cha lugs tsog pus cho ga la 'bad chu gtsang mchod yon rin thang che ba'i skyogs nang du/ /ja yi btung ba'i u ma'i jo bo ji tsam dgyes pa'i je mang 'dod yon ju rtse'i gos sogs zong 'di dag /nya gang zla bar 'chi ba'i nyi 'od nye ba'i skabs med nyo tshong re ba zhung ngu min 'di'i slad du'o/ /zhes tshigs bcad gcig gi nang du sde ba gcig tshang zhing —/ de'i tshig rkang re'i nang du gsal byed gcig la dbyangs med pa dang dbyangs bzhi bo mnyam du sbyar nas spel ba sogs rtsom pa po rang rang gis rig pa'i stobs dang smyu gu'i rtsal ji ltar rgyas na de ltar brtsams chog chog cig yin/4 tshig rkang snga ma'i gsal byed kyi rjes ma dang / tshig rkyang phyi ma'i gsal 395

byed kyi yi ge 'go ma gnyis 'dra bar sbyar ba la thog mtha' sbyar ba'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan zer/ dper na/ ra ri 'dzin kyang cha shas yongs rdzogs ston gsum mtshan gyi dus tshod la/ /la thang med par bsil zer spro ba'i mtshan mo'i mgon po a dar sha /sha ba ri ba'i 'jigs pa med par dga' bde ri mo shar ba'i sa/ /sa la'i ljongs kyi dge mtshan 'di ko e ma rmad byung ge sa ra/ /zhes pa lta bu/5 gsal byed kyi yi ge gcig yang yang bskor nas brjod pa la bskor ba'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan zer/ dper na/ zhabs dkar ba tshogs drug rang grol gyis/ /ka ye skal ldan snying gi grogs gnyis ka /kha bde khog dkar grogs po kha yi kha/ /ga ler nyon dang phan pa'i gros 'di ga /nga bdag thul dang 'khor bar ya mi nga / /zhes pa lta bu/6 gsal byed sum cu sho lo ka gcig gi nang du bsdus nas gcig kyang ma lhag par tshang bar byed pa la bsdus pa'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan zer/dper na/ mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung gis/ 'chad pa skal bzang thos pa'i bang mdzod gtams/ /rtsod pa phra zhib rig pa'i rgya mtsho yangs rtsom pa dbyangs can pi wang 'jebs shing snyan/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum a ho rmad / /ces pa lta bu/7 gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams rtags 'jug gi gzhung ltar pho mo ma ning gi sde tshan du dbye ste/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sho lo ma'i nang du rim pa ltar bsgrigs pa zhig la rtags kyis dbye ba'i bya dka' ba'i ka phreng gi rgyan zer/ dper na/rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos/ ka ra ṇa ltar ya rabs mchog gi spyod tshul snod du 396

ca co'i ngag spangs khungs ldan lo rgyus dbus 'gyur ta la'i glegs bam ji bzhin rab gsal pa ri dza yi pusta ka /kha dog tshig don ma 'dres lang tsho rnam par bkra ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs snyan tshig bsil zer mdangs kyis tha gru kun khyab sgra 'dzin bdud rtsi'i pha rol shes ldan dga' ston che/ /ga dza lta bu'i dregs pa'i blun po legs bshad skyes las ja chang btung ba 'ba' zhig don du gnyer phyir da lta'i dus kyi snang tshul 'di la ba lang spyod las gzhan mi brin/ /nga zhes stobs nor snyems pas 'gying yang shes ldan rigs pa'i nya gar gzhal tshe lci dang yang ba'i mtha' bral na ra'i dbus na g.yung bor mthong bas ma rmad 'gro ba shin tu dkon / /zhes sogs rtsom 'di lta bu ni ka rtsom snyan ngag gi rgyan gyi khrod na shin tu bya dka' ba yin no/ /gzhan yang ka rtsom snyan ngag la brjod bya'i don gyi sgo nas dbye na/ don brjod ka rtsom dang / 'gyur brjod ka rtsom/ legs bshad ka rtsom sogs su phyes na'ang mi chog rgyu med snyam/1 bya ba zhig byung ba nas bzung 'phel ba'i rim pa gtso bor brjod pa'i ka rtsom la don brjod ka rtsom snyan ngag zer/ dper na/ rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyis/ ki su g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgya bod dpung / /khu tshul mtshon cha sna tshogs brten bzhin du/ /ge sar bdud 'dul lta bur chas pa'i ma ngo tsha kha skyengs gor kha rgyal blon rnams/ /ci drag thabs kyis gros bsdur mang byas kyang —/ /chu shor rags mtshungs gyur tshe 'gran 'dod blo/ /je mtho bskyed kyang rang sdug rang nyid kyis/ /nyo bar bsam nas kho bor tshur shog ces/ /ti pi lcags dang glang chen bsu ba bcas/ /thu lud 'debs 'os gor rgyal drung bos 397

te / /de ring sang las ma 'gyangs song zhig ces/ /no 'khol 'dra ba'i rgyal ngan wa skad shor/ /lta bu/2 dga' skyo chags sdang ste yid kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs gtso bo byas nas mtshon par byed pa'i ka rtsom la 'gyur brjod ka rtsom snyan ngag zer/ dper na/dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ ka chu yan chad nag chu man chad nas/ /kha tshig mtho ba'i skye bo mang na yang / /ga ler bsam na rang re'i tha snyad pa'i/ /nga rgyal de ni don gyi nga rgyal yin/ /zhes pa lta bu/3 blang dor gyi gnas 'doms shing spang blang gi shan phyes nas rnam dkar gyi las la bskul ba gtso bo byas pa'i ka rtsom la legs bshad ka rtsom zer/dper na/ mkhyen rab 'od gsal lags kyis/ zha bos cang shes zhon pa'i brtul zhugs de bskyangs na/ /za nyal 'gro 'dug spyod pa'i dus tshod kyang don ldan / /'a 'ur 'du 'dzi'i khrod du khyi 'khyam bzhin nyul na/ /ya rabs mkhas rnam khrel bas bag yod dang ldan mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu brjod bya'i nang don gyi gtso phal la brten nas dbye ba phyes kyang chog /gsum / ka phreng gi rgyan dang sgra rgyan gyi khyad par/snyan ngag me long las snye snyan ngag mdzes par byed pa yi/ /chos rnams rgyan zhes rab tu brjod / /ces pa ltar/ brjod bya'i yul gang rung zhig la rjod byed kyi tshig nyams phun tshogs pas tshig sbyor snyan zhing mdzes par byed pa zhig snyan ngag gi rgyan du 'dod pa bzhin/ ka rtsom yang gtso bo bod yig gi gsal byed sum cu tham pa kho nas rgyan gyi nyams thon dgos par brten der ka phreng gi rgyan 398

nam kā li'i rgyan zhes ming btags kyang / ka rtsom snyan ngag de ka phreng gi bdag nyid can yin pas 'gal ba ci yang med snyam/ yin na yang kha cig gis ka phreng gi rgyan zhes rgyan bye brag cig tu mi 'dzin par snyan ngag me long las bstan pa'i sgra rgyan gyi khongs su gtogs par 'dod kyang / me long ma las bshad pa'i sgra rgyan ni sgra don gnyis las sgra'i nyams gtso bo 'don pa'i tshig sbyor zhig yin pa dang /ka phreng gi rgyan ni sgra'i nyams gtso bo 'don pa ma yin par gsal byed sum cu go rim yod pa'i sgo nas spel ba'i rtsom tshul khyad par ba zhig yin pas de gnyis kyi khyad par zhib tu brjod na 'di ltar/ sgra rgyan las bstan pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan de ni rjod byed kyi sgra la yi ge dang tshig ci rigs zung ldan te gnyis re bsgrigs nas tshig mdzes par byed pa yin pas ka phreng gi rgyan dang mi 'dra zhing / chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan yang tshig 'dra ba gnyis kyi bar du tshig gzhan gyis chod pa dang ma chod pa zung du 'brel nas brtsams pa'i sgra'i nyams ldan zhig yin pas ka phreng gi rgyan dang mi 'dra/ dbyangs nges pa'i sgra rgyan las dbyangs a nges pa'i rgyan dang / ka phreng gi rgyan las dbyangs med pa'i ka phreng gi rgyan gnyis dbyangs nges pa'am dbyangs med pa 'dra yang / sgra rgyan gyi skabs su gsal byed kyi yi ge rnams rim pa bzhin thon mi dgos shing cig shos la ka phreng gi rgyan gyis nges par spras dgos pa'i khyad par yod pa bzhin gnas nges pa'i sgra rgyan dang / gsal byed nges pa/ kun 'khor sogs dang khyad par yod pa zur bltas leb mthong du song bas re re bzhin bgrang ba'i ngal ba mi bya'o/ /mdor na / ka rtsom snyan ngag dang ka phreng gi rgyan ni don spyi mi 'dra ba gnyis ste/ gong du brjod zin pa ltar ka rtsom snyan ngag ni sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi rtsom lus shig tu byas 399

pa'i snyan ngag gi nang gses shig yin la/ de ni ngag rgyun la ka bshad dam ka phreng zhes grags pa de'o/ /ka phreng gi rgyan ni bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i tshig rgyan sbyor stangs shig ste/ ka rtsom snyan ngag de nyid 'grub par byed pa dang mdzes par byed pa'i gsal byed sum cu'i rgyan zhig la go dgos/ ka rtsom snyan ngag ni gtso bo gsal byed sum cus tshig sbyor mdzes par byed pa zhig yin pas/ka phreng gi rgyan de snyan ngag me long las bstan pa'i rgyan gyi khongs su bsdus na mi 'grig ces logs su ka phreng gi rgyan du 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang der thug pa yin/bzhi / ka rtsom snyan ngag 'bri skabs do snang dgos sa/spyir ka rtsom snyan ngag 'bri dus gtso bo ka phreng gi yi ge de dag re re bzhin nges par du go don ldan pa zhig dang / snyan zhing 'jebs la tshig gi gra snyom po zhig yong bar do snang gzab cing nan pa byed dgos pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig yin mod/ gtso bo gsham gsal 'di dag la mnyam par bzhag na legs par sems/1 ka rtsom snyan ngag 'bri skabs/ dang thog ka phreng gi yi ge rkyang ba de tshor go don dang tshig gi 'brel ba nges can zhig cis kyang ldan par do snang byed dgos / yi ge kā la'i phreng ba rnams la go don 'brel chags pa zhig bsgrub dgos na/ dpe cha dang ka rtsom grags can mang po blta klog dang 'tsho ba'i myong ba las ming tshig gsog 'jog brda dag rnams las yi ge rkyang ba dang 'brel ba'i go don rnams ma 'dres par rtogs pa la 'bad dgos/ de ltar bsgrub tshe 400

ka rtsom 'bri ba'i tha snyad kyi dbul 'phongs sel nus/2 ka rtsom snyan ngag 'bri dus ka phreng ched du sgrig pa'i tshor snang med par tshig sbyor rang bzhin gyis grub pa lta bu zhig yong bar do snang byed dgos/ de ltar thon tshe rtsom rtsal gyi khyad nus des klog pa po rnams kyi yid la sgyu rtsal gyi ro mchog dang rtsom nyams rtse dga' bskrun pa ma zad/ brjod bya'i nang don rnams snying la sim pa zhig gter srid/3 bod kyi brda rnying nang nas cung go bde zhing gson nyams dang ldan pa'i ming tshig 'ga' yid la 'dzin par byed dgos/ dper na/ rgyu nor la ka ca dang —/ bzhad gad la ga zha/ cha rgyus med pa la cha med/ btsod mdog la ja hong —/ ngan pa la tha ran/ go cha la ya lad/ ces pa lta bu'i brda rnying ka bshad la spyad rung ba zhig yin/ de min dmangs khrod kyi kha skad nang nas dper na/ka re ko re dang / kha ne khon ne/ ga be gob be/ nga ge ngog ge zhes pa lta bu gsal byed kyi yi ge dang 'brel ba'i ming tshig gi rigs de dag kyang skabs bstun gyis sbyor mkhas byung na ka rtsom snyan ngag gi ming tshig phun sum je tshogs dang —/ rtsom tshul gson nyams ldan pa/ tshig grub kyi mthun sbyor 'debs yul gyi khyad chos mtshon pa sogs dge mtshan du ma mchis so/ /4 tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs min dang don snga phyi 'brel chags min la bsam blo btang nas rdo chags btsan bsgrigs lta bu mi byed par mnyam par 'jog dgos / spyir ka kha'i go rim ma 'chol ba dang gsal byed kyi yi ge rkyang ba rnams rim pa ltar bsgrigs nus na shin tu legs mod kyang / tshig gi gong 'og 'brel mi chags shing don mi 'byor tshe/ 'phul brtsegs 'dogs dbyangs gang rung 401

zhig sbyar nas thabs mkhas kyis ming gzhi'i yi ge gsal byed kyi tshab byas kyang mi chog pa med de/ dper na/ (chos rgyal nor bzang gi rnam thar〉las/bka' las byas pa can gyi a ma'i bu chung nor bzang / /kha la nyan pa'i bu chung byang nas 'khor ba yag byung / /zhes dang / bu mo rgya las lhag pa'i lha sras mdzes ldan lha mo/ /ma ngas steng phyogs lha mi gtong ka byung song / /zhes pa lta bu/ ka phreng gi rgyan sbyor tshe gsal byed sum cu nges par tshang dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang ma mtha' yang gsal byed kyi sde ba gcig cha tshang bar ma thon na ka rtsom snyan ngag tu mi 'gyur bar snyam mo//dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(1) (rje rin po che'i snyan rtsom gces btus/〉(2) (dpal don grub rgyal gyi gsung 'bum pod gsum pa/〉(3) a lags tshe tan zhabs drung tshang gi snyan ngag spyi don/〉(4) bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs las snyan ngag gi rnam bshad/〉(5) chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis bris pa'i ka bshad rtsom rig skor cung zad gleng ba/〉(6) (ka rtsom dang snyan ngag me long las bstan pa'i sgra rgyan gyi khyad par brjod pa/ 〉bod ljongs zhib 'jug 1995lo'i deb gnyis pa las gsal/(7) 1994lo'i bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉deb dang bo/(8) (thon mi'i zhal lung /〉402

bod yul la bsngags pa zhes bya ba las 'phros pa'i gtam/sha bo klu rgyal/de ring phran gyi gleng gzhir gyur pa'i bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa'i sdeb legs tshig gi phreng ba 'di ni/ kha ba ri ba'i yul gyi shes rig gi byung rabs khrod paṇ+ḍi ta'i cho lo thog mar bdag gir bzhes shing / lnga zung rig pa'i gnas kyi rnam bzhag gi lam chen gsar 'byed pa/ nga brgyad ma'i spobs pas mkhas pa'i bya ba rdo rje'i shugs kyis lta ngan gyi brag ri bshig mkhas sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa'i tshe brtsams la/ khong nyid kyi rnam thar gzhan du gsal bas 'dir rgyas par mi spro mod/ 'on kyang / h+pha ran se'i mkhas chen de'u na'i(5 rlu 141smostu 2༅12050212 222421)sgyu rtsal gyi mtshan nyid rig pa zhes pa'i bstan bcos khrod brtsams chos la rgyus mnga' byed dgos tshe / brtsams chos skrun mkhan gyi mi rigs dang / brtsams chos la thebs pa'i yul srol goms 'gros kyi bag chags/ brtsams chos byung yul gyi khor yug bcas la gzhan las lhag pa'i sgo nas zhib 'jug byed dgos/① zhes gsungs pa ma zad/ gna' bo'i ko ru'i brkos bzhengs sgyu rtsal la gong gi thabs lam ltar rigs rus dang / dus rabs/ lam lugs bcas phyogs gsum du bgos 403

te dpyad pas gsal cha zhib tu thon yod/ de bas/ sa paṇa gyi rtsom 'di byung ba'i khor lug la gzhigs nas brtsams chos la blta rgyu gal che bar sems/sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag(1182)lor sa skyar 'khrungs shing / rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags phag(1251)lor lang cir sku gshegs/ khong nyid 'tsho bzhugs gnang ba'i skabs/spyir 'dzam pa'i gling la bltas nas bshad na ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i dus shig yin/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung yul du grub pa'i rgya gar snga mo nas kha che chos lugs kyis btsan gyis dbang bsgyur/ ma ha tsi na ru grags pa'i rgya nag gtso byas pa'i e sha ya'i gling phran las 'das pa'i 'dzin ma'i khyon phal cher sog po'i stobs kyis kha lo bsgyur bzhin mchis/ nub gling dus rabs bar ma'i bkag sdom gyi rgya las grol la nye ba'i dus su babs pa'i skabs der/ bod kyi yul 'dir srid phyogs su lha sras dar ma'i nang bstan bsgrubs pa rgyu rkyen rten 'brel dang bcas te lha lung dpal rdor gyis bod kyi rgyal brgyud bcad nas kha 'thor lung 'thor du song /de bas/ chab srid thog gcig gyur gyi bdag po med pa'i rkyen gyis rig gnas dang bsam blo'i steng yang gcig gyur gyi tshad gzhi dang / bkag rgya sogs dben pa'i phyi rkyen kyis rdzong gog ltar chags pa'i gangs ri ra ba'i ljongs su me tog mnyam bzhad dang mkhas brgya 'gran gleng gi rnam pa ngo mas rgya gar/ ta zig bal bo/ kha che/ bhaṅga la sogs kyi mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa dag rang yul kha ba ri bo'i ljongs su gdan drangs nas snga 'gyur bstan bcos rnams la dag ther dang bod du ma 'gyur ba'i gzhung rnams lo tsā byed pa 404

dang —/ 'chad nyan spel ba/ de min kun slong bzang zhing blo rig gsal ba'i bu phrug dag phyi yul du mngags nas mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gi nying bcud skor tshur rang yul du nang 'dren byed pa/ de ma zad 'chad nyan byas pa brgyud rtsod pa sogs kyi thabs kyis bka' dang bstan bcos dag bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin gtan la phab cing / bstan bcos dgongs 'grel dang mtha' dpyod sogs brtsams nas bod rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i lam du 'bad pa'i mtho rlabs dgung du 'phyur ba'i dus skabs 'di lta bu 'dzam gling shes rig lo rgyus thog u dum wa ra'i 'dab rgya grol ba ltar shin tu dkon no/ /de lta bu'i rig gnas kyi rgyab ljongs khrod bod yul la bsngags pa zhes bya ba 'di byung bas/ bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos la ngang gis dus skabs de'i khor yug gi byin gyis rlabs srid/ dper na/ rtsom gyi sgrig stangs thad nas bshad na/ rtsom gyi mgo ru seskreta'i oswastisidhi zhes pa'i dbu 'khyud cing /mgo mjug gnyis su mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba sogs tshigs su bcad de grub pa'i 'bri srol 'di sangs rgyas kyi bka' yi rtsom srol las 'phel ba / dper na/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs zhes pa las de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang / gza' mi bzad pa'i gzugs can shin tu khro ba dang / shin tu 'jigs pa byed rnams kyi mchod pa dang —/ mchod yon dang bzlos brjod pa gsang las kyang gsang ba ngas bshad do / /②zhes pa las rtsom par dam bca' ba'i 'bri stangs mngon/ 'o na/ sa paṇa ni mchod brjod dang dam bca' ba'i 'bri srol bod du thog mar sbyar mkhan du gyur ram zer na mi 'thad de/ rtsom rig gzhung lugs thog mkhas mchog 'di 405

bas dang por bstan pa tsam las/ snga ma slob dpon thon mis sum cu pa'i rtsa bar bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / /rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /①zhes legs par sdeb yod do/ /rtsom gyi bar du yon tan rmad du byung ba yid 'phrog pa'i cha byad dad pa'i yid kyis bstod pa'i tshig gi rnam par g.yo ba'i dar dir gyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs kyis gtibs pa kun nas khyab pa/ sogs lta bu rgya(gar)rtsom gyi shan zhugs pa ma zad/ bltas ma thag tu tshur 'gyur 'ong ba'am bshu 'bri byas pa lta bu'i 'du shes shig 'char/ khyad par du sman mdo zhes bya ba lta bu'i khrod lhag tu mang / yin yang / kho bos 'dir ngal ba byed pa ni sa paṇa khong nyid la mtshon na sku na phra ba'i dus nas seskreta gtso byas pa'i phyi nang rig gnas kun la thos pa rgya cher btsal nas bag chags zab mo bzhag pa ma zad/ rang gzhan gyi rig gnas bar dpyad bsdur byas te rang nyid kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsom gshis shig dang / lhag tu kha ba ri ba'i ljongs 'dir rtsom srol gsar ba zhig chags thub par nan gyis tshod lta byed bzhin mchis par sems/ dper na/khong nyid mchog gi phyis kyi legs bshad rin po che'i gter zhes pa ni rgya gar gyi rtsom srol zhig bod skad steng gnas spor byas pa'i tshod lta phul byung zhig tu 'khums/de min mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba dag 'di ltar tshod lta byas pa ni grags pa'i zer sgros su ma grub par/ khong nyid mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i nang du/ bstan bcos byed pa'i dam pa yis/ /ston pa la ni mchod brjod bya/ /bstan pa spel phyir dag pa'i tshig /'di la dad pa bzang po 406

mthong —// dam bca' ba dang bskul tshig sogs/ /'chad phyir spro ba ston pa ste / /mchog rtogs 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ /khas len pa la 'gal ba red / /②ces pa bzhin rtsom pa po rang gi rgyud la 'byung ba dang / bshad nyan byed pa gzhan gyi rgyud la thob pa/ gzhung 'chad pa la spro ba ston pa/ rtsom mthar phyin pa sogs kyi dgos pa dag gzhung dang lag len zung gi steng nas gsal bar mkhyen cing bstan pa la 'u cag rjes rabs pas khong nyid mchog gi ngal ba la nges shes cung tsam skye dgos par 'os/deng dus kyi rig gsar dar spel gyi 'phrin las la brel ba'i tha snyad pa 'gas sa paṇa la sogs ni bag chags rnying bas yongs su gos pas/ kho tshos brtsams chos dag la zhib 'jug byas kyang nga tsho'i 'tsho gzhes la rngo mi thogs pa ma zad/ da dung bag chags rnying pa'i dra rgya las grol bar gegs su 'gro srid/de las deng rabs kyi rtsom rig gsar ba dag la dpyad brjod re bris te /phyag rjes gsar ba zhig bsnan na legs zhes bsam mod/ kho bo'i sems su mi rigs shig la mtshon na 'tsho gzhes kyi gnad don dngos nas gal che mod/ gal te mi rigs shig gi khyad chos med gyur na 'tsho gzhes ji ltar gya nom pa byung yang mi rigs rang grub kyi mtshan nyid dben no/ /de bas/ shes ldan mi sna'i gral du tshud phyin rang nyid kyi rtsam khug nang gi rgyags phye'i mang nyung gis mi rigs kyi 'tsho gzhes mnyam gleng mi byed par/ 'das song gi rig gnas la bag chags mang tsam bzhag nas rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyi phyogs re re'i las sne zhig la 'jus te don dngos thog 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi don gnyer ba zhig byed rgyu gal che/ tag tag phran gyis lab zin pa'i mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam 407

bca' ba'ang kho bos rnying hril du gyur pa'i rtsom gyi sgrig srol zhig tu mi sems te/mig sngar phyi gling dang rang rgyal gang du ches grags che ba'i brtsams chos phal cher gyi ldeb ma dang bo'i steng yig 'bru chen pos deb 'di byams ldan gyi a mar mchod do/ /yang na nga'i ma yum slob grwar mchod do zhes pa sogs ha cang mang ba ma zad/ lo 'di 'ga'i ring lhag tu rgyugs che/ gzhan rtsom par dam bca' ba'ang de las lhag tu le'u zhig gsar du bstsal nas gzhung 'chad pa la spro ba ston pa sogs kyi dgos pa nyog ring zhig sbyar ba dus tshod dang / dngos shugs ci rigs kyi 'gro song che ba las gzhan gyi khyad par ci 'dug pa kho bo'i ngal bas btsal kyang ma rnyed do/ /'di ltar bsdur tshe bod kyi mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' lta bu sogs kyi rtsom srol de bas kyang tshad mar grub pas/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi 'phrin las spel mi thub kyang gad phyags khrod 'dor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan spu tsam yang mi ldan no/ /bye brag snyan ngag gi lo rgyus la bltas tshe bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa ni btsan po'i dus skabs su dar che ba'i mgur gyi rtsom rtsal thun mong ma yin pa rnams 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi jo bo rje'i bstod pa zhes pa dang /lhag par du rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur dag gis rgyun 'dzin brgyud/bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa'i rtsom 'di la rtsom gyi sgyu rtsal dang bsam blo sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas 'du shes dang kha dbugs gsar ba bsnan te gsar gtod kyi lam du 'bad pa'i dus su babs pa dang / phyis bod kyi snyan ngag la shugs rkyen cher thebs pa'i snyan gzhung me long ma zhes pa'ang da dung dar med pa'i bar brgal gyi dus shig la byung bas/ bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa 408

la srol rgyun mgur dang rtsom pa po khong nyid seskreta'i bag chags zab pa dang bstun snyan ngag me long ma'i gzhung gi tshig rgyan gyi skor la rgyus mnga' che ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis brtsams chos 'di la phyogs gnyis kyi yon tan gcig 'dus kyi gong bu zhig tu 'khums/ spyir sgyu rtsal la dbyangs kyi sgyu rtsal dang ris bris sgyu rtsal / bzo dbyibs kyi sgyu rtsal/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/ 'dres ma'i sgyu rtsal sogs su dbye ba deng dus 'dzam gling yongs su grags mod/ nga tsho'i gleng gzhir gyur ba ni rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi khongs gtogs snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos yin/snyan gzhung me long ma ru 'di la lus rgyan srog gsum du 'bod/ bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa rtsom stangs srol rgyun mgur gyi gnas bstod kyi tshul du grub mod / 'on kyang / rtsom lus thad mgur gyi gnas bstod dang khyad par yod/btsan po'i dus skabs kyi mgur gyi khrod bzhugs pa'i gnas bshad dam phyis kyi gnas bstod dag phal cher tshigs bcad kyi rnam par chags/ dper na/ ti se n-i gangs kyis brun/ /na ning n-i gzhe ning sngon/ /ma pang n-i mtsho 'gram nas/ /ngang dang n-i ngur byer pa/ /zhes pa dang / ngang ngur ni gser ma g.yu/ /mthing brang ni chab gi rkyen/ /min tog ni hwa lo thon/ /ne'u gsing ni spang kyi rgyan/ /spang rgyan ni mthon gyi bkra/ /bzang ldan ni lus la 'tshogs/ /blta sdug ni dmyig lam bkra/ /spos dri ni shangs na gda'/ /① zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rtsom lus thad bod yul la bsngags pa zhes bya ba ltar gnas bstod bcad lhug spel mar bkod pa bstan bcos gzhan du re gnyis bzhugs mod/ phal cher tshigs bcad du sbyar/ de min rtsom gyi srog gam bsam blo dang gnas bstod byed tshul thad kyang 'gyur ldog byung yod pa/ dper na/ nam mkha'i rdzong 409

gi pho brang na/ /steng na lho sprin smug po 'thibs/ /'og na gtsang chab sngon mo 'bab / /rgyab na brag dmar nam mkha'i dbyings/ /mdun na spang bo me tog bkra / / zur na gcan gzan ngar skad 'don/ /logs la bya rgyal rgod po lding //mkha' la sbrang char zil ma 'bab/ /rgyun du bung bas glu dbyangs len/ /sha rkyang ma bus rtse bro brdungs/ /spra dang spre'us yang rtsal sbyong / /co ka ma bu 'gyur skad mang —/ /lha bya gong mos glu dbyangs len/ /rdza chab bsil mas snyan pa brjod/ /dus kyi skad rigs nyams kyi grogs/ /gnas 'di'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /nyams dga' glu ru blangs pa yin/ /② lta bu tshig gi sdeb sbyor dang / /rgyan gyi bkod pa sogs kyis snyan ngag gi nyams snang 'char yan du rgyu ba'i phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan ldan mod/ 'di'i rigs phal cher 'di ltar gtso bo phyi'i bkod pa 'bri bzhengs byas pa brgyud yul lam gnas de'i ngo mtshar brjod/deng rabs rgya'i rtsom rig smra ba'i seng ge sku zhabs le'u tse tha'u(mo1༅zo)mchog gis gshis rgyud grub tshul gyi rnam bshad((ṣ+ṭha ༅bye〉〉)ces bya ba'i nang du 'dzam gling gi rtsom rig spyi'i 'phel phyogs ni/ gtam rgyud kyi byung rim gtsor gyur pa'i thog ma'i dus dang / mi sna'i gshis ku'i bzhengs skrun gtsor gyur pa bar ma'i dus/ sems khams kyi 'tshol dpyod gtsor gyur pa tha ma'i dus yinanyuzer ba/ gtso gnad don brjod rang bzhin gyi rtsom rigs(brtsams sgrung lta bu)la 'jug pas/ mig sngar gyi dpyad gzhir gyur pa bcad lhug spel mas grub pa'i bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa la cher mi 'phrod mod/ ma mthar yang sgyu rtsom 'di nyid srol rgyun mgur gyi gtam rgyud gtso bor 'dzin pa dang phyi'i bkod pa rkyang rkyang 'bri bzhengs byed pa'i gnas bstod dag gi sbrum las rab tu 'phags 410

te nang bcud kyi sems can kyi khams las grub pa'i dwangs ma lugs gnyis blang dor la mkhas pa dam pa'i chos kyi grib bsil snum pas phyogs kyi 'khor lo bgengs pa/ bcu phrag snang ba'i 'od zhags dkar pos dam du 'khyud pa sogs dngos yod kyi brjod gzhi dag rnam par bkod de ngag rig 'khrigs pa'i tshig tshogs kyis rab tu rgyan pa'i cha 'di la/ ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bshes gnyen chen po'i dpung gi ngag tu grags pas/ rjod byed tshig la sbyor mkhas sa paṇa mchog /don gyi gting dpog bu ston rin chen grub/ /tshig don gnyis la mkhas pa rje bla ma/ /zhes pa yongs su bden par grub min kun gyi dogs gzhi yin mod / sa paṇa mchog rjod byed tshig gi sbyor rtsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa grub mtha' ris med kyis rjes su yi rang byed yul du gyur pa bzhin phyogs las rnam par rgyal zhing sems khams kyi gsos sman lta bu'i rig pa la nan gyis bsngags te / sems khams kyi skyon yon dang / dge sdig bzang ngan/ yo srang sogs ngos zin nas ma rig pa'i gnyen po shes rab kyi rtsal rdzogs dgos pa rtsom gyi mjug tu/ de ltar sgo gsum mkha' ltar dwangs pa la/ /shar ba'i bsdebs legs tshig gi bsil zer can/ /dri med zla ba ltar dkar dge ba gang / /des ni 'gro kun 'jam dbyangs 'dra bar shog /ces pa bzhin gsal/ lhag par du khong nyid kyi legs bshad rin po che'i gter zhes pa deng rabs rtsom rig smra ba'i gzhung gi srang mda' la gzhal tshe rang gshis kyi skyon yon zung ldan gyi gong bu lta bur grub pa'i mi'i sems khams lta ci/ tha na srog chags kyi sems khams kyang phra zhing zhib pa'i 'tshol dpyod byas yod pa dag rnam dpyod can dag gi mig gi bdud rtsi ru 'gro nges/ de bas/ deng skabs bod kyi brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom 411

byed mkhan dag la mtshon na mi sna'i sems khams 'tshol dpyod bya bar dpe mtshon gyi dge mtshan chen po ldan no/ /dor zhi rin po che mchog gis/ snyan ngag gi khyad chos su dga' skyo chags sdang khong nas brdol ba'i rlabs/ /rang byung lhun grub gdangs su 'phos pa'i dbyangs / /yid kyi mtsho mo skyom byed bskal pa'i rlung / /brjod 'dod zhing du rnam shes 'pho ba'i lam/ /②zhes gsungs pa bzhin bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa byung ba'i rgyab ljongs sngon la bshad zin pa ltar skabs der bod du rig gnas la mthong chen sbyang brtson byed pa'i mtho rlabs gsar ba zhig bslangs pas / rtsom pa po rang nyid rig pa'i gnas la don gnyer byed pa zhig yin pa'i cha dang / khyad par du dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa'i sa paṇa la mtshon na thos pa rgya cher 'tshol ba'i dus yin pa ma zad/ khong gi dgongs pa bzhin shes bya'i gnas kun thugs kyi bum par bkang thub pa'i rten 'brel khor yug 'dis sgrig pas / gnas mchog 'di la bsngags pa'i dga' ba brag srubs nas bung ba'i bkod ma'i chu dang chu mig bzhin brdol ba/ khong gis thos bsam gyi bag chags zab pa'i mkhyen rtsal gyis rtsom gyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi tshig dang yig 'bru'i bar lhog lhog tu 'phyur ba mngon par gsal ba/ rtsom mjug tu'ang /kho bo'i blo gsal dri med chu gtsang las/ /byung ba'i bstod tshig pad+mo'i phreng mdzes pa/ /legs sbyar ngag gi ze'u 'brus rab brgyan pa'i/ /phreng ba 'di ni rdzogs sangs rgyas la 'bul/ /zhes pa ltar shugs drag po'i tshor 'du brjod 'dod kyi gzhi ngag rig 'phrul gyis bstan pa mngon par snang ngo / /yang —/ bcos min shugs dran sems snang srog med na/ /tshig sbyor spu 412

mdog mdzes kyang gser mong ro/ /ngo mtshar rtog btags gshog zung ma skyes na / /sa la 'khyer 'gros byed pa'i bye'u phrug nyid/ /① ces pa bzhin bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa'i nang sa steng dpag bsam ljon shing rab bskyed ces/ /lcug phran smyu gu'i tshogs rnams cis mi bskyed/ /lta bu dga' skyo chags snang sogs yid kyi bcos min bden pa dang / tshor ba btang snyoms su ma 'khyil bar zhen pa shugs drag pas yongs su gtams pa ma zad/ rtog ge'i rigs pas yongs su spud de srog zhugs pa'i g.yu 'brug bzhin rab tu brjid/ yang dper na/ 'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la/ /nyi zer phra ba'i cha shas 'jug pa ltar/ /zhes pa dang / sa'i cha glang po'i spyi gcug ltar mtho la skye dgu ma lus pa'i sgron me/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gza' las thar ba ltar rdul dang bral bas gtsang ba'i 'jug ngogs dang ldan pa / bsil ba'i sgra dbyangs nye bar sgrogs pa'i chu klung dri ma med pa 'bab pa dang ldan pa'i 'gram ngogs/ bod yul 'dir/ thugs rjes dpag tu med pas bskal pa brjod kyis mi langs par smon lam rgya mtsho'i rdul dang mtshungs pa 'byongs pas bsod nams dri ma med pa'i chu klung 'byung ba'i sdong bu rnam par rgyas pa sogs ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i rtog btags kyi nyams dang snang ba 'char yan du rgyu ba'i sems kyi rnyed snang dngos yod kyi kha ba'i ljongs su ji bzhin chags pa'i phyi'i bkod pa dang nang gi bcud 'di bzhin no zhes gzugs rgyan sogs me long ma'i dngos bstan dang shugs kyi rgyan yongs su spras pa ma zad/ rab tu bstan nas mdzes chas kyis yongs su phyug pa'i na chung sgeg mo'i lang tsho yi gnyan du 'gro/ 'on kyang / snyan ngag gi dpe'am rgyan gang bkod yod pa dag rdzi bos nor lug tshang brtsi byed pa'i las 413

kyi rjes su 'gro bar sems nas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhagamador na/ khong gis rang nyid la sbyar ba'i/ shes bya'i mkha' la thogs pa med rgyu zhing / /phas rgol nyi zla'i gzi brjid bza' nus kyang / /rtag tu skye bo kun gyis ma mthong bas/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i sgra gcan 'dra/ /⑫zhes pa'i ngag rig 'di las 'phros pa'i rnam dpyod kyi gzi 'od ltar bod yul la bsngags pa'ang mkhas dbang dag gi yid dbang 'phrog pa/ sa skya'i gdung rabs ngo mtshar bang mdzod ces pa las 'phags pa'i lung / rtsom pa 'di 'dra myur 'jug pa/ /glog 'gyur bas kyang ches myur zhing / /rtsol ba med par 'byung ba ni/ /mtsho ltar ngang gis lhun grub lags/ /de don phun sum tshogs gyur pa/ /rlom chen zlo yi dbang po mchog /'gas kyang sngon chad ma dpyad pa/ /dpyod ldan gang gis rnam dpyad pa/ /yid gsal bgyid pa gangs ri'i rtser/ /nyi ma shar ba lta bu ste/ /kun nas dga' ba bskyed pa ni/ /bsam gtan ro myong lta bur mchis//zhes pa'i gsung la sbyar nas rtsom pa rnams kyang 'bad rtsol la mi ltos par 'byung ba dang / tshig nyung ngus kyang don rgya chen po ston pa dang / blun pos bltos na go sla bas don gsal ba dang / tshig rgyan bzang pos mkhas pa rnams yid 'phrog par byed pa dang / mkhas par rlom pa brgya'i blo gros phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pas kyang dpyod par mi nus pa'i don zab mo ston pa yinaris gsungs pa don la gnas shing 'char yan dang dngos yod ring lugs gnyis tshad mtho'i zung sbrel las byon pa'i snyan tshig ngag gi rig rtsal 'dis sa paṇa gyi rtsom stobs rjen par ston no/ /414

mtshan 'grel/()bod yul la bsngags pa zhes pa'i brtsams chos 'di rin chen rdo rje yi bod kyi dus rabs rim byung gi rtsom yig gces bsdus〉 kyi shog ngos 15—20bar bzhugs pa de nyid bdams/rjode'u na'i sgyu rtsal gyi mtshan nyid rig pa〉 yi shog ngos 70— 104steng bzhugs/pa/ 'di ni1998lo'i zla bcu par thog mar an we rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dpe skrun khang gis ba na(/)1996lo'i(krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉 gi deb gnyis pa'i shog ngos 89steng bzhuga~X/1982lo'i zla bcu par mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis thog mar bton pa'i(si tu'i 'grel chen〉 gyi shog grangs1steng bzhugs/()1981lo'i zla drug par mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis thog mar bton pa'i sa paṇa gyi mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo〉 yi shog grangs 6—7steng bzhugs/()2001lo'i zla bzhi par kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis thengs gnyis par bton pa'i gnya' gong dkon mchog tshe brtan gyi(bod kyi brda rnying yig cha rtsa chen bdams bsgrigs rnams kyi tshig don kun nas khrol bar byas pa rab gsal me long〉 gi shog grangs 335steng bzhugs/()2001lo'i zla dang por mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis thog mar bton pa'i rin chen rdo rje yi bod kyi dus rabs rim byung gi rtsom yig gces bsdus〉 kyi shog ngos 428steng bzhugs/()1986lo'i zla bdun par hrang tshe rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dpe skrun khang gis thog mar bton pa'i le'u tse tha'u yi gshes rgyud grub tshul gyi rnam bshad〉 kyi shog ngos 33steng bzhugs/415

()()1992lo'i zla bzhi par mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis thengs gnyis par dpar du bton pa'i snyan ngag gi rnam bshad〉 kyi shog ngos 265—266steng bzhugs/(/)/ 1986lo'i zla gnyis par mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis thog mar bton pa'i sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen bang mdzod〉 kyi shog ngos 95dang 105gnyis kyi steng du bzhugs/

ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag che long du brjod pa nag po 'gro shes/dngos grub sgrol ma/gcig spyir rtsom yig ces pa'i go don dang rtsom yig gi grub rkyen gsum/1 go don/rtsom du 'jug pa'i las dang bo ba zhig yin phyir spyir btang gi rtsom yig ces pa'i go don dang grub rkyen dag rags pa zhig shes dgos par brten ha lam 'chad par bya ste/ rtsom yig ces par sgra yangs 'jug dang dog 'jug gnyis yod/ dang bo ltar na rtsom spyi la 'jug cing gnyis pa ltar na sgyu rtsom ma yin pa'i rtsom yig thung gras yod do cog la 'jug par bshad do/ /2 tsom yig gi grub rkyen gsum/rtsom yig gang 'dra zhig yin yang der bsam blo nges can zhig dang rgyu cha nges can zhig /mtshon thabs nges can zhig spyad yod pas bsam blo/ rgyu cha/mtshon thabs bcas la rtsom yig gi grub rkyen gsum du mi rnams 'dod/rtsom yig gi bsam blo zhes pa ni rtsom yig gis mtshon par byas pa'i nang don de yin/ spyir btang rtsom yig gcig gis gnad don gcig thag gcod 417

dang —/ nang don gcig mtshon pa yin phyir rtsom yig gi brjod bya ci 'dra'i phun sum tshogs kyang nang don gtso bor dmigs te 'bri dgos phyin nang don gtso bo der snying bo'i nang don nam snying don zer/ skabs rer sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi bshad tshul ltar brjod bya'i dgongs don nam srog kyang zer ro/ / rtsom stangs ma 'dra na brjod bya'i snying don gyi go don yang mi 'dra ba 'byung ste / spyir btang rtsom yig la mtshon na/ dgag sgrub rtsom yig tu lta ba zhig mtshon la/ gsal bshad rtsom yig tu shes bya zhig mtshon/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig tu gnas tshul cung rnyog 'dzing che ste/ ji bzhin brjod pas gtso bo gzugs brnyan ldan pa'i sgo nas klog pa po'i yid sems bskul dgos shing / la las rtsom yig tu 'dod tshul bstan yod mod/ kha shas su mi mngon zhing gsal la mi gsal bar 'dug de las gsar 'gyur rtsom yig lta bus gnas tshul gsar ba re mtshon zhing / klog pa por don zhig byung ba bshad pa las gzhan med do/ /rtsom yig ma bris pa'i sngon la brjod snying gtan khel yong bar byed dgos/de la nyams par 'jog dgos pa'i gnad don gsum ste/ dang bo/ dmigs gtad kyi rang bzhin yod dgos shing klog pa pos nyams 'jog byed sa de bdams dgos/ gnyis pa/ nang don gsar ba dgos pa las gzhan zer tshig zlos khyer mi rung / gsum pa/ gnad du bsdus pa yin dgos/ grams che na bsdu mi thub pas rtsom yig gcig tu gnad don gcig bris na bzang / rgyu cha ni/ mi/don / ljongs/ grangs 'bol/ tshang mas khas len pa'i gnas lugs sogs dang ske/rang nyid kyi lta ba dang bsam blo'i snying don mtshon par phan thog dang ram 418

'degs nyan byed tshang ma rtsom yig gi rgyu cha byas chog chog cig yin/rtsom yig gi rgyu cha bdams gses byed par mnyam 'jog byed dgos sa bzhi mchis te/gcig na rtsom gyi snying don mtshon par phan dgos/ gnyis na dper mtshon thub dgos/ de ni rgyu cha rigs gcig las ches dper mtshon gyi rang bzhin ldan pa dang gnad don ches gsal bshad thub pa'i rigs dag bdams nas bkol dgos pa de yin/ gsum na bden pa yin dgos/ don dag byung byung tshang ma mthong thos myong gsum dka' na'ang rgyu cha'i 'byung khungs las don gyi bden rdzun dbye thub pa dgos/ bzhi na gsar zhing gson nyams ldan dgos/klog pa pos blta 'dod pa'i rgyu cha yin na/ da gzod klog pa por bags chags zab mo zhig 'jog thub/rtsom yig gi mtshon tshul ni sgrig gzhi dang mtshon thabs sogs 'du ste/sgrig gzhi ni rtsom yig gi rus sgrom dang rtsom yig gi khag so so'i bar gyi 'brel ba ste rgyun par bshad pa'i sngon tu ci zhig 'bri dgos pa dang mjug tu ci zhig bshad dgos pa de'o/ /rtsom yig gang 'dra zhig yin rung sgrig gzhi bkod sgrig byed gzhi ni gnyis ste gcig ni phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos kyi gnas tshul ngo ma dang —/ gcig ni mi rnams kyi shes rtogs kyi chos nyid do/ /de gnyis 'os 'tsham gyis zung 'brel byed dgos/mtshon thabs ni rtsom yig skad chas mtshon par zhib rjod byas pa'i rnam pa zhig ste/ mtshon thabs su zhib 'bri/ zhib brjod/ gsal bshad/ bgro gleng /'gyur brjod bcas rigs lnga yod/ rtsom yig phal che bar mtshon thabs rnams 419

bsres nas bkol mod mtshon par byed pa'i dgos par brten rtsom lus rigs gcig pa'i rtsom yig tu dus rgyun mtshon thabs gtso bo gnyis bkol gyin yod/ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig tu zhib brjod mang zhing zhib 'bri bkol la/gsal bshad rtsom yig tu gsal bshad mang tsam/ dgag sgrub rtsom yig tu bgro gleng mang tsam bkol bar byed do/ /gnyis / ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi go don dang khyad chos/1 go don/ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig ni spyir mi dang bya ba/ dngos po'i rnam pa dang yul ljongs sogs ji bzhin du 'khod pa'i rtsom yig gcig la zer zhing /rtsom stangs 'di dus rtag tu mi rnams kyis 'tsho ba'i nang bkol spyod byed pa ha cang khyab che ste/ mi rnams kyis nyin re bzhin ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi rang bzhin ltar phan tshun gleng mol bgyid bzhin yod pa dang / gnas tshul gsar ba brjod pa dang / mig dper 'os pa'i mi sna'i mdzad 'phrin dril bsgrags pa/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i ri klung dag la bstod bsngags byed pa sogs mdzad sgo mang po'i mtshon thabs la rtsom stangs 'di nyid med du mi rung ba zhig yin par brten/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig legs po zhig 'bri shes na rtsom gyi rigs phal mo che'i rmang gzhi lta bu yin pas nga tshos nges par slob sbyong gzab nan bgyis nas rtsom tshul 'dis nges cha yong bar byas na don snying chen po yod pa gdon mi za'o/ /ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi go don la sgra yangs 'jug gi go ba zhig dang sgra dog 'jug gi go ba gnyis yod de/ gang bri byar gyur 420

ba'i gnas tshul dngos de gzhir bzhag pa'i steng zhib brjod dang mtshon thabs kyis gtso bo bgyis shing / brjod bya'ang mi dang bya ba gnyis gtsigs su bstan pa'i rig rtsal gyi rtsom yig ste/ dper na/ rtogs brjod dang / brtsams sgrung /gtam rgyud sogs ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi khongs su gtogs pa 'di lta bu ni ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi sgra yangs 'jug gi go ba yin no/ /sgra dog 'jug gi go ba ni bslab gzhi dang bab bstun nas 'chad na 'di ltar/brjod bya mi dang bya ba la sogs pa rnams gnas dus rang bzhin yul la ji lta ji ltar yod pa de lta de ltar tshul bzhin rtsom thog tu 'god par byed pa'i rtsom tshul zhig la go ba blangs na 'grig go/ /2 khyad chos/ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi khyad chos rnams ni phal cher bzhi ru bsdu chog ste/ grub cha drug nges par tshang dgos pa dang / brjod bya'i mi dang don dngos yin dgos pa/ 'bri gzhi dper mtshon thub pa zhig gdam dgos pa/skad char gson nyams ldan dgos pa dang bzhi'o/ /(1)ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi grub cha drug nges par tshang dgos/ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi grub cha drug ni mi dang / bya ba/ sa gnas sam yul/ dus tshod/ bya ba'i 'byung rkyen/ brgyud rim mtha' 'bras rnams la zer zhing / spyir btang mi dang bya ba gsal bo zhig 'bri ba la grub cha 'di dag nges par tshang dgos te/ gang brjod par bya ba'i bya ba de nyid la 'jug pa'i byed pa po su yin pa dang / mi des brtsams pa'i bya ba de gang zhig yin pa dang /de dang 'brel ba'i dus dang gnas gang dang gang yin pa dang / de 'byung ba'i 421

rkyen dang brgyud rim dang 'bras bu ji lta bu yin pa bcas rnams tshang dgos pa nges par gsal te/ dper na/ 〈dngul zho bdun dang mi srog gnyis〉zhes pa'i slob tshan du dus ni sngon zhes pas mtshon la/ yul ni dgu rong gi dgon pa zhig tu/ mi sna ni grwa ba 'dod rngam can zhig dang rkun ma 'ga'/ grwa ba kha shas sogs / bya ba'i 'byung rkyen ni grwa ba 'dod rngam can de rgyu nor la ha cang brkam chags che ba/ brgyud rim ni dngul 'gyed thob pa/ dngul brtsis pa/ rkun mas dngul gyi ched du kho rang 'grongs pa/ grwa ba 'gas rkun ma bzung ba sogs yin la / mjug 'bras ni dngul zho bdun gyi ched du mi srog gnyis shor ba lta bu/(2)mi dang don dngos brjod pa las sgro bkur spangs pa/dngos thog bden 'tshol las rtog bzo mi bgyid pa ni ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi khyad chos shig yin te/ dper na/ (su zhig rab tu gces pa'i mi yin〉zhes pa'i slob tshan du sngon khron rogs me 'gog skabs kyi khron rogs dmag mi'i dpa' mdzangs kyi gnas tshul rnams sgro bkur spangs shing ji bzhin du mtshon yod la/ der sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin nges gtan re mchis na'ang spyir brjod bya'i mi dang don ni dngos yod yin stabs/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa zhig yin par gda'/(3)'bri gzhi dper mtshon ldan pa zhig bdams pa/thog mar 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang nas rang gis myong tshor byang ba rnams la langs phyogs dang lta ba/ thabs shes yang dag pa'i sgo nas zhib mo'i blo yis dpyad de/ rang gi lta ba mtshon nus shing klog pa po la'ang sems 'gul dang slob gso thob nus pa btsal dgos pa dang / de nas rgyu cha gang mang mang las 422

rtsom gyi dpe gzhi dang 'brel ba zab min la dmigs te dpe gzhi dang 'brel ba lhag par zab pa'i rgyu cha gang legs pa de nges par du phra zhing zhib mos gleng nas 'bri gzhi'i snying don 'bur du thon par bsgrub dgos pa dang / gzhan rnams 'dor ba'ang cung zad bsdus na legs te/ dper na/ (a pa'i brtse dung〉zhes pa'i slob tshan du/ 'tsho ba'i myong ba gang mang mchis pa las dum bu kha shas bdams yod de/ kho chung dus zhim po zhig brkus pa yab kyis tshor nas gyong gsob tu ca lag phog tu bcug tshul/ lcags rta sbyang skabs sdig pa las gces gces mi byed tshul/ skyes skar du za ma g.yo skol byed tshul/ sgor mo bskur tshul sogs bris pas yab kyis bur bskyangs pa'i brtse dung zab mo mtshon yod pa lta bu/(4)skad cha gson nyams ldan pa/sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin ldan zhing spyi mthun gyis lag len byed bzhin pa'i ming tshig dang / lhag par chags sdang ris su thon zhing gson nyams dod po mchis pa'i skad cha bkol dgos shing / thabs bde bab bstun gyi sgos tshig rgyan rig pas spras chog la/ bsam bzhin du tshig sgrub kyi rnam pa 'dra min bkod sgrig byas te spyad chog /'on kyang brda ched ni ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig tu mi 'bri'am nyung tsam bris na 'os so/ /gsum pa/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi dbye ba/spyir slob khrid kyi skabs su ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig dang / dgag sgrub kyi rtsom yig gsal bshad kyi rtsom yig rgyun spyod yig rigs bcas lus bzhi ru 423

phye ba yin zhing / de'i nang gses kyi ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig ni bslab gzhi ltar skabs babs kyi 'chad bya yin te/ de la gnas tshul gsar 'gyur dang /gnas tshul khyad rtsom/ gsar 'gyur rtsom yig gnas skor zin bris bcas nang gses khag bzhir dbye mod/ skabs 'dir bslab gzhi'i le tshan sgrig stangs ltar / ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig la brjod bya'i nang don gtso phal gyi cha nas dbye ba phye na/ dngos brjod dang / ljongs brjod/ mi brjod/ don brjod dag mchis pas gsham du de dag gi don mdor bsdus shig ngo sprod bya rgyu yin/1 dngos brjod rtsom yiga'adir dngos brjod zer ba ni gang yin zhe na/ rang byung khams kyi sems ldan dngos po/ sems med dngos po/ 'gro ba mis bzos pa'i yo byad dang bcas pa rtsom gyi brjod byar bzung nas zhib 'bri gson nyams ldan pa byed pa'i sgo nas brjod byar gyur pa'i dngos po bye brag pa de slar yang mngon par byas pa la zer/ dper na (se 'brunadang (rta 〉lta bu/na ljongs brjod kyi rtsom yigarang byung khams kyi ri klung mtsho rdzing dang mis bzo bzo bkod sogs kyi mdzes sdug dang rnam pa zhib mo snam thag tu bris nas nyams 'gyur mtshon par byas pa zhig la ljongs brjod rtsom yig zer/ dper na/ 〈sngonadang (ri bo gangs can gyi mdzes ljongs〉lta bu/3 don brjod rtsom yiga'adir don brjod ni bya ba brjod pa la go dgos/ don brjod rtsom yig gis bya ba zhig byung ba nas bzung 'phel ba'i rim pa dang bcas zhib par 424

brjod pa la brten nas spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang rtsom pa po'i bsam pa'i 'dzin stangs ji bzhin mtshon par byas nas klog pa po rnams la slob gso dang sems 'gul thebs par byed pa zhig yin/ dper na (dngul zho bdun dang mi srog gnyis〉dang (la bod g.yul 'gyed〉lta bu/4mi brjod rtsom yigaji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig tu mi 'bri ba shin tu mang la/ sgyu rtsal rtsom rig tu'ang mi sna 'bri mod gnyis ka mi 'dra ste/ snga mas dngos yod kyi mi don 'bri bar snyeg cing / phyi mas sgyu rtsal gyi thog nas snying bsdus kyis mi'i rnam pa bzo chog pa yin/ yin na'ang mi sna 'bri tshe dus rtag par thabs sna tshogs brgyud de mi sna'i sems gshis de ci lcogs kyis phyir mngon par byed pa'i rigs la mi sna gtsor brjod kyi ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig ces kyang chog snyam/dper na/ mi sna'i lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod byar bzung nas bris pa/ (sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i byung ba gsong bor smra ba'i gtamanadang / 'tsho ba'i dum bu re zung brjod byar bzung nas bris pa (rgyab gzugs〉lta bu/bzhi ba/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi mtshon thabs/1 zhib brjod/mi don gtso bor brjod pa'i rtsom yig cig 'bri dgos na zhib brjod kyi mtshon thabs la brten dgos te/ zhib brjod ces pa ni mi sna'i 'gul skyod dang bya ba'i 'phel rim gyi 'gyur ldog bcas kyi brgyud rim rnams gsal bo bshad pa 425

zhig la zer zhing / de ni ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig tu bkol chog la gsal bshad dang 'byin sgrub kyi rtsom du bkol na'ang chog pa yin/ dper na/ (sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i byung ba gsong bor smra ba'i gtam〉 du mang phyogs zhib brjod kyi mtshon thabs spyad yod/ zhib brjod byed thabs ci rigs mchis na'ang nga tsho'i bslab gzhi las bstan pa bzhin 'dir ngo sprad na 'di ltar/(1)go rim ji bzhin du brjod pa/ (rim brjod)go rim ji bzhin du brjod pa ni gnas tshul dang bya ba'i byung 'phel gyi dus tshod snga phyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin bris pa la zer/ dper na/ 〈gser khri mnga' gsol〉las nyin snga phyi dang nyin gcig gi dus tshod kyi snga phyi rnams rim pa bzhin bris yod pa lta bu/ zhib brjod byed stangs 'dir gsal zhing go sla ba/bya ba'i rgyu rkyen 'bras gsum gsal bo bston thub pa sogs kyi dge mtshan yod/(2)go rim ldog ste brjod pa/(ldog brjod)ldog brjod ni dus kyi rim pa go ldog te bya ba'i mjug 'bras sam brjod bya gal bo che zhig rtsom gyi mgo la bton nas bris pa'i rigs la zer/ dper na (dpe tshab sprod pa〉dang dma' bring skabs kyi 〈bya ba chung ngu〉lta bu/ ldog brjod byed pa'i dmigs yul ni/ la lar bya ba'i mjug 'bras sam brjod bya gal chen zhig 'bur thon byas nas brjod don gyi snying bo khyad gsal du ston par dmigs yod/ la lar klog mkhan gyi sems su dpyang thag bzo thabs kyis yid 'gug pa'i ched yin/ la lar grong zhad spong ba dang rtsom khog 'bugs stangs la 'degs 'jog yod par dmigs yod/ la lar gong smos kyi dgos pa mtha' dag kyang dmigs su bzung yod/426

(3)bar bcug gi brjod pa/(bar brjod)go rim ji bzhin brjod pa'i khrod du dgos dbang gis zhib brjod byed pa'i rgyun bcad de/ dum bu gzhan zhig bar la bcug rjes slar yang sngon gyi zhib brjod kyi 'phro mthud de bris pa de rigs la bar bcug gi brjod pa zer/bar la gzhug bya ni bya ba 'das pa zhig yin chog la bya ba gzhan zhig yin na'ang chog /dper na (la bod g.yul 'gyed〉 du bar bcug gi brjod pa ha cang gsal ba lta bu/ bar bcug gi brjod pa ni rtsom yig gi brjod bya'i gtso bo min yang —/ brjod bya'i snying bo dang 'brel ba dam por yod pa'i dpyad gzhi kha bsabs thub kyi yod/ des na bar gcig gi brjod par brjod bya phun sum je tshogs dang brjod bya'i snying bo je gsal du mtshon pa'i dge mtshan yod/(4)mnyam du brjod pa/(mnyam brjod)mnyam brjod zer ba ni dus gcig la yul tha dad par 'brel yod kyi bya ba gnyis byung ba zhib brjod byas pa la zer/ mnyam brjod byed pa ni yul mi 'dra bar byung ba'i bya ba gnyis po gal che bas gnyis ka rgyas par 'bri dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yin pa ma gtogs/ gal srid gnyis ka gal mi che na gcig gi zhor la gcig kyang zur tsam bstan pas 'thus so/ /2 zhib 'bri byed stangs/zhib 'bri zhes pa ni gson nyams kyis phyug pa'i rjod pa la brten nas mi ljongs dngos gsum gyi rnam pa ji bzhin du bkod pa la zer/ zhib 'bri byed skabs dpe rgyan dang phul byung gi rgyan sogs tshig rgyan sna tshogs la brten nas zhib 'bri byed dgos/ zhib 'bri byed tshe bri bya'i yul gyi khyad chos dag dmigs 427

su bzung nas brjod bya'i dngos po rags dbyibs su bkod chog la/ nges par sgo du ma las zhib mo rnam 'thag tu bkod na'ang chog /dper na/ (rgya mtsho'i khug rta〉 ru khug rta'i rnam pa ni 'phur ba dang ngal gso'i khyad par/ gsog 'phur dang 'phred 'phur gyi khyad par/ glog skud du ngal gso ba dang mtsho ngos su ngal gso ba'i khyad par sogs zhib cing phra bar bris yod pa lta bu/(1)mi sna zhib 'bri/mi sna gtso bor bris pa'i ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom dang rtsom rig brtsams chos gang yin yang zhib 'bri byed thabs ni gcig yin pas/ 'dir mdor bsdus shig bshad par bya ste/ mi sna zhib 'bri byed tshe dngos kyi zhib 'bri byas na chog la shugs kyi zhib 'bri byas na'ang chog go /dngos kyi zhib 'bri ni gtso bo mi sna'i phyi'i gzugs te (byad bzhin/ rgyan chas/ rnam 'gyur/ bzo lta sogs 'du/)spyod tshul/ skad cha/ bsam pa'i 'char sgo sogs zhib 'bri byas pa de yin/ de dag rgyas par mi bshad/ shugs kyi zhib 'bri ni mi sna'i 'gro 'dug 'chag gsum las 'phros pa'i shugs rkyen la brten nas mi sna mtshon pa'am mi sna gtso bo dang 'brel ba yod pa'i mi gzhan zhig bris nas mi sna gtso bo spel zla byed pa de yin/(2)khor yug zhib 'bri/khor yug zhib 'bri byed par rang byung khams kyi mdzes ljongs 'bri thabs dang spyi tshogs kyi khor yug 'bri thabs gnyis yod cing / de dag zhib 'bri byed par dang thog brjod bya'i gzhir lta zhib bya dgos/ mi su zhig gis brjod bya'i dngos po gang zhig la lta zhib byas na'ang / rang rang so sor lta zhib pa'i gnas dang —/ lta zhib pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa dang / thog ma'i gzung yul re yod srid/ lta 428

zhib pa'i gnas ni skabs 'dir lta zhib pa gnas sa'i yul de bstan pa'o/ /lta zhib gzhi 'dzin sa ni skabs 'dir lta zhib la gtsigs chen du lta ba dang / zur du lta ba/ thad kur lta ba/ mdun phyogs drang bar lta ba/ mgo yar bkyags nas lta ba sogs kyi khyad par yod pa de bstan pa yin/ lta zhib pa'i gzhi 'dzin sar 'gyur ldog byung na lta zhib pa'i phyogs kyang 'gyur 'gro/ thog ma'i gzung yul ni skabs 'dir lta zhib byed pa'i tshe dmigs su mnyam 'jog bya sa'i yul lam gnad de bstan pa yin/ brjod bya'i yul de zhib 'bri byas tshe lta zhib pa'i gnas dang / lta zhib pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa/ lta zhib pa'i thog ma'i gzung yul la mnyam par bzhag na yul de'i gnas sa dang khyad chos sogs gsal bo 'bri thub/dper na/ (sngon zhes pa'i slob tshan gyi nang du me lus rbab cha sngon la bris pa ni 6nag cing snum pa'i mtha' gnyis kyi mtshams su dkar zhing gsal ba'i nyal 'gro zhig ces pa ste/ de ni ri'i logs su langs te mgo yar bkyags pa na mthong thub tshul bris pa lta bu/ 'byung bzhi'i khams su mdzes ljongs ni la la ltos bcas su 'jags pa'i tshul gyis yod de/ dper na/ ri bo/ nags tshal/gnyid du yur ba'i srog chags sogs lta bu'o/ /la la 'gul skyod gsal bo byed pa'i rnam par yod/ dper na/ 'bab chu/ 'phur bzhin pa'i 'dab chags/rdol bzhin pa'i me phung sogs yin/ mdzes ljongs la lta zhib byed tshe nges par 'gul 'jags gnyis su do snang byed dgos/ mdzes ljongs kyi 'jags rnam 'bri skabs bri bya'i yul gyi gnas dang dbyibs/ kha dog dang che chung sogs zhib 'bri byed dgos/ mdzes ljongs kyi 'gul rnam 'bri skabs bri bya'i dbyibs dang kha dog dri dang ro sogs kyi skad cig gi 'gyur ldog dag zhib 'bri byed dgos/429

rtsom yig tu 'gul 'jags gnyis ldan du bris na bag chags zab mo 'jog /(gong gsal de gnyis la 'gul brjod/ 'jags brjod ces na'ang chog)yul ljongs 'bri skabs yul gyi khyad chos dimigs 'dzin byed dgos/ yul gcig la ri thang gi khyad par dang dus gcig la dbyar dgun gyi khyad par yod/ des na yul ljongs kyi khyad par ni yul dus mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la rten 'byung du yod pas yul dus kyi khyad par la do snang byed dgos pa gal che/ yul ljongs kyi dbyibs dang nyams 'gyur/ kha dog dang sgra sogs zhib phra bris na mtshon nus chen po yod do/ /dper na/ (mi nyag nas pe cing du bskyod pa'i lam bar〉lta bu/ (3)nyams 'gyur gyi brjod pa/('gyur brjod)nyams 'gyur gyi brjod pa ni rtsom yig gi mtshon thabs shig ste/ de ni rtsom pa pos rtsom yig gi nang du mi sna'i nang sems kyi 'gyur ba bris su lang ba de la zer / mi rnams dga' sdug chags sdang gi nyams 'gyur mtha' dag ni mi dang bya dngos phog thug las 'byung zhing / rtsom yig gi nang du nyams 'gyur brjod pa de'ang rtag par yul dang yul can la brten nas byung ba yin/ nyams 'gyur brjod pa'i mtshon thabs la dngos bstan dang shugs bstan gnyis yod de/dngos bstan nyams 'gyur gyi brjod pa ni rtsom yig tu skye dngos srog chags sam/yo byad zhib 'bri byas par brten nas rtsom pa po'am mi sna'i sems kyi 'gyur ba brjod pa de la zer/ dper na/ 〈rgya mtsho'i khug rta〉las rtsom pa po 1927lo'i gsar brje chen por pham nyes byung rjes go min tang gi sngon thon shes ldan mi snar mnar gcod tshad med byas mur yul gyar cing yo rub gling du 'khyams pa'i 430

lam bar khug rta mthong bar brten nas pha yul dran pa'i gdung ba bris yod pa lta bu/ shugs bstan nyams 'gyur gyi brjod pa ni/ nyams 'gyur gyi brjod pa dang —/ zhib brjod/ bgro gleng sogs kyi mtshon thabs gcig tu bsdus pa de la zer / dper na/ (sngon zhes pa'i slob tshan du dngos bstan nyams 'gyur brjod pa'i tshig brjod yod la/ nyams 'gyur brjod pa dang zhib brjod gnyis lhan gcig tu bsdus pa'i tshig brjod yod pa lta bu/ gzhan yang dpyad brjod dam bgro gleng / gsal bshad kyi mtshon thabs kyang yod mod/ gong gsal mtshon thabs dag dang 'dres nas yod pas 'dir logs su 'chad rtsis med do/ /lnga ba/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi mi sna'i tha snyad 'bod stangs/ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi brjod bya mang che ba mi dang bya ba yin phyir / rtsom yig nang du'ang mi sna dang kha 'bral thabs med/ rtsom pa pos rtsom yig gi nang du mi sna 'bri ba la tha snyad gang zhig la brten nas brjod kyi yod ces na/ gtso cher skyes bu mchog gi 'bod stangs dang skyes bu bar ma'i 'bod stangs la brten nas brjod par byed do/ /rtsom yig 'gar rtsom pa pos gzhan don rang gi myong ba dang mthong thos ltar bris pa la skyes bu mchog gi 'bod stangs zer/ rtsom yig tu nga dang / nyid/ phran/ bdag ces pa ni la la rtsom pa po yin gyi la la min/ 'bod stangs 'di'i dge mtshan ni/ gcig na rtsom pa pos klog mkhan la thad kur rang gi myong ba bshad pa ltar yin pas klog mkhan la nye bar gnas pa dang bcos ma ma yin pa/ mi bslu bar yod pa'i myong tshor 'byung /431

gnyis su yul dus mi 'dra bar byung ba'i bya ba mtha' dag lha bdag gi sgra sbyar nas 'brel chags par sbyor thub/ gsum na thad kur nyams 'gyur dang bgro gleng brjod thub/ yin na'ang skyes bu mchog gi 'bod tshul la mi 'dang sa yang yod de/ de ni /bdag gi mthong thos las brgal ba'i bya ba ni brjod mi thub cing mi gzhan pa'i bsam pa'i 'char sgo 'bri mi thub/ rtsom pa po zur du gnas pa'i tshul gyis mi gzhan pa'i bya ba brjod pa ltar du bris pa la skyes bu bar ma'i rtsom stangs zer/ rtsom yig nang gi mi sna ni kho dngal kho tsho'i0 sgras mtshon par byed pa yin/ skyes bu bar ba'i 'bod stangs spyad na yul dus kyi bkag sdom dang bral lo/ /drug ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi sgrig gzhi/1 dus kyi go rim/mi dang bya ba gtso bor brjod pa'i rtsom yig tu dus kyi 'pho 'gyur la brten bya dngos kyi 'phel rim mi 'dra ba byung ba dang bstun te go rim sgrig yod pa red/dus tshod kyi snga phyi'i rim pa go ma ldog par rim bzhin bris yod pa'i rtsom yig gi sgrig gzhi ni nga chos rgyun par mthong thub pa'i ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi sgrig gzhi zhig yin/ dper na/ 〈gser khri mnga' gsol〉las nyin gcig gi dus tshod snga phyi ltar bris pa dang / (ri bo gangs can gyi mdzes ljongs〉las yul gcig gi steng du dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi 'gyur ldog bris pa lta bu/2 yul gyi go rim/ ljongs brjod dang dngos brjod rtsom yig tu yul ljongs 'bri skabs lta 432

mkhan gyi gnas yug la/ kha phyogs/ gzhi 'dzin sa bcas rtag par 'pho 'gyur byed pas gzung yul yar 'gyur 'gro ba red/ der brten rtsom yig 'bri skabs yul gyi 'gyur ldog la brten nas go rim bsgrig chog pa red/ dper na nye ba nas ring ba/ steng nas 'og /lho nas byang / shar nas nub/ chu nas ri'i bar lta bu yin/ rim pa 'di ltar du mthong yul rnams mthar chags su bsgrigs na yul gyi chags stangs de mgo mjug 'brel chags shing go rim gsal bo yod pa tshor thub/ dper na mi nyag nas pe cing bar bskyod pa'i lam bar〉 lta bu/gzhan yang / ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig 'bri dus do snang byed dgos sa 'ga' 'byung ba 'di ltar/ gcig tshig stong mang tsam bshad pa las rgyu cha dngos mi ldan pas klog pa po'i sems g.yo mi thub pa ma zad brjod bya'i gnas tshul gtso bo dang snying don yang gsal bo ston mi thub/ gnyis/ mthong thos kyi gnas tshul yod do cog sdeb spungs byed pa'am yang na 'go nas mjug gi bar 'gro gron gyi rtsis tho lta bu zhig bris te don snying gang zhig bstan pa go rgyu med pa/gsum / rgyu cha yod la snying don kyang ston rgyu mchis mod/ 'on kyang 'bri gzhi'i don gyi dgos pa ltar du rgyu cha gdam gses dang sgrig sbyor byas pa mi gsal zhing /rgyu cha'i gtso phal gyi dbye ba mi shes pa dang / yang na 'brel mthud kyis bsgrub bya'i gzhi de 'bur du gtod mi nus pa sogs so/ /(gsal bshad/ rtsom yig 'di ni 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i slob deb tu tho re ba yod pa gzhir byas/ gzhan las 'brel yod 'gas kha bsabs te dkyus gcig tu go bde bar sdeb pa yin/)433

rtsom rig gsar rtsom khrod du tshig phrad rang dbang can bed spyod byed dus gzab nan byed dgos pa 'ga' gleng ba/co ne yum tshe ring /mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus su mi rnams kyis rang gi ngal rtsol dang shes rab la bsten nas skad cha dang de mtshon byed kyi yi ge gsar du gtod pa nas phan tshun 'brel 'dres rgyun ldan dang gting zab du phyin pas mi rigs rang rang gi skad yig la yul dus kyis ma chod pa'i khyad chos mngon gsal dod po yod/ rang re'i bod kyi skad yig ni dbyangs bzhi dang gsal byed sum bcu yis grub pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi yi ge'i rigs shig yin pas/ skad yig gsar du gtod pa'i dus yun dang skad yig gis bod spyi tshogs la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen/ skad yig rang ngos kyi spyod nus dang 'thus tshang min sogs phyogs gang nas bltas kyang mi'i rigs kyi skad yig 'phel ba'i lo rgyus su 'os bab kyi go gnas dang mtshan snyan yod / de bas rang re'i kha ba can la sku drin bla na med pa'i slob dpon sasgo ṭa dang sku nyid kyi rjes 'brangs mkhas can tshos bod kyi skad yig gsar bzo'am bzo bcos byed dus bod yig gi khyad chos gzhir bzung nas sum cu ba dang rtags 'jug ces brda sprod rig pa'i rtsa 'grel kha gsal go bder bkod yod kyang deng skabs bdag dang bdag 'dra ba'i gsar slob pa 'ga' res thang gi rdo 434

blangs nas rum gyi bro skyur zer ba ltar skad yig gzhan pa sbyang khul gyis bod yig gi phyi mo'i gzhung sum rtags kyi shes bya la mthong chen gtan nas byed thub med / lhag par du dus deb dang tshags par thog bkod zin pa'i brtsams chos yin rung tshig sbyor dbul zhing phongs la sum rtags kyi sgra sbyor nor 'chug mang drags pas/ mi lo bcu phrag ring la bod yig sbyang myong ba'i bod rigs slob ma zhig gi cha nas bshad na ngo tsha dgos pa'i tshod du yod/ de'i phyir smyug thogs pa bdag gis khrid ston dge rgan kyi slob ston ltar slar yang bod kyi brda sprod rig pa sum rtags la yang 'bad bskyar 'bad byas ste/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom khrod phrad rang dbang can bod spyod byed dus gzab nan byed dgos pa 'ga' gleng khul byed do/ /spyir bod kyi skad yig ni mi zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang na de'i don lnga snod drug ni sum rtags dag gsum yin pas sum rtags dag gsum gyi rgyun ldan dang yang dag pa'i sdeb sbyor 'og da gzod bod kyi skad yig gi nus pa phyi ru 'don thub/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo mkhyen rab 'od gsal mchog gi gsung las ming gi tshogs la mi rmongs pa byed par dag yig gi gzhung sbyang dgos pa dang phrad rnam dbye'i tshogs la mi rmongs par byed pa sum cu ba'i gzhung sbyang dgos pa/ bya ba'i tshig gi tshogs la mi rmongs pa byed par rtags kyi 'jug pa'i gzhung sbyang dgos zhes bkod yod pa ltar/ sbyang dgos pa gsum las 'dir bshad rgyu gtso bo ni bye brag tu phrad rnam dbye'i tshogs la mi rmongs bar byed pa sum cu ba'i gzhung las phrad rang dbang can gyi gnad don ste go bder bshad na rtsom rig gsar rtsom khrod du tshig phrad rang dbang can bed spyod dus gzab nan byed dgos ba'i skor 'ba' zhig gleng rgyu yin/435

de yang 'ba' ba skal bzang 'gyur med kyi bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i khrid rgyun rab gsal me long las phrad rang dbang can ni sgra'i rnam pa gcig las med cing ming mtha'i rjes 'jug la bltos ma dgos pa'i phrad rkyang la go dgos zhes gsungs yod pa ltar/ sum cu ba'i gzhung du dngos su bstan pa'i rgyun mkho'i phrad rang dbang can ni/ ni sgra dang / dang sgra/ dgag sgra dang de sgra/ spyi sgra/bdag sgra bcas drug yod/ de min sngar sum cu ba'i nang dngos su bstan med pa'i rgyun mkho'i phrad rang dbang can rnams 'di ru mi 'chad do/ /dang ba/ phrad rang dbang can las ni sgra'i skor/ni sgra ni tshig gi nyams ston byed kyi phrad cig yin pas/ tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba las don mi ston/ sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las ni ni dgar dang brnan pa'i sgra zhes pa ltar nges bzung gi don la 'jug pa dang brnan pa'i don la 'jug pa/ tshig gi kha skong du 'jug pa bcas 'jug pa 'dra min gsum yod pa las/ 'di ru rtsom rig brtsams chos dang 'brel ba yod pa'i 'jug pa ste tshig gi kha skong du 'jug pa ces pa dper bzhag nas bshad na/ gzhas tshig dang snyan ngag sogs tshigs bcad kyi rkang grangs ma langs pa de'i kha skong ni sgra sbyar chog ste/ dmangs gzhas las ri la rtswa ni mi 'dug /lta bu dang / sa skya legs bshad las ri dwags rnga ma bstan nas sna/ /khrel 'das bong bu'i sha dang 'tshong ske/ /zhes pa sogs gong gi dpe gnyis las don gyi dgos mkho dang tshig mang nyung kha skong ba'i phyir du phrad rang dbang can ni sgra don gyis so sor nus pa gsal bo thon yod/ yin na'ang deng skabs gsar slob pa 'ga' res ni sgra yi 'jug pa la ser sna byed kyin yod pas bod yig gi tshig sbyor bar na ni sgra 'jug 436

pa mngon gsal du nyung du 'gro bzhin yod/ dper na/ nga ni lha sa la 'gro dgos dang 'dzam gling na snyan grags che ba'i pho brang po ta la ni bordo btsan po'i skabs su 'dzugs skrun byas/ lta bu'i tshig ni/ nga lha sa la 'gro rdegis dang 'dzam gling na snyan grags che ba'i pho brang po ta la bod btsan po'i skabs su 'dzugs bskrun byas lta bur bris yod pas ni sgra ma bkod na tshig gi nang don go thub mod/nan gyis bshad na brda sprod rig pa'i thad nas skyon yod de/ ni sgra'i 'jug pa med na nga lha sa la 'gro dgos zer ba ni lha sa la su 'gro ba'i thad na gsal bshad byed pa 'dang med la tshig don kha gsal bo rang ma red/ 'dzam gling na snyan grags che ba'i pho brang po ta la bod btsan po'i skabs su 'dzugs bskrun byas zhes ni sgra skung bas na tshig gi snga phyi 'os 'tsham gyis kha skongs thub med pas tshig sbyor grim lhod la khyad par chen po yod/ gna' bo'i tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus yig cha las/ pho ma'i ni 'byong bkum pa/ lho shing ni smyug mo rgyal/ lcags kyi ni ma dral na/ smyug gis4 ni re myi phugs/ rgod kyis n+da ma bsgron na/ 'brong la ni stare myi'i 'dzen/ zhes pa glegs gna' po'i yig rnying rtse ni sgra yi 'jug pa shin du snyomang bas tshig sbyor gyi dgar dang brnan pa sbrel mthud sogs kyi thad nas nus pa chen po thon yod/gnyis pa/ phrad rang dbang can las de sgra'i skor/de sgra ni phrad rang dbang can las de dang 'di yi rnam pa gnyis las grub la tha snyad 'das ma thag pa dang rnam grangs gzhan can gnyis su 'jug pa sogs 'jug pa mang nyung bshad tshul mang po yod kyang bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i khrid rgyun rab gsal me long las don du zhib mo dpyad na 'jug tshul bzhi 437

tsam las dbye dgos don mi 'dug gsung yod/ so so dmigs su bzung bya ston pa dang nye ring khyad par ston pa/ gong 'og gi khyad par ston pa/ dus tshod kyi khyad par ston pa sogs yod kyang / skabs 'dir rtsom gyi brjod bya'i dgos mkho ltar te de ste gsum lhag bcas kyi de sgra dang phrad rang dbang can kyi de sgra yi 'jug pa la gzab nan bya dgos pa rno/ nas skya legs bshad las/ chu rme sdong rtas mi bgrod de/ /thang la gru yis ji ltar bgrod/ ces pa dang / snang sa 'od 'bum las/ n+ma dga' dga' 'dod byed pa de/ /pho gsar dmag la 'gro ba'i rtags / /zhes tshig gong 'og gnyis kyi khrod du r+shagrod de dang byed pa de zhes pa'i de sgra gnyis tshig snga phyi 'brel ba dang sbrel ba'i cha rnos khyed par zhugasalag bo mi shes mod / don du tshig rkang gong ma'i bgrod de zhes pa'i de sgra de ni rjes 'jug da yi rjes su sgra mthun pa'i de sgra sbyar ba lhargo ba༄sa kyi sbyor tshul de phrad gzhan dbang can yin no/ /de yang tshig rkang 'og ma'i byed pa de zhes pa'i de sgra ni brjod bya'i tshig gzhi gang zhig dmigs su bzung nas rgosazlo r+shashad byed pa phrad rang dbang can gyi ya gyal lags so/ /dus rgyun gsar rtsom pa tshos de sgra yi 'jug tshul rang gi yul skad ltar ci dgar sbyar ba las brda sprod kyi gzhung dngos ltar de sgra yi 'jug pa 'dra min la dmigs nas so so khag dbye ba'i thad 'bad brtson byas pa nyung shas red/ de'i phyir de sgra yi 'jug pa la mkhas par byas te brda sprod kyi shes bya bkol nas tshig sbyor la mi rmongs pa byed dgos/gsum pa/ phrad rang dbang can las dang sgra'i skor/dang sgra ni sum bcu ba'i rtsa tshig du 'byed sdud rgyu mtshan dang tshe skabs gdams ngag lnga la 'jug ces bris yod kyang / mtshams sbyor dang / bya ba'i sbyar 438

gzhi ston pa/ gdams ngag tshe skabs bcas la 'jug pa yang yod pas/ dpe cha re re'i nang du 'dra sa yod la mi 'dra sa yang yod pas mtha' gcig tu ngos 'dzin byed par mkhas brgya 'gran gleng byed 'os so/ /de yang skabs su babs pa dus gsum gyi skul tshig ltos sam phrad rang dbang can gyi gdams ngag la 'jug pa de rang dbang canan gyi bya tshig gi rjes su dang sgra sbyar nas mi gzhan la skul ma gtong ba'am gdams ngag brjod pa'i don ston pa ltos dang gnyis ni so so don mtshungs pa 'dra yang / zhib du dpyad na phrad rang dar+shang lhun gyi dang sgra las yar longs dang ma longs khyad med lta bu gdams ngag la 'jug pa'am yang na yar 4longaso dang ga'ajor 'obs deng rnya bur skul tshig la 'jug pa ni so so sgra don rmo mdzon gsal rgyo khyad rber 'dug /phran gyis bsam na de yang phrad rang dbang can gyi dang sgra'i skul tshig ni gdams ngag gi dgos mkho la 'jug pas bya byed tha dad min gyi bya tshig gang yin rung dang sgra 'jug pa na skul tshig gi don ston thub/ dper na/ bya byed tha dad pa'o bya spyag sgrub lta bu dang bya byed tha mi dad pa'i bya tshig song lta bur mtshon na dang sgra sbyar bas na skul ma'i don ston thub / gzhan yang bya ba'i tshig la gzugs 'gyur gyi rnam grangs yod na skul tshig de rang dang lhan du sbyar nas gdams ngag gi don ston pa/ dper na klogs dang lta bu'am/ gzugs 'gyur med na dang sgra kho nas gdams ngag gi don ston paX/ dper na yar longs dang lta bu sogs la 'jug pa yod pas/ dus gsum gyi skul tshig dang phrardo raje dbacung can dang sgra 'jug pa'i skul tshig gi khyad 'brel dang chos nyid gsal bo shes dgos/ 'di ni phran gyi myong ba tsam yin pas 'thus tshang du gtong bar 'os so/ /439

bzhi pa/ phrad rang dbang can las spyi sgra'i skor/phrad rang dbang can las ci ji su gang bzhi ni spyi sgra yin pas ming tshab tu 'gro ba'i phrad kyang zer/ de dag ni brjod bya'i don gyi bye brag pa dmigs su mi 'dzin par ming gi tshab la 'jug pa'i tshig phrad khag cig yin gyi/ nang gses dbye na ci ni bem po'i rigs dang / su ni gang zag mi/ gang ni gang zag dang bem po ci rigs la 'jug pa dang / ji ni tshig grogs dang bcas te thabs tshul mtshon byed du 'jug /nam zhig gam nam yang lta bu'i nam ni spyi sgra la 'jug tshul brjod pa yod kyang 'di ru skung ba yin/ de yang 'edi ru gsal bshad rags tsam zhig bya rgyu ni/ gsar slob pa rnams kyis ming don mtshon pa'i tshig sbyor nang du spyi sgra bed spyod byed dus gong du brjod pa ltar gzhi 'dzin sa'i rtsa tshig yod kyang / ci ji su gang so so dri tshig la 'jug pa dang spyi khyab la 'jug pa gsal bo 'byed dgos/ snang sa 'od 'bum las/ bu mo khyod ni de ring gang nas yong ske/ do nub 'gro ba'i sa yul gang du 'gro/ khyod la pha ma gnyen tshan ji 'khro yod / 'jig rten gtan grogs bdeg sgo su 'dra yin/ khyim dang longs spyod twe tsha gang 'dra yod/ bu mo khyod kyi ming la jig skade zer/ lta bu las spyi sgra'i 'jug pa ni ༅bye throg tu bu mo kho na'am bu mo dang 'ebrekla ba yod pa'i bya ba dmigs yul du bzung nas rang gi ma shes pa'am yang na shes bzhin du dri ba 'don pa yin gyi/dper na/ gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar las/ shel dkar pad ma'i phug pa zla ba tshes pa lta bu'i gnas na/ byang thang me tog skyed tshal nas 'ongs pa'i bram ze'i khye'u pad ma dgyes pa zhes bya ba/ ci yang shes pa/ gar yang 'gro ba/ gang sdi yang gnas pa/ sngi da yang mthun pa zhirgo gnas bcas gso/ sne/lta bu'i spyi sgra r+ya 440

'jug pa ni brjod don bye brag pa dmigs su mi 'dzin par spyi khyab kyi don tsam ston pa yin pas/ ci ji su gang sogs ming tshab kyi phrad phal cher mtshungs pa snang yang dgos nges kyi ming don dang tshig sbyor nang du dri tshig la 'jug pa dang khyad par cung zad re yod do/ /da dung mnyam 'jog byed dgos pa ni/ nga tshos rtag par phrad gzhan dbang can gyi tshig grub bzo dus tshig rkang gi g.yas g.yon la ma dpyad par rang gi goms lobs ltar rtsa tshig gi nang don gang dgar sbyor ba'i skyon 'dug /dper na/ sdong bo 'di sus bcad pa red dam lta bur mtshon na/ spyi sgras dri ba bton zin pa'i mod la dbyu dung u tshugs kyis 'byed sdud kyi sgra sbyar yod pas/ yig skad dang kha skad gang du'ang mi 'gro phyir/ rgya nag gi gtam dper sbrul la rkang pa bris zer ba dang khyad par med do/ /gzhan yang ci ji dang su gang so so'i 'jug pa ni gong gi spyi sgra sbyor tshul gyi sdom tshig las gsal po bshad yod pas bod kyi brda sprod rig pa la mkhas pa'i mi zhig phar zhog /bod skad yig la byang cha yod pa'i mi tsam zhig yin rung dka' gnad yod tshod mi 'dug yin na'ang dus rgyun tshig grogs dang sbyar nas thabs tshul mtshon byed ji ltar ni bem po'i rigs la sbyor byed ci ltar du 'bri ba dang / bem po'i rigs rme sbyong byed ci 'dra ni tshig grogs dang ji'iri nas thabs tshul mtshon byed ji 'dra ru 'bri ba'i rnor r+shaphrul 'byung bas/ smyug 'dzin pa bdag gis da dung 'alo/ rtsal rang bzhin gyi skyon cha 'di 'gog mi thub pas skabs 'dir rang dang na mnyam pa'i gsar rtsom pa rnams la gsal 'debs tsam byed pa lags so/ /lnga ba/ phrad rang dbang can las dgag sgra'i skor/ma mi min med bzhi la dgag sgra zer/ sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las ma mi min 441

med dgag sgra ste/ /ma mi thog ma min med mjug /ma ni bar gyi gsal byed la'ang —/ /myi dang myed ni brda rnying pa'o zhes gsung yod/ ma mi gnyis sngon du 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ ma sgrubs dang ma sgrub/ ma shod dang ma bshad/ ma za dang ma zas/ mi lta/ mi byedag/ mi za/ lta bye yin la/4 min med rgenyis mjurge tu sbyar rbo ni/ ba'ed kyi smron/ lta sgo min/ mtshon cha med/ g.yo sgyu med/ lta bu red ma yig bar du 'ojug pa ni/ 4 rgya ma bod/ rin ma thang / rong snyom 'brog /yin la ma yin/ gsal la ma gsal lta bug la go/ spyire dgag sgra ni skod dang yi ge'i nangag du bkol spyod ches rmong zhing 'jug pa yang go bde yin pas/ bod kyi skad yig gi rmang gzhi phran bu yod pas na phrad rang dbang can gzhan dang bsdur na sgra sbyor gyi 'jug pa sla mo tsam 'dug /yin na'ang gong gi rtsa tshig de bod kyi skad yig gi yongs khyab rang bzhin gyi gnad du bzung nas zhib du dpyad na gsal bshad dang 'thus tshang du gtong dgos pa'i phyogs kyang yod de/mkhas dbang mkhyen rab 'od gsal gyi gsung du/ legs bshad ljon dbang las/ma mi thog ma min med mjug /ma ni bar gyi gsal bshad la'ang / /zhes pa'i don 'grel bshad mkhan dag gis kyang ma mi gnyis ming gi thog mar 'jug pa dang —/ min med gnyis ming gi mjug tu 'jug ces yongs khyab tu bshad kyang /'di la'ang zhib cha ma byung ba'i skyon yod de/ ming gi thog ma zhes pa'i ming de chos brjod pa'i ming yin nam/ yang na chos can brjod pa'i ming yin/ yang na chos dang chos can brjod pa'i ming gnyis ka yin pa bcas kyi dbye ba ma phye ba dang —/ de bzhin min dang med gnyis ming gi mjug tu 'jug ces pa'i ming de'ang 'ol tshod tsam las zhib phra ma byung ba'i skyon 'dug ces bkod yod/ de 442

yang 'di'i thad kyi dka' gnad dang dgag sgrub gyi nang don rgan lags kyis rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel gnad kyi sgron me zhes pa'i ched rtsom gyi shog ngos sum cu so bdun nas bzhi bcu'i bar na dpe dang lung drangs nas gsal bo 'khod zin pas/ 'di ru bskyar zlos byed pa ni ba mo stag gi gzi rngam la bsten pa tsam las ma 'das/ phran gyis dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i nang du bkol spyod byed yas kyi skad cha re gzhir bzung nas bshad na/ don 'grub kyis za ma zas ma song dang bkra shis kyis sems khur byas ma song lta bur mtshon na/ ma song rdorngo cas byas gnyis ka dgag sgra'i rtsa tshig ltar ma mi thog ma la 'jug pa'i debang gis jogarge sgra la 'jug pa'i dbang du btang rung / gong gi tshig rkang 'di'i nang don hril bo'i cha nas ma song dang ma byas zer ba ni/ mi zhig sa cha gang zhig tu song ma song dang bya ba ci zhig byas ma byas tsam ston pa las/ don 'grub kyis za ma zas ma song dang bkra shis kyis sems khur byas ma song zhes pa'i tshig long 'di gasnyes spyo cho nas 'brel chad pas dgag sgra'i rge dorne 'egrub mi thub/rgyu mtshan ni dgag sgra'i sbyor tshul las ma mi thog ma min med mjug ces bkod yod kyang gong gi 'jug pa 'di las ma sgra rgyu mtshan don gyis ston pa'i ming tsam gyi bar du bcug yod/ gal srid dgag sgra yi ma mi min med bzhi las ma mi ni bya tshig gam las tshig gi ming kho na'i sngon du 'jug pa yin pas na/ ci'i phyir bod skad du zas ma song ngam byas ma song lta bu'i brjod pa yod/ gang ltar gong gi brjod bya'i snying po ni nged ga re slorbe pa tshos phyogs gcig nas sku drin bla na med pa'i brda sprod rig pa'i mkhas dbang tsho'i gsung la nyan dgos pa dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas rang la brtag dpyad kyi blo zhib mo yod dgos zer ba de 443

yin / dgag sgra'i rtsa tshig tu ma mi thog ma min med mjug ces gsung ba'i dbang gis bod kyi skad yig gi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhi rtsa'i chos nyid tsam la yang mi brtags par rang mos su mi sa dang mi chu/ mi nyi ma dang ma rlung dang ma rgya mtsho/ ma rdul sogs brjod par 4mi 4rigs sne/ sto/ zhu ga na sto ga zhu sto 4 4drug bsgo/ phrad rang dbang can las bdag sgra'i skor/de yang bdag sgra zer ba ni bya tshig nges can zhig gam ming tshig gang rung gi mtha' ru na ro yod med gnyis la pa ba ma sogs gsar du sbyar ba na/ ming don de dag dang 'brel ba'i bdag po gang zag ston pa'i tha snyad gzhan zhig dngos su grub/ gzhan yang don gyi ngo bo dang ldan pa'i tshig grogs can ldan mkhan gsum po bdag sgra dgos min yang skabs bstun tshig bsdus pa'i dbang gis bdag sgra dang mtshungs par 'gro ba'ang yod/ rtsa tshig las/ de min mkhan can ldan gsum yang / /bdag sgra cha 'dra yin zhes grags/ /de yang bdag sgra las gtso bo ni bdag sgra dngos ste pa po ba bo ma mo drug gi 'jug pa gal che ru 'dod / bdag sgra sbyor tshul gyi sdom tshig las/ na ro yod med pa ba ma/ /bdag po'i sgra ste ga da na/ /ba ma sa dang drag mthar pa/ /nga 'a ra la mtha' med la/ /bdag sgra yar gyur ba dang ni/ /cha la pa nyid sbyor ba lags/ /ming mthar pa ba phal cher 'dra/ /ma ni nges med skabs dang sbyar/ /zhes su gsung / spyir gong gi sdom tshig blo ru nges na bdag sgra'i 'jug pa la bar chad yong ba'i rgyu mtshan mi 'dug kyang / phran gyis mi lo bcu phrag ring la sbyangs pa byed rung dus rgyun du bdag sgra yi nor 'chug rgyun mi chad pas/ zhib tu bsam na yul skad kyis zur chags pa e yin nam 'dod/ 'di ru bshad pa'i yul skad du zur chags pa la 444

yang phyogs gnyis kyi thad nas yod de phran gyis so sor chos nyid dang gtan nas mi mthun pa dang chos nyid dang mthun rung rjes 'jug dang mi mthun pa zer ba gnyis su dbye yod/1 chos nyid dang gtan nas mi mthun pa/chos nyid dang gtan nas mi mthun pa zer ba ni bdag sgra'i sbyor tshul nyid dang mi mtshungs pa/ dper na/ a mdo'i yul kha shas su yag po la yag go dang /gnag po la gnag go /bdag po la bdag go /dmar po la dmar ro/ phyug po la phyug go zer ba sogs mdor na bdag sgra'i 'jug pa mang che ba bdag sgra 'jug tshul gyi rjes 'jug la mi blta bar bdag po gang zag ston pa'i ming de'i rjes 'jug gis bdag sgra yi tshab byed yod/ khams pa dang dbus gtsang gi skad du yang de nyid du 'jug pa e yin gsal bo ma shes rung phal cher mi 'jug pa shas che 'dod/2 chos nyid dang mthun rung rjes 'jug dang mi mthun pa/chos nyid dang mthun rung rjes 'jug dang mi mthun pa zer ba ni bdag sgra'i sbyor tshul dang mthun rung pa ba ni bdag sgra 'jug tshul gyi rjes 'jug dang mi mtshungs pa la go dgos te/ dper na/ a mdo'i yul kha shas su rta pa la rta ba dang dbul po la dbul bo/ mda' pa la mda' ba/ rtsis pa la rtsirmi sba sorgeso mdor dz+wa pa sgro mang cho ba the sgra la 'ejurge rbes/4 4 dgashe ṣ+pe spe sbyong tshul dang 'gal yod/ yang gcig bshad na dgag sgra yi 'jug sdonapa dang mtha' gcig tu ltos zla langs pa yang ma yin gyi/ dper na/ mag pa/ rdzi bo/ dpa' bo/ dgra bo sogs kyi 'jug pa ni dgakri sgra'i 'jug tshul dang rmethun no sto/ / sto ོ445
