de'i phyir bdag gis bsams na a mdo'i mi yis bdag sgra yi sbyor tshul la slob sbyong nan po byas nas yul skad du khyab brdal gtong thub na brda sprod rig pa'i thad nas gzhung lugs dang mthun pa ma zad bod skad gcig gyur la yang phan pa che snyam mo/ /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(1) mkhyen rab 'od gsal gyi rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel gnad kyi sgron me/(2) 'ba' ba skal bzang 'gyur med kyis brtsams pa'i bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i khrid rgyun rab gsal me long /(3) hu'u hru'u cin gyi bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i rnam bshad rgya mtsho'i zegs ma/(4) bod ljongs zhib 'jug dgu bcu go lnga lo'i deb dang po/(5) mi rigs slob gso/ go gcig lo'i deb drug pa/

slob 'bring slob mar tshig rgyan rig pa khrid skabs dpe rgyan gyi sbyor tshul skor lhan thabs su brjod pa shes rab sgo 'byed/dngos grub sgrol ma/dang po/ dpe rgyan gyi sbyor tshul lhan thabs su 'khrid pa'i dgos pa/1 slob deb kyi sgrig tshul nas bshad na dpe rgyan gyi dpe brjod nyung song tshul / spyir tshig rgyan rig pa'am snyan gzhung las don rgyan so lnga'i nang gses dpe rgyan la dpe rgyan spyi'i ngo bo ma 'gyur ba gzhir gzung ba'i steng brjod bya srog gi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa la brten nas/ rjod byed dpe'i nyams 'gyur mi 'dra ba so gnyis bstan yod kyang / mtho 'bring gi skad yig slob deb tu/ bcu pa rmad byung gi dpe/ bcu gnyis pa the tshom gyi dpe/ bcu drug pa smad pa'i dpe/nyer drug pa mang ba'i dpe/ nyer brgyad pa phreng ba'i dpe/ so gnyis pa rgyu'i dpe sogs tho re long nge ba las med pas nyung thal song /2 gong gsal slob deb tu drangs pa'i dpe brjod dag las la lar dpe mtshon gyi rang bzhin mi gsal tshul/447

dpe rgyan so gnyis las mang po zhig gcig shes kun grol gyi tshul du 'khrid chog pa dag 'dir gdams mi 'dug ste/ dper na/ chos dpe khrid pa'i zhor la dngos dpe dang bzlog pa'i dpe/ phan tshun dpe sogs bsdur nas dpe dang dpe can/ mtshungs gsal sgra ni kun la yod pa 'dra zhing / mi 'dra sa'i khyad chos ni 'di dang gan red ces 'khrid na stabs bde la go sla ba yang yin mod/ de 'dra bar bsam blo ma btang bar lag tu ci stobs dang kha la gang thon byas yod/3 slob ma'i ngos nas bshad na lta rgya chung zhing tha snyad la nang byan chud mi thub tshul/slob grwa chung 'bring gi slob mar blta klog bya rgyu'i dpe cha ni slob deb las logs su ha cang dkon pas slob deb tu ma drangs pa'i dpe rgyan lhag ma rnams zur du khrid tshe/ snyan 'grel grags can gyi dpe brjod tshad ldan de dag las slo ba ma'i lta rgya bskyed cing / ming tshig mang po zhig kyang khong du tshud par 'gyur te / dper na/ dpe rgyan bcu dgu ba 'gal ba'i dpe la bod mkhas pa'i dpe brjod du/ rab 'bar bskal pa'i zhugs dang rta gdong ri/ /khro bo'i rgyal po khyed kyi ral tshogs rnams/ /gcig kyang phan tshun rnam pa tha dad pa'i/ /ngang tshul 'di gnyis 'gal bar bdag sems so/ /zhes pa las/ zhugs zhes pa me dang /rta gdong ri zhes pa me ri dang / khro bo zhes pa ni drag po'i rnam 'gyur can gyi lha spyi dang / khro bo'i rgyal po ni drag lha gtso bo'i ming yin tshul gsal bo shes pa ma zad / me ri 'byung tshul rig byed gtam rgyud dang / deng rabs tshan rig gi me ri ji ltar byung tshul la bshad tshul dang lta tshul 'di dang 'di'o zhes zhib mo rnam 'thag tu 'chad na slob ma'i lta rgya bskyed pa dang ming tshig mi nyung ba khong du chud 448

par 'gyur nges/4 bsam gzhig byed stangs phyogs su lhung bas dpe brjod mdo 'dril dka' tshul/slob ma'i rang rkya 'pher ba'i ngang dpe brjod bltas na'ang 'dra/ dge rgan gyis khrid skabs dri ba dris na'ang 'dra/ gtso bo dpe brjod de nyid mtshan nyid dang mthun min la nyams 'jog byed rgyu bskyur nas/ dpe dang dpe can gang yin/ mtshungs chos ci yin la snyegs pa las dpe brjod gang de'i sho lo ka hril bo'i brjod don gang yin dang / 'di ltar dpe rgyan gyis spras pa'i dge mtshan la bsam blo mi gtong zhing / gtong bar bskul na'ang shes rgyu mi 'dug /dper na/ pad ma rdul mang zla ba mdzad/ /de dag las kyang khyod kyi bzhin/ /mtshungs pa las kyang khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa lta bur mtshon na/ pad ma dang zla ba dpe dang / khyod kyi bzhin te mdzes ma'i bzhin dpe can yin tshul shes mod/ dpe pad ma la rdul mang zhing / zla ba mar ngo 'grib pa'i skyon bstan nas dpe can de las ldog na dri ma dang 'grib pa'i skyon med pas/ khyad par 'phags tshul dang / mdzes ma'i mdzes chos khyad par ba la bsngags brjod byas yod tshul gyi mdo don 'dril ba'i nus pa zhan pas/ dpe brjod la go ba len dus phyogs su mi lhung bar zur mang bo nas bsam blo gtong dgos tshul gyi lam la bkri dgos/5 dpe brjod mi zhog cing sdeb sbyor mi 'byung tshul/slob mas dpe brjod 'bri skabs ci 'bri 'di 'bri med par klad pa stong ba yin pa'i nyams shar la/ bris kyang kha thog lag thog tu zin pa'i don rnams 449

bskyur nas rang dang rgyang gis chod pa'i lha dang lha min sogs brjod byar bdams nas brtson pas 'jug par byed cing / bris pa'i dpe brjod dag las la lar sho lo ka gcig tu tsheg bar mang nyung shor la/ la lar tsheg bar la mang nyung ma mchis kyang tshig gi cha ya sdeb stangs mi 'dra zhing gcod mtshams nor ba tag tag bris yod/gnyis pa/ dpe rgyan gyi sbyor tshul gzhan rnams tshul ji ltar lhan thabs su 'chad pa'i thabs bstan pa/dpe rgyan so gnyis po re re nas 'khrid na mang drags pas slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi gzhan rnams 'grub dka' la/ slob deb tu drangs pa drug po las ma 'khrid na nyung thal song bas dpe rgyan gyi spyi don tsam yang nges mi thub pa'i gnas su gyur 'dug /de'i phyir gsham gsal 'khrid thabs 'ga'i sgo nas lhan thabs kyi tshul du 'chad na gong gi 'gal ba gnyis thag gcod byed thub snyam/1 rnam pa phyes nas gcig shes kun grol byed thabs/dpe rgyan la don gyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ (1)dpe las dpe can lhag pa / rmad byung gi dpe dang smad pa'i dpe lta bu/ (2)dpe las dpe can dman pa / ngo bstod kyi dpe dang mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe lta bu/ (3)dpe dang dpe can 'dra drags par brjod pa/ 'gal ba'i dpe dang de nyid brjod pa'i dpe lta bu/(4)don rgyan gzhan dang ming don 'brel yod kyis bkar na/ phul byung gi dpe dang rab btags kyi dpe lta bu/ (5)mtshungs gsal gyi sgra tshig zur la dngos su thon pa/ chos dpe/ dngos dpe/ phan tshun dpe lta bu/ (6)mtshungs gsal 450

gyi sgra tshig zur la dngos su thon med kyang mtshungs pa shugs las rtogs thub pa/rmongs pa'i dpe dang / the tshom gyi dpe/ de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ zla bo dngos po'i dpe lta bu dang / gzhan yang nges pa'i dpe dang nges med kyi dpe/ bsngags pa'i dpe dang smad pa'i dpe sogs kyi dbye bar brten nas dpe rgyan gyi nang gses gcig 'khrid pa'i zhor la dpe rgyan gzhan zhig gi sne bstan te 'khrid na zur bltas leb mthong dang gcig shes kun grol byed thub bo/ /na mtshan mtshon ldog nas go sla 'dzin bde byed thabs/yongs grags kyi 'gros ltar sngon la mtshan nyid bkral/ de'i rjes dpe brjod 'khrid pa las mtshan mtshon ldog ste 'khrid na slob mas go sla zhing 'dzin bde ba zhig byed thub/ dper na/ gal te pad ma 'ga' zhig la/ /smin legs rnam 'khrul mig ldan na/ /khyod kyi bzhin gyi dpal 'dzin te/ /zhes pa 'di ni rmad byung dpe/ /zhes pa lta bu rmad byung gi dpe 'di 'khrid skabs/ sngon la dpe can ni mdzes ma'i gdong / dpe ni pad ma yin pa shes su bcug rjes da gzod tshig gi gnad 'gag bzung nas dri ba 'di ltar 'don dgos/ rnam 'khrul mig ldan na zhes brtags pa mtha' bzung gi tshig phrad na yig 'dis dpe pad ma la ci zhig mi ldan pa shes sam zhes dris tshe/ dpe can gyi khyad chos rnam par 'khrul ba'i mig mi ldan no zhes lan khos 'debs ngas 'debs byed do/ /de'i rjes su dpe pad ma la dpe can mdzes ma'i gdong gi khyad chos rnam par 'khrul ba'i mig zung ldan na dpe can mdzes ma'i gdong gi dper 'os so zhes brjod pa lta bu la rmad byung gi dpe zer ro zhes bkral na gnad zin la mtshan mtshon sbrags tshul kyang sla mo yang mos shes 'gro/451

3 dpe brjod 'phros sbyar byed thabs/dpe rgyan gyi dpe brjod la slob deb tu drangs pa gnyis re yod pa de'i mgu bar mi byed cing / slob ma'i blo dang 'tshams min la gzhigs nas zur du mkhas pa so so'i dpe brjod drangs na slob ma'i blo sgo 'byed cing lta rgya yang bskyed thub/dper na/ rmad byung gi dpe gcig pu la mtshon na/ slob deb tu drangs pa'i dpe brjod gnyis kyis chog par mi byed par bod mkhas kyi dpe brjod/ ha ri tsan dan ljon par mtshams sprin gyis/ /'khyud nas dal bu'i 'gros kyis rgyu byed cing ske/ /blo gsal tshogs la legs bshad 'doms shes na/ /tshangs par spyod ldan khyod dang mtshungs par 'gyur/ /lta bu dang / bstan pa rgya mtsho'i dpe brjod/dge mtshan dmar po 'phro ba'i nyin byed des/ /yang dag rig pa'i gzhung lugs mtshon 'chang zhing / /'dzugs skrun las la mdzub ston byed nus na/ /tang gi yang dag 'go 'dren dang mtshungs 'gyur/ /lta bu dpe brjod legs shos gang 'dzoms kyis zur brgyan na yag thog la bzang ma yin nam/4dpe brjod 'jog dus ngag thog yig thog mnyam 'gro byed thabs/tshogs thun du slob mar ngag thog las dpe brjod gzhag tu bcug na slob ma'i ngo spobs je cher 'gro zhing / skad cha shod nus kyi sbyong ba byed thub la/ slob ma'i rang lcag la bskul ma thebs par ma zad/ mgo 'gul bar tshegs dka' ba'i ngan shor gyi rgya las grol te bsam blo gtong rgyu dang skad cha bshad rgyur mos pa yod par bsgyur thub/ yig thog nas dpe brjod bzhag tshe tshig sdud kyi nus pa dang / sdeb sbyor gyi nus pa/ rtsom 'bri'i nus pa sogs bskyed bsring byed thub/mdor na/ slob ma'i dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum la gzhigs nas gang 452
na la 'badas pa yang ba

bod skad kyi byung 'phel thad kyi lta tshul 'ga' brjod pa/'jam po/bod mi rigs ni 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas ldan pa'i mi rigs shig yin par ma zad/ rig gnas kyi lo rgyus ches ring ba'i mi rigs shig kyang yin/bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi mkhas dbang rim byon rnam pas/ lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang mi rigs rang gi skad dang yi sher brten nas/ mi rigs 'di'i rig gnas 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i slad du bla na ma mchis pa'i phyag rjes gnang yod pa sogs dus deng gi bar ma nyams par yod pa ni skad dang yi ge'i bka' drin yin pa dang / da lta nga tsho'i mig sngar mjal du yod pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi shes bya'i bang mdzod chen mor mtshon na/ skad yig gi yon tan ni bang mdzod de'i sgo mo 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bu yin pa dang / deng rabs tshan rig lag rtsal gyis khyad du 'phags pa'i sngon thon mi rigs kyi thog khang du bgrod 'dod na / skad yig gi yon tan ni thog khang der bgrod spyad kyi them skas lta bu yin pa smos ci dgos/ gal te rang re'i bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i skad yig 'di nyams rgud du song na/ bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la'ang nyams rgyad chen po 'byung ba ma zad/ tshan rig lag rtsal gyis rjes su lus pa'i rnam pa 'di yang sgyur thabs med pa shes sla/ des na/ mi rigs rang gi skad dang yi ge sbyong 454

spyod spel gsum bya ba ni/ nga tsho yongs kyi g.yol thabs med pa'i 'os 'gan zhig lags snyam nas/ mang thos rgyan gyis dbul ba bdag lta bus mdzo khal ra yis theg 'dod kyi dpe ltar/ 'dir bod kyi skad 'di ji ltar byung tshul dang 'phel tshul/ bed spyod tshul sogs rang blos dpag tshod kyis gleng bar bya/dang po/ skad cha'i 'byung khungs/spyir skad cha zhes pa ni brjod bya'i don ston par byed pa'i brda'i rang bzhin can zhig la ngos 'dzin pa dang / bye brag 'dir brjod pa'i skad cha ni skyes bu'i lce rkan sogs las byung ba gang zhig brjod bya'i don ston par byed pa'i ngag gi nga ro zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos/ nga tshos skad cha'i ngo bo zhib gsal zhig rtogs dgos na/ thog mar de'i 'byung khungs dang 'phel rim gyi chos nyid la shes rtogs tsam yod par bya dgos/ spyir btang skad cha'i 'byung khungs zhes pa la go don gnyis yod de/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi skad cha'i 'byung khungs dang bye brag mi rigs so so'i skad cha'i grub tshul de gnyis yin la/gcig 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi skad cha'i 'byung khungs/'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi skad cha'i 'byung khungs ni/ 'gro ba mis smra brjod mi shes pa'i dus nas smra brjod shes pa'i go rim zhig yin/ 'di'i thad la chos lugs so sor lta ba mi mthun pa'i bzhed srol mang na'ang / deng rabs tshan rig lag len gyis zhun brdar byas tshe mang che shos rmi lam ltar dpyad ma bzod par gyur/ des na/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi skad cha'i 'byung khungs ni da lta da dung gzhi gcig la nges pa'i kha tshon gcod dka' ba zhig yin mod/ yin na'ang 455

'dir deng sang gi sgra rig smra ba mang shos kyi ngag sgros la khyab che ba'i lugs ltar cung zad spros na/ mi'i rigs kyi skad cha ni thog mar 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung ba'i dus nas bzung / mi rnams rang rang gi lus srog 'tsho ba'i slad du thun mong gis ngal rtsol dang lag cha bzo skrun byed pa'i go rim nang / phan tshun 'brel 'dris byed pa'i dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i ched du byung ba zhig yin/ de bas na ngal rtsol las skad cha byung ba red/ 'o na/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi thog ma'i skad cha ni ci lta bu zhig yin zhe na/ de'ang tshan rig dang mthun pa'i dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha dkon pa dang yul dang dus kyis bskal bas lkog gyur gyi chos zhig tu zad mod kyi/ yin na'ang nga tshos rjes dpag tshad mas dpyad chog pa zhig yin te/ spyi tshogs tshan rig dang rang byung tshan rig gi yongs grags lta ba ltar/smra shes don go'i mtshan nyid can gyi gang zag mi ni gna' bo'i spra rigs 'phel 'gyur las byung ba zhig red/ 'phel 'gyur gyi dus rim nang 'tsho byed ngal rtsol la brten nas lus kyi grub cha khag la 'gyur ldog byung zhing / sgra'i skye gnas kyang rim bzhin 'thus tshang du song nas skad cha thog mar byung ba zhig yin/ skabs de'i mi rnams kyi sgra'i skye gnas dang blo rig la sogs pa ni/ deng sang gi mi nang bzhin de 'dra 'thus tshang cha rdzogs shig dang gsal zhing skyen pa zhig ga la yin/des na kho tshos phan tshun bar 'brel 'dris byed pa'i skad kyi gdangs mi gsal zhing rmang gzhi'i tha snyad kyis mi 'dang ba/ tshig sbyor gyi rnam gzhag sogs dben pas gdod ma'i bshad stangs tsam las skad cha 'di phun sum tshogs pa zhig min pa ni rtogs thub pa red/ da lta dar rgyas phun sum tshogs po byung ba'i skad rigs sna tshogs pa de dag kyang / ma gzhir rmang gzhi de'i thog nas rim bzhin 456

spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun nas byung ba zhig yin/ mdor na/ngal rtsol las mi dang mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs byung ba dang dus mtshungs su mi'i rigs kyi skad cha'ang byung ba yin/ gong nas bshad pa ltar spyir skad cha'i 'byung khungs la dus da lta'i bar da dung nges pa'i lta ba 'thad ldan gcig mthun zhig med pas/ 'di'i thad la deng sang 'dzam gling thog gi sgra rig smra ba rnams kyis mu mthud du zhib 'jug byed bzhin yod pa ma zad/ 'brel yod kyi tshan rig ste/dper na 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi skye dngos khongs gtogs la zhib 'jug byed pa'i mi'i rigs kyi rig pa dang / mi'i rigs kyi bsam pa'i 'khyer so la zhib 'jug byed pa'i sems khams rig pa dang / mi'i rigs kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa'i gna' rdzas brtag pa'i rig pa sogs kyi las rigs kyis kyang zhib 'jug byed kyin yod/ zhib 'jug bya yul de'i byung 'phel gyi chos nyid ma rtogs na/ de'i ngo bo zhib gsal zhig rtogs thabs bral bas/ thog mar mi'i rigs kyi skad cha ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la nges shes rnyed pa ni gal che'i gnas su gyur/gnyis / bye brag mi rigs so so'i skad cha'i grub tshul/1 mi rigs so so'i skad cha'i grub tshul spyir bshad pa/bye brag mi rigs so so'i skad cha ni/ dper na bod skad dang rgya skad/dbyin ji'i skad/ h+pha ran si'i skad/ sog skad sogs lta bu de rigs ni gdod ma'i skad cha'am yul skad kyi rmang gzhi'i thog nas rim gyis rigs gyes pa zhig yin pa ste/ dper na h+pha ran si'i skad sogs ni dmangs khrod la ting gi skad zur nas grub pa lta bu dang / skad cha so so de dag ni mi'i rigs kyis smra shes 457

shing skad brda 'phrod pa'i rjes su grub pa zhig yin pas/ dus kyi cha nas bshad na de ni 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi skad cha byung ba las ha cang 'phyis pa'i phyir/skad rigs la la'i lo rgyus da lta da dung gsal bor rtogs thub ste/ dper na sog rigs kyi skad lta bu la mtshon na/ dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang la mi rigs 'di'i sde rus khag gis bde spyod byed pa'i skad gcig gyur yin mod/phyis su dus rabs bcu drug pa yas mas su snga ma gcig gyur gyi sog skad de so sor gyes pa yin zhing / de ni dus da lta'i bar du lo brgya phrag du ma las ma 'das pa red/ mdor na/ skad cha ni mi'i rigs kyi thun mong gi phan tshun bar brda sprod par byed pa'i yo byad cig yin pa dang / rigs rus mi 'dra ba dang tsho ba mi 'dra ba'i mi mang gi tshogs pa re la skad rigs kyang mi 'dra ba re yod cing /gdod ma'i skad cha byung ba nas bzung 'dzam gling thog la skad rigs gcig las mi tshad pa ma zad/ phyis su spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun nas gcig gyur dang so sor gyes pa zhig yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir mi rigs so so'i skad cha ni/ gdod ma'i skad cha'am yul skad kyi rmang gzhi'i thog nas rigs gyes te so sor snang ba zhig yin pa ma zad/ de'i bye brag la'ang grangs kyis mi long ba zhig mchis so/ / 2 nang gses bod rigs kyi skad cha'i 'byung khungs/bod skad kyang yul gangs can gyi nor 'dzin dpal mo'i gzhi ru 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i bod kyi mi rgyud ji ltar mched pa'i dus rim de nas bzung mthar gyis byung ba zhig yin te/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo nam mkha'i nor bus/ bod skad kyi 'byung khungs ni ya thog bod kyi mi rgyud srid pa nas byung ba zhig yin nges 458

pa ni rang byung gi rigs pas yongs su grub pa zhig yin zhes pa dang / ‘ bod kyi mi rgyud ji ltar mched pa'i dus rim de nas bzung / bod mi rigs rnams kyi phan tshun bar go brda 'phrod pa'i thun mong gi skad de bod skad ces pa'i gdags gzhi de nyid byung yod par nges zhes kyang gsungs/ de ni bod mi rigs rnams kyis phan tshun bar brda sprod par byed pa'i yo byad med du mi rung ba zhig yin la/'di la brten nas mi dang mi'i bar gyi bsam pa'i 'char snang dang so so'i lta tshul / chogs nyes skyid sdug gi myong ba sogs phan tshun brje res byed pa dang /spyi tshogs kyi las sgo sna tshogs spel zhing tshan rig rig gnas kyi shes bya gong spel tu btang dang gtong bzhin yod do/ /gnyis pa/ bod skad kyi 'phel 'gyur/skad cha ni spyi tshogs rim gyis grub pa dang chabs cig rim gyis byung ba zhig yin pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba dang chabs cig rim gyis dar rgyas su 'gro ba zhig kyang yin/ de yang ya thog mi'i rigs kyi skad cha byung ba nas bzung / spyi tshogs kyi 'du 'god dang rang byung khams kyi 'gyur ldog /chab srid dang dpal 'byor sogs kyi 'phel 'gyur gyi yo lang mang du brgyud par brten / skad cha la'ang mu mthud du 'phel 'gyur byung yod/ deng sang 'dzam gling thog gi skad rigs gang la mtshon na yang / thog mar byung dus su skad cha 'di nyid stabs mi bde la cha mi tshang ba zhig yin par ma zad/ dus yun ring zhing rtog dra che ba'i 'phel 'gyur gyi dus rim zhig brgyud yod nges/ des na/bod skad kyang de dang 'dra bar lo rgyus kyi dus yun shin tu ring mo zhig gi nang 459

du thon skyed rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba dang 'brel/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i shes rgya yang je cher gyur pa dang / phan tshun 'brel ba byed pa'i rgya khyon yang je cher gyur pas/ de'i yo byad gtso bor gyur pa'i skad cha la'ang 'phel rgyas chen po byung ste rim gyis phun sum tshogs shing gya nom par gyur/ de yang skad cha'i 'phel rim gyi thog nas bshad na/ rang byung du dar ba'i 'phel rim dang gzhung lugs kyis gcun pa'i 'phel rim gnyis su dbye chog ste/ yul 'dir ya thog bod kyi mi rgyud srid pa nas bzung / bod mi rnams kyis phan tshun bar brda sprod pa'i thun mong gi skad de bod skad ces pa'i gdags gzhi de nyid byung yod la / de'ang lo rgyus kyi bshul lam ring mo zhig gi nang du/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun nas rim gyis 'phel rgyas byung ba zhig yin/ de ltar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ thon skyed ngal rtsol gyi nang du mi rnams bya dngos 'dra min sna tshogs la phrad pa dang / de dag la rang rang gis 'dod pa ltar ming sogs btags pa las tha snyad mang bor song ba dang / de dag tshig tu sbyar te bsam pa brje res sogs byas nas phan tshun la brda sprod pa'i skad de 'phel rgyas su phyin pa yin/ skad de'ang rigs rus so so'i gnas yul tha dad pa dang /gnas skabs kyi cha rkyen mi 'dra ba ci rigs par brten nas dus rim so so'i nang —/ skad kyi sgra gdangs spyod tshul dang ming brda tha snyad sogs la 'pho 'gyur ci rigs shig byung yod de/ dper na ma gzhir gcig gyur gyi spyi tshogs shig phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen ga ge mo zhig gis/ yul gru khag du mar gyes pa dang phan tshun bar 'gro 'ong gi 'brel ba de rang bzhin gyis nyung bar gyur nas dus yun ring bo zhig 'gor rjes/ dang thog gcig gyur gyi skad de'ang sa phyogs mi 'dra ba'i 460

dbang gis yul skad kyi shan zhugs nas khyad par yong srid pa lta bu'o/ /yin na'ang bod yul 'dir shin tu snga ba'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po sogs kyi dus su / tsho ba khag gcig tu 'dres te dpal 'byor dang chab srid sogs gcig tu gyur par brten/ skad cha la'ang de mthun gyi gcig gyur yong yod par the tshom ci / rlabs chen gyi slob dpon mar khe sis/ 8sa phyogs kyi skad rnams gcig tu gyur nas mi rigs kyi skad thun mong ba zhig byung ba ni dpal 'byor dang chab srid gcig tu gyur pa la rag las yod mices gsungs/ mdor na/ btsan po de dag gi ring la rang rang gi mnga' 'og tu tshud pa'i yul phyogs de'i mi rnams kyis / bod rang gi gzhi rtsa'i skad lugs 'di mu mthud du rgyun bsrings pa ma zad / skad cha 'di gcig mthun yong bar byed pa la bsub tu med pa'i byas rjes bzhag yod/ gzhan yang btsan po de dag gi ring gi bod skad ni/ gzhung lugs kyi rtsa tshig gang gis kyang gcun med par ming dang tshig gi sbyor stangs dang phrad kyi thob thang sogs thog ma nas rang byung gi goms srol ltar dar ba yin pas/ rang byung du dar ba'i 'phel rim tsam du zad do/ /de yang dus rabs bdun pa'i nang la/ mtshan snyan gyi ba dan srid rtser g.yo ba'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po mchog gi mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i mthu yis/ bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur zhing dgongs don ma lus lhun gyis grub nas/ bod kyi skad 'di sngar las lhag pa'i gcig gyur dang tshad ldan can gyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas btang / de yang gsal bar bshad na/ rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po'i rjes su lo tsā ba thon mi sam bho ṭas/ bod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i skad 'di'i don dngos la gzigs shing bod skad kyi gzhi gdangs rnams 'tshol bsdu byas pa'i 461

rmang gzhi'i thog yig gzugs gsar tu bzos pa dang / bod skad kyi 'bri klog gi khyad chos dang ming brda'i sgra gdangs dang rjod byed tshig gi grub stangs sogs la gzhi bcol nas thugs gzhig dpyad brdar gang legs byas shing / rgya gar gyi sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos kyi ma lag la zur lta byas nas/ bod skad kyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i gcig gyur gyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung thog mar brtsams te/bod skad 'thus je tshang dang tshags je zhib tu btang ba yin/ dus de nas bzung bod skad kyi ming dang tshig gi sbyor stangs dang phrad kyi thob thang sogs sum rtags kyi gzhung ltar sbyor srol dar ba'i phyir/ gzhung lugs kyis gcun pa'i 'phel rim gyi 'go brtsams pa yin/ skabs de'i bod skad kyi gnas tshul ji 'dra yin pa yul dus kyis bskal na'ang / bod kyi yi ge ni sgra sbyor yi ge yin pas rgya bod byung 'phel brjod pa'i deb ther khag las 'phros pa'i rgyal po'i ming dang sa cha'i ming gi skad gdangs 'don tshul las/ bod skad kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos mtshon pa'i gnas te skad gdangs klog tshul tsam shes thub/ dus rabs bdun pa'i dus mjug nas dus rabs bcu ba'i dus mjug tu/ bod skad kyi skad gdangs brda sprod/ ming tshig sogs la 'pho 'gyur che tsam byung yod/ bod skad 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos de dag la gzhigs nas skad gsar ba'i lam du dag bcos byas te gtan la phab/ de yang da drag dang rkyang ba'i 'a rten sogs spangs shing / gna'i brda sogs go dka' ba rnams dor nas yul dus dang mthun pa'i go sla zhing 'don bde bar byas/ dus 'di'i yan chad du phrad mang dag cig la gtan 'khel ba'i spyod srol med mod kyi/ 'on kyang bod kyi skad 'phel mtshams 'dir slebs pa dang / yang sgos su skad gsar bcad thengs 462

gnyis byas rjes phrad so sor gtan 'khel ba'i sbyor srol re 'dug pas/ bod skad kyi brda sprod gzhung lugs dang de'i nyams len 'thus tshang can gyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas byung ba red/ dus rabs bcu ba'i dus mjug nas bod du btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi gcig gyur dbang sgyur de kha thor ya bral du song zhing / sa phyogs dang yul lung so so'i dbang 'dzin pas rang dbang bdag 'dzin byed pa'i dus su slebs pas/ bod skad la phog thug chen po byung ste rim bzhin yul skad dang lung skad kyi dbang du song / dus mtshams 'di'i yan chad de bod kyi btsan po dang lo tsā ba rnamarmo kyi sku ring la deng dus ltar mdo dbus khams gsum sogs yul lung tha dad pas khyad par phyes pa'i yul skad rnams kyi sgra gdangs klog tshul sogs la khyad par med par rtogs thub pa yin/ de yang bod kyi byung 'phel brjod pa'i deb ther khag gi gsung sgros ltar na/ dus rabs bcu ba'i mjug tu lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus su lo tsā ba rin chen bzang bo sogs kyis bod skad la gsar bcad gnang bar gsungs/ skabs der skad gsar bcad gnang don ni gi gu ldog pa sogs bcos pa las gtso bo ni bkas bcad gong ma'i brjod don rnams sngar las lag len don 'khyol zhig yong phyir yin snyam/ phyis su yon gong ma dang sa skya bas gtsos bod kyi chos srid mi snas mnyam sdeb byas par brten/ kha bral ya thor gyi gnas bab las rgyal te chos srid zung 'brel gyi srid dbang btsugs/ snga ma lo brgya phrag gsum lhag gi kha 'thor ya bral gyi lo rgyus 'phel rim nang / bod rang gi skad la phog thug chen po byung nas yul lung so so'i kha skad kyi dbang du song na'ang / dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dus mjug nas dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus mjug bar gyi dus 463

mtshams 'di'i nang / bod kyi ser skya mkhas dbang rim byon gyis lo rgyus dang /grub mtha'/ rtsom rig sogs rig pa'i gnas la phyag rtsom bla na med pa mdzad yod par brten/ bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung de dang des nye bar gcun pa'i yig skad ni 'phel rgyas gtong thub pa byung / dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus mjug nas dus deng gi bar gyi bod skad kyi gnas tshul de gong gi dus mtshams khag dang bsdur na cung shes sla/ gcig nas dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mang tsam yod pa dang / gnyis nas bod kyi skad yig rig par zhib 'jug byed mkhan tshos sbyar ba'i phyag rtsom mang tsam yod pas/ 'dir phran gyis de tsam las ma spros so/ /gong gsal ltar rgyal po dang lo tsā ba de dag gi sku ring la skabs de'i spyi tshogs dang skad yig 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkhor legs par bstun nas/ bod skad kyi ming brda tha snyad dang tshig sbyor sogs skad yig gi phyi mo'am rtsa ba brda sprod kyi rnam gzhag dang mthun par gcig gyur byas shing skad gsar ba'i lam du yang yang dag bcos byas te gtan la phab mod/ yin na'ang dus 'gyur gyi yo lang mang du brgyud pa sogs gnas skabs kyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa zhig gis/rang sar gang bder bsgyur nas yul skad kyi shan zhugs te mthar yul lung tha dad pas khyad par phyes pa'i yul skad sna tshogs pa zhig dang / de'i bye brag tu'ang mi 'dra ba ci rigs shig byung yod pa tshang mas mngon sum mthong chos su grub/'o na/ de dag la ci'i phyir bod skad ces su grags pa yin zhes dris na/ de ni gna' bo'i skad lugs de dang de'i sbyor ba dang rjes su 'brel ba'i phyir yin la/skad 'di'i rang gshis sam rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi la deng dus kyi bar 'gyur ba ma 464

thebs par gnas pa rang re rnams kyi dbang bo'i mngon sum du gyur ba 'di red / ma 'ongs dar rgyas kyi phyogs su gtong tshul yang spyi tshogs 'phel phyogs kyi dgos mkhor gzhigs na/ skad rigs gang 'dra zhig yin rung de'i yul sde gcig gam sa khul 'ba' zhig la zhabs 'degs zhu thub pa tsam gyis mi 'grig par / mi rigs hril pos ha go zhing phan tshun bar go brda 'phrod nges pa'i thun mong gi skad cha zhig chags rgyu de ni shin tu gal che'o/ /gsum pa/ bod skad spyod spel bya tshul/bod kyi yul khams ni stod mnga' ris nas smad rgyal rong gi bar shin tu rgya che zhing / yul gru phan tshun bar sa thag ring bos brgyangs pa zhig yin/ 'das pa'i dus su 'grim 'grul yang gtso bo rta khal dang rkang ba'i 'gros la brten dgos pa las/ deng sang gi cha rkyen lta bu'i sngon thon 'grim 'grul mkho chas gang yang med stabs/ yul stod smad kyi sde khag tu chad pa dang rong 'brog bar gyi 'brel ba dam por byed ma nus pa sogs kyis/ bod skad bed spyod byed pa la 'gal rkyen chen po bzos yod/ deng 'dir yang dag srid jus kyi 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phros par brten/ bod du sngar med pa'i 'pho 'gyur che shos shig byung ba ni 'grim 'grul sogs kyi mthun rkyen bzang bo bskrun nas/ rim bzhin rkang thang dang rta khal la brten dgos pa'i rjes lus kyi rnam pa 'di brjes te/bod yul stod smad dang zhing 'brog bcas kyi bar du'ang 'brel ba dam zab byed thub pa byung / tshul 'dis bod kyi skad yig kho na'i thad nas bshad na de nyid sbyong spyod spel gsum byed pa la mthun rkyen legs po bskrun yod pa yin/465

gcig tha snyad gsar spel bya dgos/rang re'i dus rabs ni/ spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur nyin re las nyin re shin tu myur ba'i dus rabs khyad par can zhig yin pa mngon sum mthong chos su grub / 'di lta bu'i 'pho 'gyur che la myur ba'i dus skabs su deng rabs tshan rig zhib 'jug las rig so so nas snang tshul gsar ba dang chos nyid gsar ba mu mthud du rnyed rtogs byed pa'i nang / grangs kyis 'jigs pa ster ba'i bya dngos gsar ba mang po thon pa la de mthun gyi bod kyi tha snyad gsar bzo de'i rjes su ma zin pa dang / bzos yod pa dag kyang khyab gdal dang bed spyod byed ma nus pa'am 'ga' re byas yod pa phal cher mi rigs gzhan gyi skad 'dres mar spyod pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ de yang rgya'i skad sor bzhag byas pa'i tha snyad mang po bsres pa'i rgya ma bod kyi skad du gyur pa'i skor dang / bod rang gis snga dus nas bed spyod byed kyin yod pa'i dngos rdzas kyi tha snyad dor nas rgya skad kyis tshab byed pa'i skor gnyis yod la/ gnas tshul 'di rigs la brtag na/ snga ma ni rgya skad kyi ming bod la bsgyur ba'i tha snyad yod kyang / rgya skad 'di dag thog ma bkol ba'i skabs su sgyur ming gcigs su ma bzung ba'i rkyen gyis/ rgya skad kyi rjes ma chod par zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi ngag la lobs song bas da lta bsgyur 'dod kyang 'gyur dka' ba'i gnas su 'dug /phyi ma ni bod skad du tha snyad gsar bzo byed mi dgos par gna' dus nas yod bzhin du bod skad 'di nyams rgyad du 'gro ba'i nyen kha chen po zhig tu ma mthong bar tha snyad log bzo'i ltas ngan gyi goms srol chags pa tsam du zad/ de min gsar byung mang po zhig la dus da lta'i bar du bod skad kyi tha snyad zhig med pas/ rgya skad kyi rjes 'jug 466

tu mi zhugs kyang re zhig thabs med pa ltar gyur 'dug mod/ yin na'ang de ni yun ring gi thabs shig min pa tshang mas shes bzhin pa red/ rje btsun sa paṇa gyis / ‘ brda sprod pa'i mkhas pa dag gis brda gsar ba ma sbyar na/ don mi 'grub pa mthong na/ gsar ba sbyar ba ma 'gal mod ces gsungs pa ltar/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi mkhas dbang rnam pas/ thog ma'i skad cha'i ma lag de'i rmang gzhi'i thog dngos po so so'i khyad chos dang nus pa/ de min bzo dbyibs sogs la brten nas tha snyad gsar ba'i tshig sbyor ji ltar sgrub tshul sogs la zhib tu gzigs na/ bdag cag la dka' gnas 'di dkrol ba'i thabs lam yang dag cig bstan yod de/ dper na/ mtshams dang sprin gnyis lhan du sbrel ba las mtshams sprin zhes pa nyi ma shar nub mtshams kyi sprin dmar po'i ming yang mtshams sprin gyi dmar ba'i khyad chos dang 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas tha snyad sogs bzos yod pa dper na/ mtshams sprin can zhes pa me tog gi ya rgyal zhig gi ming dang / gzhan yang chu dang bya gnyis lhan du sbrel ba las chu bya zhes pa lta bu 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas ming btags pa dang / rin lta bu ming tshig dang chen po lta bu khyad chos sam yon tan gyi ming gnyis sbrel ba las rin chen zhes pa lta bu'i tha snyad gzhan zhig 'byung gi yod pa sogs kyis mtshon/ gzhan yang nga tshos mig dper 'os pa'i skad rigs gzhan gyis rang rang gi shes rig sna tshogs pa'i mthun rkyen du dgos nges che pa'i brda sbyor ci rigs pa dang / tha snyad kyi bye brag gsar ba du ma dus bstun du spel tshul sogs la zhib tu gzigs na'ang —/ zur blta'i dpyad gzhir 'os pa'i gnas mi nyung ba las blang bya'i thabs 'ga' re rnyed thub snyam/ mdor na/ nga tshos bod spyi'i ming tshig zhib 467

'jug tshogs pa sogs btsugs nas/ gna' dang da yod kyi ming tshig gcig dang tha dad dang / bod la sngar yod kyi ming tshig mi spyod pa rnams rim bzhin mi rigs rang gi ming tshig spyod pa'i phyogs su bskul ba dang / las rigs so so'i ming tshig tha snyad bcas med pa rnams ni/ bod kyi thog ma'i skad cha'i ma lag de'i rmang gzhi'i thog gzhan nas bod skad du bsgyur ba'am bod spyi la khyab pa'i tha snyad gsar bzo byed cing / de dag la brjod don gsar ba nges gtan byas te shes rig gsar ba spel dgos par ma zad/ rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams la tha snyad gsar ba de rigs ngo sprod byed thub pa'i tshig mdzod che chung sna tshogs pa spel dgos so/ /gnyis / bod sbyi 'gros kyi skad gtan la dbab dgos/da lta'i dus rabs ni mi rigs so so'i srid 'byor rig gsum dar rgyas su gtong ba'i skal ba bzang po btsal bas mi rnyed pa dang drangs pas mi drongs pa zhig yin la/ dus rabs khyad par can 'di'i nang du bdag cag bod rigs rnams sngon ltar gna' lugs kho na'i steng du gnas thabs med cing gnas par dka' ba'i chos nyid can zhig yin pa ni nyin re las nyin rer je gsal du 'gro bzhin yod/ rgyu mtshan der brten nga tshos deng dus spyi tshogs kyi 'phel phyogs dang dgos mkhor gzhigs na/ bod spyi 'gros kyi skad cig chags rgyu ni lhag par du gal che ba dang 'gangs che bar mthong / de yang deng sang mdo dbus khams gsum gyi yul skad gang gis bod spyi 'gros kyi skad cha'i rmang gzhi byed pa la/yul gsum dang mkhas pa so sor bzhed tshul mi mthun pa mang po mchis pa ma zad / rang rang gi rigs lam skyong ba'i lung yang mang po drangs na'ang / don 468

dngos thog phan pa de tsam zhig byung med pa ni tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar yin/phran gyis bltas na rang re'i bod kyang mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar yul so so'i skad lugs 'dra min sna tshogs snang ba dang / de dag bar sgra'i 'don stangs dang tha snyad 'bod tshul/ tshis sgrig stangs sogs kyi khyad par cung mchis na'ang —/ bod mi tshang mas bod spyi 'gros kyi skad cig chags pa la rang rang gi blo gros kyi mthu dang shes rab kyi rtsal bton te/ 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang nas de'i phyogs su 'bad brtson byas na de yang shin tu dka' ba'i las zhig ma yin snyam/de bas/ bod spyi 'gros kyi skad cha zhig chags dgos pa'i skor la rang gi bsam 'char 'ga' bton na/1 kha skad de yig skad dang thag je nyer gtong zhing yul skad so sos gtso bo bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang 'brel ba'i yig skad kyi thog nas gcig gyur bya dgos/ spyir kha skad kyis yig skad de nyid 'thus tshang dang cha rdzogs shig yong bar byed pa dang / yig skad kyis kyang kha skad de nyid tshad ldan dang tshul mthun zhig yong bar byed pas/ de gnyis phan tshun 'bral thabs med pa zhig yin pa tshang mas los shes/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir mkhas dbang chab spel sogs kyis /kha skad de rim bzhin yig skad dang nye ba'i phyogs su bsgyur thub dang mi thub ces dgongs 'char lhug por bstsal ba sogs blang bar bya ba'i gnas yin gyi btang snyoms su bzhag na mi rigs snyam/ kho bos kha skad de rim bzhin yig skad dang nye ba'i phyogs su bskyod rgyu zhes pa'i thabs lam la rigs pa dang ldan te/ rgyu mtshan ni kha skad la yul lung so so'i skad kyis shan zhugs pas yul phyogs mi gcig pa'i mi gnyis kyis phan tshun brda sprod pa'i tshe 469

brda 'phrod dka' ba'i gnas su gyur 'dug mod/ yin na'ang rang cag gis spyad dang spyod bzhin yod pa'i yig skad kyis kha skad kyi zhan cha de sel thub par ma zad/ bod thun mong gis brjod thub cing go bar nus pa'i khyad 'phags kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /yang yul skad so so gtso bo bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang 'brel ba'i yig skad kyi thog nas gcig gyur bya dgos zhes pa ni/ gna' bo'i skad lugs ji ma ji bzhin du gnas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ma yin te/ skad rigs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang skad cha'i byed nus kyi dbang du btang na'ang / de ltar gnas thabs med cing gnas par dka' ba'i rang bzhin can zhig yin/ des na/ nga tsho'i bod kyi skad cha'i 'phel phyogs kyi dgos mkhor gzhigs na/ de nyid brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs la'ang de mthun gyi blang dor phran tsam byas te tshags je zhib tu gtong dgos min dpyod ldan rnams kyis dpyad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang da lta nga tsho'i yul skad so so la khyad par mchis na'ang bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang 'brel ba'i yig skad la khyad par med de/ bod mi rigs kyi mkhas dbang ji rnyed cig gis/ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i lung rigs kyi bstan bcos phun sum tshogs pa grangs las 'das pa zhig brtsams yod la/ de dag gi rtsom pa po a mdo ba'am khams pa/ dbus gtsang ba'am rgyal rong ba sogs gang yin la mi bltos par bod yig gi chu tshad nges can zhig yod phyin tshang mas ha go thub pa'i khyad chos ldan yod/ bod kyi brda sprod kyi gzhung dang 'brel ba'i yig skad 'di la bod rigs yongs rdzogs gcig mthun gyi rmang gzhi brtan po yod pa ni nga tshor ldan pa'i cha rkyen bzang po zhig ma yin nam/ des na/ kha skad de yig skad dang thag 470

je nyer gtong zhing / yul skad so so gtso bo bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang 'brel ba'i yig skad kyi thog nas gcig gyur bya dgos pa las/grub mtha'i chags sdang dang sa gnas kyi 'du shes kyi dbang du song nas rang rlom gyi lta bas rtsod gleng gi gad rgyangs sgrog pas ci phan/2 dbus gtsang gi skad gdangs klog tshul gzhir bzung zhing / yul skad so so'i legs cha gcig tu 'dres pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog bod yongs kyis brjod thub cing go bar nus pa'i spyi skad cig chags dgos/ gong du bshad pa ltar yul skad chen po gsum mam bzhi po la sgra'i klog tshul dang ming ngam tha snyad 'bod tshul/ tshig gi sgrig stangs bcas la khyad par mchis na'ang / gtso bo ni sgra gdangs kyi yang lci dang klog tshul sogs kyi khyad par la thug pas/ sgra gdangs gcig mtshungs su gyur na phan tshun phal cher ha go bar 'gyur ba kho thag red/bdag gi bsam tshod ltar na dbyangs gsal sogs kyi sgra gdangs klog tshul ni dbus gtsang skad kyi sgra gdangs klog tshul gzhir bzung nas gtan la phab na legs snyam/ rgyu mtshan ni dbus gtsang gi skad gdangs klog tshul de skad gdangs 'phel rgyas kyi rtsa ba'i kha phyogs dang mthun par ma zad/ yi ge so so'i skye gnas dang gnas bab ldan pa'i nga ro yang dag pa thon thub pa'i phyir/gzhan yang lo ngo stong phrag lhag gi ring la lha sa ni bod kyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas kyi lte bar gyur pas/ mdo khams kyi skye bo rnams lha sar slob gnyer dang gnas mjal/ de min tshong las sogs kyi ched du lha sar 'dzoms te de'i skad la bag chags bzhag dang 'jog bzhin yod pa ma zad/ bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug byed mkhan gyi mi rigs gzhan pa dang / rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i 471

mkhas pa rnams las mang che shos kyis dbus gtsang gi skad slob sbyong byas dang byed bzhin yod pa sogs kyis/ dbus gtsang gi skad gzhir byas nas bod kyi spyi skad cig chags pa'i mthun rkyen du gyur yod/ 'o na tha snyad 'bod stangs dang tshig gi sgrig stangs sogs kyang dbus gtsang gi skad dang yongs su bstun dgos sam zhes dris na/ de'ang ma yin te gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar sgra gdangs klog tshul gyi cha ma gtogs phyogs kun nas bstun dgos pa'i don ni ma yin te/dbus gtsang gi yul skad du tha snyad gang mang zhig rang sar ma gtogs mi spyod pa dang / bya tshig gi 'gyur ba las dus mtshon pa rnams tshul bzhin mi spyod par rogs tshig dang tshig rkang je ring du btang nas dus sogs ston pa'i srol zhig dar 'dug pas/ de rnams ni yul skad gzhan gyi rna bar snyan zhing go bde ba'i tha snyad dang bod kyi brda sprod ma lag dang mthun pa'i tshig sbyor sogs la bstun dgos / de bas yul skad kyi legs cha gcig tu 'dres pa zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de la thug yod/ mdor na/ gtso bo bod kyi brda sprod gzhung lugs kyis gcun pa'i 'og dbus gtsang gi skad gdangs klog tshul gzhir bzung zhing yul skad legs cha gcig tu 'dres pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog bod spyi yis brjod thub cing go bar nus pa'i spyi skad cig chags dgos pa las/ dus rtag tu rang rang gi yul skad de mchog tu bzung nas yul skad gzhan dag la mthong chung dang rtsis med du gtong ba ni/ gzhung lugs dang skad rigs kyi chos nyid la dpyad pa lkog tu gyur pa'i phyogs lhung gi lta ba kho na'o/ /des na/ kha skad de gtso bor bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang 'brel ba'i yig skad dang thag je nyer gtong ba dang / dbus gtsang gi skad kyi sgra gdangs klog tshul gzhir bzung 472

zhing yul skad kyi legs shos gcig tu 'dres pa'i bod thun mong gis brjod thub cing bo bar nus pa'i spyi skad cig chags rgyur 'bad par rigs so/ /gsum / mi rigs rang gi skad yig slob gso'i ma lag cha tshang du gtong dgos/mi rigs rang gi skad yig 'di 'phel rgyas su gtong na/ thog mar mi rigs rang gi skad 'di bed spyod byed pa'i shes ldan mi sna mang po bskyed sring byed dgos par brten/ nga tshos bod kyi skad yig slob gso dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar 'brel yod sde khag la dge mtshan ldan pa'i re ba 'don dgos/ de yang deng sang mi rigs skad yig slob gsor zhib 'jug gi spro ba ldan pa'i mkhas pa tshor gcig mthun gyi lta tshul zhig yod pa ni/ mi rigs kyi slob gso'i ma lag 'thus tshang cha rdzogs shig tu btang na da gzod mi rigs de'i skad yig lam sked nas chud zos su mi 'gro bar ma zad/ de nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel tu 'gro ba'i thabs lam khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin zhes pa de yin/ slob gso'i ma lag cha tshang ba dang bslab sbyang du 'jug pa'i thabs bzang bo sogs kyis/mi rigs rang gi skad yig bkol spyod byed mkhan gyi shes ldan mi sna 'bum phrag du ma bskyang ba dang chabs cig mi rigs hril bo'i skad yig gi byang tshad mtho ru gtong bas/ slob chung nas slob 'bring rim bzhin slob grwa chen mo'i bar 'brel chags shing rgyun mthud pa'i bod kyi skad yig slob gso'i ma lag cha tshang ba zhig chags rgyu ni shin tu gal che ba dang dgos nges pa zhig yin/473

bzhi/ bya ba dngos kyi nang bod skad bed spyod byed pa'i khor yug che ru gtong dgos/de ni da skabs slob grwa mi nyung ba zhig gi nang du bod skad dang bod yig gi sbyangs 'bras bzang ba'i slob ma mi nyung ba zhig byung dang 'byung bzhin yod mod/yin na'ang spyi tshogs kyi bya ba dngos kyi nang bed spyod tshul la bltas na de dang mi mthun pa zhig red/ ma tshad slob gso dang de'i byed nus bar 'gal ba 'byung rkyen yang gnad 'di la thug yod snyam/ don dngos dang drang thad nas bshad na/rim pa khag gi tang srid las khungs dang khe las las don sde tshan bcas kyi bya ba'i nang bod skad dang bod yig ni spyod sgo chung bas/ bod skad bod yig sbyangs pa'i shes yon can rnams phyir las gnas su yong na blo gros kyi mthu dang shes rab kyi rtsal bton pa'i go skabs nyung ba red/ de ni rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi bya ba dang 'tsho ba'i nang bod skad dang bod yig nye bar mkho ba'i gnas tshul dang 'os shing mthun pa zhig ga la yin/ mdor na/ gong gsal gyi gnas tshul sogs la dmigs nas da skabs yongs khyab kyi lta tshul zhig yod pa ni / bod mi rigs kyi skad 'di 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos na/ thog mar bkol spyod kyi gnad don 'di nyid thag gcod dgos zhes pa dang / mi rigs rang gi skad 'di bkol spyod legs po zhig yong bar byed na/ thog mar 'di phyogs kyi bya ba gcigs 'dzin bgyid pa'i las khungs dang 'go khrid pa med mi rung / mig snga'i gnas tshul dang bstun na lta tshul 'di la brtag dpyad kyi chu tshad mthon po mnga' zhing / des zhib 'jug gi bya bar gzhol 'dod pa rnams la blo sgo yangs por 'byed pa'i 'jug ngogs shig bstan yod par gdon mi za/ deng rabs kyi 474

tshan rig dang rig gnas kyis mi rigs shig gi lus la nus rtsal rgyas pa dang /mang tshogs yongs kyi hur brtson bskul ma'i 'dab gshog cig ldan dgos na/thog mar mi rigs rang gi skad cha dang yig ger brten dgos pa red/ de yang kha bshad tsam gyis mi 'grub par dgos nges kyis gcigs chen byas te gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags dang rig gnas slob gso/ 'grim 'grul dang yig skyel glog 'phrin / zhabs 'degs las rigs sogs kyi bya ba'i nang du bod skad bod yig bed spyod byas nas spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mtho ru btang na/ da gzod gong gi gnad 'gag de bsal thub par ma zad/ bod skad dang bod yig sbyangs pa'i mi rnams kyis rang gi yon tan gyi gshog 'dab brkyangs pa'i khor yug yangs po zhig chags par the tshom med do/ /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(1) sgra rig pa'i spyi rnam/ cang su'u slob gso'i dpe skrun khang gis 1990lor dpar bskrun byas/(2) skad rigs kyi 'byung khungs khyad chos/ (krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉1989lo'i deb dang po/(3) bod pa'i skad kyi lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams dbye stangs dang dus mtshams so // /da kyi gzhi gdangs khyad chos skor/ (krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉1993lo'i deb 475

bod kyi sbyi skad khyab spel gtong ba'i skor gyi bsam gzhigs/mi nyag kun dga' rgyal mtshan/spyir skad yig ni mi rigs su 'dra zhig la mtshon na'ang ha cang gal che ba zhig yin te/ mi rigs so so'i rig gnas dang lo rgyus/ chab srid/ dpal 'byor sogs spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul ci 'dra zhig yod rung tshang ma skad yig la brten nas brjod dgos shing / mi rnams phan tshun bsam blo brje res sogs 'brel ba tshang ma gtso bo skad yig la brten nas byed dgos/ der brten mi rigs so so la rang rang gi thun mong min pa'i skad yig yod cing gal srid mi rigs gang zhig gi skad yig nyams song na de'i rig gnas kyang gnas dka' ba zhig red/rgyu mtshan ni mi rigs so sos rang rang gi rig gnas dang lo rgyus bskrun pa'i brgyud rim khrod du/ de dag gi rjod byed du gyur pa'i rang rang gi thun mong min pa'i skad yig spyod de bskrun pa zhig yin pas mtshon byed kyi skad yig dang mtshon bya'i rig gnas/ lo rgyus sogs kyi bar du 'bral thabs med pa'i gnas gzhi dang gnas chos kyi 'brel ba zhig grub yod/ 'brel ba de la 'bral thabs med pa zer dgos don yang gal srid mi rigs zhig gi rig gnas de mi rigs gzhan pa zhig gi skad yig la brten nas mtshon dgos na/ de'i ngo bo ji bzhin du 476

brjod dka' zhing bro ba yang mi ldan la de dag bskrun pa'i thun min gyi brgyud rim yang mtshon mi thub/ skabs de 'dra zhig la slebs dus mi rigs rig gnas de'i tshe srog kyang phal cher rdzogs pa'i mtshams la slebs pa yin te/ de yang mi zhig la cha mtshon na rig gnas ni gnas chos rnam shes dang skad yig ni gnas gzhi lus po'am srog rtsa de yin pas lus po 'jig tshe rnam shes gnas mi thub pa bzhin skad yig 'jig na'ang rig gnas gnas dka' 'o/ /spyi tshogs kyi 'phel 'gyur dang phyi rol yul gyi dngos po'i 'gyur ldog ltar mi rigs so so'i skad yig kyang 'gyur ldog gi rang bzhin las 'bral thabs med pa chos nyid yin mod/ phyi rol yul gyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs las 'gyur ldog gi rnam pa ni sna tshogs su mchis pa zhig yin/ deng dus gling hril po can du 'gyur ba'i gom stabs je mgyogs su 'gro ba'i dus 'dir/ mi rigs so so'i rig gnas kyi bar du phan tshun shugs rkyen thebs res shin tu che zhing / dar rgyas su phyin tshar med pa'i rgyal khab dang mi rigs mang po zhig gi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi gnas bab de khyon yongs nas ha cang tshabs chen zhig gi nang du tshud yod de/ phyogs gcig nas rgyal khab dang mi rigs kha shas kyis rang gi dpal 'byor dang chab srid dmag don sogs kyi stobs shugs la brten nas rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan gyi 'dod mos dang lo rgyus/ dngos yod gnas tshul sogs la mi bstun par btsan shed kyis rig gnas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi byed thabs 'ba' zhig spyod bzhin yod pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas mi rigs dang mi rigs/rgyal khab dang rgyal khab/ sa gnas dang sa gnas bar gyi 'brel ba de lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gang zhig dang sdur rung rtsa ba'i 'gyur ldog byung yod cing 'gyur ldog 477

des mi rigs dang rgyal khab sa gnas so so'i bar gyi rig gnas la phan tshun shugs rkyen gtong thebs de ldog thabs med pa'i las shig tu slebs yod pa red/dus skabs 'di 'dra zhig gi nang du mi rigs rig gnas kyi srog rtsa'am mtshon byed gtso bo skad yig gi mdun lam la 'dang yag po zhig rgyag rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtug gi las 'gan du babs 'dug pas/ rang re'i skad yig las don sgrub mkhan dang bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas srung skyob kyi las don thad la thugs bsam rgyag mkhan rnam pas blo rtse gcig sgril gyis 'bad dgos pa'i dus su slebs 'dug snyam/ der brten 'dir thog mar bod kyi skad yig gi nus pa nyams rgyad du 'gro bzhin yod pa'i gnad don la dmigs nas bsam tshul 'ga' zhig gleng na/ 'dir gnas tshul 'di 'dra 'ga' zhig mthong ste/gcig bod mi rigs thun mong gi spyi skad chags thub med pa'i skor/bod yul du spyir mdo dbus khams gsum gyi yul skad chen po gsum yod cing / yul skad de dag gi nang du yang sa gnas so so'i bar du phan tshun go brda 'phrod thub pa tsam las don du khyad par mi chung ba ldan pa sha stag yin/ da dung de min sa gnas phran tshegs su spyod pa'i sa gnas kyi skad kyang mi nyung ba zhig yod de/ dper na khams phyogs su mtshon na rgyal rong skad/ mi nyag skad/rta'u skad sogs ni bod skad dang rgyang thag cung tsam ring ba'i sa gnas phran tshegs pa'i yul skad yin no/ /der brten deng sang bod yul du bod skad spyod mi sa ya bzhi 'bum lnga khri dgu tsam yod mod/ lo rgyus kyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs las yul skad so sor gyes pas phan tshun go brda 'phrod cung dka' ba dang / phan tshun 478

'grims 'brel byed skabs su yang rgya skad la brten che bas bod kyi yul skad dag gi bar du 'brel ba byed nyung ba'i gnas tshul tshabs chen zhig dang phrad yod / rgya rigs la mtshon na yang yul skad chen po bdun tsam bgrang du yod pa ma zad de dag phan tshun bar du khyad par shin tu che mod/ mi rigs yongs kyis spyod pa'i spyi skad chags thub yod pas skad yig gi stobs shugs ha cang che zhing mi rigs kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gyi las don der byas rjes bla na med pa 'jog thub bzhin yod pa lta bu red/ 'dir bod rang la de lta bu gal che ba'i spyi skad chags thub med pa'i rgyu mtshan gang red zer na gnas tshul 'di 'dra 'ga' zhig snang ba gsham gsal/1 lo rgyus kyi rgyu rkyen las skad gcig gyur la tshod 'dzin thebs pa/bod kyi btsan po'i rgyal rabs sil bur 'thor nas bzung / bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther rnams su lung pa re la rgyal po re zhes 'byung ba bzhin mi lo bzhi brgya lhag tsam gyi ring la bod kyi mi rigs 'di gcig gyur byung thub med cing / yon rgyal rabs kyi skabs su sa skya pas srid dbang 'dzin pa nas bzung sil bur gnas pa'i rnam pa mjug rdzogs mod/ phyogs gcig nas don ngo bo'i steng nas bod khul sa gnas so so'i bar gyi 'brel ba la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ma thub cing —/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang bsgyur stobs shugs kyang bod mtha' 'khob rnams su ha cang zhan pas bod yul hril po'i 'brel ba la tshod 'dzin thebs yod/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas dga' ldan pho brang gis srid dbang bzung ba'i dus dkyil tsam nas man jus srid gzhung gis bod khul du so sor phye ste 'dzin pa'i 'thab jus lag len bstar nas bzung / bod mtha' 'khob kyi sa cha 479

mang po bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang 'brel ba je lhod du phyin cing / bod yul so so sngar bas kyang kher rkyang du lus pa'i gnas tshul byung ba red/2 bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo las tshod 'dzin thebs pa/bod kyi spyi tshogs ni da bar zhing las dpal 'byor gyi nang du gnas pa zhig yin cing / sa gnas dang tsho ba so so'i bar du dpal 'byor thad kyi 'brel ba ha cang nyung ba dang / de bzhin srid dbang sgrig 'dzugs kyi thad nas kyang gong du smos pa bzhin 'brel ba ha cang lhod nas sa gnas so so'i bar gyi yul skad kyi rgyang thag je nye yong bar tshod 'dzin chen po thebs yod pa red/3 bod yul gyi skyel 'dren gyi cha rkyen zhan pas kyang yul khag so so'i bar du 'brel ba nyung ba/bod mtho sgang gi sa gnas su skyel 'dren gyi cha rkyen ni dus yun ring po'i nang du rta zog kho na la brten pa yin zhing sa btsan pas yul so so'i bar du phan tshun 'brel 'dris byed dka' ba las kyang tshod 'dzin thebs yod/gnyis / bod kyi spyi skad gtan 'khel byas te khyab spel gtong dgos pa'i skor/mi rigs ci 'dra zhig yin rung rang nyid lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i khrod du gnas shing 'phel rgyas yong rgyu'i re 'dod yod cing de ltar mi rigs de nyid la rang skyong gi dbang cha dang rang nyid mu mthud du gnas pa'i dbang cha yang yod pa zhig yin/ de ltar min par su zhig gis dbang cha de dag 'phrog bsam na de ni mi rigs mthun sgril gyi dgra bo yin zhing spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags dang mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun gyi bya ba la yang gnod 'tshe 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen chen po 480

zhig yin par gdon mi za'o/ /de ltar na thog mar mi rigs kyi ngo bo la ngos 'dzin yag po zhig yod dgos shing de ci 'dra zhig red zer na/ mi rigs zhes pa ni thun mong gi skad yig yod pa/ thun mong gi rig gnas yod pa/ thun mong gi lo rgyus yod pa/ thun mong gi sems khams kyi 'du shes sogs yod pa'i mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs kyi grub cha zhig yin/ mi rigs de nyid mi rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni rang nyid la thun mong min pa'i rig gnas yod pa la thug yod cing / de nyid mu mthud nas gnas shing dar rgyas yong dgos na rang nyid kyi skad yig med thabs med de thun mong min pa'i rig gnas de gtso bo mi rigs de'i thun mong min pa'i skad yig gi steng nas mtshon bzhin yod pas so/ /der brten skad yig de deng sang spyi tshogs kyi khrod du phan tshun go brda 'phrod byed kyi lag cha tsam kho na la 'dang rgyag na skad yig gi byed las la da dung ngos 'dzin yag po yong med pa yin zhing / don dngos thog skad yig gi byed las ni go brda sprod byed kyi lag cha yin pa ma zad da dung ches gal che ba zhig la mi rigs rig gnas kyi srog rtsa bzung yod pa de yin/ gal srid mi rigs gang zhig gis rang nyid kyi rig gnas rtsa ba nas nyams shor na don dngos thog mi rigs de nyid kyang 'jig pa yin te/ gang zhig rang gi rig gnas nyams pa'i mi rigs ni rang gi mtshan nyid shor ba yin pas de nyid ming gi lhag ma tsam du zad pas so/ /der brten mi rigs kyi skad yig gi mdun lam la 'dang yag po zhig rgyag min ni mi rigs de nyid kyi tshe srog la do snang byed min la thug yod cing / skad yig gi mdun lam ni mi rigag de'i thun mong gi spyi skad chags thub min la rag 481

las te/ gal srid bod thun mong gis spyod pa'i spyi skad cig chags ma thub na spyi tshogs kyi khor yug chen po'i khrod du bod pa nang phan tshun yang mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig spyod dgos pa'i gnas babs de las brgal dka' ba dang / de ltar yun ring song tshe bod kyi skad yig gi nus pa je nyams su phyin te mtha' mar rtsa ba nas brlag pa'i nyen kha ha cang che'o/ /der brten rang re bod la mtshon na deng sang kha tsha dgos gtug gi las 'gan ni mdo dbus khams gsum gyis go nus pa'i spyi skad khyab spel gtong rgyu la dam 'dzin byed dgos pa de red 'dug /gsum / bod kyi spyi skad khyab spel gtong ba la mi rigs rang skyong sa khul gyi srid gzhung gis 'gan gtso bo bzhes dgos pa'i skor/mi rigs rang skyong sa khul gyi srid gzhung gi byed nus la ma brten na spyi skad gtan 'khel byas rung khyab brdal gtong thabs bral te/ dper na rgya skad la spyi skad chags thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo srid gzhung gi byed nus las yin pa ltar red/ de yang yin te gal srid srid gzhung gi gcig gyur gyi bkod sgrig med na rgya skad kyi yul skad chen po bdun gyis gtsos pa'i sa gnas khag gi bar du gcig gyur gyi lta ba 'byung dka' ba dang / byung rung khyab brdal gtong mi thub ste / mi lo mang po'i ring la btsugs nas spyi skad chags shing khyab brdal du 'gro thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus 'og srid gzhung gi nus pa legs por 'don thub pa la thug yod/mi rigs rang skyong sa khul gyi srid gzhung ni sa gnas de ga'i mi rigs kyi khe phan tshab byed pa'i srid gzhung yin pas/ sa gnas de ga'i mang tshogs kyi 'dod blo mtshon thub dgos shing de'i khe phan la srid gzhung gi thun mong min 482

pa'i nus pa thon thub dgos pa zhig red/ mi rigs su yin rung rang nyid kyi skad yig bed spyod gtong rgyu la mi dga' ba'i bsam blo yod mi srid cing / gal srid srid gzhung gang zhig gis de'i gnas tshul la mthong chen ma byas par grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad yig ni med na'ang chog pa'i lta ba bzung na de ni mi dmangs kyi khe phan dang 'gal ba'i mi rigs chen po'i 'du shes yin pas mi rigs mthun sgril gyi 'gal rkyen yin pa dang tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang yang 'gal lo/ /de bzhin gong du smos zin bzhin mi rigs shig gi tshe srog ni mi rigs de'i rig gnas la rag las shing / mi rigs rig gnas kyi tshe srog ni mi rigs de'i skad yig la rag las pa'i gnas tshul 'di'i thad nas mi rigs rang skyong srid gzhung gis mi rigs kyi skad yig gi mdun lam la 'dang zhib tu rgyag dgos pa yin par ma zad/ mi rigs sa khul gyi rjes lus kyi rnam pa de ngo bo'i thog nas bsgyur dgos na rang gi skad yig slob gso la dam 'dzin byed dgos te/ spyir grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul du mi rigs de'i pha skad la brten nas slob gso byed dgos pa las/ gal srid rgya skad rkyang pa'i steng nas slob gso byed pa yin na sa khul de dag tu skad yig gi khur po je ljid du song nas/ slob gso'i las don la grub 'bras thob dka' zhing de las dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun la'ang thad kur 'gog rkyen du 'gyur bas/ mi rigs sa khul de sa khul gzhan pa khag dang sdur na rjes lus kyi tshad je ring du phyin pa las thabs gzhan med do/ /bzhi / phyi'i rig gnas kyi shugs rkyen dang de la gtad pa'i thabs shes/483

gong du smos pa bzhin dus rabs kyi gnas babs gsar pas 'dzam bu gling hril por shugs rkyen ha cang chen po ster bzhin yod cing / de las sa gnas so so'i 'phel rgyas kyi gom stabs mdun nas mdun du bskyod bzhin yod pa dang lhan du/ yul khams de dag gi srol rgyun rig gnas la shugs rkyen ha cang chen po thebs bzhin yod/ de yang a me ri gas gtsos pa'i nub phyogs rig gnas kyis gling hril po'i khyon du dpal 'byor dang dmag don/ chab srid sogs kyi lag cha la brten nas mi rigs dang rgyal khab gzhan pa'i rig gnas la phyogs yongs nas rig gnas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi byed thabs spyad pas/ mi rigs de dag gi rig gnas la bsam yul las 'das pa'i shugs rkyen thebs bzhin yod pa dang yang sgos su stobs shugs zhan pa'i mi rigs dang rgyal khab kyi rig gnas gnas babs de nyen kha ha cang che ba'i dus skabs shig tu slebs yod pa red/spyir mi rigs kyi rig gnas de phyi yi rig gnas dang phrad dus 'gro lam gnyis yod cing / gcig ni sgo rgyag pa'i thabs shes spyad de rang gi khyab khongs su rig gnas gzhan gyi shugs rkyen rtsa ba nas thebs par mi bcug pa dang /gcig shos ni de las ldog ste rig gnas gzhan la dga' bsu zhu ba'i rnam pa gtad cing de'i legs cha rnams dang du blangs pa'i thabs shes spyod rgyu de red/de las 'gro lam dang po ni 'das pa'i lo zla'i khrod du rang cag gis spyod pa'i thabs shes de yin zhing des rang re'i mi rigs 'di la brjed dka' ba'i pham kha byin yod/ 'gro lam gnyis pa la tshang mas dga' bsu byed bzhin yod cing de las mi rigs kyi rig gnas de mu mthud nas mdun du bskyod thub pa'i re ba 484

yod pa red/ deng sang gi gnas tshul la gna' snga mo ltar 'gro lam gnyis pa la ngo rgol byed mkhan med pas de dang du blangs pa la rtsod pa med/ 'on te gnad don dngos ni gal srid stabs ma legs na stobs shugs zhan pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas de stobs ldan rig gnas kyi gnon shugs 'og rang tshugs rtsa ba nas shor ba'i nyen kha yod pa de red/ der brten stobs shugs zhan pa'i mi rigs khag gi mig sngar lhags pa'i las 'gan ni/ rang nyid kyi rig gnas kyi ngo bo mi shor ba'i sgo nas gzhan gyi rig gnas la slob sbyong yang dag par byas te/mgyogs myur du gling hril po can du 'gyur ba'i brgyud rim khrod du rang gi srog rtsa je brtan du yong ba byed rgyu de red/ 'di'i thad la lag len gyi go rim zhib cing phra ba ci 'dra dgos tshang mas thugs bsam bzhes dgos shing / rang nyid kyis kyang bsam blo gtong khul byed bzhin yod la 'dir las bya'i tshul du re zhig 'bri mtshams 'jog rgyu dang mu mthud du zhib 'jug byas te bri rgyu yin lags/

bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i khrod kyi bya ba gcig la byed sgra nyis brtsegs thob min skor cung zad gleng ba/mu po/de yang bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir thon mi saṃ bho ṭas bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i srol btod pa nas bzung / dran dbang rnams kyis zhib 'jug dang dar spel legs par mdzad de phun sum je tshogs su btang nas da lta'i bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i rmang gzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhung lugs 'di nyid byung ba yin zhing / de'i nang gi sum cu pa'i skabs nas byung ba'i rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i skabs nas byung ba'i bya byed las gsum gyi nang tshan byed po dang byed pa gnyis kyi bar du byed sgra dgos sam 'brel sgra dgos / byed sgra dgos na bya ba gcig la byed sgra nyis brtsegs dgos min skor la sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhed tshul du ma yod pa las 'dir de'i skor cung zad gleng bar bya ba la gsum ste/ bya ba gcig la byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi 'dod par smra ba dang / byed sgra nyis brtsegs dgos par smra ba dang / de gnyis kyi dgongs bzhed la dpyad nas dbye zhib byed pa'o/ /486

dang po/ bya ba gcig la byed sgra gnyis mi dgos par 'dod par smra ba'i lugs brjod pa/sngon gyi mkhas pa dkar lebs drung yig pad+ma rdo rje sogs mkhas pa de nyid kyi rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams kyis ni dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bya ba gcig la byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi 'dod pa'i tshul de dag thams cad tshur bsdus na sgrub byed dam rgyu mtshan chen po gsum bkod yod de/sgrub byed dang po mkhas pa de dag gis byed sgra nyis brtsegs gtan nas mi dgos par 'dod pa'i rig pa ni/ mkhas pa dkar lebs drung yig pad+ma rdo rje'i sum rtags gzhung gi dka' gnad dang dris lan rnams su/ da ni blun po bdag rang gi 'thad pa ltar na/ dper brjod kyang ci'i phyir 'jug gi gzhung don tshang ba zhig ni nges par dgos te/ dper na/ shing mkhan gyi sta res lcang ra ru shing bcad / lta bu 'di bzhin bka' bcos dag ther zhu rgyur bkod de/ shing gcod mkhan 'di bdag byed pa po dngos yin te/ shing gcod mkhan/ shing gcod pa po lta bu gtso bo gang zag las/ 'khor yan lag dbang po'i cha shas rnams dang /bem po sogs la mi 'jug go/ zhes dang / gyi ni bdag po dang rdzas kyi 'brel sgra byed po don la go ba byed pa dngos gsal gyi brda 'chad/ dper na mgar ba'i tho bas lcags brdungs lta bu yin te/ sta res shing bcad ces pas kyang don go la / byed po med par sta re bem po rang stobs kyis shing gcod pa mi srid la/shing gcod pa'i mi su yin na de nyid byed pa po yin dgos so/ /'di la byed sgra zhugs na sum rtags kyi dgongs don brjod bde 'dren dgos pa la brjod pa mi 487

bde khar/ bya med byed sgra sum cu pa tsam du ma zad/ mdo rgyud rnams dang dngos su 'gal/ zhes dang / yang / sta re shing mkhan gyi yin par go na/ sum rtags ltar/ shing mkhan gyi sta re/ zhes rten dang brten pa'i 'brel sgra yin par ra 'phrod dgongs 'byor byung 'dug pa gang legs dang / shing mkhan gsum pa'i byed pa po ma yin la rnam dbye dang po ste rtags 'jug gi bdag byed pa po zhes rang dbang can no/ /shing mkhan gyi sta re zhes 'brel sgra song zin nas slar yang byed sgrar the tshom yong don med pa ste byed 'brel gnyis rnam dbye dang sgra don so so'o / /gcod mkhan gzhan zhig yin par go 'dug ces gsal ba ltar/ shing gcod mi su yin de nyid gcod mkhan nam gcod pa po ste bdag byed pa po zhes pa'i ming de yin na yang / shing mkhan 'dis nye 'gyang gang du'ang bya ba ma byas pa'i phyir gsum pa'i byed pa por 'dod na ni rgya bod gzhung dang 'gal/ byed sgra'i dbang thob yod pa'i rnam dbye gsum pa'i byed pa po zhes pa'i gang zag dngos der 'dod pa la ni sta re dgos pa mi 'byung ba lags so/ /rnam dbye gsum pa'i byed sgra ni sta res dbang ba yin phyir bem pos bya ba byas pa'i byed pa sta re dngos gsal dang / gcod mkhan bdag byed pa po ni 'brel sgra'i don thob yin pas shugs bstan du bzhed pa bod kyi mkhas pa snga rabs pa rnams kyi lugs ltar ro/ /sgrub byed gnyis pa sgra gdangs drag zhan nan che chung dang skye gnas dbugs shugs khyad par la brten nas byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi thob par bsgrub pa ni/ 'dir bya ba med la byed sgra bkod pa de dag kyang don dang 'gal ba smos ci dgos/ gangs can lugs kyi sgra dang yang 'gal ba 'di lta ste/ nga ro gnas 488

nas dbyung skabs/ 'brel sgra zhes pa mgrin steng nas ring chu cung zad kyis yar bteg pa'i sgra shugs rtsol ba la ha cang bltos mi dgos pa/ klog stangs gcig la'ang gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga po rang shugs su thon pa dang / byed sgra zhes pa 'brel sgra'i steng du'ang bcu pa bsnan pas drug sgra dang sa sgra gnyis 'dus pa'i phyir/ gcod mtshams su dbugs shugs chen pos mar mnan dgos pa'i sgra gnyis pa/ gis/kyis / gyis/ yis/ 'is/ zhes khog pa nas brdab shugs chen pos so sor bar mtshams gcod dgos pa gnyis 'jam drag mtshungs thabs med/ ces dang /yang byed sgra nyis brtsegs 'di nga ro gnas dbyung la dper na/ 'brog gis lug gis rtswa zas lta bu yi ger bar mtshams ma bcad pa sbrel te bkod kyang / klog pa'i tshe/ 'brog gis/ lug gis/ zhes sgra gdangs su dbugs shugs gnyis kyi ngal gso bstud mar dgos par thal bas klog stangs dang gcig 'gal/sgrub byed gsum pa mkhas pa 'di nyid kyis sum rtags lugs kyi sgra don thob khungs dang / rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos/ bod mkhas snga rabs rnams kyi gsung rtsom/ sa dge rnying 'brug gi chos spyod sogs la gtugs na yang byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi thob par bsgrub pa ni/ sngon du chos rgyal khri srong gi sku ring rgya bod lo paṇa brgya rtsa tshogs dus 'gyur byang dkar chag tu'ang / slob dpon rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis blangs te/ zhes dang / lhag par rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos byings gzhi brjod kyis mi lang yang / lo paṇa snga phyi rim byon gyis yang nas yang du zhus dag mdzad pa'i ston pa'i zhal gsung mar grags pa'i bka' 'jam sdud bzang gsum gyi ya rgyal 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las kyang / rang gi lag gis rdo rje mchog /ces dang /489

rang gi lag gis gsor byed pa/ /zhes dang / tshig gi bdag pos tshigs su bcad / /ces dang / byams pa'i go chas chas pa ste/ /zhes sogs dang / sdud pa las kyang / dang po'i sems kyis byang chub mchog reg ma yin la/ /zhes dang /tha ma'i sems kyis byang chub zhi ba thob min la/ /zhes sogs shin tu mang /bzang spyod las kyang / blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ces dang /blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang / /sogs dang / der ma zad gangs ljongs 'dir yongs su grags pa'i sa dge rnying 'brug gi legs bshad chos spyod sogs las kyang / sa paṇa chen pos/ kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gi nor bus zhabs mchod pa/ /zhes dang / dge ldan lugs su'ang / grags pa'i dpal gyis lham mer mdzes pa'i sku/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i mkhyen pas ji tsam legs dpyad kyang —/ /zhes dang / zla ba'i zhabs kyis gang tshe byin brlabs pa/ /zhes dang /tshig spyi'i bshad sgrub rtags kyi dge sbyong gis/ /zhes sogs ji snyed dang / rnying lugs le'u bdun gsol 'debs las kyang / thugs kyi rigs mchog rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /zhes dang / thugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor / /zhes dang / 'brug lugs su'ang / sgyu ma'i snang bas slu bar mi 'gyur zhing —/ /zhes dang / dga' ba'i yid kyis gnas der 'jug byed na/ /zhes sogs 'di dag mdzad pa po rnams zhal 'dzoms bka' bgros mdzad de bsgrigs pa ma yin yang / bod sgra sum rtags gzhung gcig tu song phyir sgra don thob khungs legs par gzigs nas/ snga ma 'brel sgra dang / phyi ma byed sgrar mthun grub tu bkod pa mig ldan yongs la mngon sum snang ba 'di kho bo'i bden tshig khungs skyel gyi dpang por sa dge rnying 'brug sogs grub mtha' yongs la grags pa de'i 490

phyir na/ yul gangs can gyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che ji srid nam gnas kyi bar de srid du kho bo'i bden dpang gtan tshigs 'di dag kyang 'jig par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dkar drung bden tshig zho 'thung rus pa las grub pa dam bca' bzhi ldan gyi mtshon cha rdo rje pha lam zhes grags pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa/ bya ba gcig la byed sgra gnyis dgos par 'dod par smra ba'i lugs brjod pa/thog mar dbyangs can sgra mdo las/ byed pa po gtso bos bya ba nus pa'i sgrub byed la'o/ /byed pa po gtso bo nyid dang des bya ba byed pa la lhag par phan 'dogs nus par sgrub sla bar byed pa'i don la'ang rnam dbye gsum pa 'jug ste/dper na/ bhin+daḥshareṇ+ḍa 'ome:rāba'olo ldir+shabanaḥgarāgreṇ+ḍabodrirno3thabanarid+majo)panaḥ 'bod sgrog 'jig rten dur 'jug byed pa//dga' byed kyis ni mda' yis phug ste bsad/ /slar yang spre'u rnams kyis g.yul bskyed de/ wa/ lag pa'i sen/ mos kyang ni gshog par byed/ /ces pas rā ma ṇa dang sha re ṇa ni rnam dbye gsum pa'i ṭā byin pa ste/ dga' byed kyis dang mda' yis zhes pa ste/ 'bod sgrog ni srin po laṅga mgrin bcu ste de dga' byed rgyal po rā mas mda' yis phug ste bsad ces pa'o/ /byed pa po ste byed mkhan yin/ de gtso bo yin pas gsum pa 'jug par ma zad/ gtso bo'i 'dod don 'grub pa la shin tu phan 'dogs pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i byed pa rang la yang rnam dbye gsum pa 'jug go/ de dang mtshungs par si tu paṇa chen gyi 'grel chen mu tig phreng mdzes su/ de'ang zhib mor dpyad na/ bdag gis rigs sngags kyis tshe 491

sgrub lta bur bdag dang rig sngags gnyis ka spyir byed po yin pas gnyis ka la rnam dbye gsum pa 'jug kyang / bdag byed po gtso bo dang rig sngags byed po phal ba yin pa'i dbye ba yod cing / yang na bdag byed pa po dang rig sngags ni byed pa tsam yin pa'i bye brag shes par bya dgos so/ /zhes dang / de'i rjes 'brang rje dngul chu yab sras dang / mdangs can mkhan rin po che/ mkhas dbang lhag bsam bcas kyis kyang / shing mkhan gyis sta res shing bcad ces grags che'i dper brjod mdzad pa dang / deng dus kyi rig gnas dang brda sprod smra ba'i mkhas pa phal cher gyis kyang byed sgra nyis brtsegs 'bri bar mdzad de/don grub kyis zor bas rtswa brngas/ bdag gis rna bas nyan/ bzo pas 'phrul 'khor gyis lcags brdungs/ dge rgan gyis phyag gis yi ge 'bri/ slob mas sems kyis don la bsam/ lha bzos tshon gyis ri mo bris/ lta bus mtshon byed sgra nyis brtsegs dgos par 'dod pa'i lugs rnams mdo tsam 'dir bkod pa yin no/ /gsum pa/ de gnyis kyi dgongs bzhed la dpyad nas dbye zhib mdzad de dgongs pa 'gal med du bsgrub pa/de ltar bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i 'phel rim gyi lo rgyus dal 'bab ring mo'i khrod du sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis byed sgra nyis brtsegs thob min 'di la lta stangs chen po mi 'dra ba gnyis byung zhing / de dag la rang rang gis lung dang rig pa sogs la brten nas dgag bzhag spong gsum mdzad de 'thad phyogs 'dzin pa ma gtogs/ de gnyis kyi lta ba gcig mthun zhig byung med la/ de 492

las byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis ni sum cu pa'i skabs kyi byed sgra la bya ldan gang zag la byed sgra tshogs dgos pa'i byed pa po zhig dang —/ rtags kyi 'jug pa'i skabs kyi bya byed las gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i bdag byed pa po la ni 'du byed las gang yin gyi byed pa po rang dbang can rnam dbye dang po ste ming rkyang gi khongs gtogs su bzhed pas/ sum cu pa'i skabs kyi byed po dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i skabs kyi bdag byed pa po gnyis dus dang rnam pa thams cad du mi 'dra bar 'dod cing / sum cu pa'i skabs kyi byed po'i sgra'am byed sgra ni rnam dbye gsum pa yin la/ rtags kyi 'jug pa'i skabs kyi bdag byed pa po ni rnam dbye dang por bsdu ba dang / sum cu pa'i skabs kyi byed po'am byed sgra ni byed po dang byed pa sogs gang rung gis bya ba byed pa zhig ston na de la byed sgra thob par 'dod pa dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i skabs kyi byed po dang byed pa gnyis kyi bar du ni dus dang rnam pa thams cad du byed sgra mi thob pa'i lugs gcig byung ba'i 'dod tshul rnams ni gong du bshad zin to/ /yang byed sgra nyis brtsegs thob par 'dod pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis ni sum cu pa'i skabs kyi byed sgra dang / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i skabs kyi bya byed las gsum gyi nang tshan bdag byed pa po gnyis gcig par 'dod pa dang / gal srid byed sgra nyis brtsegs ma bris na byed po gang yin rtogs mi thub pas de la dus dang rnam pa thams cad du byed sgra nyis brtsegs 'bri dgos par 'dod pa ste / dper na/ bkra shis kyi sta res shing bcad lta bu la mtshon na shing gcod byed sta re de bkra shis kyi yin pa las shing gcod mkhan su yin rtogs mi thub pas de la byed sgra nyis brtsegs 'bri dgos par 'dod pa'i lugs gcig bcas 493

lugs gnyis su nges pa las de dag gi dgongs don la dbye zhib cung zad bya ba la gsum ste/dang po byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi 'dod pa de dag gi khungs gtso bo gtugs yul ni/ rgya 'gyur 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs la brten nas bshad pa yin na yang / de nyid thams cad la rigs bsgril che na de dag mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ dper na/ bkra shis kyi sta res shing bcad lta bu la mtshon na shing gcod byed sta re de bkra shis kyi yin pa las shing gcod mkhan su yin rtogs mi thub pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i skyon dang /gnyis pa byed sgra nyis brtsegs 'dod pa de dag gis ni/ dbyangs can sgra mdo sogs la khungs bcol nas de dag gi rjes 'brang phal cher gyis byed po dang byed pa la dbye bsal med par thams cad la byed sgra nyis brtsegs thob par bzhed na yang / de ltar byed sgra thams cad la ma nges te/ dper na/ gong du brjod pa'i 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs su byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi thob pa'i lugs sogs dang mi mthun pas sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyi dgongs pa 'gal med du rtogs mi thub pa'i skyon sogs 'byung ba yin no/ /gsum pa da ni sngon byon mkhas pa de dag gi dgongs pa la dbye zhib byas te dgongs pa 'gal med len tshul ni 'di lta ste/ mkhas pa de dag gi dgongs pa rigs bsdus na gnyis su 'du ste byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi dgos pa'i skor gcig dang / byed sgra nyis brtsegs dgos pa'i skor gcig bcas gnyis su nges pa las/dang po byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi dgos pa'i skor rnams ni 'di ltar shes 494

dgos te/ gong du bkod pa'i rgya 'gyur 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ rang gi lag gis rdo rje mchog /yang dang yang du gsor byed pa/ zhes dang / dge rgan tru/ phyag cib yi ge bris/ zhes pa dang / bkra shis kyi mig gis bltas/ lhas byin spyo sen mos glang chen bsad/ ces pa lta busarme tshon pa'i dper brjod 'di sheg ni/wa wayan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel ba yin par ma zad/ lag pa dang ske/ phyog dang / mig dang / sen mo bcas ni byed pa dngos yin pa gsal zhing —/ des shugs la byed por go ba dang / yan lag dang yan lag can de gnyis 'bral du mi rung ba zhig yin pas/ 'di rigs la byed po med par byed pa 'byung ba'i skyon dang / byed pa po gang yin sogs mi shes pa'i rnyog 'dzing dang bral bas na byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi thob pa skor gcig dang /yang 'brog pa'i lug gis rtswa bzas/ ldong gi spyi dpon rgyal pos dgra bo bsad / ces pa'i dper brjod de dag ni dngos sne gang la dbang ba'i bdag po'i khyad par ston pa'i 'brel sgra ste/ bdag po dang bdag po can gyi 'brel ba'am bdag po dang bdag gi ba'i 'brel ba yin par ma zad/ skabs 'dir 'brog pa dang / ldong gnyis kyis ni bya ba gang yang ma byas pas de la byed sgra thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yang med pas mtshon gzhan la yang rgya cher rtogs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po las/ blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ces dang / kun mkhyen tsong kha pa chen pos kyang /wa bla ma'i drin gyis mthong ba'i tshe/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ byams/ pa'i bo cas chas pa ste/ /zhes sogs dang / sdud pa las kyang /dang po'i sems kyis byang chung mchog reg ma yin la/ /zhes dang / tha ma'i — — 47

sems kyis byang chub zhi ba thob min la/ /zhes dang /mthun par smra gyur de tshe sngon gyi /skyes mchog gis/ /ma 'ongs pa yi dus na sangs rgyas 'gyur ro zhes/ /zhes seng /dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab las/skye ba'i skye bas zhes pa las//zhes dang /de bzhin du tshad ma kun btus las kyang //don gyi tshul gyis dben pa yang /brjod bya ma yin yul 'di'i yang / /spyi yi tshul gyirme bstan par bya/ /zhes dang /tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ sems la brtse rmegs boca/sa skye ba/ /rang gi ngang gis 'jug 'gyur te/zhes dang /sa paṇa chen pos/kun nas dga' ba'o gtsug ci/ nor bus zhabs mchod pa/ zhes dang /dge ldan lugs su'ang / grags pa'o dpa' /)sa lham mer mdzes pa'i sku/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i mkhyen pas ji tsam legs dpyad kyang //zhes dang / zla pa'i zhabs kyis gangad ngo byin brlabs pa/ /zhes dang /tshig spyi'i bshad sgrub rtags kyi dge sbyong gis/ /zhes dang / rnying lugs le'u bdun gsol 'debs las kyang / thugs kyi rigs mchog rigs kyi 'khor kyis bskor/ /zhes dang /thugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyiso bskorawa /zhes dang /'brug lugs su'ang /sgyu ma'i snang bas slu rber mi 'gyur zhing //zhes dang /dga' ba'i yid kyis gnas der/ 'jug byed na//zhes sogs 'di dag mdzad pa po rnams zhal mthun par snga ma 'brel sgra dang / phyi ma byed sgrar mthun grub tu bkod pa ltar/ snga ma de dag ni 'brel sgra yin te/ de dag rigs bsdus na dngos po gang la dbang ba'i bdag po'i khyad par ston pa dang /dngos po gang gi yan lag dang cha shas su gtogs par ston pa dang / dngos po gang las byung ba'i 'byung khungs kyi khyad par dang / dngos po gang zhig dngos gshis kyi rang bzhin ji ltar gnas pa'i khyad par ston pa dang /'brel gzhi dang 496

'brel chos gnyis gzhi mthun pa'am/ gnyis ka tshogs pa'i 'brel ba gzhi mthun gyi 'brel ba ston pa dang / mtshon byed dpe'i 'brel sgra ston pa lta bus mtshon de dag ni 'brel sgra yin pa sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyi lta ba gcig mthun yin no//de bzhin du phyi ma byed sgra yin par mkhas pa rnams kyi zhal gcig mthun yin na yang / spyir byed sgra zhes pa de ni byed pa po tsam du ma zad/ bem shes cha shas kyi byed pa la sogs pa rigs bya yon rdzas rnams ris med bsam gyis mi khyab par 'jug ces rgyal ba'i bstan 'gyur du gsal ba don la gnas pa ltar/bya ba rnams kyang byed sgra 'jug yul de rang rang so sos byas pa lta bu nam yang mi srid pa'i phyir te/ byed pa po'i lus kyi dbang po dang / yan lag dang / bsam pa dang / bya ba byed pa'i thabs dang / yo byad sogs kyis bya ba byed par ston pa'i tshig sogs la 'jug pa de dag la byed po dang byed pa gnyis su dbye ba med pa'i skor zhig dang /yang bya ba'i khyad par gsal byed du 'jug ste/ dper na/ skad cha nan gyis bshad/ ces dang / khra lam gyis mthong / zhes dang / gzhan yang rgyu rkyen gsal byed du 'jug pa ni/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ nye bar bslad pa'i bag chags mtshams sbyor ba med pa'i rkyen gyis mi mkhas pas kyang tha snyad la yid brtan du med par mthong bas gnyis ku rab tu bstan pa'i phyir re zhig bshad do / /zhes pa lta bus mtshon 'di dag kyang dbye bsdu byed skabs byed sgra'i khongs su bsdu na yang don la sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis byed sgra dang cha 'dra ba zhes brjod cing / rim bzhin byed pa po dang cha 'dra ba byed pa ston pa dang / byed pa po dang cha 'dra ba rgyu mtshan ston pa'i byed sgra ste 'di dag byed sgra'i khongs 497

gtogs yin na yang byed po dang byed pa'i tha snyad gdags su med pa'i phyir ro/ /mkhas pa dkar lebs kyis gong gi dper brjod de dag byed sgra nyis brtsegs mi thob pa'i rgyu mtshan du drangs na yang / 'di dag la ni bya byed kyi tha snyad 'jug tu mi rung ba'i phyir na de'i rgyu mtshan du mi 'gro bas/ 'di rigs la mtshon nas bshad na/ byed sgra yin na byed po dang byed pa gnyis ka dus dang rnam pa thams cad du tshogs dgos par ma nges pa dang / byed sgra yin na bya byed las gsum tshang bar ma nges pa sogs kyi gnad kyang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa byed sgra nges par dgos pa'i skor 'ga' zhig bshad par bya ste/dper na/ dga' byed kyis ni mda' yis phug ste bsad/ ces dang / shing mkhan gyis sta res shing bcadawa/ ces dang / lha bzos tshon gyis ri mo bris/ zhes dang /nga tsho pas r+shaphrul 'khor gyis lcags brdungs/gezhes dang / bdag gis rig sngags kyis tshe meb/ ces pa tsholta bu'i dper brjod la mtshon nas bshad na/ skabs 'dir dga' byed dang / shing mkhan/ lha bzo/ bdag ste byed pa po de dag gis bya ba byed pa'i yo byad dang thabs sogs ston pa yin pas 'di rigs la byed sgra dang po de med na/ mda' dang / sta re/ tshon/ rig sngags 'phrul 'khor bcas bdag po gang yin ston pa las/ byed pa po gzhan zhig yin par go bas gong gi byed pa po de dag byed po yin par rtogs mi thub pas na rgya gar gyi sgra gzhung dang ske/ bod kyi mkhas pa phal cher gyi dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gi sgo nas byed sgra nyis brtsegs thob par bzhed par ma zad/ gzhan yang dkar lebs drung yig gis kyang / dper na sngon dus brgya byin gyis/ /ri rkang rdo rjes bcag lta bu/ /bod yig sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'i lugs/ wa/radi las ldog pa'i rbe 498

sbyor skyon/ /phrad dam rnam dbye ma chod pa/ /dper na sngon dus ri po'i rkang / /dbang pos rdo rjes bcag lta bu/ /bshad khrid lugs su spang byar bshad/ /ces gsungs the'i dgongs don yang 'di lta bu la thug pa yin no/ /mdor na gong du mkhas pa rnams kyis bkod pa'i dper brjod de dag la dbye zhib byas na gnad don 'di 'dra zhig rtogs thub ste/ bya byed las gsum tshogs pa dang / de yang byed po dang / byed pa tshang ba'i dper brjod cig yin pa nas bzung / de la rigs gnyis su nges te/ dang po byed po dang byed pa de yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel ba yin par ma zad/ de gnyis dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 'bral du mi rung ba zhig yin pa nas bzung ste de la 'brel sgra 'bri dgos pa ni/ gong du brjod pa'i mkhas pa dkar lebs drung yig sogs kyi dgongs pa len tshul dang / de bzhin du byed po dang byed pa de gnyis bdag dang bdag gi ba'i 'brel ba yin zhing / de gnyis 'bral du rung ba zhig yin na ni de la dus dang rnam pa thams cad du byed sgra 'bri dgos pa de ni/ rgya gar gyi sgra gzhung dang bod kyi brda sprod mkhan po phal cher gyi dgongs pa len tshul dang yang yid mthun pas/ 'di lta bu'i rig pa la brten nas byed sgra nyis brtsegs dgos min skor gyi phyogs ris lta ba'i rnyog 'dzing dang bral zhing / bod gangs can pa'i brda sprod rig pa'i khrod kyi byed 'brel gyi bed spyod byed tshul 'di la sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyi dgongs pa 'gal med du rtogs pa'i gnas lugs don dam dang ldan pa ni 'di lta bu yin no/ /de ltar bod gangs can pa'i brda sprod rig pa'i khrod kyi dka' gnad chen po gsum gyi ya gyal rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa po'i don la cung zad dpyad khul 499

bgyis kyang / phran chung ni skyes sbyangs gnyis ku'i yon tan gyis shin tu dbul bas / 'di lta bu'i dka' ba'i gnad la de yin 'di min gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i rnam dpyod dang bral yang dus rgyun bod kyi brda sprod rig pa gzhan la 'chad pa dang / rang nyid kyis bed spyod byed pa'i khrod du shin tu rnyog 'dzing che ba dang / sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang lta ba gcig mthun zhig med pas/da thengs sngon gyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang / mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rtsom du ma la brten nas 'di lta bu'i bsam tshul cung zad cig spel ba la/spyir bod kyi rig pa'i gnas kun la spyan dkyus rabs tu yangs pa rnams kyis ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi dri ma rnams rig pa yang dag gi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gtsang mas legs par bkrus nas/ bod gangs can pa'i brda sprod rig pa de je legs dang je gsal phun sum je tshogs su 'gyur ba'i smon 'dun dang bcas te gus pas sbyar ba'o/ /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(1) 〈gangs can rig mdzod/〉(dkar lebs sum rtags dka' 'grel/) bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas spyi lo 1989lo'i zla ba 2par dpar du bskun/(2) (brda sprod rig pa'i don 'grel phyogs bsgrigs/〉dor zhi gdong drug snyems blos brtsams/ kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas 1987lor par du bskrun/(3) (thon mi'i zhal lung /〉 tshe tan zhabs drung gis brtsams/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas 1986lor par du bskrun/(4) (bod yig dang slob gso/〉 dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas spyi lo 2004lo'i zla 3par dpar du bskrun/(5) (brda sprod pa dbyangs can gyi mdo'i 'grel pa rab tu bya ba gsal ldan〉500
sdo da
