bod kyi skad yig gi tshig phrad skor cung tsam gleng ba/chu mdo pad ma bkra zhis/spyir brda sprod rig pa zer ba ni skad kyi brda sprod pa'i tshul de rig pa'i lam nas drangs te bshad pa'i tshul lam ston pa'i gzhung la go dgos/ nga tsho bod kyi skad yig gi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs ni tshig phrad kyis brjod bya gtso bor byas pa'i sum cu ba'i rtsa ba dang / bya tshig gi rnam bzhag gtso bor byas pa'i rtags 'jug gi rtsa ba de gnyis yin/ gang 'di gnyis kyis bod khyon yongs la dar spel btang nas skye dgu'i blo yi mun pa drungs nas phyung ste/ phyi nang gi mkhas grub lo paṇa ji snyed pa rnams kyis mdzad bzang gsum gyi mtshar sdug mngon par ma zad/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya'i tshogs kyang yid kun 'phrog nas 'dzam gling gi rig gzhung las khyad 'phags kyi rang bzhin dang ldan no zhes chu rtsa bzang bo dwangs gtsang gi chu mig sa yis 'gebs mi thub zer ba lta bu'o/ /de ltar yang yin gyi/ rtsa ba de gnyis la brten nas gangs can gyi mkhas dbang rnams kyis bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'chad pa'i bshul lam kyang yongs su che ba'i lam ston gsal sgron 'ba' zhig bstan yod/ sgron 'od de la brten nas lam phran mang bo zhig btod zin pa gdon mi za mod/'on kyang sum rtags kyi rtsa ba'i lam las gyis pa'i grub mtha'i lam chen ni gtso 502

bo gnyis las ma byung ste/ gcig ni pra ti rin chen don grub kyi lugs dang /gcig shos ni brda sprod smra ba'i dbang phyug si tu paṇa chen lags so/ /khong gnyis kyis bkral ba'i 'grel ba de tshor rjod byed cha la legs pa mang ba/ rjod tshul thad la gnas lugs dang mthun pa/ 'grel bshad gnas la 'bigs pa/gzhung lugs gsal bar mdzad pa brgyud nas gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin yang thon yod pa bcas kyi yon tan che ba dang ldan no/ /gzhung lugs de dag gi yon tan la bstun nas rjes 'jug gi skyes bu rnams kyis kyang brda sprod 'di nyid sngar gyi bzang char gzhigs nas de las phun sum tshogs pa/ sngar las rgyud rim ldan pa/ zhib cing cha tshang ba zhig phyogs sdom bya rgyu'i gnas la bab yod ces phyogs kun tu sgrog bzhin yod pas/ rang nyid kyis kyang bod kyi skad yig gi tshig phrad skor cung tsam gleng bar bya'o/ /bod yig ni bod rang gi tha snyad so so dang gdangs kyi nga ro rnams thugs gzhigs legs par bcug pa'i mtha' gzhi legs par btings pa'i yi ge zhig yin / bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyang rang rigs tshad ldan gyi skad cha'i sdeb spyor gyi khyad chos la gtugs nas thon ma'i rgyud pa rnams rim gyis legs par sbyar ba'i rig gzhung zhig yin/ skad gdangs ni ming gi 'byung gnas yin la/ tshig rnams kyi brjod pa ston byed ni tshig phrad yin dgos pa phran rang gis bsam pa'o/ /de yang rtsa tshig las/ yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung ste/ /ming gi khongs nas tshig phyung nas/ /tshig gis don rnams ston par byed/ /ces bstan te/ yi ge ka sogs re re ste 'dus nas/ don rnams kyi ngo bo ste ming dang / ming du mar 503

'dus pa las don rnams kyi khyad par ston pa ste tshig dang / de 'dra'i tshig gi brjod pa las don gyi rnam pa kun rtogs par 'gyur/ zhes bstan yod pa 'di'i thog nas bsam pa'i 'char sgo dog par byed dgos don med la skabs 'di lta bu'i rtsa 'grel ni don gyi spyi khog tsam bstan pa yin pas/ go ba len skabs nges par skad cha dngos dang gzhigs pa dang don gyi gnad la bstun pa gtso ste/spyir kha skad kyis skad yig gzhung lugs la bstun dgos pa las go ldog ste bstun dgos pa'i tshul ni gnas lugs kyis grub pa min na'ang / skad yig gi gzhung lugs dang kha skad gnyis kyi 'brel ba mi rigs so so'i lo rgyus thog bden dpang byung ba 'di yin/ ming du ma 'dus yod pa ste/ ngas chu 'thung lta bur mtshon na/ ming du ma 'dus yod de/ nga / chu/ 'thung / lta bu de'o/ /tshig gi phreng ba de skad cha dngos dang gzhigs na/ tshig gi cha shas gsum ste bya byed las gsum sogs kyang ngos 'dzin rgyu med pas/ don gyi rnam pa kun tu rtogs par 'gyur ba ga la srid/ spyir tshig ces pa na/ (brda sprod blo gsal dga' ston〉las / tshig gi mtshan nyid ni don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par sogs sbyar nas ston pa'i sgra de/ mtshan gzhi ni/ nyi ma'i 'od ces pa dang nyi ma ni che'o zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o zhes gsungs yod de/ don gyi ngo bo ston byed ming du ma 'dus nas de la khyad par ston par byed pa'i rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sbyar nas sgra byung ba de tshig la go dgos zhes gsungs yod/ gal te nyi ma'i 'od zer ces pa'i nyi ma dang 'od gnyis kyi bar don gyi khyad par ston byed phrad med na/ nyi ma 'od ces pa ste tshig ma yin par ma zad/ bod skad la 'das pa'i dus dang da lta'i dus kyang ma byung / des na ming dang tshig brjod pa sogs dang tshig phrad bar 504

gyi 'brel ba ni/ (brda sprod gsal byed ngag sgron〉las/ ming gi mu tig phrad kyi skud pa brgyus nas ni/ /tshig gi phreng ba spel nas brjod pa'am rtsom du grub/ /ces dpe'i gzugs su dkyus gcig tu bkod nas/ rang nyid thun mong gi yon tan gyi byed las dang nus pa sogs gsal ba'i sgo nas legs par bstan yod/gzhan yang gser tog sum rtags〉 las/ rjes 'jug dang ldan pa'i ming gi khongs nas rjes 'jug de'i nus pas rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sbyar bas tshig ces pa don gyi ngo bo'i khyad par ston pa'i sgra phyung bar byas nas/ de 'dra ba'i tshig gis 'jig rten du brjod bya'i don mtshon pa'i brjod pa ji snyed yod pa rnams ma nor bar ston par byed pa yin pas na yi shes ming dang ming tshig tu bsgrub pa'i ched du 'jug pa yin no zhes gsungs yod/ dper na/ rjes 'jug dang ldan pa'i ming ste khong zhes par mtshon na/ rjod pa po rang mtshon byed kyi ming 'di tshig sbyor du zhugs pa'i tshe/ khong gi byed las gang yod pa nges par byed pa ni tshig phrad ster ba la rag las pa yin te/ khong bshad/ khong la bshad/khong gis bshad ces pa'i tshig sbyor gsum gyi khong gi byed las mi 'dra stabs/tshig phrad ni gnas skabs kyi brjod don dang bstun nas/ ming gi cha shas la sngar med pa'i sgra zhig gsar du sbyar bar byed pa'i nus pa'am khyad chos de dang ldan pa zhig yin/tshig phrad ni ming gi cha shas dang sbyar nas sngar med pa'i brjod bya sna tshogs kyi khyad par gsar ba ston byed kyi sgra zhig yin pas/ rang ngos kher rkyang du bkar nas brtags tshe/ don ci yang mi ston pa'i rigs shig kyang yin te/(thon mi'i zhal lung〉 las/ ming tshig gcig gam du ma'i thog mthar bar 505

gsum ci rigs kyi gnas su phrad kyi sgra de sbyar ba na don zhig ston la/ de ltar ma sbyar ba'i phrad kyi sgra rkyang ba des spyi bam po zhig las don gsal bor gang yang mi ston no zhes gsungs/ yang yi ge'i bshad pa mkhas pa'i rgyan〉las/ rang nyid tshig rkyang gis brjod bya ston mi nus par tshig snga phyi phrad par byas nas don ston pas na/ tshig phrad ces bya ste/ (tshad ma sde bdun yid kyi mun sel〉las/kho na zhes pa'i tshig 'di la tshig phrad ces pa'i rgyu mtshan ni tshig gzhan dang phrad na don ston la ma phrad na don gang yang mi ston pas de skad ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs yod pas so/ /tshig phrad rang kher rkyang gis don ci yang mi ston pa zhes pa ni/ thog mar tshig phrad rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas bshad pa yin te/ ming gi cha shas ltar ming grub dus nas gtan chags kyi rang bzhin can zhig yin pa las ldog ste gsar du sbyar ba zhig yin pas ming gi cha shas dang mi 'dra/ deng sang mi la las tshig phrad kyi don gyi 'jug tshul dang don ston pa gnyis so sor 'byed shes med pas sum bcu pa'i gzhung las bstan med pa'i tshig phrad zhig rig na/ rang gi bed spyod nyams blangs kyi bag chags gzhir bzung nas 'di'i don ni 'di'o zhes don gyi 'jug tshul de don ston pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa de ni shin tu mi rigs te/'di'i skor la mkhas dbang dmu dge bsam gtan gyis/ kha cig tshig phrad 'di dag gi ngo bo/ byed las rnams sogs mi shes par 'di dang 'di 'dra ba mi dgos so zer ba ni brda sprod pa'i rig lam nyams par byed pa ste/ phrad 'bor chen med par byas na/ brjod pa mi tshang zhing nyams mi thon pa tshig gi nus pa'ang shor nas/ byis pa'i rdol gtam smra ba ltar lab rdol du 'gyur ro zhes 506

legs par gsungs yod la/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i mkhas pa'i gtam mo/ /da ni tshig phrad kyi dbye ba'i sgo nas don gyi 'jug tshul skor bshad na/ spyir tshig phrad la rtsa ba'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis te/ rang dbang can gyi tshig phrad dang gzhan dbang can gyi tshig phrad/ de la rtsa ba'i gzhung las bstan yod pa ni i ldan gyi rnam dbye phrad bcas dang / e ldan gyi rnam dbye phrad bcas dang / o ldan gyi rnam dbye phrad/ a ldan gyi rnam dbye phrad bcas dbyangs so sor phye ba'i phrad ci rigs sogs yod de/ 'di rnams kyi sgra yi 'jug tshul dang don gyi 'jug tshul ni sum rtags kyi khrid byed gzhung thams cad du gsal bar bstan yod pas/'dir zhib mor yi ge la bkod kyis mi lang ngo / /ji skad du/ phrad dang rnam dbye gzhan rnams kyang / /de rnams dpyad pas go bar nus/ /zhib mor bkod kyis mi lang ngo / /zhes so/ /'di la gzhung gzhan las ma bstan pa tshig mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan la 'jug pa'i tshig phrad skor ni brda sprod nyer bdun gyi rtsa 'grel〉 las du mar bstan te/ so dang sen mo rno la ring / 'phul la khad/ 'chi la thug skyid nyams la / yin pas na/ byos shig gu/ smra re mkhas/ de bas lhag 'u cag nged cag bskor bar byed kyin snying po bzla/ lha phyag 'tshal gyin mchod pa 'bul/ /de lta de ltar de bzhin sgra ldan/ mgo can yin no lo/ e re mdzes/ e yin/ lhan ne ba / lhang nge ba/ a la la/ 'u ru ru/ di ru ru/ ldems se ldem/ ko ro ro/ zu lu lu / nye re re/ sogs don mi ston cing /ming gi mtha' bar du sbyar na brjod bde ba dang / mtshams sbyor ba dang /don gsal la phan 'dogs pa zhig go /gzhan yang tshig phrad rang 'jug yul gsal bar ston pa ni sgra 'grel〉507

las / de ni gong ma'i rjes 'ded yin/ /nas ni ma 'ongs bsu ba'i sgra/ /da ni skad cig ston pa'i dus/ /ya ni spro ba byed pa'i brda/ /yang ni phyi ma bsnon pa'i sgra / /'ang ni the tshom rtog pa'i sgra/ /'ong ni slad ma bsu ba'i sgra/ /ye ni yod med ston pa'i sgra/ /na ni gzhan la smon pa'i sgra/ /thad ni dpe la 'jog pa'i sgra/ /'di ni zla la 'gel ba'i sgra/ /rdzogs pa bshad du med pa'i sgra/ /thal 'gyur gzhan du 'chug pa'i sgra/ /khyab pa 'dod pa sdong bsgrub sgra/ /gtan tshigs bsgrub bya 'byor byed sgra/ /rgyun ni 'brel bar ston pa'i sgra/ /lung ni 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i sgra/ /man ngag nges par ston pa'i sgra/ /bka' ni tshad ma sgrub pa'i sgra / /zhes dang / ha ni dpa' bar gyur ba'i sgra/ /he ni dgyes pa chen po'i sgra/ /nan ni gnyen pos gnod pa'i sgra/ /zhes dang / yang(lha 'grel〉las/ ldan pa ni yod pa'i sgra/ 'di zhes bya ba mngon tu 'gyur ba'o/ /de zhes pa ni skabs la babs pa ste/ kun ni mang ba'i sgra'o/ /kun ka zhes bya ba ni thams cad do/ /la ni gzhi yi don/ thams cad ni ma lus ste/ nyid ni snang ba'i ngo bo de kho na nyid du nges pa'o/ /zhes kho rang kher rkyang gis don ston rgyu med na'ang / don gzhan la 'jug pa'i tshul yod pa ni mngon sum grub bo/ /yang tsam ni lhag ma 'gog pa dang —/tshad dang / dman pa'i sgra la 'jug ste/ dper na/ spyod pa tsam las lta ba rnam dag min/ rgya ru de tsam/ dpangs su mda' gang tsam/ mkhas pa'i ming thog tsam lta bu dang / gzhan yang / thams cad/ kun ka /du ma/ tshogs/ yo gaphal cher/ yod do cog /yin no cog /'gyur ro cog rnams mang tshig la 'jug par 'dod de/ 〈gangs can bod kyi brda skad ming gzhi gsal bar ston pa'i nor bu gter chen〉zhes bya ba'i brda sprod kyi gzhung las/ thams cad kun ka yo 508

ka du ma rnams/ /ming tshig sgra yin ma lus 'ba' zhig dang //sha stag rnams ni lhag ma 'gog sgra ston//zhes gsungs yod pas sbyar skabs nges par skabs thob dang gtso dgos/gzhan yang / rjes 'jug gi nus pas rang 'dra'i ming byung ba'i phrad kyang mang ste/dper na/lhang nge ba/ lhang nge /ting nge 'dzin/e re mdzes/lhan ne ba/yod do cig /yin no cog/nyung ngu /thung ngu zhes pa sogs shin tu mang bas 'di dag gis mtshon nas rgya cher shes par bya'o//yang /rnga rnga bodarnge'u/nya nya bodanye'u/mda'achamada'abodamade'u/rdor+shardo bodarde'u/mi mi'o/mi'u/rdza rdzasgo rje'u/shadashapo she'u sogs rim bzhin du dang po ni dngos po'i ming dang / bar ma ni chen po'am mchog la 'jug pa/ tha ma ni chung ngu'am dman pa'i ming la 'jug pa dang / khang ba khang bu/ khridakhri'u/gro gri'u/sgo sge'u/stare ste'u/mthebodamathe'u/spradaspre'u/bya bye'u/mtsho mtshe'u la sogs snga ma ni dngos po'i rang ming dang phyi ma ni chung ngu'i ming ngo //gyi khyig/rnga rje'u/rta rte'u/ba be'u/ram re'u/lug lugu/sha ba—she'u sogs snga ma ni sems can rang ming dang phyi ma ni phru gu'i ming la 'jug pas 'u bu gu ngu sogs chung ngu nyung ngu sogs la 'jug pa'i tshig phrad du 'dod do//gzhan yang tshig phrad kyi bsgyur ba'i rnam pa'i sgo nas tshig phrad la'ang phrad gnyis 'dus dang gsum 'dus mang 'dus sogs kyang yod de/dper na/'di lta bu'i bsgyur tshul rim bzhin du/'dis/'dir/'di'i/'di la/'di las/ca09

'di'i phyir/ 'di 'dra/ 'di bzhin/ 'di'o/ /lta bu dang / tshig phrad de'i bsgyur tshul ni dper na/ des/ de'i/ der/ de dag /de rnams/ de nyid/ de phyir / de slad/ de ltar/ de snyed/ de las/ de'i phyir/ de'o/ /lta bu dang / gang sgra'i bsgyur tshul ni dper na/ gang gis/ gang zhig /gang dag /gang 'dir/gang ltar/ gang rnams/ gang phyir/ gang gang / gang na/ gang nas/ gang red/gang yin lta bu dang / ci'i bsgyur tshul ni dper na/ ci'i/ ci la/ cis/ ci'i phyir / ci las/ ci'ang / ci nas kyang / ci zhig /ci phyir/ ci ma rung / ci ste na lta bu dang / ji sgra dper na/ ji ltar/ ji snyed/ ji 'dra/ ji 'dra ba/ ji ste/ ji ste na lta bu dang / su sgra dper na/ sus/ su'i/ su zhig /su yin/ su red/ su yin yang / lta bu dang / yang sgra dper na/ yang yang / slar yang / yang na/ yang nas yang du lta bu'o zhes dpe brjod 'di dag gis rgya cher shes par mtshon no/ /mdor na/ 〈brda sprod blo gsal dga' ston〉las/ phrad gnyis 'dus/gang dag slar yang / ci zhig /slad nas/ de slad sogs dang / sum 'dus/gang su dag de tsam du/ ci la yang sogs dang / bzhi 'dus/ ci snyed su dag /gang slad ce na/ de lta na yang / de tsam la ni/ ci zhig ce na sogs dang / lnga 'dus / gang zhig su dag la/ de dang de rnams ni/ ci zhig ltar snyam yang / de dang de bzhin du/ de dang de rnams la sogs dang / drug 'dus/ su zhig de bzhin snyam na/ gang zhig de ltar gnas na/ de la de ni ster ro sogs dang /bdun 'dus/ gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ de dang de la der snang ngo / /zhes sogs shin tu mang mod ces bstan yod pas 'dir che long tsam zhig brjod pa la gang thad du skyon yang mchis par nges pas mthong thos kyi mkhyen rgya rnam par 510
bcos re ba

the bo'i ming gi 'byung khungs la dpyad pa/tshe gzungs skyabs/de yang mdo smad kyi rong chen bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan the bo rong zhes pa rtswa chu rtsi shing 'dzoms shing 'bru rigs sna lnga 'byung ba/ mtha' bzhi ri brag gis skor ba'i yul gru 'di/ gna' snga mo zhig nas pha spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang ma brag srin las mched pa'i bod mi yis bzung ba'i yul gru zhig yin na yang —/ deng dus yul 'di'i mi rgyud byung tshul dang ming thogs tshul skor gnas tshul ngo ma mi shes par lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang 'gal ba'i 'khyog bshad mkhan yang yod pas/ 'dir re zhig gang du byung ba'i chu rgyun gangs la thug pa bzhin lo rgyus kyi dpyad gtam rags tsam brjod na/dang po/ the bo rong gi mi rgyud byung tshul/gna' snga mo zhig nas stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi / smad mdo khams sgang drug gi yul ljongs chen po 'dir/ spre'u dang brag srin mo gnyis las mched pa'i mi rgyud de bod mi rus bzhis rim gyis khyab nas yod pa chos 'byung dang lo rgyus kyi deb ther kun tu gsal/ de nas rgyal phran bcu gnyis dang sil ma bzhi bcu sogs gyes nas 'khrug rtsod kyi dus yun ring bo 'das/ dus der kha ba can gyi yul ljongs chen mo 'dir bod spyi la dbang 512

ba'i rgyal bo zhig med/ mtha' bzhi'i rgyal bos rtag tu 'phrog bcom dang / rus rgyud phan tshun bar ri lung rtswa chu sogs 'tsho yul rtsod pa'i dus zhig yin pas/(chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dge' ston〉 du/ rgyal phran de rnams 'thab rtsod gsod gcod dga'/ /legs nyes mi rtsi bkyon 'bebs btson rar 'dzud/ /mtha' bzhi'i rgyal pos rtag tu mnar zhing gtse/ /rgya nag rgyal po shing la sprul ltar 'khri/ /rgya gar rgyal po lug la spyang ltar 'jab/ /stag gzig rgyal po bya khyur khra ltar rgyu/ /ge sar rgyal po shing la rta ltar 'tshab/ /ces gsungs/ de'i dus nas rgyal rong dang the bo rong sogs mdo smad kyi rong chen 'di dag tu sa chu dro zhing 'bru rigs sna lnga 'byung ba dang / rtswa chu shing gsum 'dzoms pas gna' mis 'tsho ba spyad nas yod/ de la bod mi bu gdung drug gi rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal〉zhes pa las/ 'gag dog mo gsum ni sbra la thob/ /spra dpa' rtsal che ba de nas byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i 'gag dog mo gsum ni chu chen/ rgya chu(zung chu) / 'brug chu gsum gyi 'bab yul la zer bas the bo rong 'di'i thog ma'i rus rgyud ni sbra yin pa gsal/thang rgyal rabs yan gyi rgya'i lo rgyus rnams su the bo rong phyogs sbra'i rigs kyi bod mi la tu'u(6)dang tu'u chang(rmecho)zhes bod las logs su gyur pa'i mi rigs zhig tu brtsis nas bkod 'dug kyang don dngos bod yin/ de'i skabs kyi rgya'i lo rgyus pa rnams kyi 'khrul gzhi ni bod la rus kyi dbye ba du ma yod pa de las byung ba yin/ (thang yig〉las/ thu sgod ni nub kyi 'jang gi rus su gtogs la/ der yang rigs brgya dang lnga bcu mchis/ rma chu dang / tsong chu/rgyal mo rngul chu'i 'bab yul du bkrams te gnas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/513

bar skabs shig nas shar phyogs kyi rgyal po rnams nub phyogs su rgya bskyed de / khyad par du thang gi rgyal po us te(77)sogs kyi dus su mdo smad sa gnas dag tu dmag 'bor chen btang ste/ bod mi rnams gsod 'ded kyis kru'u(lo/)zer ba'i dmag gi gzhi sa mang bo brtsigs mkhar du ma btsugs te re zhig gzhis chags/ bod mi rnams de snga'i 'tsho gnas gzhung nas ri lung rdza rtse sogs su gnas 'pho mi byed ka med byung / de la chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/ thang la mi chags brag ri btsan po 'dzin/ zhes zer ba yang rgyu mtshan zab mo yod/ deng dus the bo phyogs kyi sa cha mang bor gna'i mkhar shul dang so phag mang bo mthong rgyu yod pa ni de dag gi skabs kyi mkhar shul sogs yin la/ yul 'di dang thog nas rgya sogs bod mi las logs su gyur pa'i mi rigs shig gis bzung ba ma yin/de nas bod skad smra ba spyi'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su bod dmag 'bum phrag du ma btang ste 'di phyogs kyi thang gi kru'u du ma bcom thang dmag rnams bod yul nas phyir bskrad cing rang sa rang gis bdag tu bzung /de nas so mtshams srung ba'i dmag ches mang bo bzhag pas da lta 'di phyogs kyi mi sde mang bo zhig de'i skabs kyi dmag mi las mched pas deng dus gza' ru/tshong ru/ g.yas ru ba sogs ru mtha' can gyi mi sde mang / gnyis / the bo zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul/'dir the bo zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul la brjod tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' yod de / the'u rang zhes pa las thogs pa dang / bzang ba the bong gi don las thogs pa dang / de kru'u( 〉〉/)zhes pa'i de yig las thogs pa dang / de phud g.yag 514

khur zhes pa'i de bud las thogs pa bcas brjod tshul mi 'dra ba mchis/ de las dang bo the'u rang zhes pa las thogs zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ the'u rang zhes pa byi la'i rnam pa can gyi 'byung bo'am/ yi dwags kyi rigs shig la zer / de ni 'brug dkar gtsang bo'i chu 'go ste stag tshang lha mo nas mar le bar bcu phrag 'ga'i lam nas rkyang tsha'i the'u rang 'gag zhes pa'i sa ming dang / de na the'u rang gi tshang ste brag khung ngam brag skyibs zhig yod par bshad/ des gna' snga mor the'u rang mang ba'i yul yin pas the'u rang 'gag man chad la the'u rang khog ces brjod pas phyis brda 'gyur nas the bo rong zhes brjod zer mkhan yang yod/ de nas la las the bo zhes pa ni bzang ba ste the bong gi don yin zhes brjod kyang rgyu mtshan 'di yin zhes gsal bo bshad rgyu med pa 'dra/'dir bzang ba the bong gi don yin zhes brjod pa de dang de phud g.yag khur zhes pa'i de phud de ni dang bo dang / gong ma/ rtse mo zhes pa bzang ba'i don yin la de dang 'brel nas brjod pa yin min mi shes/ gal te yin na the bong ngam bzang ba'i don yin zhes brjod na de phud g.yag khur las thogs pa yin zhes brjod tshul dang don gcig mtshungs dang / min phyir bzang ba the bo'i don yin zhes brjod pa la rgyu mtshan 'dren rgyu med/ de kru'u( ska/)zhes pa las thogs pa yin par 'dod pa ni gna' dus thang rgyal rabs sogs rgya nag gi rgyal rabs 'ga'i dus su kru'u zhes pa'i dmag gi gzhi sa du ma gtsugs pas/ the bo khog 'dir yang de kru'u zhes pa'i kru'u zhig btsugs pas de kru'u zhes pa'i de yig la bdag sgra bo sbyar bas de bo'am the bo zhes brjod par 'dod mkhan yang yod/brjod tshul 'di yang the de gnyis sgra nye ba ma gtogs gzhan yid ches kyi lung 515

dang rgyu mtshan 'dren rgyu med/de nas deb ther dang mkhas pa chen po gnyis las lung 'dren rgyu yod pa'i brjod tshul ni de phud g.yag khur las thogs pa'i brjod tshul 'di yin/ 〈mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtsho〉zhes pa las/ hor gyis sgom grwa bcom skabs dmag nang nas skyen po btus pa'i dpa' bo mi dgu dmag dang bcas pa hor bod kyi mtshams su bzhag ste rgyal po'i bka' ma byung bar du ldog tu med gsungs pas dpa' bo mi dgu'i rgyud pa la ka ma log tu thogs shing / mdo smad lho byang gi mi rgyud phal cher bod chos rgyal gyis rgya bod so mtshams su bzhag pa las mched pa sha stag yin pas skad rigs la'ang brda rnying ma 'gyur ba mang /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ the bo'i sa cha 'dir yang khri srong gi dus su so mtshams srung ba'i dmag bzhag pa yang(gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar〉 las/de phud g.yag khur du grags pa rgya'i kha gnon du bzhag ste mtheb ju brag dkar gnyan gyi pho brang du sa mkhar bzung nas bsdad pa'i lho phyogs the bo stod smad gnyis su grags pa las the bo stod ma zhes pa ri brag gi sa char gnas shing dpa' rtsal ngoms pa'i dud khri phrag brgal ba'i yul gru de las 'brong ba zhes chad/ces gsungs pa dang / yang(mdo smad chos 'byung〉las/ khri ral ba can gyis tsong khar dmag gi gzi byin bskyed pa'i dar bo che phyar/ dmag rtsis dang go bsher mdzad dus dar pa zer bas g.yag chen po gnyis mchan khung du bcug ste sa la ma reg par khyer bas/ cen dar ba g.yag khur ces ming thog pa dang /dmag sde thams cad las de bud pas/ de bud du thogs/ rgya bod kyi sa mtshams gnon pa'i dmag dpon du bskos/ theb jus brag dkar gnyan gyi pho brang la 516

btsan mkhar brtsigs te/ mdo smad kyi mi dpon byas/ zhes gsungs/ de bud g.yag khur brag dkar('breng ba'i brag dkar/ zi na'i brag dkar/ brag dkar bya rgod)gnyan gyi pho brang ste the bo rong du rgya bod kyi sa mtshams gnon pa'i dmag dpon du bskos pas de'i dmag sde dang bcas pa la de phud dam de bud du thogs/ phyis brda 'gyur nas the bo zhes brjod pa yin/ 'di la bod kyi mkhas dbang chen po dmu dge bsam gtan gyis/ che dar pa g.yag khur ni dmag sde thams cad lus de bud pas/ de'i ming la de bud dam de phud du thogs / de'i dmag sde chen po de'i ming la'ang de phud du grags/ de dus dang da lta'ang de phyogs kyi skad gdangs la de dang the gnyis sgra shin tu nye ba'i stabs kyis / phyis su brda 'gyur nas the bo zhes 'bod cing bris pa red/ 'di la 'khyog bshad srid kyang don dngos gnas thogs tshul 'di red/ ces gsungs/mdor na/ the bo rong gi mi rgyud gdod ma'i sbra rigs dang / khri srong sogs kyi dus su bzhag pa'i mtha' mtshams srung ba'i dmag sde gnyis las mched pa ni da lta'i mi sde rnams kyi 'byung khungs dang / dar pa g.yag khur zer ba'i dmag dpon las the bo zhes pa'i ming thogs zhes brjod na lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul dngos dang mthun par sems/ /

rgyal rong dmangs khrod las byung ba'i khro ri a mye sgo ldong gi sgrung las 'phros pa'i gtam/rdo rje/rgyal rong rgyal mo dngul chu'i 'gram rgyud du/ /rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad dmangs khrod du/ /brgyud nas byung ba'i lo rgyus don chen gtam/ /a mye sgo ldong zhes bya'i gna' bo'i sgrung / /gling gi khro thung rgyal po yin par 'dod/ /ces gleng bya thog mar khro ri a mye sgo ldong zhes pa'i ming la cung zhig dpyad na/la las khro ri ni gter kha khro yod pa e yin snyam nas rgyu mtshan du 'dod pa dang /la las rgyal po khro bo skyabs kyi rgyab ri'i ri rgyud yin pas de'i ming zur las thog pa e yin 'dod pa dang / la las khro skyabs thugs rje chen po byung ba'i gtam rgyud la sbyar ba e yin sogs bshad mod/ gter kha khro yod med da dung tshan rig gis gsal bshad dngos ma mthong ba dang / rgyal po khro skyabs kyi ming zur las thog par lo rgyus dus rabs dang bstun na sngon gyi tha snyad zhig gi ming sogs las phar thog pa zhig yin dgos par snang la/ khro skyabs thugs rje chen po byung ba'i gtam rgyud la sbyar ba de tsho ni khro skyabs khog tsam gyi bshad rmi zhig las / rgyal rong khog yongs la khyab pa'i gna' sgrung gi bshad pa de min par sems so/ /des na sgrung gtam 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum rgyu mtshan du byas 518

na khro ni gling gi khro thung rgyal po'i ming gi cha shas dang / ri ni khong la sdong grogs byed pa'i gzhi bdag drag rtsal can de'i rgyu mtshan yin par snyam/ a mye ni rang gi pa'i pha sogs bgres pa mtshon byed kyi mtshan yin mod/ skabs 'gar a mye bgres pa mtshon byed tsam la bsam na/ khyab chung ba'i don skyon du yang 'gyur srid de/ ci'i phyir na che ba mngon par 'don byed kyi mtshan yang yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i brtse dung shugs su gnas yod pa zhig kyang yin/ mdzad rjes dang bka' drin sogs kyi che ba 'don byed kyi mtshan yang yin par 'dod/ sgo ldong ngam sga ldong ni gtam rgyud rang las byung ba ltar na/ pha rus sga dang ma rus ldong yin pas khong gi mtshan de las byung ba yin pa sogs gleng gzhi'i tshul dang /gleng bya sgrung dngos ni mi rgan rnams kyis bshad pa ltar na/ gna' skal ba sngon gyi dus su shar rgyal mo rong shod chen bco brgyad kyi mi thams cad kyis chos dge ba ni sgra tsam yang mi shes/ sdig pa kho na bsags nas yod pas/ de'i rnam par smin pas bdud kyi cho 'phrul mi ru rdzus nas 'gro ba mi rnams kyi bde skyid 'tsho ba bcom nas/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar nas gnas yod par/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kyis mkhyen nas/ sprul pa'i thugs sras zhig gangs can bod kyi mdo smad hor phyogs su dud tshang nyam chung la rus rgyud bzang po pha rus sga dang ma rus ldong yin pa'i khyim rgyud zhig tu mthu chen a mye sgo ldong bskul ba bzhin bsam bzhin du sku 'khrungs/ khong gi mtshan yang pha ma gnyis kyi rus las btags par bshad/ khong ni sprul pa'i sku zhig yin pas 'khrungs ma thag tu gsung skad 'byon pa dang / sku 'khrungs pa'i nyin nas bzung rjen bre gang gi gor ba gsol thub pa dang / nyin gnyis par bre do/ nyin gsum 519

par bre gsum sogs gsol ba bzhes/ de bzhin nyin re bre re bsnan nas gsol ba mdzad/ nyin zhag nyi shu lon skabs nas bzung rjen 'bo gang gi gor ba gsol bar/ ma yum gyi gsung don bu khyod kyis nyin zhag de tsam la/ zas de tsam zhig gsol na nged pha ma gnyis kyis nyid 'tsho thabs dka' 'o zhes smos par / bus gsung don drin chen gyi pha ma gnyis thugs sun par ma mdzad dang /nga ni 'gro ba'i don la byon pa zhig yin pas/ pha ma la drin lan 'jal rgyu dang /sems can bde skyid kyi don dang / rgyal rong khams su bdud srin rnams btul bar mdzad rgyu dang / chos kyi 'khor lo skor rgyu'i ched sogs yin/ sang nyin nga gnas ri sogs skor bar 'gro dgos pas rjen 'bo gang gi gor ba dang ja zom gang sogs skol gsung nas gzim/ phyi nyin tho rangs par bzhengs nas rjen 'bo gang gi gor ba dang ja zom gang de gsol nas/ nags gseb sogs su phebs nas gcan gzan dang ri dwags sogs las/ bdud kyi cho 'phrul dom dred sogs bsad nas pha mar 'tsho rten sogs rogs ram byed mgo tshugs nas lo 'ga' song rjes/ nyin zhig da ni bdud srin 'dul ba'i dus la bab song /nga rang gi las 'phro rong smad phyogs su yod/ rong khams su mi rnams la sdug bsngal ster ba'i mi gzugs bdud kyi cho 'phrul can sogs byung yod pas de ma btul na/ skye 'gro thams cad sdug bsngal bar bya 'dug pas/ pha ma gnyis lus rgas shing stobs zhan pas kha bral mi phod kyang / bdag ni sems can gyi don la byon pa yin pas bya thabs bral/ dngos rdzas longs spyod 'di rnams pha ma gnyis kyi 'tsho rten dang lto gos gyis shig gsungs nas byon par/ deng skabs si khron rnga ba khul gyi khongs su gtogs pa chu chen rdzong gi sa'i char mdo chen 'brog sde 520

chen po de'i 'dus gnas rgyal sras rig pa'i rdo rje'am rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyis bzhengs pa'i mdo chen a dkar ri'i dgon pa'am thub bstan nyi shar gling gi mdun rgyud kyi ri 'dabs kyi lung mdor zhag bzhugs mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan de la brten nas/ de nas bzung ri de'i ming la khro ri a mye sgo sdo'am a mye sga ldong zhes mdo smad sa yi thig le rgyal mo rong chen bco brgyad kyi mi rnams kyis gnas mchog gam gzhi bdag chen po drag rtsal can zhig tu sems nas / kye/ 'od gsal lha las bab pa'i rigs/ /'dzam gling las kyi sa ba 'dir / /srid skyong zo dor gnyan gyi tshul/ /don la rigs gsum mgon po ste/ /rgyal ba kun dang dbye ba med/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /rin chen gter gyi mnga' bdag po/ /rgod ldem mched gsum spyan 'dren no/ /zhes sogs brjod / deng skabs kyang ri bsang dang rlung rta mchod pa rgyun mi chad pa 'bul nas / kha 'dzin dang sdong grogs sogs yid la ci 'dod kyi dngos grub dang ci bsam lhun gyis grub pa'i re bcol byed sa'i gzhi'i rten zhig tu gyur yod pa shes gsal ltar la/ phyi nyin tshes bcu gsum/ skar ma smin drug lo bzang po/zla ba bzang po/ zhag bzang po/ nyin bzang po/ dus tshod bzang po sogs 'phrod sbyor shin tu bzang bar sems nas/ mchod pa phul/ smon lam btab/lha bsang btang nas brjod don/ bswo bswo cha'o lha rgyal lo/ de ring lo dang po shing pho byi ba/ zla ba dang po me pho stag zla/ nyin dang po sa 'brug gi nyin/ nam yar langs yos bu'i dus bzang 'di la/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba zhi khro lha tshogs dang —/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dam can rgya mtsho lha tshogs/ khyad par du dgra bla wer ma bcu gsum/ de ring tshes grangs 'di la gnas pa'i lha mthu bo che/521

klu mthu bo che/ klu gnyan sa bdag yul lha gzhi bdag rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ las dkar nag gi shan 'byed pa dang / bstan dgra bsgral ba'i las dang —/ sems can bde skyid la 'god pa'i las bcas la sdong grogs mdzod cigam g.yel cig bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces gsung nas rgyal rong sa khul kun la rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas phebs pa'i skabs/ dud tshang nyam chung ba ma dang bu mo gnyis las med pa zhig yod/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nub bu mo de srin mo mig gcig mas za ba'i res yin pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas der phebs par/ do nub nga rang la gnas tshang zhig g.yar e chog gsung par/ ma rgan des sdug bsngal gyi nyams dang bcas de 'dra ma gsung / do nub nga'i bu mo de srin mos za res yin pas mi 'os zhes zer bar/ sgo ldong gis de la skyon ci yang med/ngas khyed ma bu gnyis dang lhan du 'dug grogs byed pas chog go zhes yar khyim du byon nas zhag bzhugs mdzad nas khong gis gsung don/ khyod gnyis snga tsam nas nyal bas chog nga la gro sog khur po gcig sprod dang 'grig gsung pa bzhin byas par/ khong gis gro sog gcal du bkram ste srin mo de bsgug par/mtshan phyed kyi dus tsam la bdud srin de 'ur sgra ldi ri ri/ sa chen po'i gzhi yang 'dar shig shig byas nas thon par khos bshad don/ bu khyod 'di gar ci byed du 'ong ba yin/ nga rang ni mi gsar gyi sha gsar za bar dga' ba zhig yin zer bzhin nang du thon par sgo sdong khong gnyis shugs 'gran par/ sgo ldong khong pham khul gyi rnam par/ bdud srin khong khengs rlom skyes par/ sgo ldong gis thabs mkhas kyis bdud srin gyi brang la me dkrug ('gal)brgyab dang lhan skam pas snying rtsar bzung / ral gris dum gcod byas/ phur pa gzir nas 522

bdud srin gyi rnam par shes pa dag pa'i zhing khams su spar bar bshad/ dus de nas bzung shar rgyal mo rong chen bco brgyad kyi mi rnams kyi 'tsho bar bde skyid kyi nyi ma shar mgo tshugs pa'i dus yin pas/ dus ston yang lo gsar lta bu zhig de nas bzung byed srol dar/ shing byi zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo po rag mchod pa dang / tshes bcu gsum nyin gnam la skar ma/sa la dus tshod bzang ngo snyam pa'i srol rgyun rgyal rong la chags nas lo ltar du tshes grangs de rnams la/ lha srung dang / dgra bla wer ma/ thab lha/ khyad par du gnyen gyi lha mthu chen a mye sgo ldong sogs la bsang mchod 'bul ba dang / khyim tshang dang nye rgyud rnams mgron du mnyam 'dzoms byas nas dga' ston gzab rgyas byed/ glu len/ bro rdung / phye ril snum du btsos nas bdud kyi mig yin zer nas za/ gro phye'i thug pa nar ril ring po btsos nas bdud srin gyi rgyu ma yin zer nas za/ rtsam pa dang snum bsres nas gro phyes btum ste 'jong ril byas nas bdud srin gyi snying yin no zer nas za srol yod pa dang / rang rang so so'i a mye yang mye mtshun mgon mtshun mchod byed/ khyad par du tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mor a mye sgo ldong gis bdud srin btul ba'i tshes bzang dus bzang yin pas/ yul tsho'i mi rnams kyis byis pa rnams khag gnyis su bgos te lha dang 'dre gnyis 'thab tshul/ me 'gal rgyag res byas nas lha rgyal 'dre pham gyi rten 'brel yang brtsi/ de nas bzung byed srol de da lta yang gnas bzhin yod pa dang / a mye sgo ldong sdongs grogs mdzad mkhan dgra bla wer ma bcu gsum sogs yin pas dus de nas bzung dgra bla bcu gsum gyi lha gar 'cham srol yang rgyal rong la dus de nas bzung dar bar bshad/ rgyal rong brda rnying kha — 523

skad kyi gtam thab ka bshad pa zer ba las/ pi snyi bcu pa smin drug zla ba yar tshes bcu gsum wu zhag ci tis/ steng 'og bar gsum ki lha klu mi gsum ki 'dus gis/ mchog gsum dbu 'phang ka bstod/ yul ri gzhi bdag nye'i gtang rag ka phul/ bod a mye sgo ldong dngos su ka bstod ki srol lam bzang po ki bdog 'di nges/ zhes dang / bcu pa smin drug zla ba yar tshes bcu gsum wu snyi ci de'i re/ bod a mye sgo ldong snga dro nyi ma rtse shar spyan 'dren/ bsu ma ka sa/thab chen gser gyi ma 'dal wu ta'i/ bzhugs gdan ka 'jag da ngag pan wu 'phros te rdzu 'phrul sprul pa'i sku mkhar na ngos she zhes dang / gdung rus chen bco brgyad ki nor g.yang na ka thob kyis/ khams gsum sems can thams cad ki skyid ki rgyas wi ka si po/ wu de wu tshes bdud rngam rje rtsal po kyis sprul pa ki gsum na ka klod re/ dang po bdud khyab pa lag ring ka tsis de gis ta wed ki dgu we phyi'i she na ka rnyab/ gnyis pa the'u rang rkang gcig pa re ta wed ki dgu wi phyi'i she de brla rde na ki mad du/ gsum pa srin mo mig gcig ma ka tsis gis ta wed ki dgu wi phyi'i she na nam to/ sems can nye ri gnod 'tshe wa sho na ka skyid wi de nye ki kye ki me'i ka glod li ched kyis lha yi sprul pa rje sgam po di rmu rje rga lo 'jes(gnyis)yab yum to ka si pe tsi 'dzes sras bod a mye spun gsum na ki 'khrungs / che ba mthu chen a skyes sgo rdung ci de nyid na skyes rje ki gsum de brla to skyid nyid zhal nu dkar po lha rgyal nag po bdud pham to ka gsungs ki gsum par mi rdi stobs dang sgyu rtsal 'gran zla ki me'i to ki rdzogs zhes dang / bdud srin 'dre gsum ki wi kha gnon/ bod a myes sgo rdung nye re shar phyogs dung ri dkar po dung gi ja mkhar wu gu da'i ki bzhugs 'di nges/ lo re'i ki lan re 524

sems can 'gro don ki mdzad ci de bcu pa smin drug zla ba yar tshes bcu gsum wu snyi ki 'byon nges to ka gsungs 'di nges/ zhes pa la sogs lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs 'di lta bu mang po zhig rgyal rong dmangs khrod du bshad rgyun mchis na'ang 'dir dpe mtshon tsam zhig bkod pa yin no/ /de las sngon rgyal rong la chos mi dar ba dang ri dwags sogs bsad nas 'tsho ba skyel dgos pa dang / gcan gzan gdug pa can mang ba dang / mi gzugs bdud kyi cho 'phrul can/bdud khyab pa lag ring dang / srin mo mig gcig ma dang / the'u rang rkang gcig sogs bdud srin 'dre gsum btul nas zhes pa sogs las rgyal rong gi gdod mi'i spyi tshogs mtshon yod la/ rus rgyud sga dang ldong zhes pas rgyal rong mi'i rus rgyud mi'u ldong drug las mched pa'ang bstan yod/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul zhig mdo smad phyogs su sku 'khrungs zhes pa sogs las rgyal rong la chos lugs gzhan byung nas rgyal rong gi gdod ma'i chos lugs la 'pho 'gyur byung ba yang go nus/ de ni zhor tshig tsam las dngos su zhib 'jug byed na ni sgrung de la rgyal rong gi lo rgyus kyi rin tshad nges can zhig ldan yod snyam mo/ /yang bskyar du gong du bshad pa'i dus ston 'di la mi rgan tshos 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba'i bshad pa re mchis te/ la las rgyal rong gi lo gsar yin zer/ la las a mye khro thung gi rjes dran yin zer/ la las bdud srin btul ba'i dga' ston red zer/ la las ni sngon hor gling g.yul bkyes pas gling pham te hor dmag rgyal rong khog tu khyab/ phyis su gling dmag gis hor dmag rnams rgyal rong nas brlag phud g.yul las kyi rgyal kha thob pa'i dus tshigs dga' ston te/de nas bzung dar bar yang bshad/ gang ltar yang rjod byed tshig gi cha nas 525

'dra min sna tshogs zhig mchis na'ang / brjod bya don gyi cha nas gling sgrung gi nang don dang ha cang mtshungs te/ nyam chung rnams kyi pha ma/ btsan po rnams kyi gnya' gnon/ bdud rig btul ba'i tho ba/ dkar po chos kyi sa bon btab nas/ skye 'gro bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar bkod pa sogs yin pas a khu khro thung ngam gling ge sar gyi lo rgyus zhig ma yin nam snyam mo/ /mi rgan mgo ses bshad bshad lo rgyus min/ /khyi rgan o yos zos zos rus pa min/ /bye'us rgum bu 'thu tshad 'bu srin min/ /'on kyang dgos pa'i dus na dpyad gzhir 'os/ /mi rgan 'chi kha'i 'chal gtam gyong po'i nang / /lo rgyus dngos kyi gtam bzang yod dang med/ /rig pas dpyad dang zhib 'jug tshad ma sogs/ /bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin dgos nges snyam/ /rgyal rong mi yi lo rgyus la/ / —'brel ba cung re yod snyam nas/ /lo rgyus zhib 'jug pa rnams la/ /dpyad gzhi'i tshul du bris pa dge/ /526

bal bo'i mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzhengs pa'i gter ma'i gtam gyi dgos pa'i skor gleng ba/chu bzang klu rgyal tshe ring /de yang bal yul gyi mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor dang / khri srong skabs su bzhengs pa'i bsam yas gtsug lag khang gnyis ni yul dang bzhengs mkhan gyi gang zag sogs phyogs gang mang nas phan tshun mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod stabs/ de gnyis 'brel nas dpyad rgyur rin thang cher med pa ltar snang yang / mkhan slob chos gsum gdan 'dzoms pa la brten nas bod du dam pa'i chos kyi srol rgya cher dar bar byas shing / lhag par du bod brgyud nang bstan gtsug lag khang gi thog ma bsam yas gtsug lag khang skabs der gsar du legs grub byung bar mtshon na/ chos 'byung dang deb ther khag tu bsam yas grub pa'i dga' ston du bod mi res glu re blangs shing / rta re rgyugs shing /bya re skad re grags myong ba'i skor bkod nas bltas pa tsam gyis nang chos bod du spel ba la bod mi sus kyang dga' bsu thob yod bzo lta bu zhig bkod yod mod / 'on kyang lo rgyus kyi don dngos ni de las ldog ste/ skabs der mtshon na bod btsan po'i srid dbang gi rgyab rten la brten nas btsan thabs kyis chos spel zhing / bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa na ma zhang khrom pa skyes 527

gson dur du sbas pa dang / bsam yas gtsug lag khang nyin brtsigs pa mtshan mor 'dres bshig par bshad pa des gsal bor go thub pas mtshon/ bod 'bangs byings la mtshon na da rung yun ring du dar che ba'i bon lugs kyi lta spyod skor rgyun 'byams su mchod yul byed pa mngon thub/ lo rgyus kyi gnas babs de lta bu'i ngos nas bshad na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bal bo'i mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi lo rgyus dang / lung rigs kyis brdar chod pa'i sgo nas de 'brel gyi phan yon rgya cher bstan pa ni skabs der mtshon na gtam gyi sbyor ba gzhan gang gis kyang tshab byed mi thub pa'i phan rlabs rgya cher yod 'dug pas/ 'dir mdzub mos ri ston gyi tshul du de'i skor rags tsam spro bar 'dod do/ /dang po/ sangs rgyas chos lugs ngo sprod thub pa'i dgos pa ldan/srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su sangs rgyas chos lugs nas lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug sogs legs cha mang bo zhig bcud du blangs yod na'ang / don du phyi'i rig gnas kyi bcud snying bor len pa'i tshul gyis spel ba las/ dam pa'i lha chos bod du spel ba'i mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs med pa ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang ni sus bltas kyang mi mthun pa'i cha btsal du med pa'i dga' bzhi 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang du grags pa des gsal bar go thub pas/ skabs de'i chos lugs ni chos lugs spel ba'i las kho na ma yin par rig gnas spel ba'i las thabs kyis spel yod pa rigs pas dpyad bzod du grub kyang / khri srong gi skabs su bod btsan po'i srid dbang gi stobs shugs la brten nas sangs rgyas chos lugs kho na spel ba dmigs su 528

bzung ba yang / rgya che'i dmangs byings la mtshon na cha rgyus med pa'i chos lugs de nyid don du ji lta bu zhig yin pa mi shes pa'i gnas tshul 'og nas bod khams kyi gong zhol bar gsum gyi mi gang mang zhig gis btsan po'i bka' dang gsar du dar ba'i phyi'i chos lugs de dang len byed rgyu phar zhog tshad mi 'dra ba'i lo rgyus kyi don rkyen mang bo bslangs te/ spyi tshogs hril bo yom yom du btang ba dang / tha na rgyal bo'i pho brang nang khul du'ang 'cham mthun mi 'ongs pa'i gzhi mar gyur bas na de thams cad sel ba'i ched du/ slob dpon pad+mas ngo mtshar ba'i 'phrul dang go sla ba'i gtam sbyor la brten nas skabs de'i skye bo rab 'bring tha gsum gyi blo 'gugs mdzad pa ni dgos pa shin tu che ba zhig yin te / bab chags pa'i tshig sbyor dang / don 'dus tshig nyung gi lam nas mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi lo rgyus gsungs pa ni shin tu nas nyan spro ba ma zad / der thengs gcig nyan pa tsam gyis kyang rgyu ci 'dra yin na 'bras bu yang de 'dra 'byung ba bzhin du rgyu dge ba las 'bras bu bde ba dang / rgyu sdig pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba/ dge ba'i 'bras bu chung ngu la bde ba'i 'bras bu rgya cher smin pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi dgongs pa zab mo rtogs thub pa ni/ ji skad du / ji 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra 'byung bar gyur/ /ko ṭa pa yis sa bon las/ /'bras bu sa lu 'byung mi srid/ /ces pa ltar dang / rigs mi gtso/ rus mi gtso/ bslab pa gtso ste dka' ba bzod thub tshe gtan gyi bde ba sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang lag tu yod cing / dge ba'i lam ma nor tshe bde ba'i go 'phang mig mthong lag zin du myong thub par ma zad/ rnam dkar dge ba'i sems dang ldan na rgyal bo'i khrims dang dmangs kyi stobs gang gis kyang brdzi mi 529

thub pa sogs nang chos kyi dgongs pa rnams skabs de'i spyi tshogs dang mi'i bsam blo'i phugs 'dun sogs dang mthun par spros pa des mi su yin yang der log rtog mi skye zhing / nang chos la 'jug 'dod kyi smon pa zhig ngang gis 'phel bar mdzad pa'i dgos pa chen po zhig mthong thub pa yin/gnyis pa/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor dang bsam yas gzug lag khang gnyis bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus kyi gnas bab 'dra ba/de yang mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi lo rgyus thos pas grol ba zhes bya ba 'di ni slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bka' bstsal ba mkha' 'gro ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis zin bris su btab ste rnam snang chen po'i sku rgyab tu sbas pa phyis gter las bton pa zhig yin la/ 'di'i le'u dang por bltas pa tsam gyis khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su bsam yas bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus gnyis la mi 'dra sa mang yang / de gnyis bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus kyi gnas bab las 'phros te dpyad pa cung tsam btang na/ 'dra ba'i cha 'ga' yang mchis te/ skabs der sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du spel ba'i bya gzhag dngos la sne khrid dang / lo rgyus mi sna mang bo zhig la bzang stod ngan smad dang / byas rjes can la bstod bsngags / ngan pa 'ga' zhig la mtshang brus pa lta bu'i nus pa mi dman pa thon 'dug ste/ de yang mchod rten bya rung kha shor de nyid rgyal bo'i bka' yis rgyab skyor ma thob tshe bya rdzi ma bde mchog ma smad lngas bzhengs 'dod kyang re ba don smin yong ba'i go skabs med la/ de bzhin du mchod rten bzhengs pa'i thog mtha' gang du'ang rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu thob rgyu phar zhog rgyal blon thams cad kyis mchod rten bzhengs rgyu'i bsam pa kun nas bslangs shing /530

phyi nang bar gsum gyi dka' khag gang mang khyad bsad kyis ma rung skye bo gang drag la kha gtad drag gnon bgyis mthar/ gzhi khyen che ba'i mchod rten de nyid lo ngo bdun phrag gcig gi yun du grub par byas pa lags/ de'i bzhengs tshul dang bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus gnyis ni don che sa nas bshad pa yin na/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas babs dang bcas pa tshangs pa'i thig gis bcad pa ltar yang lci med pa'i gnas su mthong thub cing / bya rdzi ma bu rnams mi drag phal mo che gang gis kyang brdzi ma thub pa des bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang gi skabs su bsam sbyor ngan pa'i skye bo ma zhang khrom pa skyes sogs mi drag phal mo che la zur za drag po zhig byas pa mthong thub par ma zad/ gzhan gegs dang bar chad ci tsam byung yang dpa' 'thab kyi ngar ma yal/ brtson 'grus kyi rgyun ma chad/ mdun skyod kyi 'gros ma lhod pa'i bya rdzi ma bde mchog ma smad lngas mtshon pa'i mkhan slob chos gsum dang / rgyal bstan dar spel la mtshungs pa med pa'i brtse gzigs dang /zol med kyi rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gyi rgyal blon 'bangs gsum la bsngags brjod tshad med cig byas yod do/ / gsum pa/ slob gso'i don snying ldan pa/mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi lo rgyus thos pas grol ba zhes pa'i slob dpon pad+ma'i gsungs 'di la skabs de'i spyi tshogs gnas bab dang 'tsho ba'i rin thang ldan pa'i bsam blo'i cha til la snum bzhin snang ste/ gong du spros pa nang bzhin sangs rgyas chos ma dar ba'i yul yin pa'i cha nas mchog gsum mi bslu ba'i skyabs kyi dwangs ma yin pa sogs nang chos la dad dgos pa'i slob gso ni rtsa ba 531

dang —/ gzhan da rung bal yul gyi mi thams cad kha 'chams kyis rgyal bo la/ mo dbul mo bya rdzi ma gcig gis mchod rten 'di lta bu bzhengs na rang re kun la gnod che bas/ sa rdo rnams rang gnas su bskyal te rtsig tu ma bcug pa 'thad do zhus pa sogs don min gyis brnyes pa byas par/ rgyal bos de min gyi gnas lugs smras pa lan gcig tu gsungs pa las kyang / chos dang 'jig rten gyi lugs gang nas bshad na'ang legs bshad gser gyi lhun po lta bu'i sngon med ske legs bshad kyi bcud 'dus pa yin/ de yang dpal ldan zla bas/ yon tan ma lus brtson 'grus rjes 'gro zhing / /bsod nams blo gros tshogs ni gnyis kyi rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad kyang dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas pas mi 'grub pa med cing / thabs shes brtson pa gsum ma dor na mtho rgyal bo'ang rang dang mthun sdeb kyi grogs su 'gugs chog la/ 'bangs mi tshogs dgra ru langs kyang mi tshugs pa/ rang nyid bya rdzi tsam gyi go sa la mi dang dud 'gro srog chags thams cad grogs dang mdza' bshes su bsten chog pa ma zad/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad rang gi byas rjes la dga' gus yi rangs dang steng gi nam mkhar byon nas bsngags pa brjod pa'i gtam gyi rol mo rna ba'i bu ram du gyur ba des/ bya ba che ma chung gsum gang la 'jug kyang rang rang gi thad nas snying stobs bskyed dgos pa'i skul ma dang / slob gnyer sbyang brtson byed pa ni lus sogs 'tsho thub kyi zas tsam du ma yin par/ rang rgyud du snying rje shes rab sogs rmad byung gi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'dzoms par spro sems kyis 'jug cing mthar phyin pa'i ched du yin pa sogs don mthun gyi slob gso thob thub la/ lhag par du le'u lnga las 532

gnyis pa ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis lung bstan nas smon lam btab cing grub pa'i le'u nang du gtso bo mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi mdun nas smon lam rgya cher btab pa'i stobs las bya rdzi ma bde mchog ma'i bu rnams mkhan slob chos gsum du gyur nas mtha' 'khob kyi yul la dam pa'i chos spel zhing / bsam yas gtsug lag khang sogs rten dang brten pa mang du bzhengs pa/ sad mi bdun rab tu byung bar mdzad pa de las skye ba snga phyi yod pa dang thugs bskyed smon lam mthu btsan pa/ mkhan slob chos gsum zhal 'dzoms pa yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad kyi thugs smon dus su babs te bden par grub pa yin pa sogs las 'bras dang dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i phan rlabs dang bcas pa'i chos 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs mang bo zhig ston thub pa'i dge mtshan thon 'dug go /

bod kyi rlung rta dang khor yug srung skyob bar gyi 'brel ba la mdo tsam dpyad pa/rig bstan/de yang ljongs rgyu ba zhig bod yul la thog mar slebs skabs ches mngon gsal gyi dngos po zhig mthong rgyu yod pa de ni rlung rta'am dar lcog ces pa de red / dar lcog ces pa'i tshig de la chos lugs kyi nang don ci yang ma mchis mod / 'on kyang sangs rgyas chos lugs bod kyi rig gnas nang sim 'dzul byas rjes rlung rta'i ming la dar lcog ces ming gsar pa re btags nas rim bzhin chos lugs kyi nang don du bsdu len byas yod pa red/ de la brten nas da lta dar lcog ces pa de la gsol 'debs dang smon lam gyi tshig /sngags yig tsam las gzhan mtshon don ci yang med pa'i dngos po zhig tu 'pho 'gyur byung ba red ces mkhar rme'u bsam gtan gyis gsungs yod mod/ 'on kyang kho bos bltas na bon chos dang sangs rgyas chos lugs gnyis kyis de la 'grel bshad mang po zhig rgyag rgyu yod pa red snyam yang 'dir rang nyid kyis 'bri ma shes pas de lugs zhu/ spyir rlung rta 'bri tshul 'di la rlung rta dang klung rta zhes 'bri srol gnyis yod 'dug/534

dang po/ 'byung ba lnga dang rlung rta'i bar gyi 'brel ba la mdo tsam dpyad pa/rlung rta'i ri mo ni 'byung ba lnga'i mtshon byed yin te/ khyung ni srog gi mtshon byed de tshe thag ring du bskyed par phan pa dang / stag ni lus kyi mtshon byed de lus po bde thang dang 'tshar longs 'byung bar phan/ 'brug ni dbang thang gi mtshon byed de dbang cha dang go gnas 'phar bar phan/ seng ge ni rlung rta'am kha rje bsod nams mtshon byed de don rnams bde blag tu 'grub par phan/rlung rta ni bla dpal mtshon byed de zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad rta mchog ltar bgrod myur la 'grub bde bar phan/ rgud pa yod na gso ba dang /nyams pa yod na bskyed pa dang / chad pa yod na bsring ba dang / 'khrugs pa yod na mthun par bsdebs pa sogs cha rkyen ches bzang zhing gnad che ba zhig yin pa nga rang tshos brtsi srol yod/ de'i tshul ji ltar red ce na/ sa'i khams las grub pa'i rdul gyi phung po ni ri bo yin la/ ri bo ches mtho shos ni gangs ri yin pas sa'i khams las grub pa'i rdul gyi snying po zhig yin pa'ang mtshon thub la / ri der gnas shing g.yo 'gul gyi nus shugs yod pa de ni seng ge'am gangs seng zhes pa de yin stabs/ rlung rta'i nus pa'i nang gi sa'i khams kyi nus shugs mtshon byed du seng ge byung ba yin/ spyir na gangs ri'i steng du seng ge yod dam med ces pa ni a mdo'i mkhas pa 'ba' gzhung khyung thar rgyal gyis gangs seng yod med la dpyad pa de ni deng dus kyi bsam phyogs dang lta phyogs shig las snying po med ces gsungs pa ltar red 'dug lo bzhi stong sngon gyi bod 535

mi tsho'i bsam phyogs dang lta phyogs shig yin stabs de dag la brtag dpyad mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dmangs gtso bcos sgyur skabs khams kuḥthog dgon pa'i rten sgam nang du gangs seng gi pags pa zhig rnyed yod pa dang / de bzhin du kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po rnam gnyis kyis rin chen ril bu'i phabs rta gangs seng gi 'o ma dngos su lon yod pa kho bo'i dge rgan dis chung blo chos tshang gis gsungs pa sogs mang po zhig bshad rgyu yod kyang 'dir yi ge mang bar dogs nas ma bris/ de bzhin du chu'i khams mtshon byed du 'brug gi gzugs 'bri srol byung zhing de chu la gnas 'cha' ba'i sems can g.yo 'gul gyi nus pa dang ldan pa zhig yin pa dang / me'i khams gyi nus pa mtshon byed du khyung gi gzugs byung ba ni tsha ba'i nus shugs phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba'i phyir na khyung chen 'bar ba zhes pa me'i nus shugs la go dgos pa dang / 'byung ba shing mtshon byed du stag 'jog dgos pa'i don ni stag nags tshal gyi khrod du rgyun du gnas pa dang g.yo 'gul gyi nus shugs ldan par ma zad nags ri srung skyob byed pa la med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa dang / rlung ni g.yo ba dang bskyed pa'i byed las can zhig yin stabs 'byung rtsis nang du 'byung ba shing gi khams su bsdu bar bshad pa dang / rlung rta'i dkyil du rta bzang po zhig bris yod pa de ni nyes pa las legs par bgrod pa dang —/ ltas ngan las bkra shis par gyur pa dang / re ba yid bzhin du skong ched rta mchog nor bus brgyan nas phyis su rlung rta zhes rlung gi bzhon pa ltar 'gros myur ba'i don dang sbyar nas 'bri srol byung ba zhig tu 'dod cing / phyi'i rgyal khab tu'ang rta la mchod bkur dang dran gso'i stegs bu mang po zhig bzhengs yod pa 536

dper na/ u ru su'i mo si kho'i 'grems ston khang du rta pho gnyis la dran gso byed ched dran gso'i stegs bu zhig bzhengs yod pa dang / hang ga ri ru zangs las bzhengs pa'i rta pho zhis dang / rta de ni 'dzam gling 'khrugs chen thengs gnyis pa'i skabs su g.yul ngo ru shi ba'i rta red/ ce khe ru rta gso ba'i bshams ston khang zhig yod pa bcas mang po yod cing / suspyir na rta ni mi'i rigs kyi blos thub kyi grogs po ches bzang po zhig yin pa ni tshang mas shes gsal ltar lags/rta'i tshe tshad ni mi lo nyi shu nas sum cu'i bar yin/ 'brog pa tshos bshad pa ltar mi tshe gcig la rta rabs gnyis zhes pa ltar yin la/ rta'i nyin rer gnyid tshad phal cher chu tshod gnyis re yin la/ de la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig yod pa ni langs nas gnyid thub pa dang 'gro zhor du'ang gnyid thub pa bcas red/ mdor na 'dir rtas ci mtshon zhe na skyes bu pho mo su yin yang de'i 'byung khams kyi nus pa'i rgyun de mtshon cing / 'byung khams kyi nus rgyun de nam mkha'i khams kyi gzhi la brten nas rgyun bsring dgos pa yin stabs/ nam mkha'i khams kyi nus shugs kyang mtshon thub pa ni bshad ma dgos pa dang /rlung rta btsugs pa de lha gso ba dang bsang gtong ba/ 'khor yug srung skyob byed rgyu dang / 'byung ba mthun sbyor byed rgyu bcas kyi don mtshon yod/ yang deng dus dang mthun pa'i dpe go bde mo zhig bzhag na/ de yang dang po mi zhig la dpe mtshon na thog mar pha ma'i khu khrag gi 'byung 'dus las 'dzam gling steng tu gom pa dang po spos la/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i gnyer skyong las nar son/rim bzhin 'byung ba snyoms pa las sems la dga' bde skyid gsum dang ro la mngar skyur tsha gsum bcas grangs med myong zhing / ma snyoms pa las skye rga na 537

'chi sogs kyi sdug bsngal du ma myangs/ de bzhin du skye dngos la mtshon na yang /'byung ba lnga 'phrad pa las mgo bo 'degs shing / 'byung ba lnga ma 'phrad na skam rul gyi nyen kha'ang che/ de bzhin du ni sa'i go la ril po 'di la mtshon na'ang mi'i lus po lta bu zhig yin te/ gser gyi sa gzhi ni lus lta bu dang / de bzhin du chu sa'i khrag dang / rlung dbugs/ me drod/ nam mkha' khor lug /skye dngos gyon pa/ gter kha'i rigs rnams don lnga snod drug dang / srog chags rnams de'i phru gu lta bu yin pas/ phrug gus pha mar gnod bskyel mi rung ba bshad ma dgos pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi bya dngos yod tshad kyi rtsa ba 'byung ba'i chos nyid gcig tu 'khums pas/ mtshan nyid rig pa'i phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag dang / brda sprod rig pa'i sgra'i skye gnas kyi rnam gzhag /gso ba rig pa'i rlung mkhris bad kun gyi rnam gzhag /skar rtsis rig pa dang 'byung rtsis kyi rnam gzhag /mdzes rtsal rig pa'i kha dog gzhi'i rnam bzhag sogs mdor na chos 'jig rten gang gi lugs kyi rnam gzhag bshad na'ang 'byung lnga'i chos nyid kyi rig pa las log pa zhig yod pa ma yin pas/ gal srid bden par ma bzung ba'am dbang med kyis sa rko rdo bslogs dang gter kha bsdogs 'don/ rtsi shing nags tshal gcod 'breg /ri skyes srog chags sogs la gnod pa byas na 'byung lngas grub pa'i rang byung khams kyis spyi sger su la'ang 'jig pa chen po re gtong nges yin pa tshang mas shes dgos/ bod mi tshos rlung rta mang po ri la btags nas ri bsang rlung rta byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang khor yug srung skyob byed rgyu la bsam blo kho na btang yod/ gal te rang byung khams la gtor bshig byas na sgo phyugs la god kha dang lo tog la sad ser mi la rims nad sna tshogs gtong 538

nges yin pa ni nga tshos mngon sum tshad mas myong grub byung ba rnams 'dir bshad pa yin no/ / ciganyis pa/ rlung rta 'bri stangs dang 'byung ba mthun mi mthun bcas la chung zad dpyad pa/de yang rlung rta'i ri mo 'bri stangs ni dkyil du rta rgyan cha dang ldan pa zhig 'bri dgos/ khyung dang 'brug gnyis ni rlung rta'i stod kyi zur gnyis dang / stag dang seng ge gnyis ni rlung rta'i smad kyi zur gnyis la bris yod/rlung rta dpar sa'i gzhi ni rlung ras dang ras/ shog bu sogs la dpar na bzang —/ bsang gtong skabs su rlung rta rnams chag pa dang chag pa byas nas nam mkha'i dbyings su gtor ba dang / bsang gtong skabs bsang khang nang du bsang grol zhes me la'ang mang po bsreg srol yod/ rlung rta chag pa re la sgor mo re ma gtogs mi dgos/ rlung rta'i ri mo rnams ras dang rlung ras la par ba yin tshe/ mda' gzugs can gyi dar lcog dang / shing sdong dang brag sogs mtho sar 'dogs dgos/ dar lcog la dbye na mda' dar dang mdung dar/ rlung rta sogs bod yul la 'bod srol du ma yod/ rlung rta'i bstan pa 'di dar yul la mtshon na bod yul gtso bo byas pa'i 'dzam gling gi sa cha mang po la dar yod la/deng sang rgya nag gi yul la'ang ha cang dar rgyas chen po byung yod/rlung rta dpar sa'i mdog ni skye bo pho mo su yin yang 'byung ba me yin na dmar po dang / chu yin na sngo nag dang / shing yin na ljang gu/ sa yin na ser po / lcags yin na dkar po bcas 'byung ba so so'i mdog ltar byas na bzang 539

bar bshad/ spyir rlung rta'i don dngos ni khams dang bde skyid/ bsod nams/kha rje dang dbang thang / las lam dang lam 'gro sogs tha snyad mang po la 'jug /de rnams rim bzhin yar dar ba la rlung rta dar ba red ces pa dang mar rgyad pa la rlung rta rgyad pa red ces pa sogs bod mi tshos 'bod srol du ma yod cing /rlung rta'i nges tshig ni rlung de phyogs gang la g.yug na dar de de phyogs la spag spag ces rta zhon pa lta bu 'gro bas na 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa red snyam/ yang na kha rje dbang thang dar bar mgyogs pas na de ltar smras so/ /'byung ba rnams mthun phyogs dang mi mthun phyogs cung zad bshad na/rig pa gang yin yang sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas bshad na sa chu 'phrod pa dang / me rlung mthun pa/ nam mkha' kun dang mthun pa ltar sbyar na bzang ba dang / sa dgra me dang / me dgra chu/ chu dgra rlung / rlung dgra sa ltar sbyar na dgra 'gyur gyi nad brgya 'byung zhing / mi'i dbang po mi mdzes pa dang / zas mi zhim pa/ sgra mi snyan pa/ yid mi bde ba sogs kyi skyon 'byung ba dang / 'jig rten chos nyid du/sas chu 'dzin pa dang / rlung gis me sbar ba dang / nam mkhas 'byung bzhi gang la'ang gegs mi byed par rten byed la/ chu dang chu 'phrad na chu cher 'phel zhing rgyas pa sogs rigs bsgre nas shes par bya dgos/ bod kyi rlung rta gar yod sa la 'gro lugs ltar na sa rko dang rdo sngogs sogs gtan nas byed mi chog par khor yug srung byed dgos rgyu'i brda yig lta bu zhig yin pa ni mi tshang mas shes dgos so/ /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(1) (bod kyi lha sgrung skor gleng ba/〉 kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /540

gzhi rim dge rgan tshos slob ma skyong tshul skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/gnyan mo 'grub/spyir na slob gso'i bya gzhag gong 'phel du song na tshan rig lag rtsal gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang 'brel rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor sogs kyang gong 'phel du 'gro ba ni gdon mi za/ des na slob gso'i bya gzhag gong 'phel du 'gro dgos na slob grwa yag po gnyer dgos pa de yin/ rang re bod kyi sa khul la mtshon na rang rigs kyi bde skyid la sha tsha zhing tshad dang ldan pa'i shes yon can 'bor chen zhig skyed bsring yag po byas nas mang tshogs kyi rig gnas spus tshad mtho 'degs ma btang na mi rigs rjes lus kyi rnam pa de dus nam yang bsgyur mi thub pa ni nga tshor lo rgyus las thob pa'i nyams myong yin/ de yang bod kyi skad yig gzhir bzhag gi thog nas shes yon can skyed sring byed dgos na rtsa ba phal cher gzhi rim slob gso la rag las pa yin/'o na cha rkyen zhan zhing 'grim 'grul mi bde ba'i gzhi rim dag la mtshon na dge rgan gyi dpung sde 'dzugs skrun dang sra brtan gtong bar dka' khag che la slob mar snying thag pa nas sha tsha zhing gces skyong byed mkhan gyi dge rgan bzang po zhig brtan 'jags byed thub pa ni de bas kyang las sla bo zhig ma red/ slob 542

khrid rgyun 'khyongs dge rgan la dka' spyad snying rus ldan pa'i chod sems dang mi rigs rang nyid la sha tsha zhing slob gso'i las don la dga' zhen che ba'i rnam dkar gyi bsam pa bzang bo zhig med na shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i gzi brjid can gyi las 'gan de legs po zhig 'grub thub pa shin tu dka'/de bzhin slob grwa yag po gnyer ba la gong rim 'brel yo da sde khag bis rgyab skyor dang slob grwa'i 'go 'dzin dang gtso 'gan pas thugs khur do dam yag po byed pa/ dge rgan gyis slob ma gces skyong byed pa sogs dang kha bral thabs med pa ni kun gyis shes gsal ltar yin la/ 'dir bshad pa skabs su babs pa ni dge rgan bzang bo zhig gis slob ma rnams ji ltar byas te phyogs gang thad nas gces skyong byed tshul gyi skor la rags tsam dpyad pa de yin/1 bsam blo'i slob khrid thad/ dge rgan bzang bos rang gi slob ma rnams la bsam blo'i slob khrid kyis brtse sems dang phan sems mtshon tshul ni/ slob gso'i srog shing de bsam blo'i slob gso spel nas mi rigs rang gi lo rgyus dang rig gnas kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin skor tshig nyung go sla'i sgo nas shes rtogs byed du 'jug pa gzhi rtsar bzung nas/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas dang skad yig la yang ngos 'dzin yag po yod cing dga' zhen ldan pa/ brtse dung che ba / brtson sems ldan pa bcas kyi phyogs su blo sems 'gugs thub pa ra byed dgos pa dper na/ sa'i go la'i yang rtser gnas shing 'dzam bu gling gi lte bar gyur pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs chen po 'dir pha spre'u byang sems dang ma srin mo gnyis kyi sha rus las mched cing / rim bzhin 'phel 'gyur sna tshogs byung ba'i rang rigs bod mi rnams ni lo rgyus kyi dus rim ha cang ring (rtse thang 543

spra mi la da phan lo ngo khri phrag bdun brgya lhag bi lo rgyus yod pa/ra bshad)bo'i khrod du blo rig rgod cing las la brtson pas rang byung khams kyi dngos po mtha' dag la bsgyur bkod sna tshogs byas par brgyud nas thun mong bi skad yig dang /thun mong gi bcu phrag rig gnas/ thun mong gi sdod yu la/ thun mong gi chos lugs / thun mong gi goms gshis dang / chab srid dpal 'byor/ dmag don sogs phyogs gang gi thad nas kyang rang rigs kyi khyad chos gzengs su thon zhing 'dzam gling kun la yongs su grags pa'i lo rgyus rlabs po che gsar bskru na byas nas 'gro ba mi'i rigs la sub thabs med pa'i phyi rjes rlabs chen bzhag yod tshul sogs legs par 'chad pa lta bu'o/ /2 shes bya'i slob khrid thad/ dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la shes bya'i slob khrid thad nas brtse sems mtshon tshul gtso bo ni/ slob deb dngos kyi dka' gnad rnams ngag 'jam sems bzang gis thabs dang dpe du ma'i sgo nas slob khrid gang 'tsham byas te slob ma re re bzhin du tshig don gang gi cha nas kyang re 'dod bskang ci thub byed par ma zad/ nam rgyun slob mas dri ba bton par lan kha gsal drang bo 'debs dgos pa las/ 'ga' re la 'khyog bshad dang 'phya smod zur za byed pa/ la lar rgyugs kyi kha phyogs drang bshad byed par ma zad / tha na kha byang lkog shor byed pa dang 'ga' rer rgyugs byang gi phyogs tsam la yang mi gtogs pa re bshad nas mgo skor gtong ba/ la lar rmang gzhi cung brtan po yod kyang rgyun par rgyugs kyi thob skar dma' ba dang / 'ga' res nam rgyun rtsed mo sogs la rnam g.yeng byed kyang thob skar mthon po len pa sogs kyi rgyun ldan min pa'i gnas tshul rtag tu byung na/ dge rgan la phyogs lhung che zhing 544

yid rten med pa 'i phyi rtags yin pa lta bu'i drang bo min pa'i nyes skyon gang yod la dus thog tu yo bsung legs bcos byed rgyu gal shin tu che/3 'tsho ba'i thad/ slo ba ma'i 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen dang bde sdug la phyogs gang thad nas sems khur dang rogs ram ci thub byed pa'i dus mtshungs su dge rgan rang gi 'tsho ba'i nyam/sa myong thog nas slob gso dang sha tsha gces skyong byas nas slob ma tsho la 'tsho ba'i thad nas re 'dod dang ham sems chen po med pa ra 'dod chung chog shes ldan pa 'i sgo nas nam rgyun slo ba sbyong kho nar blo sems gcig sgrim yong thabs byed dgos/4kun spyod thad/ nam rgyun slob grwa'i 'grig lam do dam byed pa phud/ da dung slob khrid dge rgan gyis kyang skabs bstun slob ma rnams la kun spyod thad nas rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i sgos blang dor gyi rnam bzhag gang 'tsham bslabs nas/rgyun par ma cang dang kha la 'o khe sogs la rnam g.yeng byed pa dang / lo tshad la ma thon par mdza' grogs sgrib pa so/gas kyis slob sbyong la gnod 'tshe byed cing /tshul ldan min pa'i spyod ngan mtha' dag la sngon 'gog dang legs bcos yong bar byas na phan nus lhag par che ba mthong ba yin no/ /545

bod kyi bla sprul dag gis deng gi dus skabs su spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang mi rigs mthun sgril sogs la thon pa'i nus pa/dpal 'tsho/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i gros tshogs chen mo'i rjes su/ rang re'i zhing chen kyis mu mthud du tang gi chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus lag bstar byas nas dgon sde khag rim bzhin sgo 'byed byas te/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyi lus sems la dbugs 'byin par byas nas khong tshos stobs shugs gtso bo thon skyed gong 'phel dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen legs bcos byed pa'i phyogs su bsgyur/ khyad par du dad ldan mang tshogs rnams gom gang mdun spos kyis spyi tshogs rang lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun dang phyi phyogs sgo 'byed la nus pa 'don ched/1997lo'i zla dpa nas bzung / zhing chen yongs nas bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dgon khag la rgyal gces ring lugs kyi slob gso rgya cher spel bar ma zad/khrims lugs ltar dgon sde la do dam byed pa'i shugs tshad je drag tu btang nas dgon sde khag gi bdag gnyer dang do dam stabs bder bzos yod/ rgyu 546

mtshan de'i dbang gis nye ba'i lo du ma'i ring rang re'i zhing chen gyi dgon grwa phal mo che la nang khul gyi 'gal ba dang bod khul bde 'jags min pa'i snang tshul nyin bzhin je nyung du gyur yod/ lhag par du deng gi char bde 'jags dgon grwa'i srid jus rang zhing chen yongs su sgo kun nas lag bstar byas pa dang bstun nas/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bla sprul dag gis 'cham mthun spyi tshogs dang mi rigs mthun sgril/ spyi tshogs bed 'jags bcas kyi thad la thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa gal chen bton dang 'don bzhin yod/dang po/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bla sprul ni bod khams bde 'jags kyi srung dmag yin/sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / dge ba phun sun tshogs par bya ba ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rtsa ba'i dgongs don yin la/ bod brgyud nang bsta na gyi bla sprul rnams ni nang bstan gyi dgongs spyod bslab gzhi sems can la khrid ston byed mkhan yin pas/ chos lugs khag gi yar thon bla sprul dag gis bcings 'grol byung ba nas bzung nga tsho'i tang dang mnyam du skyid sdug mnyam rol dang /thun mong mnyam 'brel sgos mi rigs mthun sgril la yar skul dang / mtha' mtshams bde 'jags/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur gyi thad la nus/ pa gal chen thon yod/ phyi phyogs sgo 'byed kyi dus nas bzung zhing chen tang u dang srid gzhung / de min sa gnas tang u dang srid gzhung gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid la brten nas khong tshos rgyal gces chos gces kyi bsam blo'i go cha rab tu bsnan nas chos lugs kyi sgrig lam gsar ba 'dzugs skrun la rang nus ci lcogs kyis 547

sri zhu gang legs sgrub kyin yod/ yang gcig bshad na/ sangs rgyas chos lugs las bstan pa'i sdig spong dge sgrub kyi rnam bzhag dang / bdag bas gzhan gces kyi bsam blo/ byams dang snying rje'i lta ba rnams ni 'gro ba mi'i shes rig gi nying bcud du nges pas/ lo rgyus dus skabs so so'i nang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mtho rim bla sprul dag gis rang rang nus tshod kyis rgyal phan dmangs phan gyi las don bla lhag tu spel te/ bod khams bde 'jags dang / dad ldan mang tshogs kyi bsam blo gcig gyur/ gangs ljongs rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum / mi rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril dang mes rgyal zhi bde sogs phyogs kun gyi thad gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i nus pa gal chen thon yod/deng gi char/ chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus dang / mi rigs thams cad 'dra mnyam yin pa'i chab srid lam lugs bzang bo 'dis sa gnas so so'i bla sprul che chung kun la'ang rang rang nus tshod kyis sri zhu byed pa'i gar stegs bzang bo zhig skrun yod de/ rgyu mtshan ni/ bod rigs mang tshogs phal mo ches rang la chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma'am yang na lha sde gang gi dmangs yongs nas mchod bkur byed pa'i bla ma'i bka' mchid dang gsung tshig la lhag par brtsi ba dang / dper na bod khams kyi sa cha ga ge mor rtswa sa rtsod gleng sogs don rkyen 'dra byung na srid gzhung gis thag gcod dka' ba'i gnad don rnams bla ma'i tshig gcig gis thams cad kyi yid sems 'gul bar byed la/ ma bcos rang 'grig sgos gyod sna thams cad zhi bar byed pa lta bu yin/ gzhan yang tang gi srid jus dril bsgrags dang / dad ldan mang tshogs kyi yid sems zhi 'jags/ dgon pa'i grwa btsun khag gi 'byung khams lhod la 'bab dgos 548

pa'i dus la reg tshe/ bla sprul dag gis tang bi chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus dngos dang sbyar nas mang tshogs la slob ston byas na grub 'bras g.yur du za ba 'thob nges la/ de yang bod mi rigs kyi sems khams su bla ma ni gzhan su dang gang gis kyang tshab byed mi nus shing kun gyis thun mong du dad pa dang brtsi 'jog byed pa'i dmigs bsal can gyi go gnas can yin pa'i rkyen gyis red/ da lta spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa sngar las je bzang nas je bzang du snang la/chos lugs dad mos byed pa'i mang tshogs kyi dpung khag kyang slob gyur gtan nas 'grim ma myong ba'i bod 'bangs phal ba nas shes bya'i yon tan gyi chu tshad nges can ldan pa'i las byed mi sna'i bar du lo re bzhin je mang 'phel bar mngon pas/ bod kyi bla sprul rnams la'ang spyi tshogs gsar ba dang dus skabs gsar ba'i lo zla'i khrod rang rang gi yon tan ngoms pa'i mdun sa yangs po ldan par ma zad/ re ba dang dgos nges kyi cha rkyen yang sngon chad dang bsdur na je mthor gyur yod la/ de ni spyi tshogs dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i dus rabs rang bzhin gyi 'phel rgyas kha phyogs shig yin snyam/ mdor na sngon dang da lta'i dus rabs gang du'ang bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bla sprul dag gis bod khams bde 'jags dang bod mi'i sems khams gcig gyur/ mi rigs kha bral dang rgyal khab kha bral byed pa'i rlung yan gsum sogs sngon 'gog byed pa'i thad la'ang mdzad rjes bla med bzhag yod la/ phyin chad kyang 'jog nges su mchis pas / khong tsho ni ming don gnyis ldan gyi bod khams bde 'jags kyi srung dmag lta bu yin zhes brjod kyang mi chog pa med snyam/549

gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rtsa ba'i dgongs don dang deng gi srid jus kyi kha phyogs gnyis phal cher cha mthun pa/yig cha ltar na rang re'i zhing chen la bod rigs sa ya gcig lhag yod la/phal che ba sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad mos byed mkhan sha stag yin pas/dad ldan mang tshogs la chos lugs dad mos kyi rang dbang rgya chen po skrun rgyu ni da lta'i spyi tshogs khrod nges par bsam blo gtong dgos pa'i gnad don zhig yin par ma zad/ mi rigs kyi gnad don de'ang 'byung 'gyur gyi dus yun ring mo zhig la srid gzhung dang 'go khrid yongs nas yid gzab byed dgos pa'i gnad don gal chen zhig yin la/ khyad par du bod rigs mang tshogs nang khul gyi gnad don de'i rigs thag gcod byed dgos na sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lag cha 'di la brten dgos so/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas chos lugs las bstan pa'i byams dang snying rje'i bsam blo dang / rigs drug sems can thams cad mchog dman gyi dbye ba med par rang gi ma bzhin mthong ba'i 'du shes/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i lta ba dang rang gzhan gnyis la dmigs pa'i byang chub sems bcas ni mthar gtugs na yangs shing dkyil rgya che ba'i 'tshe med gzhan phan gyi bsam blo'i rmang gzhi byas rkyen/ da lta'i dus skabs su mgrin gcig tu bsgrags pa'i 'cham mthun spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo dang phal cher don gcig tu gzhol te/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gzhung don las thog mtha' bar gsum du bstan pa'i zhi bde dang kun mthun la bsngags shing / 'khrug rtsod dang ngan pa 550

nag nyes la smad pa'i bsam blo bcas ni dad ldan gyi sems 'dul bar byed pa'i thabs dam pa yin par ma zad/ byams snying rje sogs sems can kun la dmigs pa'i bsam blo'i go rtogs sogs las kyang 'cham mthun spyi tshogs sgrig 'dzugs kyi re ba yo ngas su mtshon la/ de bas nga tshos sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bde ba chen po la gzhol ba'i dgongs don rnams yongs su bed spyad de spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang 'dzam gling zhi bde'i don du hur thag byas na shin tu legs snyam/ kun su'u zhing chen srid gros kyi rgyun las u yon bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan mchog gis/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi byams snying rje dang rang sems rang bdag gi rtsa ba'i dgongs don 'dis spyi tshogs ring lugs 'cham mthun spyi tshogs sgrig 'dzugs kyi brgyud rim khrod du thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa 'don thub pa zhig ste/ rang sger gyi ngos nas lus bde bag phebs kyi gnas gzhi mkho sprod byas nas sems khams do snyoms la brtson pa las gzhan/gom gang mdun spos kyis mi'i rigs kyi bsam pa'i go rtogs mthor 'degs byed pa yin la/ spyi tshogs kyi ngos nas brjod na/ /dug sel gyi ma lag cig yin pas/ de la brten nas spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang bsam blo'i skye khams do snyoms la srung skyob byed dgos so zhes gsungs pa don la gnas so/ /der brten bod kyi bla sprul dag gis bod mi rigs kyi sems su gnas pa'i dad pa longs su spyad nas rgya che'i mang tshogs la sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum dang / dge sdig spang blang gi rnam bzhag ston dgos pa las gzhan/blo khog yangs shing dkyil rgya che ba'i mig rgyang ring du bskyed nas sems can la gus pa dang / brtsi 'jog zhi bde dang 'grig mthun gyi las don la rnam par 551

brtson te/ yang dag drang ldan gyi lam du blo rtse gcig sgrim sgos hur thag bya rgyu ni/gcig nas dad ldan mang tshogs kyi re ba yin la/ gnyis su srid gzhung gi re ba dang khong tshos bsgrub par rung zhing sgrub kyang nus pa'i don du sems so/ /gsum pa/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bla sprul dag gis spyi phan gyi las don la rtse gcig tu brtson len bya dgos/tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ bod kyi bla sprul mang che ba zhig la gzhan phan snying rje'i lhag bsam dkar po ches cher ldan par ma zad/ gtong yod che zhing dam pa'i chos la nang byan chud pa'i blo sbyong gting zab mo ldan phyir/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyi snying dbus su gzhan gyis tshabs byed mi nus pa'i go gnas gal chen zin yod/ dus rgyun du'ang bla ma ni rang nyid dge ba'i phyogs su khrid pa'i slob dpon dang tshe 'di phyi gnyis char sdongs grogs mdzad pa'i lam ston lta bu yin pas/ bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ /sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med/ /ces bla ma ni sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i skyabs mgon du bkur la/ de bzhin bla ma'i tshig gcig gi gsungs smras kyang bzang ngan 'grig min kyi thad la mi brtag par thams cad gsung gi tshad ma ru bkur nas rmongs zhen gyis dang du len pa'i gnas tshul gang mang mang mthong thub/ de yang phyogs gcig nas bshad na/bod mi dge ba dang kun phan gyi phyogs su bskul bas shin tu legs shing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bltas na/ mi rigs 'di'i bsam blo bcings 'grol dang dngos po'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun gyi thad tshad bkag nges can thebs yod pas/blang dor dpyad 'jog med par mtha' gcig tu rgyun 'dzin byas na mi rung mod/552

'on kyang nang ba'i chos lugs kyi dgongs spyod bslab gzhi ni thog mtha' bar sasum du dge ba dang du len pa dang sdig pa ring du spangs pa zhig yin na yon tan che bar sems so/ /mi rigs mthun sgril gyi thad nas gzhigs na'ang rang re'i rgyal khab yongs su bod brgyud nang bstan la dad mos byed pa'i mi grangs 'bor chen yo da la/de dag las mi rigs kyi phyogs nas brjod na gtso bo bod rigs dang / sog rigs/ hor rigs/ de min mdo dbus mtho sgang du yun ring 'tsho sdod byed pa'i mi rigs gzhan dang gzhan sogs shin tu mang ba dang / khong tsho yang bod mi rigs dang 'dra bar bla ma dang skyes chen dam pa'i gsungs la shin tu brtsi ba lags phyir/ rigs so so'i mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon dang spyi tshogs kyi gcig sgril nus pa mthor 'degs byed pa sogs kyi thad la phan 'bras chen po yod la/ de ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bzang cha yin la dad ldan tshang ma'i thun mong gi 'dun pa'ang yin pas/ dad ldan mang tshogs dang yang na nang bstan mthun tshogs/ khyad pa ra du bod kyi mtho rim bla sprul thams cad kyis bdag cag gi ston pas sems can kyi don sgrub pa'i rnam thar ltar spyi phan gyi las su zhugs te/ dman la byams shing dbul bar sbyin pa/ slob la bskul zhing nyen la rogs skyob bcas byed dgos par ma zad/ mes rgyal gcig gyur la srung skyob dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon/ spyi tshogs 'cham mthun la lhag bsam rnam dag gis hur brtson bya rgyu ni gnad kyi dam par sems so/ /mdor na spyi tshogs kyi dus skabs gsar ba dang lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen gsar ba'i khrod du bod kyi bla sprul dag la rig gnas yon tan gyi chu tshad nges can 553

'dzoms dbos pa ni bsnyon du ma mchis te/ de ni dus rabs kyis khong tshor bstsal ba'i 'os 'gan med du mi rung ba zhig yin pas cis kyang yid gzab byed dgos mod/ 'on kyang bod kyi bla sprul nyung shas la rig gnas dang chos lugs kyi blo sbyong dman pa'i thog zang zing 'du 'dzi sogs kun rdzob kyi las su 'khor nas lugs mthun don ldan gyi bya ba mi bsgrub la/ kha cig gis rang gi sprul ming tsam la brten nas rgyu nor mang bsdu/ gzhan mgo ci g.yog sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bya ba sna tshogs la brel zhing / dam pa'i chos dang dad ldan mang tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i las rnams la rgyab tu phyogs pa'i bya brgya cher spel bzhin yod pa 'di ni shin tu mi legs la/ chos srid 'jig rten rtsa khrims gang dang yang mi mthun pas/ tshul 'di 'dra la dad ldan mang tshogs kun gyis kyang blang dor gyi blo mig yangs su phye rgyu sand che snyam mo/ /

mjug byang /de yang / bod rig pa ( stsa la166 01087 1166 'ib cu 5714)ni/ bod kyi spyi tshogs dang / lo rgyus/ rig gnas/ tshan rig lag rtsal sogs la zhib 'jug byed pa'i sna mang kun 'dzom gyi rig pa zhig gam rig gzhung tshan khag cig yin la / rig gzhung gi ma lag kun 'dzom gyi phung po zhig kyang yin/ de'i khongs su/bod kyi lo rgyus dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ dmag don/khrims lugs/ chos lugs/ mtshan nyid/ skad yig rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/ slob gso / yul srol goms gshis sogs spyi tshogs tshan rig kun 'du la/ bod kyi bzo rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ gnam rig skar rtsis sogs rang byung tshan rig rnams kyang de'i nang du 'dus yod/ bod kyi lo rgyus su rlung ltar grags pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams kun kyang de'i khongs su gtogs pa ni brjod ma dgos pa zhig yin/ mdor na/ bod kyi bsam pa'i rig gnas dang dngos po'i rig gnas/ bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang thun mong ba'i rig gnas/ bod kyi 'das dang da lta/ ma 'ongs pa'i rig gnas kun kyang 'di'i nang du bsdus na mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan ga la yod/bod rig pa 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mang tsam yod pa ni dper na/ thog mar 'di la zhib 'jug byed yul gyi cha nas/ 'jug yul kher rkyang gcig nyid yin pa dang khongs gtogs nang gses mang la yangs shing rgya che ba'i rang bzhin ldan/ gnyis su 'di la nang don gyi cha nas/ rig gnas kyi 555

gting zab cing sgam la mtho ba dang nang don phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin ldan / gsum na 'di la dus yun gyi cha nas/ rgan la gzhon pa'i rang bzhin ldan/bzhi ru 'di la khyad chos kyi cha nas/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon zhing gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin ldan/ lnga ru 'di la shugs rkyen khyab yul gyi cha nas / 'dzam gling kun tu snyan grags 'bar zhing shugs rkyen che ba'i rang bzhin ldan / drug tu 'di la rig gnas ma lag gi cha nas/ nub phyogs rig gnas dang spun zla mi rigs rig gnas kyi zhan cha kha skong ba'i rang bzhin ldan/ bdun du 'di la rigs lam 'du shes kyi cha nas/ rigs lam phra zhing 'gran gleng gi rnam pa can dang nang gi 'du shes gtso bor 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin ldan/ brgyad du 'di la spyi tshogs dgos mkho'i nus pa'i cha nas/ rang las gzhan gtso bor byed pa dang lhag bsam snying rje gzhan phan zhi ba'i lam la 'bad nas spyi tshogs 'cham mthun legs 'grub yong ba'i rang bzhin gyi dge mtshan ldan/des na/ rang re'i rig tshogs kyis zhib 'jug byed yul ni/ gong du bshad pa'i bod rig pa 'di dag yin pa ni brjod ma dgos pa zhig yin te/ 'on kyang zhib 'jug byed pa'i yul gyi cha nas gtso bo ni/ khams dang a mdo gnyis kyi cha shas 'ga' las grub pa'i da lta'i si khron bod khul 'di yin/ de yang mtsho bod mtho sgang du gnas pa'i mdo dbus khams gsum yang zhib 'jug byed yul du 'dzin chog pa la 'gal ba ci yang med de/ de dag tshang ma bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug byed yul dngos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rang re'i rig tshogs kyis mkhas shing mdzangs la rab tu sgam pa'i sku zhabs yangs gling rdo rje mchog gis tshogs gtso dang 'go khrid mdzad pa'i legs 556

rkyen dge mtshan la brten nas/ dus da lta'i bar du (si khron bod rig pa'i zhib 'jugan dpe tshogs deb phreng dgu'i bdag nyid can dpar nas kun la bkram thub pa byung zhing / de las bod yig dpe tshogs deb phreng gnyis bkram yod / deb 'di ni (si khron bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug〉 dpe tshogs deb phreng gi bod yig dpyad rtsom gces btus pod gsum pa yin la/ spyi'i deb phreng ang bcu ba'ang yin/ deb 'dir btus pa'i bod yig dpyad rtsom rnams ni/ rang re'i rig tshogs kyi skabs gsum pa dang skabs bzhi ba'i bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gros bsdur tshogs 'du'i thog tu spel ba'i dpyad rtsom kun las gces btus byas pa yin la/ gros bsdur tshogs 'du'i rjes su 'don sprod dang bdams bsal byas pa kha shas kyang bsnan yod/ legs bshad kun btus kyi 'bras bur smin pa'i dpyad rtsom 'di dag gi rtsom pa po dang lhag par sgrig mkhan gyis dag bcos thengs mang byas mthar legs grub byung ba zhig yin mod/'on kyang 'di las bcos pa ma dag pa dang / dag pa bcos pa/ chad kha ma skong ba dang lhag ma ma dor ba sogs yig skyon dang tshig skyon ci yod pa ni nged rtsom sgrig pa'i las 'chor ba yin pas rnam dpyod yangs pa dag gis nor bcos gnang rgyu gal che/ gal te don skyon dang lta ba mi mthun pa yod na ni/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi 'os 'gan dang dbang cha yin pas nged rtsom sgrig pas de'i thad la dag bcos byed khul dang rig gzhung lta ba'i rang dbang 'phrog don de bas kyang med / des na ji skad du/zhib 'jug yul la bkag rgya med/ /dril sgrag byed na 'grig lam yod/ /557

ces pa ltar yin pas/ mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i rig gzhung mkhas dbang rnam pas me tog mnyam bzhad dang mkhas brgya 'gran gleng gi zlos gar ci dgar 'khyab par rigs so/ /rtsom sgrig pas/2008lo'i zla 9tshes 29la/grong khyer chen po spos ngad ldan nam rgya nag chu 'du phug nas sbyar ba'o//

dpe snyig 'gan 'khur ba/ pad+ma chul /zem/sa /mgon po skyabs/mdume shog 'char 'god pa/ garma tshe ring /si khron bod rig pa'i zhib 'jugadeb bcu ba/gtsa sgri ga nga/ ya ngas gling rdo rje/gco sgrig gzhon pa/bud dha/si khron dpe skrun chags pa/si khren mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/khreng tug sa thung par 'debs 'gan 'khri tshad yod kung sis dpar/2007lo'i zla 2par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2007lo'i zla 12par par thengs dang po dpar/dkyus ma'i par grangs/000la 130ngas(spyirnga5 34:/ dpe rtab/rnga5/ 58༄98 09 66dkyus ma'i dpe rin sgor/8000
